title: AdaTutor: Adaptive Tutoring through Pedagogical Strategy Selection
summary: Effective tutoring requires determining not only what information to provide, but also which form of assistance to deliver. A tutor may address the same student error using various pedagogical strategies, adapting its approach as the interaction progresses. We introduce Comparative Pedagogical Supervision (CPS), a training framework to learn to select the optimal strategy and feedback for student learning. We evaluate CPS on math and science reasoning datasets. After five tutoring turns, CPS outperforms the strongest fixed-strategy baselines. The learned tutor transfers across datasets, and its strategy selection can also inform a separate API-based tutor.

AI.tldr: 论文提出比较式教学监督（Comparative Pedagogical Supervision, CPS）训练框架，使辅导模型不仅决定提供什么信息，还决定以何种教学策略呈现帮助，并在数学与科学推理数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 有效辅导的关键不仅在于"给什么信息"，还在于"以何种形式给予帮助"。同一学生错误可用多种教学策略应对，且策略应随交互进程动态调整；而现有辅导系统多采用固定策略，缺乏对策略选择的显式学习。
AI.method: 提出 CPS 训练框架：以"比较"方式对教学策略与反馈进行监督学习，从候选策略/反馈中学习选择对学生学习最优的组合，并支持随辅导轮次推进动态调整策略。
AI.result: 在数学与科学推理数据集上评估：经过五轮辅导后，CPS 优于最强的固定策略基线；所学辅导模型可跨数据集迁移；其策略选择还能用于指导一个独立的基于 API 的辅导模型。
AI.conclusion: 显式学习教学策略选择比固定策略更有效，且策略知识具有可迁移性，可作为插件式信号增强外部辅导模型，说明"策略层"应与"内容层"分开建模与优化。

title: MatOS: An Agent Operating System for Materials Research
summary: Materials research relies on scattered and growing data, knowledge, and simulation tools, and a single study often spans multi-day workflows across literature analysis, computation, and experiment. Large language model agents can now retrieve materials data, operate simulation codes, and close design-synthesis-characterization loops with autonomous laboratories. However, extending these agents with new capabilities, keeping long-running tasks on track, and letting them learn from past tasks and user feedback remain difficult. Here we present MatOS, an agent operating system for materials research with three core components: (1) a layered scientific asset graph that organizes data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles, and workflows as reusable assets; (2) a stateful adaptive workflow that runs tasks as explicit execution graphs with scientific checks, so that they can be resumed and traced; and (3) evidence-driven asset evolution, which revises these assets from execution records and user feedback. On ResearchClawBench, MatOS improves on the previously best-performing agent by 11.15% with the same base model and extends the cost-score Pareto frontier. With a common base model, it outperforms Codex CLI and Claude Code, exceeding Codex CLI by 2.13% on MatTools and 4.17% on SciAgentGym. In eight research cases, MatOS narrowed more than 30 million candidate structures to 97 solid-electrolyte candidates, identified 89 halide variants with higher computed conductivity than their parent structures, linked the force errors of 11 pretrained interatomic potentials to local atomic environments, and supported two new methods that reduce errors by 3.1% and 13.6% relative to their baselines. These results show that organizing research capabilities as reusable, evolving assets enables agents to carry out long, multistage materials studies. Code is available at https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS.

AI.tldr: MatOS 是一个面向材料研究的智能体操作系统，将数据、知识、工具、技能、角色与工作流组织为可复用资产，通过分层科学资产图、有状态自适应工作流与证据驱动的资产演化三大组件，支撑长流程、多阶段材料研究任务。
AI.motivation: 材料研究依赖分散且不断增长的数据、知识与仿真工具，单一研究常横跨文献分析、计算与实验的多日工作流。现有大模型智能体虽可检索材料数据、运行仿真代码乃至闭环自主实验，但在扩展新能力、维持长任务不偏离，以及从历史任务与用户反馈中学习这三方面仍存在困难。
AI.method: 提出 MatOS，包含三部分：(1) 分层科学资产图，把数据、知识、工具、技能、角色与工作流统一建模为可复用资产；(2) 有状态自适应工作流，将任务表达为带科学校验的显式执行图，支持断点续跑与可追溯；(3) 证据驱动资产演化，依据执行记录与用户反馈对上述资产进行修订。
AI.result: 在 ResearchClawBench 上，同基座模型下较此前最佳智能体提升 11.15%，并拓展了成本—分数帕累托前沿；在同基座模型下优于 Codex CLI 与 Claude Code，在 MatTools 上超 Codex CLI 2.13%，在 SciAgentGym 上超 4.17%。八个研究案例中：从超 3000 万候选结构筛至 97 个固态电解质候选；识别出 89 个计算电导率高于母体结构的卤化物变体；将 11 个预训练原子间势的力误差关联至局域原子环境；支撑两项新方法，相对基线误差分别降低 3.1% 与 13.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将研究能力组织为可复用、可演化的资产，能够使智能体完成长周期、多阶段的材料研究。代码已开源。

title: Task Success Is Not Enough: Side-effect-Aware Evaluation of Tool-Using Language Model Agents
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 19 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables
summary: Tool-using language model agents are usually evaluated by whether they finish the user's task. That metric misses a common failure: an agent can complete the requested work while also taking an unauthorized side-effecting action, such as writing to the wrong object, expanding the scope of the request, or contacting an unintended recipient. We call this failure mode collateral damage (CD). We introduce SABench (Side-effect-Aware Benchmark), a benchmark of 201 email, calendar, and ticket tasks. Each task crosses one of four state structures (independent, dependent, externally reachable, cross-tool) with one of four trap families (ambiguity, mis-targeting, cascade harm, overreach), and each task has a deterministic trace-based oracle for both goal satisfaction and authorization compliance. Across 2,211 model-task pairs from 11 frontier LLMs spanning major commercial and open model families, 15.2% of all runs incur CD, with risk concentrated in ambiguity tasks (38.8% violation rate) while non-ambiguous traps average 8.4% CD. Among goal-satisfied runs, 12.8% still produce unauthorized writes. Cross-tool and dependent states have about twice the CD rate of independent states. CD rates vary by 4.7x across models at comparable goal rates, which suggests that task success alone is a poor proxy for safe tool use. The SABench task corpus is released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Phaedrus/sabench; the traces, oracle, code, and analysis pipeline are released at https://github.com/hjj194/sabench-artifact.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"附带损害"(collateral damage, CD)这一失败模式，即agent在完成用户任务的同时执行了未授权的副作用动作；据此构建SABench基准(201个邮件/日历/工单任务，4种状态结构×4种陷阱族，含确定性trace级oracle)，在11个前沿LLM的2,211个模型-任务对上测得15.2%的CD率，并揭示任务成功率并非安全工具使用的有效代理指标。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用型语言模型agent多以"是否完成任务"为评估标准，忽视了一种常见且危险的失败：任务虽完成，但伴随未授权的副作用行为（写错对象、扩大请求范围、联系非预期收件人等）。需要专门的度量与基准来显式刻画并量化该失败模式。
AI.method: 提出SABench基准：包含201个邮件、日历与工单任务；任务设计为4种状态结构（独立、依赖、外部可达、跨工具）与4种陷阱族（歧义、误指向、级联危害、越权）的交叉组合；每个任务配备基于确定性执行轨迹的oracle，同时判定目标满足与授权合规。评测覆盖11个前沿LLM（涵盖主流商用与开源模型家族）共2,211个模型-任务对。
AI.result: 全部运行中15.2%出现CD；风险高度集中于歧义类任务（违规率38.8%），而非歧义陷阱平均CD为8.4%。在目标已满足的运行中，仍有12.8%产生未授权写入。跨工具与依赖状态的CD率约为独立状态的两倍。在目标成功率相当的情况下，不同模型的CD率差异达4.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 仅以任务成功率衡量工具使用型agent会系统性低估安全风险，任务成功不能作为安全工具使用的代理指标；需引入副作用感知的授权合规评估。作者开源了任务语料（HuggingFace）以及轨迹、oracle、代码与分析流水线（GitHub）。

title: One Mean Log-Mel Vector per Phoneme: Simple and Fast Text Injection for Speech Recognition
summary: Text injection trains speech recognition models on unpaired text alongside paired audio. We feed the speech encoder synthetic input derived from text so the whole model learns from it. Previously, we synthesized this input with a frozen text-to-speech (TTS) model. Here, a simple lookup table replaces the TTS model: a mean log-mel vector (or one-hot encoding) per phoneme, repeated for a random duration drawn from alignment statistics, with silence between words. Training is 1.8 times faster than with the neural TTS, achieving comparable word error rates. With an external language model, our system reaches 1.36 / 2.90 / 1.52 / 3.24 % WER on LibriSpeech {dev,test}-{clean,other}, to our knowledge state-of-the-art using only LibriSpeech paired data, text, and lexicon. We analyze components of synthetic input (durations, acoustic features), compare different HMM aligners, evaluate scaling on the 25 000 h Loquacious dataset, and show that full-encoder injection yields strong relative improvements compared to partial-encoder and decoder methods. The code of the whole pipeline behind every number in this paper is public: github.com/rwth-i6/returnn-experiments/tree/master/2026-text-injection

AI.tldr: 用"每音素均值log-mel向量（或one-hot）+按对齐统计采样的随机时长+词间静音"的查表合成输入替代神经TTS做文本注入，训练速度提升1.8倍且WER相当；在LibriSpeech上配合外部LM达到1.52/3.24% WER（test-clean/other），并分析了各合成成分、HMM对齐器、大规模扩展与全编码器注入的优势。
AI.motivation: 文本注入（text injection）利用无配对文本提升语音识别，需要将文本转为语音编码器可消费的合成输入。此前依赖冻结的神经TTS模型生成该输入，成本高、管线复杂、训练慢。作者希望以极简方式替代TTS，获得同等效果的同时大幅提高训练效率，并系统验证合成输入的哪些成分真正关键。
AI.method: 提出查表式合成输入：为每个音素维护一个均值log-mel向量（或one-hot编码），按对齐统计中采样的随机时长重复展开，词间插入静音，直接送入语音编码器，使整个模型端到端从文本学习。对比实验覆盖：合成输入的时长与声学特征成分消融、不同HMM对齐器对比、在25 000 h Loquacious数据集上的扩展性评估，以及全编码器注入与部分编码器注入、解码器注入方法的比较。全部流程代码开源。
AI.result: 训练速度较神经TTS方案快1.8倍，WER相当。配合外部语言模型，在LibriSpeech {dev,test}-{clean,other}上取得1.36/2.90/1.52/3.24% WER；据作者所知，这是仅使用LibriSpeech配对数据、文本与发音词典条件下的最优结果。全编码器注入相对部分编码器与解码器方法带来显著相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 简单的查表式合成输入足以取代神经TTS用于文本注入，表明注入的有效性主要来自时长与粗略声学统计而非TTS的声学逼真度；全编码器注入优于局部注入。方法可随数据规模扩展，且全流程开源，便于复现与后续研究。

title: HobbyLM: A Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Model Family on a Hobby Budget
summary: We describe HobbyLM, a family of small sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models trained from scratch with a few hundred to a few thousand dollars of rented GPU time. The core is a decoder-only transformer with fine-grained experts, sigmoid routing with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing, grouped-query attention with per-head QK-normalization, and aMuon/AdamW optimizer split. Each of these choices was selected with a single-variable ablation suite at 130M parameters. On this architecture we train a 500M-parameter model (169M active) on 40B FineWeb tokens and post-train it into a chat model, a masked-diffusion language model, a function-calling and computer-use agent, and a single "omni" checkpoint that reads text, images, video, sound and speech through frozen encoders and small projectors. We run these models on a laptop CPU with a from-scratch Rust inference engine. Two of the authors then adopted the architecture without architectural changes to build HobbyLM-1B (1.04B total, 305M active parameters), trained on a 100B-token curated mixture with a high-quality anneal. HobbyLM-1B reaches a 47.5 average on seven zero-shot benchmarks, and its builders also release an instruction-tuned model and an on-device macOS computer-use adapter. Finally, we describe HobbyLM-Image, a 333M-parameter flow-matching diffusion transformer that generates 1024x1024 images in a 32x-compressed latent space, together with a dependency-light CPU implementation of the full text-to-image pipeline. We report what worked, what did not, and where the small-scale ceilings lie. We also state for each component which author designed or built it.

AI.tldr: 提出低成本小规模稀疏MoE模型家族HobbyLM：以130M单变量消融选定架构，训练500M（169M激活）模型并扩展到1B（305M激活，七项零样本均分47.5），并配套自研Rust CPU推理引擎、多模态"omni"变体与333M流匹配扩散图像模型。
AI.motivation: 论证在数百至数千美元租用GPU预算下，通过精心的小规模消融选型即可构建具备竞争力的小型MoE模型家族，并可在笔记本CPU上本地部署；同时报告小尺度下各组件的能力天花板与失败经验。
AI.method: Decoder-only Transformer，采用细粒度专家MoE、sigmoid路由与无辅助损失负载均衡、GQA+逐头QK归一化、aMuon/AdamW混合优化器；每项设计均在130M参数上做单变量消融。基于此训练500M（169M激活）模型，40B FineWeb token，后训练为chat、掩码扩散LM、函数调用/computer-use agent，以及通过冻结编码器+小型projector接入文本/图像/视频/声音/语音的"omni"检查点；推理用自研Rust引擎在CPU运行。作者另按原架构训练HobbyLM-1B（1.04B总参、305M激活）于100B精选混合数据并做高质量退火，另发布指令微调模型与macOS端侧computer-use适配器。图像侧为HobbyLM-Image：333M流匹配扩散Transformer，32×压缩潜空间生成1024×1024图像，附轻依赖CPU文生图流程。
AI.result: HobbyLM-1B在七项零样本基准上取得平均47.5；500M模型可完成聊天、掩码扩散、函数调用/computer-use及多模态omni多种后训练形态，并能在笔记本CPU上以自研Rust引擎运行；HobbyLM-Image可在CPU上以依赖轻量实现完成1024×1024文生图。
AI.conclusion: 低成本、单变量消融驱动的小型稀疏MoE架构具备可扩展性与多形态后训练潜力，且能在CPU端侧部署；论文同时明确报告了哪些设计有效、哪些无效以及小规模模型的能力上限，并对各组件标注了作者分工。

title: How Humans Learn Unfamiliar Worlds: A Think-Aloud Dataset on ARC-AGI-3
summary: Learning through exploration and using newly acquired knowledge to achieve goals are central capabilities of general intelligence. Understanding these capabilities requires tracing how learners build, use, and revise world models during interaction. We construct the first dataset that records how humans discover and use the mechanisms of novel environments, using ARC-AGI-3 as a testbed: 144 trajectories from 64 participants across 25 public games, each pairing time-synchronized actions with think-aloud audio, plus 250 trajectories from large language model (LLM) agents with and without harnesses on the same games. We annotate mechanism triggers and recognition, action purposes, and errors and recovery, linking changes in understanding to the observations and actions that support them. We analyze characteristics of human cognition and compare them with those of LLM agents. Both groups anticipate mechanisms and use familiar analogies. Qualitative representations are more common in successful human trajectories than in successful LLM trajectories (50.0% versus 14.3%). Humans more often explore unfamiliar situations without a concrete hypothesis, while hypothesis testing is common in both groups. We also trace how learners recover through belief revision, replanning, and execution correction. As LLMs with well-designed harnesses reach saturated performance on public ARC-AGI-3 games, our cognitive analyses motivate next-generation benchmarks that challenge familiar priors, require accumulated evidence and abstraction, and test planning through subgoals, experimentation, and recovery. Our dataset is available at [https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/](https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/).

AI.tldr: 论文构建首个基于ARC-AGI-3的人类探索与心智模型构建数据集，同步记录行为与出声思维，并与LLM智能体对比，揭示二者在质性表征、探索策略与信念修正上的差异。
AI.motivation: 理解通用智能需追踪学习者在交互中如何构建、使用和修正世界模型，但现有数据缺乏将理解变化与其支撑性观察/行动对应起来的过程性记录。
AI.method: 以ARC-AGI-3为测试平台：采集64名被试在25个公开游戏上的144条轨迹（动作与出声思维音频时间同步），以及250条LLM智能体轨迹（含/不含harness）；标注机制触发与识别、行动意图、错误与恢复，将理解变化与其观察、行动关联；分析人类认知特征并与LLM对比。
AI.result: 两组均会预判机制并使用熟悉类比；成功人类轨迹中质性表征比例显著高于成功LLM轨迹（50.0% vs 14.3%）；人类更常在没有具体假设下探索陌生情境，而假设检验在两组中均常见；并刻画了通过信念修正、重规划与执行纠错的恢复过程。
AI.conclusion: 配备良好harness的LLM在公开ARC-AGI-3游戏上已达饱和，故需下一代基准：挑战熟悉先验、要求证据积累与抽象、通过子目标—实验—恢复检验规划能力；数据集已公开。

title: WebViSE: Scaling Visual Design Intelligence from the Open Web for LLM Website Generation
summary: Large language models have made remarkable strides in website development, enabling complete and interactive web experiences to be built from natural-language instructions with far less effort. Yet, non-expert users often struggle to articulate sophisticated visual and interaction designs in natural language. Meanwhile, the open web already contains a vast reservoir of such design knowledge, embodied in mature website implementations. To this end, we introduce Website-derived Visual Skill Extraction (WebViSE), a framework that automatically abstracts these implementations into reusable Visual Skills and builds a structured Skill library. To scale the library, WebViSE organizes its Skills in a multi-parent DAG and jointly evolves Skill descriptions and DAG structure using Skill-conditioned Potential Queries, enabling efficient matching between diverse user instructions and relevant Skills. The auto-evolved structure outperforms non-hierarchical LLM retrieval baselines at only 39.09% of the estimated retrieval cost with Qwen3.8-Max. For any models, WebViSE can be directly injected as plug-and-play guidance, enabling diverse models to produce more visually compelling and aesthetically refined web pages. For open-source models, WebViSE can be used to build a data-synthesis pipeline that internalizes visual design intelligence into model weights. Experiments across multiple web development benchmarks and human evaluation consistently show that WebViSE improves the visual quality and interaction fidelity of artifacts. Overall, our work establishes an automated path for extracting, organizing, and transferring design intelligence from the open web to website-building models. We release all extracted Visual Skills, the associated Skill DAG, and our code at https://github.com/YifeiSun-0710/WebViSE.

AI.tldr: WebViSE 框架从成熟网站实现中自动抽取出可复用的"视觉技能"（Visual Skills），并组织成多父 DAG 技能库，通过技能条件化潜在查询联合进化技能描述与 DAG 结构，实现用户指令与技能的高效匹配；可插件式注入任意模型，也可用于数据合成以将设计智能内化进开源模型权重。
AI.motivation: LLM 已能依据自然语言指令快速构建完整交互式网站，但非专家用户难以用自然语言精确表达复杂的视觉与交互设计；而开放网络上已有大量成熟网站实现，蕴含丰富的设计知识。因此需要一条自动化路径，把这些设计知识从开放网络中提取、组织并迁移到建站模型中。
AI.method: 提出 Website-derived Visual Skill Extraction（WebViSE）：1）自动将成熟网站实现抽象为可复用 Visual Skills，构建结构化技能库；2）以多父 DAG 组织技能，利用 Skill-conditioned Potential Queries 联合进化技能描述与 DAG 拓扑，实现指令—技能高效匹配；3）作为 plug-and-play 提示引导注入任意模型；4）面向开源模型构建数据合成管线，将视觉设计智能内化到权重中。
AI.result: 自动进化出的技能结构在检索性能上优于非层次化的 LLM 检索基线，且使用 Qwen3.8-Max 时仅需约 39.09% 的估计检索成本；在多个网站开发基准与人工评估中一致提升生成产物的视觉质量与交互保真度。
AI.conclusion: WebViSE 建立了从开放网络提取、组织并向建站模型迁移设计智能的自动化路径；作者开源了全部提取的 Visual Skills、技能 DAG 及代码。

title: Numina Fuse: Interactive Autoformalization in Lean 4
summary: Numina Fuse is an agent-native application for formalizing mathematics in Lean 4. Since Lean can compile while not representing its intended informal meaning, and agents now write Lean faster than people can read it, we built Fuse around human supervision of agent work. A user works with an AI orchestrator on a Lean project and supervises it through views of the blueprint, the dependency graph, and the Lean code, while the backend keeps the project's derived state and runs agents for hours without the user present. We describe the development of Fuse throughout 2026, as it moved from a prescribed pipeline of agents paced by human review to an orchestrator that dispatches specialists, provers, and parallel children on its own. We designed for this shift, keeping project state, tooling, and interface design separate from orchestration so that agents could take over more of the work as models improved. We report Fuse's use in a formalization of the three-dimensional Kakeya conjecture and a study of prover models. We close with lessons for the next generation of autoformalization systems. Fuse Desktop, an open-source local version, is available at https://github.com/project-numina/fuse-desktop.

AI.tldr: Numina Fuse 是面向 Lean 4 形式化数学的智能体原生应用，核心是以人类监督智能体产出为设计前提，通过蓝图、依赖图与代码视图实现可监管的自动化形式化。
AI.motivation: Lean 可编译并不代表其形式代码符合预期的非形式数学含义，而智能体撰写 Lean 代码的速度已超过人类审阅速度，因此需要以"人类监督"而非"人类逐行审查"为中心来构建工具。
AI.method: 用户与 AI 编排器协同推进 Lean 项目，并通过蓝图、依赖图、Lean 代码三类视图进行监督；后端维护项目的派生状态，支持在用户缺席时长时间运行智能体。系统架构上把项目状态、工具链与界面设计与编排逻辑解耦，使编排从由人工评审节拍的固定智能体流水线，演进为可自主调度专家、证明器与并行子智能体的编排器。
AI.result: 报告了 Fuse 在三维 Kakeya 猜想形式化工作中的应用，以及对证明器模型的研究结果。
AI.conclusion: 总结了对下一代自动形式化系统的经验教训；并开源了本地桌面版 Fuse Desktop（https://github.com/project-numina/fuse-desktop）。

title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern
summary: Can LLM agents carry a hard real-world problem from raw data to a system that holds its own against people? We study this in Hearthstone Battlegrounds, an eight-player auto-battler with stochastic shops and battles, hidden information and nearly a thousand interacting cards. We present AutoTavern, a self-improving research system: specialised LLM research agents share a typed research memory, every claim passes verification gates, and live games close the loop, so the agents improve the simulator, opponents and policy and, from the same feedback, their own research process; a human sets goals and rules on ambiguous mechanics. In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym, the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent, trained with PPO against opponents calibrated to real games. TavernAgent plays complete games on the live ladder by itself: its rating rose from 6,000 to about 15,000 and, on the public leaderboard's measure, its last 20 records average a placement of 1.60 with 80% first places, better than the server's ten highest-rated players on every statistic (2.34, 59%). TavernBench, 960 tasks in 40 scenarios, shows that the system the agents built is the strongest player: TavernAgent answers 91% of the play tasks against at most 63% for frontier LLMs, and decides in 0.03 s where they need up to 26 s; within the second a live turn allows, it keeps 90% and no LLM more than 26%. LLM agents build far better than they play. We will open-source TavernBench and TavernGym at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern.

AI.tldr: 提出自改进研究系统 AutoTavern，由多个专门化 LLM 研究智能体组成，共享类型化研究记忆、以验证门控保证声明可靠性，并通过实时对局闭环反馈同时改进模拟器、对手、策略与自身研究流程；20 天内从原始数据构建出完整复现的 TavernGym 模拟器与 23 版 TavernAgent，后者在实战天梯排名指标上超越服务器前十名玩家，并在 TavernBench 上以 91% 对 63% 大幅领先前沿 LLM。
AI.motivation: 本文考察 LLM 智能体能否将高难度真实世界问题从原始数据推进到可与人类竞争的系统。选取炉石传说酒馆战棋（8 人自动战斗、随机商店与战斗、隐藏信息、近千张交互卡牌）作为测试床，因为该任务同时具备随机性、不完全信息与组合爆炸，单靠 LLM 的即时推理难以胜任，需要端到端"研究+工程+训练+部署"能力。
AI.method: 系统层面：专业化 LLM 研究智能体共享类型化研究记忆；每条声明须通过验证门控；实时对局构成闭环，使智能体迭代改进模拟器、对手与策略，并从同一反馈中改进研究过程；人类只负责设定目标与裁定歧义机制。产出层面：(1) TavernGym——首个忠实、全内容的在线游戏复现；(2) TavernAgent——以 PPO 针对标定至真实分布的对手训练，共 23 个版本；(3) TavernBench——40 个场景、960 个任务的基准。
AI.result: TavernAgent 可自主在实战天梯完成完整对局，评分由 6,000 升至约 15,000；按公开排行榜口径，其最近 20 局平均名次 1.60、80% 第一名，各项统计均优于服务器评分最高的十名玩家（2.34、59%）。TavernBench 上 TavernAgent 解出 91% 的操作任务（前沿 LLM 至多 63%），决策耗时 0.03 s 对比其最高 26 s；在实时单回合 1 秒预算内保持 90%，而所有 LLM 不超过 26%。
AI.conclusion: LLM 智能体"构建系统"的能力显著强于其"直接游玩"的能力；通过研究记忆、验证门控与真实环境闭环，LLM 智能体可在数十天内将复杂现实问题推进到超越人类顶尖水平。作者将开源 TavernBench 与 TavernGym。

title: Rectified Language Flow
summary: Continuous-state flow and diffusion models offer a promising approach to fast, parallel language generation, but matching the generation quality of autoregressive models remains challenging. We present Rectified Language Flow (ReLF), a language model that generates text by transporting noise to token embeddings using rectified flow. ReLF combines several complementary design choices: fixed token embeddings constructed with Hellinger-SVD, self-conditioning guidance trained with cross-entropy, and regularized reflow for few-step generation. We further introduce singular logits, which combine an analytically computed term that drives commitment to a valid token embedding as noise vanishes with a bounded neural residual that learns contextual token preferences. With 64 function evaluations on OpenWebText, ReLF achieves lower generative perplexity than autoregressive baselines at matched diversity across all three model sizes tested, while also outperforming prior continuous flow methods in this setting. After two reflow rounds, ReLF still outperforms autoregressive baselines with 16 function evaluations while generating 1,024-token sequences 15-19 times faster at batch size 1.

AI.tldr: ReLF 用 rectified flow 把噪声传输到 token 嵌入来生成文本，结合 Hellinger-SVD 固定嵌入、自条件引导、正则化 reflow 与 singular logits，在 OpenWebText 上以 64 NFE 在同等多样性下生成困惑度优于自回归基线，两轮 reflow 后仅需 16 NFE 仍优于基线且快 15-19 倍。
AI.motivation: 连续状态流与扩散模型有望实现快速、并行的语言生成，但其生成质量仍难以匹配自回归模型；作者希望弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 提出 Rectified Language Flow（ReLF）：用 rectified flow 将噪声传输至 token 嵌入；采用 Hellinger-SVD 构造固定 token 嵌入；以交叉熵训练自条件引导；用正则化 reflow 支持少步生成；并引入 singular logits——由解析项（在噪声消失时驱动收敛到合法 token 嵌入）与有界神经残差（学习上下文相关的 token 偏好）组合而成。
AI.result: 在 OpenWebText 上，64 次函数评估（NFE）时，三种模型规模在同等多样性下生成困惑度均低于自回归基线，并优于已有连续流方法；经两轮 reflow 后，16 NFE 仍优于自回归基线，且在 batch size 1 下生成长度 1024 的序列速度快 15-19 倍。
AI.conclusion: ReLF 表明连续流语言模型可在保持生成质量领先的同时实现显著加速，为高质量、少步、并行的语言生成提供了可行路径。

title: Unlocking the Specialization Capability of PPG Foundation Models for Wearable Signals through Structured Pruning and Adaptive Fine-Tuning
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) plays a central role in wearable health monitoring and clinical decision support. However, existing approaches to universal PPG representation learning are predominantly trained on high-quality large-scale datasets obtained from oximeters in hospital settings and often struggle to adapt to sparse and low-quality real-world datasets, thereby limiting their generalization to clinically relevant tasks on prevalent PPG data such as collected from wearable devices. Surprisingly, even after full fine-tuning, PPG foundation models cannot consistently outperform general-purpose time-series models. Therefore, a key question is how to effectively adapt PPG foundation models to target prediction tasks. Through empirical studies on various PPG foundation models, we find that pretrained models often exhibit inherent sparsity and computational redundancy, suggesting that PPG foundation models have learned to activate task-relevant network substructures for different prediction tasks. To preserve this valuable prior knowledge, we propose a structured pruning-and-fine-tuning framework, SPAFT, which regularizes the adaptive fine-tuning process by constraining it to a more relevant and compact parameter space based on parameter importance and structural redundancy. Extensive experiments across four PPG foundation models, five benchmark datasets, and ten downstream tasks demonstrate that SPAFT achieves win rates of 82.8% and 87.5% on regression and classification tasks, respectively. This prune-then-finetune paradigm often enables PPG foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance, laying a promising foundation for the real-world clinical deployment of PPG foundation models and the development of personalized PPG foundation models.

AI.tldr: 针对PPG基础模型（foundation model）在真实低质量可穿戴数据上泛化不佳、全量微调后仍难以稳定超越通用时序模型的问题，作者通过实证发现预训练模型存在固有的稀疏性与计算冗余，并据此提出结构化剪枝-微调框架SPAFT，在参数重要性与结构冗余约束的相关紧凑参数空间内进行自适应微调。在4个PPG基础模型、5个基准数据集、10个下游任务上，SPAFT在回归/分类任务上分别取得82.8%和87.5%的胜率，常达到SOTA水平。
AI.motivation: 现有PPG通用表征学习大多基于医院血氧仪采集的高质量大规模数据训练，难以适应稀疏、低质量的真实世界数据，因而对视可穿戴设备采集的常见PPG数据的临床相关任务泛化受限；更令人意外的是，即使经过全量微调，PPG基础模型也无法稳定优于通用时序模型。因此核心问题是：如何将PPG基础模型有效适配到目标任务。
AI.method: 对多种PPG基础模型进行实证研究，发现预训练模型呈现固有的稀疏性与计算冗余，说明其已学会针对不同预测任务激活与任务相关的网络子结构。为保留这一有价值的先验知识，提出结构化剪枝-微调框架SPAFT：基于参数重要性与结构冗余，将自适应微调过程约束到更相关、更紧凑的参数空间，从而对微调进行正则化。
AI.result: 在4个PPG基础模型、5个基准数据集和10个下游任务上开展大量实验，SPAFT在回归任务上胜率达82.8%，在分类任务上胜率达87.5%。
AI.conclusion: "先剪枝后微调"（prune-then-finetune）范式常使PPG基础模型达到最先进的性能，为PPG基础模型在真实世界的临床部署以及个性化PPG基础模型的开发奠定了基础。

title: PACE: Research Proving Agent for Adaptive Conjecture Exploration
summary: Many mathematical research agents focus on solving problems with fixed statements. However, conjecture research, especially in applied mathematics, may require revising candidate questions or conclusions as investigation proceeds, coupling problem formulation with proof development. We present PACE, a research-proof agent that supports this process through a structured research loop that selects mathematical objectives and develops or challenges candidate mechanisms. The whole prover constructs proofs from these mechanisms, and an independent verifier checks them against the original target. Evidence-tracking memory stores assumptions and dependencies arising during research and marks evidence for revalidation when a candidate or condition changes. This memory supports task-specific context composition that keeps checked premises, exploratory material and unresolved obligations distinct. To evaluate proof construction and conjecture research, we introduce ResearchProofBench, an applied-mathematics benchmark focused on optimization, comprising 51 known-proof tasks with 331 hidden checkpoints under historical abstract access and six open-problem cases. The known-proof tasks assess reconstruction of published results, while the open-problem cases assess mathematical investigation and proof development. On the 51 known-proof tasks, PACE achieves an aggregate Proof Score of 75.16 and completes 20 proofs. In conjecture research, PACE develops conditional results, with its submissions receiving higher review scores than the compared baselines.

AI.tldr: PACE 是一个支持"问题表述—证明开发"耦合的研究型证明智能体，通过结构化研究循环、证据追踪记忆与独立验证器构建证明，并在新基准 ResearchProofBench 上取得 Proof Score 75.16、完成 20 个证明，且在开放问题研究中获得优于基线的评审分数。
AI.motivation: 现有数学研究智能体多针对表述固定的问题求解；而应用数学中的猜想研究常需随研究推进修订候选问题或结论，使问题表述与证明开发相互耦合，现有方法难以支撑这一过程。
AI.method: 提出 PACE：以结构化研究循环选择数学目标，并发展或质疑候选机制；整体证明器基于这些机制构造证明，独立验证器对照原始目标进行校验；证据追踪记忆记录研究中的假设与依赖，在候选或条件变更时标记需重新验证的证据，并支持任务特定上下文组合，将已检验前提、探索性材料与未解决义务区分开。同时构建 ResearchProofBench 基准（优化方向，51 个已知证明任务、331 个隐藏检查点、历史摘要访问设置，另有 6 个开放问题案例）。
AI.result: 在 51 个已知证明任务上，PACE 聚合 Proof Score 达 75.16，完成 20 个证明；在猜想研究中产生条件性结果，提交内容获得高于对比基线的评审分数。
AI.conclusion: 将问题表述与证明开发耦合的研究循环、证据追踪记忆及独立验证机制，可有效支持应用数学中的证明重建与开放问题探索，PACE 在已知证明与猜想研究两类任务上均优于基线。

title: SWE-Ladder: Learning to Localize, Reproduce, and Patch via Progressive Privileged Self-Distillation
summary: Resolving a repository-level issue typically requires a software-engineering (SWE) agent to localize the faulty code, reproduce the failure, and patch the code. Reinforcement learning trains such agents from a single test result on the final patch, while on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adds token-level supervision from a teacher with privileged evidence, exposing the full reference patch at every step. Neither provides stage-specific guidance for localization or reproduction. We propose SWE-Ladder, which turns the verified repair of each training instance into stage-specific evidence: the changed files and lines for localization, the fail-to-pass tests for reproduction, and the diff for patching. A rule-based router assigns each step of an end-to-end rollout to a stage based on its tool call, a frozen teacher sees only the matching evidence, and the stages are distilled in repair order while GRPO optimizes the full trajectory. With Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on SWE-bench Verified under the R2E-Gym scaffold, SWE-Ladder improves pass@1 from 9.6% to 16.4%, compared with 10.4% for GRPO and 12.4% for OPSD with the full patch. Under the OpenHands scaffold, it improves pass@1 from 13.0% to 17.6%. Reversing the stage order under R2E-Gym reduces pass@1 to 11.4%.

AI.tldr: 提出 SWE-Ladder，将已验证的修复拆解为定位、复现、打补丁三阶段的证据，配合规则路由器与冻结教师做分阶段自蒸馏，并用 GRPO 优化完整轨迹；Qwen3-4B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上 pass@1 由 9.6% 提升至 16.4%（R2E-Gym）/13.0%→17.6%（OpenHands）。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 仅用最终补丁的单一测试结果作为奖励，OPSD 则对每一步都提供完整参考补丁的 token 级监督，二者都缺乏针对定位与复现等中间阶段的定向指导，导致训练信号与仓库级问题求解的多阶段流程不匹配。
AI.method: 把每个训练实例的已验证修复转化为阶段专属证据：定位用变更文件与行，复现用 fail-to-pass 测试，打补丁用 diff。规则路由器依据工具调用将端到端 rollout 的每一步归入相应阶段，冻结教师只看到与该阶段匹配的证据，按“修复顺序”（定位→复现→打补丁）分阶段蒸馏，同时用 GRPO 优化整条轨迹。
AI.result: R2E-Gym scaffold 下，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 在 SWE-bench Verified 上 pass@1 从 9.6% 升至 16.4%，优于 GRPO 的 10.4% 与使用完整补丁的 OPSD 的 12.4%；OpenHands scaffold 下由 13.0% 升至 17.6%。将阶段顺序反转后 pass@1 降至 11.4%。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段、证据受限的蒸馏监督比整体补丁监督更有效；阶段顺序具有实质影响，按修复流程推进蒸馏是关键，且方法在不同 scaffold 上具备可迁移性。

title: AlphaIdeaBench: Benchmarking Automated Research Idea Generation under Feasibility Constraints with Peer Review Alignment
summary: Research ideas are always proposed under resource constraints: a plan must fit the available compute, API credit, and time. Yet evaluations of research-ideation agents mostly score unconstrained novelty or overlap with a published paper, and their LLM judges are rarely checked against peer review. We introduce AlphaIdeaBench, a benchmark of 100 ideation tasks (50 workshop calls for papers and 50 open problems stated in surveys), each paired with an explicit resource budget and a shared proposal schema. An LLM judge scores each proposal on 12 dimensions covering validity, novelty, and feasibility. To validate the judge, we compare its scores on four novelty axes (problem, method, scenario, and insight) with scores derived from reviewer comments on 600 papers from ICLR 2026, NeurIPS 2025, and ICML 2025. For problem and method novelty, Gemini 3.7 Flash is within one point of the reviewer-derived score on 94-97% of papers; agreement on scenario novelty is relatively lower. We evaluate eight published harnesses on a shared backbone and, within one harness, eight backbone LLMs. CoI-Agent obtains the highest overall score, narrowly ahead of SciMON, which leads on method and insight novelty. All harnesses score low on scenario novelty and rarely change the problem setting. The backbone largely determines which open problem a proposal targets, whereas the harness determines whether a proposal addresses one problem or combines several. Weaker backbones such as Llama 4 Scout fail to carry out that harness's strategy and score low on budget feasibility. Finally, when only the budget is varied on three topics, a larger budget changes the experimental setting on compute-intensive topics but only adds tests on an inexpensive one. We release the tasks, rubrics, and scores to foster standardized, reproducible benchmarking of future research-ideation agents under constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出AlphaIdeaBench：100个带显式资源预算与统一提案格式的研究构想任务，配套12维LLM评审量表，并用审稿意见校准评委；评测8个harness与8个骨干模型，发现整体方案差异小、场景新颖性普遍偏低，骨干决定选题、harness决定单/多问题整合，预算变化影响随任务成本而异。
AI.motivation: 现有研究构想智能体评测多只打「无约束新颖性」或与已发表论文的重叠度，忽视构想本身在算力、API额度、时间约束下产生这一现实前提；且所用LLM评审员很少与同行评审结果做一致性校验。
AI.method: 构建AlphaIdeaBench：50个研讨会征稿议题+50个综述中的开放问题，每项任务配显式资源预算与共享提案schema。用LLM评审按12个维度（有效性、新颖性、可行性）打分；以ICLR 2026、NeurIPS 2025、ICML 2025共600篇论文的审稿意见反推问题/方法/场景/洞见四个新颖性轴分数，作为评委校准依据。同一骨干上评8个已发表harness，同一harness内评8个骨干LLM；另在3个主题上仅变动预算做受控实验。
AI.result: 评委校准：问题与方法新颖性上Gemini 3.7 Flash与审稿导出分数在94–97%论文上差距≤1分，场景新颖性一致性相对较低。harness对比：CoI-Agent总分最高，SciMON紧随其后并在方法新颖性、洞见新颖性上领先；所有harness场景新颖性得分低、极少改变问题设定。骨干对比：骨干主要决定提案针对哪个开放问题，harness决定是聚焦单一问题还是组合多问题；弱骨干（如Llama 4 Scout）无法执行harness策略，预算可行性得分低。预算消融：在计算密集型主题上增大预算会改变实验设定，在低成本主题上仅增加测试数量。
AI.conclusion: 资源约束下的构想能力是当前智能体的短板，尤其场景新颖性；新颖性主要由骨干决定、构想组织方式主要由harness决定，且存在骨架能力门槛。论文开源任务、评分细则与分数，以支持在约束下开展标准化、可复现的研究构想智能体基准评测。

title: CoEvolve: Counterfactual-Guided Co-Evolution of Memory and Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks. Yet their memory and collaboration architectures often remain static, constraining continued adaptation and improvement over time. Recent work addresses this limitation by evolving memory or collaboration based on interaction experience. However, updates to these interdependent components are not necessarily aligned: an evolved workflow may require experience that memory does not provide, while evolved memory may encode guidance that the workflow cannot use. To address this problem, we propose CoEvolve, a skill-centered framework for aligned memory--collaboration evolution. CoEvolve represents reusable local collaboration patterns as skills that link evolving collaboration decisions to their supporting memories. It further compares original and counterfactual trajectories to identify local evolution signals, which coordinate updates to the skill library, skill memory, and executor memories across rounds. Experiments on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks confirm that CoEvolve achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated baselines, while ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of aligned co-evolution and counterfactual-guided evolution.

AI.tldr: CoEvolve 提出以"技能"为中心的框架，将可复用的局部协作模式表示为技能，用以对齐 LLM 多智能体系统中记忆与协作的演化，并通过反事实轨迹对比生成局部演化信号来协调技能库、技能记忆与执行者记忆的更新。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的多智能体系统其记忆与协作架构多为静态，限制持续适应；虽有工作基于交互经验分别演化记忆或协作，但二者相互依赖却未必对齐——演化后的工作流可能需要记忆未提供经验，演化后的记忆也可能编码了工作流无法使用的指导。
AI.method: 提出 CoEvolve 框架：将可复用局部协作模式抽象为"技能"，把演化中的协作决策与其支撑记忆关联；通过比较原始轨迹与反事实轨迹识别局部演化信号，跨轮次协调技能库、技能记忆和执行者记忆的更新。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 基准上，CoEvolve 在所评估基线中取得最佳整体性能；消融实验验证了对齐式协同演化与反事实引导演化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以技能为中介可有效对齐记忆与协作的协同演化，反事实引导的局部信号是驱动该演化的关键机制。

title: SkillShift-Bench: Benchmarking Skill Learning under Environment Evolution for Web Agents
comment: 70 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
summary: Skill learning enables web agents to reuse prior experience for long-horizon interactive tasks. However, learned skills are typically evaluated in closed environments, overlooking the fact that real-world web deployment involves continuous shifts in invocation context, perceptual grounding, and execution feasibility. To this end, we introduce SkillShift-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating skill learning with controlled open-environment shifts. SkillShift-Bench simulates Contextual Shift, Perceptual Shift, and Execution Shift across three self-hosted web systems, and evaluates agents with diagnostics covering task success, interaction cost, skill use, and skill failure. Comprehensive experiments reveal systematic robustness degradation under controlled shifts, characterized by lower success rates, higher interaction costs, and more frequent skill failures, with Execution Shift exerting the strongest pressure. We further formulate shifted skill execution as a nonstationary local executability problem and provide both a dynamic-regret analysis and a practical test-time adaptation method, demonstrating the feasibility of improving learned-skill execution without relearning the skill library. Code, tasks, environments, documentation, and the leaderboard are available at https://skillshift-bench.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向开放环境受控偏移的技能学习评测基准 SkillShift-Bench，系统揭示技能鲁棒性退化，并将偏移下的技能执行形式化为非平稳局部可执行性问题，给出动态遗憾分析与测试时自适应方法。
AI.motivation: 现有学到的网页技能通常在封闭环境中评测，忽略真实部署中调用上下文、感知接地与执行可行性的持续变化，导致技能复用能力的评估失真。
AI.method: 构建 SkillShift-Bench，在三个自托管网页系统上模拟上下文偏移、感知偏移与执行偏移；设计涵盖任务成功率、交互成本、技能使用与技能失败的诊断指标；并将偏移下的技能执行建模为非平稳局部可执行性问题，提出动态遗憾分析与无需重学技能库的测试时自适应方法。
AI.result: 实验显示受控偏移下出现系统性鲁棒性退化：成功率下降、交互成本上升、技能失败更频繁，其中执行偏移压力最大；测试时自适应可在不重训技能库的前提下改善技能执行。
AI.conclusion: 开放环境偏移是网页智能体技能学习的关键缺口，需以受控基准与诊断指标衡量鲁棒性，并可通过测试时自适应缓解退化。

title: Benchmarking System One Models for Time-Series Decision Making: A Case Study of Jev
summary: Time-series tasks require both accurate predictions and fast decisions. Advances in large models have introduced decision-oriented models that directly output answers and their probabilities, which we call Structured System 1 models. Their applicability to time-series tasks remains underexplored. Using Jev 1.13.0 as a case study, we evaluate time-series classification, event type prediction, oil temperature direction and stock movement prediction, converting continuous forecasting targets into discrete decisions to fit the model interface. We establish a unified evaluation framework using accuracy and AUC. Results show stronger performance on selected explicit temporal patterns and event type prediction, but near-chance discrimination on many numerical sequence classification tasks and stock movement prediction. Some datasets also reveal a gap between ranking quality and final decision accuracy. These findings motivate improvements in temporal representation, domain adaptation, and decision-score alignment. Standardized sample construction, model calls, and result recording support extending the evaluation to future models.

AI.tldr: 本文以Jev 1.13.0为例，系统评估"结构化系统1模型"（直接输出答案及概率的决策导向大模型）在时间序列任务上的适用性。
AI.motivation: 时间序列任务既需准确预测又需快速决策；大模型催生了直接输出答案及概率的决策导向模型（结构化系统1模型），但其在时间序列任务上的适用性研究不足，且现有评估缺乏标准化框架。
AI.method: 以Jev 1.13.0为案例，选取时序分类、事件类型预测、油温方向预测与股票走势预测任务，将连续预测目标离散化为决策以适配模型接口；构建统一评估框架，采用准确率与AUC两项指标，并标准化样本构造、模型调用与结果记录流程。
AI.result: 在部分显式时间模式任务与事件类型预测上表现较强；但在许多数值序列分类任务及股票走势预测上判别能力接近随机水平；部分数据集上还出现排序质量与最终决策准确率之间的不一致（AUC与准确率脱节）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化系统1模型在时间序列任务上适用性有限，需从时序表示、领域适应与决策分数对齐三方面改进；标准化流程可支持将评估扩展到未来模型。

title: How To Build A Modern Diffusion Language Model
summary: The frontier of large language model (LLM) performance has advanced rapidly in recent years, fueled by scaling laws for pretraining on large text corpora. However, mainstream LLMs have fundamental limitations: they generate text autoregressively, producing outputs sequentially from left to right one token at a time. This sequential process leaves parallel GPU hardware underutilized during inference--a bottleneck that has grown acute as progress shifts toward scaling post-training and inference-time compute--and commits irreversibly to each token without the ability to revise earlier mistakes. Discrete diffusion models address these limitations by generating tokens in parallel, starting from a noisy or masked sequence and iteratively refining the entire output over a series of denoising steps. This parallel generative process enables speeds of thousands of tokens per second, provides a new axis of inference-time compute scaling, and supports built-in error correction and controllable generation. Over the past two years, discrete diffusion has scaled to billions of parameters across biological sequence modeling and natural language, with open-weights and commercial releases from leading labs. This article provides a survey of key ideas in discrete diffusion and a high-level introduction to how modern diffusion LLMs are built, covering their foundations, core algorithmic and architectural building blocks, applications in biology and language, and implications for future LLM scaling laws.

AI.tldr: 该综述文章围绕离散扩散模型（discrete diffusion）展开，介绍其如何通过并行生成与迭代去噪克服自回归LLM的顺序生成瓶颈，并系统梳理其基础理论、核心算法与架构模块、在生物序列与自然语言中的应用，以及对未来LLM缩放定律的影响。
AI.motivation: 主流LLM采用从左到右的逐token自回归生成，导致推理时GPU并行硬件利用率低；随着后训练与推理时计算的扩展，这一瓶颈愈发突出；且每个token一经生成便不可撤销，无法修正早期错误。离散扩散通过并行生成与迭代精炼为上述问题提供解决思路。
AI.method: 文章为综述性质：以离散扩散为核心，首先阐释其基本原理（从含噪或掩码序列出发，经多步去噪迭代精炼整个输出），随后介绍现代扩散LLM的构建方式，涵盖基础理论、核心算法与架构构件，并对比离散扩散与自回归生成范式。
AI.result: 离散扩散具备多重优势：生成速度可达每秒数千token；提供推理时计算扩展的新维度；内建纠错能力与可控生成能力。过去两年，离散扩散已在生物序列建模与自然语言任务上扩展至数十亿参数规模，并有领先实验室发布的开源权重与商业版本。
AI.conclusion: 离散扩散已成为可扩展至数十亿参数、在生物与语言领域均有实际落地的生成范式，可作为自回归LLM的替代或补充路径，并对未来LLM缩放定律的研究具有重要启示。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Mechanical Engineering: Foundations, Opportunities, Challenges, and Responsibilities
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping mechanical engineering (ME), from modeling, simulation, and optimization to diagnostics, design, and technical communication. Drawing on a round-table at the 28th ABCM International Congress on Mechanical Engineering (COBEM 2025), this article presents a structured perspective for the Brazilian and international ME communities. Rather than an exhaustive survey, it examines how AI can enhance engineering practice without compromising scientific rigor. We distinguish statistical learning from human cognition and discuss the capabilities, limitations, and emerging agentic forms of AI. We then consider industrial adoption, workforce changes, and AI-assisted scientific discovery, alongside the energy and infrastructure demands of AI computation and their implications for sustainability and thermal management. The discussion emphasizes the integration of physical knowledge, structured reasoning, and domain expertise into AI systems, particularly in safety-relevant applications. Topics include physics-informed and hybrid learning, physically constrained modeling, validation, uncertainty quantification, and certification. We also examine educational, epistemological, and ethical challenges, including curriculum reform, human-agent collaboration, professional accountability, and the preservation of engineering knowledge. We conclude with principles for responsible AI adoption in ME: physical consistency, rigorous validation, explicit treatment of uncertainty, energy sustainability, human oversight, and ethical responsibility. AI should complement, not replace, engineering judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文基于COBEM 2025圆桌讨论，提出人工智能（AI）在机械工程（ME）中负责任应用的结构化观点，强调AI应增强而非取代工程判断。
AI.motivation: AI正重塑机械工程从建模、仿真、优化到诊断、设计与技术交流的各环节，巴西及国际ME学界需要一个兼顾实践效益与科学严谨性的立场框架，以避免过度炒作、明确AI能力边界。
AI.method: 采用圆桌讨论形成的结构化综述视角（非穷尽性调研）：区分统计学习与人类认知，剖析AI的能力、局限与新兴的智能体（agentic）形态；从工业采纳、劳动力变化、AI辅助科学发现、算力能耗与基础设施需求等维度展开；重点讨论将物理知识、结构化推理与领域专家知识融入AI系统。
AI.result: 归纳了物理信息与混合学习、物理约束建模、验证、不确定性量化与认证在安全相关应用中的关键作用，并识别出课程改革、人机协作、职业问责、工程知识传承等教育与认识论、伦理层面的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 提出ME中负责任AI采纳的六项原则：物理一致性、严格验证、显式不确定性处理、能源可持续性、人类监督与伦理责任；AI应补充而非替代工程判断。

title: SKALOS: Learning to Distinguish Similar Skills with Capability Graphs
summary: Skills provide LLM agents with reusable procedural knowledge, making appropriate skill selection essential for reliable agent behavior. As skill libraries expand, distinguishing semantically similar candidates becomes increasingly difficult. Existing methods encode or rewrite skill descriptions for relevance-based ranking, yet heterogeneous descriptions can obscure capability differences. To address this challenge, we propose SKALOS, a graph-native reranker that compares skills via explicit capability evidence. Its multi-hierarchy graph aligns equivalent expressions across skills while preserving skill-specific capability evidence. Since individually relevant capability elements may not jointly support a query, semiring-based capability witness learning scores each branch by its weakest evidence, checks joint support for the extracted requirements within one implementation, and selects the strongest alternative. To reduce the influence of extraction errors, we develop ranking-feedback graph calibration that adjusts unreliable evidence for candidate comparison. Experiments on SkillRet show that SKALOS improves NDCG@10 by 2.68 percentage points over a matched text-only reranker. Witness-guided skill selection also increases ALFWorld task success rate from 22% to 29%.

AI.tldr: 提出图原生重排序器SKALOS，通过显式能力证据对比技能，解决大规模技能库中语义相似技能难以区分的问题。
AI.motivation: 技能库扩展后，语义相似的候选技能难以区分；现有方法仅对技能描述做编码或改写以进行相关性排序，而异构描述会掩盖能力差异。
AI.method: 构建多层级图，对齐技能间的等价表达并保留技能特有的能力证据；采用基于半环的能力见证学习，按最弱证据对分支打分、检验提取需求在单一实现中的联合支持并选出最强替代；引入排序反馈图校准以降低抽取错误影响。
AI.result: 在SkillRet上NDCG@10相比匹配的纯文本重排序器提升2.68个百分点；见证引导的技能选择使ALFWorld任务成功率从22%提升至29%。
AI.conclusion: 以显式能力证据与联合支持检验为核心的图原生重排序，可有效提升技能检索排序与下游智能体任务表现。

title: Movable-Element Multi-Functional RIS-Assisted Hybrid RSMA-NOMA: A Constrained Hybrid Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: In this work, we propose a movable-element (ME) multi-functional reconfigurable intelligent surface (MF-RIS) architecture, termed MM-RIS, which integrates element mobility with adaptive signal reflection, transmission, amplification, and energy harvesting (EH) to enhance communication flexibility and energy self-sustainability. A hybrid rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) and non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) transmission scheme is further designed to improve spectral efficiency. We formulate an energy efficiency (EE) maximization problem by jointly optimizing transmit beamforming, power and rate allocation, MM-RIS configurations, panel deployment, and ME positions. To address the resulting non-convex mixed continuous-discrete optimization problem, we propose constrained hybrid deep reinforcement learning with federated transformer and parametrized sharing (CRAFTS). CRAFTS integrates multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO) and multi-agent deep Q-networks (MADQN) through bi-directional parametrized sharing to handle continuous and discrete actions, respectively. Moreover, a transformer-based architecture and federated learning (FL) are incorporated to enhance state representation and distributed knowledge sharing, whilst a Lagrangian-based adaptive penalty mechanism facilitates the constraint satisfaction. Simulation results have demonstrated that the proposed MM-RIS architecture and CRAFTS framework substantially improve EE and constraint satisfaction compared to the benchmarks in the open literature. Moreover, the results validate the benefits of spatially reconfigurable MM-RIS, hybrid RSMA-NOMA transmissions, and intelligent collaborative learning, highlighting the potential of the proposed framework for energy-efficient and adaptive next-generation wireless networks.

AI.tldr: 提出可移动单元多功��RIS（MM-RIS）架构与CRAFTS混合深度强化学习框架，联合优化波束成形、功率/速率分配、面板部署与单元位置以最大化能效。
AI.motivation: 提升通信灵活性与能量自持续性，同时提高频谱效率与能效，满足下一代无线网络对自适应、节能的需求。
AI.method: MM-RIS集成单元移动性与反射、传输、放大、能量收集多功能；设计混合RSMA-NOMA传输方案；将EE最大化建模为联合优化问题（含混合连续-离散变量），提出CRAFTS：MAPPO与MADQN经双向参数共享分别处理连续/离散动作，结合Transformer状态表示、联邦学习知识共享及基于拉格朗日的自适应惩罚机制满足约束。
AI.result: 仿真显示所提MM-RIS与CRAFTS在能效和约束满足度上显著优于文献基准，并验证了空间可重构、混合RSMA-NOMA与协同学习的增益。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具备用于高能效、自适应下一代无线网络的潜力。

title: How Much Information Can We Fit inside a Transformer?
summary: How efficiently can transformers store factual knowledge? The answer to this question has implications for both model design and understanding the limits of transformer-based systems. Prior studies observe a linear relationship between the number of facts memorized and the number of model parameters required, substantially worse than what theoretical analyses predict is achievable. We re-examine empirical scaling: through rigorous and systematic experiments, including extensive hyperparameter search via Bayesian optimization, we determine the smallest model that can perfectly memorize a given set of facts, and measure how this minimum size scales with the number of facts. On synthetic datasets of random, independent (subject, relation, object) triples---e.g., (Paris, capital_of, France) ---drawn at random with no exploitable structure, we find that memorization capacity, the size of the largest dataset that a model memorizes completely, grows exponentially with the transformer dimension. Equivalently, the minimum transformer dimension $d_{\min}$ required to memorize $N$ facts grows logarithmically in $N$. Across 11 dataset sizes spanning $N = 45$ to $49{,}920$, a lack-of-fit F-test does not reject the logarithmic fit (with an offset), but it does reject all other tested alternatives including power-law. Along the depth axis, however, at fixed width, the maximum memorizable dataset size grows sublinearly with the number of layers over the measured range. We further extend our exploration to structured data containing symmetric relations or two-hop composition. In this setting, we find that transformers exploit these regularities to further improve capacity. All code to reproduce our results is available at https://github.com/Magronox/transformer_information_capacity.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视Transformer事实存储的经验标度律，通过严格实验与贝叶斯超参搜索确定记忆给定事实集的最小模型，发现记忆容量随维度呈指数增长（即最小维度随事实数对数增长），深度方向则为次线性增长，且结构化数据（对称关系、两跳组合）可被利用以进一步提升容量。
AI.motivation: 既有研究观察到存储事实数与所需参数量呈线性关系，远劣于理论分析预测的可达效率，这既影响模型设计也关系到对Transformer系统能力上限的理解，因此需要更严谨地重新测量经验标度。
AI.method: 在无结构可exploit的随机独立(subject, relation, object)三元组合成数据集上，通过系统性实验与贝叶斯优化进行广泛超参搜索，确定能完美记忆给定事实集的最小模型，并测量该最小规模随事实数的变化；用lack-of-fit F检验比较对数、幂律等候选拟合形式；另沿深度轴固定宽度测量，并扩展到含对称关系与两跳组合的结构化数据。
AI.result: 记忆容量（可被完全记忆的最大数据集规模）随Transformer维度指数增长；等价地，记忆N条事实所需最小维度d_min随N对数增长。在N=45至49,920的11个数据集规模上，带偏移的对数拟合未被lack-of-fit F检验拒绝，而幂律等其他备选均被拒绝。固定宽度下，可记忆最大数据规模随层数在测量范围内呈次线性增长。结构化数据中，Transformer能利用对称关系与两跳组合等规律进一步提升容量。
AI.conclusion: Transformer的事实记忆容量在维度上呈指数标度、在深度上呈次线性标度，优于先前观察到的线性参数标度，并表明模型可利用数据规律性提高记忆效率；代码已开源以便复现。

title: CaliMem: Search-Efficient Data Agent via Calibrated Memory
summary:
Data curation is a first-order design choice in machine learning, yet tailoring training data to a downstream model and task remains costly in labor, expertise, and compute. Datasets are therefore often processed through fixed pipelines and reused across applications. We show that this assumption is fragile: across 55 dataset--model tasks spanning biological domains, the same curation recipe can help one model while hurting another. Effective curation must adapt to the downstream setting, motivating automated search over data recipes. We first build an agentic system that searches for curation policies at deployment, improving data utility via \textit{test-time curation (TTC)}. Although achieving performance gains, its search is driven largely by recent feedback and remains local. Adding persistent memory helps the agent retain evidence across iterations and reveals a deeper problem: it forms claims that extend beyond the conditions in which they were observed, sometimes abandoning an entire strategy after a single unsuccessful trial.
  To address this problem, we introduce CaliMem, a calibrated-memory agentic loop that requires the agent to predict the outcome of each proposed policy before executing it. Comparing this prediction with the observed result gives the agent a \textit{reality check} on the claims behind its proposal. It uses the prediction error to retain supported claims, revise mistaken ones, and specify the conditions under which a conclusion holds. This makes the agent's beliefs testable, reduces overgeneralization, and supports more effective long-horizon exploration. Across biological and LLM post-training tasks, CaliMem consistently outperforms fixed curation baselines and published methods, and exceeds full-data training by up to 19.4\%. Code is open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 数据策划（curation）应随下游模型与任务自适应；作者提出智能体式的测试时策划（TTC），并进一步提出带校准记忆的 CaliMem 循环：先预测策略效果再执行，用预测误差修正信念、限定结论适用条件，从而减少过度泛化、支持长程探索。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集通常经固定流水线处理并跨应用复用，但作者在 55 个跨生物领域的数据集—模型任务中发现同一策划配方可能对某模型有益、对另一模型有害，说明固定流程假设脆弱，需按下游设定自适应并自动搜索数据配方；同时已有智能体搜索受近期反馈驱动、易形成超出观测条件的过度概括结论。
AI.method: 先构建部署时搜索策划策略的智能体系统（TTC）；再加入持久记忆以跨迭代保留证据；进而提出 CaliMem——校准记忆智能体循环，要求智能体在执行每个候选策略前先预测其结果，将预测与实测比较形成"现实检验"，并依据预测误差保留有支持的论断、修正错误论断、明确结论成立的条件。
AI.result: 在生物领域与 LLM 后训练任务上，CaliMem 稳定优于固定策划基线及已发表方法，相较全量数据训练最高提升 19.4%；TTC 本身即可提升数据效用，但检索仍偏局部。
AI.conclusion: 数据策划是一阶设计选择而非固定预处理；显式预测—验证的校准记忆机制可使智能体信念可检验、降低过度泛化，并支撑有效的长程探索，代码已开源。

title: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses
summary: Agent harnesses enable large language models to act through tools, observe the results, and iteratively work toward a task goal. Verification checks and revises agents' work to improve output quality. Yet there is limited guidance on how harnesses should organize this effort. We study verification as an axis of test-time scaling by examining when to intervene, who checks the work, and how checking leads to revision. Our framework spans four layers of the agent lifecycle: initial instructions, mid-turn reminders, completion gates, and independent review. We compare 17 designs across seven frontier coding models on Terminal-Bench (TB) and SWE-bench Verified (SWE), and introduce VisualBench for expert evaluation of visual and interactive artifacts. Initial instructions and execution-time reminders yield modest, model-dependent average gains on the coding benchmarks, without substantially increasing average output token use. Completion gates can yield larger gains but may substantially increase cost. Independent review by a critic offers a more favorable accuracy-cost tradeoff, improving average accuracy by 5.9-9.5 percentage points on TB and 3.9-6.6 on SWE at 1.13-1.25 and 1.00-1.04 times baseline cost, respectively. On VisualBench, independent review achieves net preferences of 13.2-23.8 points over the baseline across its four designs, exceeding the evaluated L0-L2 designs. Additional review rounds or independent critics further improve average TB accuracy by up to 3.5 percentage points. Together, these results provide empirical guidance for verification design in agent harnesses and support independent review as a practical axis of test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文把验证视为测试时扩展的一个轴，系统比较17种验证设计在7个前沿编码模型上的效果，发现独立的批评者评审在精度-成本权衡上最优。
AI.motivation: Agent harness虽能通过工具执行和验证改进输出质量，但缺乏关于如何组织验证工作的指导：何时介入、由谁检查、检查如何促成修订。
AI.method: 提出覆盖agent生命周期四个层面的框架（初始指令、轮次中提醒、完成门控、独立评审），在Terminal-Bench与SWE-bench Verified上对7个前沿编码模型的17种设计进行对比，并引入VisualBench进行专家评估。
AI.result: 初始指令与执行期提醒带来温和且依赖模型的平均增益，且不明显增加输出token；完成门控增益更大但成本显著上升；独立评审精度-成本权衡最优，TB平均精度提升5.9-9.5个百分点、SWE提升3.9-6.6个百分点，成本分别为基线1.13-1.25倍与1.00-1.04倍；VisualBench上独立评审四种设计净偏好13.2-23.8点，超过L0-L2设计；增加评审轮次或独立批评者可再提升TB平均精度最多3.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究为agent harness中的验证设计提供实证指导，并支持将独立评审作为测试时扩展的一种实用轴。

title: SearchHorizonBench: A Benchmark for Search Value in AI Agents
summary: AI agents must decide when another search is worth its cost. Answer-success probabilities capture question difficulty, while this decision requires estimating the additional benefit of search. We introduce SearchHorizonBench, a benchmark for learning and evaluating search value from execution experience. Paired continuations and repeated executions separate expected search gain from generation noise and connect prediction quality to decision utility. The resource contains 45,632 executions across 3,168 questions. On 1,632 held-out questions, historical calibration reduces Brier error by 16.2%, with the improvement concentrated in success-level information. Search gains have a standard deviation of 21.4 percentage points, and tested historical estimators explain less than 2% of this variance in point estimates. Matched-configuration learning curves probe this distinction across training scales. At the reference token price, free selection observations yield a 2.49-point utility opportunity over the best constant action, driven primarily by gain information. Reusable histories, frozen splits, strong baselines and scoring tools provide a common foundation for developing and evaluating value-aware search agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 SearchHorizonBench 基准，从执行经验中学习与评估"搜索价值"：用配对续写与重复执行将预期搜索增益与生成噪声分离，并将预测质量与决策效用挂钩；在 1,632 道留出题上历史校准使 Brier 误差降低 16.2%，且增益信息带来 2.49 个百分点的决策效用机会。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体需决策"再做一次搜索是否值得其成本"。答案成功概率刻画的是问题难度，而该决策真正需要的是对搜索额外收益（增益）的估计，二者并不等价，现有评测缺乏对此的测量基础。
AI.method: 构建 SearchHorizonBench：含 3,168 道问题、45,632 次执行；采用配对续写与重复执行解耦期望搜索增益与生成噪声；设置冻结划分、可复用历史、强基线与评分工具；用 Brier 误差评估预测质量，用决策效用衡量价值；并用匹配配置下的学习曲线在不同训练规模上考察该区分。
AI.result: 留出 1,632 题上，历史校准使 Brier 误差下降 16.2%，改进集中于成功层信息；搜索增益标准差达 21.4 个百分点，而所测历史估计器在点估计上仅解释不足 2% 的方差；在参考 token 价格下，自由选择观测相对最优常数动作产生 2.49 点效用机会，主要由增益信息驱动。
AI.conclusion: 成功概率与搜索增益是可区分的信息源，当前估计器几乎无法捕捉增益方差，而增益恰是决策效用的主要来源；该基准为开发与评估"价值感知"的搜索智能体提供了统一基础。

title: Curriculum-Guided Acquisition of Hierarchical Task Knowledge from LLM-Generated Experience
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Presented at the Thirteenth Annual Conference on Advances in Cognitive Systems (ACS 2026)
summary: Hierarchical task knowledge enables efficient problem solving by allowing previously acquired skills to be reused across tasks and problem instances. In this paper, we investigate curriculum-guided acquisition of hierarchical task knowledge in an HTN learning framework. We compare three approaches: online learning during problem solving, human-designed curricula, and an automated curriculum generation procedure that derives learning experiences from verified LLM-generated solution traces. The proposed procedure solves small training problems with an LLM, extracts task accomplishment information, and transforms it into ordered sequences of state-task learning problems for HTN method acquisition. We evaluate the three approaches across multiple planning domains. The results demonstrate that automatically generated curricula recover much of the benefit of expert-designed curricula while substantially reducing the token cost of online hierarchical knowledge acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文在HTN学习框架中比较了三种分层任务知识获取方式：求解中在线学习、人工设计课程、以及从经校验的LLM生成解轨迹中自动生成课程；实验表明自动生成课程在多个规划域上可恢复专家课程的多数收益，并显著降低在线学习的token开销。
AI.motivation: 分层任务知识可通过复用已获技能提升问题求解效率，但如何在HTN学习框架中高效获取这类知识、以及课程设计（人工 vs. 自动）的作用缺乏系统比较；在线学习直接求解学习代价高。
AI.method: 对比三种方法：(1) 问题求解过程中的在线学习；(2) 人工设计课程；(3) 自动课程生成——用LLM求解小规模训练问题，抽取任务完成信息，转化为有序的状态-任务学习问题序列，用于HTN方法（method）习得。
AI.result: 在多个规划域上的评估显示，自动生成课程能恢复专家设计课程的相当大部分收益，同时大幅降低在线分层知识获取的token成本。
AI.conclusion: 以验证过的LLM解轨迹为来源的自动课程生成，是替代人工课程、降低在线学习成本的有效途径，可支撑HTN分层任务知识的高效获取。

title: OS-Wizard: Scaling Computer-Using Agents to Specialized Software via Knowledge-Guided Exploration
summary: Computer-using agents are increasingly capable of performing complex tasks in the digital world. However, high-quality interaction trajectories remain scarce for specialized desktop applications, where limited application knowledge, cumbersome GUI workflows, and incomplete exploration hinder automated collection. We introduce OS-Wizard, an automated trajectory collection framework. It combines tutorial-guided exploration with a hybrid GUI--Code action space, providing application-specific knowledge and simplifying GUI workflows through direct execution of application-native commands. The framework also checkpoints and revisits pivotal states during tree exploration to explore alternative workflows, complementing linear rollouts for broader coverage. We collect 10.9K trajectories comprising 54.9K state--action samples. Fine-tuning open-source base models on this corpus yields a best-performing model that improves performance on a benchmark of specialized desktop workflows by 58.2 percentage points to 64.1\%, surpassing reported human performance of 59.8\% and establishing a new state of the art. The fine-tuned model also improves performance on general desktop workflows using GUI actions only, suggesting that the collected supervision benefits general desktop tasks as well. Comparative experiments and ablations demonstrate the efficiency of trajectory collection and the importance of code actions.

AI.tldr: 提出自动化轨迹采集框架OS-Wizard，结合教程引导探索、GUI-Code混合动作空间与树式检查点重访，采集10.9K轨迹（54.9K状态-动作样本），微调后模型在专业桌面任务基准上提升58.2个百分点达64.1%，超越报告的59.8%人类表现，创下新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 专业桌面应用的交互轨迹稀缺：应用知识有限、GUI工作流繁琐、探索不完整，导致自动化采集困难。
AI.method: OS-Wizard自动化轨迹采集框架：(1) 教程引导的探索，注入应用专有知识；(2) 混合GUI–Code动作空间，通过直接执行应用原生命令简化GUI流程；(3) 在树搜索中对关键状态做检查点与重访，探索替代工作流，与线性rollout互补以扩大覆盖。基于该语料微调开源基座模型。
AI.result: 采集10.9K条轨迹、54.9K状态-动作样本；微调后最佳模型在专业桌面工作流基准上提升58.2个百分点至64.1%，超过人类报告的59.8%；仅用GUI动作在通用桌面任务上亦有提升。对比实验与消融验证了采集效率与代码动作的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 教程引导+混合GUI-Code动作+检查点重访可高效获得高质量轨迹；所采监督对专业及通用桌面任务均有迁移收益，代码动作是性能提升的关键。

title: Distilling Expert Judgment at Scale
summary: Frontier AI models are increasingly deployed on topics where the stakes are high and expert judgment is required, including healthcare, defense, finance, governance, and politics. We present a general methodology for distilling expert human judgment into automated evaluation systems that operate at scale. Our approach assembles networks of domain experts and develops techniques for extracting not just their conclusions but their reasoning processes, encoding those processes into structured editorial standards that automated judges can apply continuously. We ground our approach in a long tradition of research on the nature of expertise and the conditions under which expert judgment is reliable and more effective than other approaches, and argue that independent, expert-calibrated evaluation is necessary not only on epistemic grounds but as a matter of accountability and public trust. We validate the methodology on AI news reporting as a first application domain. On source quality, two independent domain experts achieve Krippendorff's $α= 0.83/0.69$ on a held-out test set when applying the editorial standards, and our automated judge reaches $F1 = 0.81/0.97$ against expert consensus. On neutrality, experts achieve $α= .72$ on the test set, and the automated judge reaches $F1 = 0.86$ against expert consensus. Additionally, a controlled comparison shows that expert-calibrated judges substantially outperform uncalibrated frontier models on every source-quality metric, demonstrating that encoding expert reasoning is the critical step that prompt engineering alone cannot replace. We present this benchmark as a proof of concept for a broader evaluation infrastructure applicable to any domain where judgment matters and expertise is scarce.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将人类专家判断蒸馏为可规模化自动评测系统的方法：组建专家网络、抽取其推理过程并编码为结构化编辑标准，使自动评审器可连续应用。以AI新闻报道为首个验证领域。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型 increasingly 被部署于医疗、防务、金融、治理等高风险、需专家判断的领域，亟需既独立、又经专家校准、且可规模化的评测；作者认为这不仅是认识论上的必要，也是问责与公众信任的要求。
AI.method: 方法论层面：组建领域专家网络，设计技术抽取专家不仅结论、更包括其推理过程，将推理编码为结构化编辑标准，供自动评审器持续应用；理论根植于关于专长本质及专家判断何时可靠的既有研究。验证层面：以AI新闻报道为应用场景，在留出测试集上检验专家间一致性（Krippendorff's α）与自动评审器对专家共识的F1，并设受控对比检验“专家校准评审器 vs. 未校准前沿模型”。
AI.result: 来源质量维度：两位独立专家 α=0.83/0.69，自动评审器对专家共识 F1=0.81/0.97；中立性维度：专家 α=0.72，自动评审器 F1=0.86。受控对比显示，专家校准评审器在全部来源质量指标上显著优于未校准前沿模型，表明编码专家推理是提示工程无法替代的关键步骤。
AI.conclusion: 该基准可作为更广泛评测基础设施的概念验证，适用于任何“判断重要而专长稀缺”的领域。

title: Isharah-Selfie: Continuous Sign Language Recognition Dataset for One-handed Signing
summary: Current sign language recognition and translation benchmarks are commonly collected in controlled settings using fixed or studio-style cameras, particularly limiting their ability to reflect how signers communicate in everyday mobile scenarios. As such, this gap becomes increasingly evident when considering the Arabic Sign Language (ArSL), which is a primary sign language used across Arab countries. In this work, we introduce Isharah-Selfie, a large-scale ArSL dataset collected entirely using front-facing smartphone cameras under unconstrained selfie conditions. The dataset comprises 8,997 video clips performed by 16 signers across 1,493 unique sentences, covering several domains such as healthcare, education, and transportation. Unlike conventional datasets dominated by fixed-camera, two-handed signing, Isharah-Selfie captures realistic mobile communication characterized by one-handed signing, close-range viewpoints, partial body visibility, camera motion, unconstrained environments, and heterogeneous device resolutions. Each video is annotated with both gloss sequences for continuous sign language recognition (CSLR) and Arabic sentence translations for sign language translation (SLT). Moreover, we define signer-independent and unseen-sentences evaluation protocols to assess generalization across unseen signers and novel sentence compositions. Extensive benchmarks using RGB-based and pose-based data show that current CSLR and SLT methods remain challenged by selfie-style signing conditions, particularly under unseen-sentence evaluation, where compositional generalization remains weak. By releasing Isharah-Selfie, we aim to support research toward robust, user-centered sign language technologies that operate reliably in realistic smartphone-based communication settings. The Isharah-Selfie dataset is available on https://isharah-selfie.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Isharah-Selfie，一个完全用前置手机摄像头在无约束自拍条件下采集的大规模阿拉伯手语数据集（8,997个视频片段、16名手语者、1,493个独特句子），并给出CSLR与SLT基准评测。
AI.motivation: 现有手语识别与翻译基准多在固定或演播室摄像头的受控环境下采集，难以反映日常移动通信场景；对阿拉伯手语（ArSL）而言这一缺口尤为明显。
AI.method: 构建Isharah-Selfie数据集：前置手机摄像头、无约束自拍条件采集，覆盖医疗、教育、交通等领域；视频具备单手打手语、近距离视角、部分身体可见、相机运动、异构分辨率等特点；每条视频同时标注gloss序列（用于CSLR）与阿拉伯语句子翻译（用于SLT）。并定义signer-independent与unseen-sentences两种评测协议。
AI.result: 基于RGB与姿态（pose）数据的广泛基准实验表明，现有CSLR与SLT方法在自拍式手语条件下仍面临挑战，尤以unseen-sentences评测下的组合泛化能力最弱。
AI.conclusion: 发布Isharah-Selfie以推动面向真实智能手机通信场景的鲁棒、以用户为中心的手语技术研究；数据集已在项目主页公开。

title: The Future Is Finer: Multivariate Time Series Super-Resolution Forecasting
summary: Web platforms run on multivariate time series, from service telemetry and Web traffic logs to sensor streams served through Web APIs. Yet, retention policies often archive them at coarse granularity to save storage and bandwidth. Decisions such as autoscaling, alerting, and billing operate at finer granularity than existing forecasters reach, since these models predict at the resolution of their input. We therefore introduce Multivariate Time Series Super-Resolution Forecasting (MTS-SRF), which forecasts fine-grained futures from coarse histories, and propose TimeMagnifier to address its three challenges. Fourier Anchor counters data sparsity by fitting each input window to a trend-Fourier structure with sparse cross-variable gating; De-noise Only constrains fine-grained ambiguity by refining along the resolution axis rather than the noise axis, lengthening the grid level by level; and banded DTW Alignment corrects cross-resolution misalignment against the coarse forecast. On the first MTS-SRF benchmark, with ten datasets from five domains, real archived cross-resolution pairs, strengthened baseline adaptations, and five-seed significance tests, TimeMagnifier is best on every dataset, resolution coefficient, and metric against 15 baselines and cuts MSE by 12.3% on average. Its De-noise Only and DTW stages also transfer as a plug-in that lowers the MSE of existing forecasters by 5.1% to 9.0%. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该文提出多变量时间序列超分辨率预测（MTS-SRF）任务，即由粗粒度历史预测细粒度未来，并给出TimeMagnifier模型，在首个MTS-SRF基准上全面领先15个基线，平均降低MSE 12.3%。
AI.motivation: Web平台的多变量时间序列（服务遥测、Web流量日志、Web API传感器流）常因存储与带宽限制被以粗粒度归档，而自动扩缩容、告警、计费等决策所需的粒度比现有预测模型更细，因现有模型只能按输入分辨率预测，故需从粗历史预测细未来。
AI.method: TimeMagnifier针对三大挑战设计：（1）Fourier Anchor，以趋势-傅里叶结构拟合输入窗口并结合稀疏跨变量门控应对数据稀疏；（2）De-noise Only，沿分辨率轴逐级加长网格细化，而非沿噪声轴去噪，以约束细粒度歧义；（3）banded DTW Alignment，对齐粗粒度预测以校正跨分辨率错位。
AI.result: 构建首个MTS-SRF基准：5个领域10个数据集、真实归档的跨分辨率数据对、强化的基线适配与五种子显著性检验。TimeMagnifier在所有数据集、分辨率系数和指标上均优于15个基线，平均MSE降低12.3%；其De-noise Only与DTW阶段可作为插件迁移，使现有预测器MSE降低5.1%–9.0%。
AI.conclusion: 粗历史到细未来的超分辨率预测是可定义且可解的任务，TimeMagnifier通过频域锚定、分辨率轴细化与跨分辨率对齐有效解决稀疏、歧义与错位问题，且其关键模块具备良好通用性与可插拔性。代码将公开。

title: ConMem: Counterfactual Multi-Scenario Probing for Resolving LLM Memory Misalignment
summary: Long-term memory is critical for autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents executing multi-session, long-horizon tasks. However, existing memories often inappropriately store, retain, or retrieve over-generalized, misattributed, or privacy-sensitive information, a problem we term memory misalignment. To study this problem, we construct \textbf{MemAlign}, a benchmark comprising 1,079 curated memory cases grounded in synthetic, validated multi-session conversational contexts covering diverse misalignment taxonomies. We then propose ConMem, an algorithm that reframes retention decisions as prospective counterfactual causal inference. \textbf{ConMem} synthesizes counterfactual interaction scenarios to prospectively audit downstream intervention effects across three aspects: relevant task execution, irrelevant invariance checks, and risk-sensitive boundary shifts. Experiments show that ConMem outperforms other methods, achieving 75.16\% accuracy, 64.15\% balanced accuracy, and a Macro-F1 of 65.31\%, effectively mitigating over-retention biases without sacrificing personalization utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"记忆错位"问题并构建MemAlign基准（1,079个多会话记忆案例），同时提出ConMem算法，将记忆保留决策重构为前瞻性反事实因果推断，通过合成反事实交互场景审计下游干预效应，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆对执行多会话、长时程任务的自主LLM智能体至关重要，但现有记忆机制常不当地存储、保留或检索过度泛化、错误归因或隐私敏感的信息（即"记忆错位"），缺乏系统性研究与评测手段。
AI.method: 1）构建MemAlign基准，包含1,079个精选记忆案例，基于合成的、经验证的多会话对话上下文，覆盖多样的错位分类体系；2）提出ConMem算法，将记忆保留决策重构为前瞻性反事实因果推断，合成反事实交互场景，从相关任务执行、无关不变性检验、风险敏感边界偏移三方面前瞻性审计下游干预效应。
AI.result: ConMem取得75.16%准确率、64.15%平衡准确率、65.31% Macro-F1，优于其他方法，在不牺牲个性化效用的前提下有效缓解过度保留偏差。
AI.conclusion: 记忆错位是LLM智能体长期记忆的关键问题；以反事实因果推断视角进行前瞻性记忆保留决策，可在保持个性化价值的同时提升记忆对齐质量。

title: TempShap: When and How Much a Feature Matters in Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Attribution for a time-series forecaster should answer two questions that a feature-level scalar cannot: when in the input window a feature acts, and how much its influence changes across the forecast horizon. Most existing Shapley explainers treat each feature as one player and therefore collapse both axes. We propose TempShap, a retrospective, loss-based Shapley framework whose players are the individual input cells $(t,i)$. Its attribution tensor yields temporal-localization and horizon-impact profiles. We validate these against planted temporal structures, a tractable exact cell game, and a closed-form attribution oracle for a real linear forecaster. Permutation sharing estimates the cell-level game at localized perturbation cost. Under redundant inputs, one-at-a-time scores under-credit substitutable information, whereas the signed Shapley decomposition preserves total value and yields more reliable held-out deletion rankings under mean masking. A planted counterexample isolates the redundancy mechanism. Experiments show a deletion-ranking advantage across Shapley estimators, forecasting benchmarks, and model families. TempShap therefore makes fine-grained Shapley attribution both practical and operationally useful.

AI.tldr: 提出 TempShap：以输入单元 (t,i) 为玩家的回溯式、基于损失的 Shapley 框架，输出归因张量，可同时刻画时间定位与预测期影响剖面，并经多类验证证实在删除排序上优于逐特征标量归因。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测器的归因需回答标量特征归因无法回答的两个问题：某特征在输入窗口的何时起作用，以及其影响在预测期内如何变化。现有 Shapley 解释器将每个特征视为单一玩家，从而同时坍缩了时间轴与预测期轴。
AI.method: 构建 TempShap：玩家定义为单个输入单元 (t,i)，采用回溯式、基于损失的 Shapley 框架，得到归因张量并导出时间定位剖面与预测期影响剖面；用置换共享（permutation sharing）以局部化扰动代价估计单元级博弈。验证手段包括植入时间结构、可精确求解的单元博弈、以及真实线性预测器的闭式归因 oracle；并用植入反例隔离冗余机制。
AI.result: 归因能正确恢复植入的时间结构并与精确单元博弈、闭式 oracle 一致；在冗余输入下，逐一（one-at-a-time）得分低估可替代信息，而有符号 Shapley 分解保持总价值，在均值掩码下给出更可靠的留出删除排序；跨多种 Shapley 估计器、预测基准与模型族均显示删除排序优势。
AI.conclusion: TempShap 使细粒度 Shapley 归因既可行又具操作价值，为时间序列预测提供了兼顾时间定位与预测期影响的可解释性工具。

title: Estimation of Propagated Risk in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) based multi-agent systems introduce a distinctive reliability challenge in which actions taken by upstream agents can affect the correctness of downstream agents. While prior work has investigated error propagation and developed methods for estimating uncertainty inherited from upstream agents, existing approaches do not explicitly model how realized sender-receiver interactions contribute to downstream error risk under different sender correctness states. In this work, we study agent-level error-risk estimation from multi-agent execution traces. We propose Interaction-Effect Propagation (IE-Prop), an interaction-conditioned model that learns separate effects for correct and incorrect upstream agents. For each sender-receiver interaction, the model combines these conditional effects using the sender's estimated error risk, and recursively propagates the resulting risk estimates through the execution graph. We evaluate our approach across three multi-agent architectures and three benchmarks. Across all evaluated architectures, our approach raises the final-node AUROC over the established baseline by approximately 0.05 points on average. Furthermore, tracking risk across multiple agent steps contributes a distinct +0.03 AUROC gain in sequential systems. These results show that realized inter-agent interactions provide predictive information beyond receiver-local evidence, while the value of multi-step risk tracking depends on the system's information-flow structure.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出交互效应传播（IE-Prop），一种以交互为条件、分别学习上游代理“正确/错误”两种状态下对下游影响的多智能体误差风险估计模型，并在三种架构、三个基准上使末端节点AUROC平均提升约0.05。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统存在独特可靠性问题：上游代理的行为会影响下游代理的正确性，形成误差传播。已有工作虽研究误差传播并估计从上游继承的不确定性，但未显式建模在发送方不同正确性状态下、实际发生的发送—接收交互如何贡献下游误差风险。
AI.method: 从多智能体执行轨迹中进行代理级误差风险估计。IE-Prop对正确与错误的上游代理分别学习条件化交互效应；对每个发送—接收交互，用发送方的估计误差风险对两种条件效应进行组合，并将所得风险估计沿执行图递归传播。
AI.result: 在三种多智能体架构与三个基准上评估：所有架构中末端节点AUROC较既有基线平均提升约0.05；在顺序式系统中，跨多个代理步骤追踪风险额外带来+0.03 AUROC增益。
AI.conclusion: 实际发生的代理间交互提供了超越接收方局部证据的预测信息；而多步风险追踪的价值取决于系统的信息流结构。

title: Seeing the Options: Typed Decisions over Visual Candidates with Reusable Option Memory
summary: Typed decision-making tasks in agents, such as UI element selection, product recommendation, and chart matching, require models to choose from a set of discrete candidates. While prior work demonstrates that text-only System One models achieve four key properties including candidate-order invariance, scalability, and cache reuse via separate request-candidate encoding, extending them to multimodal settings where candidates are visual remains underexplored. We introduce Iris, a framework that accommodates image, text, or hybrid candidates while preserving the core decision module. We prove that order invariance and exact cache reuse hold for any per-candidate encoder under Iris, and derive the closed-form latency reduction. We construct a visual-candidate benchmark from Multimodal-Mind2Web (K=16, deduplicated, order-shuffled, three generalization splits). Independent encoding (Iris) achieves 78.4 / 72.1 / 74.8 percent accuracy with zero-flip rate under candidate reordering. Joint encoding reaches 90.6 / 89.5 / 91.6 percent but suffers an 8 to 10 percent answer-flip rate when shuffled. To bridge this gap, we propose a design that encodes each candidate conditioned on the request state without inter-candidate cross-attention; it preserves strict order invariance, enables forked cache sharing, and attains 91.7 / 86.5 / 90.0 percent accuracy at one-third of OneJev latency with calibrated null probabilities (AUROC 0.93 to 0.97). Reusing image candidates across requests cuts latency by 37x at K=256 and 191x at K=2048. On MetaEncoder benchmarks, Iris-4B achieves 100 percent on JevBench original and easy, outperforming 30B MetaEncoder and 27B OpenJev. Finally, we resolve a systems bottleneck on Ampere GPUs: reformulating Qwen3.5 patch-embedding Conv3d into its exact matrix-product form accelerates processing by 350x. Code, data, and checkpoints: https://github.com/lllfx/Iris.

AI.tldr: Iris 框架将具备候选顺序不变性与缓存复用等特性的 System One 式选择决策模型扩展到多模态候选场景，在多模态 Mind2Web 视觉候选基准上兼顾高准确率与严格顺序不变性，并大幅降低延迟。
AI.motivation: UI 元素选择、商品推荐、图表匹配等类型化决策任务需要模型从离散候选中做选择。已有工作证明纯文本 System One 模型（候选与请求分离编码）具备顺序不变性、可扩展性与缓存复用等四项特性，但候选为视觉内容的多模态扩展仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 提出 Iris 框架，支持图像、文本及混合候选并保留核心决策模块；证明在任意单候选编码器下顺序不变性与精确缓存复用成立，并给出延迟缩减的闭式解。构建基于 Multimodal-Mind2Web 的视觉候选基准（K=16，去重、顺序打乱、三种泛化划分）。对比独立编码与联合编码，并提出"以请求状态为条件、无候选间交叉注意力"的编码设计，支持分叉缓存共享。
AI.result: 独立编码准确率为 78.4/72.1/74.8%，重排序下零翻转；联合编码达 90.6/89.5/91.6% 但重排后有 8–10% 答案翻转率。所提设计达 91.7/86.5/90.0%，延迟为 OneJev 的三分之一，零概率校准良好（AUROC 0.93–0.97）；跨请求复用图像候选在 K=256 时降低延迟 37 倍、K=2048 时 191 倍。MetaEncoder 基准上 Iris-4B 在 JevBench original 与 easy 上达 100%，超过 30B MetaEncoder 与 27B OpenJev。此外将 Qwen3.5 的 patch-embedding Conv3d 重写为精确矩阵乘形式，在 Ampere GPU 上加速 350 倍。
AI.conclusion: Iris 在保持严格顺序不变性与缓存复用的前提下，以接近联合编码的准确率显著降低延迟，验证了多模态候选选择中"请求—候选分离编码"范式的有效性，并在基准与系统工程层面取得双重收益。

title: More: Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving training improves the performance of agents on difficult tasks through verifiable feedback, but it often applies costly deliberation uniformly across tasks. To address this problem, we propose Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort (MORE), a self-evolving training framework that adaptively selects both reasoning form and computational effort for each task. Specifically, MORE follows a two-stage training paradigm: (i) \emph{Stage 1} establishes a compact prior over direct answering, short and long chain-of-thought, and code-based reasoning, and (ii) \emph{Stage 2} self-evolves this prior with Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO (MATE-PPO) on generated, verifiable task streams without curated data. By learning mode selection and token expenditure jointly, MORE allocates concise reasoning to tasks that permit it while retaining extended deliberation where it is useful. Across coding, mathematics, and general-reasoning benchmarks, MORE achieves consistent performance gains on Base and Coder backbones at model scales from 3B to 14B. During inference, MORE demonstrates higher accuracy and better efficiency, with markedly shorter response lengths and reduced inference time.

AI.tldr: 提出MORE，一种自适应选择推理形式与计算量的自演化训练框架，两阶段训练后在3B–14B模型上兼顾精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化训练（依赖可验证反馈）虽能提升难题表现，但对所有任务统一施加高成本推理，造成计算浪费；需要按任务难度自适应分配推理形式与算力。
AI.method: 两阶段范式：Stage 1 在直接作答、短CoT、长CoT与代码化推理上建立紧凑先验；Stage 2 用模式自适应与测试时算力PPO（MATE-PPO）在自动生成的可验证任务流上自演化，无需人工精选数据，联合学习推理模式选择与token开销。
AI.result: 在代码、数学与通用推理基准上，Base与Coder骨干、3B至14B规模均取得稳定性能提升；推理阶段精度更高、响应长度显著缩短、推理时间减少，效率更优。
AI.conclusion: 将推理形式与计算预算纳入自演化训练的统一决策，可实现"按需思考"，在保持难题长推理能力的同时降低总体推理成本，为高效自适应推理提供可行路径。

title: Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neurons for Event-Driven Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on dense, continuous-valued computation presents a fundamental challenge for energy-constrained deployment. Inspired by the sparse, event-driven signaling and temporal integration mechanisms of biological neurons, a promising alternative is to introduce spiking computation into VLA models. However, enabling such computation without restructuring pretrained policies or compromising closed-loop control remains an open challenge. To address this challenge, we introduce the Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (PoT-LIF) neuron, which emits signed spikes with power-of-two amplitudes. By combining magnitude-coded spike events with residual-preserving membrane dynamics, PoT-LIF enables continuous information to be progressively represented through discrete spikes. The Heartbeat formulation further localizes this process within weighted projections, bridging biologically inspired spiking computation and pretrained VLA architectures without modifying their external inference interfaces. We integrate PoT-LIF into the vision projection, vision-language projection, and action projection of $π_{0.5}$ and evaluate both operating modes over 2,000 paired closed-loop LIBERO episodes per configuration. Standard-mode PoT-LIF VLA achieves success rates of 96.90% and 96.35% at $T = 1$ and $T = 2$, respectively, while Heartbeat mode achieves 97.25% and 96.90% at $T = 2$ and $T = 4$, compared with 96.70% for the original continuous-activation $π_{0.5}$ baseline. At $T = 1$ with a 60.01% firing rate, PoT-LIF uses approximately 1/7.67 of the dense-reference arithmetic energy, corresponding to a modeled reduction of 86.95%.
