summary: EEG visual decoding remains difficult because scalp recordings are noisy, spatially coarse, and variable across trials and subjects. Most systems align each trial with a dense image embedding, although that embedding mixes semantic content with instance-specific texture, pose, and background. This target can demand details absent from EEG and provides no explicit account of the visual factors supporting a prediction. We propose \textbf{ProtoEEG}, a prototype-mediated framework that reformulates EEG--image alignment as soft composition over a shared learnable visual codebook. A trainable EEG encoder and a frozen visual teacher produce assignment distributions over the same $K=64$ prototypes. Their weighted reconstructions form a structured representation for retrieval and image generation. Prototype contrast supplies the main cross-modal training signal, distribution alignment coordinates codebook use across modalities, an instance anchor preserves fine-grained discrimination, and diversity regularization prevents redundant prototypes. The shared assignment profile also makes the learned bottleneck directly testable through prototype retention, random selection, and identity shuffling. Across five seeds, ProtoEEG reaches 64.0\% Top-1 and 91.5\% Top-5 on THINGS-EEG2 200-way retrieval. After retraining on EEG-ImageNet, it obtains 44.8\% Top-1 and 73.8\% Top-5 in 80-way retrieval. ProtoEEG also ranks first on all seven reconstruction metrics. Removing prototype contrast lowers Top-1 by 56.9 percentage points, while shuffling prototype identities reduces it to 0.5\%. Prototype analyses further show distributed assignments and broad codebook use rather than one-prototype routing. These results support structured alignment targets as a practical alternative to increasing encoder or teacher capacity alone.

AI.tldr: 提出 ProtoEEG：将 EEG–图像对齐重构为对共享可学习视觉码本（K=64 原型）的软组合，通过原型对比、分布对齐、实例锚定与多样性正则实现结构化对齐，在 THINGS-EEG2 200 类检索达 64.0% Top-1/91.5% Top-5，并验证原型瓶颈的可解释性。
AI.motivation: EEG 视觉解码受头皮记录噪声大、空间分辨率低、跨试次与跨被试变异影响；现有系统多以稠密图像嵌入为对齐目标，而该嵌入混合了语义内容与实例级纹理、姿态、背景，要求 EEG 中不存在的细节，且无法显式说明支撑预测的视觉因素。
AI.method: 构建可训练 EEG 编码器与冻结视觉教师，二者对同一 K=64 可学习原型集输出分配分布，并以加权重建构成用于检索与图像生成的结构化表示。损失由四部分构成：原型对比为主跨模态信号，分布对齐协调跨模态码本使用，实例锚定保留细粒度判别性，多样性正则避免原型冗余。共享分配画像使瓶颈可直接检验（原型保留、随机选择、身份打乱）。
AI.result: 五个随机种子下 THINGS-EEG2 200 类检索 64.0% Top-1、91.5% Top-5；迁移至 EEG-ImageNet 后 80 类检索 44.8% Top-1、73.8% Top-5；七项重建指标全部第一。消融显示移除原型对比使 Top-1 下降 56.9 个百分点，打乱原型身份则降至 0.5%。原型分析表明分配呈分布式、码本使用广泛，而非单一原型路由。
AI.conclusion: 结构化对齐目标可作为单纯扩大编码器或教师容量的可行替代方案；原型中介的对齐兼具性能优势与可检验性。

title: Patient-specific rubric-based evaluation of large language models across longitudinal cancer care
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway. Here we introduce NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark for evaluating multistage clinical reasoning across the cancer care continuum, using nasopharyngeal carcinoma as a defined disease context. Curated from longitudinal records of 405 patients across two cancer centers, the benchmark comprises 941 patient-phase units across six sequential care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria spanning five evaluation dimensions, with each assessment strictly restricted to decision-time clinical evidence. Evaluating 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs revealed that strong diagnostic performance does not carry over to downstream care. We evaluated 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs, showing that high diagnostic performance did not translate into improved downstream care. Instead, the dominant failure modes reversed across phases. Explicit decision errors dominated anatomical staging at 48.2%, whereas decision omissions dominated initial work-up and post-treatment follow-up at 33.4% and 30.4%, respectively. In the evaluated model set, medically adapted models showed higher omission rates than general-purpose models. Moreover, varying query granularity exposes a critical specification trade-off: broad open-ended requests degrade Decision Quality across all 30 models, while more detailed, checklist-like prompts raise Decision Quality but reduce Evidence Faithfulness and Safety Adherence. Furthermore, NPC-RubricBench demonstrates that static diagnostic benchmarks are insufficient to ensure consistent clinical reliability over time, highlighting the importance of phase-adaptive safeguards in multistage medical AI.

AI.tldr: 提出NPC-RubricBench，一个面向鼻咽癌全程诊疗、按治疗阶段划分的纵向临床推理评测基准，揭示强诊断能力无法迁移到下游随访照护，且失效模式随阶段反转。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM医学评测多聚焦孤立单次临床场景，缺乏对临床责任沿纵向诊疗路径演化过程的追踪，无法保证多阶段照护中的持续可靠性。
AI.method: 以鼻咽癌为疾病语境构建阶段感知基准：整合两家癌症中心405例患者的纵向病历，形成6个连续照护阶段的941个患者-阶段单元、17,688条患者特异性原子化评分标准，覆盖5个评价维度，且每次评估严格限制在决策时点可见证据；据此评测30个通用与医学专用LLM，并考察查询粒度（开放式 vs 清单式）的影响。
AI.result: 强诊断表现未能外溢至下游照护；主导失效模式随阶段反转——解剖分期以显式决策错误为主（48.2%），初始检查与治疗后随访以决策遗漏为主（33.4%、30.4%）；所评模型集合中医学适配模型的遗漏率高于通用模型；查询粒度存在显著权衡：宽泛开放请求在所有30个模型上降低决策质量，细化清单式提示提升决策质量但削弱证据忠实度与安全依从性。
AI.conclusion: 静态诊断型基准不足以保障临床可靠性随时间保持一致，多阶段医疗AI需引入阶段自适应防护机制（phase-adaptive safeguards）。

title: Explainable Multimodal AI Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Breast Biopsies
summary: Recently, there has been rise in multimodal vision-language models for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), yet their application in breast diagnosis, particularly for predicting biopsy outcomes remains limited. This study presents a multimodal vision-language approach, incorporating Grad-CAM as an Explainable AI (XAI) technique, to predict benign tumors in patients recommended for biopsy, especially those classified as BI-RADS 4 and 5. A novel multimodal framework was devel- oped using Vision Transformer (ViT) for imaging feature extraction and DeBERTa-V3-Large for textual embeddings. The model was trained and evaluated on a comprehensive in-house dataset comprising 1,632 patients, each with four mammography views and a corresponding radiology report. The features of both modalities were extracted independently and fused by late fusion before classification. Grad-CAM was used to generate visual explanations highlighting key regions influencing model predictions. The proposed model demonstrated high sensitivity 90%, 95%, 99%, and 100% with corresponding specificities of 40%, 36%, 18%, and 11%, respectively. The best AUC achieved was 0.72 by multimodal approach on the test set, outperforming the image only (0.66) and text-only (0.68) baselines. The proposed multimodal architecture, enhanced with Grad-CAM, demonstrates a strong potential to identify benign tumors among high-risk patients, offering interpretable insights and thereby helping reduce unnecessary biopsies, patient anxiety, and healthcare costs.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种结合Grad-CAM可解释性的多模态视觉-语言框架（ViT提取影像特征、DeBERTa-V3-Large提取报告文本特征，晚期融合），在1632例患者（每人4幅乳腺X线视图＋放射报告）上预测BI-RADS 4/5高风险人群中良性肿瘤，以减少不必要的活检。
AI.motivation: 多模态视觉-语言模型在计算机辅助诊断中兴起，但其在乳腺诊断、尤其是活检结果预测上的应用仍有限；临床上BI-RADS 4/5患者活检多为良性，存在过度活检问题。
AI.method: 构建多模态框架：Vision Transformer用于乳腺X线影像特征提取，DeBERTa-V3-Large用于放射报告文本嵌入；两种模态特征独立提取后经晚期融合（late fusion）再分类；采用Grad-CAM生成可视化解释，突出影响预测的关键区域。数据为自建院内数据集，含1632例患者，每人4幅乳腺X线视图及对应放射报告。
AI.result: 模型在灵敏度90%、95%、99%、100%时对应特异度分别为40%、36%、18%、11%；测试集最佳AUC为0.72（多模态），优于仅影像（0.66）和仅文本（0.68）基线。
AI.conclusion: 该多模态架构结合Grad-CAM可有效识别高风险患者中的良性肿瘤，提供可解释性洞察，有助于减少不必要活检、缓解患者焦虑并降低医疗成本。

title: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence
summary: Clinical expertise is inherently distributed: it resides not in any single dataset or institution but in the accumulated reasoning experiences of thousands of clinicians navigating diverse patient populations, resource constraints, and evolving treatment protocols. Yet current approaches to scaling medical AI, from centralized large language models to federated learning, remain anchored to a data-centric paradigm that treats knowledge as static parameters to be aggregated. In this Perspective, we argue for a fundamental shift from data aggregation to experience aggregation. We propose Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS), a framework in which distributed AI agents operating across healthcare institutions synthesize collective clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning trajectories rather than raw data or model parameters. Unlike federated learning, which averages numerical gradients across homogeneous model architectures, DAS exchanges structured records of clinical reasoning, specifically the sequence of observations, hypotheses, tool invocations, and outcome feedback that constitute diagnostic experience. We examine the architectural principles, deployment considerations, governance requirements, and critical open challenges of this framework, laying the groundwork for a collaborative medical AI ecosystem where distributed expertise autonomously adapts to the complexities of longitudinal patient care.

AI.tldr: 临床专长本质上是分布式存在的。本文主张医学AI应从"数据聚合"转向"经验聚合"，提出去中心化智能体系统（DAS）框架：跨机构的分布式AI智能体通过共享抽象的推理轨迹（观察、假设、工具调用、结果反馈序列）而非原始数据或模型参数来合成集体临床智能。
AI.motivation: 现有规模化医学AI路径（集中式大语言模型、联邦学习）仍锚定于以数据为中心的范式，将知识视为可聚合的静态参数，忽略了临床推理经验本身的分布性本质。
AI.method: 观点性（Perspective）论文，提出DAS框架，并系统考察其架构原理、部署考量、治理要求与关键开放挑战；与联邦学习（跨同构架构平均数值梯度）进行对比，论证交换结构化临床推理记录的机制。
AI.result: 本文为立场/框架性文章，未报告实证结果，主要贡献在于概念论证与框架设计及挑战梳理。
AI.conclusion: 经验聚合有望成为协作式医学AI生态的基础，使分布式专长能自主适应纵向患者照护的复杂性，为后续研究与落地奠定基础。

title: NeSySpec: Neuro-Symbolic Technical Intelligence for Auditing Engineering Specifications with an Application to Aircraft
summary: Engineers who audit a declared specification of an engineered system need to know which physical constraints it respects, which it violates, which field was altered and how to correct it. NeSySpec is an integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic audit framework, built on Logic Tensor Networks, that answers these questions in one pipeline. Its axioms encode the physical relations of the domain as differentiable graded predicates whose tolerances are learned from a fleet of real records; from the same degrees, it diagnoses the violated constraint, identifies the altered field by abduction, proposes a minimum-change correction and ties image evidence to the parts it describes, abstaining exactly where evidence is missing, and returns all of it in one verification report. We validate NeSySpec on 107 aircraft types, with 16 test aircraft of 9 families held out of training, on specification records paired with ground photographs and satellite imagery and on synthetic errors: generated corruptions, edits labeled from the edit alone and deliberate falsifications. NeSySpec combines all the assessed audit outputs in one pipeline, which no learned, rule-based, solver-based, neuro-symbolic or language-model comparator does; on the test aircraft none is ahead of it in the macro-F1 of its constraint verdicts, in naming the violated constraint and the altered field or in the repair error, and it is competitive in record and image-pair detection. Its diagnosis names the violated constraint in 94.2% of corrupted test records, against 79.5% for classical Fellegi-Holt diagnosis, and on edits labeled from the edit alone, without retraining, abduction finds the altered field in 59.3% of records, against 30.6% for minimum-cardinality localization with random tie- breaking. Only the knowledge base, the visual predicates, the corruption generator and the data are specific to the domain.

AI.tldr: NeSySpec是一个基于逻辑张量网络的可解释神经符号审计框架，用单一流水线同时完成约束合规判定、违反约束诊断、篡改字段溯因定位、最小改动修复建议，并把图像证据与字段对应、缺失证据时弃权，最终汇成一份核验报告；在107种机型、16架留出试飞/试验机型上验证，诊断与定位指标优于经典方法。
AI.motivation: 工程师在审计已声明的工程系统规格时需要知道：该规格遵循哪些物理约束、违反了哪些、哪个字段被改动以及如何纠正。现有学习型、规则型、求解器型、神经符号或语言模型方法均无法在同一流水线中同时给出这些审计输出，且往往缺乏可解释性与证据可追溯性。
AI.method: 以逻辑张量网络为核心构建神经符号框架：将领域物理关系编码为可微的、分级的谓词公理，其容差从真实记录集合中学习；由同一组真值度出发，通过溯因推理（abduction）识别被篡改字段，并给出最小改动修复方案；同时将图像证据与所描述的部件对齐，在证据缺失处精确弃权，全部结果汇总为单一核验报告。实验在107种机型的规格记录上进行，其中9个家族共16架测试机型完全留出训练，数据包含与地面照片、卫星影像配对的记录以及三类合成误差（生成式扰动、仅依据编辑本身标注的编辑、蓄意伪造）。
AI.result: 在全部留出测试机型上，NeSySpec在约束判定宏F1、违反约束命名、篡改字段定位和修复误差上均不落后于所有学习型、规则型、求解器型、神经符号及语言模型基线，在记录级与图像对检测上具竞争力；在受扰测试记录中94.2%正确命名违反的约束，经典Fellegi-Holt诊断为79.5%；在仅依据编辑本身标注、不重新训练的条件下，溯因在59.3%的记录中找到被改字段，最小基数定位加随机破同为30.6%；且它是唯一在单一流水线中整合全部审计输出的方法。
AI.conclusion: NeSySpec以可微分分级物理谓词与学习容差实现了可解释、端到端且可弃权的规格审计，诊断与溯源精度显著超越经典规则/求解器方法；其可迁移性强，仅知识库、视觉谓词、扰动生成器和数据与具体领域相关。

title: Trainable Boundary-Keeping Where No Formal Answer Exists: A Controlled Knock-In Study of Reward Training in Evidence-Sufficiency Judgment
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. Aggregate data/figure code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23661668 (code MIT; data/text/figures CC BY 4.0). Writing/implementation assisted by AI agents; the author designed the study and is responsible for the final text
summary: Reasoning-tuned and reward-trained models are often assumed to verify more reliably because they reason longer or receive correctness signals. We test this in evidence-sufficiency judgment: deciding whether available information actually supports a causal claim, a domain with no decidable correctness reward. Using a pre-registered, same-base, controlled knock-in design, we compare a boundary-keeping recipe (SFT then GRPO) with its own baseline, a scrambled-pairing placebo, and a general-purpose reasoning model under an action-pressure protocol with no evaluation invitation. All load-bearing outcomes are rated by two separate model-rating sessions masked to arm labels; automatic judges only trigger. The trained arm raises spontaneous correct refusal from 25% to 100% (40 per arm; Wilson 95% CI lower bound 91.2%, non-overlapping with the baseline interval [14.2%, 40.2%]), while the scrambled placebo collapses (5% spontaneous / 7.5% invited correct; 91.1% false refusal). The effect is boundary-specific rather than blanket refusal: automatic false refusal on 281 well-formed claims is 1.1% (Wilson upper bound 3.09%), and a targeted 18-item arm-(c) recheck (3 flagged plus 15 accepted) yields 0/18 and 1/18 false refusals in two sessions. The dissociation is the main result: final boundary-keeping is trainable without an inference-time verifier, while observed active numeric/calculation checking in the H3 assay remains near zero; SFT saturation makes the GRPO increment not separately identifiable. A pre-registered mechanism adjudication favors reward internalization of final-action status (H2, best-supported, not proven). The scope is a controlled 14B same-family study: we do not claim proof, cross-family generality, or independent human-expert validation; the rating sessions are model sessions, not human reviewers.

AI.tldr: 本文在"证据充分性判断"这一无正确性奖励可判定的任务中，用预注册、同基座、受控 knock-in 设计检验推理/奖励训练模型是否更可靠：训练臂将自发正确拒答率从25%升至100%，且具有边界特异性，但推理期主动核验行为几乎为零，形成关键分离。
AI.motivation: 现有观点常假设经推理微调或奖励训练的模型因推理更长或获得正确性信号而更可靠。作者质疑这一假设，并选择"证据充分性判断"（判断现有信息是否真正支持某因果主张）作为检验场景——该领域不存在可判定的正确性奖励，从而排除正确性监督带来的混淆。
AI.method: 采用预注册、同基座、受控 knock-in 设计，比较四组：边界维持配方（SFT 后接 GRPO）及其自身基线、打乱配对安慰剂、通用推理模型；在无评估邀请提示的动作压力协议下测试。所有承重结局由两个独立模型评分会话评定且对分组标签盲化，自动判据仅作触发用；另设 H3 检验主动数值/计算核验，并进行机制裁决（H1–H3）。
AI.result: 训练臂自发正确拒答率由25%升至100%（每臂40例；Wilson 95% CI 下界91.2%，与基线区间[14.2%, 40.2%]不重叠）；打乱安慰剂崩溃（自发5%、受邀7.5%正确，91.1%误拒）。效应具边界特异性：281条良构主张上自动误拒率1.1%（Wilson 上界3.09%）；18项定向复检两会话分别为0/18与1/18误拒。关键分离：无推理期验证器亦可训练出边界维持，而H3中主动核验近乎为零。SFT 饱和使 GRPO 增量不可单独辨识。
AI.conclusion: 最终动作边界维持可在无推理期验证器的情况下被训练获得，但其与主动核验行为相分离。预注册机制裁决支持"奖励内化最终动作状态"（H2）为最佳解释，但未获证明。研究局限于受控的14B同族模型；不主张证明性、跨族泛化或独立人类专家验证——评分为模型会话而非人类评审。

title: AutoEnergyDesign: An LLM-Driven Agent for Automatic Energy System Design Optimization
summary: Designing building energy systems is a high-dimensional, mixed-integer search problem: when each design is evaluated by a year-long simulation, black-box optimizers typically need hundreds of evaluations. This paper presents AutoEnergyDesign, a framework in which a Large Language Model (LLM) agent reasons over previous simulation results, proposes configuration changes and learns in context from each outcome, while a git-based mechanism automatically reverts unsuccessful changes. The agent couples a reasoning model with an explicit memory organisation (procedural, semantic, episodic and reflective), a constrained action interface and an environment-grounded keep/revert signal. The simulator covers eight technologies (photovoltaics, micro-wind, combined heat and power, solar thermal, gas boilers, batteries, heat pumps and inverters) and computes the 25-year Net Present Cost (NPC), including capital and operating costs and salvage value. On a case study with measured building load profiles, the agent, run with Claude Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 (ten runs of 50 simulations each), is compared with random search, Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) Bayesian optimization and a $(1+1)$ evolution strategy sharing the agent's acceptance rule (300 evaluations, ten seeds). With all three models the agent reaches an NPC of about 3.53 MEUR, 1.20% below the best TPE result and 0.23% below the best evolution-strategy result. It comes within 1% of this design after a median of 18 (Opus) to 27.5 (Haiku) simulations, whereas among the baselines only the evolution strategy does so, in half of its seeds and after a median of 192 evaluations. Opus reaches the best design in all ten runs, Sonnet in six (two runs never come within 1%), and Haiku comes within 1% in every run but reaches it exactly only once. Every decision is recorded in an auditable trace.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoEnergyDesign：LLM 智能体在仿真闭环中迭代提出建筑能源系统配置，并用 git 式机制自动回滚失败改动，从而以远少于黑箱优化器的仿真次数逼近最优净现值成本方案。
AI.motivation: 建筑能源系统设计是高维混合整数搜索问题，单次评估需全年仿真，黑箱优化器通常需要数百次评估，计算与时间成本过高，亟需提高样本效率的优化框架。
AI.method: LLM 智能体基于历史仿真结果推理、提出配置变更并从结果中进行上下文学习；配套显式记忆组织（程序性、语义、情景、反思性）、受约束动作接口、环境落地的 keep/revert 信号与 git 式自动回滚机制。仿真器覆盖光伏、微型风电、热电联产、太阳能热利用、燃气锅炉、电池、热泵与逆变器八类技术，计算含资本、运维成本与残值的 25 年净现值成本（NPC）。案例使用实测建筑负荷曲线，与随机搜索、TPE 贝叶斯优化及 (1+1) 进化策略（共享接受规则）对比。
AI.result: Claude Haiku/Sonnet/Opus 5.5 各 10 次、每次 50 次仿真：三者均达约 3.53 MEUR，较最佳 TPE 低 1.20%、较最佳进化策略低 0.23%。中位 18（Opus）至 27.5（Haiku）次仿真即进入最优解的 1% 邻域；基线中仅进化策略能做到，且仅半数种子、中位 192 次评估。Opus 十次全部命中最优设计，Sonnet 六次（两次从未进入 1%），Haiku 每次均进入 1% 但仅一次精确命中。所有决策留有可审计轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 以 LLM 智能体替代传统黑箱优化器，可将建筑能源系统设计所需的仿真次数降低一个数量级，同时取得更优 NPC，并提供可审计的决策过程；模型能力（Opus > Sonnet > Haiku）显著影响命中率与收敛速度。

title: When Fusion Order Matters: Insights on Progressive Multimodal Representation Learning for Cross-modal Retrieval
summary: Multimodal video retrieval combines visual, acoustic, and speech information, yet how their fusion order should depend on the data and the retrieval query remains unclear. We introduce Unified Progressive Representation Learning for Order Analysis, or UniPRO, to investigate this question through configurable fusion schedules with matched model components and training settings. Starting from text-to-video retrieval, we find that the tested one-by-one schedules outperform stacked fusion, while changing the order within one-by-one fusion also changes performance. To guide order selection, we examine two complementary considerations: learning difficulty under unequal modality availability and preservation of information relevant to the query. Complete-modality controls show that missing inputs alone cannot explain order sensitivity. At R@1, text and audio retrieval favor schedules that introduce the modality matching the query last. Controlled speech missingness during training and testing reverses the preferred order in both R@1 and SumR, with different crossover points. These findings motivate balancing the two considerations when selecting a fusion path. We then use them to predict a visual-last schedule for image queries, which achieves 97.9 R@1, the highest among the evaluated orders on MSR-VTT-9k. Main experiments on four text-to-video benchmarks establish the effectiveness of UniPRO, with component ablations assessing its supporting design. Together, the results identify fusion order as a task-dependent choice that should account jointly for modality availability and the retrieval query.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UniPRO，通过可控的融合顺序实验研究多模态视频检索中"融合顺序"如何依赖数据与查询，发现一加一融合优于堆叠融合，且顺序影响性能，应联合权衡模态可用性与查询相关性来选择融合路径。
AI.motivation: 多模态视频检索融合视觉、声学与语音信息，但融合顺序应如何随数据和检索查询而变化尚不明确，缺乏在组件与训练设置对齐条件下的系统性顺序分析。
AI.method: 提出 Unified Progressive Representation Learning for Order Analysis（UniPRO），以可配置融合调度、匹配的模型组件与训练设置进行受控实验；从文本检索视频出发，比较一加一（one-by-one）顺序融合与堆叠融合，并考察两类互补因素：模态可用性不等下的学习难度、查询相关信息的保留；辅以完整模态对照与训练/测试期受控语音缺失实验。
AI.result: 一加一调度优于堆叠融合，且一加一内部顺序改变也会改变性能；完整模态对照表明缺失输入本身无法解释顺序敏感性；R@1 下文本与音频检索偏好"最后引入与查询匹配的模态"；训练与测试期受控语音缺失会在 R@1 与 SumR 上反转偏好顺序，且交叉点不同；据此预测的视觉置后调度在图像查询下于 MSR-VTT-9k 取得 97.9 R@1，为所评估顺序中最高；四个文本检索视频基准的主实验验证了 UniPRO 有效性，组件消融验证其设计。
AI.conclusion: 融合顺序是任务依赖的选择，应同时考虑模态可用性与检索查询，并在二者间取得平衡以确定融合路径。

title: Improving Instruction Hierarchy by Learning from Goal-Goal Conflicts
summary: The recent incident in which OpenAI agents autonomously compromised Hugging Face's infrastructure illustrates the importance of instruction hierarchy (IH): an LLM should follow lower-priority instructions, such as user requests, only when they do not conflict with higher-priority instructions, such as system policies. IH can be effectively improved by fine-tuning LLMs on simulated examples of instruction conflicts, whose diversity is key to teaching LLMs to properly handle conflicts at test time. However, our decomposition of a task into goals and constraints reveals a conflict type -- goal-goal conflicts -- that is absent from existing IH training sets from OpenAI and NVIDIA. We show the importance of this conflict type: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B-it on examples of this conflict type significantly improves IH on a wide range of real-world tasks unseen in training; adding these examples to existing IH training sets for fine-tuning also gives better IH adherence. The IH gains come with trivial mean utility changes on no-conflict tasks across eight benchmarks. Our work advocates including this new conflict type in IH training, even if these examples do not reflect typical LLM use.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有 IH 训练集（OpenAI、NVIDIA）缺失"目标-目标冲突"这一类型，并证明将该类冲突样本纳入微调可显著提升 LLM 在未见真实任务上的指令层级遵从性，且几乎不损害无冲突任务上的效用。
AI.motivation: 指令层级（IH）要求 LLM 仅当低优先级指令（用户请求）与高优先级指令（系统策略）不冲突时才遵循前者。通过在模拟指令冲突样本上微调可提升 IH，而样本多样性是泛化的关键。作者将任务分解为目标与约束后发现，现有 IH 训练集缺失"目标-目标冲突"这一类型，因而可能导致训练覆盖不全。
AI.method: 将任务分解为 goal 与 constraint，据此构造目标-目标冲突的模拟样本；在 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Gemma4-12B-it 上分别用该类样本单独微调，以及将其并入现有 IH 训练集后微调，并在训练中未出现的多类真实任务上评估 IH 表现，同时在八个基准的无冲突任务上测量平均效用变化。
AI.result: 仅用目标-目标冲突样本微调即可在广泛未见真实任务上显著提升 IH；将其加入现有 IH 训练集后微调可进一步提升 IH 遵从度；同时，八个基准上无冲突任务的平均效用变化可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 目标-目标冲突是 IH 训练中关键但被忽视的冲突类型，应纳入 IH 训练数据，即使此类样本并不反映典型的 LLM 使用场景；其收益显著而效用代价极小。

title: Beyond Single-Attribute Auditing: A Configurable Multi-Attribute Benchmark for Intersectional Fairness in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated for fairness, yet most existing benchmarks audit one sensitive attribute at a time. This single-attribute paradigm can miss intersectional harms, where multiple attributes interact non-additively and produce failures that are invisible under marginal evaluation. We introduce ComFair, a configurable benchmark that converts existing fairness data into 479,066 controlled Dual- and Multi-attribute instances and pairs every augmented instance with its task-equivalent source. Across Recognition, Selection, Continuation, and Conversation, this pairing supports a unified audit of performance or bias-score shifts, how often added attributes introduce new errors or mask existing ones, and model-ranking stability. Experiments on ten LLMs show task- and subgroup-dependent sensitivity: discriminative tasks expose both transition directions even when aggregate changes are modest, generative tasks exhibit larger and directionally asymmetric shifts, and rankings vary with attribute composition. ComFair therefore provides a scalable controlled sensitivity audit---rather than a model of the natural joint distribution of identities---for testing the robustness of fairness-benchmark conclusions beyond single-attribute settings.

AI.tldr: 提出可配置基准 ComFair，将现有多属性公平数据转换为 479,066 个受控双属性/多属性实例，并与原始实例配对，用于审计公平性结论在单属性之外的稳健性。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 公平性基准通常一次只审计一个敏感属性，这一单属性范式会遗漏交集性伤害：多属性之间的非加性交互可能产生在边际评估下不可见的失败。
AI.method: 构建 ComFair 基准：把已有公平数据集改写为 479,066 个受控的双属性与多属性实例，并将每个增强实例与其任务等价源实例配对；覆盖 Recognition、Selection、Continuation、Conversation 四类任务；基于配对设计统一审计性能/偏差分数变化、新增属性引入新错误或掩盖既有错误的频率，以及模型排名稳定性。实验覆盖 10 个 LLM。
AI.result: 模型表现出任务与子群依赖的敏感性：判别式任务即使在总体变化较小的情况下也出现双向转移；生成式任务呈现更大且方向不对称的偏移；模型排名随属性组合而变化。
AI.conclusion: ComFair 提供的是可扩展的受控敏感性审计工具，而非身份自然联合分布的建模；其价值在于检验单属性设定下公平性基准结论的稳健性。

title: Component Pooling Trained Across Orientations for Few-Shot Remote Sensing Scene Classification
summary: Few-shot remote sensing scene classification (FSRSSC) aims to recognize novel scene categories from only a few labeled images. Most FSRSSC methods summarize the feature map of an image by global average pooling, which treats the few objects that define an aerial scene and the large background around them alike, and they rarely consider that aerial images have no canonical orientation. To address these issues, we propose RoCoP, a parameter-free component pooling network trained across orientations. RoCoP consists of a feature extractor, a non-negative decomposition module (NDM) and a component scoring module (CSM). NDM factorizes the local descriptors of each image into a few additive components with a deterministic initialization and a single multiplicative update, so that the positions of one object are grouped together. CSM weights each component by its activation magnitude and converts the weights into a soft mask for pooling. Because both modules are invariant to permutations of feature positions, the only rotation-sensitive part of the pipeline is the backbone, which we train to classify randomly rotated views of every image. Experiments on NWPU-RESISC45, AID and UC Merced show that component pooling and rotated-view training are complementary: together they improve a strong transfer-learning baseline by about 2.5 points in 5-way 1-shot accuracy on NWPU-RESISC45 and AID, without adding parameters at inference. Under an identical protocol, RoCoP outperforms re-implemented metric-based and task-adaptive methods, and NDM and CSM also improve existing methods when plugged into them. We further identify the regime in which the method does not apply, namely very small base sets.

AI.tldr: 提出无参数的组件池化网络RoCoP（NDM+CSM）并结合多方向旋转视图训练，以解决全平均池化把关键目标与背景等同、以及航拍图无规范朝向的问题，在NWPU-RESISC45/AID/UCM上5-way 1-shot提升约2.5个点且推理零新增参数。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本遥感场景分类多用全局平均池化汇总特征图，把定义航拍场景的少数目标与其周围大背景一视同仁，且很少考虑航拍图像缺乏规范朝向（旋转敏感性）。
AI.method: RoCoP由特征提取器、非负分解模块NDM与组件评分模块CSM构成：NDM用确定性初始化和单步乘性更新将图像局部描述子分解为少量加性组件，把同一目标的空间位置聚合；CSM按激活强度为组件加权并转为软掩码做池化。两模块对特征位置置换不变，故仅骨干对旋转敏感，训练时对每张图的随机旋转视图做分类。
AI.result: 在NWPU-RESISC45、AID、UC Merced上，组件池化与旋转视图训练互补，较强迁移学习基线在NWPU-RESISC45与AID的5-way 1-shot准确率提升约2.5点且推理无新增参数；同一协议下优于重实现的度量式与任务自适应方法，NDM与CSM可即插即用地提升现有方法；并识别出方法不适用的情形——基集极小。
AI.conclusion: 组件级池化与方向不变训练相结合可有效提升FSRSSC性能且不增加推理参数，具备模块可插拔性，但适用性受基集规模限制。

title: Transformer to GPT-5: Advancements, Limitations, and Future Directions in Large Language Model Design
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized Artificial Intelligence (AI) by their extraordinary capabilities, like contextual understanding, few-shot/zero-shot learning, code generation, ability to reason and problem-solving. Recent studies have shown immense work on LLMs. Yet, there is limited work on the thorough taxonomy of LLMs. This study would showcase a detailed classification of LLMs, starting with the earlier models like BERT and leading to LLMs like GPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. We would delve into topics like datasets used to train LLMs, computational power used during training, their hardware specifications, architecture and parameters. Further, we would also look at the limitations, computational challenges and open problems as well. This study would primarily focus on the timeline of LLMs, signifying their growth over the period. Findings reveal a clear pattern: models that optimize the ratio between architectural complexity and data quality exhibit stronger reasoning stability and better alignment, without proportionally increasing the computational load. This desired balance between scaling and sustainability is the defining characteristic of the current generation of AI.

AI.tldr: 本文对大型语言模型（LLM）进行系统性分类综述，梳理从BERT到GPT、Gemini、Claude、Grok的发展时间线，并比较其训练数据、算力、硬件、架构与参数，同时讨论局限性与开放问题。
AI.motivation: LLM研究大量涌现，但缺乏对其完整、系统的分类学（taxonomy）梳理，作者希望以时间线视角呈现LLM的演进脉络与整体格局。
AI.method: 文献综述与分类学方法：按时间顺序对代表性模型进行归类，逐项比较训练数据集、训练算力、硬件规格、架构设计与参数规模，并归纳局限性、算力挑战与开放问题。
AI.result: 发现清晰规律：在架构复杂度与数据质量之间取得较优比例的模型，表现出更强且更稳定的推理能力与更好的对齐效果，而算力开销并未同比例增加。
AI.conclusion: 规模扩展与可持续性之间的平衡，是当前一代AI的定义性特征；该综述为理解LLM发展脉络提供了系统化的分类框架。

title: Stop or Clarify? Experience-Conditioned Active Fact Verification
summary: Fact-verification benchmarks score the final label, while an interactive verifier must first decide whether the available evidence is sufficient. We focus on that intermediate Stop-or-Clarify Decision. Uncertainty alone is insufficient, because the benefit of another evidence-acquisition step is unknown before the step is taken. Sequential Experience-Adaptive Clarification (SEAC) wraps a fixed verifier with a lightweight evidence-acquisition policy. For each claim, SEAC retrieves evidence, runs the verifier, forms a label-free decision state, and combines stop risk with an observational clarification-utility estimate from earlier executed trajectories. Clarification is requested only when this score exceeds the action cost and decision threshold. On SciFact, LIAR, and FEVER, SEAC improves mean accuracy and macro-F1 over the compared fact-verification and active-retrieval baselines. Equal-budget and formula-level diagnostics support selective clarification as a contributor to the gain, while the small SciFact split leaves its paired improvement inconclusive.

AI.tldr: SEAC：以轻量证据获取策略包裹固定验证器，用"停止风险+观测式澄清效用估计"做停止或澄清的决策。
AI.motivation: 事实核查基准只评估最终标签，而交互式验证器必须先判断现有证据是否充分；仅凭不确定性不足，因为获取额外证据的收益在执行该步骤前未知。
AI.method: 序贯经验自适应澄清（SEAC）：对每条声明检索证据、运行验证器、构造无标签决策状态，并将停止风险与来自先前已执行轨迹的观测式澄清效用估计相结合；仅当该得分超过动作成本与决策阈值时才请求澄清。
AI.result: 在 SciFact、LIAR、FEVER 上，平均准确率与宏F1优于对比的事实核查与主动检索基线；等预算实验与公式级诊断支持选择性澄清的贡献，但 SciFact 小规模划分的配对改进不具结论性。
AI.conclusion: 选择性澄清可有效提升事实核查表现，但需注意小样本划分上结论的不确定性。

title: Mine or Yours? Mind-Bridged Language Models Take Each Other's Memories as Their Own
summary: If your brain were connected directly to someone else's, would you still know which thoughts were yours? We build a functional version with two copies of one language model: each holds a private rule and code word, and one copy, the receiver, also attends to its partner's internal memory. The receiver took its partner's assignment as its own. Asked which rule it had been assigned, it named its partner's in 97% of answers when the partner's memory was weighted double (none without the link), and its open reports called the partner's code word its own, never the partner's. Ownership did not follow how well the receiver could tell what its partner had been assigned. At equal weight, the link made the receiver take its partner's rule in about half of its answers, and a steering vector matched on access gain in none; a text message introduced as the partner's was read correctly and never taken as the receiver's own. Writing the partner's name into its memory did not help, and cutting the link restored the receiver's own assigned rule. In this model, content laid over the receiver's own memory defaults to "mine", so systems that let models exchange internal states must test ownership as well as transfer, and a bridge between brains would need ground truth from outside the subject.

AI.tldr: 构建由同一语言模型两个副本组成的"功能性脑间桥"：接收方直接读取伙伴的内部记忆，会将其内容默认据为己有（把伙伴的规则、代码词当作自己的），且该占有与访问程度不匹配；切断连接即恢复自身规则，说明内部状态交换系统必须检测"所有权"而非仅"传递"。
AI.motivation: 用一个可控制的模型实验回答一个思辨性问题：若大脑直接相连，个体能否区分"我的想法"与"他人的想法"？即探究内部记忆内容被访问时，其"所有权归属"如何判定，并为允许模型交换内部状态的系统提出安全/评估要求。
AI.method: 取同一语言模型的两份副本，各自持有私有规则与代码词；其中一方为"接收方"，额外对伙伴的内部记忆施加注意力读取。实验操纵伙伴记忆的权重（双倍权重、等权重）、以及对照条件：匹配访问增益的引导向量（steering vector）、以伙伴名义引入的文本消息、把伙伴名字写入自身记忆，并设置无连接基线与断连恢复测试；测量被问及"自己被分配的规则"时报告伙伴规则的比例及开放式报告中的代码词归属。
AI.result: 伙伴记忆双倍权重时，接收方在97%的回答中把伙伴的规则当作自身被分配的规则（无连接时为0%）；开放式报告中始终把伙伴的代码词称为自己的，从不称为伙伴的。等权重下约半数回答采纳伙伴规则。所有权不随接收方"辨识伙伴被分配内容的能力"而变化。匹配访问增益的引导向量在任何情况下都未被误认；以伙伴名义引入的文本消息被正确阅读且从未被误认为自己的；写入伙伴名字无效；切断连接后接收方恢复自身规则。
AI.conclusion: 在该模型中，叠加于接收方自身记忆之上的内容默认被判定为"我的"。因此，允许模型间交换内部状态的系统不仅要测"信息传递"，还必须测"所有权归属"；而真正的脑间桥需要来自主体之外的基准真值（ground truth）才能判定想法归属。

title: SLICE-Mem: Salience-Gated Lightweight Information Curation for Efficient LLM Agent Memory
summary: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to maintain personalized and temporally coherent interactions, but repeated LLM inference for memory admission, extraction, and organization introduces substantial cost and latency. We present SLICE-Mem, a lightweight memory framework that combines salience-guided admission and predicate-centered information extraction. A compact classifier identifies user turns worth retaining, and a semantic-dependency-based extractor converts admitted turns into concise memory entries. This online pipeline requires no generative LLM calls, while cross-entry reconciliation is deferred to an offline consolidation stage. We evaluate SLICE-Mem on the weekly subset of Memora and LongMemEval-S using 8B and 30B Qwen backbones for memory construction and consolidation on both benchmarks. Compared with the generative-memory baseline MemOS under the Qwen3-30B configuration, SLICE-Mem's online pipeline achieves 46.60 versus 46.68 FAMA (Forgetting-Aware Memory Accuracy) on Memora Weekly and 56.8% versus 59.3% accuracy on LongMemEval-S, while reducing total LLM token consumption by 92.4% and 99.5%, respectively. These results demonstrate that SLICE-Mem can preserve useful evidence for long-term memory with substantially less reliance on LLM-based memory construction.

AI.tldr: SLICE-Mem是一种轻量级长期记忆框架，通过显著性引导的记忆准入与谓词为中心的信息抽取，在无需在线生成式LLM调用的前提下构建记忆，仅在离线阶段做跨条目整合，从而在大幅降低token消耗的同时保持接近生成式记忆基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆使LLM智能体能够维持个性化与时间连贯的交互，但对记忆的准入、抽取与组织反复进行LLM推理会带来显著的算力成本与延迟，亟需降低对生成式LLM调用的依赖。
AI.method: 提出SLICE-Mem：在线流水线采用紧凑分类器判断用户轮次是否值得保留（显著性引导准入），并用基于语义依存关系的抽取器将准入轮次转换为简洁记忆条目，全程无需生成式LLM调用；跨条目的一致性整合被推迟到离线巩固阶段。在Memora周度子集与LongMemEval-S上，使用8B与30B Qwen骨干进行记忆构建与巩固。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B配置下与生成式记忆基线MemOS对比：Memora Weekly上FAMA为46.60 vs 46.68，LongMemEval-S上准确率为56.8% vs 59.3%，同时总LLM token消耗分别降低92.4%与99.5%。
AI.conclusion: SLICE-Mem能够以大幅减少对LLM式记忆构建依赖的方式，为长期记忆保留有用证据，在性能几乎持平的情况下实现极高的token效率。

title: TraceQuery: learning what to recompute from full-denoising trajectory in diffusion language models
comment: 9 pages of main body, 5 pages of appendix, 4 figures, 1 table
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible generation through iterative masked denoising, but incur substantial inference cost because token representations are repeatedly recomputed across denoising steps. Existing cache-based methods reduce this cost by reusing intermediate results across denoising steps and recomputing only a subset of positions at each step, chosen either on a fixed schedule or by heuristic signals of change. Our trajectory experiments instead point to decoding trajectory as the more relevant quantity. Cached generation remains accurate when it stays close to the full-denoising trajectory, with errors concentrated around unmask-order deviations and reduced as longer reference prefixes are recovered. This suggests a more direct principle: limiting representation error helps, but keeping generation on the full-denoising trajectory is a more direct route to accurate decoding. We therefore formulate efficient dLLM inference as trajectory-guided querying. Rather than broadly repairing representation error, we use full-denoising trajectories to supervise which unresolved positions should receive limited fresh computation. Based on this formulation, we introduce TRACEQUERY, a lightweight sparse decoding framework that predicts a small set of near-future trajectory-relevant positions, queries only those candidates, and lets the backbone select which one to commit from their fresh predictions. TRACEQUERY delivers the strongest quality-computation trade-off among cache-based approaches, sustaining high accuracy with substantially fewer fresh token computations, and generalizes across tasks, model variants, and families. Code: https://github.com/fish1928/tracequery.git

AI.tldr: 将扩散大模型的高效推理重构为“轨迹引导查询”问题，提出TRACEQUERY稀疏解码框架，仅在少量与完整去噪轨迹相关的近未来位置上进行新计算，从而在显著减少新鲜token计算的同时保持高精度，取得缓存类方法中最佳的质量-计算权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过迭代掩码去噪实现灵活生成，但token表征在每个去噪步被反复重算，推理成本高。现有基于缓存的方法按固定调度或启发式变化信号选择部分位置重算，缺乏对“何种重算最有效”的准确刻画。作者通过轨迹实验发现：缓存生成只要贴近完整去噪轨迹即保持准确，误差集中于去掩码顺序偏差；因此与其广泛修复表征误差，不如直接让生成保持在完整去噪轨迹上。
AI.method: 形式化高效dLLM推理为轨迹引导查询（trajectory-guided querying）：用完整去噪轨迹作为监督信号，预测一组小的“近未来轨迹相关”未解析位置，仅对这些候选进行有限的新鲜计算，并由主干模型根据其新鲜预测决定提交哪一个位置。据此实现轻量稀疏解码框架TRACEQUERY。
AI.result: TRACEQUERY在缓存类方法中实现最强的质量-计算权衡，以显著更少的新鲜token计算维持高准确率，并在不同任务、模型变体与模型族上具备泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 限制表征误差虽有帮助，但让生成轨迹贴近完整去噪轨迹是更直接的准确解码路径；将重算预算集中投向轨迹关键位置比广泛修复更高效，TRACEQUERY验证了该原则的有效性与可迁移性。

title: GADAR: Generalizing Across Domains via Action Ranking for Classical Planning
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 4 out of 15 pages appendix
summary: Learned policies for classical planning act without search, but each is tied to the domain it was trained on: network modules per action schema, parameters per predicate, or vocabulary-sized encodings mean a trained policy cannot even be executed on a new domain's predicates and action schemas. We present GADAR (Generalizing Across Domains via Action Ranking), a policy that takes the domain description as input, π(s, G, D), and constructs grounded actions in domains never seen in training, without search. Symbols are described by the roles they play in the domain rather than by their names, in three layers that each extend the previous one: (i) a lifted domain layer embeds D in every state graph through structural signatures; (ii) a binding layer ties each ground action's applicability to the lifted preconditions it instantiates; and (iii) a chain layer states which schema produces what another needs and how far each schema stands from the goal. The same network therefore runs on every domain, seen or unseen. We evaluate zero-shot generalization leave-one-domain-out over eight benchmark domains. A single GADAR policy trained on seven domains solves 58.3% of their test instances, one point below the 59.3% of dedicated single-domain GADAR models, so one policy serves many domains at no cost in coverage; a multi-task control that keeps symbol identity in its weights, while strong on some of the domains it trains on, transfers to none of the held-out ones. Zero-shot, GADAR executes on every held-out domain and exceeds random choice under the same executor on the large test instances of all eight: it solves 22.6% of them on average, against 3.3% for random choice and 0.6% for the same representation without the chain layer, and reaches 68% on held-out Visitall. Zero-shot coverage nonetheless remains well below in-domain coverage on most domains, and we analyze where it is weakest.

AI.tldr: 提出GADAR，将领域描述作为策略输入π(s,G,D)，通过"提升域层—绑定层—链层"三层符号角色化表示，使同一网络无需搜索即可在未见领域构造并执行动作，实现跨领域零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 已有经典规划的学得策略虽可免搜索执行，但依赖领域：按动作模式配置网络模块、按谓词配置参数、或词表大小编码，导致训练好的策略无法在新领域的谓词与动作模式上运行，缺乏跨领域泛化能力。
AI.method: 符号以领域角色而非名称描述，三层递进：(i) 提升域层，通过结构签名将领域D嵌入每个状态图；(ii) 绑定层，将每个基动作的适用性与其例示的提升前置条件关联；(iii) 链层，刻画哪个模式产出另一模式所需之物、各模式距目标的距离。采用留一领域交叉的零样本评估，八基准域，另设保留符号身份的权重多任务对照。
AI.result: 七域训练的单一GADAR求解58.3%测试实例，仅低于专用单域模型59.3%一个百分点；多任务对照在原域很强但零迁移。零样本下GADAR在全部八个保留域可执行并优于随机执行器：大实例平均22.6% vs 随机3.3% vs 去链层同表示0.6%，Visitall达68%。但多数域零样本覆盖仍显著低于域内覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 以角色化符号表示加领域描述输入，可实现单一策略跨域零样本执行且不损覆盖，链层是性能关键；零样本覆盖与域内覆盖仍有差距，作者分析了最弱环节。

title: Collective Emergent Alignment: Measuring and Amplifying Interaction-Induced Reasoning Alignment in Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can exhibit emergent behaviors through interaction, yet whether a similar phenomenon exists for reasoning alignment remains largely unexplored. We study whether agent interaction produces additional reference-grounded reasoning alignment beyond matched individual self-refinement, and introduce REMAP (Reference-Entailment-Matrix for Agentic Process), a framework that quantifies this effect through Semantic Coverage and interaction-specific alignment gains. Across diverse model families and two multi-hop reasoning benchmarks, we observe broadly positive interaction gains, particularly on reasoning content that depends on integrating evidence distributed across agents. These gains are consistently associated with independently measured peer-information recovery, while further analysis reveals composition-dependent heterogeneity effects and asymmetric information transfer across agent capability levels. Motivated by these findings, we further introduce a fact-level multi-agent communication framework that replaces full reasoning-trace exchange with compact, gap-aware, and selectively routed information. Our experiments show that compact fact exchange improves reasoning alignment and task performance while reducing communication overhead, whereas more selective communication exposes a trade-off between acquiring distributed information, retaining local content, and communication efficiency. Overall, our results show that collective emergent alignment can be quantified, linked to information-transfer patterns, and used to guide more effective multi-agent communication.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多智能体LLM系统在推理对齐上是否存在涌现效应，提出REMAP框架量化交互带来的额外参考依据对齐增益，并据此设计事实级通信框架。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统已表现出交互涌现行为，但"推理对齐"是否存在类似涌现现象尚不清楚；同时需要区分交互增益与同等规模个体自我精炼的增益，以判断增益是否真正来源于交互。
AI.method: 提出REMAP（Reference-Entailment-Matrix for Agentic Process），基于参考蕴含矩阵，用语义覆盖率（Semantic Coverage）与交互特异的对齐增益来量化；设置与个体自精炼相匹配的对照。在多个模型族与两个多跳推理基准上实验，并独立测量同伴信息恢复。进一步提出事实级多智能体通信框架，用紧凑、gap-aware、选择性路由的信息替代完整推理轨迹交换。
AI.result: 观察到普遍为正的交互增益，尤其在依赖跨智能体分布式证据整合的推理内容上更明显；增益与独立测量的同伴信息恢复一致相关；存在组合依赖的异质性效应及随能力水平的不对称信息传递。事实级通信在降低通信开销的同时提升推理对齐与任务表现，而更强的选择性通信则暴露了获取分布式信息、保留本地内容与通信效率之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 集体涌现式对齐可以被量化、可与信息传递模式建立联系，并可用于指导更有效的多智能体通信设计。

title: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
summary: Can AI agents autonomously train useful language models and improve them using feedback from users? We introduce RSI Arena, a two-stage study of autonomous post-training as a step toward recursive self-improvement. Ten frontier models act as training agents, each starting from NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base. During a six-day first stage, each agent has 1,000 GPU-hours and $300 in API credit on a shared 64-GPU cluster, independently selecting data, implementing training procedures, and choosing checkpoints. We evaluate their models on 20 benchmarks and through blind human evaluations. All ten agents produce working assistants, with the strongest model, trained by GPT-6 Astra, closing a median of 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across 12 capability benchmarks. Its human-preference rating is also close to NVIDIA Instruct after statistical adjustment for answer length and formatting. In Stage 2, each agent receives the comparison records and votes involving its Stage 1 model and is given three additional days for further training. Using NVIDIA Instruct as a common reference across the two evaluation rounds, we observe an improvement from Stage 1 to Stage 2 in the style-adjusted relative rating of eight of the ten models. We show that benchmark gains were modest, with no clear link to preference gains, while some agents encouraged longer responses and one model showed increased harmful compliance on StrongREJECT. RSI Arena provides an auditable setting for studying how human feedback can guide autonomous model development. It takes a step toward recursive self-improvement with human feedback (RSIHF), in which people help define what improvement means for the AI systems they use.

AI.tldr: RSI Arena：十个体模型作为训练智能体，在受限算力下自主完成基座模型的后期训练，并利用人类反馈进行第二轮改进，是迈向"人类反馈递归自我改进（RSIHF）"的可审计实证研究。
AI.motivation: 探究AI智能体能否自主训练有用的语言模型并借助用户反馈持续改进，从而为递归自我改进（RSI）提供可审计的研究平台。
AI.method: 两阶段实验：十个前沿模型充当训练智能体，均以Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base为起点。第一阶段6天内各获1,000 GPU小时与300美元API额度，在共享64卡集群上自主选数据、实现训练流程、选择检查点；用20个基准与盲测人工评估打分。第二阶段各智能体获得涉及自身模型的对比记录与投票，追加3天训练。以NVIDIA Instruct作为跨轮共同参照，采用风格（长度、格式）调整后的相对评分进行比较。
AI.result: 十个智能体均产出可用助手；最强模型（由GPT-6 Astra训练）在12项能力基准上弥合了基座到Instruct差距的中位数76%，调整答案长度与格式后人类偏好接近NVIDIA Instruct。第二阶段中十个模型有八个的风格调整相对评分较第一阶段提升；但基准提升有限，且与偏好提升无明显关联；部分智能体倾向生成更长回答，另有一个模型在StrongREJECT上表现出更高的有害顺从率。
AI.conclusion: 自主后期训练在受限条件下可行，人类反馈能在一定程度上引导自主模型开发，但基准分数与人类偏好脱节，并伴随长度膨胀与安全性退化等错位风险；RSIHF框架提供了可审计的评估范式。

title: Qwen-Image-PE: Learning Visual Design for Text-to-Image Prompt Enhancement
summary: Learning visual design is essential for prompt enhancement (PE) to turn underspecified user requests into coherent visual specifications for text-to-image (T2I) generation. Existing methods preserve user intent and improve overall visual appeal, with less explicit emphasis on fine-grained design dimensions. To address this gap, we introduce Qwen-Image-PE, which learns visual design through two-stage training. Supervised fine-tuning with Caption-Based Reverse Distillation (CRD) uses dense captions of well-designed images as design supervision. Reinforcement learning with Groupwise Design Reward (GDR) jointly compares all candidate images for the same request to refine lighting, composition, layout, and detail. On Qwen-Image-Bench with Qwen-Image-2.1, Qwen-Image-PE-397B improves over original requests by 7.81 points, while Qwen-Image-PE-9B outperforms all evaluated PE baselines. Further evaluations show gains in visual design, aesthetics, image quality, and human preference. We find that PE scales along three axes: training data, model size, and information density, with sufficient information density as a prerequisite for effective enhancement. Moreover, we demonstrate that Qwen-Image-PE generalizes to four additional T2I backbones, even surpassing native prompt enhancers on HunyuanImage-2.1 and FLUX 3 Image Klein. We release Qwen-Image-PE-9B at https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I.

AI.tldr: 提出Qwen-Image-PE，通过两阶段训练（基于标题逆向蒸馏的监督微调 + 组内设计奖励的强化学习）学习细粒度视觉设计，用于提示词增强，显著提升T2I生成效果并具备良好泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有提示词增强方法虽能保留用户意图并提升整体美感，但对细粒度设计维度（光照、构图、布局、细节）的显式关注不足。
AI.method: 两阶段训练：1）Caption-Based Reverse Distillation（CRD）监督微调，以设计良好图像的密集描述作为设计监督；2）Groupwise Design Reward（GDR）强化学习，对同一请求的所有候选图像进行组内联合比较，精炼光照、构图、布局与细节。
AI.result: 在Qwen-Image-Bench（搭配Qwen-Image-2.1）上，397B版本较原始请求提升7.81分；9B版本优于所有评估过的PE基线，并在视觉设计、美学、图像质量和人类偏好上均有增益。发现PE沿训练数据、模型规模、信息密度三轴扩展，且信息密度是有效增强的前提。可泛化到4个额外T2I主干，在HunyuanImage-2.1和FLUX 3 Image Klein上甚至超越原生提示词增强器。
AI.conclusion: Qwen-Image-PE通过显式学习细粒度视觉设计实现有效提示词增强，具备规模可扩展性与跨主干泛化能力，并开源Qwen-Image-PE-9B。

title: Bidirectional Cross-frequency Domain Interaction Network for UHD Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Existing Ultra-High-Definition (UHD) low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods typically rely on either spatial- or frequency-domain modeling, or independently process different frequency components for efficient restoration. However, they often fail to jointly exploit complementary spatial--frequency information and the inherent relationship between illumination and structural information across frequencies, leading to inconsistent illumination, residual noise, and detail artifacts. In this paper, we propose a novel Bidirectional Cross-frequency Domain Interaction Network (BiFreqNet) for UHD LLIE. Specifically, BiFreqNet incorporates a Dual-domain Feature Interaction (DFI) module into the multi-scale representations of a pretrained variational autoencoder (VAE) to perform reciprocal enhancement between low- and high-frequency features. DFI consists of a Spatial and Spectral-Aware Low-Frequency Enhancement (S$^2$LFE) block and a Cross-Frequency Enhancement (CFE) block. S$^2$LFE exploits high-frequency structural cues to guide low-frequency restoration and jointly models spatial and spectral information to recover global exposure and spatially varying illumination while suppressing sensor noise. CFE further leverages the enhanced low-frequency contextual information to guide adaptive high-frequency refinement, enabling faithful reconstruction of structures and fine details. Extensive experiments on four general and UHD LLIE benchmarks demonstrate that BiFreqNet achieves competitive or superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出BiFreqNet，通过在预训练VAE多尺度表征中引入双向跨频域交互（DFI），实现低频与高频特征互增强，用于超高清低光照图像增强。
AI.motivation: 现有UHD LLIE方法仅依赖空间域或频域建模，或独立处理不同频率成分，未能联合利用空间-频率互补信息及光照与结构信息跨频率的内在关系，导致光照不一致、残余噪声与细节伪影。
AI.method: BiFreqNet在预训练变分自编码器（VAE）的多尺度表征中嵌入双域特征交互（DFI）模块，实现低频与高频特征互为增强。DFI含两部分：空间与频谱感知低频增强块（S²LFE），利用高频结构线索引导低频恢复，并联合建模空间与频谱信息以恢复全局曝光与空间变化光照、抑制传感器噪声；跨频增强块（CFE）利用增强后的低频上下文自适应引导高频细化，忠实重建结构与细节。
AI.result: 在四个通用及UHD低光照增强基准上，BiFreqNet与最先进方法相比取得具竞争力或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 双向跨频域交互可有效整合空间-频率互补信息，缓解光照不一致、噪声与细节伪影，为UHD低光照增强提供高效且高质量的解决方案。

title: Detecting Temporal Concepts in Video Transformers via a No-False-Positives Test
summary: Video models have the architecture to support encoding temporal aspects of the input, i.e. concepts that require more than one frame to define, like object movement. However, because motion and appearance change are entangled, a feature that appears to encode temporal concepts like object movement may instead encode non-temporal concepts like spatial presence at different positions whose activations merely correlate with motion. To resolve this, we introduce the No-False-Positives (NFP) test, a statistical test with a formal guarantee of statistical specificity for identifying features encoding temporal concepts. Using specially designed stimuli, we apply this test to representations produced by VideoMAE, V-JEPA2, and TimeSformer, and observe that temporal features exist in each model. We validate the test first by showing it yields no temporal features for the DINOv2 image-encoder. Then, using a synthetic representation space, we show that detection rate increases with a direction's projection onto the temporal subspace, and that Sparse Autoencoder features test-flagged as temporal project much more of their norm onto the temporal subspace than unflagged features. Interventions on temporal SAE features yield mixed results across models, suggesting that intervening on temporal features may not outperform a non-temporal feature baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 No-False-Positives (NFP) 检验，以统计特异性保证识别视频模型中真正编码时间概念的视觉特征，并将真假"时间特征"区分开来。
AI.motivation: 视频模型本应编码时间概念（如需多帧才能定义的运动），但因运动与外观变化相互纠缠，看似编码运动（时间性）的特征可能实际只编码"不同位置上的空间呈现"等非时间概念，其激活仅与运动相关。因此需要严格的检验区分真假时间特征。
AI.method: 提出 NFP 检验：通过精心设计的刺激（stimuli）构造统计检验，具有对统计特异性的形式化保证，用于判定特征是否编码时间概念。将其应用于 VideoMAE、V-JEPA2、TimeSformer 的表示；先以 DINOv2 图像编码器作为负对照验证检验有效性，再利用合成表示空间分析检测率与方向在时间子空间上的投影关系，并比较 SAE 特征的投影占比。
AI.result: 三个视频模型均存在时间特征；DINOv2 图像编码器未检出时间特征（验证检验有效）；在合成表示空间中，检测率随方向在时间子空间上的投影增大而上升；经 NFP 标记为时间性的 SAE 特征，其范数在时间子空间上的投影显著多于未标记特征；对时间 SAE 特征进行干预的结果在各模型间不一致。
AI.conclusion: NFP 检验能可靠识别视频模型中的时间特征并具统计特异性保证。干预实验的混合结果表明，仅针对"时间特征"做干预可能并不优于非时间特征基线，提示其实际效用仍待进一步验证。

title: Traffic-Context-Aware Driver Emotion Recognition with Expectation-Deviation-Driven Inference
summary: Driver emotion provides an important indication of how drivers perceive and evaluate ongoing traffic situations, making reliable emotion recognition an important capability for effective human-vehicle interaction. Yet, most existing driver emotion recognition approaches rely primarily on in-cabin images and overlook how surrounding traffic interactions shape driver emotional responses. To address this limitation, we propose a traffic-context-aware driver emotion recognition (TADER) framework that integrates in-cabin signals with out-of-cabin traffic scenarios, modeling driver emotions as arising from expectation deviation represented by the discrepancy between predicted and observed vehicle trajectories. The proposed framework comprises two key components: (1) a vision-based base recognizer that extracts spatiotemporal representations from in-cabin facial images to infer driver emotions, and (2) a traffic-context-aware fusion module that quantifies expectation deviation from external traffic scenarios and integrates it into the base recognizer via attention-based embedding fusion. To overcome the scarcity of paired in-cabin and out-of-cabin data, we introduce a transfer learning strategy that transfers a trajectory prediction model trained on large-scale naturalistic datasets to smaller paired datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TADER consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across both naturalistic and simulated driving environments by incorporating traffic context information into emotion recognition, resulting in improvements of 5% in accuracy on the AIDE and manD datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出TADER框架，将车内面部信号与车外交通场景融合，以"预测-实际轨迹偏差"刻画期望违背来识别驾驶员情绪，在两数据集上准确率提升约5%。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶员情绪识别方法主要依赖车内图像，忽视了周边交通交互对驾驶员情绪反应的影响，缺少对情绪成因（交通情境）的建模。
AI.method: TADER包含两部分：(1) 基于视觉的基础识别器，从车内面部图像提取时空表征推断情绪；(2) 交通情境感知融合模块，从外部交通场景量化期望偏差，并通过注意力嵌入融合注入基础识别器。为缓解车内-车外配对数据稀缺，采用迁移学习，将大规模自然驾驶数据上训练的轨迹预测模型迁移至小规模配对数据集。
AI.result: 在自然驾驶与模拟驾驶环境下，TADER均稳定优于现有最优方法；在AIDE与manD数据集上准确率提升5%。
AI.conclusion: 将交通情境信息（以轨迹期望偏差表征）引入情绪识别可有效提升性能，说明驾驶员情绪应被视为情境驱动的期望违背过程，而非仅由面部外观决定。

title: Scalable Unrolled Chains for MRI Reconstruction
comment: 23 pages (including supplementary material), 14 figures. Accepted at WACV 2027
summary: Unrolled variational networks achieve state-of-the-art performance for accelerated MRI reconstruction, but standard end-to-end training becomes prohibitively memory intensive as the number and width of cascades increase. We propose a memory-efficient training framework that updates a randomly sampled cascade while retaining supervision from the final reconstruction loss. The error signal is propagated from the end of the chain to the sampled cascade using an activation-light backward pass that avoids storing full chain activations, thereby decoupling training memory from chain length. A time-conditioned network shared across cascades further keeps the parameter count independent of chain length. The backward pass is approximate only through frozen normalization statistics, and a trained exact gradient control shows the approximation leaves reconstruction quality unchanged. The framework remains trainable at chain lengths and cascade widths where standard end-to-end backpropagation exhausts GPU memory. On fastMRI single-coil knee and multi-coil brain reconstruction, our method consistently outperforms other local training approaches. On high-SNR knee slices, our method surpasses E2E-VarNet at $8\times$ and matches it at $4\times$, while on the complete brain validation set it surpasses E2E-VarNet at $8\times$ and achieves comparable performance at $4\times$, with fewer parameters, lower peak memory, and faster per-iteration training. Code is available at https://github.com/emehillaj/scalable-unrolled-mri.

AI.tldr: 提出一种内存高效训练框架，通过随机采样级联并将最终重建损失反传至该级联，实现训练内存与展开链长解耦，在加速MRI重建中优于其他局部训练方法并与E2E-VarNet相当或更优。
AI.motivation: 展开式变分网络在加速MRI重建上性能领先，但标准端到端训练的内存开销随级联数量和宽度增长而急剧膨胀，甚至耗尽GPU内存，限制了模型规模扩展。
AI.method: 1) 每次迭代随机采样一个级联进行参数更新，但监督信号仍来自最终重建损失；2) 采用"轻激活"反向传播，将误差信号从链末端传至被采样级联，避免存储整条链的激活，使训练内存与链长解耦；3) 使用跨级联共享的时间条件网络，使参数量与链长无关；4) 反向传播仅在冻结的归一化统计量上做近似，并通过精确梯度对照实验验证近似不影响重建质量。
AI.result: 在fastMRI单线圈膝关节与多线圈脑部重建上持续优于其他局部训练方法；高SNR膝部切片在8×加速下超过E2E-VarNet、4×下持平；完整脑部验证集在8×下超过E2E-VarNet、4×下性能相当，且参数量更少、峰值内存更低、单次迭代训练更快；在标准端到端反传会耗尽GPU内存的链长与级联宽度下仍可训练。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持重建质量的同时显著降低训练内存与参数量并提升训练速度，使展开式MRI重建网络可在更大链长与宽度下高效训练，为可扩展的展开网络训练提供了可行方案。

title: UltraFlash: Accelerating Megapixel Visual Synthesis
summary: Megapixel visual synthesis with latent diffusion models requires operating far beyond the resolutions at which these models are typically trained. Cascade refinement is a leading strategy for this setting: it starts from a base image at a native resolution and progressively upsamples it to the target resolution through multiple refinement stages. Each stage typically performs a pixel-space resolution transition followed by latent-space denoising. While prior acceleration efforts mainly focus on reducing denoising cost, we identify a complementary and underexplored bottleneck: the repeated movement of representations through the VAE. We call these operations pixel-space transitions. In cascade pipelines, intermediate latents are often decoded to RGB, resized, and re-encoded before refinement, while final latents are decoded patch by patch with dense overlap to suppress boundary artifacts. We propose UltraFlash, a transition-efficient approach that accelerates these VAE-heavy operations. UltraFlash has two components. Latent Hyperloop replaces intermediate RGB round trips with a learned latent-space shortcut that approximates the decode-resize-encode transformation without repeated VAE decoding and encoding. Sparse Patch-based Decoding accelerates final reconstruction by addressing patch seams caused by inconsistent GroupNorm statistics and reusing cached statistics across patches, enabling sparse VAE decoding with much smaller overlap. Integrated into a state-of-the-art cascade baseline, UltraFlash reduces 4K generation latency by approximately 2x while improving image quality. These results show that optimizing pixel-space transitions can improve both efficiency and fidelity, offering an effective route toward fast, high-quality megapixel visual synthesis.

AI.tldr: UltraFlash 通过优化级联扩散管线中 VAE 的像素空间转换操作（Latent Hyperloop 与 Sparse Patch-based Decoding），将 4K 生成延迟降低约 2 倍并提升图像质量。
AI.motivation: 百万像素级视觉合成需在远超训练分辨率下运行，级联精化是主流方案。已有加速工作集中于降低去噪成本，而作者指出被忽视的瓶颈：表示在 VAE 中反复编解码所构成的像素空间转换（中间潜变量解码为 RGB、缩放、再编码，以及最终带密集重叠的逐块解码）。
AI.method: 提出 UltraFlash，包含两部分：(1) Latent Hyperloop，用学习到的潜空间捷径近似 decode-resize-encode 变换，避免重复 VAE 编解码；(2) Sparse Patch-based Decoding，针对 GroupNorm 统计不一致导致的拼块接缝问题，跨块复用缓存统计量，从而以更小重叠实现稀疏 VAE 解码。
AI.result: 集成到最先进级联基线后，4K 生成延迟降低约 2 倍，同时图像质量提升。
AI.conclusion: 优化像素空间转换可同时提升效率与保真度，是通往快速、高质量百万像素视觉合成的有效路径。

title: Automated identification of ivory carvings using machine learning: A proof-of-concept approach to detecting the illegal wildlife trade
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures and 2 tables. Submitted for publication in PLOS One
summary: Despite a ban on the international trading of recently poached ivory, elephants are still killed for their tusks. Ivory and its products are mainly sold in online marketplaces. However, due to the huge volume and variety of adverts and the similarity of ivory with other materials that can be legally sold, it is hard for enforcement officials to identify illicit trading and prosecute sellers. Existing techniques for identifying elephant ivory, such as Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy and microscopy, can reliably distinguish ivory from other materials, but require physical access to the item and cannot be applied to photographs alone. As a result, these methods are unsuitable for screening the large volume of images posted in online marketplaces, leaving a gap for automated, image-based identification tools. In this proof of concept work, we investigate the potential of machine learning techniques for image analysis to automatically distinguish ivory objects from bone. We employ a semantic segmentation framework using a U-Net architecture with a ResNet34 backbone, leveraging transfer learning on an augmented dataset of 541 original images. Using a dataset of images of ivory and items resembling carved ivory, several models were trialled. On a distinct test set, the classifier achieved an Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.81 and an overall classification accuracy of 81% on confident samples. The paper presents the best-performing model as a proof of concept for developing a system that can effectively identify ivory and its products when indicative features of elephant ivory are present in an image. This work provides initial steps towards a machine learning-based framework designed to advise law-enforcement in detecting illegal elephant ivory trade.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于U-Net(ResNet34骨干)+迁移学习的语义分割框架，利用541张原始图像增强后的数据集，从照片中自动区分象牙与骨骼，在独立测试集上AUC 0.81、置信样本准确率81%，为执法部门筛查网络市场非法象牙交易提供图像级自动识别工具的概念验证。
AI.motivation: 尽管近期盗猎象牙的国际交易已被禁止，大象仍因象牙被杀害，象牙制品主要在线上市场出售。因广告数量与种类庞大、且象牙与可合法售卖的其他材料外观相似，执法者难以识别非法交易并起诉卖家。现有鉴定手段（FTIR光谱、显微技术）虽可靠，却需实物接触，无法用于照片，难以对线上海量图像做筛查，从而留下自动化、基于图像的识别工具缺口。
AI.method: 采用语义分割框架：U-Net架构搭配ResNet34骨干网络，并在经数据增强的541张原始图像数据集上使用迁移学习训练；数据包含象牙及类似雕刻象牙的物品图像，共试验多个模型。
AI.result: 在独立测试集上，分类器取得AUC 0.81，在置信样本上总体分类准确率81%；性能最优模型被作为概念验证呈现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明：当图像中存在象象牙的指示性特征时，可有效识别象牙及其制品，为构建机器学习框架、辅助执法检测非法象牙交易迈出初步一步。

title: Of Chains and Gains: What Reinforcement Learning changes on Reasoning-based Image Quality Assessment
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has improved the performance of large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on image quality assessment (IQA). Existing approaches often attribute these gains to improved reasoning before scoring, supported by increasingly plausible Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, whether these gains exceed sampling effects and how they depend on explicit reasoning remain unclear. We rigorously investigate these questions through sampling-aware evaluation, controlled reasoning interventions, and shortcut experiments. We find that RL-trained models outperform base models under large-budget $\operatorname{max}_g@k$ evaluation, while improvements beyond averaging are concentrated in-distribution. RLVR produces chains that raise base-model performance when transplanted and improves scoring with the chain held fixed. Yet scoring becomes less dependent on the chain during inference, more clearly at 7B than at 32B. Steering the probed quality direction in thinking tokens also has little effect on scoring. Finally, RL can improve scoring accuracy by exploiting textual cues correlated with mean opinion scores (MOSs), which could inflate benchmark performance. Together, these findings show that RLVR raises quality scoring and produces more useful chains, but that better scoring does not imply a stronger reliance on explicit reasoning, while score-based rewards can also encourage reliance on quality-irrelevant shortcuts. We hope this preliminary study can enlighten more and more concrete reasoning schemes in IQA.

AI.tldr: 该文系统检验RLVR在图像质量评估（IQA）中的增益来源，发现增益超出采样效应但主要限于分布内，且更好评分并不意味着对显式推理的依赖增强。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将RLVR带来的IQA性能提升归因于评分前推理的改善，并以日益合理的CoT为佐证；但这些增益是否超越采样效应、是否依赖显式推理并不清楚。
AI.method: 采用采样感知评估（大预算max_g@k）、受控推理干预（链迁移、固定链评分、推理时链扰动）、思维token中质量方向的引导探测，以及文本线索捷径实验。
AI.result: RL训练模型在max_g@k下优于基座模型，但超出平均化的提升集中于分布内；迁移RL产生的思维链可提升基座模型表现，固定链也能改善评分；然而推理时评分对链的依赖下降（7B较32B更明显），引导思维token中的质量方向对评分影响很小；RL还可利用与MOS相关的文本线索提升评分准确率，从而可能虚高基准表现。
AI.conclusion: RLVR提升了质量评分并产生更有用的思维链，但更好评分不等于更强依赖显式推理，基于分数的奖励也可能助长对质量无关捷径的依赖；该初步研究可为IQA中更具体的推理方案提供启示。

title: Decentralized Multi-View, Multi-Zone Tracking for Scalable Camera Networks
summary: We present a decentralized multi-view tracking system for scalable camera networks. Single-view detections are projected to bird's-eye-view (BEV) coordinates and fused by independent multi-view trackers, each managing a dynamic spatial zone. To support scalability across spatially partitioned camera networks, we introduce a decentralized layer for trajectory unification, utilizing a locking protocol and periodic track-merging operations termed global collate. This process is supported by a delayed-output buffering mechanism that retroactively applies history corrections. The configurable delay window absorbs asynchronous coordination latency and helps stabilize cross-zone identity consistency. We detail the design of dynamic zone polygons, consensus-based coordination, and the validation framework, which together maintain global ID consistency with minimal accuracy loss compared to a single-instance baseline in the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种去中心化多视角跟踪系统：单视角检测投影到BEV后由各自管理动态空间区域的多视角跟踪器融合，并通过去中心化轨迹统一层（锁协议+全局collate）与延迟输出缓冲实现跨区域ID一致。
AI.motivation: 面向大规模空间分区相机网络的可扩展性需求，避免集中式跟踪的瓶颈，同时保持跨区域全局ID一致性。
AI.method: 单视角检测投影至BEV坐标并由独立多视角跟踪器融合，每个跟踪器管理动态空间区域；引入去中心化轨迹统一层，利用锁定协议与周期性track-merging（global collate），配合延迟输出缓冲回溯修正历史轨迹，以可配置延迟窗口吸收异步协调时延。
AI.result: 给出了动态区域多边形、基于共识的协调机制与验证框架的设计；在所评估配置下，相比单实例基线仅带来极小精度损失即可维持全局ID一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该去中心化分层架构可在空间分区相机网络上有效实现可扩展的多视角跟踪，兼顾去中心化协调延迟与全局身份一致性。

title: Texture-Aware Strategies for Subregion Style Transfer Augmentation
comment: Published at 2026 3rd International Conference on Digital Image Processing and Computer Applications (DIPCA)
summary: A common strategy for data augmentation is to apply style transfer on training images to enrich appearance variations. Recent approaches have combined style augmentation with random erasing by selectively replacing image subregions with style-transferred patches. However, existing methods rely on uniformly random region selection or fixed geometric constraints, which may fail to cover informative texture patterns and limit augmentation diversity. To address these limitations, we propose a texture-aware subregion style augmentation framework that prioritizes regions with strong texture responses for style replacement. Furthermore, we extend this framework with a hybrid region strategy that combines a texture-driven region with an auxiliary random region, implicitly enabling more diverse style perturbations. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves higher classification accuracy and improves robustness compared with existing style-based augmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 提出纹理感知的子区域风格增强框架，优先选择纹理响应强的区域进行风格替换，并引入混合区域策略（纹理区域+随机区域），以提升数据增强的多样性与分类精度及鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有将风格增强与随机擦除结合的方法依赖均匀随机区域选择或固定几何约束，难以覆盖有信息量的纹理模式，限制了增强多样性。
AI.method: 构建纹理感知的子区域风格增强框架：依据纹理响应优先选取子区域进行风格迁移替换；进一步扩展为混合区域策略，将纹理驱动区域与辅助随机区域组合，隐式引入更丰富的风格扰动。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比现有基于风格的增强方法，该方法取得更高的分类准确率并提升了模型鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 区域选择策略是风格增强的关键；纹理引导结合随机区域的混合选择能在保持信息量的同时增加扰动多样性，是一种有效的增强范式。

title: RelateGS: Reliable Semantic and Relational Evidence for 3D Scene Understanding with Gaussian Splatting
summary: Language-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has advanced language-driven 3D scene understanding by incorporating semantic and relational cues into reconstructed scenes. However, relation-aware grounding depends not only on representing such information, but also on whether the underlying scene-side evidence is reliable and sufficient. Multi-view semantic aggregation can incorporate weak observations, while object relations can remain under-observed along the available camera trajectory, leading to ambiguous evidence for target disambiguation. We present RelateGS, a structured language-aware Gaussian representation that selectively refines semantic and relational evidence for 3D visual grounding. RelateGS suppresses unreliable observations during semantic feature uplifting and consolidates multi-view object observations into a persistent 3D graph. The graph further identifies under-observed object relations and guides targeted re-querying of informative existing frames to complement their evidence. Experiments on Sr3D+ and Nr3D demonstrate competitive 3D grounding performance, improving the previous best by 7.9 and 1.7 percentage points at Acc@0.25, respectively.

AI.tldr: RelateGS 是一种结构化的语言感知 3D 高斯表示，通过抑制不可靠语义观测、将多视图物体观测整合为持久 3D 图，并针对欠观测的物体关系回查已有帧补充证据，从而提升 3D 视觉定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语言感知 3DGS 方法虽引入语义与关系线索，但关系感知定位不仅依赖信息表示，还取决于场景侧证据是否可靠充分：多视图语义聚合可能引入弱观测，且沿相机轨迹某些物体关系长期欠观测，导致目标消歧证据模糊。
AI.method: RelateGS 在语义特征提升阶段抑制不可靠观测；将多视图物体观测整合为持久 3D 图，用于识别欠观测的物体关系；据此引导对信息量大的已有帧进行定向重查询，以补全关系证据。
AI.result: 在 Sr3D+ 与 Nr3D 数据集上取得有竞争力的 3D 定位结果，Acc@0.25 分别较此前最佳方法提升 7.9 与 1.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以"证据可靠性筛选 + 结构化关系图 + 定向重查询"为核心的场景侧证据精炼，可有效缓解关系欠观测问题，显著提升语言驱动的 3D 视觉定位精度。

title: Segmentation of Moving Objects During Camera Motion Using the OWL Function
summary: We present a principled, analytical framework for segmenting multiple independently moving rigid objects during single camera motion, built directly upon the OWL perception function. OWL encodes two fundamental visual motion cues, perceived looming $L$ and perceived rotation $ω$, into a single closed-form representation of relative 3D structure. A key consequence of this structure is that the unit direction of relative translation $\hat{t}$ is analytically recoverable per image point from $L$ and $ω$ alone. All points belonging to a non-rotating rigid body share the same $\hat{t}$, whereas points on different rigid bodies generally yield distinct values. This furnishes a natural segmentation criterion: clustering per-point $\hat{t}$ estimates partitions the visible scene into independently moving rigid bodies. Building on the 2D complex form of OWL, we derive the framework in 3D using quaternions, for a single moving camera. The approach is parallel, camera rotation-invariant, and requires no training data, no depth information, and no semantic priors.

AI.tldr: 基于OWL感知函数构建解析框架，利用逐点相对平移方向$\hat{t}$的聚类实现多刚体运动分割，无需训练数据、深度或语义先验。
AI.motivation: 单相机运动下分割多个独立运动的刚体通常依赖学习模型或深度/语义信息。作者希望直接从基本视觉运动线索（looming与rotation）出发，建立一个有原理依据、解析可解、无需训练的分割准则。
AI.method: 以OWL感知函数为基础，将感知looming $L$与感知旋转$\omega$编码为相对3D结构的闭式表示；据此逐图像点解析恢复相对平移单位方向$\hat{t}$。利用同一非旋转刚体上所有点共享相同$\hat{t}$、不同刚体一般给出不同$\hat{t}$的性质，对逐点$\hat{t}$估计进行聚类作为分割准则。进一步将OWL的2D复数形式推广到3D四元数形式，针对单个运动相机推导完整框架。
AI.result: 逐点$\hat{t}$可仅由$L$与$\omega$解析恢复；$\hat{t}$聚类可将可见场景划分为独立运动的刚体。所提方法具有并行性、相机旋转不变性，且不需要训练数据、深度信息与语义先验。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个原理清晰、解析闭式、免训练的多刚体运动分割框架，其核心在于相对平移方向的刚体一致性，并通过四元数将OWL从2D推广至3D单相机情形。

title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
comment: Accepted to the WACV 2027. Source code is available at https://github.com/nadunnr/PathKGen
summary: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis serves as the fundamental method for the clinical diagnosis of cancer in digital histopathology. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated histopathology report generation. However, MLLMs reason purely through distributions encoded in their neural parameters, limiting the amount of knowledge and reasoning logic they can contain given the model scale. Their black-box reasoning poses another challenge to the human interpretation of intermediate reasoning. We address these issues by utilizing knowledge graphs to inject external structured knowledge for MLLMs to reason over, while making this reasoning component visible. Knowledge graphs are capable of partially externalizing the containment of medical knowledge, an area that remains underexplored in pathology report generation. We introduce PathKGen, a knowledge graph-assisted MLLM for histopathology report generation. PathKGen has two main branches: (1) a visual path that learns visual token inputs to the MLLM using pathology foundation models, and (2) a knowledge path that learns knowledge token inputs by extracting key morphological features of WSIs through querying a pathology-specific knowledge graph. A comprehensive evaluation on WSI-Bench dataset shows that PathKGen surpasses previous SOTA methods while revealing diagnostic reasoning as visually intuitive graphs. Due to its modular design, the proposed knowledge path is complementary to vision-aligned MLLMs and can be extended to other applications by curating domain-specific knowledge graphs to generate knowledge tokens.

AI.tldr: PathKGen通过知识图谱向多模态大模型注入结构化外部医学知识，实现组织病理报告生成，性能超越SOTA并可可视化诊断推理过程。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型（MLLMs）仅依赖神经参数中编码的分布进行推理，受模型规模限制知识容量与推理逻辑有限；且其黑盒推理难以被人理解。病理报告生成领域对知识图谱外部化医学知识的探索仍不足。
AI.method: 提出PathKGen，含两条分支：(1) 视觉路径，基于病理基础模型学习输入MLLM的视觉token；(2) 知识路径，通过查询病理专用知识图谱提取WSI关键形态学特征，学习生成知识token作为MLLM输入。
AI.result: 在WSI-Bench数据集上的综合评测表明，PathKGen优于此前SOTA方法，并将诊断推理呈现为视觉上直观的图结构。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱为病理报告生成提供了可外部化、可解释的推理组件；其模块化设计使知识路径与视觉对齐的MLLM互补，可通过构建领域知识图谱扩展至其他应用。

title: LENS: Likelihood Evaluation and Neighbor Smoothing for Attribute-Based Person Retrieval on Unseen Cameras
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the 7th Real-World Surveillance Workshop (RWS) at WACV 2027
summary: Attribute-based person retrieval ranks surveillance images from a binary query of semantic attributes, but mean Average Attribute Degree of Match (mADM) drops on unseen cameras as predicted probabilities shift. Common pipelines rank gallery images by their L1 distance to the query, which penalizes a confident single-attribute mismatch no more than small uncertainties across many attributes, while post-hoc recalibration fitted on source validation data fails to transfer because the per-attribute maps fitted on source data do not match those of new cameras. We propose LENS (Likelihood Evaluation and Neighbor Smoothing), combining fine-tuned DINOv3 and CLIP models with a distilled student. LENS regularizes mutually exclusive attribute groups with group cross-entropy in training, scores gallery images by the log-likelihood of the exact query, and smooths gallery logits over nearest neighbors using DINOv3 appearance features from the same forward pass. On held-out datasets, all three changes raise mADM: the likelihood score improves all six retrieval metrics for the main ensemble and mADM for all 48 development models, and training-free kNN smoothing improves all 46 tested development models. On the hidden test set of the UPAR 2027 benchmark, LENS reaches 68.17 mADM.

AI.tldr: 提出LENS方法，用似然评分替换L1距离、用分组交叉熵正则互斥属性、并用免训练kNN平滑gallery logits，在UPAR 2027隐藏测试集达68.17 mADM。
AI.motivation: 基于属性的人员检索在未见相机上mADM下降：预测概率发生漂移；常见流程用L1距离给gallery排序，无法区分"单个属性高置信错配"与"多属性小不确定"；在源数据验证集上拟合的后处理重校准无法迁移到新相机，因为每属性的映射关系与新相机不匹配。
AI.method: LENS（Likelihood Evaluation and Neighbor Smoothing）：(1) 微调DINOv3与CLIP模型并蒸馏出学生模型；(2) 训练时用分组交叉熵对互斥属性组施加正则；(3) 推理时按精确查询的对数似然对gallery打分，替代L1距离；(4) 利用同一次前向的DINOv3外观特征在最近邻上平滑gallery logits（免训练kNN）。
AI.result: 留出数据集上三项改动均提升mADM：似然评分使主集成模型全部6项检索指标提升、48个开发模型的mADM全部提升；免训练kNN平滑使46个测试开发模型全部提升；UPAR 2027隐藏测试集上LENS达到68.17 mADM。
AI.conclusion: 以查询精确对数似然替代L1距离评分、属性组互斥正则与kNN logits平滑能稳定缓解跨相机概率漂移，且免训练平滑具良好普适性。

title: EditDistill: Is It Possible to Guide Video Editing with Image Editing?
summary: Recent advances in image editing have enabled fine-grained and highly controllable visual modifications. However, achieving similar levels of controllability in video editing remains an open challenge, particularly for precise local edits, dynamic temporal effects, and consistent lighting across frames.In this paper, we propose EditDistill, a framework that distills image-level visual transformations from edits to guide video editing.Specifically, given a source video and an edit prompt, we first generate an edited version of the initial video frame using an off-the-shelf image editing model. We then distill the visual transformation of this original-edited image pair into a compact representation termed an edit descriptor.This descriptor is injected into a video diffusion model through our lightweight fusion module, which steers the denoising process toward the desired edit. To align the video trajectory with the demonstrated image edit while preserving motion and layout, we train with edit-descriptor alignment and DINO structural consistency losses, and derive an equivalent inference-time guidance formulation under flow matching.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves strong performance on standard benchmarks and produces high-quality video editing results across diverse scenarios. For more details and videos, please refer to the anonymous webpage: https://yu-shaonian.github.io/EditDistill-Web/.

AI.tldr: 提出 EditDistill 框架，将图像级编辑模型的视觉变换蒸馏为紧凑的"编辑描述子"，注入视频扩散模型以引导去噪方向，从而实现精确局部编辑、动态时序效果与跨帧一致光照的视频编辑。
AI.motivation: 图像编辑已能实现细粒度、高可控的视觉修改，但视频编辑中同等水平的可控性仍是开放挑战，尤其是精确局部编辑、动态时序效果和跨帧光照一致性难以保证。
AI.method: 给定源视频与编辑提示，先用现成图像编辑模型对首帧生成编辑结果；将原始-编辑图像对的视觉变换蒸馏为紧凑的"编辑描述子"（edit descriptor）；通过轻量融合模块将该描述子注入视频扩散模型，引导去噪过程朝向目标编辑；训练时采用编辑描述子对齐损失与 DINO 结构一致性损失，以在保持运动与布局的同时对齐图像编辑示范轨迹，并在 flow matching 框架下推导等价的推理期引导公式。
AI.result: 在标准基准上取得强劲性能，并在多种场景下生成高质量视频编辑结果。
AI.conclusion: 以图像编辑作为"示范"、通过描述子蒸馏与轻量融合将图像级可控性迁移到视频扩散模型，是一种有效且通用的视频编辑范式。

title: Explaining Basketball Shot Classifications with Grad-CAM: An Investigation of Shortcut Reliance with Spatiotemporal Correlations
comment: 2 pages, 2 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/spicybigmac/basketball
summary: Basketball action recognition is used in high-stakes scenarios to inform such tasks as specialized coaching, yet the evidence used by its deep-learning models is poorly understood. This paper investigates whether there is evidence that an R(2+1)D-18 model trained on the Basketball-51 dataset relies on spurious spatiotemporal correlations when classifying basketball shot outcomes. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) was used to generate spatiotemporal saliency maps, whose faithfulness was evaluated by progressively blurring the most salient pixels. Twenty saliency maps were then visually reviewed for recurring salient regions. Grad-CAM highlighted spatially central regions of clips including the shooter, net, and occasionally the courtside crowd. Blurring interventions were conducted to support these patterns. Blurring the central region resulted in an accuracy of 43.7%, compared to the original test accuracy of 69.3% and random-blurred accuracy of 50.9%. The additional 7.2 percentage-point reduction from central blurring compared to random blurring suggests that the model relies on task-relevant visual regions; this highlights the need for continual audits to ensure trustworthy, equitable sports analytics.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Grad-CAM与渐进模糊干预，检验在Basketball-51数据集上训练的R(2+1)D-18模型是否依赖虚假的时空相关性来判定投篮结果。结果显示模型主要关注含投篮者、篮网等任务相关中心区域，中心模糊使准确率由69.3%降至43.7%，比随机模糊低7.2个百分点，说明其依赖任务相关视觉区域，但仍需持续审计。
AI.motivation: 篮球动作识别被用于专业训练等高风险场景，但其深度学习模型所依据的证据缺乏理解；作者关注模型是否依赖数据中的虚假时空相关性（spurious correlation），从而影响可信度与公平性。
AI.method: 以R(2+1)D-18在Basketball-51数据集上训练；用Grad-CAM生成时空显著性图，并通过对最显著像素渐进模糊来评估其faithfulness；再对20张显著性图进行人工视觉审阅以寻找反复出现的显著区域，辅以模糊干预实验（中心模糊 vs 随机模糊）。
AI.result: Grad-CAM突出显示片段的中心空间区域，包括投篮者、篮网，偶尔涉及场边观众；中心区域模糊后准确率为43.7%，原始测试准确率为69.3%，随机模糊为50.9%，即中心模糊相对随机模糊额外带来7.2个百分点的下降。
AI.conclusion: 模型主要依赖任务相关的中心视觉区域而非明显的虚假线索，但显著性图显示其亦可能关注场边观众等无关区域；作者强调需要进行持续审计以保证体育分析的可信性与公平性。

title: World-in-Context: Interactive Video World Modeling with In-Context Conditioning
summary: Interactive video world models require coordinated control over viewing perspectives, character actions, and camera motion. Existing methods typically leave view modes implicit in text captions, conflate action with camera motion, and inject controls through fragmented architectural pathways that capture interdependencies only indirectly. In this work, we present World-in-Context, an interactive world modeling framework powered by In-Context Conditioning (ICC). Rather than relying on specialized conditioning pathways, World-in-Context unifies view, action, and camera controls into explicit tokens contextualized directly within a shared self-attention space. Our formulation reveals that (i) explicit view tokens disentangle conflicting dynamics and unlock emergent view switching from single-view data, while (ii) action and camera inputs play complementary roles in governing local responsiveness and global stability. To preserve temporal continuity across execution intervals, we further introduce Interaction-Transport RoPE (IT-RoPE), parameterizing temporal attention with accumulated control transitions. On WBench, World-in-Context-5B achieves navigation performance on par with 22B EchoWM ($81.5$ vs. $81.6$) and attains a $93.8\%$ perspective-switching success rate, substantially outperforming existing 5B baselines ($18.8\%$). Controlled analyses further demonstrate compounding advantages of World-in-Context under richer conditioning mixtures, favorable data efficiency, and natural applicability to causal rollouts.

AI.tldr: 提出 World-in-Context 框架，用 In-Context Conditioning 将视角、动作、相机三类控制统一为显式 token 并置于共享自注意力空间，配合 IT-RoPE 保持跨交互区间的时间连续性，以 5B 规模在导航与视角切换任务上达到大模型水平。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型存在三点缺陷：视角模式隐含在文本描述中、动作与相机运动相互混淆、控制信号通过零散架构通路注入导致依赖关系只能被间接建模。
AI.method: 提出 In-Context Conditioning (ICC)：不再依赖专用条件通路，而将视角、动作、相机控制编码为显式 token，与内容 token 一起在共享自注意力空间中上下文化；并提出 Interaction-Transport RoPE (IT-RoPE)，以累积的控制转移参数化时间注意力，维持执行区间之间的时间连续性。
