AI.result: 在 WBench 上，World-in-Context-5B 的导航性能与 22B 的 EchoWM 相当（81.5 vs. 81.6），视角切换成功率达 93.8%，远优于现有 5B 基线（18.8%）。受控分析显示在更丰富的条件混合下具有复合增益、良好的数据效率，并可自然用于因果自回归 rollout。
AI.conclusion: 显式视角 token 可解耦冲突动态并从单视角数据中涌现视角切换能力；动作与相机输入分别主导局部响应性与全局稳定性。统一到自注意力上下文的控制注入方式在小模型规模下即可逼近大模型效果。

title: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
summary: Precise camera control is essential for cinematic character video generation, yet existing methods struggle to follow large-angle trajectories with combined rotation, translation, and radius variation from arbitrary initial azimuths. Such viewpoint changes also reveal character regions unseen in the initial frame, causing geometric distortions, appearance degradation, and identity drift. To systematically study these coupled challenges, we introduce CLACT, a large-scale Character-centric dataset and benchmark covering diverse Large-Angle Camera Trajectories, with accurate camera geometry and multi-view character observations for training and evaluation. We further propose WorldCast, a framework for world-consistent character video generation under diverse large-angle camera motions. Specifically, we back-project the initial frame into a 3D point cloud using estimated depth, align the point-cloud scale with the target camera trajectory, and render it along the trajectory to obtain explicit geometric guidance and coverage masks. To complement the incomplete character information, we introduce Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention (GAMA). Using relative camera poses estimated jointly from the initial frame and multi-view character anchors, we express anchor and target-view geometry in a common coordinate frame. GAMA uses this geometric alignment to guide the retrieval and injection of view-relevant character features during generation. Evaluations across diverse large-angle camera trajectories demonstrate accurate trajectory following while preserving character geometry, appearance, and identity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向电影化角色视频生成的大角度相机轨迹数据集与基准 CLACT，以及世界一致性生成框架 WorldCast，通过点云几何引导与几何对齐记忆注意力（GAMA），在保持角色几何、外观与身份的同时实现精确的大角度相机轨迹跟随。
AI.motivation: 精确的相机控制对电影化角色视频生成至关重要，但现有方法难以从任意初始方位角跟随包含旋转、平移与半径变化的大角度组合轨迹；同时视角剧变会暴露初始帧未见的角色区域，导致几何畸变、外观退化与身份漂移。为系统研究这些耦合挑战，需要专门的数据集与基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建 CLACT：大规模角色中心数据集与基准，覆盖多样大角度相机轨迹，含精确相机几何与多视角角色观测；2) 提出 WorldCast 框架：用估计深度将初始帧反投影为3D点云，将点云尺度与目标相机轨迹对齐，并沿轨迹渲染以获得显式几何引导与覆盖掩码；3) 引入 Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention (GAMA)，利用由初始帧与多视角角色锚点联合估计的相对相机位姿，将锚点与目标视角几何表达在统一坐标系中，据此检索并注入视角相关的角色特征，弥补不完整的角色信息。
AI.result: 在多样大角度相机轨迹上的评测表明，方法能够准确跟随轨迹，同时保持角色的几何结构、外观与身份一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据集基准 CLACT 与几何引导、几何对齐记忆注意力的 WorldCast 框架，可有效解决大角度相机运动下角色视频生成中的视角覆盖不足与一致性退化问题，实现世界一致的角色视频生成。

title: Ampe-DB: A Dataset for Human Activity and Interaction Analysis Using the Ghanaian Game Ampe
comment: 74 pages, 9 figures, 7 numbered tables. Ampe-DB V1 dataset (637 interaction clips) available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RuthBiney/Ampe-DB
summary:
Human activity recognition benchmarks underrepresent culturally situated forms of movement and interaction. We introduce Ampe-DB, a multimodal dataset based on Ampe, a traditional Ghanaian game involving coordinated jumping, leg movements, and two-person interaction. It contains 637 canonical clips from 15 participants, with RGB video, two-person pose representations, participant and pair metadata, four-class movement labels, and derived binary movement-relation labels.
  We evaluate four-class movement recognition and binary movement-relation classification using three protocols: a duplicate-safe fixed benchmark, four-fold pair-held-out evaluation, and participant-held-out diagnostics for participants with complete class coverage. Baselines comprise a frozen Kinetics-400-pretrained R(2+1)D-18 RGB encoder, a two-layer bidirectional GRU for pose sequences, and validation-selected RGB-pose late fusion.
  For four-class recognition, RGB macro-F1 falls from 0.955 on the fixed benchmark to 0.418 under pair-held-out evaluation and 0.384 under participant-held-out evaluation. Pose is more robust, achieving 0.957, 0.811, and 0.839 across the same protocols. Fusion reaches 0.976 on the fixed benchmark and 0.824 under pair-held-out evaluation, but does not consistently improve on pose under participant shift. Binary movement-relation recognition also becomes substantially harder under held-out evaluation, especially for different-leg configurations.
  These findings show that strong fixed-benchmark scores can mask failures to generalize across people and pairings. Ampe-DB supports research on fine-grained movement recognition, human-human interaction, multimodal learning, and identity-aware generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ampe-DB——一个基于加纳传统游戏 Ampe 的多模态人体动作数据集（15 名被试、637 个规范片段、RGB、双人姿态、元数据、四类动作标签及二值动作关系标签），并系统比较固定基准、配对留出与个体留出三种评测协议下 RGB、姿态与 RGB-姿态晚期融合基线，揭示固定基准高分掩盖了跨人与跨配对泛化失败。
AI.motivation: 现有动作识别基准对文化情境化的运动与交互形式代表性不足，尤其缺乏双人协同、跳跃与腿部动作的细粒度数据；同时固定划分基准可能高估模型泛化能力，需要能考察跨个体与跨配对泛化的数据与协议。
AI.method: 构建 Ampe-DB（RGB 视频、双人姿态表示、被试与配对元数据、四类动作标签、派生二值动作关系标签）；设定三种评测协议：去重安全的固定基准、四折配对留出、以及仅纳入类别覆盖完整被试的个体留出诊断；基线包括冻结的 Kinetics-400 预训练 R(2+1)D-18 RGB 编码器、两层双向 GRU 姿态序列模型，以及经验证集选择的 RGB-姿态晚期融合。
AI.result: 四类识别中，RGB 宏 F1 从固定基准 0.955 降至配对留出 0.418、个体留出 0.384；姿态更稳健，分别为 0.957、0.811、0.839；融合在固定基准达 0.976、配对留出 0.824，但在个体迁移下未稳定优于姿态。二值动作关系识别在留出评测下显著变难，异侧腿配置尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 固定基准上的强性能可能掩盖跨人与跨配对泛化缺陷；Ampe-DB 可支撑细粒度动作识别、人-人交互、多模态学习与身份感知泛化研究。

title: SWIFT-Cell: Segmentation Without Iterative Flow Tracking
summary: Generalist segmenters such as Cellpose-SAM (CPSAM) outline cells accurately across stains but slowly; watershed detectors such as QuPath's are fast but less accurate. In time-critical use, such as interactive retrieval of cells from a user-drawn region, CPSAM at the reference settings takes 58-303 s per measured 8192 x 8192 region on an RTX 4500 Ada GPU, beyond a seconds-scale interactive target. We distil CPSAM into SWIFT-Cell (SWIFT), a 0.63M-parameter U-Net trained only on CPSAM masks of 1,202 H&E and IHC tiles. On three 8192 x 8192 development regions SWIFT takes 2.0-5.2 s on 4 CPU cores in int8, 2.5-5.1x faster than QuPath's detector on the same cores, and 0.36-0.49 s on a GPU. Against human annotations on eight H&E, IHC and ISH sets it keeps 95% of CPSAM's panoptic quality (PQ) on PanNuke (0.593 vs. 0.627) and is level on NuCLS (0.546 vs. 0.540). On Ki-67 IHC masks scored to the outline centre it is 0.205 PQ above QuPath's better mode, 0.079 below CPSAM and 0.027 below InstanSeg (CI includes 0; at the outer edge 0.008 below CPSAM); on 212 pathologist-outlined nuclei in Ki-67 fields of 12 untouched patients its recall is 0.925 (CPSAM 0.920, InstanSeg 0.901; paired difference CIs include 0); one method-blinded pathologist accepted its outlines in 96% of 100 fields (60 from two development tissue patients, 40 hematology; CPSAM 83%, QuPath 53%; tissue 100% for SWIFT and CPSAM); on ER/PR points from 12 patients its detection F1 is 0.882 (CPSAM 0.896, InstanSeg 0.857), and on 4-reader PD-L1 points 0.83 (CPSAM 0.85, readers 0.87). SWIFT is close to CPSAM in accuracy and faster than watershed detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过知识蒸馏将通用分割模型CPSAM蒸馏为轻量U-Net模型SWIFT-Cell（0.63M参数），在保持接近CPSAM精度的同时，实现秒级交互速度，CPU上比QuPath分水岭检测器快2.5-5.1倍。
AI.motivation: 通用细胞分割器（如Cellpose-SAM）精度高但在大尺寸区域上极慢（8192×8192区域需58-303秒），无法满足交互式检索等时间敏感场景的秒级目标；而分水岭检测器（如QuPath）虽快但精度较低。因此需要在精度与速度之间取得更好平衡。
AI.method: 将CPSAM知识蒸馏为SWIFT-Cell（SWIFT）：一个仅0.63M参数的U-Net，仅用CPSAM在1,202张H&E和IHC图块上生成的掩膜作为监督训练。在三个8192×8192开发区域上评估速度（CPU int8 4核与GPU），并在8个H&E、IHC、ISH数据集上对照人工标注评估精度（PQ、召回率、F1）、方法盲法病理学家接受率。
AI.result: 速度：SWIFT在CPU（int8，4核）上耗时2.0-5.2秒，比QuPath检测器快2.5-5.1倍；GPU上0.36-0.49秒。精度：PanNuke上保留CPSAM 95%的PQ（0.593 vs 0.627），NuCLS上持平（0.546 vs 0.540）；Ki-67 IHC上比QuPath最佳模式高0.205 PQ，低于CPSAM 0.079、低于InstanSeg 0.027（置信区间含0）；212个病理学家勾画核的召回率0.925（CPSAM 0.920，InstanSeg 0.901）；单盲病理学家接受率96%（CPSAM 83%，QuPath 53%）；ER/PR检测F1为0.882（CPSAM 0.896），PD-L1为0.83（CPSAM 0.85）。
AI.conclusion: SWIFT在精度上接近CPSAM，同时速度快于分水岭检测器，可作为时间敏感交互场景下的高效细胞分割方案，在精度与速度间取得良好权衡。

title: DuoPIC: Uncertainty-Aware Voxel-Level Digital Twins of Cerebral Perfusion with Transport PDEs in Acute Stroke
summary: Digital twins of cerebral perfusion relate tracer dynamics to cerebral blood flow (CBF), blood volume (CBV) and mean transit time (MTT), but must be data-driven, physically consistent and uncertainty-aware. We introduce DuoPIC, a digital twin that needs no reference maps, in which a Windkessel flow model drives a tracer transport partial differential equation (PDE). A population-level neural closure divides each region into fast and slow pathways with tracer mass and MTT conserved by construction, and a tempered posterior quantifies the uncertainty of every estimate. Its voxel maps set the state of the art for lesion detection on ISLES'17 MR (AUC 0.745) and ISLES'24 CT (0.743). On held-out patients, the neural PDE reduced the compartment's reconstruction error by 19% and lifted 95% MTT interval coverage from 88% to 94%. Code: https://github.com/detinatran/duopic

AI.tldr: 提出DuoPIC数字孪生框架，无需参考图谱，以Windkessel血流模型驱动示踪剂输运PDE，结合人口级神经闭合与tempered后验，实现物理一致、不确定性可量化的脑灌注估计，在ISLES'17/24病灶检测与MTT区间覆盖上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 脑灌注数字孪生需将示踪剂动力学与CBF、CBV、MTT关联，现有方法依赖参考图谱且缺乏物理一致性与不确定性量化，故需数据驱动、物理约束且能给出不确定性估计的建模方式。
AI.method: 构建DuoPIC：Windkessel血流模型驱动示踪剂输运PDE；人口级神经闭合将每个区域划分为快/慢通路，并在构造上守恒示踪剂质量与MTT；采用tempered后验量化每个估计的不确定性；无需参考图谱。
AI.result: 体素图在ISLES'17 MR（AUC 0.745）与ISLES'24 CT（AUC 0.743）病灶检测上达到SOTA；在留出患者上，神经PDE将房室重建误差降低19%，并将95% MTT区间覆盖率从88%提升至94%。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束的神经PDE与保守闭合可在无参考图谱条件下提供高精度且校准良好的灌注估计，兼顾检测性能与不确定性覆盖。

title: FreqPKC: Frequency-Aware PeakConv for Radar Semantic Segmentation
summary: Automotive millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar has attracted increasing attention for semantic segmentation in autonomous driving, owing to its robustness under adverse weather and lighting conditions. Recent works have introduced radar-specific neural operators such as PeakConv (PKC), inspired by constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detection, to better model the peak-dominated characteristics of radar images. However, existing methods typically treat the guard bandwidth as learnable parameters, without explicitly characterizing the frequency response of the PKC operator. In this work, we revisit PKC from a frequency-domain perspective and propose Frequency-Aware PeakConv (FreqPKC), which explicitly models and exploits its underlying spectral characteristics. By analyzing the frequency response of PKC, FreqPKC enables the network to capture a broader range of frequency components and adaptively adjust its effective bandwidth. With the proposed Frequency-Aware (FA) module, the network can infer appropriate guard bandwidths to balance high- and low-frequency information: it enhances high-frequency components in target regions for more precise segmentation while suppressing noise through low-frequency filtering in background areas. Building on FreqPKC, we further develop FreqPKC-Net, a radar semantic segmentation (RSS) framework that integrates frequency-guided adaptive modulation with cross-view fusion for multi-view inputs, and can also be adapted to single-view data. Experiments on the public datasets CARRADA, CARRADA-RAC, and a self-built dataset named RS-SAR demonstrate that FreqPKC-Net consistently outperforms existing SoTA methods on both range-Doppler and range-angle views.

AI.tldr: 论文从频域视角重新审视PeakConv算子，提出频域感知的FreqPKC及分割框架FreqPKC-Net，在多个雷达语义分割数据集上超越现有SoTA。
AI.motivation: 车载毫米波雷达语义分割在恶劣天气与光照下鲁棒性强，已有工作引入受CFAR启发的PeakConv（PKC）建模雷达图像的峰值主导特性，但现有方法将保护带宽视为可学习参数，未显式刻画PKC算子的频率响应，导致高低频信息利用与噪声抑制能力受限。
AI.method: 从频域视角分析PKC算子的频率响应，提出FreqPKC，显式建模并利用其频谱特性，使网络覆盖更宽的频率成分并自适应调整有效带宽；设计频域感知（FA）模块，推断合适的保护带宽以平衡高低频信息——在目标区域增强高频成分以提升分割精度，在背景区域通过低频滤波抑制噪声。在此基础上构建FreqPKC-Net框架，融合频率引导的自适应调制与多视角输入的跨视角融合，并可适配单视角数据。
AI.result: 在公开数据集CARRADA、CARRADA-RAC及自建数据集RS-SAR上，FreqPKC-Net在距离-多普勒与距离-角度两种视图下均持续优于现有SoTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模PKC的频率响应并自适应调节保护带宽，可有效平衡高频细节与低频噪声抑制；FreqPKC-Net在多视角与单视角雷达语义分割任务中均取得领先性能，验证了频域感知设计的有效性。

title: Can One Hear Geometry? Gauge-Invariant Spectral Descriptors for Text-to-B-rep Retrieval
summary: Text-to-3D solid retrieval requires aligning natural language with precise geometry despite variations in pose, scale, and recording conventions. Existing methods discretize Boundary Representation (B-rep) models into point clouds or meshes, or learn features from faces, edges, and topology, risking information loss or lacking explicit invariance guarantees. We propose a text-to-B-rep retrieval framework based on group actions and spectral geometric invariants, making invariance an explicit constraint on descriptor construction. Specifically, we use group actions to characterize equivalence transformations induced by translation, rotation, reflection, uniform scaling, and contour recording conventions. For sketch-extrusion solids, we construct a fixed 280-dimensional spectral geometric descriptor by integrating geometric information from three complementary levels, including cross-sectional regions, contour boundaries, and extrusion structures. Furthermore, we use descriptor-consistent multi-positive sets and geometric attribute supervision to promote structural alignment between text and solids. On Text-to-3D solid retrieval, our method achieves 88.6% Recall@5, exceeding the previous state of the art by 13.6 percentage points and demonstrating the effectiveness of explicit geometric invariants for precise 3D solid retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出基于群作用与谱几何不变量的文本到B-rep实体检索框架，用显式不变性约束构造280维谱几何描述子，在文本到3D实体检索上达到88.6% Recall@5，超SOTA 13.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 文本-3D实体检索需在姿态、尺度与记录约定变化下对齐语言与精确几何。现有方法将B-rep离散为点云/网格，或从面、边与拓扑学习特征，存在信息损失或缺乏显式不变性保证的问题。
AI.method: 以群作用刻画平移、旋转、反射、均匀缩放与轮廓记录约定引起的等价变换，使不变性成为描述子构造的显式约束；针对草图-拉伸实体，融合截面区域、轮廓边界与拉伸结构三个互补层次的几何信息，构造固定280维谱几何描述子；并采用描述子一致的多正样本集与几何属性监督，促进文本与实体间的结构对齐。
AI.result: 在Text-to-3D实体检索任务上取得88.6% Recall@5，较此前最优方法提升13.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何不变量对精确3D实体检索有效；将不变性作为描述子构造的约束，可避免离散化带来的信息损失并在该任务上显著超越现有方法。

title: Fast Instinct, Slow Reason: A Dual-Speed Agentic Framework for Self-Configuring Multi-Object Tracking in Satellite Video
summary: Multi-object tracking in satellite video underpins persistent monitoring, yet offline-tuned trackers lack the onboard intelligence and efficiency to adapt within an observation of tens of seconds. The root is that adaptation still means relabelling and retraining the detector, which cannot run on board in time. Tuning the tracker configuration strongly controls accuracy without touching the network, yet search needs labelled or proxy evaluations, and a language agent costs seconds and tokens per decision. We propose a dual-speed agentic framework pairing a fast instinct compiled offline with a slow reason serving the mission. Its algorithm, Arbitration of Unlabelled Shortlists from Prior Experience, or AUSPEX, learns a covering shortlist and a label-free ranker from labelled source tasks and commits one configuration per sequence. Its system, a Cascaded Onboard Runtime with Verified Uplinked Skills, or CORVUS, cascades reflex, skill, and agent layers, so that a verified skill commits 2.5 s into each observation while a language agent serves natural- language missions. On SatMTB and SatVideoDT with three recent detectors, AUSPEX raises IDF1 by 2.84 to 2.94 points and MOTA by 3.21 to 3.29 points on average without target labels, balances accuracy and labels best among sixteen methods, and loses at most 0.28 IDF1 points at 1.25 tracking passes. CORVUS executes four missions with execution accuracy up to 0.99 and target recall at the perception ceiling, spends no token on the routine decision, runs on Jetson Xavier NX, and hosts fifteen language models from six families without altering any commitment, demonstrating its extensibility and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出双速智能体框架AUSPEX+CORVUS，在无目标标签条件下通过离线编译的覆盖短名单与无标签排序器实现序列级跟踪配置自适应，并级联机载运行时支持自然语言任务。
AI.motivation: 卫星视频多目标跟踪需在数十秒观测内持续监测，但离线调优的跟踪器缺乏在轨自适应能力与效率；现有自适应仍依赖重标注与重训检测器，无法及时在轨运行。调整跟踪器配置可在不动网络的情况下强控精度，但搜索需有标签或代理评估，而语言智能体每次决策耗时且耗token。
AI.method: 双速智能体框架：快速本能经离线编译，慢速推理服务任务。算法AUSPEX（Arbitration of Unlabelled Shortlists from Prior Experience）从有标签源任务学习覆盖短名单与无标签排序器，并为每条序列提交一个配置；系统CORVUS（Cascaded Onboard Runtime with Verified Uplinked Skills）级联反射、技能、智能体三层，经验证技能在每次观测2.5秒内提交配置，语言智能体承接自然语言任务。
AI.result: 在SatMTB与SatVideoDT上搭配三种近期检测器，无目标标签下IDF1平均提升2.84–2.94点、MOTA提升3.21–3.29点；在16种方法中精度与标签开销平衡最优；1.25次跟踪遍历下IDF1损失至多0.28点。CORVUS四项任务执行准确率达0.99，目标召回达到感知上限，常规决策零token开销，运行于Jetson Xavier NX，承载六个家族十五个语言模型且不改变任何提交，体现可扩展性与泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在配置空间而非网络参数上进行无标签自适应，并以级联运行时将验证技能与语言智能体解耦，可在星上资源受限条件下实现高效、可扩展的多目标跟踪自适应与任务执行。

title: ONOT/TONO-Print: A Paired Benchmark for Identity-Document Portrait Quality under Document Production Shift
summary: Identity-document portraits are modified during document production by printing, engraving, and integration into the document template. These transformations may change image texture, contrast, colour, and other visual properties without necessarily changing the underlying biometric or presentation information. In this work, we introduce ONOT/TONO-Print, a small paired benchmark for evaluating face-image quality models under identity-document production shift. The benchmark is based on ONOT and TONO portraits and contains synthetic variants representing five common production techniques: toner, inkjet, dye sublimation, laser engraving, and thermal transfer. A smaller physical subset contains portraits printed and scanned using inkjet and toner devices. The benchmark is used to compare the behaviour of biometric and ICAO-related face-quality components before and after production. Results show that production can introduce substantial domain shift for some quality estimators, while other models remain comparatively stable.

AI.tldr: 提出ONOT/TONO-Print配对基准，用于评估证件制作工艺（打印、雕刻、模板集成）引起的域偏移对面部图像质量模型的影响。
AI.motivation: 证件人像在制作过程中会因打印、雕刻及模板集成而被修改，改变纹理、对比度、颜色等视觉属性，但生物特征与呈现信息本身未必变化。现有面质评估模型在此类"制作域偏移"下的稳健性缺乏系统评测手段。
AI.method: 基于ONOT与TONO人像构建小规模配对基准，包含模拟五种制作工艺（碳粉、喷墨、染料升华、激光雕刻、热转印）的合成变体；并设较小子集为喷墨与碳粉设备实际打印扫描的物理样本。用该基准对比生物特征类与ICAO相关面质组件在制作前后的表现。
AI.result: 部分质量评估器在制作后出现显著域偏移，性能变化明显；另一些模型则相对稳定。
AI.conclusion: 证件制作工艺可显著影响面质评估模型的可靠性，模型间稳健性差异明显；该基准为质量模型在制作偏移下的鲁棒性评测提供了可复用工具。

title: What Remains OOD? OODConceptBench for Open-World Concept Recognition in Vision-Language Models
summary: In the era of large-scale pretrained models, zero-shot generalization has increasingly blurred the boundary between known and unknown concepts. However, current evaluations do not directly reveal which open-world concepts different vision-language models can recognize. To study this problem, we introduce OODConceptBench, a hierarchical benchmark for open-world concept recognition on image-concept pairs. The full benchmark set (L1) contains 30,752 images, and the harder subset (L2) contains 14,285 images. The benchmark covers 560 concept phrases across seven open-world categories. We evaluate 37 vision-language models across release year, model family, and variant. We obtain three main findings. First, target-concept recognition is lower on L2 than on L1 across all 37 evaluated models. Second, later-released models do not necessarily achieve stronger open-world concept recognition. Third, an increase in overall recognition does not imply consistent improvement across all benchmark categories. Together, these results show that OOD remains a challenge even in the era of large-scale vision-language pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出分层基准 OODConceptBench，用图像-概念对直接评测视觉语言模型能识别哪些开放世界概念，覆盖 7 大类 560 个概念短语，并评测 37 个模型。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练时代零样本泛化模糊了已知/未知概念边界，现有评测无法直接揭示各视觉语言模型能识别哪些开放世界概念。
AI.method: 构建分层基准 OODConceptBench：完整集 L1 含 30,752 张图像，更难子集 L2 含 14,285 张图像；覆盖 7 个开放世界类别的 560 个概念短语；按发布年份、模型家族、变体维度评测 37 个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：(1) 全部 37 个模型在 L2 上的目标概念识别率均低于 L1；(2) 后发布模型并不必然具备更强的开放世界概念识别能力；(3) 总体识别率提升不意味着各基准类别上的一致改进。
AI.conclusion: 即使在大规模视觉语言预训练时代，分布外（OOD）概念识别仍是挑战。

title: End-to-end prostate lesion segmentation and detection from undersampled diffusion-weighted MRI
summary:
Automated prostate lesion detection from diffusion-weighted MR imaging (DWI) conventionally relies on reconstructed images and does not fully use all acquisition information. We present an end-to-end network that uses complex multicoil DWI data and coil sensitivity information for prostate lesion segmentation.
  We included 269 fastMRI prostate examinations with additional voxel-level lesion annotations. Of these, 64 examinations contained PIRADS 4 or 5 lesions. The proposed network, VarNet-Seg, consists of a k-space variational network (VarNet) with six variational cascades and an image-space 3D segmentation U-Net. Comparator models used the same segmentation architecture with fully coil-combined images (CC-Seg), fixed root-sum-of-squares reconstruction (RSS-Seg), or fixed SENSE reconstruction (SENSE-Seg). We performed ablations with end-to-end training and data consistency (DC) enabled or disabled. We evaluated lesion segmentation using Dice and patient-level detection using AUROC in five-fold cross-validation with full sampling, simulated undersampling, added noise, or both.
  VarNet-Seg achieved the highest Dice at every undersampling level. At eight-fold acceleration, Dice was 0.22 for VarNet-Seg, 0.14 for SENSE-Seg and 0.16 for VarNet-Seg (no DC). The paired difference from SENSE-Seg was 0.08 (95% CI, 0.04-0.11). With full sampling, VarNet-Seg and RSS-Seg performed similarly (0.40 vs 0.39). Patient-level AUROC decreased from 0.75 with full sampling to 0.63 at eight-fold acceleration; corresponding RSS-Seg AUROCs were 0.76 and 0.64.
  The proposed multicoil network improved prostate lesion segmentation under simulated undersampling compared to conventional models. Matched ablations supported contributions from both end-to-end training and data consistency. Prospective evaluation is needed to establish whether this approach can be used clinically in accelerated prostate DWI.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端多线圈复数DWI分割网络VarNet-Seg（k空间变分网络+3D U-Net），在加速采样下前列腺病灶分割优于常规重建方法。
AI.motivation: 传统DWI前列腺病灶自动检测依赖重建后图像，未充分利用全部采集信息（复数多线圈数据与线圈敏感度）。
AI.method: 纳入269例fastMRI前列腺检查（64例含PIRADS 4/5病灶及体素级标注）。VarNet-Seg由含6个变分级的k空间变分网络与图像域3D分割U-Net组成；对照为相同分割架构配合全线圈合并图像（CC-Seg）、固定RSS重建（RSS-Seg）、固定SENSE重建（SENSE-Seg）。消融端到端训练与数据一致性（DC）开关。五折交叉验证，在全采样、模拟欠采样、加噪及二者组合下评估Dice与患者级AUROC。
AI.result: VarNet-Seg在各欠采样水平Dice最高；8倍加速下Dice为0.22，SENSE-Seg 0.14、无DC的VarNet-Seg 0.16，与SENSE-Seg配对差0.08（95% CI 0.04–0.11）。全采样时VarNet-Seg与RSS-Seg相近（0.40 vs 0.39）。患者级AUROC由全采样0.75降至8倍加速0.63；RSS-Seg相应为0.76与0.64。
AI.conclusion: 多线圈端到端网络在模拟欠采样下改善前列腺病灶分割，消融实验支持端到端训练与数据一致性两者的贡献；尚需前瞻性评估以确定其临床用于加速前列腺DWI的可行性。

title: Semantic Concept Steering Breaks the Explanation Drift Loop in Continual Learning
summary: Catastrophic forgetting in continual learning (CL) manifests not only as accuracy degradation but also as \emph{explanation drift}: models maintain predictive accuracy while silently shifting attention from diagnostic features to spurious correlations. This work identifies and resolves a previously overlooked structural flaw in explanation-aware CL: pixel-level saliency regularization derives supervision targets from the model's own frozen saliency maps, creating a \emph{self-referential drift loop} that actively reinforces spurious attention across tasks. We introduce \textbf{C$^3$L} (Concept-Consistent Continual Learning), which breaks this loop by anchoring regularization to class-consistent semantic concepts (e.g., ``curved beak'', ``striped pattern'') discovered offline, independent of model state, providing (i) target independence from model drift, and (ii) cross-instance semantic consistency across every instance of a class. We identify that our concept-based objective, combined with approximate LRP relevance conservation, induces a \emph{crowding-out effect}: since concept and background regions compete for the relevance of the same prediction, enforcing high relevance within concept regions implicitly suppresses spurious background correlations without explicit penalization. \method does not require human-annotated concept sets, as it employs a fully automated concept discovery and spatial grounding. Extensive evaluation across five benchmarks and over 20 baselines demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in accuracy, forgetting, explanation quality, spurious correlation mitigation, and out-of-distribution robustness.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别出解释感知持续学习中的"自指漂移循环"结构性缺陷，提出以类别一致语义概念为锚点的C³L方法，打破该循环并借助"挤出效应"抑制虚假相关，在五个基准、20+基线上述多维指标上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中的灾难性遗忘不仅表现为精度下降，还表现为"解释漂移"：模型维持预测精度，却悄然将注意力从诊断性特征转向虚假相关。现有像素级显著性正则化从模型自身冻结的显著性图中导出监督目标，形成自指漂移循环，反而在任务间强化虚假注意力，这是一个此前被忽视的结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 提出C³L（Concept-Consistent Continual Learning）：将正则化锚定到离线发现的类别一致语义概念（如"弯曲的喙""条纹图案"），使目标独立于模型状态、且在同一类别所有实例间保持语义一致，从而打破自指循环。方法无需人工标注概念集，采用全自动的概念发现与空间定位；并结合近似LRP相关性守恒，诱导"挤出效应"——概念区域与背景区域竞争同一预测的相关性，在概念区域内强化相关性即隐式压制虚假背景相关，无需显式惩罚项。
AI.result: 在五个基准、20余个基线上的广泛评估表明，该方法在准确率、遗忘程度、解释质量、虚假相关缓解以及分布外鲁棒性上均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 解释感知持续学习的关键在于正则化目标的来源独立性：以类别一致语义概念替代模型自产显著性可同时提升精度保持、解释稳定性与泛化鲁棒性，且全自动流程避免了人工概念标注的依赖。

title: Fovea-JEPA: Overcoming Geometric Blind Spots in V-JEPA for Camera Motion Recognition
summary: Camera motion recognition requires separating viewpoint changes caused by camera translation, rotation, or zoom from object motion and scene dynamics. Video-language models often rely on semantic cues and struggle with the geometric evidence needed for this task. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures such as V-JEPA offer strong spatio-temporal representations, but our experiments suggest that they underrepresent geometric cues in some regions. Under temporal-reversal supervision, V-JEPA improves overall but degrades on several motion families, whereas a weaker geometry-oriented VGGT predictor improves across all families. We refer to these geometrically underrepresented regions as geometric blind spots and propose Fovea-JEPA to identify and address them. Using V-JEPA as the base model and VGGT as a geometry expert, we construct intervention pseudo-labels from their prediction errors to weakly supervise a blind-spot predictor. The predictor produces token-wise response maps, which are aggregated into a clip-level intervention score to guide adaptive fusion of visual and geometric features. This selective intervention introduces complementary geometric information while preserving reliable visual predictions. Experiments on CameraMotionDataset, CameraBench, and ShotBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Fovea-JEPA, with gains of 9.67, 8.67, and 24.38 percentage points over previously reported state-of-the-art baselines, respectively. Code and models will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fovea-JEPA，通过识别并修复V-JEPA在几何信息上的"盲区"，自适应融合视觉与几何特征以提升相机运动识别性能。
AI.motivation: 相机运动识别需将相机平移、旋转、缩放引起的视角变化与物体运动、场景动态分离。视频-语言模型依赖语义线索，缺乏几何证据；V-JEPA虽具强时空表征，但实验显示其在部分区域几何线索表达不足（几何盲区）。
AI.method: 以V-JEPA为基座模型、VGGT为几何专家，利用二者预测误差构建干预伪标签，弱监督训练一个盲区预测器；该预测器输出token级响应图，聚合成片段级干预分数，据此自适应融合视觉与几何特征，实现选择性干预。
AI.result: 在CameraMotionDataset、CameraBench、ShotBench上分别较已报道的SOTA基线提升9.67、8.67、24.38个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 选择性注入互补几何信息可弥补V-JEPA的几何盲区，同时保留可靠视觉预测，验证了Fovea-JEPA在相机运动识别任务上的有效性。

title: Real-Time Conveyor Belt Defect Detection via Edge TPU-Accelerated YOLOv11 on Raspberry Pi 5
summary: Conveyor belts are vital arteries in continuous bulk material handling, particularly in heavy process industries such as cement manufacturing. Undetected structural anomalies (longitudinal tears, holes, degraded patch repairs, and impact punctures) cause catastrophic belt snapping, costly downtime, and severe safety hazards. While deep learning offers high accuracy, existing models rely on power-hungry workstation GPUs, hindering practical deployment at remote industrial edge points. In this paper, we propose, implement, and validate an end-to-end, low-power edge AI vision system for real-time conveyor belt defect detection deployed on a Raspberry Pi 5 accelerated by a Google Coral Edge TPU coprocessor. The system leverages an optimized YOLOv11 nano (YOLOv11n) architecture trained on a multi-source industrial corpus exceeding 3,000 augmented samples from an operational cement plant in West Java, open-source datasets, and automated captures. The model undergoes post-training full integer quantization (INT8) compiled for systolic tensor execution. Experimental results demonstrate robust detection capability, achieving precision of 0.742, recall of 0.730, and mAP@0.5 of 0.764 across four defect classes. Deployed on-site in an IP-rated enclosure interfaced with an RTSP PoE industrial camera, the system achieves stable throughput of 30-40 FPS at 320x320 resolution with an end-to-end latency of 70-90 ms. Operational profiling under harsh clinker dust confirms thermal equilibrium at 55 +/- 5 deg C on the host CPU and ~65 deg C on the Edge TPU with zero frame loss. This demonstrates that edge AI bridges the gap between high-accuracy computer vision and cost-effective predictive maintenance in continuous manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证一个端到端低功耗边缘AI视觉系统，在Raspberry Pi 5 + Google Coral Edge TPU上以优化INT8量化的YOLOv11n实现水泥厂输送带缺陷实时检测，mAP@0.5=0.764，现场30–40 FPS、端到端延迟70–90 ms。
AI.motivation: 输送带是连续散料输送的关键环节，纵向撕裂、孔洞、修补老化、冲击穿孔等未检测结构异常会导致断带、停机与安全事故。深度学习虽有高精度，但依赖高功耗工作站GPU，难以在远程工业边缘点部署，故需低成本、低功耗的边缘方案。
AI.method: 采用优化的YOLOv11 nano架构，在超过3000个增强样本的多源工业语料（印尼西爪哇某在运水泥厂、开源数据集、自动化采集）上训练；进行训练后全整型量化（INT8）并编译为面向脉动张量阵列的执行格式；部署于Raspberry Pi 5 + Coral Edge TPU，配IP防护外壳与RTSP PoE工业相机。
AI.result: 四类缺陷检测precision 0.742、recall 0.730、mAP@0.5 0.764；320×320分辨率下稳定30–40 FPS，端到端延迟70–90 ms；熟料粉尘环境下主机CPU热平衡约55±5 ℃、Edge TPU约65 ℃，零丢帧。
AI.conclusion: 边缘AI可在连续制造场景中衔接高精度计算机视觉与低成本预测性维护，实现工程可行的现场部署。

title: BoundedGS: Memory-Efficient High-Resolution Training for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary:
High-resolution 3D Gaussian Splatting training increases pixel and Gaussian-tile intersection counts, expanding rasterization caches that coexist with projection and gradient state at peak memory. A complete-view update aggregates gradients across the view; each region's forward and backward caches can be released after its contribution is collected. BoundedGS separates rasterization and projection backward passes and bounds the active local rasterization working set according to its measured load. Candidate-indexed projection and compact gradient storage address the view-level peaks exposed by this change, while CPU-assisted structure rebuilding and bounded image supply manage resources outside rendering. In a resolution sweep at a fixed count of about 6M Gaussians, the measured rendering working set stays within 1.073-1.077 GiB from 1K to 16K; at 11K, a warm pass takes 19.79 seconds versus 21.76 for full-frame execution. Across five native 5K outdoor scenes, full training reduces the mean rendering working set from 9.97 to 1.76 GiB (82.3%), retains similar reconstruction quality, and shortens training time from 36.7 to 33.9 minutes.
  Project page: https://xiaobin2001.github.io/BoundedGS-Web/

AI.tldr: BoundedGS通过分离光栅化与投影反向传播、限制局部光栅化活跃工作集，将3DGS高分辨率训练渲染内存降至近常数级别，同时保持重建质量并缩短训练时间。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率3D Gaussian Splatting训练时，像素与高斯瓦片（tile）相交数增加，导致光栅化缓存膨胀，并与投影、梯度状态在峰值内存中共存，亟需在保证重建质量的前提下降低峰值显存占用。
AI.method: 基于完整视图更新中梯度可分段聚合、区域前向/反向缓存可在贡献收集后释放的观察，BoundedGS将光栅化与投影的反向传播过程分离，并按实测负载限定活跃局部光栅化工作集；同时采用候选索引的投影与紧凑梯度存储应对视图级峰值，并以CPU辅助的结构重建与有界图像供给管理渲染之外的资源。
AI.result: 约6M高斯、固定数量下分辨率扫描（1K–16K）中渲染工作集稳定在1.073–1.077 GiB；11K下预热传递19.79秒，全帧执行为21.76秒。五个原生5K室外场景完整训练中，平均渲染工作集由9.97 GiB降至1.76 GiB（降幅82.3%），重建质量相近，训练时间由36.7分钟缩短至33.9分钟。
AI.conclusion: 通过将峰值内存与分辨率解耦，BoundedGS实现了高分辨率3DGS训练的近似恒定渲染内存开销，并兼得质量保持与效率提升。

title: From Presence Labels to Bounding Boxes: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Scale Surgical Instrument Localization?
summary: Spatial localization of surgical instruments through bounding-box annotations is a foundational component of surgical scene understanding, supporting detection, tracking, interaction analysis, and grounded vision-language applications. Yet existing annotations often cover selected frames, video subsets, or dataset variants rather than complete procedures. Manual extension is time-consuming and expert-dependent. Additionally, weakly supervised and detector-based pseudo-labels require task-specific training and may be imprecise. In this study, we design a scalable MLLM-based annotation framework that converts surgical frames and existing instrument-presence labels into accurate bounding boxes, and systematically analyze its reliability, cost, and design sensitivity. We instantiate the framework using six MLLMs and a multi-call configuration on laparoscopic cholecystectomy in Cholec80. Using a carefully designed stratification scheme, two annotators independently label 1,000 frames, and an expert surgeon reviews one annotation set to establish the reference. Results show that instrument-set F1 ranges from 88.2 to 92.7,whereas mIoU ranges from 0.180 to 0.735, showing that comparable recognition can conceal large localization differences. A structured multi-stage annotation pipeline achieves 0.784 mIoU, compared with 0.735 for the best single-call baseline and 0.814 human-human agreement. Using the best accuracy pipeline, we create and publicly release a spatial extension of Cholec80 comprising 285,977 bounding boxes across all 184,498 annotated frames from the 80 videos. The annotations and human references are made available on GitHub

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于多模态大模型（MLLM）的可扩展手术器械边界框标注框架，将手术帧和已有的器械存在性标签转换为精确边界框，并系统评估其可靠性、成本与设计敏感性，最终公开释放Cholec80的空间扩展标注（285,977个边界框）。
AI.motivation: 现有手术器械空间定位标注多覆盖部分帧、视频子集或数据集变体，缺乏完整手术流程的标注；人工扩展耗时且依赖专家；弱监督与检测器伪标签需任务特定训练且可能不精确。
AI.method: 设计可扩展的MLLM标注框架，将手术帧与器械存在性标签转换为边界框；在Cholec80腹腔镜胆囊切除术上以6个MLLM及多调用配置实例化；采用分层抽样，两名标注者独立标注1,000帧，由专家外科医生审核一套标注集建立参考；并提出结构化多阶段标注流水线。
AI.result: 器械集合F1为88.2–92.7，而mIoU仅0.180–0.735，说明相近的识别性能可能掩盖较大的定位差异；结构化多阶段流水线达0.784 mIoU，优于最佳单次调用基线的0.735，接近人工一致性0.814；基于最佳流水线构建并公开Cholec80空间扩展，涵盖80个视频全部184,498个标注帧、共285,977个边界框。
AI.conclusion: MLLM可高效地将器械存在性标签扩展为空间标注，但识别指标不足以反映定位质量，需以mIoU等空间指标评估；多阶段结构化流水线显著提升定位精度并接近人工水平，所释放的大规模完整手术空间标注可支撑检测、跟踪、交互分析与视觉语言应用。

title: GeoPrompt: Geometry-Conditioned Prompt Learning for Underwater Open-Vocabulary Instance Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) provides a promising solution for marine perception by recognizing and segmenting categories beyond predefined label spaces. Existing OVIS methods usually rely on vision-language alignment, where visual region features are matched with textual category embeddings to recognize both seen and unseen classes. However, this alignment assumption becomes fragile in underwater environments. Color attenuation, scattering, turbidity, and low contrast distort visual appearance, causing region features to deviate from their corresponding semantic concepts. As a result, the similarity between degraded visual features and textual classifiers becomes unreliable, which particularly weakens the recognition of unseen underwater categories that cannot be corrected by category-specific supervision. To address these issues, we propose GeoPrompt, a geometry-conditioned prompt learning framework for underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation. Our key insight is that geometric structure is more stable than visual appearance in degraded underwater scenes. Specifically, GeoPrompt introduces a geometry-guided visual adaptation module (GVAM) to extract depth-derived structural priors and inject them into multi-scale visual features. It further develops a geometry-conditioned prompt learning (GCPL) that generates geometry-aware textual classifiers from structural representations. These geometry-aware classifiers are integrated with fixed and image-conditioned textual classifiers to improve open-vocabulary semantic alignment. Experiments on the MARIS-OpenIS benchmark show that GeoPrompt achieves state-of-the-art performance and brings consistent improvements on underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation.

AI.tldr: GeoPrompt：利用深度几何先验替代不稳定的视觉外观，做几何条件提示学习的水下开放词汇实例分割，在MARIS-OpenIS上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有OVIS依赖视觉-语言对齐，但水下颜色衰减、散射、浑浊、低对比度使区域特征偏离语义概念，视觉-文本相似度不可靠，尤其削弱无类别监督校正的未见类识别。
AI.method: 核心洞察为几何结构比视觉外观在水下退化场景中更稳定。提出GVAM提取深度导出的结构先验并注入多尺度视觉特征；提出GCPL由结构表征生成几何感知文本分类器；将其与固定文本分类器、图像条件文本分类器融合以改进开放词汇语义对齐。
AI.result: 在MARIS-OpenIS基准上取得SOTA，并在水下开放词汇实例分割上带来一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 以几何结构为条件的提示学习可缓解水下视觉-语言对齐脆弱性问题，为水下OVIS提供有效方案。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Crowd Flow Control Using Dynamic Barriers
comment: An earlier version was presented at the 26th Scientific Forum for Hajj, Umrah and Visit Research, Umm Al-Qura University (2026)
summary: Crowd barriers are widely used to regulate pedestrian movement during large public events such as pilgrimages. However, fixed barrier layouts often create unnecessary stopping and local congestion even when they successfully control the overall crowd flow. Finding better barrier configurations is difficult because there is no dataset that provides the best barrier placement for a given crowd scene. We address this challenge by introducing a simulation-driven reinforcement learning framework that learns barrier configurations without requiring labelled training data. Starting from a segmented crowd scene, we construct a realistic simulation environment that reproduces the observed pedestrian distribution. This environment is then used to train a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent that continuously adjusts barrier positions to improve pedestrian movement. Unlike supervised approaches the proposed framework allows the agent to explore barrier configurations that have never been observed in real data. We evaluate the learned policy under unseen numbers of pedestrians. The learned policy consistently outperforms the existing manually designed barrier configuration by reducing pedestrian stops while maintaining effective flow regulation. These results demonstrate that combining computer vision crowd simulation and reinforcement learning provides an effective framework for optimizing crowd control infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 提出仿真驱动的强化学习框架，无需标注数据即可学习人群隔离栏（barrier）布局配置，用SAC智能体持续调整障碍位置以改善行人流动。
AI.motivation: 固定隔离栏布局虽能控制整体人流，却造成不必要的停顿与局部拥堵；且缺乏"给定场景最优隔离栏布置"的数据集，使优化困难。
AI.method: 从分割后的人群场景出发，构建复现观测行人分布的真实感仿真环境；在该环境中训练Soft Actor-Critic智能体，持续调整隔离栏位置以改善行人运动。相较监督方法，框架允许探索真实数据中从未观测到的配置。
AI.result: 在未见过的行人数量下评估学习策略，其持续优于现有手工设计的隔离栏配置，在保持有效流量调控的同时减少行人停顿。
AI.conclusion: 融合计算机视觉人群仿真与强化学习，可为人群控制基础设施优化提供有效框架。

title: StickFigure: Enabling Pose-Only IoT Cameras for Privacy-Preserving Edge Vision
summary: Indoor IoT cameras can support assisted living and activity-aware spaces, but exporting raw RGB frames raises privacy concerns by exposing facial, clothing, and household details that body-motion tasks often do not require. We present StickFigure, a pose-only IoT camera system that, during real-time monitoring, keeps raw frames local and ephemeral while exporting only compact skeleton streams sufficient for downstream human activity recognition (HAR). While pose estimation has matured on GPUs, extracting accurate pose streams on resource-constrained IoT cameras remains difficult. To overcome these challenges and enable on-device pose streams on (almost) any IoT camera, we present two core designs in StickFigure: an activation-aware pose backbone that allocates channel capacity after spatial downsampling and a lightweight hierarchical MLP refiner that selectively corrects elbow and wrist coordinates using intermediate visual features and kinematic context. We fully implement StickFigure and evaluate it on public benchmarks and real-world deployment. Compared with state-of-the-art MCU pose models, StickFigure achieves the highest pose accuracy and downstream HAR utility on both NTU RGB+D and Penn Action, while using 96.5% fewer parameters and 99.3% fewer MACs per frame than RTMPose-S-based baselines, achieving 0.107 s p95 latency on a representative STM32H753 MCU. We believe StickFigure establishes a new operating point for privacy-aware edge vision on massive IoT cameras.

AI.tldr: StickFigure 是一个"仅姿态"的物联网摄像头系统，原始 RGB 帧仅在本地短暂保留，只对外输出紧凑骨架流用于下游人体活动识别（HAR），并在资源受限 MCU 上实现高精度实时姿态估计。
AI.motivation: 室内 IoT 摄像头可支持辅助生活与活动感知空间，但导出原始 RGB 帧会泄露面部、衣着、家居细节等人体运动任务并不需要的隐私信息。同时，尽管 GPU 上姿态估计已成熟，在资源受限的 IoT 摄像头上提取精确姿态流仍很困难。
AI.method: 包含两个核心设计：(1) 激活感知（activation-aware）姿态骨干网络，在空间下采样之后再分配通道容量；(2) 轻量级分层 MLP 精修器，利用中间视觉特征与运动学上下文，选择性地校正肘部与手腕坐标。系统在设备端完成推理并完整实现。
AI.result: 在 NTU RGB+D 与 Penn Action 上，相较最先进的 MCU 姿态模型取得最高姿态精度与最佳下游 HAR 效用；相比基于 RTMPose-S 的基线，参数量减少 96.5%、每帧 MACs 减少 99.3%，在代表性 STM32H753 MCU 上达到 0.107 s 的 p95 延迟。
AI.conclusion: StickFigure 为大规模 IoT 摄像头上的隐私感知边缘视觉建立了新的工作点（operating point），兼顾隐私保护、精度与资源效率。

title: UniQuery: Unifying Vision Models with a Joint Query Head for Cross-Domain Pedestrian Attribute Recognition
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the 7th Real-World Surveillance Workshop (RWS) at WACV 2027
summary: Pedestrian Attribute Recognition (PAR) predicts semantic attributes of individuals, such as gender, age, clothing and accessories, and its descriptions support attribute-based person retrieval and person re-identification. However, accurately recognizing fine-grained attributes across domains remains challenging due to occlusion, appearance variations, and shifts in image distributions. Ensembles of independently trained foundation encoders combine their logits with fixed fusion weights, so every attribute uses the same mix and the encoders are never trained together. We propose UniQuery, which instead jointly fine-tunes DINOv3 and CLIP for attribute-specific fusion. It combines two query heads, one for each encoder, with a joint query head whose attribute queries attend to tokens from both encoders, and the prediction is the average of the logits of the three query heads. We evaluate UniQuery on the benchmark of the UPAR Challenge 2027 at the WACV 2027 Real-World Surveillance workshop, where models are trained on PA100k, PETA and Market-1501 with a shared set of attributes. In leave-one-dataset-out experiments, UniQuery outperforms the independent ensemble in Challenge_Avg on both held-out datasets. Ablations show that learning fusion over independently trained encoders does not improve upon logit averaging in the mean over the two held-out datasets, while freezing the encoders lowers the Challenge_Avg of UniQuery. On the hidden test set of the benchmark, UniQuery achieves a Challenge_Avg of 0.8001.

AI.tldr: UniQuery 联合微调 DINOv3 与 CLIP，通过双编码器查询头与联合查询头实现属性特定的融合，在 UPAR 2027 挑战赛基准上取得 Challenge_Avg 0.8001。
AI.motivation: 行人属性识别（PAR）在跨域场景下受遮挡、外观变化与图像分布偏移影响，细粒度属性识别仍困难。已有的独立基础编码器集成采用固定融合权重，所有属性共用同一混合方式，且各编码器从未联合训练，缺乏属性自适应性。
AI.method: 提出 UniQuery：联合微调 DINOv3 与 CLIP，设置两个编码器各自的查询头，外加一个联合查询头，其属性查询同时关注两个编码器的 token；最终预测为三个查询头 logits 的平均。采用留一数据集交叉验证：在 PA100k、PETA、Market-1501（共享属性集）上训练，在留出数据集上评测。
AI.result: 在留一数据集实验中，UniQuery 在两个留出数据集上的 Challenge_Avg 均优于独立集成；隐藏测试集上 Challenge_Avg 达 0.8001。
AI.conclusion: 联合训练与属性特定融合优于固定权重的独立集成；消融显示仅在已训练编码器上学习融合（在双数据集均值上）不优于 logit 平均，而冻结编码器会降低 UniQuery 的 Challenge_Avg，说明联合微调编码器是性能提升的关键。

title: Tight Learned Event-Inertial Odometry (TLEIO): a Transformer-Based Architecture for End-to-End Motion from Event Streams
summary: Event cameras provide microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and sparse asynchronous measurements, making them compelling for odometry under fast motion and challenging illumination. Yet, accurate event-based state estimation remains difficult: existing systems often use events as a complement to frames or rely on feature tracking, correspondence search, and optimization-heavy backends, limiting the efficiency promised by event sensing. We introduce Tight Learned Event-Inertial Odometry (TLEIO), a compact filter-based pipeline that learns short-window relative motion directly from voxelized event streams and tightly fuses the resulting constraints with IMU propagation. Its learned front-end, EventsFormer, predicts local displacements and per-axis uncertainty from event voxels in a single forward pass, while a stochastic-cloning EKF fuses these overlapping predictions with IMU propagation, producing metric trajectories without explicit feature tracks and pose optimization at inference time. The network is trained directly from pose displacements, without requiring event-flow labels. We evaluate TLEIO on the TartanAir/TartanEvent benchmark and on real DAVIS240c sequences. On TartanAir, TLEIO reduces average ATE from 2.26 m to 1.10 m over the IMU-only TLIO baseline, while achieving up to 48.9% lower runtime than optimization-based event odometry methods.

AI.tldr: 提出TLEIO——一种紧凑的滤波式事件-惯性里程计：用EventsFormer从前端体素化事件中直接学习短窗口相对运动及逐轴不确定性，再以随机克隆EKF与IMU紧耦合，无需特征跟踪或推理期位姿优化。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率、高动态范围与稀疏异步测量，适合快速运动与复杂光照下的里程计。但现有事件法多以事件为帧的补充，或依赖特征跟踪、对应搜索与优化重型后端，削弱了事件感知的效率优势，因此需要兼顾精度与效率的紧耦合方案。
AI.method: (1) 前端EventsFormer：对体素化事件流单次前向预测局部位移及逐轴不确定性；(2) 后端：随机克隆EKF（stochastic-cloning EKF）将重叠的相对运动预测与IMU传播紧融合，输出米制轨迹；(3) 网络直接由位姿位移监督训练，无需事件光流标签；推理期无显式特征跟踪与位姿优化。
AI.result: 在TartanAir/TartanEvent与真实DAVIS240c序列上评估：TartanAir上平均ATE由IMU-only TLIO基线的2.26 m降至1.10 m；相比基于优化的事件里程计方法，运行时间最多降低48.9%。
AI.conclusion: 学习式事件前端与随机克隆EKF紧耦合可在免除特征跟踪与优化后端的前提下显著提升精度并降低计算开销，验证了"学习相对运动+滤波融合"路线用于事件惯性里程计的可行性与效率优势。

title: Freeze What Is Settled, Cache What Is Smooth: Spatial Freezing Keeps Step Caching in Its Low-Error Regime
summary: Instruction-based image editors built on diffusion transformers run tens of denoising steps. Training-free acceleration either reuses features across steps (step caching) or stops computing the regions an edit leaves untouched (region freezing), and the two have been combined before. We ask how a high speed-up target should be split between them. On Qwen-Image-2.1, freezing does more than remove tokens: it lowers the cost of every step, so the step cache can reach the same overall speed-up with a conservative threshold that keeps its error small. A per-step cost model fitted on development runs predicts held-out latency with a median error of 4.0% and reproduces the speed ceilings of the region methods we re-implemented (2.73$\times$ predicted vs. 2.70$\times$ measured for RegionE). Driving frozen tokens to the model's one-step $x_0$ estimate beats returning them to the reference image on every development sample, and in 90% of measured cases the composed error stays below the sum of the two individual errors. The resulting method, FreezePlan, keeps five full steps and gives the rest of the budget to TaylorSeer. On a pre-registered test split it runs 5.05$\times$ faster end to end at 29.8 dB PSNR to the original output, with no significant drop in a VLM judge score; TaylorSeer at 5.02$\times$ reaches 23.5 dB. The curve extends to 5.99$\times$ at 28.0 dB. Swapping in the region selectors of prior methods under our schedule lowers median PSNR by only 0.5--0.6 dB, which places the gain in the schedule and budget split rather than in the selector.

AI.tldr: 在Qwen-Image-2.1上研究"区域冻结+步缓存"的加速预算如何分配：冻结能降低每步成本，从而让缓存可用更保守阈值。提出FreezePlan（前5步全算，余下交给TaylorSeer），预注册测试集上端到端5.05×加速、PSNR 29.8 dB，VLM评分无显著下降；外推到5.99×仍有28.0 dB。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer指令编辑需数十步去噪，训练无关加速主要有步缓存（跨步复用特征）与区域冻结（不算未编辑区域），二者已被组合使用，但缺少"给定高速率目标时如何在这两者间分配预算"的系统分析。
AI.method: 1）以逐步骤成本模型拟合开发集运行，预测未见延迟并复现所重实现区域方法的速率上限（RegionE预测2.73× vs 实测2.70×）；2）将冻结token驱动至模型单步x0估计，而非回填参考图；3）误差分析显示90%测量案例中组合误差低于两独立误差之和；4）据此设计FreezePlan：保留5个完整步，其余预算给TaylorSeer。
AI.result: 成本模型预测延迟的中位误差4.0%；预注册测试集上端到端5.05×，对原始输出PSNR 29.8 dB，VLM评判分数无显著下降（TaylorSeer在5.02×时仅23.5 dB）；曲线可延伸至5.99×@28.0 dB；换用先前方法的区域选择器仅使中位PSNR下降0.5–0.6 dB。
AI.conclusion: 加速收益主要来自调度与预算分配策略，而非区域选择器本身；先冻结压薄每步成本、再以保守阈值叠步缓存，是达成高速率同时保持低误差的有效方式。

title: The Locality Trade-off in Masked Patch Self-Distillation
summary: Masked patch self-distillation is a key component of modern vision foundation models, including DINOv2 and DINOv3, yet its implications for local visual information remain unclear. We show that its semantic benefits can coexist with a scale-dependent locality cost. Using two annotation-free diagnostics, we distinguish recoverable local appearance from spatial correspondence. In smaller models, adding iBOT substantially weakens patch correspondence while largely preserving appearance decodability. In larger models, correspondence improves, but pixel and texture evidence becomes less linearly accessible in deep features. Thus, scaling changes the form of the locality cost rather than uniformly eliminating it. Our analysis of Gram anchoring further shows that preserving patch relations does not guarantee simultaneous improvements in both properties. These findings motivate evaluating and designing visual representations around the complementary demands of semantic abstraction, appearance preservation, and spatial correspondence. Our code is available at https://github.com/winci-ai/jea.

AI.tldr: Masked patch self-distillation（如iBOT）的语义收益可能伴随尺度相关的局部性代价：小模型中加入iBOT显著削弱patch对应性但基本保留外观可解码性；大模型对应性改善但像素/纹理证据在深层特征中线性可及性下降。
AI.motivation: 理解masked patch self-distillation（DINOv2/DINOv3的关键组件）对局部视觉信息的影响尚不明确，需要区分"可恢复的局部外观"与"空间对应性"两类局部属性，并考察模型规模与Gram anchoring对二者的作用。
AI.method: 提出两种无需标注的诊断方法，将局部性分解为局部外观可解码性与patch空间对应性两个维度；在小型与大型模型上对比加入iBOT前后的表现，并进一步分析Gram anchoring对patch关系保持的影响。
AI.result: 小模型中加入iBOT大幅削弱patch对应性而外观可解码性基本保持；大模型中对应性提升但像素与纹理证据在深层特征中线性可及性降低——即规模改变的是局部性代价的形式而非消除代价。此外，Gram anchoring保持patch关系并不保证两类属性同时改善。
AI.conclusion: 视觉表征的评估与设计应围绕语义抽象、外观保持与空间对应性三者互补的需求展开，而非追求单一维度的局部性指标。

title: The Paired Thermal Channel Is Two Orthogonal Axes: A Controlled Attribution Study of Calibration Cost and Detection Gain in Infrared Person Detection
summary: The calibrated thermal channel in infrared person detection comprises two structurally orthogonal axes. True calibrated $ΔT$ outperforms scale-matched grayscale pseudo-$ΔT$ by $+0.0221$ mAP (paired Wilcoxon $p=0.0098$, Cohen's $d=+1.08$), confirming that the calibrated channel carries information the grayscale channel lacks. The calibration axis is driven by the joint pairing-scale condition. Preserving both paired correspondence and absolute calibrated scale raises expected calibration error (ECE) from $\approx 0.05$ to $0.142$. The $2\times 2$ interaction ($p=0.0059$) localizes the rise to this condition. Breaking either factor alone returns ECE to the broken-factor level (true-vs-const $p=0.002$; true-vs-shuffled $p=0.002$). Under post-hoc temperature scaling, the pairing cost survives recalibration ($p=0.002$), while the scale cost is largely absorbed ($p=0.16$). As regards the detection axis, the gain stems from structural de-structuring. Phase randomization, which destroys spatial structure while preserving per-sample variance, yields $+0.0185$ mAP over true $ΔT$ on FLIR ADAS ($p=0.014$, $d=+0.96$). The FLAME~3 gain is $+0.0064$ mAP ($p=0.078$, n=8). On the calibration axis, the same intervention is insignificant on FLIR ADAS ($p=0.47$) but significant on FLAME~3 ($p=0.0078$). These findings rest on a five-arm controlled attribution with temperature-evidential learning (TEL) as the testbed. TEL obtains a single evidence-derived routing scalar together with a complementary diagnostic entropy, and establishes a finite-evidence degeneracy theorem proving that the acquisition product degenerates to this scalar with a closed-form bound. A physical $0.5^\circ$C threshold admits cross-dataset physical readings, whereas a gray threshold of $20$ inverts without physical interpretation.

AI.tldr: 该文以温度-证据学习(TEL)为试验台，通过五臂受控归因实验，把红外行人检测中的"校准热通道"拆解为配对对应(结构)与绝对校准尺度(幅度)两条正交轴，并检验其在检测与校准两类目标上的可归因效应。
AI.motivation: 现有红外行人检测将校准ΔT通道与灰度伪ΔT通道混用，缺乏对"校准通道究竟携带何种信息"的受控归因；同时不清楚增益与代价分别来源于配对结构、绝对尺度还是二者交互，因而无法判断通道设计与后处理校准的合理边界。
AI.method: 五臂受控归因实验（真ΔT、尺度匹配灰度、常量、打乱配对、相位随机化等）结合温度-证据学习(TEL)测试床：以2×2因子设计分离配对对应与绝对尺度及交互，用配对Wilcoxon检验与Cohen's d量化mAP差异；测量ECE并在后处理温度缩放前后对比；相位随机化保留逐样本方差、破坏空间结构以检验"结构去结构化"假设；并提出有限证据退化定理，证明获取乘积在闭式界下退化为单一由证据导出的路由标量并伴随诊断熵。
AI.result: 真ΔT较尺度匹配灰度伪ΔT提升+0.0221 mAP(p=0.0098, d=+1.08)；同时保留配对与绝对尺度使ECE由≈0.05升至0.142，2×2交互显著(p=0.0059)，单独破坏任一因子ECE回落至单因子破坏水平(p=0.002/0.002)；温度缩放后配对代价仍存在(p=0.002)，尺度代价基本被吸收(p=0.16)。检测轴上相位随机化在FLIR ADAS上比真ΔT高+0.0185 mAP(p=0.014, d=+0.96)，FLAME 3上为+0.0064 mAP(p=0.078, n=8)；校准轴上该干预在FLIR ADAS不显著(p=0.47)、在FLAME 3显著(p=0.0078)。物理0.5°C阈值可跨数据集迁移，灰度阈值20则发生反转且无物理解释。
AI.conclusion: 校准ΔT通道的检测收益来自结构"去结构化"(相位随机化即可复现并超越)，而非严格配对；其校准代价则定位于配对×尺度联合条件，属需重训练而非可事后温度缩放消除的系统误差。TEL的退化定理表明获取乘积可归约为单一证据标量，物理单位阈值相较灰度阈值具备可迁移性与可解释性。

title: Saga: an in silico ontology for a multimodal patient world model
summary: Simulating an individual's disease course requires connecting patient history to future events, clinical timing and disease morphology. Longitudinal prediction and multimodal representations exploit this information, but organizing future readouts around a common patient state and advancing trajectories without real intermediate observations remain central challenges. Here we introduce Saga, a multimodal patient world model that learns a shared state from patient histories to predict clinical events and generate multimodal images. Generated events and times are appended to the history and re-encoded to advance prediction. We studied 461,370 patients with 12 cancer types across 112 centres. Modality-specific paired evaluations linked future images to observed follow-up. With historical images held fixed, removing patient conditioning reduced event F1 from 0.716 to 0.591 and increased lesion-burden error from 11.8% to 21.3%. In free rollouts, eight-step event F1 was 0.672, compared with 0.553 for a longitudinal Transformer evaluated from the same origins, and timing error was lower by 8.7 days. In the internal test set, one-year progression AUROC was 0.882, with values of 0.871 and 0.856 in temporal and geographical external evaluations. These results show that shared patient states connect future phenotypes across observational scales with event-driven trajectory progression, sustaining comparative predictive advantages during rollout and discrimination in external clinical evaluation. Saga makes patient-level disease simulation a multimodal prediction task that can be tested against observed follow-up.

AI.tldr: 提出Saga——多模态患者世界模型，从病史学习共享患者状态，同时预测临床事件与生成多模态图像，并以事件驱动方式推进轨迹；在461,370名患者、12种癌症、112个中心上验证其预测与外部泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 模拟个体疾病进程需将患者病史与未来事件、临床时序和疾病形态相连接。现有纵向预测与多模态表示虽利用这些信息，但在"以统一患者状态组织未来读出"以及"在没有真实中间观测的情况下推进轨迹"两方面仍存在核心挑战。
AI.method: 构建多模态患者世界模型Saga：从患者病史中学习共享状态，用于预测临床事件并生成多模态图像；将生成的事件与时间追加进病史并重新编码，实现自回归式的轨迹推进（free rollout）。采用模态特异的配对评估，将未来图像与观测到的随访数据对齐；通过消融（固定历史图像、去除患者条件）检验状态条件的贡献，并与纵向Transformer基线比较。
AI.result: 在112个中心、12种癌症、461,370名患者上研究。固定历史图像时，去除患者条件使事件F1由0.716降至0.591，病灶负荷误差由11.8%升至21.3%。自由rollout中八步事件F1为0.672（同起点纵向Transformer为0.553），时间误差低8.7天。内部测试集一年进展AUROC为0.882，时间外推与地理外推分别为0.871和0.856。
AI.conclusion: 共享患者状态能够在不同观测尺度上连接未来表型，并通过事件驱动实现轨迹推进，在rollout过程中保持相对预测优势，并在外部临床评估中维持判别能力。Saga将患者级疾病模拟转化为可与真实随访对照检验的多模态预测任务。

title: EKT-Router: Expert-Evidence Alignment for Embodied Vision-Language Models
summary: Embodied vision-language models must answer questions from partial, evolving observations. Their success depends on both the reasoning capability selected and the evidence available to it. Expert routers adapt internal computation, while tool-augmented systems acquire external evidence; choosing these independently can leave a suitable expert without the evidence it needs. We introduce EKT-Router, a bounded framework that jointly selects a capability expert, optional knowledge, and perceptual tools. Outcome-derived signatures represent the overlapping strengths of General, Spatial Reasoning, and Spatiotemporal experts. A joint utility scores complete expert-evidence routes under a call budget. After acquisition, a packet verifier admits valid evidence with positive predicted expert-conditioned gain. The selected expert then answers once, reverting to the unchanged observation if all packets are rejected. Across 6 embodied QA benchmarks, EKT-Router achieves a mean score of 61.4, the highest among the compared systems, and averages 74.7 on 10 general vision-language benchmarks. With all external evidence disabled, question-conditioned expert selection alone improves over the best fixed expert by 1.75 points. Ablations show that learned routing is the dominant component and that knowledge and perception are complementary.

AI.tldr: 提出 EKT-Router，一个在调用预算约束下联合选择"能力专家 + 可选知识 + 感知工具"的有界框架，在 6 个具身问答基准上平均得分 61.4，为对比系统最高，10 个通用视觉语言基准平均 74.7。
AI.motivation: 具身视觉语言模型需从局部、演化的观测中作答，其表现同时取决于所选推理能力和可获得的证据。专家路由只调整内部计算、工具增强只获取外部证据，二者独立决策会导致"合适的专家缺乏所需证据"。因此需要联合决策。
AI.method: 1）用结果导出的签名刻画 General、Spatial Reasoning、Spatiotemporal 三类专家的重叠优势；2）在调用预算下以联合效用对"专家—证据"完整路线打分；3）获取后用 packet verifier 仅接纳预测专家条件增益为正的有效证据；4）所选专家仅作答一次，若全部证据包被拒则回退到原始未修改观测。
AI.result: 6 个具身 QA 基准平均 61.4（对比系统中最优）；10 个通用 VLM 基准平均 74.7；关闭全部外部证据时，仅凭问题条件化的专家选择即比最佳固定专家提升 1.75 分；消融显示学习式路由是主导组件，知识与感知互补。
AI.conclusion: 专家选择与证据获取应联合优化而非独立进行；学习式路由贡献最大，知识与感知工具互为补充，且在预算受限下仍具增益。

title: Explaining Navigation Decisions: Stage-Aware Visual Attribution for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly enable robots to follow language instructions, understanding their navigation decisions becomes important for reliable deployment. Existing explainability methods overlook a key challenge in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN): evidence for the current action may be distributed across historical and current observations and associated with different instruction stages. We identify instruction-stage insensitivity, where existing methods produce similar explanations despite changes across different navigation stages. To address this issue, we propose a stage-aware attribution framework for VLN. We first construct action-conditioned temporal instruction--visual attributions across observations. These attributions are projected into instruction space to estimate stage associations, which guide the aggregation of relevant historical evidence for refining the current explanation. An instruction-guided spatial filter further suppresses isolated responses while preserving compact, instruction-relevant regions. Experiments across multiple VLN policies and benchmarks show improved attribution quality over existing methods. We further demonstrate that our method acts as a diagnostic tool for analyzing failure cases, and validate its applicability to real-world navigation on a Unitree G1 robot.

AI.tldr: 提出面向视觉语言导航的阶段感知归因框架，解决现有可解释性方法对不同导航阶段不敏感的问题，并在多策略多基准及真实机器人上验证。
AI.motivation: VLM驱动的机器人导航需可靠可解释。现有可解释方法忽视VLN的关键难点：当前动作的证据分散在历史与当前观测中，且对应不同指令阶段，导致"指令阶段不敏感"——不同阶段却给出相似解释。
AI.method: 构建以动作为条件、跨观测的时间-指令-视觉归因；将归因投影到指令空间估计阶段关联，据此聚合相关历史证据以细化当前解释；再用指令引导的空间滤波器抑制孤立响应，保留紧凑的指令相关区域。
AI.result: 在多种VLN策略与基准上，归因质量优于现有方法；可作为失败案例分析诊断工具，并在Unitree G1机器人上验证真实导航适用性。
AI.conclusion: 阶段感知归因有效提升VLN解释的阶段敏感性与质量，兼具诊断与实机部署价值。

title: Accuracy Is Not Enough: An Efficiency- and Statistics-Aware Benchmark of ResNet50 and Vision Transformer for Explainable Multi-Class Gastrointestinal Diseases Classification
summary: Automated classification of gastrointestinal (GI) findings in endoscopic images could support early diagnosis, but architectures are often chosen on accuracy alone. We present a controlled, reproducible benchmark of ResNet50 and ViT-B/16 for eight-class GI classification on the public Kvasir dataset (4,000 images), using a stratified split (400 test images) and stratified group 5-fold cross-validation over all images. In cross-validation, ResNet50 and ViT-B/16 reached 92.12% and 91.70% accuracy, and a two one-sided tests (TOST) procedure showed equivalence within a +/-3 percentage-point margin (difference +0.43 points, 90% CI -0.33 to +1.18; p < 0.001). The architectures differed mainly in cost: ResNet50 had 3.6 times fewer parameters and 4.3 times fewer operations, 2.5-fold lower single-image CPU latency (69 vs. 177 ms) and 3.8-fold higher GPU throughput. Cross-validated calibration was similar (expected calibration error 0.021 vs. 0.023). An edge-oriented transformer, MobileViT-S, was most accurate on the test split (95.5%) but lost 9.4 points when an acquisition artefact present in some classes (the ScopeGuide inset) was occluded, whereas ResNet50 was not significantly affected. On 500 unseen polyp images with expert masks, both models' Grad-CAM maps focused on the lesion (3.6 times chance). On a de-duplicated external subset of GastroVision (1,998 images), accuracy fell to 78-80% for all three models and differences between them remained small. Accuracy differences between architectures were thus small relative to the effects of shortcut learning and domain shift, whereas efficiency differences were large. An efficient CNN is a defensible default for resource-constrained screening, but no model is deployment-ready without local validation.

AI.tldr: 在Kvasir数据集八分类任务上系统对比ResNet50与ViT-B/16：两者精度等价（92.12% vs 91.70%，TOST验证），但ResNet50参数量少3.6倍、算力少4.3倍、CPU延迟低2.5倍；架构间差异远小于捷径学习与域偏移带来的影响，高效CNN是资源受限场景的合理默认选择，但任何模型部署前都需本地验证。
AI.motivation: 内镜图像自动分类有望支持胃肠道病变早期诊断，但现有工作往往仅依据精度选择网络架构，忽略了计算成本、校准性、捷径学习与域泛化等部署关键因素，缺乏受控可复现的对比基准。
AI.method: 在公开Kvasir数据集（4,000张图像，八分类）上建立受控可复现基准：采用分层划分（400张测试集）与覆盖全部图像的分层分组5折交叉验证；对比ResNet50与ViT-B/16，并用双单侧检验（TOST）在±3个百分点边界内检验等效性；同时评估参数量、运算量、CPU单图延迟、GPU吞吐、校准误差（ECE）；引入边缘导向Transformer MobileViT-S，通过遮挡ScopeGuide伪影做捷径学习测试；在500张带专家掩膜未见息肉图像上用Grad-CAM评估定位；在去重后的GastroVision外部子集（1,998张）上评估域偏移。
AI.result: 交叉验证中ResNet50与ViT-B/16精度为92.12%与91.70%，TOST显示在±3个百分点内等效（差值+0.43，90% CI −0.33~+1.18，p<0.001）。效率差异显著：ResNet50参数量少3.6倍、运算量少4.3倍、CPU单图延迟69 vs 177 ms（低2.5倍）、GPU吞吐高3.8倍。校准相近（ECE 0.021 vs 0.023）。MobileViT-S在测试划分上最高（95.5%），但遮挡ScopeGuide内嵌伪影后下降9.4个百分点，ResNet50无显著受影响。Grad-CAM在500张息肉图像上聚焦病灶，达随机水平3.6倍。外部GastroVision子集上三者精度均降至78–80%，模型间差异仍很小。
AI.conclusion: 架构间的精度差异相对于捷径学习和域偏移的影响很小，而效率差异很大；在资源受限的筛查场景中，高效CNN是可辩护的默认选择，但没有任何模型可在未经本地验证的情况下直接部署。

title: TurboWAM: Learning What Matters for Fast World Action Models
summary: World action models have demonstrated promising performance in robot policy learning, yet their high inference latency remains a critical bottleneck for real-world deployment. Recent approaches have sought to improve inference efficiency by reducing test-time future-frame imagination or accelerating action prediction. However, these methods often leverage representations from all video world model layers without explicitly considering their varying relevance to action prediction, leading to redundant computation and suboptimal representation utilization. In this work, we propose TurboWAM, a fast world action model that efficiently aggregates structured world representations conditioned on action predictions. Specifically, TurboWAM introduces a structured world representation aggregation module that adaptively fuses representations from different world model layers according to their relevance to the evolving action denoising state. Furthermore, TurboWAM employs a structured action supervision mechanism that adaptively modulates gradients from action supervision across different world model layers during backward propagation, facilitating world representation learning. During inference, by reducing the number of world model layers executed and caching relevant representations across action denoising steps, TurboWAM substantially reduces computational overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple robot manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that TurboWAM achieves low inference latency while maintaining competitive task success rates compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出TurboWAM，通过在动作条件下自适应聚合世界模型各层结构化表示、并对各层施加结构化动作监督，结合推理时减少执行层数与跨去噪步缓存表示，在多个机器人操作基准上以低推理延迟保持与SOTA相当的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: World action model在机器人策略学习中表现优异，但推理延迟高，制约实际部署。已有加速方法（减少测试时未来帧想象、加速动作预测）直接使用全部视频世界模型层的表示，未考虑各层与动作预测的相关性差异，导致冗余计算与表示利用不充分。
AI.method: 1) 结构化世界表示聚合模块：依据各世界模型层表示与不断演化的动作去噪状态之间的相关性，自适应融合不同层的表示；2) 结构化动作监督机制：在反向传播中按层自适应调制动作监督梯度，促进世界表示学习；3) 推理优化：减少执行的世界模型层数，并在动作去噪步之间缓存相关表示以降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在多个机器人操作基准上的大量实验表明，TurboWAM 相比最先进方法在保持有竞争力的任务成功率的同时，实现了较低的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 按动作相关性对世界模型多层表示进行结构化聚合与监督，并配合层数与缓存层面的推理裁剪，是缓解world action model推理瓶颈的有效途径，可在不显著牺牲成功率的前提下提升部署实用性。

title: WMEval: Evaluating Interactive World Models Grounded on Physical Simulations
summary: Interactive world models hold immense potential for high-stakes applications in robotics, game engines, and immersive digital twins, yet existing benchmarks primarily focus on perceptual similarity rather than the physical-causal coherence essential for real-world utility. We introduce WMEval, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates interactive world models against Unity-based physical simulations. By leveraging Unity as a high-fidelity ground-truth oracle, we shift evaluation beyond perceptual visual assessment toward the objective state-based verification required for downstream applications. Spanning 9 diverse scenes, WMEval assesses action controllability, scene and character consistency, prompt adherence, kinematics, fluid mechanics, physical causality, and lighting. By executing matched action sequences in both the simulator and the world model, WMEval enables evaluation at both the perceptual level and the physical-causal level, using simulator-derived states as reference. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal significant room for improvement in dimensions that remain hidden by standard perceptual metrics but are vital for real-world deployments. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/WMEval.

AI.tldr: WMEval 是一个以 Unity 物理仿真为高保真真值预言机的交互式世界模型评测基准，将评测从感知相似性推进到基于状态的物理-因果一致性验证。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型在机器人、游戏引擎、数字孪生等高风险场景中潜力巨大，但现有基准主要衡量感知相似度，缺乏对真实应用所需的物理-因果一致性的评估。
AI.method: 以 Unity 作为高保真真值预言机，在仿真器与世界模型中执行匹配的动作序列；覆盖 9 个多样场景，从动作可控性、场景与角色一致性、提示遵循、运动学、流体力学、物理因果、光照等维度，在感知层与物理-因果层双重评测，并以仿真器导出的状态作为参考。
AI.result: 对当前最先进模型的实验显示，在被标准感知指标掩盖、但对真实部署至关重要的维度上仍存在显著提升空间。
AI.conclusion: WMEval 建立了面向下游应用的客观状态级评测范式，揭示了感知指标之外的物理-因果短板，为交互式世界模型的实用化提供评测依据。

title: Late Breaking Results: Audio-Language-Action Models with Direct Speech Conditioning for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 2 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to DAC 2026 Late Breaking Results
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to follow instructions in typed text, limiting broader deployment in natural speech. The traditional solution by prepending a speech recognition before VLA to convert speech into texts would incur additional latency and propagate errors. To address this, we present Speech-$π_{0.5}$, which maps raw speech directly to motor commands without explicit textual transcriptions. Specifically, built on $π_{0.5}$, we use a cross-modal projection to convert voice frames directly into audio tokens with significant response latency reduction. To further improve the accuracy, we adopt split LoRA adaptation with dedicated audio and task adapters, under a two-stage training. Speech-$π_{0.5}$ achieves $3\times$ lower response latency than ASR pipeline while maintaining competitive task success on LIBERO, and generalizes robustly to unseen accents where a single adapter degrades significantly.

AI.tldr: 提出 Speech-π₀.₅，将原始语音直接映射为机器人运动指令，绕过显式文本转录，在保持 LIBERO 任务成功率的同时将响应延迟降低 3 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型仅接受文本指令，限制了自然语音场景下的部署；传统"ASR + VLA"级联方案存在额外延迟与误差级联传播问题。
AI.method: 基于 π₀.₅ 构建：(1) 使用跨模态投影将语音帧直接转换为音频 token；(2) 采用分离式 LoRA 适配，分别设置音频适配器与任务适配器；(3) 两阶段训练策略。
AI.result: 响应延迟较 ASR 流水线降低 3 倍，在 LIBERO 上保持有竞争力的任务成功率，并对未见口音具备稳健泛化能力（单一适配器在此场景下显著退化）。
AI.conclusion: 端到端语音到动作的映射可同时兼顾低延迟与任务性能，分离式 LoRA 设计对跨口音泛化至关重要。

title: Grounding on Request: Learning Modality Control in Vision-Language Models
summary: When an image and its caption disagree, can a user reliably control which one a vision-language model (VLM) follows? Accuracy alone cannot answer this question, since a model might give the correct answer from parametric knowledge without following the requested evidence. We therefore evaluate modality grounding control through conflict-preserving counterfactual interventions. Specifically, Flip measures whether an initially correct answer follows an edit to the requested modality, while Stay measures whether it remains stable when the competing modality is edited. To learn this control, we build on neologism learning by introducing new words for visual and textual grounding, training only their embeddings while keeping the pretrained model fixed. We also introduce Counterfactual Twin-Margin (CTM) supervision, which uses paired interventions to teach how answer probabilities should change when the requested evidence changes. Across three VLMs on three existing benchmarks and our multi-attribute Ground-CF benchmark, we find that learned modality words improve control over natural-language instructions. Surprisingly, a single learned embedding per modality provides strong lightweight visual control and shows little average degradation on held-out values. LoRA remains strongest overall, although its visual advantage narrows under held-out evaluation. Moreover, counterfactual supervision improves control in several settings where standard supervision is weaker. Finally, we test our method on real-world news video and find that visual control improves when the relevant evidence is made easier to access. Overall, our results show that reliable modality control requires testing not only whether an answer is correct, but whether it continues to follow edits to the modality of choice.

AI.tldr: 提出用"冲突保持的反事实干预"来评测VLM的模态接地控制（Flip/Stay指标），并用可学习的模态词嵌入+反事实孪生间隔(CTM)监督来获得轻量级控制能力。
AI.motivation: 准确率无法判断模型究竟是遵循了被指定的模态证据，还是仅凭参数化知识答对；因此需要一种能检验"用户能否可靠控制模型跟随图像或文本"的评测与训练范式。
AI.method: 构建保冲突的反事实干预：Flip衡量正确答案是否随被请求模态的编辑而翻转，Stay衡量竞争模态被编辑时答案是否保持稳定；基于新词学习为视觉与文本接地各引入新词，仅训练其embedding、冻结预训练模型；并提出反事实孪生间隔(CTM)监督，用成对干预约束答案概率随证据变化的走向；同时构建多属性Ground-CF基准。
AI.result: 在3个VLM、3个现有基准及Ground-CF上，学习到的模态词比自然语言指令带来更好的控制；单一模态embedding即可提供强轻量视觉控制且留出值上平均退化很小；LoRA整体最强但视觉优势在留出评测下收窄；反事实监督在标准监督较弱的若干设定中提升控制；真实新闻视频上，当相关证据更易获取时视觉控制提升。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的模态控制不能只看答案是否正确，还必须检验答案是否持续跟随所选模态的编辑；轻量嵌入方法在控制性与通用性间取得较好折中。

title: Road Infrastructure Perception for Autonomous Driving: Taxonomy, Representations, Tasks, and Challenges
summary: Road infrastructure perception is a fundamental component of autonomous driving, as it recovers the structured road elements that define roadway geometry, delimit operational space, and encode traffic regulations. Although individual tasks such as lane detection, drivable-space estimation, traffic-sign recognition, and online map construction have been extensively studied, the field remains fragmented across task definitions, sensing assumptions, output representations, datasets, and evaluation protocols. This survey provides a function-oriented synthesis of road infrastructure perception. We first clarify its scope and organize existing studies into three complementary categories: geometric-structural, functional-spatial, and regulatory-semantic infrastructure. Based on this taxonomy, we review sensing modalities, scene representations, representative methods, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols, emphasizing the field's evolution from image-space recognition toward metric, vectorized, topology-aware, occupancy-based, and rule-grounded scene modeling. We further examine how representation choices affect evaluation and downstream usability, revealing limitations of current benchmarks in relation reasoning, temporal consistency, robustness, and planning-oriented assessment. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions toward unified infrastructure representation, open-environment generalization, relation- and rule-aware reasoning, and downstream-oriented evaluation. By connecting tasks, representations, and evaluation under a common functional framework, this survey aims to establish road infrastructure perception as a coherent foundation for map-compatible and behavior-relevant autonomous-driving scene understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇面向功能的道路基础设施感知综述，将现有研究按几何-结构、功能-空间、法规-语义三类组织，系统梳理感知模态、场景表示、方法、基准与评测协议，并指出当前基准在关系推理、时序一致性、鲁棒性和面向规划的评测方面的不足，提出统一表示、开放环境泛化、关系与规则推理及下游导向评测等未来方向。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需要恢复定义道路几何、限定可行驶空间并编码交通规则的结构化道路元素，但车道检测、可行驶区域估计、交通标志识别、在线地图构建等子任务在任务定义、传感假设、输出表示、数据集与评测协议上高度割裂，缺乏统一的功能性框架。综述旨在将道路基础设施感知整合为一致的基础，服务地图兼容与行为相关的场景理解。
AI.method: 功能导向的综合梳理：界定研究范围并构建三分类体系（几何-结构类、功能-空间类、法规-语义类）；在此分类下回顾传感模态、场景表示、代表性方法、基准与评测协议；分析表示选择对评测与下游可用性的影响；归纳现有基准的局限并讨论开放挑战与未来方向。
AI.result: 梳理出该领域从图像空间识别向度量、矢量化、拓扑感知、占据式及规则约束的场景建模演进脉络；揭示表示选择与评测方式、下游可用性之间的耦合关系；识别出现有基准在关系推理、时序一致性、鲁棒性与面向规划的评测上的具体缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 通过在统一功能框架下连接任务、表示与评测，该综述为道路基础设施感知确立了作为地图兼容、行为相关自动驾驶场景理解基础的地位，并指向统一基础设施表示、开放环境泛化、关系与规则感知推理及下游导向评测等关键方向。

title: Rescuing Your Pruning: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning and Post-Training Recovery in MLLMs
summary: Visual token pruning substantially reduces the inference cost of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing methods are mostly training-free and plug-and-play. They treat the resulting performance drop as an inevitable cost of compression and pursue increasingly complex pruning rules. We rethink this view through two questions: how much of the loss can post-training rescue, and, building on this recovery, how can joint compression push pruning to its limit? We curate a 282K-sample post-training mixture covering general VQA, reasoning, OCR, and grounding, and post-train 36 configurations that drop or merge tokens under a unified protocol. Post-training rescues most of the loss, even for OCR and grounding, and its adaptation gain in closing the gap between the pruned and the dense model grows as the budget tightens. For joint compression, we find that the vision encoder, not the LLM, dominates prefill time in native-resolution MLLMs, so where tokens are removed matters more than how many: keeping 40% of tokens at the encoder runs faster than keeping 10% at the projector. Our best configuration prunes the encoder lightly and the projector aggressively, leaves the LLM intact, and keeps general understanding and reasoning at the dense level. It accelerates the LLM stage by 3.49x but the end-to-end time-to-first-token by only 1.54x, showing that LLM-stage speedups overstate end-to-end gains. We hope these findings offer insights for future research on joint visual token compression. Our data, protocol, and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了视觉token剪枝后的后训练恢复能力与联合压缩策略，发现后训练可挽回大部分性能损失，且在原生分辨率MLLM中"在哪里删token"比"删多少"更重要。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法多为免训练、即插即用，将性能下降视为压缩的必然代价，并致力于设计日益复杂的剪枝规则。作者希望回答两个问题：后训练能挽回多少损失？在恢复基础上联合压缩能将剪枝推向何种极限？
AI.method: 构建282K样本的后训练混合数据，覆盖通用VQA、推理、OCR与grounding；在统一协议下对36种token丢弃/合并配置进行后训练；并分析编码器与LLM在预填充阶段的耗时构成以指导联合压缩。
AI.result: 后训练可挽回大部分性能损失（包括OCR与grounding），且预算越紧时其缩小剪枝模型与稠密模型差距的适配增益越大。联合压缩方面，原生分辨率MLLM中视觉编码器（而非LLM）主导预填充时间，故在编码器保留40% token比在投影器保留10%更快。最优配置为编码器轻剪、投影器激进剪、LLM不动，可保持通用理解与推理达稠密水平；LLM阶段加速3.49x，但端到端首token时间仅加速1.54x，说明LLM阶段加速高估了端到端收益。
AI.conclusion: 后训练是token剪枝性能损失的有效补救手段，且联合压缩中剪枝位置比剪枝比例更关键；LLM阶段加速不能代表端到端收益，作者希望这些发现为未来联合视觉token压缩研究提供启示，并将公开数据、协议与代码。

title: Allocation Before the Clock: Graph, Set and Game Theory of Professional League of Legends Objective Setups
summary: Before every neutral objective in professional League of Legends, each team decides which of its five players walk to the pit, which hold a lane, and when to commit. The leading analysis of such setups, TAGNet for Counter-Strike 2, clusters graph-network embeddings of player positions and reads cluster win rates as tactical quality. We treat a setup as an allocation on a walled map: formations are set partitions on the lattice $Π_5$, control is a geodesic Voronoi split of a navigation graph, and commitment is an allocation game solved as a quantal response equilibrium priced in win probability. On all 164 games of MSI and Worlds 2025 (2,994 team-setups, minimap tracks validated against Riot positions), trailing teams leave the pit empty far more often than leading teams, by +34.8 percentage points at the first baron and +30.4 percentage points at Atakhan. Our model, HASSE-QRE, finds six setup patterns that whole-model series-bootstrap refits reproduce (ARI 0.819, comparable to 0.813 for TAGNet's $K$-Means step alone) and indicates that teams price fights, travel and committed players, not the objective itself (weight 0.018; fixing it to one costs 59.9 log-likelihood points). The equilibrium reproduces a quarter of the commitment gap, almost all of it through state variables rather than its strategic channels. Weighting a team-level contrast by exposure moves it across $p=0.05$ (0.046 against 0.052). We release the tracks, setups and code.

AI.tldr: 论文将MOBA中目标点团队站位建模为"围墙地图上的资源分配"，提出HASSE-QRE框架，揭示落后队伍更多"放弃坑位"，且队伍在博弈中几乎不为目标本身定价。
AI.motivation: 现有团队战术分析主要沿用TAGNet（CS2）思路：聚类图网络嵌入的选手位置并以簇胜率衡量战术质量，缺乏对"谁进坑、谁守线、何时投入"这一分配决策的结构化博弈建模；同时电竞数据中暴露量与选择偏差影响结论稳健性。
AI.method: 将setup形式化为三要素：阵型=格$Π_5$上的集合划分；控制权=导航图上的测地Voronoi划分；投入=以胜率为"价格"的分配博弈，用分位数反应均衡（QRE）求解，构成HASSE-QRE（层级/半序结构+QRE）模型；在MSI与Worlds 2025全部164场、2,994个队伍setup上分析，小地图轨迹与Riot官方位置校验，并用全模型序列自助重采样检验模式稳定性（ARI）。
AI.result: 落后队伍空坑率显著高于领先队伍：首条男爵+34.8个百分点、Atakhan+30.4个百分点。模型识别出六个可复现的setup模式（ARI 0.819，与TAGNet K-Means单步0.813相当）。队伍为团战、行军和投入人数定价，而不为目标本身定价（权重0.018；将该权重固定为1损失59.9个对数似然点）。均衡可复现约四分之一的投入差距，且几乎全部经由状态变量而非策略渠道。对队伍层面对比按暴露量加权会使结论跨越$p=0.05$（0.046 vs 0.052）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化分配博弈框架可解释职业LoL中立目标前的团队站位与投入行为，其预测力主要来自状态变量；目标本身在决策中近乎不被定价，说明"为龙/为男爵而战"的直觉需修正。同时，加权方式对显著性结论敏感，提示电竞观察性研究须谨慎处理暴露偏差。作者开源轨迹、setup与代码。

title: Mix Forcing: Causal Pre-Training via Mixture Attention for Interactive World Models
summary: While interactive video world models require autoregressive generation, directly adapting pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into autoregressive ones with teacher forcing can disrupt their visual priors and degrade autoregressive generation quality. In this paper, we introduce Mix Forcing, a causal pre-training paradigm for interactive video world models, implemented with the Mixture-of-Bidirectional-and-Autoregressive (MoBA) attention. Mix Forcing jointly trains a video diffusion model with both teacher forcing and bidirectional training, yielding a strong causal initialization for few-step post-training. In self-attention, Mix Forcing leverages teacher forcing to learn causal next-chunk prediction for autoregressive rollout, while using bidirectional attention to preserve pretrained visual priors. To support online text interaction, Mix Forcing further adopts a chunk-wise cross-attention design that conditions each video chunk on a shared environment prompt and its own local prompt, without exposing future instructions to the current chunk. Following causal pre-training on a 14B image-to-video model, we apply consistency and distribution matching distillation to obtain a four-step autoregressive generator. Experiments on our internal benchmark and public benchmarks, including WBench and SANA-WM-Bench, show that our model achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and timely event following with precise camera control. Notably, our model supports high-fidelity long-horizon generation without quality degradation even over one-hour rollouts. Project page is here: https://zelingao98.github.io/mixforcing

AI.tldr: 提出Mix Forcing因果预训练范式与MoBA注意力，结合教师强制与双向训练为交互式视频世界模型提供强因果初始化，实现四步自回归生成与长时序高质量rollout。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需自回归生成，但将预训练双向视频扩散模型直接改造为教师强制式自回归会破坏其视觉先验，降低生成质量。
AI.method: 采用混合双向与自回归（MoBA）注意力的Mix Forcing：自注意力中教师强制学习下一chunk的因果预测，双向注意力保留预训练视觉先验；并提出chunk-wise交叉注意力，每个视频chunk以共享环境prompt与自身局部prompt为条件，避免未来指令泄漏。在14B图像到视频模型上因果预训练后，用一致性蒸馏与分布匹配蒸馏得到四步自回归生成器。
AI.result: 在内部基准及WBench、SANA-WM-Bench等公开基准上取得最优视觉质量、及时事件跟随与精确相机控制；支持超一小时rollout的高保真长时序生成且无明显质量退化。
AI.conclusion: Mix Forcing以双向—自回归混合训练缓解先验破坏问题，为少步蒸馏与长时交互生成提供有效因果初始化范式。

title: Distilling Dense Trajectory Teachers For Large-Motion Video World Models
summary: Video world models are expected to generate videos that accurately follow specified camera trajectories while maintaining consistent 3D structures. However, existing models are predominantly trained on densely sampled videos with small inter-frame camera motions. When applied to sparse, large step trajectories, they often produce frozen frames, inaccurate camera motion, and severe geometric drift. We attribute this degradation to a mismatch between the gradual viewpoint transitions seen during training and the large viewpoint changes required at inference time. To address this problem, we propose Dense Trajectory Teacher Distillation (DTTD), a post-training framework that transfers a model's generation capability from dense trajectories to large camera motions. Given a sparse trajectory, DTTD interpolates additional camera poses to construct a dense trajectory covering the same path.
