AI.method: Distill a continuous foundation model into a discrete codebook learned gradient-free via Growing Neural Gas, producing an adjacency graph over codes; then use the codebook as the MIM reconstruction target with a graph-distance soft cross-entropy loss that replaces one-hot targets with topologically graded supervision. Student pretraining uses 383 public Duke iAMD OCT volumes, distilling an 86M-parameter teacher into a 22M-parameter student.
AI.result: Student matches and sometimes exceeds the teacher on three classification and two segmentation benchmarks, with ≥3.6x fewer FLOPs; on external OLIVES it beats the MIRAGE teacher on every metric (98.06% vs. 95.22% balanced accuracy). Works with both MIRAGE and DINOv3 teachers; the general-domain teacher is competitive for classification while retina-specific pretraining adds most value for segmentation.
AI.conclusion: Compact retinal models from this pipeline are potentially deployable, transferring across OCT datasets, devices, and clinical tasks, including three datasets unseen during student pretraining; the benefit of domain-specific pretraining is task-dependent.

title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
summary: Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value. Taking RAG as a reference, we dissect the net value of memory into the gains and losses over direct retrieval, termed memory benefit and memory tax. These gains and losses arise because memory process changes how the raw information is organized and accessed. We view such changes as the double-edged deviations from the raw history. They are originally designed and introduced to benefit the task, for example by reorganizing facts or distilling preferences, but some may also remove or obscure evidence, giving rise to memory tax. Since memory benefit reflects the expected gains of its design, we then focus more on the overlooked memory tax, study how it arises from the system and evaluation side, and generalize the concept to more application scenarios of memory. We hope the notion of memory tax can provide a new lens and shift more attention from standalone performance to the net value of memory, informing more reliable memory designs and evaluations. We will open-source the code and results to the community. Project Page: https://hexuan21.github.io/MemoryTax/

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估发现，专用记忆系统在多种基准与骨干模型上常不如朴素RAG，即记忆相对直接检索的净价值为负。作者将净价值分解为"记忆收益"与"记忆税"，重点剖析被忽视的记忆税，呼吁从单点性能转向净价值视角。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体中日渐流行构建记忆，但"记忆相较于直接从原始历史检索"的净价值缺乏清晰结论，既有工作多关注单独性能而非相对基线的增益与代价。
AI.method: 以RAG为参照进行多基准、多模型骨干的大规模评测；将记忆的净价值拆解为相对直接检索的收益与损失（记忆收益 vs. 记忆税），并将记忆过程视为对原始历史组织的"双刃剑式偏离"；随后从系统侧与评测侧分析记忆税的来源，并推广该概念至更多记忆应用场景。
AI.result: 多个专用记忆系统在不少情形下劣于朴素RAG，表现出负净价值；记忆收益源于设计预期的信息重组与偏好蒸馏等，而记忆税源自证据被删除或遮蔽等信息丢失与模糊化。
AI.conclusion: 提出"记忆税"这一分析视角，将关注点从孤立性能转向记忆的净价值，为更可靠的记忆设计与评测提供指导；代码与结果将开源。

title: Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL
summary: Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. However, because these rewards are typically defined as a weighted measure of rubric coverage, models are trained primarily to maximize a recall objective. As a result, RL-trained models produce responses that are more complete but also more verbose and contain more unnecessary or factually incorrect content, leading them to be less preferred than responses from the base model. To address this issue, we present the FORK reward, which jointly optimizes recall and a novel precision objective, which requires each unit of a model response to be both necessary and factually correct, as measured by rubric-driven necessity credits and a factual-correctness grader, respectively. Our experimental results show that FORK outperforms existing rubric-based RL methods and achieves Pareto-optimal performance that balances rubric coverage and overall response quality. Compared to the original recall-based reward, FORK substantially improves precision and reduces response length while achieving similar rubric coverage, which leads to significantly higher win rate compared to the base policy (e.g., from 10.6% to 68.0% on RubricHub-Medical and from 22.1% to 74.1% on HealthBench).

AI.tldr: 提出FORK奖励，在基于评分表的强化学习中联合优化召回率与新颖的精确率目标，缓解奖励塑造导致的冗长与事实错误问题，显著提升胜率。
AI.motivation: 基于评分表（rubric）的奖励通常按评分表覆盖度的加权和定义，模型因此主要被训练去最大化召回率（recall）。结果是RL训练后的回答更完整但更冗长，并包含更多不必要或事实错误的内容，反而比基座模型的回答更不被偏好。
AI.method: 提出FORK奖励，联合优化召回率与精确率（precision）目标。精确率要求回答的每个单元既"必要"又"事实正确"，分别由评分表驱动的必要性信用（necessity credits）与事实正确性评分器（factual-correctness grader）度量。
AI.result: FORK超越现有基于评分表的RL方法，达到在评分表覆盖度与整体回答质量之间平衡的帕累托最优性能。相比原始召回型奖励，在覆盖度相近的情况下大幅提升精确率并缩短回答长度，相对基座策略的胜率显著提升（如RubricHub-Medical 从10.6%升至68.0%，HealthBench 从22.1%升至74.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 仅优化召回率的评分表奖励会导致冗长与事实错误，使RL模型劣于基座模型；显式引入必要性—事实正确性约束的精确率目标可同时改善质量与长度效率，取得更优的整体偏好表现。

title: Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering
comment: 10 pages. Preprint submitted to IEEE ICHI 2027. Extends the non-archival GenAI4Health @ NeurIPS 2026 study arXiv:2609.09684v2 with automatic RMS scaling, RSP-Drop, budget analyses, and entropy-prefilter ablations
summary: Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks. We investigate perturbation-based data selection using two signals derived from Gaussian perturbations of the final-block representation: prediction-change frequency and non-flipping margin contraction. After a shared entropy prefilter, Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) combines the signals using automatic root-mean-square scaling, while RSP-Drop ranks candidates by contraction alone. Both selectors use only questions and answer options during selection. We evaluate them with MedGemma-4B on five medical QA datasets at retained-set budgets of 64, 128, and 256 examples. At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection. Their relative performance varies across datasets and budgets. A selected-set case study identifies contrasting clean-margin profiles among the examples exchanged by the two rules, while a full-pool ablation shows that entropy prefiltering is not uniformly beneficial. These retrospective results characterize the empirical utility and limitations of perturbation-based selection under a fixed adaptation protocol. Evaluation uses one backbone and benchmarks with documented training-family overlap; it does not establish clinical effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 该文研究医疗语言模型在问答库微调时的紧凑训练子集选择，提出基于高斯扰动的两种选择规则（RSP 与 RSP-Drop），在MedGemma-4B与五个医疗QA数据集上验证其优于熵池匹配随机选择。
AI.motivation: 从现有问答库适配医疗语言模型时，挑选紧凑训练子集是关键步骤；作者希望检验仅利用问题与选项信息、基于表示扰动的选择信号能否有效替代依赖标签或完整训练的昂贵选择方法。
AI.method: 在最终层表示上施加高斯扰动，提取两类信号：预测翻转频率与不翻转情况下的边界收缩（margin contraction）；先做统一的熵预筛，Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) 用自动均方根缩放融合两种信号，RSP-Drop 仅按收缩排序。选择阶段只使用问题与答案选项。以MedGemma-4B在五个医疗QA数据集上，保留集预算64/128/256进行评估，指标为Macro-F1，并做选定集案例分析与全池消融。
AI.result: 在主要预算128下，RSP与RSP-Drop的数据集平均Macro-F1分别为47.55与48.28，熵池匹配随机选择为45.11；两者相对优势随数据集与预算变化。案例分析显示两种规则互换的样本具有不同的干净边界（clean-margin）分布；全池消融表明熵预筛并非普遍有益。
AI.conclusion: 扰动式数据选择在固定适配协议下具有一定经验效用但存在局限；结果属回顾性研究，仅用单一骨干网络且基准存在训练家族重叠，不能证明临床有效性。

title: Distill, Debate, Discover: Grounding Multi-Agent Research Ideation in Graph-Distilled Insights
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support research idea generation and scientific discovery. Multi-agent debate offers a collaborative approach to this task by bringing together diverse perspectives to develop research ideas. However, a key challenge is how to equip agents with distinct and meaningful expertise to guide their contributions. Inspired by how researchers draw on accumulated research experience during collaboration, we introduce InsightAgents, a framework that constructs literature-grounded agent expertise by distilling insights from graphs of related papers. Guided by insights that trace evolving research approaches, reveal underlying assumptions, and identify unresolved challenges, within a line of research, agents jointly identify a research problem and propose, challenge, and refine potential approaches through debate to develop a research proposal. We evaluate InsightAgents against three research idea generation frameworks on 100 NLP research topics through pairwise comparisons by two LLM judges. In both online and offline knowledge settings, InsightAgents achieves the highest average score across the five evaluation dimensions under both judges.

AI.tldr: 提出 InsightAgents 框架：从相关论文图谱中蒸馏洞见，为多智能体辩论中的各智能体构建有领域专长的专家画像，以联合生成研究问题与提案。在 100 个 NLP 主题上经两名 LLM 评审两两比较，在线上与离线知识两种设置下于五个维度均取得最高平均分。
AI.motivation: LLM 被广泛用于研究想法生成与科学发现，多智能体辩论可汇聚多元视角；但关键难题在于如何让各智能体具备区分度高且有意义的专业能力，以引导其贡献，而非泛泛而谈。
AI.method: 借鉴研究者协同时调用积累研究经验的做法，从相关论文图谱中蒸馏洞见（追踪研究方法的演进路径、揭示隐含假设、识别未解决挑战），据此为智能体构建有文献根基的专家知识；智能体在该洞见引导下共同识别研究问题，并通过辩论提出、质疑与改进候选方案，最终形成研究提案。
AI.result: 在 100 个 NLP 研究主题上，与三个研究想法生成框架进行两两比较，由两名 LLM 评审打分；在线上与离线两种知识设置下，InsightAgents 在五项评价维度上的平均分均为最高。
AI.conclusion: 以文献图谱蒸馏的洞见作为智能体专长的来源，是赋予多智能体辩论差异化专业视角的有效途径，可稳定提升研究问题识别与提案生成的质量。

title: When Does GEPA Merge Help? A Mechanism-Level Diagnostic
summary: GEPA is among the strongest reflective prompt optimizers for language-model programs, but its system-aware merge operator is unstable across models: merge improves gpt-4.1-mini on average while degrading Qwen3-8B, an asymmetry noted but left unexplained by the GEPA paper. We investigate this instability across five datasets and two models. Our nine-configuration sweep over merge timing and merge operator shows that merge can improve both models when configured appropriately. This suggests that merge instability is better explained by configuration sensitivity than by an inherent flaw in the merge operator. We then test whether prompt-level features predict GEPA's merge-accept decisions and find that they do not, ruling out static-feature gating. As a proof of concept, a behavior-based probe built from these diagnostics avoids large merge failures in our multi-seed runs by abstaining on high-risk tasks, although it does not consistently outperform NoMerge. Code is available as GEPA-MergeProbe at https://github.com/ChongZZZZ/GEPA_MERGE .

AI.tldr: 本文针对GEPA反射式提示优化器中"系统感知合并算子"跨模型不稳定的现象（提升gpt-4.1-mini但损害Qwen3-8B）展开实证研究，发现该不稳定源于配置敏感性而非算子本身缺陷，并验证基于行为的探针可实现风险规避式弃权。
AI.motivation: GEPA是语言模型程序最强的反射式提示优化器之一，但其合并算子在跨模型表现上存在未被原论文解释的不对称性：合并平均上提升gpt-4.1-mini却降低Qwen3-8B性能。作者希望解释这一不稳定性的成因，并探索可行的缓解机制。
AI.method: 在5个数据集、2个模型上开展研究：（1）围绕合并时机与合并算子设计9种配置的扫描实验；（2）检验提示层静态特征能否预测GEPA的合并接受决策；（3）基于诊断结果构建行为驱动的探针，在高风险任务上弃权（abstain），并进行多随机种子验证。
AI.result: 9种配置扫描表明，合理配置下合并可同时提升两个模型，说明不稳定性主要归因于配置敏感性而非合并算子固有缺陷；提示层静态特征无法预测合并接受决策，静态特征门控被排除；行为探针在多seed运行中避免了大规模合并失败，但未稳定优于NoMerge基线。
AI.conclusion: GEPA合并的不稳定性是配置依赖问题，可通过调参缓解；静态特征门控不可行，而行为级风险探针作为概念验证能降低最坏情形风险，但尚不能稳定带来净收益，代码以GEPA-MergeProbe开源。

title: MTA-Zero: Self-Improving Multimodal Deep Search via Online QA-Solver Co-training
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong visual reasoners, yet remain limited in open-world, multi-step search that requires grounding images, selecting tools, and integrating web evidence. Existing approaches typically construct and filter fixed offline corpora whose question distributions cannot adapt as the target deep-search agent improves. Building on MTA-Agent's image-grounded QA construction, we present MTA-Zero, an online multimodal QA-Solver co-training framework for self-improving multimodal deep-search agents that requires no precomputed multi-hop corpus. Starting from image-grounded VQA seed contexts, a trainable QA Generator retrieves evidence and constructs verified multi-hop questions online. A separate deep-search Solver then selects tools, gathers evidence, and answers the generated questions. To focus generation on the Solver's learning frontier, we derive a Goldilocks reward for the QA Generator from the Solver's group-wise rollout success rate: questions solved by all rollouts or by none receive zero reward, whereas questions near the current frontier are favored. We optimize the two policies independently with GRPO, without sharing parameters or gradients. Across six multimodal deep-search benchmarks, MTA-Zero improves a Qwen3-VL-8B Solver from 36.91% to 51.58% mean accuracy and achieves performance comparable to GPT-5 under the same agent workflow. The same framework also improves a newer Qwen3.6-27B Solver by 10.82 points. These results show that verified online question generation provides a policy-specific curriculum for continually improving multimodal deep-search agents.

AI.tldr: 提出MTA-Zero，一个无需预构建多跳语料的在线多模态问答—求解器协同训练框架，通过"金发姑娘"奖励引导问答生成器为深度搜索智能体提供自适应的在线课程。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在多步、开放世界的多模态深度搜索（需图像定位、工具选择、网络证据整合）上仍受限；现有方法依赖固定离线语料构建与过滤，问题分布无法随目标智能体的能力提升而自适应。
AI.method: 以图像grounded VQA种子上下文为起点，可训练的QA生成器在线检索证据并构建经校验的多跳问题；独立的深度搜索求解器选择工具、收集证据并作答。由求解器组内rollout成功率导出Goldilocks奖励：全部解出或全部未解出的问题奖励为零，接近当前能力前沿的问题被偏好。两条策略各自用GRPO独立优化，不共享参数与梯度。
AI.result: 在六个多模态深度搜索基准上，将Qwen3-VL-8B求解器平均准确率从36.91%提升至51.58%，在相同智能体工作流下性能可比GPT-5；同一框架还将更新的Qwen3.6-27B求解器提升10.82个点。
AI.conclusion: 经过校验的在线问题生成可为策略定制课程，持续改进多模态深度搜索智能体，验证了在线自进化训练范式的有效性。

title: Linear-Time Context Compression with State-Space Encoding
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) impose substantial computation and memory costs as context sizes increase, motivating methods that compress a context into a shorter representation before inference. Existing soft-prompt compression methods typically use the same Transformer backbone as used in the target model, where producing the compressed representation leads to significant latency overheads. This restricts them to the offline setting where context is compressed once and then reused across many queries. We propose the Boa Compressor, a plug-and-play online context compressor built on a Mamba state-space model (SSM) that encodes arbitrary-length context in a single linear-time pass, producing a representation on which we condition a frozen target LLM. The SSM is trained by distillation, matching the next-token logit distribution from the LLM ingesting the full context (as teacher) to the same LLM ingesting the compressed representation (as the student). At equal compression ratios, Boa matches or surpasses the performance of existing state-of-the-art offline compression baselines, while being an order of magnitude faster than Transformer-based implementations, thereby reducing end-to-end latency rather than adding compression time overhead. We demonstrate that Boa also scales well to longer contexts and to compression ratios as aggressive as 16x. By enabling effective compression that is cheap enough to run on every query at inference time, Boa becomes a practical and general tool for efficient long-context inference.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Mamba状态空间模型的即插即用在线上下文压缩器Boa Compressor，单次线性时间编码任意长度上下文，速度比Transformer实现快一个数量级，压缩质量匹配或超越现有离线SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 基于Transformer的LLM随上下文增长导致显著计算与显存开销，需在推理前压缩上下文。但现有软提示压缩方法沿用目标模型的Transformer骨干，压缩表示生成本身带来高延迟，只能用于"压缩一次、多查询复用"的离线场景，无法在每次查询时在线压缩。
AI.method: 构建基于Mamba SSM的即插即用在线压缩器，对任意长度上下文做单次线性时间编码，产出表示用于条件化冻结的目标LLM；采用蒸馏训练，令输入压缩表示的LLM（学生）匹配输入完整上下文的LLM（教师）的下一token logit分布。
AI.result: 在相同压缩率下，Boa匹配或超越现有SOTA离线压缩基线，同时比Transformer实现快约一个数量级，降低端到端延迟而非增加压缩开销；对更长上下文扩展良好，压缩率可达16x仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 压缩足够廉价以致可在推理时对每次查询实时执行，使Boa成为高效长上下文推理的实用通用工具，将软提示压缩从离线复用推进到在线按需场景。

title: From Writing Advice to Manuscript Governance: A Constrained-Transformation Framework for Academic Revision
summary: Academic revision presents a governance problem when legitimate writing objectives conflict. Writing-process and social-science research show that revision is recursive and that wording carries epistemic and disciplinary commitments. Those literatures identify important constraints but do not settle which objective should prevail when concision, outlet form or stylistic variation conflicts with evidence and claim boundaries. This paper models revision as an admissibility problem under ordered constraints. Task-relative invariants, contextual constraints and mutable presentation choices define the admissible space; a claim-preservation contract links evidence and judgement to an authorised claim boundary. Four governance propositions specify preservation, precedence, context and sufficiency. The Academic Writing Filter implements the model by screening candidate revisions; it is not a universal definition or classifier of good academic writing. The contribution is a technology-independent mechanism for changing presentation without silently changing the research argument.

AI.tldr: \u672c\u6587\u5c06\u5b66\u672f\u4fee\u8ba2\u5efa\u6a21\u4e3a\u53d7\u7ea6\u675f\u4e0b\u7684\u201c\u53ef\u63a5\u53d7\u6027\u95ee\u9898\u201d\uff0c\u63d0\u51fa\u4e00\u7ec4\u6cbb\u7406\u547d\u9898\u4e0e\u4e00\u4e2a\u7b5b\u9009\u673a\u5236\uff08Academic Writing Filter\uff09\uff0c\u4f7f\u8868\u8fbe\u5c42\u9762\u7684\u4fee\u6539\u4e0d\u81f4\u60c4\u79fb\u6539\u7814\u7a76\u8bba\u8bc1\u3002

title: RAGing Against Misogyny: Improving Implicit Misogyny Explanations
summary: Implicit misogyny often requires background knowledge to be understood. To address this challenge, we propose a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for detecting and explaining implicit misogyny in English and Italian, leveraging encyclopedic, slang and feminist knowledge sources. Using the ImplicIT-Mis and SBIC+ datasets, we evaluate the contribution of each knowledge source to detection and explanation quality, investigating also whether RAG addresses known LLM failure modes in implicit misogyny. Results show that RAG improves recall on ImplicIT-Mis, but does not improve detection performance on SBIC+. However, human evaluation shows that RAG-based explanations are preferred over no-RAG explanations in both languages. Feminist literature emerges as the most consistently useful source for detection and explanation.

AI.tldr: 提出RAG框架检测并解释英意双语的隐性厌女，融合百科、俚语与女性主义知识源；RAG提升ImplicIT-Mis召回但未改善SBIC+检测，解释质量更受人工偏好，女性主义文献最有用。
AI.motivation: 隐性厌女表达往往依赖背景知识才能被理解，LLM在此类任务上存在已知失效模式，单纯依赖参数化知识难以支撑检测与解释。
AI.method: 构建RAG框架，针对英语与意大利语，外挂百科、俚语、女性主义三类知识源；在ImplicIT-Mis与SBIC+数据集上做消融式评估，量化各知识源对检测与解释的贡献，并考察RAG是否缓解LLM的已知失效模式；辅以人工评估比较有无RAG的解释质量。
AI.result: RAG在ImplicIT-Mis上提升召回率，但在SBIC+上未提升检测性能；人工评估显示两种语言中基于RAG的解释均优于无RAG解释；女性主义文献在检测与解释上均为最稳定有效的知识源。
AI.conclusion: 外部知识检索对隐性厌女的解释质量有稳定增益，但对检测性能的提升依赖数据集特性；女性主义知识源价值最高，提示知识源选择应任务与语言适配。

title: SimPOTrans: Self-Adaptation for Offline-to-Simultaneous Speech Translation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Simultaneous speech translation (SimulST) aims to translate ongoing speech with low latency while preserving translation quality. Recent studies have adopted large language models (LLMs) for SimulST and formulated it as a multi-turn dialogue task for efficient generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance. However, existing dialogue-style SimulST approaches typically rely on specialized training schemes to acquire simultaneous translation behavior, either using synthesized read/write trajectories, which may provide suboptimal training signals, or jointly optimizing translation quality and latency, whose competing objectives may cause optimization instability. In this paper, we introduce SimPOTrans, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that enables offline speech translation models to self-adapt to dialogue-style SimulST. Through a simple two-stage RL post-training pipeline, SimPOTrans rewards an offline model for exhibiting translation behaviors beneficial to simultaneous scenarios when given partial speech inputs, thereby enabling offline-to-simultaneous self-adaptation without synthesized read/write trajectories or explicit latency optimization. At inference time, SimPOTrans requires no external decision policy and enables flexible quality--latency control by simply adjusting the chunk size of speech input. Experiments on the ACL 60/60 and MCIF benchmarks across three language directions (En$\rightarrow$De, En$\rightarrow$Zh, and En$\rightarrow$Ja) demonstrate that SimPOTrans outperforms several strong baselines, achieving a superior quality--latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出SimPOTrans强化学习框架，通过两阶段RL后训练使离线语音翻译模型自适应为对话式同传，无需合成读写轨迹或显式延迟优化，推理时通过调节语音块大小实现质量-延迟灵活控制。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式SimulST依赖专门训练策略：或使用合成的读/写轨迹（训练信号次优），或联合优化翻译质量与延迟（目标相互竞争导致优化不稳定）。作者希望避免这两类问题。
AI.method: SimPOTrans是一个强化学习框架。采用简单的两阶段RL后训练流水线，在给定部分语音输入时，奖励离线模型表现出有利于同传场景的翻译行为，从而实现离线到同传的自适应；不依赖合成的读/写轨迹，也不显式优化延迟。推理时无需外部决策策略，仅通过调整输入语音块（chunk）大小即可控制质量-延迟权衡。
AI.result: 在ACL 60/60与MCIF基准、三个翻译方向（英→德、英→中、英→日）上的实验表明，SimPOTrans优于多个强基线，取得更优的质量-延迟权衡。
AI.conclusion: SimPOTrans表明以RL奖励"对同传有利的行为"即可让离线LLM语音翻译模型自适合同传，规避合成轨迹与延迟联合优化的缺陷，并保留推理时通过块大小调节的灵活性。

title: FATE-5: Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for Continuous Big Five Personality Control
summary: Controlling personality in large language models is important for building conversational agents that can be customized to different users and interaction settings. However, existing personality control methods often face a tradeoff between strong trait expression and natural dialogue generation. We introduce FATE-5, Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for the Big Five, a two-stage framework that separates personality encoding from naturalness alignment. FATE-5 first learns continuous soft prompt representations of Big Five profiles using dialogue supervision and an auxiliary survey objective. It then improves dialogue naturalness through preference alignment based on both dialogue quality and personality agreement. Across three language model backbones, FATE-5 maintains strong trait expression while achieving substantially higher dialogue naturalness than other trait-strong methods. On held-out questionnaires, it achieves monotonicity correlations of 0.97-0.99 and recovery RMSE of 8.9-12.4, substantially improving over the evaluated baselines. These results demonstrate effective continuous personality control while maintaining natural conversational behavior.

AI.tldr: FATE-5：两阶段框架，将大五人格的连续软提示编码与自然度偏好对齐解耦，在保持强特质表达的同时显著提升对话自然度。
AI.motivation: 在对话智能体中按用户与场景定制人格很重要，但现有人格控制方法难以兼顾"强特质表达"与"自然对话生成"，二者存在权衡。
AI.method: 两阶段：(1) 用对话监督加辅助问卷目标，学习大五人格画像的连续软提示表示；(2) 基于对话质量与人格一致性的偏好对齐，提升对话自然度。在三种语言模型骨干上验证。
AI.result: 相较其他"强特质"方法，自然度显著更高且特质表达依旧强；在留出问卷上单调性相关系数达0.97–0.99，人格恢复RMSE为8.9–12.4，明显优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了有效且连续的细粒度人格控制，同时保持自然对话行为，缓解了特质强度与自然度的权衡。

title: Offline Language-Based Support System for Tactical Decision-Making in Air Combat Operations
comment: Accepted at the LatinX in AI Workshop @ NeurIPS 2025. 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables
summary: An offline language-based support tool is presented to assist pilot training and tactical decision-making in air combat operations. The system, named MATE (Mission Assistant for Training and Evaluation), applies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to answer natural language questions using content extracted from doctrinal and tactical manuals. Built entirely with open-source components, it performs text preprocessing, embedding generation, semantic search, and language generation locally, ensuring full offline functionality. The tool was evaluated by three Brazilian Air Force fighter pilots, who rated the answers produced with three open-weight language models (Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 14B, and Mistral NeMo 12B) to five tactical questions derived from a publicly available air combat manual. Average ratings ranged from 4.00 to 4.40 on a five-point scale, with Mistral NeMo 12B obtaining the highest score, and the pilots rated the response time of the tool as fully adequate compared to manual search. The relevance of the retrieved content was identified as the main point for improvement. Potential applications are discussed in onboard mission systems, flight simulators, and training environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MATE——一个全离线、基于RAG的语言支持工具，用本地开源组件从条令与战术手册中检索并回答问题，以辅助飞行员训练与空战战术决策；三名飞行员对三种开放权重模型的回答评分均值为4.00–4.40（5分制）。
AI.motivation: 飞行员在训练与空战战术决策中需要快速查阅条令和战术手册，人工检索效率低；且机载/训练环境常无网络，需保证离线可用与数据不出本地。
AI.method: 构建MATE（Mission Assistant for Training and Evaluation）系统，采用检索增强生成（RAG）流程：文本预处理、向量嵌入生成、语义检索与语言生成，全部由开源组件在本地完成；随后由3名巴西空军战斗机飞行员针对5个取自公开空战手册的战术问题，对Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen 2.5 14B、Mistral NeMo 12B三种开放权重模型的回答进行5分制评分，并评价响应时间。
AI.result: 平均评分为4.00–4.40（5分制），其中Mistral NeMo 12B得分最高；飞行员认为相比人工查阅手册，工具响应时间完全可接受；检索内容的相关性被认定为最主要的改进方向。
AI.conclusion: 全离线RAG方案在航空战术知识问答中具备可行性并获领域专家正面评价，后续应重点优化检索相关性；该工具可应用于机载任务系统、飞行模拟器与训练环境。

title: Does the Voynich Manuscript Mean Anything? Calibrated Tests Find Little Trace of Language
summary: The Voynich manuscript is a fifteenth-century book in a script that no one can read. One account holds that its text means nothing and that a scribe made it by copying his own words and changing them a little. The other holds that a real language lies hidden behind a cipher. We write each account as a program that fills the pages of the manuscript, fit every program with the same budget, and check it on statistics the fit never saw. The copying process of Timm and Schinner predicts these statistics far better than any cipher with one key. But ciphers that switch keys between the manuscript's two dialects, or that encode only the word classes of a real text, predict them equally well. Word statistics alone cannot decide. We look for a trace of language that needs no decipherment. In 28 texts in 16 languages the same word pairs keep sharing a line. The manuscript shows this pattern at half the strength of the weakest of these texts. A word code keeps the pattern above the manuscript unless its plaintext has a weak pattern or many words are miscopied. Solvers that decipher control texts find no readable text in the manuscript under a letter cipher, a word code or 28 codes with one letter, letter pair or syllable per word. Word codes of abbreviated Latin, the plaintext their fits prefer, show which word follows which more clearly than the manuscript unless two words in five are miscopied. One cipher remains possible, a nomenclator with a second key whose scribe miscopies more than half of the words, and our solvers cannot exclude it in 9 of 16 languages. Most of the structure a solver finds comes from how the end of one word shapes the start of the next, which reflects how tightly glyphs are bound to each other. Planted messages are found reliably only when they are long, each letter always becomes the same word and these words are adjacent, so other messages could hide.

AI.tldr: 本文把伏尼契手稿的两种解释（无意义抄写 vs. 密码隐藏真实语言）都写成生成程序，在同等预算下拟合，并用未见统计量检验；结论是词级统计无法判定，只有"词序/语言痕迹"分析略偏向无意义抄写，但无法排除极端误抄的命名符密码。
AI.motivation: 伏尼契手稿的文字至今无人能读，学界存在两派对立观点：一派认为文本无意义、是抄写者自我复制并稍加改动而成；另一派认为真实语言被密码隐藏。现有研究多依赖词频统计，缺乏统一、可比较的检验框架，作者希望用可计算的生成模型配合样本外统计检验，来客观比较两类假设。
AI.method: 将两种解释各自实现为生成程序（Timm–Schinner 的复制过程；以及单密钥密码、双方言切换密钥密码、仅编码词类/词码等），在相同预算下拟合并用拟合时未见过的统计量检验；随后寻找无需破译的语言痕迹（跨语言的"同词对共行"模式），并用破译器对对照文本与手稿做解译测试（字母密码、词码、28种以字母/字母对/音节映射为词的码）。
AI.result: Timm–Schinner 复制过程对手稿未见统计量的预测远优于任何单密钥密码；但在两种方言间切换密钥的密码、或仅编码词类的密码，预测效果同样好——词统计本身无法裁决。在16种语言28篇文本中，稳定的同词对共行模式在手稿中仅达到最弱对照文本的一半强度。词码在多数设定下能保留高于手稿的该模式，除非明文本身模式弱或大量词误抄。破译者未能在手稿中找到可读文本；缩写拉丁语的词码（其拟合最偏好的明文）在词序可辨性上仍优于手稿，除非约五分之二的词被误抄。唯一无法排除的是带第二密钥、且误抄超过一半词的命名符密码（在16种语言中有9种无法排除）。
AI.conclusion: 词级统计不足以判定手稿性质；语言痕迹（词对共行、词序结构）在手稿中约只有对照语言的一半强度，多数证据倾向于"无意义抄写"解释，而"极强误抄的命名符密码"仍是唯一无法排除的替代方案。此外，解译器仅在同码、相邻、长消息的植入场景下可靠，说明其他隐藏消息仍可能躲过检测。

title: MANTIS: Multi-Axis News Transformations for Instance-Wise Stress Testing and Worst-Case Training in Fake News Detection
summary: Automated fake news detection is vital on social media, where fake news is easily rewritten to fool detectors. However, existing approaches typically rely on superficial writing cues or single-style text rewrites, resulting in poor robustness under diverse cosmetic modifications. We construct MANTIS-Bench, a multi-axis presentation-attack benchmark that pairs original news with rewritten views across writing style, emotional expression, and dissemination framing. We further propose MANTIS, an instance-adaptive adversarial framework enabling dynamic worst-case training tailored to each news article with zero inference-time overhead. This reframes fake news defense from heuristic format smoothing into targeted, fact-invariant credibility assessment. Experiments on MANTIS-Bench show that MANTIS reduces the Union Attack Success Rate (UASR) by 3.55 percentage points relative to SheepDog on GossipCop and consistently outperforms prior single-axis defenses on Macro-F1 while maintaining competitive clean accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-axis and instance-adaptive worst-case training.

AI.tldr: 提出多轴呈现攻击基准 MANTIS-Bench 与实例自适应对抗框架 MANTIS，实现无推理开销的动态最坏情况训练，提升假新闻检测在多种改写下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有假新闻检测依赖表层写作线索或单一风格改写，面对多样化的"整容式"修改时鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 构建跨写作风格、情感表达、传播框架三个维度的呈现攻击基准 MANTIS-Bench（原始新闻与改写视图配对）；提出 MANTIS 实例自适应对抗框架，针对每篇文章定制动态最坏情况训练，推理阶段零额外开销；将防御从启发式格式平滑重构为面向事实不变性的可信度评估。
AI.result: 在 MANTIS-Bench 上，MANTIS 相对 SheepDog 在 GossipCop 上将联合攻击成功率（UASR）降低 3.55 个百分点，Macro-F1 持续优于既有单轴防御方法，同时保持有竞争力的干净准确率。
AI.conclusion: 多轴与实例自适应的最坏情况训练能有效提升假新闻检测对抗多样化改写攻击的鲁棒性。

title: Semantic Atoms for Scalable Text Analysis in Data Analytics in the Era of LLM-Based Agents
summary: Much of the information needed for data analysis is buried in text columns: an analyst may infer customer frustration from complaint text and use it to explain resolution time. We call workloads in which processing text columns is central to subsequent data analysis TADA (\emph{Text Analysis in Data Analytics}). In an agentic setting, the user's query dynamically specifies this processing, and answering it interleaves LLM-based semantic steps with exact SQL or Python operations. This mixed execution raises two design questions: which work should be neural and which symbolic, and which semantic outputs later steps can reuse. We address them for agent-planned TADA workflows with two complementary, query-driven semantic atoms. Each atom takes a sequence of text items and a natural-language query specifying the semantic task: \textbf{Tagging} returns one string per input item, while \textbf{Categorization} returns $M$ category objects over $N$ input items. Tagging results are materialized as a row-aligned column and Categorization results as a category table; SQL or Python then performs exact computation over this exposed state. We realize this interface in TADA-Agent, whose atoms run inside generated Python programs and internally handle inputs beyond a reliable context window. We evaluate TADA-Agent on TABench, a benchmark of 40 complete analysis requests over spreadsheet tables spanning workflow composition, input--output structure, and literature-grounded analytical scenarios. Against a semantic-operator baseline and relative to a held-out TADA reference run, TADA-Agent delivers comparable row-level semantic quality, has higher complete-artifact preservation estimates, and uses over an order of magnitude fewer semantic-model requests under the evaluated native execution paths.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TADA（Text Analysis in Data Analytics）问题，并设计两个查询驱动的语义原子 Tagging 与 Categorization，在 TADA-Agent 中实现神经-符号混合执行，并构建 TABench 基准进行评估。
AI.motivation: 数据分析所需信息大量隐藏在文本列中，智能体需按用户查询动态地交错执行 LLM 语义步骤与精确的 SQL/Python 运算，由此产生两个设计问题：哪些工作应由神经网络完成、哪些应由符号运算完成，以及哪些语义输出可被后续步骤复用。
AI.method: 提出两个互补的、查询驱动的语义原子：Tagging 对每个输入文本项返回一个字符串；Categorization 在 N 个输入项上返回 M 个类别对象。Tagging 结果物化为按行对齐的列，Categorization 结果物化为类别表，再由 SQL/Python 在暴露状态上做精确计算。该接口在 TADA-Agent 中实现，原子运行于生成的 Python 程序内，并在内部处理超出可靠上下文窗口的输入。构建 TABench 基准，包含 40 个针对电子表格表格的完整分析请求，覆盖工作流组合、输入-输出结构和有文献依据的分析场景。
AI.result: 与语义算子基线相比，并相对留出的 TADA 参考运行，TADA-Agent 的行级语义质量相当，完整工件保存估计更高，且在所评估的原生执行路径下所需语义模型请求数少一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 以查询驱动的语义原子作为神经-符号边界，可同时兼顾语义质量、结果可复用性与执行效率，为智能体规划的数据分析型文本处理提供可行范式。

title: Style over Substance? Linguistic Bias in LLM-based Peer Review Copy title
summary: The number of paper submissions to major AI conferences has increased dramatically in recent years, substantially increasing the peer-review workload of researchers. At the same time, large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support peer review, both by individual reviewers and by conference organizations. While LLM capabilities have improved considerably, their evaluations may be influenced by linguistic characteristics that are unrelated to scientific content. In this work, we introduce a controlled experimental framework for studying such effects by systematically perturbing the linguistic style of research papers. Specifically, we rewrite papers to exhibit (i) linguistic features associated with native or non-native English writing, and (ii) high- or low-confidence linguistic features. To construct these interventions, we derive fine-grained rewriting instructions grounded in the linguistic literature and apply them using LLMs. Crucially, our interventions are designed to preserve the underlying scientific content. We then evaluate the resulting papers using different LLM reviewers. Our experiments expose a critical vulnerability in LLM-based peer review: reviewers systematically reward confident rhetoric independent of scientific content, raising serious concerns about the robustness of their assessments.

AI.tldr: 提出受控扰动实验框架，系统改写论文的语言风格（母语/非母语英语特征、高/低自信修辞）而保持科学内容不变，发现LLM审稿人会系统性地奖励自信修辞。
AI.motivation: AI会议投稿量激增导致审稿负担加重，LLM被广泛用于辅助同行评审；但LLM评审可能受与科学内容无关的语言特征影响，其评估稳健性存疑，需要可控实验加以检验。
AI.method: 构建受控实验框架：基于语言学文献制定细粒度改写指令，用LLM对论文进行风格改写，注入(i)母语/非母语英语写作特征、(ii)高/低自信语言特征，同时确保科学内容不变；再用多个不同的LLM审稿人对改写后论文进行评估。
AI.result: 实验揭示LLM同行评审的关键脆弱性：审稿人会系统性地奖励自信修辞，且该效应独立于科学内容本身。
AI.conclusion: LLM评审对语言风格（尤其是自信程度）敏感，其评估稳健性存在严重问题，对将LLM用于同行评审的实践提出警示。

title: Do Language Models Understand Igbo Culture? Beyond Multiple Choice
summary: The value of language models for any community depends on whether a model actually understands the culture of the people it intends to serve. We use the Igbo language as a case study. Existing benchmarks test translated Western ideas, lacking depth. To address this, we introduce CAB-Igbo, a benchmark developed from indigenous cultural sources and verified by native speakers across six domains. We evaluated diverse models under varying conditions, incorporating regional personas. Performance was assessed using multiple-choice accuracy and human evaluations across Epistemic Fidelity, Representational Richness, Linguistic Quality, and Pragmatic Proficiency. Results reveal a stark dissociation between language fluency and cultural knowledge. Through statistical testing, we show that for most models, the severe lack of Epistemic Fidelity and Representational Richness is already present in English and does not significantly worsen when switching to Igbo. Instead, native language prompting mainly degrades Linguistic Quality and Pragmatic Proficiency. Gemini 2.0 Flash is the only model whose cultural knowledge scores improve under Igbo prompting. We find that current models struggle to demonstrate the knowledge needed for true alignment with Igbo, and multiple-choice formats allow pattern-matching to appear as understanding. Furthermore, automated judges agree with humans on linguistic quality but fail on epistemic fidelity. Ultimately, cultural evaluation must be built from community knowledge, establishing human evaluation as the gold standard to prevent misrepresenting low-resource communities globally.

AI.tldr: 提出CAB-Igbo基准（源自伊博本土文化资料、经母语者校验、覆盖六大领域），在多种条件下评估多模型，发现语言流利度与文化知识严重脱节：多数模型在英语下已存在认知忠实度与表征丰富度缺陷，切换伊博语主要损害语言质量与语用能力；多选题格式易使模式匹配伪装成理解；自动评判在语言质量上与人类一致但在认知忠实度上失效。
AI.motivation: 语言模型对某社群的价值取决于其是否真正理解该社群文化。现有基准多为翻译的西方观念，缺乏文化深度，无法有效衡量对低资源语言社群（如伊博语）的文化理解。
AI.method: 构建CAB-Igbo基准：取材于本土文化原始资料，由母语者验证，覆盖六个领域；在多模型、多提示条件（含区域人格设定）下测试，采用多选题准确率与人工评估（认知忠实度、表征丰富度、语言质量、语用熟练度）双重指标，并进行统计检验与自动评判对照。
AI.result: 语言流利度与文化知识显著分离；多数模型的认知忠实度与表征丰富度缺陷在英语即已存在，切至伊博语后未显著恶化，母语提示主要降低语言质量与语用熟练度；仅Gemini 2.0 Flash在伊博语提示下文化知识得分提升；多选题可被模式匹配利用；自动评判与人类在语言质量上一致、在认知忠实度上不一致。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型难以体现与伊博文化真正对齐所需的知识；文化评估须基于社群知识构建，并以人工评估为金标准，以避免对全球低资源社群造成误表征。

title: CalibraRL: Confidence-Calibrated Reinforcement Learning for Mitigating Hallucinations in RAG
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often produce plausible but incorrect answers, motivating reinforcement learning methods that reward correct answers, penalize incorrect answers, and allow abstention. However, fixed outcome-based rewards do not distinguish incorrect responses with different confidence levels or account for differences in answering reliability across queries. Consequently, such rewards may inadequately penalize overconfident errors and fail to discourage unnecessary abstention. We propose CalibraRL, a reinforcement learning framework that incorporates response confidence and query-level answering evidence into reward design. For non-abstaining responses, CalibraRL combines correctness-based utility with a Brier-based penalty that encourages agreement between confidence and correctness. For abstentions, it estimates conditional answering reliability using a Beta posterior derived from the correctness of non-abstaining responses within each sampled group. The abstention reward increases with the posterior probability that the model's accuracy on non-abstaining responses is below a predefined threshold. CalibraRL reuses training rollouts without requiring additional annotations indicating whether the model knows the answer to each question. Experiments on three QA datasets demonstrate that CalibraRL improves answer precision and reduces hallucinations compared with strong baselines. Further analysis shows that CalibraRL reduces mean expected calibration error (ECE) by 30.8\% across two backbone models and three datasets, highlighting its potential to improve the reliability of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in web search.

AI.tldr: CalibraRL：将回答置信度与查询级可靠性证据引入强化学习奖励设计，抑制过度自信错误与不必要弃答，提升精度并降低幻觉与ECE。
AI.motivation: LLM常给出貌似合理但错误的答案。现有基于结果正确性的RL奖励无法区分不同置信水平的错误，也不考虑不同查询的作答可靠性差异，因而对"高置信错误"惩罚不足，且无法抑制不必要的弃答（abstention）。
AI.method: 提出CalibraRL强化学习框架。对非弃答回答，将基于正确性的效用与Brier型惩罚结合，促使置信度与正确性一致；对弃答，利用同一采样组内非弃答回答的正确性构造Beta后验，估计条件作答可靠性，弃答奖励随"模型非弃答准确率低于预设阈值"的后验概率增大而增加。方法复用训练rollout，无需额外的"模型是否知道答案"标注。
AI.result: 在三个QA数据集上，相较强基线提升了答案精度并减少幻觉；进一步分析显示，在两个骨干模型、三个数据集上平均ECE降低30.8%，体现其在提升检索增强生成（RAG）可靠性方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 将置信度校准与组内经验可靠性估计纳入RL奖励，可在无需额外标注的情况下同时改善正确性、抑制幻觉并提升校准质量，为可靠RAG提供可行路径。

title: STEP: Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction Correctness via Per-Step Probability Scoring
comment: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP (UncertaiNLP 2026) at EMNLP 2026
summary: Estimating the correctness of large language model (LLM) predictions without access to ground truth is critical for reliable deployment in high-stakes settings. Existing approaches, such as entropy and perplexity, operate solely on final output statistics, discarding the rich information encoded in intermediate reasoning steps. To address this limitation, we propose STEP (Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction correctness), a training-free framework that scores each reasoning step via lightweight forward passes to obtain a soft probability distribution qi over candidate answers, from which we derive a set of soft trajectory features capturing per-step confidence and its progression toward the final answer. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements, particularly in AUROC, over output-based baselines and hard-indicator trajectory methods. Notably, Temporally-Weighted Consistency, which assigns higher importance to later reasoning steps where answer distributions have stabilized, contributes the largest gains, highlighting the importance of temporal structure in reasoning trajectories. These results further validate the advantage of preserving continuous probability signals over binary discretization.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的STEP框架，通过对每个推理步骤做轻量前向传播获得候选答案的软概率分布，提取软轨迹特征来估计LLM预测正确性，在AUROC等指标上显著优于输出级基线与硬指标轨迹方法。
AI.motivation: 在无真值条件下估计LLM预测的正确性对高风险场景部署至关重要，但熵、困惑度等现有方法仅利用最终输出的统计量，丢弃了中间推理步骤中的丰富信息。
AI.method: STEP（Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction correctness）为免训练框架：对每个推理步骤执行轻量前向传播，得到候选答案上的软概率分布q_i，并由此导出刻画逐步置信度及其向最终答案演进过程的软轨迹特征；其中时间加权一致性（Temporally-Weighted Consistency）对答案分布已趋稳定的靠后步骤赋予更高权重。
AI.result: 在多个基准上实验，相较输出级基线与硬指标轨迹方法取得一致且显著的提升，尤其在AUROC上；时间加权一致性带来最大增益。
AI.conclusion: 推理轨迹中的时间结构对正确性估计十分重要，保留连续概率信号优于二值离散化。

title: EdgeDeID: A 0.6B Clinical De-identifier Trained Without Real Patient Data
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Under review at ACL Rolling Review (ARR). Code: https://github.com/BardiaKh/EdgeDeID ; models and data: https://huggingface.co/EdgeDeID
summary: De-identifying clinical notes with a hosted language model discloses the information the step is meant to protect. We present EdgeDeID, a 0.6B-parameter decoder-only de-identifier that runs locally and is trained without real patient text: three LLM teachers write synthetic notes, a single labeler re-annotates them into one convention, and the model learns to emit a typed XML schema of the identifiers it finds. On a 100-note synthetic in-domain benchmark with manually verified annotations it reaches 0.994 micro-F1 and leaves no missed identifier in 99% of notes, against 0.857 and 12% for the strongest of eight off-the-shelf systems. Quantized, it runs on CPU in 615 MB. Of three additions to supervised training, only a verifier adapter helps: it separates complete from incomplete outputs of other systems at 0.94 AUROC, whereas reinforcement learning with a recall-weighted reward and a rule-based post-processing layer leave in-domain results unchanged. On MIMIC ICU nursing notes F1 falls to 0.48. The errors follow two properties our synthetic notes lack, telegraphic style and low identifier density, and three hand-written in-context examples recover 0.08 F1 without annotated target data.

AI.tldr: 提出EdgeDeID：一个0.6B参数、本地运行、完全不使用真实患者文本训练的临床笔记去标识化模型。三个LLM教师生成合成笔记，单一标注器统一重标注，模型学习输出标识符的类型化XML模式。在100条合成域内基准上达0.994 micro-F1，99%的笔记无漏检；量化后615MB可在CPU运行。在MIMIC ICU护理笔记上F1降至0.48，错误源于合成笔记缺失的电报式文风与低标识符密度，加入三条手写上下文示例可在无目标标注数据下恢复0.08 F1。
AI.motivation: 将临床笔记送至托管语言模型做去标识化，本身就会泄露该步骤本应保护的信息；同时真实患者文本难以获取用于训练。因此需要可在本地部署、且不依赖真实患者数据训练的去标识化方案。
AI.method: 0.6B decoder-only模型，纯合成数据训练：三个LLM教师撰写合成临床笔记，由单一标注器统一重标注为同一规范，模型学习输出其识别到的标识符的类型化XML schema。另尝试三种在监督训练之上的增强：验证器适配器、召回加权奖励的强化学习、基于规则的后处理。
AI.result: 合成域内100条人工核验基准上micro-F1 0.994，99%笔记无漏检标识符；八个现成系统中最强者为0.857与12%。量化后615MB、可CPU运行。三种增强中仅验证器适配器有效，对区分其他系统的完整/不完整输出达0.94 AUROC；强化学习与规则后处理在域内无提升。MIMIC ICU护理笔记F1为0.48。
AI.conclusion: 小型本地模型在高保真合成数据上可显著超越现成系统，但存在显著域偏移（合成→真实护理笔记），其根源为电报式文风与低标识符密度两类分布差异；少量手写上下文示例即可部分弥补，且无需目标域标注数据。

title: One Model, Two Paths: Balancing Single-Pass and Looped Performance in Language Models
summary: Repeating Transformer layers can improve language-model performance without adding parameters. A pretrained model can be adapted to support both single-pass and looped inference by reusing middle-layer weights for additional computation. Because both paths share weights, training to improve looped predictions can degrade single-pass quality. We study joint training strategies using weighted losses on both outputs, with guidance from the frozen original model. Joint supervision substantially reduces single-pass degradation compared to looped-only training, while preserving looped gains over ordinary continued training. Most of this benefit comes from adjusting the single-pass loss weight, with guidance from the frozen original model further improving the looped output. With validation-selected weights, our method preserves single-pass quality within a predefined tolerance of ordinary continued training while improving looped predictions.

AI.tldr: 通过加权联合损失（单次推理+循环推理）并引入冻结原模型作为引导，可在保持单次推理质量的前提下提升循环推理的预测效果。
AI.motivation: 重复Transformer层可在不增加参数的情况下提升语言模型性能，但共享权重会导致"提升循环预测"与"保持单次推理质量"之间的冲突，循环训练易损害单次推理表现。
AI.method: 研究联合训练策略：对单次与循环两种输出分别施加加权损失，并以冻结的原始预训练模型作为引导（guidance）；重点考察单次损失权重调节与冻结模型引导的作用。
AI.result: 联合监督相比仅循环训练显著减轻单次推理性能退化，同时保留相对普通持续训练（continued training）的循环增益；收益主要来自调整单次损失权重，冻结原模型引导进一步改善循环输出；经验证集选择的权重可使单次质量保持在预设容差范围内。
AI.conclusion: 加权联合训练配合冻结模型引导是一种有效方法，可在预设容差内保持单次推理质量，同时提升循环推理预测，实现单次与循环推理的良好平衡。

title: Towards a Learnable Retriever for Textual Graph Question Answering
summary: Textual graph question answering (GraphQA) and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) have gained increasing attention as a way to ground large language models (LLMs) on structured knowledge. Despite extensive efforts, existing methods still face two key gaps. The first is an architectural gap: existing methods typically fine-tune an LLM-based generator, but do not also make the retriever itself a learnable LLM for graph evidence selection within one end-to-end retrieve-then-generate pipeline. The second is a retrieval-supervision gap: existing retrievers rarely use gold answer signals to supervise evidence selection. As a result, they may fail to recall evidence nodes required for reasoning, resulting in insufficient coverage of the gold answer set; meanwhile, naive attempts to boost recall often introduce excessive irrelevant information that compromises compactness and overwhelms the LLM. To address these gaps, we propose TaLenT, an LLM-based end-to-end retriever-generator framework for textual GraphQA. To bridge the architectural gap, TaLenT pairs a learnable LLM-based retriever for evidence selection with a fine-tuned LLM-based generator within one unified retrieve-then-generate pipeline. To bridge the retrieval-supervision gap, we leverage gold answer signals as retriever supervision. Specifically, we stratify graph nodes into gold answers, answer-related nodes, and irrelevant noise. We then adopt a weighted pseudo-label loss to prioritize gold answers and preserve answer-related nodes for coverage, while discarding irrelevant noise for compactness. Experimental results across three GraphQA datasets demonstrate that TaLenT consistently improves downstream performance.

AI.tldr: TaLenT：将检索器本身也设计为可学习的LLM，并用金标准答案信号做加权伪标签监督，在统一端到端 retrieve-then-generate 框架中提升文本图问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 GraphQA/GraphRAG 方法存在两处不足：一是架构缺口，通常只微调LLM生成器，未把检索器本身也做成可学习LLM并在单一端到端流程中完成图证据选择；二是检索监督缺口，检索器很少利用金标准答案信号监督证据选择，导致推理所需证据节点召回不足、金标准答案集覆盖不够，而单纯提高召回又会引入大量无关信息，破坏紧凑性并加重LLM负担。
AI.method: 提出 TaLenT 框架：架构上，将可学习的LLM检索器（用于证据选择）与微调的LLM生成器配对，构成统一的 retrieve-then-generate 流水线；监督上，以金标准答案信号监督检索器，将图节点分层为金标准答案、答案相关节点和无关噪声，并采用加权伪标签损失，优先金标准答案、保留答案相关节点以保障覆盖，同时丢弃无关噪声以保持紧凑。
AI.result: 在三个 GraphQA 数据集上的实验表明，TaLenT 能稳定提升下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时弥补架构缺口与检索监督缺口，将可学习LLM检索器与微调生成器端到端结合并用答案信号加权监督，可在保证检索紧凑性的同时提升证据覆盖与最终问答效果。

title: Incremental Predictive Value of LLM Tutoring Interactions for Student Performance
summary: We evaluate whether semester-level interaction features from a large language model tutor improve assignment-score prediction beyond constant baselines. StudyChat provides 16,851 student-assistant exchanges from two offerings of an undergraduate artificial intelligence course, with outcomes matched to 175 of 203 student-semester records. Six fitted estimators and training-fold mean and median baselines share repeated nested cross-validation. After averaging each student's held-out predictions across ten repeats, Gradient Boosting achieves mean absolute error of 3.023 grade points, versus 3.138 for the median baseline. The paired difference is -0.114, with a conditional 95% bootstrap interval of [-0.245,0.013]. Representation changes and a semester-specific median yield similarly small gains. In the lowest observed-score quartile, however, boosting's error is 7.30 points, versus 8.07 for the median and 6.67 for the mean; Ridge has the lowest fitted-model error at 6.37 despite its worse overall error of 3.331. Scores concentrate near the ceiling: 160 students (91.4%) score above 90, and the lowest quartile contributes 62.1% of boosting's total absolute error. This retrospective comparison shows how baseline choice and error distribution affect predictive value, informing evaluation of student-support tools without establishing a learning effect.

AI.tldr: 本文评估LLM导师的学期级交互特征能否在常数基线之上提升作业分数预测。在16,851条学生-助手对话、175条学生-学期记录上，Gradient Boosting的MAE为3.023，优于中位数基线3.138，但配对差异的95% bootstrap区间为[-0.245, 0.013]，未达显著。
AI.motivation: 检验基于LLM导师交互数据构建的学期级特征是否具有超越简单常数基线的预测价值，并强调基线选择与误差分布对"预测有效性"判断的影响；同时明确该回溯性比较不能确立学习效应。
AI.method: 使用StudyChat数据集（某本科人工智能课程两学期、16,851条学生-助手交互，203条记录中175条匹配到成绩）。采用重复嵌套交叉验证，比较6个拟合估计器与训练折均值、中位数基线；对每名学生10次重复的留出预测取平均后计算MAE，并用条件bootstrap估计配对差异区间；辅以表示变更与学期特定中位数基线。
AI.result: Gradient Boosting整体MAE为3.023分，中位数基线为3.138分，配对差异-0.114，95%条件bootstrap区间[-0.245, 0.013]；表示变更与学期特定中位数带来类似微小增益。最低分位组中，boosting误差7.30、中位数8.07、均值6.67；Ridge在该组拟合模型误差最低（6.37），但整体MAE较差（3.331）。分数集中于上限：160人（91.4%）高于90分，最低四分位贡献了boosting总绝对误差的62.1%。
AI.conclusion: LLM交互特征相对常数基线仅带来小幅、统计上不稳健的预测增益；基线选择与误差分布（天花板效应、误差集中于低分尾部）显著影响结论。该回溯性比较可用于指导学生支持工具的评估设计，但不构成学习效应的证据。

title: How Does Post-Training Shape LLM Value Preferences?
summary: During post-training, large language models (LLMs) learn value preferences from corpora that may contain imbalanced proportions of opinions associated with different demographic groups. Amplifying these imbalances may further underrepresent some groups' opinions. However, how opinion mixtures shape value preferences across post-training paths remains unclear. To answer this question, we conduct controlled experiments using post-training corpora with different opinion mixtures and five post-training paths based on SFT, DPO, and GRPO. We find that post-training amplifies opinion imbalances differently across post-training paths. Once value preferences are amplified, whether further post-training can remove them depends on both the post-training method and the opinion mixture in the corpus. More concerningly, a model's stability under interventions depends on whether further post-training changes its value preference. Moreover, these value preferences are transferred to student models even when distillation uses corpora with no explicit opinion questions. These findings suggest that both the opinion mixture in post-training corpora and the choice of post-training method should be considered when developing, evaluating, and reusing LLMs. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/ku-nlp/llm-value-preferences.

AI.tldr: 通过控制实验研究后训练语料中观点混合比例如何在SFT、DPO、GRPO等五条后训练路径上塑造大模型的价值偏好，发现后训练会放大观点失衡、偏好难以被后续训练消除、且会通过蒸馏迁移给学 生模型。
AI.motivation: 后训练语料中不同人群观点的比例本就不均衡，后训练可能进一步放大这种失衡并导致部分群体观点被更严重地欠表示；但观点混合比例如何沿不同后训练路径塑造价值偏好尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建具有不同观点混合比例的后训练语料，并设计基于SFT、DPO、GRPO的五条后训练路径，开展控制实验；随后施加进一步干预（继续后训练）考察偏好能否被消除，并检验蒸馏场景下的偏好迁移。
AI.result: 不同后训练路径对观点失衡的放大程度不同；已放大的价值偏好能否被后续后训练消除，取决于后训练方法与语料观点混合；模型在干预下的稳定性取决于后续后训练是否改变其价值偏好；即使蒸馏语料不含显式观点问题，价值偏好仍会迁移至学生模型。
AI.conclusion: 开发、评估与复用LLM时应同时考虑后训练语料中的观点混合比例与后训练方法的选择。

title: Reversible Pseudonymisation of Documents Sent to External LLMs: an Open Bilingual Benchmark and an Engine
comment: 22 pages, 9 tables. Code, data generator, held-out sets, pre-registrations, predictions and raw LLM answers: https://github.com/beskvladimir-create/pii-roundtrip (release v0.5.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23624098)
summary: Professionals send working documents to external large language models. A common safeguard is reversible pseudonymisation: personal data are replaced with placeholders before the request and restored locally in the answer. We present an open benchmark of five existing open tools and a regular-expression baseline on Russian and UK English, and an open engine built on the two strongest tools. The benchmark excludes each tool's own authors' dataset from its verdict, compares the engine with each tool on identical datasets for detection, reports masking precision, and tests on a held-out set of synthetic documents whose files, hashes, decision rules, run plan and stopping rule were published before any run. Two local LLMs test whether placeholders survive. All evaluation data are synthetic, and the benchmark was run by the author of the engine; code, data, predictions and raw answers are released. On external datasets no existing tool meets all predefined thresholds: in UK English the identifier and leak thresholds are not met, in Russian the identifier threshold is borderline. On the last held-out set of 1,000 documents per language, the best existing tools leave a whole value visible in 61% (Russian) and 58% (UK) of documents. On these documents, from the generator it was developed on, the engine does so in 0.3% [0.1; 0.9] and 0.2% [0.1; 0.7], leaves any part of a value visible in 0.8% and 0.2%, and meets all detection thresholds in both languages. In UK English it also restores at least 99% of its placeholders after 760 answers. In Russian it restores only 94.6% [93.6; 95.6] of name placeholders, against a 99% threshold, mainly because the inflection it borrows from pii-guard produces wrong surname forms. The engine was developed over six earlier held-out sets from the same generator; real documents were not tested.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向俄语与英式英语的可逆化名（假名化）开源基准，评测5个现有工具与1个正则基线；并构建一个基于最强的两个工具的开源引擎。结果显示现有工具在外部数据集上均未满足全部预设阈值（整值泄漏率达58%–61%），而新引擎在来自其开发所用生成器的文档上整值泄漏仅0.2%–0.3%，但俄语姓名占位符复原率仅94.6%，低于99%阈值。
AI.motivation: 专业人员常把工作文档发送给外部大语言模型，常用防护手段是"可逆化名"：请求前把个人数据替换为占位符，在返回答案中本地还原。但现有工具缺少统一的、可复现的评测基准，其检测与防泄漏能力、占位符在模型输出中的存活与还原能力都缺乏可靠证据，因此需要一个开放、预注册、可复现的基准来横向比较工具并指导引擎设计。
AI.method: 1) 构建开源基准：覆盖5个现有开源工具与1个正则表达式基线，语言为俄语和英式英语；2) 评测设计：在裁决时排除各工具自身作者的数据集，在相同数据集上对引擎与各工具逐一比较检测性能，报告掩蔽精确率；3) 预注册的留出测试：使用合成文档组成留出集，其文件、哈希、决策规则、运行计划与停止规则在任何运行前公开；4) 占位符存活测试：用两个本地LLM检验占位符是否在回答中留存；5) 引擎：基于表现最强的两个工具构建开源引擎，并进行检测阈值与还原率（760个答案）评估；6) 数据全部为合成数据，代码、数据、预测与原始回答开源。
AI.result: 外部数据集上无任何现有工具满足全部预设阈值：英式英语未达到标识符与泄漏阈值，俄语标识符阈值处于临界。在最后留出集（每语言1,000份文档）上，最佳现有工具使整个值可见的比例为俄语61%、英式英语58%；而引擎在其开发来源生成器的文档上分别为0.3% [0.1; 0.9] 与 0.2% [0.1; 0.7]，任一部分值可见为0.8%与0.2%，并在两种语言下满足全部检测阈值。英式英语在760个答案后仍能还原至少99%的占位符；俄语姓名占位符仅还原94.6% [93.6; 95.6]，低于99%阈值，主要原因是其借用的pii-guard词形变化规则生成了错误的姓氏形式。
AI.conclusion: 现有开源可逆化名工具在严格的预注册阈值下均不达标，整值泄漏率高达约六成，尚不足以支撑对外部LLM的安全使用。新引擎在检测与防泄漏上显著优于现有工具，但在俄语姓名还原上仍受词形变化（屈折）问题制约，且评测完全基于合成数据、由引擎作者自行执行、未测试真实文档，结论的外部有效性与独立性有限。

title: HerHealthGPT: An Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI System for Women's Reproductive Health Copy title
summary: "Why is my period late?" Sometimes, the most useful response begins with another question. Yet conversational AI systems may respond to incomplete health queries without seeking essential context or grounding their guidance in verifiable evidence. This paper introduces HerHealthGPT, an evidence-grounded conversational AI system designed to address these challenges in women's reproductive health. HerHealthGPT integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context-aware clarification, and source validation within an interactive web interface. Rather than responding immediately to incomplete queries, the system maintains conversational context, asks targeted follow-up questions, checks for premature conclusions, and grounds its responses in retrieved evidence. We evaluate the AI components using 540 English messages derived from 90 reproductive-health cases and conduct a prototype questionnaire study with 30 adults. Evidence retrieval improves concern-category accuracy from 54.1% to 59.3% compared with fine-tuning alone. The clarification router achieves 85.6% recall and 86.2% specificity on constructed targets. In the user study, 83.3% of participants preferred the retrieval-enabled configuration, while 25 of 30 considered its follow-up questions relevant. These findings suggest that integrating evidence retrieval with interactive clarification offers a promising approach to more transparent, context-aware reproductive-health information systems, while further clinical validation remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 HerHealthGPT——一个证据接地（evidence-grounded）的会话式AI系统，用于女性生殖健康问答，融合RAG、上下文感知澄清与来源校验，以缓解AI对不完整健康问题直接作答的风险。
AI.motivation: 会话式AI在面对不完整健康查询时常不做澄清即作答，既不获取必要上下文，也不以可验证证据支撑结论，存在误导风险；以“月经推迟”这类问题为代表，最有用的回答往往应先反问。
AI.method: 系统集成检索增强生成（RAG）、上下文感知澄清（clarification router，含追问与过早结论检测）与来源校验，并置于交互式Web界面。评估用540条来自90个生殖健康案例的英文消息做AI组件评测，并对30名成年人开展原型问卷用户研究；对比检索增强与仅微调的配置。
AI.result: 证据检索使关注类别（concern-category）准确率由54.1%提升至59.3%（对比仅微调）；澄清路由在构造目标上召回率85.6%、特异度86.2%；用户研究中83.3%偏好启用检索的配置，30人中有25人认为追问相关。
AI.conclusion: 将证据检索与交互式澄清结合，是构建更透明、上下文感知的生殖健康信息系统的一条有前景路径；但准确率提升幅度有限，仍需进一步临床验证。

title: Quality over Quantity: Rethinking Data and Model Assumptions for Bengali Coreference Resolution
comment: Accepted at KONVENS 2026, Hamburg, Germany. 11 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/zenith19/bengali-coref-low-resource
summary: Multilingual transformer models are often assumed to generalise across languages, but their effectiveness for coreference resolution in low-resource settings remains unverified. We investigate this gap in Bengali, a language with over 250 million speakers but limited annotated coreference resources. We evaluate transformer-based pre-trained encoders under multiple settings, including zero-shot, fine-tuning, data augmentation, and cross-lingual transfer. Our results challenge several common assumptions about model generalisation and data efficiency in low-resource NLP. We demonstrate that a small amount of high-quality annotated data significantly outperforms larger mixed-quality datasets (p < 0.01). We find that data augmentation, particularly back-translation, does not improve performance and can degrade results in coreference resolution. Cross-lingual transfer is also inconsistent: transfer from a distant language like English reduces performance, and transfer from the related language Hindi provides no consistent benefit across models. Several widely used multilingual models exhibit collapsed embedding spaces, rendering them unsuitable for similarity-based clustering tasks. These findings highlight the importance of annotation quality over data quantity and provide empirical guidance for developing coreference resolution systems in low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文在孟加拉语共指消解任务上系统评估基于Transformer的多语言编码器，发现高质量小规模标注数据优于大规模混合质量数据，数据增强（回译）无效甚至有害，跨语言迁移不稳定，且多个多语言模型嵌入空间塌缩。
AI.motivation: 多语言Transformer模型常被默认具备跨语言泛化能力，但其在低资源语言核心任务（共指消解）中的实际有效性缺乏验证；孟加拉语使用人口超2.5亿但标注共指资源稀缺，存在明显研究空白。
AI.method: 以孟加拉语共指消解为对象，在零样本、微调、数据增强、跨语言迁移等多种设置下评测Transformer预训练编码器；比较不同规模/质量标注数据的影响，检验回译等增强手段，考察英语（远距）与印地语（近缘）迁移效果，并分析多语言模型嵌入空间性质。
AI.result: 少量高质量标注数据显著优于更大规模混合质量数据（p < 0.01）；回译等数据增强未能提升甚至降低性能；跨语言迁移不一致——英语迁移导致性能下降，印地语迁移无稳定收益；若干常用多语言模型出现嵌入空间塌缩，无法胜任基于相似度的聚类任务。
AI.conclusion: 低资源共指消解中标注质量比数据数量更关键；对多语言模型跨语言泛化与数据效率的常见假设应被审慎对待，为低资源语言共指系统开发提供实证指导。

title: Ask Before You Answer: A Question-Driven Evidence Reasoning Architecture (QERA) for In-Context Learning
summary: AI assistants are increasingly asked to reason over a user's own web traces: group chats, community threads, activity logs and revision histories. On CL-bench Life, a benchmark of such real-life context learning, frontier LLMs solve fewer than one task in five. We find that the request is not the specification: over 80% of the benchmark's rubrics share less than 60% of their content words with the final request, as for a rule set two turns earlier or every record that meets the user's criterion, and LLMs answering directly pass only 67% of these implicit rubrics against 81% of the others. We propose QERA, a Question-driven Evidence Reasoning Architecture that asks before it answers. QERA first turns the request into a requirement checklist and typed information needs, filtered by code for faithfulness to the user's words; it then answers from the whole conversation, asks the same questions again with quotes verified by code, and applies a guarded local repair. It needs no training or rubrics and makes about four LLM calls per task. On all 405 tasks with four frontier LLMs, QERA attains the highest solving rate on every LLM (21.0% on average, against 18.2% for the strongest of three inference-time baselines and 14.6% for direct answering) and leads every baseline significantly when pooled across LLMs, while using fewer tokens than PSCI and 4-5% of the tokens of Ctx2Skill. Ablations on GPT-6-Luna show that the gain is settled before the answer, by a fixed answer protocol (+3.8 rubric points) and the request-specific questions (+1.6), and that it is concentrated on implicit rubrics, with checking afterwards refining mainly numeric requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出QERA(问题驱动证据推理架构)：先把用户请求转成需求清单与类型化信息需求(经代码校验忠实性)，再基于整段对话回答，随后用代码验证引用重新提问并做有约束的局部修复；无需训练或rubric，每任务约4次LLM调用。在CL-bench Life全部405个任务、4个前沿LLM上平均解决率21.0%(最强推理时基线18.2%，直接回答14.6%)，且显著领先，token消耗少于PSCI、仅为Ctx2Skill的4-5%。
AI.motivation: AI助手需在用户个人网络痕迹(群聊、社区帖、活动日志、修订历史)上推理，但前沿LLM在CL-bench Life上解决率不足1/5。作者指出关键错配："请求≠规格"——超过80%的评分细则(rubric)与最终请求的内容词重合度低于60%(如两轮前的规则集、满足条件的全部记录)，LLM直接作答在这类隐式rubric上通过率67%，而显式rubric为81%。
AI.method: QERA四阶段：(1)将请求转化为需求清单+类型化信息需求，并用代码按忠实性过滤(贴合用户原话)；(2)基于完整对话作答；(3)以代码校验引用的方式重问同一组问题；(4)守卫式局部修复(guarded local repair)。无训练、无rubric，约4次LLM调用/任务。
AI.result: 405个任务×4个前沿LLM：QERA在每个LLM上均取得最高解决率，平均21.0%，对比三种推理时最强基线18.2%、直接作答14.6%；跨LLM汇总后显著领先所有基线；token用量低于PSCI，约为Ctx2Skill的4-5%。GPT-6-Luna消融：收益在作答前已确定——固定作答协议+3.8 rubric点，请求特定问题+1.6点；收益集中于隐式rubric，事后检查主要改进数值型需求。
AI.conclusion: 缺陷主要源于"请求未显式化需求"，而非推理能力不足；以问题驱动的显式需求提取(前置)比事后自我检查更有效，且几乎零训练成本。局限：绝对解决率仍约21%，任务本身极难；"GPT-6-Luna"等前沿模型命名需核实。

title: What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing, Reliability, Rarely Reach
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables. Project page: https://shanyang.me/what-outcome-rl-buys/ Code: https://github.com/shanyang-me/outcome-rl-buys
summary: Outcome RL raises pass@1 but not pass@k at large k (Yue et al., 2025). But every pass@1 is scored under a token budget. Every recipe also trains under one. On physics and math problems at fixed token budgets, we compare the pass@1 of 20 released RL models (1.5B to 32B) with that of the thinking models they started from. We ask whether each pass@1 gain is changed behaviour or new knowledge. We divide each change in pass@1 into three parts. Finishing measures answering before the budget runs out. Reliability measures being right once finished. Reach measures problems RL solves that its base answered wrongly in all eight tries, minus problems the base solves that RL answered wrongly in all eight. We find four things. (1) Where the base often hits the token budget before answering, most of the change, gain or loss, is finishing (82% at 4k and 8k). Given more tokens, the base closes most of the finishing gap itself. (2) Where the base has enough tokens, the gain is reliability: the RL model is graded right more often, even on problems both finish. (3) By our definition, RL rarely solves what its base cannot. Reach adds at most 2.1 percentage points on any of our four physics and math sets. We checked 144 physics problems that only the RL model solved. Of these, 3.5% hold up when resampled or read. In a random sample, nine of ten new RL steps a human confirmed also appear in the base's samples. (4) In a small-scale RL run on an 8B model, the gain on new problems is finishing, with reliability flat. Supplying each problem's physical setup was not shown to improve on plain RL.

AI.tldr: 在固定token预算下对比20个RL模型与其基座思考模型，将pass@1变化分解为"完成度、可靠性、触达"三部分，发现RL提升主要来自更早作答与更稳定的正确率，而非获得新知识。
AI.motivation: 既有观察显示outcome RL提升pass@1却不提升大k的pass@k，怀疑RL只是改变行为而非获得新能力；而pass@1本身受token预算约束，既有评测与训练预算不一致，因此需要在固定预算下厘清pass@1增益的来源。
AI.method: 在物理与数学题上、固定token预算下，比较20个已发布RL模型（1.5B–32B）与其起始思考模型的pass@1；将pass@1变化分解为三个成分：Finishing（预算耗尽前完成作答的比例）、Reliability（完成后作答正确的比例）、Reach（RL解对而基座8次全错的题目数减去基座解对而RL 8次全错的题目数）；并对仅RL解出的题目进行重采样与人工核对，另做8B模型的小规模RL运行验证。
AI.result: (1) 基座常因预算耗尽未作答时，增益或损失的82%（4k与8k预算）来自Finishing，给予更多token后基座可自行弥补大部分差距；(2) 基座预算充足时增益主要来自Reliability，即两模型都完成的题目上RL判对率更高；(3) Reach至多在四个数理集合上增加2.1个百分点；144道仅RL解出的物理题中仅3.5%在重采样或人工阅读后成立，随机样本中人工确认的10个"新"RL步骤有9个也出现在基座采样中；(4) 8B小规模RL中，新题目上的增益来自Finishing，Reliability持平；提供物理情境设定未显示优于普通RL。
AI.conclusion: 在固定token预算下，outcome RL的pass@1提升几乎完全可归因于完成度与可靠性的行为改变，而非获得基座不具备的新知识；预算不一致会混淆比较结论，提供题目物理设置也无额外收益。

title: From Belief Inference to Task Action: A Multi-Level Evaluation of Theory of Mind on Verifiable Tasks
summary: Effective collaboration requires language models to understand what others know and believe, and to act accordingly. Models that assume others share their information may omit necessary communication and undermine coordination. Many theory-of-mind (ToM) benchmarks assess mental-state inference through story questions, but correct answers do not establish that models can use these judgments in subsequent tasks. We introduce a multi-level evaluation built on existing, verifiable tasks. We extend household collaboration and calendar scheduling with asymmetric information while retaining their original constraints and validators. Independent interfaces assess world understanding, information access, beliefs, decisions, and execution. Controls supply personal evidence or correct beliefs to distinguish state recovery from state use. Across six model configurations, these abilities diverge. On matched scheduling cases, Claude recovers all agent beliefs correctly but produces subjectively optimal plans in only 67.9% of cases. In household collaboration, supplying beliefs raises Qwen-27B success from 55.0% to 75.0%, yet Qwen-4B answers every fixed supplied-belief source question correctly while completing only 20.0% of the corresponding continuation condition. These results show why ToM evaluation must connect perspective inference to independently verified decisions and task consequences.

AI.tldr: 提出一个多层评估框架，在保留原有约束与校验器的家庭协作与日历调度任务中引入信息不对称，分别检验世界理解、信息获取、信念、决策与执行，并设置对照以区分"状态恢复"与"状态使用"。结果显示六种模型配置在这些能力上显著分化。
AI.motivation: 现有ToM基准多以故事问答衡量心理状态推断，答对并不等于模型能在后续任务中真正运用这些判断；若模型默认他人与自己信息相同，就会省略必要沟通、破坏协作。因此需要能把视角推断与可独立验证的决策和任务后果连接起来的评估。
AI.method: 基于已有的可验证任务（家庭协作、日历调度）扩展出信息不对称版本，保留原约束与校验器；设置独立接口分别评估世界理解、信息获取、信念、决策与执行；并通过提供个人证据或正确信念的对照条件，区分状态恢复（recovery）与状态使用（use）。共测试六种模型配置。
AI.result: 各能力出现分化：在匹配的调度案例中，Claude 能正确恢复所有智能体信念，但仅67.9%的案例产出主观最优方案；家庭协作中，提供信念使 Qwen-27B 成功率从55.0%升至75.0%，而 Qwen-4B 对所有给定信念来源问题全部答对，却在相应延续条件下仅完成20.0%。
AI.conclusion: 正确的心理状态推断并不保证模型能在下游任务中有效利用，ToM评估必须将视角推断与独立验证的决策及任务后果相衔接。

title: LADDER: Diagnosing Domain-Level Self-Assessment Under Noisy Feedback
summary: Knowing when they are reliable is essential for language models to support human-AI collaboration. Yet interaction feedback is not always complete or correct, and may mislead models' understanding of their own capabilities. We introduce LADDER to study how language models assess themselves under unreliable feedback. Our findings show that models can accurately report supplied performance information while still struggling to form trustworthy self-assessments from interaction experience. Apparently accurate assessments can obscure capability differences and do not necessarily predict future task performance. These findings suggest that trustworthy self-assessment should be evaluated against observed task performance and its predictive value. Our study provides empirical evidence of the limits of model self-knowledge and a basis for evaluating capability awareness in reliable human-AI collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LADDER框架，研究语言模型在不可靠反馈下如何进行自我评估，发现模型能准确复述给定性能信息，却难以从交互经验中形成可信的自我评估。
AI.motivation: 语言模型需"知道自己何时可靠"才能支撑人机协作，但交互反馈常不完整或有误，可能误导模型对自身能力的认知，因此需研究不可靠反馈下的自我评估问题。
AI.method: 提出LADDER（探究不可靠反馈下模型自我评估的框架），在交互反馈不完整或错误的设定下考察模型的自我评估，并将自评结果与实际任务表现及其预测价值进行对照分析。
AI.result: 模型能准确报告被提供的性能信息，但从交互经验中构建可信自评仍很困难；表面上准确的自评会掩盖能力差异，且不能可靠预测后续任务表现。
AI.conclusion: 可信的自我评估应以实际观测任务表现及其预测价值来检验；研究为模型自我认知的局限提供实证证据，并为可靠人机协作中的能力意识评估提供基础。

title: Synthetic linguistic data
summary: Synthetic linguistic data have become increasingly prominent in linguistic research, from the analysis of large collections of AI-generated texts to controlled experiments investigating grammatical and lexical preferences. This glossary entry extends Bresnan's (2016) distinction between the linguistic garden and the bush by introducing an artificial plant nursery as a metaphor for synthetic data. We distinguish between synthetic bush data, consisting primarily of corpus-like collections of model-generated language, and synthetic garden data, in which model outputs are elicited under controlled conditions to investigate specific linguistic hypotheses. We argue that synthetic data constitute a distinct object of linguistic investigation: comparing them with natural language data can reveal both shared patterns and divergences, but their interpretation requires careful consideration of the conditions under which they are generated.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"人工苗圃"隐喻，区分模型生成语料的"灌木型合成数据"与受控诱发下的"花园型合成数据"，主张合成数据是语言学的独立研究对象，其解释须依托生成条件。
AI.motivation: 合成语言数据在语言学研究中日益普遍（大规模AI文本分析与受控语法/词汇偏好实验），但学界尚缺乏对其类型与解释效力的系统界定，需要概念框架来厘清合成数据的地位。
AI.method: 概念/术语学论述：在Bresnan(2016)"语言花园与灌木丛"二分基础上引入"人工苗圃"隐喻，并以"灌木型合成数据"（语料式模型输出集合）与"花园型合成数据"（受控条件下诱发的模型输出以检验特定语言学假设）两类作出区分，论证其为独立研究对象。
AI.result: 建立了一套合成数据的类型学与解释框架；指出合成数据与自然语言数据比较可揭示共享模式与偏离，但解释时必须审慎考量数据的生成条件。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据应被视为语言学的独立研究对象而非自然数据的替代品；其可比性与可解释性取决于生成条件，需在方法论上明确受控与自然语料的边界。

title: Higher Reasoning Effort Improves Reference Verifiability and Changes Reasoning Summaries in GPT-5.5
summary: Large language models are increasingly being used in different stages of scientific knowledge production, including the suggestion of references. These models can operate at different levels of reasoning effort and provide summaries of their reasoning processes. This raises two questions: Does increasing reasoning effort improve the verifiability of generated references, and do the resulting reasoning summaries reveal how the model's behavior changes with greater effort? We examined summaries from GPT-5.5 as it generated scholarly references for 1,000 papers under paired low- and high-effort settings. Generated references were matched to external bibliographic records, and reasoning summaries were scored for four predefined features and explored for additional features discovered by GPT-5.5. High effort increased the mean paper-level resolver-verified reference rate from 78.3% to 84.8%, and produced longer reasoning summaries. All four predefined features received higher scores under high effort. The discovered features changed less uniformly: some appeared equally often in both conditions, whereas others were more common under high effort. Within each effort condition, neither feature set showed a consistent increase in verification rates with higher scores.

AI.tldr: 研究考察GPT-5.5在低/高推理强度下为1,000篇论文生成学术参考文献的可验证性及推理摘要变化：高推理强度将论文级解析器验证率均值从78.3%提升至84.8%，但推理摘要特征得分与验证率之间无一致正相关。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已广泛参与科学知识生产各环节（包括推荐参考文献），且可调节推理强度并输出推理摘要。由此引出两个问题：提高推理强度能否改善生成参考文献的可验证性；推理摘要是否揭示模型行为随推理强度变化的方式。
AI.method: 对GPT-5.5在配对的高/低推理强度设置下为1,000篇论文生成学术参考文献，将生成文献与外部书目记录进行匹配（解析器验证），并对推理摘要按四个预设特征打分，同时由GPT-5.5自行发现额外特征进行比较分析。
AI.result: 高推理强度使论文级解析器验证率均值由78.3%升至84.8%，推理摘要更长；四个预设特征得分在高强度下均更高。自行发现的特征变化不一致：部分在两条件下出现频率相同，部分在高强度下更常见。在每种推理强度条件内部，两类特征集均未表现出得分越高、验证率越高的持续趋势。
AI.conclusion: 提高推理强度可提升生成参考文献的可验证性与推理摘要的预设特征表现，但推理摘要中特征的丰富程度并不等价于更高的文献准确性；摘要特征不能作为可验证性的可靠代理指标。

title: Agreement Between Reconstructed and Native GDELT GKG Records: A Field-Level Baseline
summary: The Global Knowledge Graph (GKG) of the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) characterizes news articles using named entities, topics, quantitative and temporal features, quotations, tone, and dictionary-based content measures. Its codebook defines the record format, but the software that produces the records is not public, so researchers cannot generate compatible records for articles they collect themselves. We built an open-source reconstruction, gdelt-regkg, and measured how closely it agrees with GDELT's archived (native) records for 193,550 English articles from 8,729 publishers (2020-2025) and 2,500 articles in five other languages. Agreement depends strongly on the field. English tone, the percentage of positive minus negative words, has a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.79 points and a concordance correlation coefficient of 0.75. Identity agreement (F1) is 0.65 for persons, 0.42 for organizations, and 0.65 for locations. It is lower for date components (0.42), complete counts with their objects and locations (0.07), and quotations (0.07), while GCAM category presence reaches micro F1 0.84 within the implemented dictionaries. In subsets where retrieved and native titles and lengths match, tone error falls to 1.47 and organization F1 rises to 0.48, yet most disagreement remains. A larger gazetteer raises coverage of native places from 89.5% to 97.1% with little change in location F1. Tone computed on English translations of non-English articles is less accurate (MAE 2.10-2.64) than for English articles. The results are conditional on article pages that could still be retrieved, and the correspondence subsets do not isolate the effect of input differences. Reconstructed records should therefore be assessed field by field and not treated as completely interchangeable with native ones.

AI.tldr: 本文构建开源工具 gdelt-regkg 重建 GDELT 的 GKG 记录，并在 193,550 篇英文及 2,500 篇非英文学术样本上逐字段量化其与原生记录的一致性，发现一致性高度依赖字段（tone MAE 1.79、人物/机构/地点 F1 分别为 0.65/0.42/0.65，日期与引语等字段极低），故重建记录应按字段评估而非直接互换使用。
AI.motivation: GDELT 的 GKG 仅有公开 codebook 定义记录格式，但生成记录的软件未开源，研究者无法为自己采集的文章生成兼容记录，限制了可复现性与对自建语料的分析能力。
AI.method: 开发开源重建工具 gdelt-regkg；以 GDELT 归档的原生记录为基准，在 193,550 篇英文文章（8,729 家出版方，2020–2025）及五种其他语言的 2,500 篇文章上逐字段比较一致性，采用 MAE、一致性相关系数（CCC）、实体 F1、微平均 F1 等指标；并考察标题/长度匹配子集、扩大地名词典、以及机器翻译文本对结果的影响。
AI.result: 英文 tone 的 MAE 为 1.79 分、CCC 为 0.75；实体 F1 在人物 0.65、机构 0.42、地点 0.65；日期成分 F1 0.42，完整计数（含对象与地点）与引语 F1 均为 0.07；GCAM 类别在已实现词典范围内微平均 F1 达 0.84。在检索标题与长度均匹配的子集中，tone 误差降至 1.47、机构 F1 升至 0.48，但大部分分歧仍存在。扩大地名词典使原生地点覆盖率由 89.5% 升至 97.1%，地点 F1 基本不变。非英文文章英译文本上的 tone 精度更低（MAE 2.10–2.64）。
AI.conclusion: 重建的 GKG 记录与原生记录的一致性因字段差异悬殊，不能视为完全可互换；结论以仍可检索到页面为前提，且匹配子集未能分离输入差异的影响。实际使用中应按字段分别评估重建记录的适用性。

title: MechAlign: Evaluating Semantic Alignment at the Project Level in Mathematical Formalization
summary: Lean verifies that a formal proof establishes its stated proposition under declared assumptions, but does not check whether that proposition faithfully expresses the mathematical claim in a manuscript. Assessing this correspondence requires interpreting the main theorem through its project dependencies, which may be scattered throughout a large development. We introduce MechAlign, a framework for project-level semantic alignment review that combines formal dependency extraction with LLM-based assessment. Its extraction tool, LeanTrace, constructs a statement dependency graph from elaborated declarations, retaining definition bodies and structure constraints while excluding proof bodies and stopping at an explicit library boundary. The reviewer uses this context to investigate alignment and report discrepancies with localized evidence. We conduct a preliminary review of 201 main results from 173 OpenAI Math projects, using supplied informal descriptions and available paper context. A hyperbolic-group case illustrates how dependency inspection localizes a missing dimensional constraint relative to the manuscript, consistent with the upstream declaration of formalization scope. We also construct LeanReviewBench, comprising 501 fixed claim-statement-context triples from OpenAI Math, Fermat's Last Theorem, and Kakeya, with description provenance recorded. The resource supports controlled comparisons of more project-level semantic alignment evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出 MechAlign 框架，结合形式化依赖抽取与 LLM 评估，在项目级别审查 Lean 命题与手稿数学主张的语义对齐；并通过 201 个 OpenAI Math 结果的初步审查与 LeanReviewBench 基准加以验证。
AI.motivation: Lean 仅保证形式证明在其声明假设下成立，却不检查命题是否忠实表达手稿中的数学主张。判断这种对应关系需要解读主定理及其在整个大型开发中分散的项目依赖，现有工作缺乏项目级别的语义对齐审查手段。
AI.method: 提出 MechAlign 框架，将形式依赖抽取与基于 LLM 的评估相结合。其抽取工具 LeanTrace 从已精化的声明构建陈述依赖图，保留定义体与结构约束，排除证明体，并在显式库边界处停止。审查器基于该上下文排查对齐情况，并给出带局部化证据的差异报告。
AI.result: 对来自 173 个 OpenAI Math 项目的 201 个主要结果进行初步审查（使用提供的非形式描述与可得论文上下文）。双曲群案例表明，依赖检查可定位相对于手稿缺失的维数约束，且与上游关于形式化范围的声明一致。此外构建 LeanReviewBench，包含来自 OpenAI Math、费马大定理与 Kakeya 的 501 个固定 claim–statement–context 三元组，并记录描述来源。
AI.conclusion: MechAlign 实现了项目级语义对齐审查，LeanTrace 的陈述依赖图与 LLM 评估相结合可有效定位命题与手稿间的偏差；LeanReviewBench 为更广泛的项目级语义对齐评估提供了可复现的受控对比资源。

title: DTCA: Denoising Token Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, enabling bidirectional context modeling and parallel token refinement. Recent studies have applied reinforcement learning (RL) to DLMs and improved their reasoning performance. However, the iterative denoising process makes credit assignment more challenging, as final outcome rewards provide limited information about how different tokens contribute to the final output. In this paper, we propose Denoising Token Credit Assignment (DTCA), a framework for token-level credit assignment in reinforcement learning for diffusion language models. DTCA estimates token contributions by measuring the improvement in prediction confidence of remaining masked positions after token commitment and groups these signals according to part-of-speech (POS) categories. These contribution weights are used to select informative denoising timesteps and assign token-level learning signals during RL training. DTCA further calibrates these learning signals according to token-level entropy changes induced by policy updates. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct show that DTCA consistently improves mathematical reasoning performance across different generation budgets, with gains of up to 9.0 points on MATH500 and 5.3 points on GSM8K over the base model.

AI.tldr: 提出DTCA框架，为扩散语言模型的强化学习实现token级信用分配，在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上显著提升数学推理性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）通过迭代去噪生成文本，支持双向上下文建模与并行token精炼。已有工作将强化学习用于DLM并提升推理性能，但迭代去噪过程使信用分配更困难——最终结果奖励难以反映各token对输出的贡献。因此需要token级的信用分配方法。
AI.method: DTCA（Denoising Token Credit Assignment）通过衡量token确定（commitment）后剩余掩码位置预测置信度的提升来估计token贡献，并按词性（POS）类别对信号分组；用这些贡献权重在RL训练中选择信息量高的去噪时间步，并施加token级学习信号；再依据策略更新引起的token级熵变对学习信号进行校准。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上，DTCA在不同生成预算下均持续提升数学推理性能，相较基座模型在MATH500上最高提升9.0分，在GSM8K上提升5.3分。
AI.conclusion: 基于置信度提升的token贡献估计结合词性分组与熵校准，可有效解决扩散语言模型RL中的信用分配问题，是一种有效的token级信用分配框架。

title: LoopFold: Parallelizing Recurrent Depth in Looped Transformers
summary: Looped Transformers increase computation per token by repeatedly applying a shared backbone, offering a way to improve language modeling and downstream task performance at a fixed backbone parameter count. However, each loop depends on the preceding loop, so increasing recurrent depth also increases decoding latency. Existing approaches include Parallel Loop Transformers, which reduce latency by overlapping loop computation across token positions, but yield rapidly diminishing marginal accuracy gains at larger depths. To address this challenge, we introduce LoopFold, which folds computation at multiple recurrent depths into parallel batches for the same token prefix. A lightweight predictor estimates inputs to later loops so they can start before earlier loops finish. A corrector then refines the outputs of these later loops using newly available results from earlier loops. All components are trained jointly using only the final next-token prediction loss. In experiments with 1.4B models, deeper LoopFold configurations achieve progressively higher average zero-shot accuracy across eight tasks, rising from 53.41% to 56.38%. Vanilla looped models and PLT show limited gains over the same depth range. Compared with a nine-loop vanilla model, LoopFold uses five sequential stages and additional parallel computation to reduce decoding latency by 46%.

AI.tldr: LoopFold 将多个递归深度的计算折叠为针对同一 token 前缀的并行批次，用轻量预测器提前启动深层循环、用校正器利用早层结果修正，从而在保持深层循环精度收益的同时降低解码延迟。
AI.motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复应用共享主干提升每 token 计算量，可在固定主干参数量下改善语言建模与下游任务表现；但各循环存在串行依赖，递归深度增加会导致解码延迟上升。并行循环 Transformer（PLT）虽通过重叠不同 token 位置的循环计算降低延迟，但在较大深度下边际精度增益迅速衰减，因此需要兼顾深度收益与延迟的新方案。
AI.method: 提出 LoopFold：对同一 token 前缀，将多个递归深度的计算折叠进并行批次；轻量预测器估计后续循环的输入，使其能在前序循环完成前启动；校正器利用前序循环新产生的结果细化后续循环输出；所有组件仅以最终 next-token 预测损失联合训练。
AI.result: 在 1.4B 模型上，更深的 LoopFold 配置在八个任务上的平均零样本准确率由 53.41% 逐步升至 56.38%，而 vanilla 循环模型与 PLT 在相同深度区间增益有限；相比九循环 vanilla 模型，LoopFold 使用五个顺序阶段加额外并行计算，将解码延迟降低 46%。
AI.conclusion: LoopFold 缓解了循环深度与解码延迟之间的矛盾：通过预测—校正的折叠并行机制，在保持深层循环精度递增收益的同时显著降低解码延迟，优于 vanilla 循环与 PLT 的深度扩展方式。
