title: INVAR-Agri: Detecting Discrepancies in Multilingual Operator Manuals of Agricultural Implements with a Fine-Tuned LLM
summary: Operator manuals of agricultural implements are delivered in many languages, and the standards require that competent persons review every translation, which makes this review the bottleneck. This paper presents a proof of concept that compares two training workflows on the same LLM, EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct, trained on operator manuals of one manufacturer. In approach A, a back-translator translates each language version back into English, and an English reader compares it with the English version. In approach B, a checker reads the English version and the translation together, where the checker reports differences. The test sets contain errors planted in numbers, units, opposite words, obligations, negations, and conditions in 24 languages, and they include unmodified text and meaning-preserving edits for alerts and false alarms. The trained back-translator concealed many planted errors, most of all weakened obligations, while translation-quality scores rose. In contrast, the separately trained checker detected most planted errors, although it was weak for units and for number changes unlike those in training. A check by the author confirmed the concealment. In addition, a simple rule check caught the number and unit changes, but it alerted on harmless rewrites. A check of alerts on real Finnish translations showed that most alerts were false, caused by language-specific wording, so the precision on real text remains a limitation. Within this setting, a trained checker might support, not replace, the review by competent persons, and firmer conclusions need more data.

AI.tldr: 该文以同一LLM（EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct）比较两种翻译审校训练流程：回译式（A）与并读比对式（B）。实验表明训练后的回译者会掩盖植入错误（尤以弱化义务为甚）却仍获得较高译文质量评分，而独立训练的检查器能检出多数植入错误，但对单位和训练分布外的数字改动较弱；规则检查可捕获数字/单位改动但误报于无害改写，真实芬兰语译文上误报率偏高。结论为训练后的检查器可辅助而非替代合格人员审校。
AI.motivation: 农机具操作手册需多语言发布，标准要求合格人员审核每份译文，人工审核成为流程瓶颈，因此需探索LLM辅助审校的可行性流程。
AI.method: 在同一模型EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct、同一厂商手册数据上对比两种训练流程：A为回译者将各语言版本回译为英语，由英语读者与英语原版比对；B为检查器并读英语原文与译文并报告差异。测试集覆盖24种语言，在数字、单位、反义词、义务、否定、条件处植入错误，并含未修改文本与保义改写（用于评估告警与误报）；辅以规则检查与作者人工核查，并在真实芬兰语译文上评估告警精度。
AI.result: 回译者在译质评分上升的同时掩盖大量植入错误，最突出的是弱化义务；独立训练的检查器检出多数植入错误，但对单位及与训练样例不同的数字改动较弱；简单规则检查可捕获数字与单位改动但会对无害改写误报；真实芬兰语译文上多数告警为假，精度仍是限制。作者人工核查证实了掩盖现象。
AI.conclusion: 在该实验设定下，训练后的检查器可支持而非替代合格人员审校；更确定的结论需更多数据支撑。

title: The Geometry of Emotion Representations Across Scale, Depth, and Instruction Tuning
summary: We measure the emotion geometry of six LLMs spanning Google's Gemma 2 family. Using an extraction pipeline established by Sofroniew et al. (2026) on Claude Sonnet 4.5 and replicated by Hollowell (2026) on Gemma 2 27B base, we compare emotion geometry across base and instruction-tuned variants of Gemma 2 2B, 9B, and 27B. First, all six model cells exhibit the core emotion geometry. A linear map fit between two cells places held-out emotions nearest their own vectors in the target model. Across all fifteen model pairs, fit in one direction each, this failed exactly once, and the median rank was 1 in every pair. Linear maps refit on cleaned embedding-table vectors recover every held-out emotion at rank 1 in all thirty ordered pairs. Second, scale spreads the geometry's variance across more directions without weakening its tie to valence. The leading component's share of variance falls from 31.6 percent (2B) to 29.8 (9B) to 26.7 (27B) in the base models and from 31.9 (2B) to 29.2 (9B) to 27.3 (27B) in the tuned ones, while its correlation with human valence ratings stays between .71 and .78 in all six models. Third, we project each emotion vector onto the output vocabulary and ask at what depth the vector's own emotion word enters the top 10,000 of the 256,000 tokens. In the 2B and 9B models the median emotion word is there from layer 0, while in the 27B models it begins near chance, stays outside the top 10,000 for half the network, and enters at layer 23 in one step. Fourth, tuning leaves every registered analysis-layer measure within its floor. At every size, valence correlation rises and arousal correlation falls by amounts within their floors, the latter against prediction. PC2's variance share also falls, with a pooled decrease significant after correction. Mid-late layer stability exceeds its floor and traces to base 27B's final layer. Code, data, and audit reports are released.

AI.tldr: 该文测量Gemma 2系列六个LLM（2B/9B/27B的base与instruction-tuned）的情绪几何，发现核心情绪几何在全部六个模型中均存在；线性映射可跨模型迁移（重拟合后30个有序模型对全部rank 1）；规模增大使方差分散但情绪与效价关联不减弱；27B模型情绪词的词表投影呈现层23的"一步进入"；微调未超出注册分析层指标的下限。
AI.motivation: 复用Sofroniew等(2026)在Claude Sonnet 4.5上建立、Hollowell(2026)在Gemma 2 27B base上复现的情绪向量提取流程，系统考察情绪几何在模型家族内跨规模（2B/9B/27B）与跨训练阶段（base vs instruction-tuned）的稳定性、可迁移性与规模/微调效应，并配合预设下限（floors）做审慎的统计判断。
AI.method: (1) 在六个模型单元上提取情绪向量，检验核心几何；(2) 两单元间拟合线性映射，以held-out情绪在其自身向量处的rank作为保真度指标（15对单向拟合 + 30个有序对重拟合于清洗后的embedding-table向量）；(3) PCA分析方差分布及第一主成分与人类效价评分的相关性；(4) 将情绪向量投影到256,000词表，统计其自身情绪词进入top-10,000的层深度；(5) 对微调前后各注册分析层指标（效价/唤醒相关、PC2方差份额、中后期层稳定性）设定floors做效应量与显著性校正检验。
AI.result: 所有六模型均具核心情绪几何；线性映射15对中仅失败1次、各对中位rank=1，重拟合后30个有序对全部rank 1。主导成分方差份额随规模下降（base: 31.6%→29.8%→26.7%；tuned: 31.9%→29.2%→27.3%），但与人类效价相关在六模型中稳定于.71–.78。词表投影上，2B/9B中位情绪词自layer 0即进入top-10,000，27B近乎随机、半数网络层在外、于layer 23一步进入。微调效应均在下限内：效价相关上升、唤醒相关下降（后者与预测相反），PC2方差份额汇聚性下降且校正后显著；中后期层稳定性超下限，可溯源至base 27B末层。
AI.conclusion: Gemma 2家族呈现稳健、可跨模型线性迁移的情绪几何，其与效价的关联不随规模削弱，仅方差分布更分散；27B在词表读出上表现出显著的深度非单调性；指令微调在这些预设指标上未产生超出下限的结构性改变，提示情绪表征主要源于预训练而非对齐训练。作者公开代码、数据与审计报告以支持可复现性。

title: The Lay of the Land in Idiom-Translation Quality Estimation
summary: Idioms have long been a challenge for machine translation, and while large language models (LLMs) have proven increasingly adept at handling them, whether quality estimation (QE) systems have kept pace and can reliably score idiomatic renderings of these expressions above faulty literal ones remains unclear. We introduce the first parallel dataset pairing idiom-bearing English sentences with both literal and idiomatic translations across nine target languages, augmented into multi-sentence segments and a graded literality continuum. Using this dataset, we benchmark eleven conventional QE metrics from the COMET and MetricX families and ten LLMs from the Qwen-3, Gemma-4 and OLMo-3 families used as GEMBA-style judges. We find that most systems, especially older metrics and smaller models, display a marked literality bias, rating literal translations of idioms above idiomatic ones. Higher parameter counts and newer training sets appear to reduce this bias to an extent; nevertheless, of all the benchmarked systems, only MetricX-24-Hybrid (XL, XXL) and Gemma-4-31B consistently rate idiomatic translations of idioms above literal ones, and only Gemma-4-31B reliably ranks intermediate degrees of idiomaticity and literality. Our findings caution against deploying standard QE metrics in domains rich in figurative language, where higher scores might be rewarding undesirable literalism.

AI.tldr: 本文构建首个平行数据集，检验质量评估(QE)系统是否能正确区分习语的意译与错误直译，发现大多数QE指标与LLM评判者存在明显的“直译偏好”，仅少数系统表现可靠。
AI.motivation: 习语一直是机器翻译的难点。尽管LLM在翻译习语上日益擅长，但尚不清楚QE系统是否同步进步，能否可靠地给意译版本打出高于错误直译版本的分数。若QE系统偏爱直译，则会奖励不理想的翻译行为，因此需要系统评估这一潜在偏差。
AI.method: 构建首个平行数据集：将含习语的英语句子分别配以直译与意译译文，覆盖九种目标语言，并扩展为多句段落及分级的字面性连续谱。基于该数据集，基准测试11种COMET与MetricX族传统QE指标，以及10个来自Qwen-3、Gemma-4、OLMo-3族用作GEMBA式评判者的LLM。
AI.result: 大多数系统（尤其是较旧指标与较小模型）表现出明显的直译偏好，给习语直译打分高于意译。更大参数量与更新训练集可在一定程度上缓解该偏差；但在所有受测系统中，仅MetricX-24-Hybrid（XL、XXL）与Gemma-4-31B能一致地给意译打分高于直译，且仅Gemma-4-31B能可靠地对中间程度的习语性与字面性进行排序。
AI.conclusion: 标准QE指标在富含比喻性语言的领域存在可靠性风险，其较高分数可能是在奖励不理想的直译，应谨慎部署；同时提示需针对习语等figurative语言改进QE系统。

title: Examining form-based linguistic productivity in people and large language models
summary: Linguistic productivity, as evidenced by the use of words in novel contexts, is one of the most striking facts about human language. However, how abstract the knowledge that enables such productivity is remains unclear. We compare people's and computational language models' linguistic productivity in contexts where successful generalization depends on form-based information. We focus on extending the use of a novel verb learned in the active voice to passive contexts. We find people extend active to passive uses in a way consistent with abstract generalizations concerning linguistic form, even when no plausible meaning can be assigned to the novel verb. In contrast, large language models succeeded only when a meaning like an existing verb's could be assigned to the novel verb. We conclude that computational models' syntactic knowledge remains tied to the distribution and meaning of specific lexical items in a way that human syntactic knowledge is not.

AI.tldr: 人类在无法赋予新动词合理语义时仍能依据抽象形式概括将其从主动句推广到被动句，而大语言模型仅在可借用既有动词语义时才成功，说明模型的句法知识仍绑定于具体词项的分布与语义。
AI.motivation: 语言产物性（在新语境中使用词语）是人类语言的显著特征，但支撑这种产物性的知识有多抽象尚不清楚。作者希望检验：当成功概括只能依赖形式（而非语义）信息时，人类与计算语言模型的表现是否一致，从而揭示模型句法知识的抽象程度。
AI.method: 以新造动词为材料，让被试先在主动语态中学习该动词，再测试其向被动语态的扩展；设置关键条件使新动词无法被赋予合理语义，从而迫使概括只能依赖形式信息。同时用大语言模型在相同任务上进行对比。
AI.result: 人类即使在无法给新动词赋予合理语义的情况下，仍按与语言形式相关的抽象概括把主动用法扩展到被动用法；大语言模型只有在能为新动词指派类似既有动词的语义时才成功。
AI.conclusion: 计算模型的句法知识仍与具体词项的分布和语义相绑定，而人类句法知识并非如此；这表明当前语言模型在形式概括的抽象性上与人类存在本质差距。

title: "High-Quality" Data for Early-Stage Instruction Tuning: An Empirical Study of Data Quality Metrics
summary: "Data quality" is widely invoked in instruction tuning, but the term is often underspecified. We study it as an operational property by asking which simple example-level metrics, drawn from prior work on data selection, text quality, and instruction tuning, best predict training utility under a fixed finetuning budget. For each metric, we sort instruction-response examples by score, partition them into low, middle, and high bins with roughly equal token mass, finetune separately on each bin, and compare validation perplexity and LLM-as-judge scores for the models' generated answers as a function of cumulative training tokens. Our results suggest that answer-dense supervision, as captured by response ratio, is a stronger and more portable predictor of instruction-tuning utility than commonly used alternative proxies.

AI.tldr: 本文把"数据质量"操作化为样本级简单指标，通过按指标分箱并分别微调来检验哪个指标最能预测指令微调的训练效用，发现 response ratio 所刻画的"答案密集监督"是更强、更可迁移的预测因子。
AI.motivation: "数据质量"在指令微调中被广泛引用却定义含糊，缺乏对哪些简单样本级指标真正预测训练效用的系统比较。
AI.method: 从数据选择、文本质量与指令微调既有工作中选取多个样本级指标；对每个指标按得分排序指令-响应对，并按近似相等的 token 质量划分为低、中、高三个分箱，分别微调；在固定微调预算下，以累计训练 token 为自变量比较验证困惑度与 LLM-as-judge 对生成答案的评分。
AI.result: 在固定预算的受控比较中，response ratio 度量的答案密集监督，相比常用替代代理指标，对指令微调效用具有更强且更可迁移的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 数据质量应被当作可操作的样本级属性来研究；答案密集程度比常见质量代理更能指示指令微调收益，为数据筛选提供了简洁实用的信号。

title: Schema-Free Text-to-SQL: Learning Enterprise Database Structure from Query Logs
summary: Text-to-SQL systems achieve remarkable accuracy on academic benchmarks, yet performance drops dramatically in enterprise deployments. This gap stems from a fundamental assumption: existing approaches require complete schema documentation, but enterprise databases typically lack comprehensive documentation, featuring cryptic naming and implicit relationships. We present the first text-to-SQL framework that operates without schema documentation, instead learning database structure from historical query logs. Query logs encode implicit structural knowledge: which tables are queried together, how they join, and what columns map to business concepts. We construct a knowledge graph from parsed query patterns and introduce entity-driven GraphRAG retrieval that grounds user questions in domain terminology rather than relying solely on embedding similarity. Validated on both an industrial deployment with expert evaluation and the Beaver benchmark, our approach substantially outperforms similarity-based retrieval methods, the dominant industry approach, in both executability and answer quality. On Beaver, we achieve 95.7% execution validity compared to 60.8% for embedding-based retrieval, with expert data engineers preferring our system 70% to 10% on internal deployment. Our work demonstrates that text-to-SQL can operate effectively in schema-ambiguous enterprise environments, enabling natural language database interfaces "in the wild".

AI.tldr: 提出首个无需schema文档的text-to-SQL框架，从历史查询日志中学习数据库结构并构建知识图谱，结合实体驱动的GraphRAG检索，在工业部署与Beaver基准上显著优于基于嵌入的检索方法。
AI.motivation: 现有text-to-SQL在学术基准上表现优异，但企业部署中性能急剧下降。其根源在于一个基本假设：现有方法要求完整的schema文档，而企业数据库通常缺乏完整文档，命名晦涩且关系隐含。作者希望解决这种schema模糊（schema-ambiguous）环境下的落地问题。
AI.method: 不使用schema文档，改为从历史查询日志中学习数据库结构：查询日志隐含了结构性知识（哪些表被一起查询、如何连接、哪些列对应业务概念）。作者从解析后的查询模式构建知识图谱，并引入实体驱动的GraphRAG检索，使用户问题能对齐到领域术语，而非仅依赖嵌入相似度。
AI.result: 在工业部署（专家评估）与Beaver基准上均验证。Beaver上执行有效率达95.7%，而基于嵌入的检索为60.8%；内部部署中专家数据工程师以70%对10%的比例偏好该系统。
AI.conclusion: text-to-SQL可在schema模糊的企业环境中有效运行，为"真实场景"下的自然语言数据库接口提供了可行路径，并证明查询日志是替代schema文档的可用结构知识来源。

title: RoleHear: Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Role-Attributed Streaming Speech Recognition
summary: Streaming automatic speech recognition transcribes at low latency but produces an unattributed word stream, while real-time applications such as customer-service analytics need each word tied to a speaker role. Role attribution is usually a separate stage, either an offline or streaming speaker-diarization model aligned to the words or a text-based large language model applied to the transcript, and role labels for training are scarce. We present RoleHear, a semi-supervised pipeline that makes a single cache-aware streaming transducer emit roles inline through lightweight in-vocabulary role tokens: a fast turn-boundary marker followed by a per-role token a few words later. An offline transducer teacher, fine-tuned into a role-attributed recognizer, relabels unlabeled audio, and a multimodal large language model supplies silver role labels where gold annotations are unavailable. The streaming student is fine-tuned on the mixture in a single pass. Across customer-service calls with gold roles and earnings calls with silver roles, RoleHear attributes roles accurately while preserving transcription quality and narrowing the gap to the offline teacher.

AI.tldr: RoleHear 是一个半监督流水线，让单个 cache-aware 流式 transducer 通过轻量级词表内的角色 token 直接内联输出说话人角色，缓解角色标注数据稀缺与需额外角色归属阶段的问题。
AI.motivation: 流式 ASR 延迟低但只产出无归属的词流，而客服分析等实时应用需将每个词绑定到说话人角色。现有做法是分离的角色归属阶段（离线/流式说话人日志对齐或基于文本 LLM 处理转写），且训练用角色标签稀缺。
AI.method: 提出 RoleHear 半监督流水线：使单一 cache-aware 流式 transducer 通过词表内轻量角色 token 内联输出角色（先输出快速转折边界标记，数词后输出对应角色 token）；用经微调为角色归属识别器的离线 transducer 教师对无标注音频重标注，并在缺金标处由多模态大语言模型提供银标角色标签；流式学生在混合数据上单遍微调。
AI.result: 在带金标角色的客服通话与带银标角色的财报电话会议数据上，RoleHear 在保持转写质量的同时准确归属角色，并缩小了与离线教师之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 将角色归属内联到流式 transducer 中，配合教师重标注与多模态 LLM 银标构成的半监督训练，可在低延迟单模型下实现准确角色归属而不牺牲识别质量。

title: Beyond Prompts: A Systematic Study of LLM-Based Machine Translation Evaluators
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 1 figure. Dataset and prompts: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yandex/orbit-mt-eval
summary: LLM-based evaluators have rapidly become a standard tool for machine translation evaluation, yet the design choices that shape their behavior remain poorly understood. We present a systematic study of how instruction design, few-shot demonstrations, backbone model choice, and multi-step workflows affect span-level and ranking-based MT evaluation. We collect new expert RATE annotations on WMT24 and WMT25 English-Russian translations, with transfer validation on MQM- and ESA-annotated benchmarks across five additional language pairs. Our experiments reveal four robust findings: instruction structure shapes evaluator behavior, high-quality demonstrations matter more than quantity, frontier backbones exhibit distinct evaluator profiles (recall-, precision-, or ranking-oriented), and fusing outputs across diverse backbones outperforms single-evaluator multi-call setups. Although evaluator design exposes a large combinatorial space, several discovered design principles transfer consistently across annotation protocols and language pairs. We synthesize these findings into ORBIT, a family of LLM-based MT evaluators. Our strongest configurations achieve expert-level performance in error span detection and in Accuracy and Fluency ranking at roughly 20x lower cost than expert human annotation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于LLM的机器翻译评估器的设计选择（指令设计、少样本示例、骨干模型、多步流程）对跨度级与排序评估的影响，并据此提出ORBIT评估器家族。
AI.motivation: LLM评估器已成为MT评估的标准工具，但影响其行为的设计选择缺乏系统理解；作者希望厘清这些设计因素的作用规律并提炼可迁移的设计原则。
AI.method: 在WMT24与WMT25英俄翻译上收集新的专家RATE标注，并在五个额外语向的MQM与ESA标注基准上做迁移验证；系统变换指令结构、少样本示例、骨干模型与多步工作流，分析其对跨度级错误检测与排序评估的影响。
AI.result: 得到四项稳健发现：指令结构塑造评估器行为；高质量示例比数量更重要；前沿骨干模型呈现不同评估器画像（偏召回、偏精确或偏排序）；跨多样骨干融合输出优于单评估器多次调用。最优配置在错误跨度检测及准确度/流畅度排序上达到专家水平，成本约为人工标注的1/20。
AI.conclusion: 尽管评估器设计空间呈组合爆炸，若干设计原则可跨标注协议与语向稳定迁移；作者将其综合为ORBIT评估器家族。

title: When the Weakest Language Keeps Moving: ARMOR-DP for Multilingual BabyLM
comment: Accepted to the BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Multilingual BabyLM systems usually fix language sampling proportions even though the weakest language can change during training. We present ARMOR-DP, a modular framework that diagnoses imbalance arising from representation, exposure, capacity, and objective pressure, and uses per-language validation loss to update sampling. Controlled experiments show that equal character budgets create a severe representation artifact for Chinese; byte-level encoding removes much of it, while static Chinese protection can subsequently make English the weakest language. The dynamic controller tracks these transitions and achieves a better score--balance tradeoff than fixed protection. On official evaluation, curriculum-dynamic checkpoints outperform a matched static Chinese-protective baseline while using fewer Chinese epochs; scaling capacity yields the strongest internal ARMOR-DP system. These results support a simple conclusion: multilingual weakness is a training-time state rather than a fixed property of a language. ARMOR-DP therefore separates diagnosis from intervention, allowing protection to follow the current bottleneck instead of a predetermined language label.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化框架ARMOR-DP，用各语言验证损失动态调整采样比例，解决多语言BabyLM中"最弱语言随训练变化"的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言BabyLM系统固定语言采样比例，但训练过程中最弱语言会发生变化，固定保护策略会造成新的失衡。
AI.method: 模块化框架，从表征、曝光、容量、目标压力四个来源诊断失衡；基于各语言验证损失更新采样比例。开展控制实验：等字符预算、字节级编码、静态中文保护对比，以及动态控制器与扩容实验。
AI.result: 等字符预算对中文产生严重表征伪影，字节级编码可大幅消除；静态中文保护会使英语变为最弱语言；动态控制器能跟踪语言强弱转换，取得更优的分数—均衡权衡。官方评测中，课程动态检查点在更少中文epoch下优于匹配的静态中文保护基线；扩大容量得到最强的内部系统。
AI.conclusion: 多语言中的"弱"是训练时的状态而非语言的固定属性；ARMOR-DP将诊断与干预分离，使保护跟随当前瓶颈而非预设语言标签。

title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
summary: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible interaction history. We introduce Trajectory2Gym, which constructs executable interactions around under-supported compositional structures and derives supervision only from grounded decisions in their realized executions. Structural-support selection allocates the resulting experience, while parent-normalized supervised fine-tuning preserves the semantic interaction as the unit of training weight. This reframes trajectory generation as the deliberate construction of learnable interaction experience, rather than the collection of successful trajectories. Across five Qwen3 scales, Trajectory2Gym improves Tau1, Tau2, and BFCL at every tested scale, increasing the equal-weight three-benchmark mean by 16.9-29.8 percentage points. The gains are strongest in stateful and multi-turn interaction, where later decisions depend on earlier observations and feedback. Our results suggest that scaling tool-use agents depends not only on collecting more successful trajectories, but on constructing interactions whose dependencies are represented and whose decisions are learnable from the agent's visible history.

AI.tldr: 成功轨迹并非有效监督；需同时满足"组合覆盖"与"决策可依据性"，Trajectory2Gym 通过构造可执行交互并只从有依据的决策中提取监督来提升工具使用智能体能力。
AI.motivation: 成功的工具使用交互轨迹不等于有用的监督信号：成功轨迹可能欠代表多步依赖关系，且包含在决策时刻依据可见信息无法被合理解释的动作。作者提出有效轨迹监督的两项耦合要求——组合覆盖（重要观察-动作依赖被覆盖）与决策可依据性（每个被监督动作均由学习者可见的交互历史支撑）。
AI.method: 提出 Trajectory2Gym：围绕"支撑不足"的组合结构构造可执行交互，仅从实际执行中"有依据的决策"导出监督；采用结构-支撑选择（structural-support selection）分配经验，并以父节点归一化的监督微调（parent-normalized SFT）保持语义交互作为训练权重单位。
AI.result: 在五个 Qwen3 规模上，Tau1、Tau2、BFCL 全部提升，三基准等权平均提升 16.9–29.8 个百分点；增益在有状态与多轮交互中最显著，即后序决策依赖先前观察与反馈的场景。
AI.conclusion: 扩展工具使用智能体不仅依赖收集更多成功轨迹，更依赖构造依赖关系被表征、且决策能从智能体可见历史中学习的交互经验。

title: Five Architectures, One Shared Space Cross-Model Representational Alignment Without Weight Merging
summary: Combining language models is usually done by averaging weights, which works only when the models share a common starting point. We ask whether five frozen, independently trained models with different internal designs (four transformers from four organizations and one state-space model) can be related through their activations alone, with no weight merging. Using permutation tests, an independent replication probe set, depth sweeps, pooling ablations and confound checks, we find statistically robust correspondence between how the five models organize the same text. It is strongest at each model's final layer and weaker for the state-space model, whose weakest pairing is still 35-43 times chance. We use this to build a shared space with Generalized Procrustes Analysis, in which no model is a fixed reference. At the final layer, mean held-out retrieval accuracy over the twenty ordered model pairs is 0.91 to 0.93 on two probe sets (chance 0.03), beating pairwise linear maps (0.82 to 0.85), but the space is worse than those maps in the middle layers. It transfers to ordinary English of unfamiliar grammatical form and fails on mathematical and logical notation. We then test whether the space supports a router that picks among the five models on gradeable tasks. Across four task types we find no case where routing beats always using the strongest model, and we report this as a negative result. A correctness signal that looked strong turned out to be category membership in disguise. All experiments ran on one laptop without a GPU.

AI.tldr: 五个独立训练的冻结模型中，仅凭激活即可发现统计稳健的表征对应关系（末层最强），可构建无固定参考的共享空间用于跨模型检索与路由。
AI.motivation: 模型组合通常依赖权重平均，而该方法要求共享初始化。作者探究：内部结构各异、独立训练且冻结的模型，是否仅通过激活（而非权重合并）就能建立表征层面的对应关系。
AI.method: 5个冻结模型（4个来自不同机构的Transformer + 1个状态空间模型）。采用置换检验、独立复现探针集、深度扫描、池化消融与混杂因素检查验证对应性；用广义Procrustes分析（GPA）构建无固定参考的共享空间，并与成对线性映射对比。
AI.result: 对应关系在各模型末层最强，状态空间模型较弱但其最弱配对仍达随机水平的35–43倍。末层共享空间在20个有序模型对上的留出检索准确率均值为0.91–0.93（随机0.03），优于成对线性映射（0.82–0.85），但中间层劣于后者。可迁移至语法形式陌生的普通英语，在数学与逻辑符号上失败。路由实验为负结果：四类任务中路由均未超过始终使用最强模型；看似强的正确性信号实为类别归属的伪装。全部实验在单台无GPU笔记本上完成。
AI.conclusion: 独立训练的异构模型在激活层面存在可复现的表征对应，可支持无参考的多模型共享空间，但该空间尚不足以支撑有效的模型路由。

title: Small Edits, Shifting Decisions: Benchmarking LLM Accuracy and Reliability on French Input Variants
summary: French users may omit apostrophes and diacritics or make keyboard typos in everyday input. The effects of these common variations on language model performance and prediction reliability remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we construct a controlled French surface-variant benchmark covering seven task types, with 4,200 original-low-high triplets (12,600 input instances). Each high-intensity variant retains all low-intensity edits and adds further changes. We evaluate six models from two LLM families. The results show that accuracy decreases and Brier score and negative log-likelihood (NLL) increase with perturbation intensity. Larger models show smaller accuracy losses under high intensity, but increases in Brier score and NLL do not consistently decrease with scale. Keyboard typos cause the largest losses in accuracy and the quality of predicted probabilities at the predefined high-intensity settings. Finally, calibration temperatures fitted on original inputs transfer effectively to surface variants. Combining calibration with input restoration further improves Brier score and NLL over either method alone while preserving restored accuracy. Our benchmark provides a unified framework for jointly evaluating task accuracy and prediction reliability under common French surface variations.

AI.tldr: 构建法语表层变体基准（7任务、4200三联组、12600实例），评估两个LLM家族六模型发现：扰动强度越高准确率越低、Brier与NLL越差；大模型准确率损失更小但概率质量不随规模一致改善；键盘错字危害最大；原始输入拟合的校准温度可迁移，校准与输入还原结合效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 法语日常输入中常省略撇号和变音符号或出现键盘误打，这些常见表层变化对语言模型性能与预测可靠性的影响尚缺乏系统认识，需要一个受控基准来同时衡量任务准确率与概率校准质量。
AI.method: 构建受控法语表层变体基准：覆盖7类任务，4,200个"原始—低强度—高强度"三联组（共12,600条输入），高强度变体在保留低强度全部编辑的基础上追加改动；评估两个LLM家族的六个模型，以准确率、Brier分数和负对数似然（NLL）为指标，并按扰动强度和错字类型进行分层分析，另测试校准与输入还原策略。
AI.result: 随扰动强度增加，准确率下降，Brier分数与NLL上升；高强度下较大模型的准确率损失更小，但Brier与NLL的恶化并不随模型规模一致减小；在预设高强度设置下，键盘错字造成的准确率损失和预测概率质量下降最大；在原始输入上拟合的校准温度能有效迁移到表层变体；校准与输入还原结合，在保持还原后准确率的同时，较任一单独方法进一步改善Brier与NLL。
AI.conclusion: 该基准提供了在法语常见表层变化下联合评估任务准确率与预测可靠性的统一框架；模型规模并非概率可靠性的可靠保障，而校准温度迁移与输入还原的组合是提升鲁棒性与校准的有效实用手段。

title: Preference Optimization Improves Definition Generation: Semantic Change in EU Institutional Sustainable Finance Disclosures
comment: the 5th NLP4PI (NLP for Positive Impact) Workshop@EMNLP 2026
summary: Dictionary-like definition generators are known to be useful for lexical semantic change detection (LSCD). However, they suffer from overly granular sense distribution, producing excessive number of definitions for one and the same lexical sense. In this work, we show that fine-tuning with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) helps to overcome this problem. We test our approach both quantitatively on a curated academic LSCD benchmark and qualitatively on real-world data for a practical task of auditing diachronic changes in sustainability terminology within project documentation of EU development finance. All models, code and predictions produced in this study are publicly available at https://github.com/ltgoslo/dpo-for-definition-generation.

AI.tldr: 该文用DPO微调类词典定义生成器，缓解其义项划分过细、定义冗余的问题，并在LSCD基准与真实数据上验证效果。
AI.motivation: 类词典定义生成器在词汇语义变化检测（LSCD）中有效，但存在义项分布过细的问题：同一词义被生成大量重复定义，导致义项碎片化、冗余严重。
AI.method: 采用直接偏好优化（DPO）对定义生成模型进行微调，以抑制过度细分的义项生成；并在精选的学术LSCD基准上做定量评测，同时在真实数据上做定性分析。
AI.result: 定量结果表明DPO微调能缓解义项过度细分问题；定性实验在欧盟开发金融项目文件中可持续性术语的历时变化审计任务上展示了实用性。
AI.conclusion: DPO微调是提升类词典定义生成器义项粒度合理性的有效手段，可改善其在LSCD及实际术语审计任务中的可用性；模型、代码与预测均已公开。

title: The Emergence and Sparsification of a Syntactic Circuit
summary: To understand the emergence of grammatical behavior in language models, we track circuits for subject-verb number agreement in pythia-1b and ten seeds of pythia-410m across training. We find that subject-verb agreement is learned early, and is initially handled by a diffuse collection of neurons. However, after agreement behavior has stabilized, the mechanisms responsible for it continue to reorganize. The attention heads which mediate agreement often shift during training: in the case of pythia-1b, behavior is controlled by two heads early in training but by a third (different) head later. Furthermore, the circuit shrinks over training, with pythia-1b's final circuit being strikingly sparse. We take these results to be informative about how linguistic knowledge emerges and is represented in a language model.

AI.tldr: 该论文追踪Pythia模型训练过程中主语-动词数一致性(subject-verb agreement)的电路演化，发现一致性能力早期习得，但负责该行为的机制在行为稳定后仍持续重组：关键注意力头会发生替换，且电路随训练不断收缩，pythia-1b最终形成高度稀疏的电路。
AI.motivation: 为理解语言模型中语法行为的涌现机制，作者希望超越"行为是否习得"的表层观察，进一步探究支持语法能力的内在电路在训练过程中如何形成、演变与定型。
AI.method: 以pythia-1b及pythia-410m的十个随机种子为对象，跨训练检查点追踪主语-动词数一致性的电路，分析支持该行为的神经元与注意力头的构成、规模及随时间的变化。
AI.result: 主语-动词一致性习得较早，初期由弥散分布的神经元群体承担；行为稳定后电路仍在重组——中介一致性的注意力头常发生更替（pythia-1b早期由两个头控制，后期转由另一个不同的第三头控制）；电路规模随训练收缩，pythia-1b最终电路极为稀疏。
AI.conclusion: 语法能力在语言模型中的涌现与其表征具有"行为先定型、机制后精简"的特点：功能稳定不等于机制稳定，训练后期电路会收敛为更稀疏、更专一的实现，这为理解语言知识如何在模型中涌现与被表征提供了实证依据。

title: Hey, guess what: CUES lead to inferences about typicality
summary: Throughout life, we accumulate knowledge of how typical certain events are. We use this knowledge in daily conversation, often interpreting meaning beyond what has been said explicitly. In this work, we take steps to better understand this meaning recovery, investigating both atypicality and typicality inferences. First, we construct two corpora, EventTyp and the human-validated EventTypGold. We conduct large-scale human and LLM experiments and find that for humans, three CUES predict inferences about typicality: Commonsense Knowledge, Utterance Emphasis, and Snark. However, in most experimental settings, we find that LLMs lack the prerequisite Commonsense Knowledge necessary to accurately assess an event's general typicality, and therefore struggle to follow these CUES.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了EventTyp与经人工验证的EventTypGold两个语料库，通过大规模人类与LLM实验研究事件典型性推断，提出人类推断遵循Commonsense Knowledge、Utterance Emphasis、Snark三类线索（CUES），并发现LLM普遍缺乏必要常识知识，难以准确判断事件典型性。
AI.motivation: 人们终生积累关于事件典型程度的概率性知识，并用于日常对话中推断言外之意。但典型性/非典型性推断这一意义恢复过程的机制尚不清楚，且LLM能否胜任此类推断缺乏实证检验。
AI.method: 构建两个语料库：EventTyp及经人类验证的EventTypGold；在此基础上开展大规模人类受试者实验与大模型实验，对比二者在典型性与非典型性推断中的表现，并分析预测推断的关键线索。
AI.result: 人类对典型性的推断由三类线索预测：常识知识（Commonsense Knowledge）、话语强调（Utterance Emphasis）与讽刺（Snark）。而在大多数实验设置下，LLM缺乏准确评估事件一般典型性所需的前置常识知识，因而难以遵循这些线索。
AI.conclusion: 典型性推断的可解释线索框架得以确立（CUES），并揭示LLM在该任务上的核心瓶颈在于常识知识缺失，而非线索利用策略本身；为后续借助外部知识增强或评测设计改进提供了依据。

title: Position Matters More Than Channel: Talking a Language Model Out of a Correct Answer
summary: Language models now answer questions alongside other claims: a note in the system prompt, a message from another agent, their own earlier answer. We ask what it takes to talk a model out of an answer it gets right on its own, and separate three factors that earlier studies vary together: where the advice sits in the prompt, who is said to have written it, and what the model has already written. On Qwen3.5-27B and four-option MMLU-Pro items, with the rest of the advice held fixed in each comparison, we find three things. First, position matters far more than the API channel, in opposite directions for a bare claim and an argument: a bare "the answer is X" does most harm just before the model answers, while the same claim with a false rationale does most harm before the question, where it raises error on items the model otherwise almost never misses from 1% to 67%; moving the claim between the system message and the user message at the same position changes error by a few points. Second, attributing the note to an authority rather than to another participant, and phrasing it assertively, each raise error by 10-27 points, while the two authorities we tested differ by under two. Third, replaying a correct worked answer before the advice protects it whether the text is shown as the model's own or as someone else's, and the same replay keeps wrong answers from being corrected by a bare correct note. The position result replicates under an independently written prompt. Code, items and all result tables are released at https://github.com/coolkillercat/safety.

AI.tldr: 该文系统解耦了"建议"的三个混杂因素（位置、署名来源、模型已有输出），发现位置影响远超API通道且方向相反，署名权威性与断言语气各提升10-27点错误率，而回放正确推理过程可保护答案。
AI.motivation: 先前研究在考察模型被"说服"改变答案时，将建议在提示中的位置、署名来源、模型已写内容三类因素混杂在一起，无法判断各自贡献。本文旨在拆解这些因素，明确究竟什么条件能"劝服"一个本可答对的模型改错。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.5-27B与四选项MMLU-Pro题目上，每次比较中固定建议其余属性、仅改变单一变量：改变建议在提示中的位置（问题前/作答前）与API通道（系统消息/用户消息）；比较署名来源（权威 vs 其他参与者）与语气（断言式）；并测试在建议前回放正确或错误的完整解题过程（归属为本模型或他人）。位置结论另用独立撰写的提示复现。
AI.result: 位置影响远大于通道差异，且裸断言与带虚假理由的论证方向相反：裸"答案是X"在作答前危害最大，带虚假理由的版本在问题前危害最大，使原本几乎不出错的题目错误率从1%升至67%；同位置下系统消息与用户消息切换仅改变几点错误率。归属权威与断言语气各使错误率上升10-27点，而两种权威间差异不足2点。回放正确答案可保护正确回答（无论归属自身或他人），同时使裸正确提示无法纠正错误答案。
AI.conclusion: 影响模型改答的关键因素是建议的位置、署名与语气，而非渠道；虚假论证在问题前插入风险最高。回放模型自身或他人的正确推理是有效的防护手段，但也会固化既有错误。代码、题目与全部结果表已开源。

title: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
summary: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user's activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user. Grounded in a coherent persona with 3,051 past activity events, iPrefBench comprises 130 underspecified user tasks across 26 apps. Each omitted user-dependent requirement is, by construction, either history-inferable or ask-only. iPrefBench evaluates personalized mobile agents on both whether agents complete tasks correctly for the user (i.e., personalized task completion) and whether they seek user input when necessary (i.e., user-agent interaction). Evaluation of 7 frontier agents reveals a substantial gap between execution and personalization. Agents achieve high action completion scores (up to 91.6%) but low full task success (up to 47.7%) because personalization lags behind. They especially struggle with ask-only information, failing to request enough necessary information. Our findings highlight a challenge for personalized agents in knowing what to infer and when to ask. We hope that iPrefBench can serve as a valuable testbed for building agents that know their user and work with them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出iPrefBench，一个在可执行iOS环境中评估个人移动端使用型智能体"推断"与"询问"能力的基准：基于含3051条历史活动的连贯用户画像，构建26款应用上的130个信息欠指定任务，分别评估个性化任务完成度与人机交互质量。
AI.motivation: 现有computer-use智能体擅长执行完全指定的任务，但真实用户请求常欠指定。智能体需从用户活动历史推断缺失信息、对仅用户可提供的信息主动询问，且不作无依据假设、不施加多余问题负担；而缺少评测此类能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建iPrefBench：可执行iOS环境+可交互模拟用户；以连贯persona（3051条历史事件）为基础设计130个欠指定任务，覆盖26个应用；每个被省略的用户依赖需求在构造上被严格划分为"可由历史推断"或"只能询问"两类；从个性化任务完成与用户-智能体交互两个维度评测。
AI.result: 评测7个前沿智能体显示执行能力与个性化能力存在显著差距：动作完成分高达91.6%，但完整任务成功率仅47.7%；在"只能询问"类信息上表现尤差，未能充分请求必要信息。
AI.conclusion: 个性化智能体的核心挑战在于判断"什么该推断、何时该询问"；iPrefBench可作为构建"了解用户并与之协作"的智能体的测试平台。

title: Heard Enough to Act: Early Tool Calling in Spoken Dialogue Systems
summary: Latency-sensitive spoken agents must know not only which tool to call, but also when they have heard enough to act. Waiting for the turn to complete delays execution even when the request is already actionable. However, neither existing spoken agents nor spoken dialogue corpora define the earliest point at which a request becomes actionable. We introduce a synthetic spoken-dialogue pipeline that provides earliest-actionable-point supervision, marking when the observed speech grounds a tool and its required arguments. Through controlled task generation, speech synthesis and alignment, and gated annotation, we construct 26,694 dialogues totaling 786 hours across 48 domains, with disjoint training and test argument values. We additionally create an audio rendering of $τ^2$-bench for external evaluation. We train an omni-modal language model on this corpus, enabling causal, chunk-level decisions and partial-transcript generation for downstream call completion. The model achieves tool-state macro-F1 scores of 0.48 and 0.47 on held-out dialogues and the external benchmark, respectively. For correct calls, the estimated mean lead over a turn-end cascade, using the same formatter, is 1.8-2.0 seconds in-domain and 1.1 seconds on $τ^2$-bench. These results demonstrate a data-driven path toward spoken agents that act while listening. We will open-source the pipeline and the training scripts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出带"最早可执行点"监督的合成语音对话流水线，构建大规模语料并训练全模态模型，使语音智能体在听的过程中即可触发工具调用。
AI.motivation: 延迟敏感的语音智能体不仅需判断调用哪个工具，还需判断何时信息已足够行动。等待整轮结束才执行会引入不必要延迟，但现有语音智能体与语音对话语料均未定义"请求最早变为可执行"的时间点。
AI.method: 构建合成语音对话流水线：受控任务生成 + 语音合成与对齐 + 门控标注，标注"已观测语音足以支撑某工具及其必需参数"的最早可执行点；共生成26,694段对话、786小时、48个领域，训练/测试参数值不相交；另制作τ²-bench的音频版本用于外部评测。基于该语料训练全模态语言模型，实现因果、分块级决策与部分转写生成以完成下游调用。
AI.result: 在留出对话与外部基准上，工具状态宏F1分别为0.48和0.47；对正确调用，使用相同格式化器相较"轮末级联"方案的估计平均领先时长为域内1.8–2.0秒，τ²-bench上1.1秒。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了一条数据驱动的路径，使语音智能体能够"边听边行动"；作者将开源流水线与训练脚本。

title: Does the Outfit Change the Price? Context Halo in Vision-Language Model Valuation of an Identical Low-Cost Necklace
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/BraveAnn011/ai-halo-valuation-bias
summary: A chunky gold-tone chain necklace bought online for 2.43 USD was photographed four ways: worn with formal attire against a wood-panelled wall, worn at a party, worn with casual clothing in a recycling yard, and laid flat with no person present. We asked six frontier language models to estimate its price in 1,164 independent and sequential API sessions (4,604 logged rows) and compared estimates across settings. Among the four models that answered image prompts, the same necklace was priced 1.9 to 3.3 times higher in the formal photograph than in the flat-lay (all p < 0.01). Against the yard photograph, the ratio ranged from 1.23 (Grok 4.5, not significant) to 3.57 (Kimi K3), with Claude Fable 5 at 3.32. A text-only version of the task, in which the setting is described in words, produced formal-to-yard ratios of 2.2 to 3.9 in all six models, so the effect does not require pixels. Flat-lay estimates themselves were 7.8 to 18.7 times the receipt price, so part of any headline "outfit multiplier" computed against the receipt is baseline overestimate, not a context effect. A single instruction to ignore clothing and setting significantly reduced the effect in one model (ratio of ratios 0.77, 95% CI 0.65 to 0.91) and not detectably in the others; telling the model the photo came from a company website or a personal account changed nothing significant. Asked afterward whether a different outfit would have changed their number, Claude Fable 5 said yes in 24 of 24 sessions, GPT-5.6 in 69%, and GPT-4o in 18%, while GPT-4o also refused 79% of image estimation prompts. The study isolates a mechanism with one object and one wearer at about 10 sessions per model and condition; we outline the replication needed next, with multiple objects and a human benchmark. Data, code, and raw outputs are released.

AI.tldr: 同一件廉价项链在正式着装、派对、废品回收场、平铺四种场景下被多款前沿语言模型估价，正式照相对平铺/回收场的估价高1.2–3.6倍，纯文本描述亦复现该效应，说明"穿搭/场景乘数"部分来自情境效应、部分来自基线高估。
AI.motivation: 检验多模态与语言模型在物品定价上是否受"着装与拍摄场景"这类无关情境线索影响，并区分"情境乘数"与模型本身的基线高估。
AI.method: 以网购价2.43美元的仿金链条项链为单一对象，控制同一佩戴者拍摄四种场景（正式着装+木饰墙、派对、休闲装+回收场、无人平铺）。6个前沿模型、1,164次独立与顺序API会话、4,604条记录；对比四种模型的图像提示估计，并设置纯文本场景描述版本、加入"忽略服装与场景"指令、"公司官网/个人账户"来源提示，以及会话后追问是否换装会改变估计。
AI.result: 四款可处理图像提示的模型中，正式照比平铺估价高1.9–3.3倍（均p<0.01）；相对回收场照，比值从1.23（Grok 4.5，不显著）到3.57（Kimi K3），Claude Fable 5为3.32。纯文本版本六模型正式/回收场比值2.2–3.9，效应不依赖像素。平铺估价本身为实付价的7.8–18.7倍，即对收据价计算的"穿搭乘数"含基线高估成分。单条"忽略服装与场景"指令仅在一个模型显著削弱效应（比值之比0.77，95% CI 0.65–0.91）；来源提示无显著影响。追问是否换装会改变数字：Claude Fable 5为24/24，GPT-5.6为69%，GPT-4o为18%；GPT-4o对79%的图像估价提示拒答。
AI.conclusion: 研究在单对象、单佩戴者、每模型每条件约10次会话的限制下分离出情境线索影响估价的机制，效应同时存在于视觉与纯文本输入，需以多物件与人类基准进行复制验证；数据、代码与原始输出已公开。

title: A Contextual Measure of Ambiguity in Prescriptive Text
summary: Ambiguity in prescriptive text such as laws, contracts, rules, policies, or recommendations can be both desirable (e.g., if it enables a law to adapt to changing context, such as new technologies) and undesirable (e.g., if it leads to arbitrary discretion or conflict over the law's interpretation). To help navigate these trade-offs, it would be valuable to have methods for quantifying ambiguity that are predictive of such outcomes, but existing measures capture how text is perceived in isolation rather than how it is interpreted in context. In this paper, we propose quantifying ambiguity as the degree of disagreement among a set of stakeholders ("raters") on how alternative prescriptive texts ("policies") apply in each of a set of relevant scenarios ("cases"). Using two policy domains, we present preliminary analysis suggesting that, even when using simulated raters, this approach (i) correlates with real human disagreement, and (ii) is robust to spurious text features. We then apply the measure to existing deliberation datasets to describe the association between policy ambiguity and support for those policies.

AI.tldr: 提出将规范性文本（法律、合同、规则、政策等）的歧义量化为多利益相关方（"评分者"）在多个相关情境（"案例"）下对备选政策适用性判断的不一致程度，并用两个政策领域的模拟评分者初步验证该度量与真实人类分歧相关、对虚假文本特征稳健，进而刻画政策歧义与政策支持度之间的关联。
AI.motivation: 规范性文本的歧义具有双面性：既可能使规则适应新情境（如新技术），也可能导致任意裁量或解释冲突。为权衡取舍，需要能预测此类后果的歧义量化方法；但现有度量只刻画文本在孤立状态下的感知，而非其在具体情境中的解释方式。
AI.method: 将歧义定义为：一组利益相关方（raters）就若干备选规范性文本（policies）在一组相关情境（cases）中如何适用所产生的分歧程度。在两个政策领域中使用模拟评分者进行初步分析，验证该度量的效度与稳健性，并将其应用于现有的审议（deliberation）数据集。
AI.result: 初步分析表明：(i) 即使使用模拟评分者，该度量仍与真实人类分歧相关；(ii) 该度量对虚假文本特征（spurious text features）具有稳健性。将其应用于既有审议数据后，描述了政策歧义与政策支持度之间的关联。
AI.conclusion: 歧义应被理解为情境化的解释分歧而非孤立的文本属性；所提情境化、多评分者分歧度量可作为预测歧义后果的可行工具，并可用于分析歧义与政策支持的关系。

title: An Algorithmic Account of Few-Shot Concept Induction in Language Models
summary: Both models and minds not only encode features that describe an entity, but can specifically represent which features of that entity are relevant for a given context. This core capability underlies in-context learning in language models and a variety of cognitive phenomena in minds, yet it is unclear how intelligent systems identify and promote relevant features. In this work, we propose Amortized Direction Accentuation (ADA), an algorithmic hypothesis that provides an explanation for how relevance is determined in the context of few-shot concept induction --- the ability to infer a latent concept from a small number of positive examples. Under ADA, concept induction proceeds by forming a summary representation of the examples in a feature space that is shaped by amortized knowledge about which features tend to be useful for finding commonalities between items. We investigate and validate ADA in language models using a few-shot concept induction task. This work provides a novel perspective on the mechanisms supporting contextualization in language models and a promising hypothesis for a core aspect of cognition.

AI.tldr: 提出Amortized Direction Accentuation (ADA)，一种解释少样本概念归纳中"相关性如何被确定"的算法假设：在由摊销知识塑造的特征空间中，对示例形成汇总表征。
AI.motivation: 模型与心智不仅能编码实体特征，还能表征哪些特征在特定情境下相关，这一能力支撑语言模型的上下文学习与多种认知现象，但智能系统如何识别并凸显相关特征尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出ADA算法假设：概念归纳通过对少样本正例在特征空间中形成汇总表征来实现，该特征空间由"哪些特征有助于发现项目间共性"的摊销知识所塑造；并在语言模型上以少样本概念归纳任务进行验证。
AI.result: 在语言模型的少样本概念归纳任务中研究并验证了ADA，表明其对相关性判定机制具有解释力。
AI.conclusion: 为语言模型中支持情境化的机制提供了新视角，并为认知的一个核心方面提供了有前景的假设。

title: ImgMT: Wikipedia-based Dataset For Evaluating Text-in-Image Translation
summary:
Text-in-image translation aims to translate all textual content embedded in an image. In Text Image Translation (TIT), the output is translated text; In-Image Machine Translation (IIMT) additionally renders the translation back into the image. We introduce ImgMT, a massively multilingual dataset and benchmark mined from localized SVG illustrations on Wikimedia Commons, focusing on diagrams, maps, and infographics. ImgMT contains 35,612 aligned image pairs grouped into 1,855 image sets, spanning 129 languages, 20+ writing systems, and 4,886 language pairs.
  We propose a multi-level evaluation protocol that measures source-side text-region detection and OCR accuracy alongside target-side translation quality. We benchmark several multimodal large language models and a dedicated TIT system in English->X and X->English settings, and find that the source language and writing system substantially affect TIT quality. Finally, we show that ImgMT is not well suited for isolating the contribution of visual information in multimodal translation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ImgMT：从 Wikimedia Commons 本地化 SVG 插图中挖掘的大规模多语图文翻译数据集与基准，含 35,612 对对齐图像、1,855 个图像组，覆盖 129 种语言、20+ 书写系统和 4,886 个语言对，并提出多层次评测协议。
AI.motivation: 文本图像翻译（TIT）需翻译图像内全部文本，图像内机器翻译（IIMT）还需将译文回渲到图像中；该任务缺乏大规模、多语言、多书写系统的评测资源，且源语言与书写系统对质量的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 从 Wikimedia Commons 的本地化 SVG 插图中挖掘数据（聚焦图表、地图、信息图），构建对齐图像对与图像组；提出多层次评测协议，同时衡量源端文本区域检测与 OCR 准确率、以及目标端译文质量；在英→X 与 X→英 设置下评测多个多模态大语言模型与一个专用 TIT 系统。
AI.result: 源语言与书写系统显著影响 TIT 质量；ImgMT 并不适合用于分离多模态翻译中视觉信息的贡献。
AI.conclusion: ImgMT 提供了大规模多语 TIT/IIMT 基准与多层次评测框架，揭示语言与书写系统的强影响，并指出该数据在视觉信息消融研究上的局限，为后续数据与评测设计提供参考。

title: Task Format as a Factor in Adaptation: A Controlled Comparison of LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning for Prompt-Safety Classification
comment: 33 pages (14 pages main text, plus references and appendices), 1 figure, 18 tables
summary: Fine-tuning a language model for classification involves many design decisions. Comparisons of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with full fine-tuning are common but often confounded, and task format is rarely studied. We compare both regimes on prompt-safety classification with a matched 400M encoder-decoder pair (Ettin) across three task formats, with up to 15 seeds per cell and pre-specified analyses. At the pre-specified learning rates, full fine-tuning leads LoRA by 2-3 pp in every architecture and format trained on the label alone. On the encoder, the gap closes once both rates are chosen by the same search. Training LoRA to write a reason after its verdict adds 4.0 pp and closes the gap, but a content-free sentence of equal length does not. Trained models score above a prompted 8B in domain but fall behind it on two of three out-of-distribution corpora, trailing by 8-23 pp on adversarial jailbreaks and flagging 27-66% of benign but harmful-looking prompts as unsafe, against the 8B's 2-3%. Together, the results suggest that the adaptation regime matters less than how each model is trained, its learning rate, and training target, and that in-domain accuracy alone is an incomplete guide to robustness.

AI.tldr: 在匹配的400M编码器-解码器模型上系统比较LoRA与全量微调，发现学习率与训练目标（是否生成理由）比适配方式本身更关键，且域内准确率不足以反映鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LoRA与全量微调的比较研究常见但常受混淆因素干扰（学习率、任务格式未统一），且任务格式本身鲜有研究。作者希望用严格预注册、多随机种子的对照实验厘清适配机制的真实影响，并评估模型在分布外与对抗场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 在prompt安全分类任务上，用参数量匹配的400M Ettin编码器-解码器对，比较全量微调与LoRA；覆盖三种任务格式，每格最多15个随机种子，采用预注册分析；控制学习率搜索方式（固定预设值vs同一搜索流程）；并设置LoRA在判决后生成理由、以及等长无内容句子的对照条件。
AI.result: 在预设学习率下，仅用标签训练时全量微调在各架构与格式上均领先LoRA 2-3个百分点；在编码器上若两者采用同一学习率搜索，差距消失。LoRA判决后生成理由带来+4.0 pp增益并消除差距，而等长无内容句子无效。训练模型在域内优于提示的8B模型，但在三个分布外语料中的两个上落后，对抗越狱提示上落后8-23 pp，且将27-66%的良性但看似有害提示误判为不安全（8B仅2-3%）。
AI.conclusion: 适配机制（LoRA vs 全量微调）的影响小于训练方式、学习率与训练目标的影响；仅凭域内准确率评估模型是不充分的，需纳入分布外与对抗鲁棒性指标。

title: Rethinking Evaluation for Principled Generalization Using a Kripkean Challenge to Meaning as Use
summary: Large language models operationalize an intuitive, view of meaning as use. We argue that it faces a rule-following challenge. Using Kripke's interpretation of Wittgenstein, we argue that finite histories of use do not determine a unique rule for future extension. This reframes the debate about OOD generalization but also about NLP evaluation; benchmarks that measure performance on fixed use cases or local robustness, we argue, do not by themselves establish semantic competence. To evaluate whether models preserve rules and concepts under principled domain extension, we propose to evaluate two capacities, central to this ability: abstraction and recursion; and we offer an experimental paradigm for testing both.

AI.tldr: 本文指出"意义即使用"这一直觉观点面临克里普克式"遵守规则"难题：有限的用法历史无法唯一确定未来扩展规则，据此重新审视OOD泛化与NLP评测，并提出以抽象与递归两项能力为核心的实验范式。
AI.motivation: LLM在操作层面实现了"意义即使用"的直觉观点，但该观点存在哲学上的缺陷：基于有限用法历史无法唯一确定规则，因而固定用例上的benchmark表现或局部鲁棒性本身不足以证明语义能力。
AI.method: 借助克里普克对维特根斯坦的解读论证"遵守规则"难题，将OOD泛化与NLP评测问题重新框定；提出评测模型在有原则的领域扩展下是否保持规则与概念的两项核心能力——抽象与递归，并设计相应实验范式。
AI.result: 论证表明现有benchmark（固定用例性能、局部鲁棒性）不能独立确立语义能力；需通过抽象与递归能力的测试来检验规则在领域扩展下的一致性保持。
AI.conclusion: NLP评测应从固定用例性能转向对抽象与递归能力的检验，以判定模型是否真正掌握规则与概念而非仅拟合用法历史。

title: Useful Diversity or Hallucinated Variety? Persona-Conditioned Synthetic Query Generation for E-Commerce Search
comment: Accepted at IJCNLP-AACL 2026 (Findings). 20 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables
summary: Synthetic supervision can bootstrap semantic parsers in new search domains, but prompt-induced diversity is useful only when generations are faithful to the structured intent. We explore this for cold-start e-commerce search: 118,098 synthetic pairs produced by 6 LLMs with 9 persona-conditioned prompt families on a 47-field UK automotive schema, against 1,214 human-annotated and 15,304 production queries. We show that the IPIP personality bundle improves parser F1 in all four matched contrasts (Holm-corrected $p<.001$), and all three bundles have a positive main effect over the complete $2^3$ grid. Syntax conditioning is the axis that moves generations towards real traffic. It also induces lexical diversity. Alignment sKL, the divergence between von Mises-Fisher distributions fitted to synthetic and human-annotated queries, is an unlabelled proxy for parser F1 ($ρ=-0.917$ against human queries written for simulated shopper scenarios, lower is closer). An LLM committee, checked against a blinded author pass, triages the 927 queries missed by every parser and labels 37% as hallucinated. Dropped constraints dominate. The four syntax-bearing families have the largest hallucinated shares, 38 to 42%, while IPIP alone has the lowest at 28%.

AI.tldr: 本文在冷启动电商搜索场景下，系统评估了6个LLM、9种人格/句法条件化提示族生成的118,098条合成数据对语义解析器的作用，发现IPIP人格束在全部匹配对比中均提升F1，句法条件化最能逼近真实流量分布，并提出alignment sKL作为无标注F1代理指标（ρ=-0.917）。
AI.motivation: 合成监督可为新搜索域引导语义解析器，但提示诱导的多样性只有在生成内容忠实于结构化意图时才有价值；因此需要在冷启动电商搜索（47字段英国汽车schema）中考察何种提示条件化能同时带来有效的解析器增益与贴近真实流量的分布。
AI.method: 构建118,098条合成查询（6个LLM × 9种persona条件化提示族），并与1,214条人工标注查询和15,304条生产查询对照；在完整2^3网格上做匹配对比并用Holm校正检验三种提示束的主效应；用拟人化shopper场景人工查询作为参照，提出alignment sKL（合成与人工查询拟合的von Mises-Fisher分布间散度）作为解析器F1的无标注代理；最后用LLM委员会（经盲审作者复核校准）对全部解析器均失败的927条查询进行错误归因。
AI.result: IPIP人格束在4组匹配对比中均提升解析器F1（Holm校正p<.001），三种提示束在完整2^3网格上均有正向主效应；句法条件化是使生成分布向真实流量偏移的关键轴，同时带来词汇多样性；alignment sKL与F1呈强负相关（ρ=-0.917）；LLM委员会将37%的全解析器失败查询判为幻觉，丢约束（dropped constraints）占主导；四个含句法条件的提示族幻觉占比最高（38–42%），仅IPIP最低（28%）。
AI.conclusion: 提示条件化维度对合成监督的效用并不等价：人格（IPIP）维度直接提升解析器精度，句法维度改善分布贴近度与词汇多样性但带来更高幻觉率；alignment sKL可作为低成本无标注的解析器质量筛选信号，而丢约束是合成查询幻觉的主要形态，应在数据生成与过滤中优先治理。

title: From Questions to Queries to Insights: A Schema-Grounded Agentic Workflow for Natural-Language Crash Data Analysis
summary: Transportation agencies maintain extensive crash databases to identify safety priorities, evaluate countermeasures, and guide resource allocation. Making these data accessible to practitioners requires flexible ways to translate analytical questions into reliable results. Existing dashboards support predefined analyses, while additional requests often depend on specialists who understand database queries, coded fields, and agency conventions. This study presents CrashDB-QA, a fully local, schema-grounded agentic workflow that enables natural-language analysis of crash databases. Specialized components interpret questions, generate and validate read-only SQL, execute queries, and explain the results. A shared knowledge base grounds query construction in the agency's data dictionary and safety-analysis conventions, while recorded intermediate outputs support inspection and auditing. An optional extension, CrashDB-QA+, checks the alignment among the question, query, and execution result and supplies evidence for iterative repair. We evaluate the workflow on a frozen snapshot of 4.4 million Wisconsin crash records using a new benchmark of 300 questions across ten analytical categories and nine local open-weight models. Domain grounding substantially improves query accuracy, and a code-specialized 7B model provides the best accuracy-latency balance among the tested models. Compositional analyses remain more difficult than routine retrieval, particularly comparisons between groups or periods. Verification improves performance when the Judge uses authoritative field definitions and the Refiner receives execution evidence, whereas additional checking alone offers no consistent benefit. These findings demonstrate the potential of locally deployed, domain-grounded workflows to broaden access to crash analysis and identify the reasoning and verification capabilities needed for reliable use.

AI.tldr: 提出全本地、基于模式（schema-grounded）的智能体工作流CrashDB-QA，用自然语言分析4.4百万条威斯康星州碰撞数据库；域知识接入显著提升查询准确率，7B代码专用模型在精度-延迟上最优。
AI.motivation: 交通机构维护大规模碰撞数据库，但现有看板仅支持预定义分析，新需求依赖懂数据库查询、编码字段和机构规范的专业人员，限制了数据可及性。
AI.method: 构建CrashDB-QA：模块化组件负责问题解析、只读SQL生成与校验、执行与结果解释；共享知识库以机构数据字典和安全分析规范约束查询构造，并记录中间输出以支持审计。可选扩展CrashDB-QA+对问题、查询、执行结果三者一致性进行校验并提供证据以迭代修复。在4.4百万条记录快照与300题、10类分析、9个本地开源权重模型的基准上评测。
AI.result: 域知识接地大幅提升查询准确率；代码专用7B模型在测试模型中精度-延迟权衡最佳；组合型分析（尤其组间/时段比较）明显难于常规检索；当Judge使用权威字段定义、Refiner获得执行证据时校验带来增益，而单纯增加检查无稳定收益。
AI.conclusion: 本地部署的域接地智能体工作流可拓宽碰撞分析的可及性，同时指明可靠使用所需的推理与校验能力方向。

title: Synthetic Child-Adult Interactions Are Not Developmentally Plausible
summary: Synthetic data has become a common resource for training language models, and this trend has spilled over into research on developmentally plausible language modeling. However, it remains unclear whether LM-generated child-adult interactions actually resemble natural ones. We compare the synthetic TinyDialogues dataset to natural dialogue across a broad range of linguistic measures. While synthetic data matches natural data on the lexical level, it drastically underestimates the messy, fragmented nature of spoken interaction. To mitigate this, we propose instruction-tuning with data created from real dialogues, and show in a pilot study that a small model approximates the statistical tendencies of natural data after moderate parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统比较了合成儿童—成人对话数据集TinyDialogues与自然对话的差异：合成数据在词汇层面匹配自然数据，但严重低估了口语交互的破碎、零散特性；作者提出用真实对话构造数据进行指令微调，试点实验显示小模型经中等程度参数高效微调后能逼近自然数据的统计倾向。
AI.motivation: 合成数据已成为语言模型训练的常见资源，并渗透到"发展上合理的语言建模"研究；但LM生成的儿童—成人交互是否真正类似自然交互尚不清楚，需要实证检验。
AI.method: 在广泛的语言学指标维度上，将合成的TinyDialogues数据集与自然对话进行对比；针对发现的缺陷，提出用真实对话构建数据进行指令微调（instruction-tuning），并开展试点研究，采用参数高效微调（PEFT）训练小模型。
AI.result: 合成数据在词汇层面与自然数据相当，但大幅低估了口语交互的杂乱与碎片化特征；试点研究表明，小模型经过中等规模参数高效微调后，能够近似自然数据的统计倾向。
AI.conclusion: LM生成的合成对话不能替代自然对话的统计特性，尤其无法复现口语的破碎性；以真实对话为基础的指令微调是可行的缓解路径，可提升模型对自然数据统计分布的逼近程度。

title: When the Persona Contradicts the Line: Diagnosing Plan-to-Synthesis Failures in Chain-of-Thought TTS
summary: Chain-of-thought TTS systems rely on language-model planners to translate persona and context into vocal delivery, but it is unclear where this intent is lost when the requested affect conflicts with lexical sentiment. We introduce a bilingual Japanese--English persona--line conflict benchmark in which each item pairs one line with congruent and conflicting personas and pre-declares the expected acoustic direction. We probe this direction in the planner-generated delivery phrase, the planner-written emotion vector, the QwenEmotion-generated vector, and the rendered waveform. Planner outputs are usually direction-correct, while downstream agreement can be substantially lower. Bypassing QwenEmotion provides only modest gains over the full planner-controlled Base. Supervising QwenEmotion raises the direction rate to 75% in Japanese and 84% in English. A learned text-to-latent interface reaches the highest English rate of 89% and the highest Japanese arousal rate of 88%. These results show that learned repair of the plan-to-synthesis interface can recover counter-textual delivery, although its effect differs across languages and acoustic axes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建日英双语"人设—台词冲突"基准，沿规划短语、情绪向量到波形的链路逐级探测"意图"流失，并证明学习式文本到潜变量接口可修复反文本情感的语音表达。
AI.motivation: Chain-of-thought TTS 依赖语言模型规划器将人设与语境转化为发声方式，但当所要求的情感与文本字面情感冲突时，意图在链路哪一环节丢失并不清楚。
AI.method: 构造双语 person—line 冲突基准，每条台词配一致/冲突人设，并预先声明期望的声学方向；在规划器生成的 delivery phrase、规划器写作的情绪向量、QwenEmotion 生成向量以及渲染波形四个环节上探测该方向；对比绕过 QwenEmotion、监督 QwenEmotion，以及学习式 text-to-latent 接口三种方案。
AI.result: 规划器输出方向大多正确，但下游一致性显著更低；绕过 QwenEmotion 相对完整规划器控制的 Base 仅有小幅提升；监督 QwenEmotion 将方向正确率提升至日语 75%、英语 84%；学习式 text-to-latent 接口取得最高英语 89%、最高日语唤醒度 88%。
AI.conclusion: 对 plan-to-synthesis 接口进行学习式修复可恢复反文本情感的发声，但效果随语言与声学维度而异。

title: RubriX: A Fast, Fine-Tunable Non-Autoregressive Rubric Judge
summary: Rubric-based evaluation asks which level of a rubric a response meets. It is usually done by prompting a large language model (LLM) as a judge, which needs a generative call per judgment and reads every level description, so its cost grows with the rubric. We present RubriX, a rubric judge whose architecture is inspired by contrastive language models (CLM): a LoRA-adapted encoder embeds the input and each level description, and a softmax over scaled cosine similarities gives a probability for every level without text generation. Trained on public rubric data and proprietary synthetic data, RubriX reaches 75.4% exact accuracy on held-out rubrics, against 57.1% for TypeSafe's Jev and 49.8% for a Qwen3-8B judge. On eight human-labelled benchmark sets it is within 6 percentage points of Jev's accuracy on most of them, while Jev keeps a larger lead on two and ranks responses best on average; against the results reported in the G-Eval paper, RubriX outperforms G-Eval with GPT-3.5 on every SummEval dimension and both QAGS subsets. With level embeddings cached, RubriX's latency stays at about 28 ms per judgment as level descriptions grow from 10 to 3,000 tokens, while Jev's (approximate network time subtracted) rises from 44 ms to 211 ms and the Qwen3-8B judge's from 32 ms to 516 ms, making RubriX 7.7x faster than Jev and 18.8x faster than the Qwen3-8B judge at 3,000 tokens per level.

AI.tldr: The paper presents RubriX, a rubric-based evaluation judge with a contrastive-language-model-style architecture that maps inputs and rubric level descriptions into an embedding space and classifies levels via cosine-similarity softmax, avoiding generative calls and reading all rubric levels at inference.
AI.motivation: Conventional LLM-as-judge rubric evaluation requires one generative call per judgment and consumes every level description as input, so cost and latency grow with rubric size; a cheaper, scalable judge is needed.
AI.method: A LoRA-adapted encoder embeds the input and each level description; a softmax over scaled cosine similarities yields a probability per level without text generation. Trained on public rubric data plus proprietary synthetic data. Level embeddings can be cached.
AI.result: 75.4% exact accuracy on held-out rubrics vs. 57.1% (Jev) and 49.8% (Qwen3-8B judge); within 6 points of Jev on most of eight human-labelled benchmarks (Jev leads on two and ranks best on average); beats G-Eval with GPT-3.5 on all SummEval dimensions and both QAGS subsets; latency ~28 ms flat as levels grow 10→3,000 tokens vs. 44→211 ms (Jev) and 32→516 ms (Qwen3-8B), i.e., 7.7x and 18.8x faster at 3,000 tokens.
AI.conclusion: Discriminative, embedding-based judging with cached level embeddings offers substantial efficiency and strong accuracy, though Jev retains better ranking quality on average, indicating trade-offs remain in comparative ranking.

title: When Personas Become Harmful: Guiding LLMs with Global Citizenship Values Alignment
summary: LLMs are increasingly being used by users from diverse demographics with pluralistic values and distinct backgrounds. Maintaining safety while respecting value-laden personas is uniquely challenging because persona-conditioned requests are often not overtly malicious, unlike those in existing safety benchmarks. Alignment methods aimed at adversarial requests therefore may miss the harm that emerges from persona use, leaving models to either refuse legitimate value expression or blindly follow unsafe personas. We construct a dataset of 11k controversial topics paired with value-based personas mapping to value dimensions from the Schwartz Value Survey. Through an agentic pipeline that iteratively refines the topic and persona, we surface and collect harmful responses from well-aligned commercial LLMs with a more than 47% success rate. We use UNESCO's global citizenship principles as a minimal common ground for distinguishing valid value expressions from harmful behaviors, and introduce a controllable alignment model that lets users balance persona adherence and safety at inference time. The resulting model is safer and more persona-adherent than baselines on most samples.

AI.tldr: 论文提出价值人格条件下的LLM安全数据集（11k争议话题×Schwartz价值观人格）与可控对齐模型，在推理时平衡人格遵循与安全。
AI.motivation: LLM用户群体价值多元、背景各异；人格条件化请求往往不显式恶意，现有以对抗性请求为目标的基准与对齐方法容易漏检由此产生的危害，模型要么拒绝合法价值表达，要么盲从不安全人格。
AI.method: 基于Schwartz价值观调查维度构建11k争议话题与价值人格配对数据集；用迭代细化话题与人格的agentic流水线从对齐良好的商用LLM中诱导并收集有害响应；以UNESCO全球公民原则作为区分合法价值表达与有害行为的最小共识；训练可控对齐模型，支持推理时调节人格遵循度与安全性的权衡。
AI.result: agentic流水线对商用对齐LLM的有害响应诱导成功率超过47%；所得模型在多数样本上比基线更安全且更符合人格。
AI.conclusion: 显式对抗式对齐不足以保证人格化场景下安全，需要以价值维度刻画风险并引入可推理时调节的安全—服从权衡机制。

title: IntentDelta: A Human-Constructed Benchmark for Evolving User Intent
summary: Language-model agents must adapt as users revise their requirements and priorities during complex tasks. We introduce IntentDelta, a human-constructed multi-turn benchmark with 638 trajectories and 3,766 turns across WebShop and TravelPlanner. Each turn pairs a user utterance with a cumulative intention state and human reference actions. The trajectories are cross-verified and cover feasibility- and preference-driven changes in constraints and priorities. We evaluate eleven agents on intention recovery and action quality. Average Intention Recovery is 33.1\% in TravelPlanner and 44.7\% in WebShop, while average Action Score is 31.6% and 41.0%, respectively. Agents struggle to preserve earlier requirements and distinguish soft preferences from must-have constraints. Correct intention recovery also does not guarantee successful execution, highlighting challenges in translating evolving user intentions into actions.

AI.tldr: 提出 IntentDelta 基准，测试语言模型智能体在复杂多轮任务中随用户修改需求而动态适应（意图恢复与执行）的能力，结果显示现有智能体表现显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有评测缺乏对"用户在多轮交互中持续修订需求与优先级"这一动态适应能力的系统性考察，因此需要一个可量化意图演化与执行质量的多轮基准。
AI.method: 人工构建跨 WebShop 与 TravelPlanner 的多轮基准 IntentDelta，含 638 条轨迹、3,766 轮对话；每轮将用户话语与累积意图状态及人工参考动作配对，经交叉验证，覆盖由可行性驱动与偏好驱动的约束及优先级变化；在意图恢复与动作质量两维度上评测十一个智能体。
AI.result: 平均意图恢复率 TravelPlanner 33.1%、WebShop 44.7%；平均动作得分分别为 31.6% 与 41.0%。智能体难以保留先前需求，也难以区分软偏好与硬约束。
AI.conclusion: 正确恢复意图并不保证执行成功，将演化的用户意图转化为动作仍是核心挑战；IntentDelta 为评估智能体的意图追踪与适应能力提供了诊断性基准。

title: AdaptTok-Indic: Script-Aware Adaptive Tokenization for Indic Languages
summary: Multilingual tokenizers trained on English-dominated corpora often over-segment Indic languages, resulting in longer token sequences and increased tokenization disparity across scripts. We present AdaptTok-Indic, an Indic-specialized extension of adaptive tokenization that combines Unicode-normalized preprocessing with explicit Indic conjunct handling, script-aware routing, and learned byte-level boundary prediction jointly trained with a small Transformer language model. Evaluated on Bengali and Hindi, with additional evaluation on Gujarati, Tamil, and Telugu, AdaptTok-Indic achieves lower token fertility than SentencePiece BPE, an Indic-oriented tokenizer baseline, and an independently implemented MAGNET-style baseline. Across five recorded seeds, mean fertility is 1.432 for Bengali and 1.388 for Hindi, compared with 2.156 and 2.085 for SentencePiece BPE. Recorded downstream scores average 57.69 on evaluated Indic settings versus 50.82 for the SentencePiece BPE configuration. Independent verification runs using the released prototype confirm the same directional trends. The current implementation is a small-scale prototype with documented simplifications, and no statistical significance testing, released-MAGNET comparison, or code-mixed evaluation is performed. These results suggest that Indic-specialized adaptive segmentation can reduce tokenization disparity while maintaining competitive downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdaptTok-Indic：面向印度语系的自适应分词扩展，通过Unicode规范化、连字处理、文字系统感知路由与字节级边界预测降低分词生育率并提升下游表现。
AI.motivation: 以英语为主的语料训练的 multilingual tokenizer 常对印度语系过度切分，导致 token 序列变长、跨文字系统的分词差异（tokenization disparity）增大。
AI.method: 在 adaptive tokenization 基础上做 Indic 专门化扩展：Unicode 规范化预处理 + 显式 Indic conjunct（连字）处理 + script-aware routing + 与小型 Transformer 语言模型联合训练的 learned byte-level boundary prediction。
AI.result: 在孟加拉语、印地语为主，辅以古吉拉特语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语的评测中，fertility 低于 SentencePiece BPE、Indic 专用基线及独立实现的 MAGNET 风格基线：5 个种子均值孟加拉语 1.432、印地语 1.388，对比 SentencePiece BPE 的 2.156 / 2.085；下游得分均值 57.69 vs 50.82。独立复现实验方向一致。
AI.conclusion: Indic 专门化自适应分词可在保持有竞争力下游性能的同时降低分词差异；但当前为小规模原型，存在已记录的简化，未做统计显著性检验、未与正式发布版 MAGNET 比较、未评估 code-mixed 场景。

title: Knowledge-Guided LLM for Intent-Driven Service Orchestration in Integrated Terrestrial and Non-Terrestrial 6G Networks
summary: Natural-language service intents in integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial (TN/NTN) 6G networks can be incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent, making unconstrained LLM generation challenging for reliable network-facing orchestration. This paper proposes a knowledge-guided LLM framework that combines grammar-constrained semantic parsing with a knowledge-graph (KG)-driven clarification loop to produce validated, orchestration-ready service profiles across four representative service classes. On a 200-sample intent dataset, the framework achieves 89% classification accuracy and 95% policy validity with an average of 0.66 clarification turns per request. Compared with a Pure-LLM baseline, the proposed framework improves policy validity and contradiction detection while requiring fewer clarification turns, demonstrating the value of explicit knowledge-guided reasoning for robust intent processing in integrated TN/NTN 6G orchestration.

AI.tldr: 提出知识引导的LLM框架，通过文法约束语义解析与知识图谱驱动的澄清循环，将不完整/歧义/不一致的自然语言服务意图转化为可用于天地一体化6G网络编排的经校验服务画像。
AI.motivation: 天地一体化（TN/NTN）6G网络中，自然语言服务意图常存在不完整、歧义或不一致问题，无约束的LLM生成难以保证网络侧编排的可靠性，需要显式知识约束来提升意图处理的鲁棒性与输出有效性。
AI.method: 构建知识引导的LLM框架，包含两部分：一是文法约束的语义解析（grammar-constrained semantic parsing），将意图映射为结构化表示；二是知识图谱（KG）驱动的澄清循环，对缺失、歧义与矛盾信息进行交互式澄清，覆盖四类代表性服务类别。
AI.result: 在200样本意图数据集上达到89%分类准确率与95%策略有效性，平均每请求0.66轮澄清；相较Pure-LLM基线，策略有效性与矛盾检测能力提升，且所需澄清轮次更少。
AI.conclusion: 显式知识引导推理能有效支撑一体化TN/NTN 6G编排中稳健的意图处理；文法约束与KG驱动的澄清机制相较纯LLM方案在有效性与交互效率上具有优势。

title: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment (MARCA) of Individual Case Safety Reports in Pharmacovigilance
summary:
Introduction: Increasing volumes of individual case safety reports (ICSRs) challenge expert-led causality assessment in pharmacovigilance. We developed MARCA (Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment), a four-agent framework for Naranjo-based assessment, and evaluated agreement with human experts and exploratory differences between non-RAG and RAG-labelled scores.
  Methods: MARCA combined scientific literature retrieval, drug-label assessment, objective-evidence classification, and clinical causality reasoning using Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2. Agent-generated rationales informed human-assisted scoring. A consensus expert reference standard covered 215 ICSRs and 1,562 drug-event combinations (DECs) from FAERS (Q1-Q2 2025). Agreement was measured using percentage agreement and Cohen's kappa.
  Results: Question-level agreement was 96.8% for Naranjo Q2 (kappa = 0.491; 95% CI 0.265-0.663), 85.4% for Q5 (kappa = 0.269; 95% CI 0.180-0.340), and 96.8% for Q10 (kappa = 0.922; 95% CI 0.885-0.951). Final causality classification agreement was 79.4% (95% CI 71.8-85.3; kappa = 0.587, 95% CI 0.450-0.690). In a retrospective subset of 60 DECs, agreement was higher for RAG-labelled than non-RAG scores for Q5 (83.3% vs 65.0%) and Q10 (100.0% vs 18.3%).
  Discussion: MARCA-assisted assessment showed substantial variation in agreement across Naranjo questions, with lower concordance for alternative causes. Retrospective RAG comparisons are exploratory and do not establish prospective effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出四智能体框架MARCA，用于Naranjo因果关系评估，在215份ICSR（1562个DEC）上与专家共识比较的一致性为79.4%（kappa=0.587），且回顾性提示RAG标注在Q5、Q10上优于非RAG。
AI.motivation: ICSR数量激增，使药物警戒中依赖专家的人工因果关系评估难以为继，需探索可扩展的自动化辅助方案。
AI.method: MARCA由四个智能体组成：科学文献检索、药品说明书评估、客观证据分类、临床因果关系推理，基于Gemini 2.5 Pro与DeepSeek-V3.2；智能体生成的推理依据用于人工辅助打分。以FAERS（2025 Q1–Q2）215份ICSR、1,562个药物-事件组合的专家共识为参照标准，采用百分比一致率与Cohen's kappa评价。
AI.conclusion: MARCA辅助评估在不同Naranjo条目上一致性差异明显，替代原因（Q5）一致性最低；RAG相关比较为回顾性、探索性，尚不能证明其前瞻性有效性。

title: FlexA-Mem: Budget-Adaptive Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents work in scenarios with very different memory needs. A question about past conversations needs the exact facts it names, while a multi-step task needs a trace of the steps already taken together with details that the next step cannot name. Existing memories are each designed and tested for one kind of scenario. Retrieval memories such as A-Mem miss steps that the current query does not express, summaries drop exact strings, and pairing the two fixes the split of the budget in advance. We propose FlexA-Mem, a general memory that writes each unit of history once into an immutable store and renders a fresh memory for every call. The rendered memory is a compact timeline of records plus detail that a fixed rule fits into the remaining room without an LLM call. The detail is either relevant units as raw text or excerpts or the verbatim pieces that best match the query. With one store, FlexA-Mem serves both kinds of scenario. On AppWorld challenge tasks at 4k, it outperforms the second-best method by 11.5%, and on 147 unused tasks with predictions fixed in advance it outperforms A-Mem with a summary by 12.2%. On LongMemEval and LoCoMo, it matches a dedicated keyword retriever that writes no memory, while memories built on text written by an LLM fall far behind at tight budgets. Ablations show that the timeline carries AppWorld completion, whereas recovery mainly saves steps there and decides accuracy on exact facts. Code is available at https://github.com/WujiangXu/Flex-Amem

AI.tldr: FlexA-Mem 将历史一次写入不可变存储，每次调用按固定规则即时渲染"时间线+细节"的紧凑记忆，用单一存储同时服务精确事实问答与多步任务两种场景，在 AppWorld、LongMemEval、LoCoMo 上均优于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM agent 记忆方案各自只针对单一场景设计：检索式记忆（如 A-Mem）会漏掉当前查询未表达的步骤，摘要式记忆会丢失精确字符串，而两者简单拼接又需预先固定预算分配比例。作者希望用统一记忆同时满足两类需求。
AI.method: 提出 FlexA-Mem：每个历史单元只写入一次到不可变存储；每次调用时即时渲染一份新记忆，内容为记录构成的紧凑时间线，加上由固定规则（无需 LLM 调用）填入剩余空间的细节；细节形式为相关单元的原始文本/摘录，或与查询最佳匹配的逐字片段。
AI.result: AppWorld challenge 任务在 4k 预算下比第二名高 11.5%；在 147 个未使用任务上（预测预先固定）比"带摘要的 A-Mem"高 12.2%；LongMemEval 与 LoCoMo 上匹配一个不写记忆的专用关键词检索器，而基于 LLM 生成文本构建的记忆在紧预算下大幅落后。消融显示时间线支撑 AppWorld 任务完成，恢复机制主要挽回步骤，并决定精确事实类任务的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 单一不可变存储加按需渲染，可在不预先分配预算的前提下兼顾多步任务追踪与精确事实检索；时间线与细节恢复各司其职，验证了"写一次、按调用渲染"的设计有效性。

title: Each Insufficient in Its Own Way: Calibrating Language Models Across Varying Evidence States
summary: How can a language model know whether it has enough evidence to answer? Language models tend to answer even when the evidence they have is insufficient. Deciding whether to answer or gather more evidence requires a calibrated estimate of how likely an answer is to be correct with the available evidence. However, most calibration work treats the input as fixed, without asking how this estimate should change with the evidence. We introduce \emph{evidence-state calibration}, which requires a model's confidence before answering to match its probability of answering correctly and to change accordingly whenever the evidence changes this probability. We propose \ours{} (\textbf{Suffi}ciency \textbf{C}onfidence \textbf{E}stimation), which fine-tunes the confidence already present in a model's next-token distribution to match how often the model answers correctly from each evidence state. Across clinical diagnosis and multi-hop question answering with four models from two families, \ours{} reduces the Brier score by up to 60\% and increases AUROC by up to 0.16. Its confidence matches the empirical success rate and responds not only to the amount of evidence but also to which evidence is present, showing that models can learn to judge whether their current evidence is enough to answer.

AI.tldr: 提出"证据状态校准"(evidence-state calibration)概念与SCE方法,通过微调模型下一词分布中已有的置信度,使其随证据变化而正确反映答对概率,在临床诊断与多跳问答上显著降低Brier分数并提升AUROC。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在证据不足时仍倾向于强行作答;要决定"作答还是继续收集证据",需要基于当前可用证据对答案正确概率作出校准估计。然而现有校准研究多把输入视为固定,未考察置信度应如何随证据状态变化而变化。
AI.method: 定义"证据状态校准":模型作答前的置信度须与答对概率一致,并在证据改变该概率时相应变化。提出SCE(Sufficiency Confidence Estimation),对模型下一词token分布中已隐含的置信度进行微调,使其匹配模型在各证据状态下实际答对的频率;在临床诊断与多跳问答任务、两个模型家族的四个模型上评测。
AI.result: 相比基线,SCE将Brier分数最多降低60%,AUROC最多提升0.16;其置信度与经验成功率吻合,且不仅对证据"数量"敏感,也对"哪些证据存在"敏感。
AI.conclusion: 模型能够学习判断当前证据是否足以作答;置信度可作为证据充分性的可靠信号,为"作答或继续取证"的决策提供依据。

title: Propasafe-Hybrid: A Text-Based Hybrid Propaganda Detection Tool
comment: Published in the Proceedings of FLAIRS-39 (2026), Special Track: Applied Natural Language Processing
summary: Propagandistic content increasingly circulates through online news and social media, where readers often encounter it with limited scrutiny, highlighting the need for reliable and fine-grained detection. This paper introduces Propasafe-Hybrid, a sentence-level system that integrates a fine-tuned transformer classifier with LLM-based technique classification to identify, label, and explain specific propaganda strategies. The pipeline generates actionable outputs, including highlighted sentences, technique assignments, and concise rationales, so users can immediately understand why a sentence was flagged and how each label was determined. To control inference cost, Propasafe-Hybrid employs a cost-aware pre-filtering stage that forwards only high-likelihood sentences to LLMs, reducing token usage while preserving the underlying decision logic. Together, these design choices enhance the explainability, efficiency, and practical usability of sentence-level propaganda detection in real-world news environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Propasafe-Hybrid，一个句级宣传检测系统，将微调 Transformer 分类器与 LLM 技术分类相结合，实现宣传句识别、技术标签与理由解释，并通过成本感知预过滤降低 LLM 推理开销。
AI.motivation: 宣传性内容在网络新闻与社交媒体中日益泛滥，读者往往缺乏足够的辨别力，因此需要可靠且细粒度的检测手段；同时需兼顾结果可解释性与推理成本。
AI.method: 采用混合管线：先用微调 Transformer 分类器进行句级宣传识别，再由 LLM 完成宣传技术分类；引入成本感知预过滤阶段，仅将高概率句子送入 LLM；最终输出高亮句子、技术标签与简明理由。
AI.result: 系统在保留原有决策逻辑的前提下减少 token 消耗，并输出高亮句、技术标注与解释性理由等可操作结果，提升句级宣传检测的可解释性、效率与实用性。
AI.conclusion: Transformer 与 LLM 的分工式混合设计可在控制成本的同时提升句级宣传检测的解释性与实际可用性，适用于真实新闻环境。

title: Adaptive Transfer of Representational Signatures for LLM Reliability Detection
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are reported to be susceptible to reliability issues including hallucinations and reasoning errors. Existing quality detectors can predict unreliable outputs based on internal representations with decent accuracies. However, training these detectors often requires substantial domain-specific labeled data, which limits their applicability to new domains. We propose to address this challenge by transferring representational signatures across related domains. More specifically, we build a statistical framework that first extracts low-dimensional signatures for each domain, then uses cross-fitting to learn composition weights of domain-specific predictors. The weights adapt to each source domain's predictive relevance to the target domain. Our asymptotic analysis of a least-squares analogue characterizes the limiting prediction risk and aggregation weights in terms of domain discrepancies and representation bias. Experiments across multiple hallucination datasets and open-weight LLMs show that, with only 25 labeled questions in the new domain, adaptive transfer improves hallucination-detection AUROC by 6.8%. For reasoning-step prediction, it improves AUROC by 8.4%.

AI.tldr: 提出跨域迁移表示签名的统计框架，仅需目标域少量标注即可显著提升LLM幻觉与推理错误检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于内部表示的质量检测器虽能较好预测不可靠输出，但训练需大量领域专属标注数据，难以推广到新领域。
AI.method: 构建统计框架：先为每个领域提取低维签名（signature），再用交叉拟合（cross-fitting）学习各域专用预测器的组合权重，使权重随源域对目标域的预测相关性自适应调整；并对最小二乘类比进行渐近分析，以域差异和表示偏差刻画极限预测风险与聚合权重。
AI.result: 在多个幻觉数据集和开源权重LLM上，目标域仅用25个标注问题时，自适应迁移使幻觉检测AUROC提升6.8%，推理步骤预测AUROC提升8.4%。
AI.conclusion: 跨域表示签名迁移可在低标注成本下有效缓解领域数据稀缺问题，提升LLM可靠性检测的跨域适用性。

title: Gender Associations in LLM-Mediated ADHD Self-Diagnosis
comment: 20 pages (10 pages of main text, plus references and appendix). Accepted at EVAL4SD 2026. To appear in the ACL Anthology
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical self-diagnosis. However, the way demographic cues shape outputs in these interactions remains poorly understood. This is particularly consequential for diagnoses like ADHD, where persistent gender disparities are not fully aligned with the clinical evidence. We adapt the Context Association Test (CAT) to evaluate whether GPT-4o responds to gendered ADHD associations in a zero-shot, self-diagnostic setting. We show that explicit cueing consistently amplifies certain ADHD subtype associations while implicit cueing produces near proxy-aligned distributions. These divergences suggest that explicit demographic cues may activate bias-mitigation mechanisms that over-correct rather than eliminate bias, whereas implicit cues appear to reflect the model's default behavior. Our results demonstrate that evaluating gendered bias in LLM-mediated self-diagnosis requires careful attention to the demographic associations a model encodes.

AI.tldr: 研究将Context Association Test适配到零样本自我诊断场景，考察GPT-4o是否对ADHD的性别化联想作出响应。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于医疗自我诊断，但人口学线索如何塑造模型输出尚不清楚；ADHD存在与临床证据不完全一致的持续性别差异，因而成为关键检验场景。
AI.method: 把Context Association Test（CAT）改造为GPT-4o的零样本、自我诊断式评估，对比显式与隐式性别线索下模型输出的ADHD亚型联想分布，并与代理分布（proxy）对照。
AI.result: 显式线索一致地放大了某些ADHD亚型联想；隐式线索则产生与代理分布高度一致的分布，二者出现明显分歧。
AI.conclusion: 显式人口学线索可能激活过度纠正而非消除偏见的偏见缓释机制，隐式线索更接近模型默认行为；评估LLM介导自我诊断中的性别偏见需审慎关注模型所编码的人口学联想。

title: Factual Yet One-Sided: Stance Poisoning and Evidence Balancing in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary:
The stance expressed in responses from retrieval-augmented generation systems is significantly influenced by the stance distribution of the retrieved materials. Existing research on knowledge poisoning has primarily targeted factual errors. In contrast, this study focuses on injection attacks in which the facts are correct but the stance on a controversial issue is one-sided. At a mean topic-level poisoning share of 18.9% within the post-injection ProCon documents, all four generation models from different vendors exhibited stance shifts aligned with the poisoning direction; across four concentration levels, the shifts increased monotonically.
  This paper proposes a Stance-Balancing Middleware positioned between the retriever and the generator. It consists of stance detection, fixed balancing (2 supporting + 2 opposing + 1 neutral), and a debiasing prompt, without introducing additional large language model calls. Across all eight concentration-direction settings, the complete method reduced the magnitude of stance deviation by an estimated 0.106 to 0.350; the six settings at poisoning shares of 11.9%-18.9% remained significant after Holm adjustment (adjusted p <= 0.009). In the cross-model experiment, all eight model-direction combinations moved along the stance axis in the corrective direction, and seven of eight showed a clearly detected reduction in absolute distance from 0. In the concentration sweep, the post-defense intervals included 0 in all eight settings, while the cross-model pro-poisoning results retained small positive residual point estimates of +0.045 to +0.063. For 20 candidate documents, stance detection took approximately 1.5% of the median generation time on a single GPU and approximately 16% on CPU.

AI.tldr: 检索增强生成系统的立场表达受检索材料立场分布显著影响；本文研究"事实正确但立场片面"的注入攻击，并提出位于检索器与生成器之间的"立场平衡中间件"，在不增加额外大模型调用的前提下有效降低立场偏移。
AI.motivation: 现有知识投毒研究主要针对事实性错误，而忽视了一类更隐蔽的攻击：文档事实无误，但对争议话题的立场呈单边化，从而诱导生成模型产生立场偏移。因此需要研究该注入攻击的威胁，并给出低成本防御手段。
AI.method: 提出Stance-Balancing Middleware，置于检索器与生成器之间，包含三部分：立场检测、固定配比平衡（2支持+2反对+1中立）以及去偏提示，且不引入额外的大语言模型调用。
AI.result: 攻击侧：注入后ProCon文档平均话题级投毒占比18.9%时，来自不同厂商的四个生成模型均出现与投毒方向一致的立场偏移，且在四个浓度水平上单调递增。防御侧：全部八个浓度-方向设置下立场偏差幅度降低约0.106~0.350；投毒占比11.9%~18.9%的六个设置在Holm校正后仍显著（校正p≤0.009）。跨模型实验中八个模型-方向组合均沿立场轴朝纠正方向移动，其中七个检出|距离|明显下降。浓度扫描中八个设置的防御后区间均包含0，但跨模型亲投毒结果仍保留+0.045~+0.063的小幅正残差点估计。效率上，20篇候选文档的立场检测在单GPU上约占中位生成时间的1.5%，CPU上约占16%。
AI.conclusion: 立场层面的单边注入是可复现、可量化且随投毒浓度单调增强的威胁；立场平衡中间件以极低的计算开销实现跨模型、跨方向的稳健纠偏，但难以完全消除残余偏移，需进一步优化。
