title: A Russian, a Brazilian, and a German Walk into a Bar, Ask the Same Question-- And Get Three Different Answers: Profiling LLM Perspective Diversity on Contested Topics
summary: Large Language Models(LLMs) have shown strong performance on tasks with verifiable answers, but many real-world queries involve subjectivity, disagreement, and conflicting evidence. Most existing benchmarks for such queries remain English-centric, overlooking the vast diversity of perspectives held by users worldwide. To systematically study how LLM perspectives vary across languages, we curate PerspectivesQA, a manually verified multilingual dataset of globally contested topics covering 18 languages, and propose ROOTS, a framework that profiles linguistic, perspective, and framing diversity. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models covering both open-source and proprietary families at varying scales, establishing that LLMs hedge their answers in English but commit to positions in lower-resource languages. Larger models maintain a more consistent cross-lingual worldview, while smaller models are more easily swayed. All models also exhibit high sensitivity to minor surface-level input variations, producing notable stance even in larger models.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了覆盖18种语言、人工校验的多语言争议话题数据集PerspectivesQA，并提出ROOTS框架刻画语言、视角与框架多样性；对8个开源与闭源模型评测发现，LLM在英语中倾向模糊回避，在低资源语言中则明确表态；大模型跨语言世界观更一致，小模型更易被影响，且所有模型对表层输入扰动高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有针对主观性、分歧与证据冲突类查询的基准测试以英语为中心，忽视了全球用户视角的多样性；因此需要系统研究LLM视角如何随语言变化。
AI.method: 构建人工校验的多语言数据集PerspectivesQA（覆盖18种语言、全球争议话题），并提出ROOTS框架，从语言多样性、视角多样性与框架（framing）多样性三个维度进行刻画；评测涵盖开源与闭源、不同规模的8个模型。
AI.result: LLM在英语中倾向于对冲（hedging）答案，而在低资源语言中给出明确立场；较大模型保持更一致的跨语言世界观，较小模型更易被左右；所有模型对细微的表层输入变化高度敏感，即使大模型也会出现明显立场偏移。
AI.conclusion: LLM的立场表达存在显著的语言依赖性，跨语言视角一致性与模型规模相关，且模型对输入表层扰动脆弱，提示多语言主观性任务需关注视角稳健性与公平性。

title: High Scores, Hidden Failures: Evaluating Codebook-Based LLM Content Analysis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimization procedures. We uncover multiple failure modes that are largely invisible under standard metrics, showing that high aggregate scores frequently coexist with severe label-level disparities, instability across runs, domain sensitivity, and shifts in label interpretation. Importantly, these failure modes persist under widely used optimization strategies and remain largely invisible under standard metrics such as accuracy and micro-F1. Our results demonstrate that current LLM-based coding pipelines cannot be treated as stable measurement tools without targeted validation beyond aggregate performance.

AI.tldr: 对基于LLM的码本内容分析流程开展大规模失败模式分析，发现聚合指标高分的背后存在标签级失衡、运行不稳定、领域敏感与标签语义漂移等隐蔽失效。
AI.motivation: LLM在计算社会科学中被广泛用于基于码本的内容分析，已有工作报告了较强的预测性能，但其标注是否可靠、稳健尚不清楚，尤其缺乏对标准指标之外失效模式的系统检验。
AI.method: 跨4个数据集、5个模型，对LLM编码流程在受控扰动、领域偏移与优化策略下系统评估其稳定性、稳健性与概念效度，并进行标签级与运行间对比的失败模式分析。
AI.result: 识别出多种在标准指标下基本不可见的失败模式：高聚合得分常与严重的标签级差异、多次运行间的不稳定、领域敏感性以及标签解释漂移并存；这些失败模式在常用优化策略下依然存在，且被accuracy、micro-F1等指标掩盖。
AI.conclusion: 当前基于LLM的编码流程不能被视为稳定的测量工具，需在聚合性能之外进行有针对性的验证（稳定性、稳健性、概念效度）后方可使用。

title: StateLoop: Persistent State for Looped Transformers
summary: Looped Transformers offer a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling by repeatedly applying a shared backbone. Vanilla looped Transformers use each backbone output directly as the input to the next iteration. These outputs may contain information useful several iterations later, but retaining it across the loop depends entirely on the single hidden state. We introduce StateLoop, which maintains one additional persistent state per token to retain information across iterations. At each iteration, a learned gate controls how much of the previous state is retained and how much information from the backbone output is incorporated. The updated state is projected back and added to the backbone output for subsequent iterations and final prediction. This design reduces Pile perplexity and improves average accuracy across eight zero-shot tasks over Vanilla Looped. Its perplexity advantage over Vanilla Looped grows with trained loop depth, consistent with persistent state becoming increasingly useful as recurrent computation deepens.

AI.tldr: StateLoop 为每个 token 增加一个贯穿循环迭代的持久状态，用学习门控融合历史状态与骨干输出，降低 Pile 困惑度并提升八项零样本任务平均准确率。
AI.motivation: Vanilla Looped Transformer 每次迭代直接将骨干输出作为下一次输入，跨迭代保留信息完全依赖单一隐藏状态，导致前几轮产生的有用信息难以在数轮之后仍被保留。
AI.method: 在每个 token 上额外维护一个持久状态；每次迭代由一个学习门控决定保留多少旧状态、汇入多少骨干输出信息；更新后的状态经投影后加回骨干输出，用于后续迭代与最终预测。
AI.result: 相对 Vanilla Looped，Pile 困惑度下降，八项零样本任务平均准确率提升；且相对 Vanilla Looped 的困惑度优势随训练循环深度增加而增大。
AI.conclusion: 显式的持久状态是循环 Transformer 中有效的补充记忆机制，其收益随循环计算加深而增强，说明持久状态与递归深度具有协同效应。

title: Probing the phon* representations of the Mimi codebooks
comment: Accepted at the 9th International Conference on Natural Language and Speech Processing (ICNLSP-2026) https://aclanthology.org/2026.icnlsp-1.30/
summary: Neural audio codecs are increasingly used to encode speech for integration with large language models. This paper investigates the phonetic representations in the first codebook (CB0) of the Mimi codec. ABX style evaluation is poorly suited to Mimi fixed 80 ms tokenization window, which often spans multiple phonemes; we instead use forced alignment, entropy analysis, and Phone-Normalized Mutual Information (PNMI). Using TIMIT speech (58/55 speakers, SA1/SA2), individual tokens are strongly associated with specific phonemes (PNMI = 0.84, above random), yet phonemes are realized by multiple competing tokens rather than a one-to-one mapping.

AI.tldr: 该文用强制对齐、熵分析与Phone-Normalized Mutual Information（PNMI）考察Mimi编解码器首码本（CB0）的音素表征，发现在TIMIT上token与音素强相关（PNMI=0.84，高于随机），但音素由多个竞争性token实现，并非一对一映射。
AI.motivation: 神经音频编解码器越来越多地用于为大语言模型编码语音，因此需要弄清其离散token是否承载音素层面的语音信息；而Mimi固定80 ms的分词窗口常跨越多个音素，使传统ABX评测不适用。
AI.method: 在TIMIT语料（58/55位说话人，SA1/SA2句）上，对Mimi首码本CB0的token采用强制对齐、熵分析和Phone-Normalized Mutual Information（PNMI）进行量化分析，以替代不适用的ABX范式。
AI.result: 单个token与特定音素存在强关联，PNMI达0.84，显著高于随机水平；但音素对应多个相互竞争的token，token–音素关系呈多对一而非一一映射。
AI.conclusion: Mimi CB0确实编码了可测量的音素信息，但其token化粒度导致音素表征呈分散、冗余的多token分布，为基于token的语音–语言模型整合提供了表征层面的依据。

title: The LALA Benchmark: Evaluating Literary and Linguistic Analysis in LLMs
summary: We introduce the Literature and Linguistics Analysis Benchmark (LALA), comprising 236 open-ended questions written by experts in linguistics and literary studies, together with expert-provided ideal answers. By comparing models within families and at similar training scales using human and LLM judges, LALA identifies differences in linguistic competence associated with post-training, offering a framework for evaluating future models and guiding targeted improvements. We administered questions to 17 language models and evaluated their responses using both human expert assessment and two LLM evaluators, Sol and Qwen. Base models displayed little of the linguistic competence assessed by the benchmark, whereas their post-trained versions performed markedly better, suggesting that post-training plays a central role in making linguistic knowledge accessible and usable. Parameter count, by contrast, showed no statistically significant association with partial-credit performance, and competencies remained unevenly distributed across linguistic domains. We interpret this pattern as evidence that post-training adds linguistic competencies piecemeal, without producing a general linguistic intelligence capable of extending them beyond the learned policies that support them. Models performed best on logical relations between statements and selected discourse-level tasks, while even the strongest post-trained models continued to struggle with ambiguity, literary style, reference, and misleading assumptions. Human and Sol evaluations produced nearly identical model rankings in both the original and ReliableEval runs, supporting the replicability of the comparative results.

AI.tldr: LALA 是一个含 236 道由语言学与文学研究专家撰写的开放式问题及专家标准答案的基准，用于评估语言模型的语言学能力。对 17 个模型的测评显示：后训练是语言能力可用的关键因素，参数量则不显著相关；能力在各语言学领域分布不均，呈"碎片化"获得。
AI.motivation: 现有评测难以区分语言模型的语言学能力究竟来自规模扩展还是后训练，也缺乏由领域专家设计、带标准答案的开放式评测框架，因此需要一个细粒度、可复现的基准来定位后训练带来的能力差异并指导后续改进。
AI.method: 构建 LALA 基准（236 道专家撰写开放式问题＋专家理想答案）；在 17 个语言模型上施测，同族、相近训练规模模型对照；采用人类专家评审与两个 LLM 评测器（Sol、Qwen）打分，并进行 ReliableEval 复现实验；分析后训练、参数量与语言学子领域间的关系。
AI.result: 基座模型表现极弱，后训练版本显著更优；参数量与部分得分无统计显著关联；能力在语言学各领域分布不均；模型在陈述间逻辑关系与部分语篇级任务上表现最好，而在歧义、文学风格、指代和误导性前提上即便最强后训练模型仍困难；人类评审与 Sol 在原始与 ReliableEval 两轮中的模型排序几乎一致。
AI.conclusion: 后训练以"逐项拼装"的方式添加语言学能力，而非产生可泛化到所学策略之外的通用语言智能；LALA 可作为评估未来模型与指导针对性改进的框架，且 LLM 评审（Sol）在排序层面具备良好可复现性。

title: Beyond the Opening: Tracing the First Token's Persistent Influence on Reasoning Length
summary: Understanding how individual token choices affect reasoning length is important for characterizing reasoning models. Building on prior findings that changing the first reasoning token (hereafter, the first token) can substantially alter reasoning length, we focus on this initial choice to investigate how its influence operates during subsequent generation. One possibility is that the first token changes the early text that follows, which in turn affects reasoning length. However, replacing only the first token of an existing reasoning prefix and resuming generation substantially changes the remaining reasoning length, even though all other prefix tokens are unchanged. To trace this persistent influence, we compare next-token distributions while varying only the first token and find that sensitivity is concentrated at a small set of generation positions. Blocking attention from these positions to the first token reduces the length gap between first-token conditions. Using next-token distributions from a different first-token condition at these positions also substantially changes subsequent reasoning length. Together, these findings suggest that attention to the first token at a few sensitive positions helps sustain its length effect, illustrating how a local token choice persistently influences a sequence-level outcome.

AI.tldr: 首个推理token的选择通过少数"敏感位置"上的注意力机制，持续影响后续推理长度；屏蔽这些位置对首token的注意力或替换其分布，可显著削弱其长度效应。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明改变首个推理token（first token）会显著改变推理长度，但其影响如何在后续生成中持续传导尚不清楚。作者希望刻画这种"局部token选择如何影响序列级结果"的机制，此前存在一个自然假设：首token只是改变了紧随其后的早期文本，从而间接影响长度。
AI.method: （1）在已有推理前缀中仅替换首token并续写，检验剩余推理长度的变化；（2）仅改变首token，比较各生成位置的下一个token分布，定位对首token敏感的位置；（3）屏蔽这些敏感位置对首token的注意力，观察不同首token条件下的长度差距是否缩小；（4）在这些位置注入来自其他首token条件的下一个token分布，检验后续推理长度是否随之改变。
AI.result: 仅替换首token、其余前缀不变时，剩余推理长度仍发生显著变化，说明影响并非仅经由早期文本传导；下一个token分布对首token的敏感性高度集中于少数生成位置；屏蔽这些位置对首token的注意力可减小不同首token条件间的长度差距；在这些位置使用另一条件的下一个token分布也会显著改变后续推理长度。
AI.conclusion: 首个推理token的长度效应由少数敏感位置对其的注意力所"维持"，体现出局部token选择如何对序列级结果产生持续影响，为理解推理模型的长度控制机制提供了机制性解释。

title: OpenESM: Energy-Steered Models Are Scalable Foundation Learners
summary:
Energy-based models have shown promising properties for domain-specific tasks but remain challenging in modeling general-purpose scenarios. To bridge this gap, we design energy-steered models (ESMs) for foundational language modeling. ESMs integrate energy steering and token generation within a single architecture to leverage the energy-guided search to refine token generation. Specifically, ESMs first optimize a latent state over the energy landscape, then leverages the refined latent state for token generation. By performing such energy-guided pre-training on large-scale corpora, ESMs learn generally effective energy landscape where favorable tokens correspond to lower energy values. To explore the scaling behavior of ESMs, we pre-train ESMs on three large-scale corpora, then evaluate across 26 downstream tasks spanning a broad range of domains. Our results demonstrate that ESMs have promising scaling behaviors with increasing model size and training data, and outperform GPTs on most downstream tasks. These findings highlight ESMs as a promising architecture for large-scale pre-training and general purpose problem solving. We fully release the model weights and training infrastructure to enable the community to completely reproduce and extend our results.
  GitHub: https://github.com/datamllab/openesm HuggingFace: https://huggingface.co/collections/guan-wang/openesm

AI.tldr: 本文提出能量引导模型（ESMs），将能量引导搜索与词元生成整合于单一架构，先优化潜在状态再生成词元，通过大规模预训练学习通用有效的能量景观，并在26个下游任务上验证其优于GPT。
AI.motivation: 能量模型在领域特定任务上有优势，但在通用场景建模上仍具挑战，本文旨在弥合这一差距，将能量模型用于基础语言建模。
AI.method: 设计ESMs，将energy steering与token generation集成于单一架构：先在能量景观上优化潜在状态，再以精炼后的潜在状态进行词元生成；在大规模语料上执行能量引导的预训练，使有利词元对应更低能量值。
AI.result: 在三个大规模语料上预训练，并在覆盖广泛领域的26个下游任务上评估；ESMs随模型规模与训练数据增加呈现良好的扩展行为，在多数下游任务上优于GPT。
AI.conclusion: ESMs可作为大规模预训练与通用问题求解的有前景架构；作者开源模型权重与训练基础设施以支持复现与扩展。

title: Two Uncertainties Are Not One: Disagreement versus Decision-Risk in Cheap Structured Content Moderation
summary: Content moderation compresses a graded, contested human judgment into a binary act (leave up / take down) over billions of items, at a scale where running a frontier LLM on every post is uneconomical. A new class of frozen "System One" models returns typed, calibrated decisions instead of text at ~USD 0.000025 per call and ~100 ms. We run the first independent audit of one such model on 142,658 human-labeled comments, and benchmark it against 14 frontier reasoning models (the GPT-5.x, Claude, Gemini 3, and Grok families) on a shared probe set. Two findings stand out. First, the cheap model is accuracy-competitive: its zero-shot classification AUROC (0.83) is not statistically separable (paired bootstrap, n=56; a failure to reject parity, not proof of equivalence) from 13 of the 14 frontier systems while costing 1-3 orders of magnitude less, and it is no worse calibrated than several of them. Second, "confidence" conflates two uncertainties that come apart: human disagreement (where annotators split on satire and coded language) and decision risk (where the automatic action is costly-wrong). Under an asymmetric moderation loss these call for opposite escalation signals, so no single confidence number serves both. Because the model prices extra questions at nearly zero, decomposing the judgment into parallel sub-questions and reading their spread recovers a human-disagreement signal that the model's native confidence misses -- but this remedy is specific: it helps the weakest, disagreement-blind models and only when the decomposition aligns with the sources of disagreement; a specialist toxicity model and the strongest LLMs do not need it, and the effect is distribution-sensitive. We will release the instrument, the cached runs, and the analysis.

AI.tldr: 首个独立审计证明，单价约0.000025美元、约100ms的冻结"System One"审核模型在AUROC 0.83上与14个前沿推理模型中13个统计不可区分（配对bootstrap，n=56，属未能拒绝平价而非等价性证明），成本低1–3个数量级；同时指出"置信度"混淆了人类分歧与决策风险两种方向相反的不确定性，而用并行子问题答案离散度可补回人类分歧信号。
AI.motivation: 内容审核需在数十亿条目上把有争议的人类分级判断压缩为二元动作，逐条调用前沿LLM不经济。新型冻结"System One"模型以极低成本返回结构化校准决策，但其可靠性缺乏独立验证；此外单一"置信度"被假定可同时服务两种不同目的，需检验其是否成立。
AI.method: 在142,658条人工标注评论上对该类模型做首次独立审计；在共享探针集上与14个前沿推理模型（GPT-5.x、Claude、Gemini 3、Grok系列）进行zero-shot AUROC 基准比较，采用配对bootstrap（n=56）检验差异并评估校准；同时对"置信度"做概念分解，将判断拆为并行子问题并读取答案离散度作为人类分歧信号。
AI.result: (1) 廉价模型准确率具竞争力：AUROC 0.83，与14个系统里13个统计不可分，成本低1–3个数量级，校准不劣于其中若干系统。(2) "置信度"实际混合了人类分歧（标注者讽刺/隐语分歧）与决策风险（自动动作代价性错误），在非对称审核损失下两者要求相反的升级信号，单一置信度数值无法兼服务二者。(3) 子问题分解读离散度可恢复原生置信度遗漏的人类分歧信号，但效果特定：仅对最弱、对分歧不敏感的模型且分解方向与分歧来源对齐时有效；专用毒性模型与最强LLM无需此手段，且效果对分布敏感。
AI.conclusion: 低成本冻结模型在审核分类准确率上足以对标前沿LLM，但"置信度"不是单一可用信号，需区分人类分歧与决策风险并分别设计升级策略；并行子问题离散度是一种低成本但适用范围有限的分歧探测手段。作者将公开工具、缓存运行结果与分析代码。

title: Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation: Rethinking Machine Translation Evaluation in the Era of Human-Level Systems
comment: Published in Findings of EMNLP 2025. 17 pages. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yandex/wmt24-en-ru-rate
summary: As machine translation systems approach human-level quality, traditional evaluation methodologies struggle to detect subtle translation errors. We critically examine limitations in current gold-standard approaches (MQM and ESA), including inconsistencies from variable annotator expertise, excessive categorization complexity, coarse severity granularity, accuracy bias over fluency, and time constraints. To address this issue, we introduce a high-quality dataset consisting of human evaluations for English-Russian translations from WMT24, created by professional linguists. We show that expert assessments without time pressure yield substantially different results from standard evaluations. To enable consistent and rich annotation by these experts, we developed the RATE (Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation) protocol. RATE provides a streamlined error taxonomy, expanded severity ratings, and multidimensional scoring balancing accuracy and fluency, facilitating deeper analysis of MT outputs. Our analysis, powered by this expert dataset, reveals that state-of-the-art MT systems may have surpassed human translations in accuracy while still lagging in fluency - a critical distinction obscured by existing accuracy-biased metrics. Our findings highlight that advancing MT evaluation requires not only better protocols but crucially, high-quality annotations from skilled linguists.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判现有机器翻译评测范式（MQM、ESA），提出RATE协议与专业语言学家标注的英俄WMT24高质量数据集，揭示现有指标偏向准确率而掩盖流畅度差距的实质。
AI.motivation: 随着MT系统接近人类水平，传统评测方法难以捕捉细微翻译错误。现有金标准方法（MQM、ESA）存在多重局限：标注者专业水平不一致导致结果不稳定、错误分类过于复杂、严重度粒度粗、重准确率而轻流畅度、以及时间压力约束。
AI.method: 构建由专业语言学家对WMT24英俄译文进行人工评测的高质量数据集；据此提出RATE（Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation）协议，包含精简的错误分类体系、扩展的严重度等级、以及平衡准确率与流畅度的多维评分机制。
AI.result: 无时间压力下的专家评估与标准评测结果存在显著差异；分析表明最先进MT系统在准确率上可能已超越人工译文，但在流畅度上仍有落后，而这一关键差异被现有偏重准确率的指标所掩盖。
AI.conclusion: 推进MT评测不仅需要更好的评测协议，更关键的是依赖专业语言学家提供的高质量标注；评测方法学的改进须与标注质量并重。

title: Words Are the Voice of the Mind: Depression Severity Estimation from Social Traces via Mental-Guided Evidence Reasoning
summary: Depression severity estimation is crucial for mental health assessment and intervention, yet traditional approaches depend on clinical interviews or self-report questionnaires that require users' active participation. With the widespread use of online social media, users leave rich social traces that may reflect their mental states, motivating the task of social media-based depression severity estimation. Existing efforts have progressed from textual-feature-based classification to LLM-based questionnaire completion over standardized scale items, yet they still fall short in user-specific mental priors modeling, diversified semantic retrieval, and fine-grained reasoning over mental evidence. To address these limitations, we propose UMer, a user-specific mental evidence reasoning framework for social traces-based depression severity estimation. UMer first distills a user-specific mental prior from historical social traces to capture the user's psychological tendencies, behavioral patterns, and self-expression style. It then performs scale-guided multi-query retrieval to construct evidence memories from item-relevant posts. Finally, it conducts coarse-to-fine evidence-aware reasoning to distinguish direct and indirect evidence and predict item-level scores with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that UMer not only achieves competitive performance over existing baselines, but also provides evidence-grounded interpretability and generalizes to other scale-based tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出UMer框架，从社交媒体历史痕迹中蒸馏用户特异性心理先验，结合量表引导的多查询检索与由粗到细的证据感知推理，实现可解释的抑郁严重程度（量表条目级）估计。
AI.motivation: 传统抑郁严重程度评估依赖临床访谈或自评问卷，需用户主动参与；社交媒体痕迹可被动反映心理状态。现有方法从文本特征分类演进到基于LLM的量表问卷作答，但仍存在三方面不足：缺乏用户特异性心理先验建模、检索语义单一、对心理证据的细粒度推理不足。
AI.method: UMer包含三个模块：(1) 从用户历史社交痕迹中蒸馏用户特异性心理先验，刻画其心理倾向、行为模式与自我表达风格；(2) 量表引导的多查询检索（multi-query retrieval），由条目相关问题检索构建证据记忆；(3) 由粗到细的证据感知推理，区分直接证据与间接证据，预测条目级得分并生成可解释理由。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准上取得优于现有基线的竞争性表现，同时提供有证据支撑的可解释性，并可泛化到其他基于量表的任务。
AI.conclusion: 用户特异性心理先验、多样化语义检索与细粒度证据推理三者结合，是提升社交媒体抑郁严重程度估计性能与可解释性的有效路径。

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Long-Session Degradation in Full-Duplex Speech Models
comment: The project page is available at https://kimjunho333.github.io/dmlsd-fdsm/
summary: End-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue models enable natural, real-time spoken interactions with interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. Prior evaluations have assessed diverse interaction capabilities and identified some degradation patterns across conversational turns. However, how model behavior evolves over extended sessions remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we address this gap by systematically characterizing long-session degradation and developing efficient methods to mitigate it. We introduce a closed-loop evaluation framework for long-session stability and apply it to several publicly available full-duplex speech models, revealing degradation over time in responsiveness, spoken content quality, and voice consistency. To mitigate this degradation, we propose a self-distillation-based training framework for lightweight LoRA adaptation that improves long-session stability with a small amount of additional training. We further introduce a two-resolution context (TRC) architecture that preserves recent interactions in full detail while compressing older interaction history into key-value representations. We evaluate our methods on three models with distinct architectures, assessing long-session stability, information retention, and computational efficiency. Across all three models, we show that LoRA adaptation mitigates performance degradation over ten-minute sessions, while adding TRC extends these gains beyond the training session length and reduces KV-cache growth by more than 90%.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统刻画了全双工语音对话模型在长会话中的性能退化，并提出自蒸馏驱动的LoRA适配与双分辨率上下文（TRC）架构来缓解退化、降低KV缓存增长。
AI.motivation: 既有评测多关注多轮交互能力与轮次间的退化模式，但对模型行为在长时会话中如何演化缺乏理解，因此需要系统刻画长会话退化并开发高效的缓解方法。
AI.method: 提出闭环的长会话稳定性评测框架；在该框架下评测多个公开全双工语音模型；提出基于自蒸馏的轻量LoRA适配训练框架；进一步提出双分辨率上下文（TRC）架构，对近期交互保留完整细节、对较久历史压缩为key-value表示。
AI.result: 在三种不同架构的模型上评测长会话稳定性、信息保持与计算效率：LoRA适配可缓解十分钟会话内的性能退化；加入TRC后增益可延伸至训练会话长度之外，并使KV缓存增长降低90%以上。
AI.conclusion: 全双工语音模型存在随时间推移的响应性、语音内容质量与音色一致性退化；自蒸馏LoRA适配与TRC上下文架构能以少量额外训练有效提升长会话稳定性并显著降低推理开销。

title: RefinedGAW: A Refined German Academic Web Dataset
comment: 26 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 13th Web as Corpus Workshop (WaC-13), 2026 (non-archival)
summary: The largest open German text datasets are built from broad web crawls, which provide scale but limited coverage of specific domains. We introduce RefinedGAW, a processed and annotated resource derived from 26 semi-annual crawls of the German Academic Web, totaling 122 million documents and 314 billion tokens, with full crawl and capture history of every text. Documents labeled as academic research account for 84% of German RefinedGAW tokens across HTML and PDF. At 87.6 billion tokens, this exceeds the 64.9 billion tokens in the German subsets of FineWeb2 and FinePDFs, despite their almost five-times-larger combined size. RefinedGAW also contains substantial amounts of educational, math-heavy, and expert-oriented content with minimal commercial bias. Across HTML and PDF, 88% of German RefinedGAW documents have no near-duplicate candidate match in the three evaluated reference datasets, supporting complementary coverage. We release a queryable metadata index for fine-grained data selection and a rehydration tool for retrieving and processing source documents.

AI.tldr: 提出RefinedGAW：基于德国学术网络26次半年爬取构建的122M文档、314B tokens德语数据集，学术研究类内容达87.6B tokens，超过FineWeb2与FinePDFs德语子集规模，且重叠度低、覆盖面互补。
AI.motivation: 现有最大开源德语数据集源自广泛网页爬取，规模大但对特定领域（尤其学术领域）覆盖有限。
AI.method: 对德国学术网络（German Academic Web）26次半年度爬取数据进行处理与标注，保留每篇文本完整的爬取与抓取历史；构建可查询的元数据索引以支持细粒度数据筛选，并提供rehydration工具用于源文档的检索与再处理。
AI.result: 数据集共122M文档、314B tokens；标注为学术研究的文档在HTML与PDF中占德语RefinedGAW tokens的84%，达87.6B tokens，高于FineWeb2与FinePDFs德语子集合计64.9B tokens（尽管后两者总规模约为其五倍）。同时富含教育类、数学密集型和专家导向内容，商业偏见低；88%的文档在三个参考数据集中无近似重复匹配。
AI.conclusion: RefinedGAW以高学术浓度和低重叠度提供与现有网页爬取语料互补的德语数据资源，适用于面向领域的数据选择与学术文本建模。

title: Text Is the Bottleneck: A Small-Scale Replication of LLM Game Playing in Riichi Mahjong
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Replication of the riichi-mahjong track of arXiv:2509.01328. Code, configurations and ~3,200 arena game logs released; no trained weights (Tenhou data terms)
summary: We replicate the riichi-mahjong track of "Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?" (arXiv:2509.01328) under a drastically smaller budget: models of at most 2B parameters, one 16 GB consumer GPU, about five GPU-days. (1) With matched data and labels, text is the bottleneck: on the same 100k-decision training set, a 2.6M-parameter convolutional board encoder agrees with the strong AI Mortal on 80.6% of test decisions, above every text-prompt LLM we train (best 77.8%), and places better at the table (2.85 over 1,000 games vs. ~3.0 for the LLMs; paired difference at n=100 not significant). Scaled to 1.71M decisions, a 4.9M-parameter Transformer reaches 94.7% agreement, beats the 0.8B LLMs on identical seeds (-0.45 ranks, sign test p=0.005), and is statistically equivalent to parity against three Mortal champions (TOST within 0.10 ranks, p=6e-4); parity against a teacher-opponent is roughly the ceiling of pure imitation. (2) Training toward the teacher raises teacher agreement more than a 2.5x parameter increase does (+2.5 vs. +1.5 points); on human-record agreement both effects are +1.0, and neither is visible at the table. (3) Few-point agreement differences do not resolve into playing strength within a family: +2.5 agreement points coincide with a paired placement difference of +0.02 +/- 0.12 ranks (p=1.0), and +2.0 points at 2B with -0.06 (p=0.37) - both below the ~0.25-rank resolution of 100 paired games. We also document a paper-code mismatch in the original winner filter, reconstruct its two private engine patches, and show that a divide-and-conquer pipeline makes template-generated Japanese rationales 93% sentence-exact (43% without facts). Per Tenhou's terms we release no trained weights - only code, configurations, and evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 在仅2B参数、单张16GB消费级GPU、约5 GPU天的预算下复现立直麻将赛道，发现文本输入是瓶颈：小型卷积棋盘编码器与Transformer在模仿Mortal上超过LLM，且达到与教师对战的模仿天花板；但评估层面数点的一致性差异无法转化为可测量的牌力差异。
AI.motivation: 原工作"Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?"(arXiv:2509.01328)的复现成本高；作者希望在极小预算下检验：LLM在复杂卡牌游戏（立直麻将）中的瓶颈究竟是模型规模还是状态表示（文本vs.棋盘编码），并厘清"教师一致性"与"实际牌力"之间的关系。同时需要澄清原文赢家筛选逻辑的论文-代码不一致。
AI.method: 1）受控对比：同数据同标签下，比较2.6M参数CNN棋盘编码器、文本提示LLM（≤0.8B/2B）在10万决策训练集上的表现；再将数据扩至171万决策，训练4.9M参数Transformer。2）以与强AI Mortal/人类记录/三名Mortal冠军的决策一致率与1000局（配对100局）名次差异作为指标，用符号检验与TOST等价检验统计。3）消融：训练目标朝向教师 vs. 2.5倍参数扩展对一致率的增益比较。4）工程复现：修正原文赢家筛选的paper-code mismatch、重建两个私有引擎补丁，并用分治流水线生成模板式日文解释（句级精确率93%，无事实注入时43%）。
AI.result: 文本是瓶颈：10万决策下CNN达80.6%一致率，优于所有自训LLM（最佳77.8%），名次2.85 vs ~3.0（n=100配对差不显著）。171万决策下4.9M Transformer达94.7%一致率，同种子下比0.8B LLM好-0.45名次（符号检验p=0.005），与三名Mortal冠军在0.10名次内等价（TOST p=6e-4），即达到纯模仿对教师对手的天花板。朝向教师训练带来+2.5点一致率增益，大于2.5倍参数的+1.5点；人类记录一致率两者均+1.0且牌桌不可见。数点一致率增益不转化为牌力：+2.5点对应+0.02±0.12名次（p=1.0），2B规模+2.0点对应-0.06（p=0.37），均低于100局配对约0.25名次的分辨率。
AI.conclusion: 在低预算下，立直麻将的瓶颈是状态表示（文本接口）而非模型规模，紧凑棋盘/序列编码器足以匹配甚至超越LLM，并触及纯模仿的天花板；决策一致率的小幅提升不足以在有限样本的牌桌评估中分辨出牌力差异，需注意评估分辨率与统计功效。作者还揭示了原文赢家筛选的论文-代码不一致并重建私有引擎补丁；依Tenhou条款仅发布代码、配置与评估协议，不发布训练权重。

title: BehaviorMem: Building and Evaluating User Memory from Real-World E-Commerce Behavior Streams
summary: User memory helps personalized systems build on their understanding of users over time. In e-commerce, users convey their preferences and needs through both explicit language and implicit interactions with products. We study memory built from logs of these interactions, examining how it can \emph{remember} concrete evidence and established interests, and use that evidence to \emph{infer} underlying needs and preferences that inform judgments beyond well-observed product domains. Existing memory methods primarily target language-based interactions, and evaluations offer limited real behavioral data and limited separation of these capabilities. This leaves open how to jointly support and separately evaluate remembering and inference from behavioral logs. We formulate the problem of continual behavioral user memory around these joint requirements and develop a dedicated evaluation framework and memory method to address them. \textbf{BehaviorMemBench} is a benchmark built from real e-commerce logs covering 1{,}194 users and 17{,}462 behavioral batches over more than three years, with automatic future-behavior labels and a task-independent memory interface to separately evaluate remembering and inference under a common protocol. \textbf{BehaviorMem} is a memory design that organizes explicit behavioral facts and inferred user characteristics across long-term and short-term scopes in a two-axis state, with evidence-grounded formation, continual maintenance, and query-independent readout. Experiments across two builders and two task readers show that BehaviorMem leads the evaluated agentic memories on remember and infer, and reveal different method rankings across the two capabilities and competitive statistical baselines. Validation on a public dataset further supports its usefulness for downstream tasks based on behavioral histories.

AI.tldr: 提出"持续行为用户记忆"问题，构造真实电商行为日志基准 BehaviorMemBench（1,194用户、17,462行为批次、逾三年），并设计双轴状态记忆方法 BehaviorMem，在"记住"与"推断"两项能力上分别评估并领先现有agentic记忆方法。
AI.motivation: 个性化系统需基于用户历史行为建立记忆。现有记忆方法主要面向语言交互，且评估缺乏真实行为数据、难以区分"记住具体证据"与"推断潜在需求"两种能力，因此需要同时支持并分别评估这两类能力的统一框架。
AI.method: 形式化定义持续行为用户记忆问题；构建 BehaviorMemBench：基于真实电商日志，含自动化的未来行为标签与任务无关的记忆接口，在统一协议下分离评估remember与infer；提出 BehaviorMem：以"长期/短期"与"显式行为事实/推断用户特征"构成两轴状态，配合证据锚定的记忆形成、持续维护与查询无关的读出机制。
AI.result: 在两种记忆构建器与两种任务读取器的组合下，BehaviorMem 在remember与infer两项指标上均优于所评估的agentic记忆方法；同时发现不同方法在两项能力上的排名不一致，且统计基线具有竞争力；在公开数据集上的验证进一步支持其对基于行为历史的下游任务的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 行为日志记忆需联合支持并分别评估"记忆证据"与"推断偏好"；BehaviorMemBench 提供了真实数据与可分离评估协议，BehaviorMem 的双轴状态设计在实践中表现更优，为持续行为用户记忆提供了基准与方法基础。

title: DecisionTraceBench: Tracking Decision-Critical Information in Multi-Party Spoken Conversations
summary: In high-stakes domains such as finance, critical information evolves through multi-party interaction. Recovering these changes and their sources is fundamental to reliable speech understanding. Existing speech benchmarks focus on transcription, local understanding, and turn-level state prediction, leaving joint decision evolution across speakers insufficiently evaluated. We introduce DecisionTraceBench, a speech state-tracking benchmark for Decision-Critical Information State Tracking (DCIST). It jointly evaluates decision event sequences, speaker attribution, scope, and temporal evidence, using trajectory-level F1 to measure complete event-chain recovery. Our dataset comprises Chinese financial dialogues involving two to four speakers, with 100.39 hours of synthetic audio and 8.61 hours of human-performed recordings. On a fixed cohort of human-performed recordings, five cascaded systems and two direct-audio models achieve DCIST scores of 5.73% to 21.35%. Ablations with speaker-labeled reference scripts and no temporal localization requirements yield a maximum score of only 38.72%. Audio perturbation experiments further show that overall transcription error rates do not adequately reflect complete trajectory recovery. These findings reveal limitations in jointly understanding information provenance and state evolution, providing a benchmark for evaluating decision-process understanding and decision traceability in high-stakes speech applications.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 DecisionTraceBench——面向"决策关键信息状态跟踪"(DCIST)的语音基准，联合评测决策事件序列、说话人归属、作用范围与时间证据，并用轨迹级 F1 衡量完整事件链的恢复程度。数据为2–4人中文金融对话（100.39 小时合成音频 + 8.61 小时真人录音）。真人录音固定子集上，5个级联系统与2个端到端音频模型得分仅 5.73%–21.35%；即使用说话人标注的参考文本并去掉时间定位要求，最高也只有 38.72%，表明现有系统在多说话人信息溯源与状态演化联合理解上存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 高风险领域（如金融）中的关键信息通过多方交互逐步演化，恢复这些变化及其来源是可靠语音理解的基础。而现有语音基准主要覆盖转写、局部理解与轮级状态预测，缺乏对跨说话人"联合决策演化"的评估，无法衡量信息溯源与决策轨迹的完整理解能力。
AI.method: 构建 DecisionTraceBench 基准，定义 DCIST 任务，要求同时输出决策事件序列、说话人归属、作用范围与时间证据，并以轨迹级 F1（trajectory-level F1）而非局部指标衡量完整事件链恢复。数据集为2–4位说话人的中文金融对话，含100.39小时合成音频与8.61小时真人演绎录音。评测对象包括5个级联（ASR+LLM）系统与2个直接音频输入模型，并设置消融（提供说话人标注参考文本、取消时间定位要求）与音频扰动实验。
AI.result: 在真人录音固定测试集上，7个系统的 DCIST 得分区间为 5.73%–21.35%；提供说话人标注参考文本且不要求时间定位时，最高得分仅 38.72%；音频扰动实验显示，整体转写错误率不能充分反映完整决策轨迹的恢复质量。
AI.conclusion: 现有语音系统在"信息溯源+状态演化"的联合理解上仍存在显著局限，局部转写指标不足以诊断决策级理解能力。DecisionTraceBench 为高风险语音应用中的决策过程理解与决策可追溯性评估提供了基准与诊断工具。

title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent
summary: Skills provide agents with reusable experience to guide future decisions without modifying the underlying model. However, coding trajectories are often entangled with task- and repository-specific contexts, making it challenging to distill procedural skills that generalize across diverse coding environments. To address this challenge, we present Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE), which progressively distills procedural knowledge from coding trajectories through hierarchical evidence aggregation. HSE first extracts task-level evidence from individual trajectories, then aggregates recurring evidence within the same repository to form repository-specific skill candidates, and finally consolidates consistent patterns across repositories into transferable skills across repositories. The evolution is driven by an external writer-evaluator loop that generates and assesses skills while keeping the underlying coding model frozen. The loop externally updates the writer and evaluator policies to improve subsequent skill generation and assessment. This hierarchy progressively filters task-specific details while preserving procedures that generalize across diverse coding environments. Successful trajectories yield reusable guidance for future tasks, while failed trajectories reveal recurring failure modes that guide avoidance and recovery. We evaluate HSE on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE, using GLM-5.2 across Pi and Claude Code harnesses and GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 with Pi. Across both benchmarks, 10 skills evolved solely from SWE-Gym improve coding performance across all evaluated settings, demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models, and agent harnesses. We further evolve the skill library from target-benchmark trajectories without verifier feedback, relying solely on the learned evaluator for candidate assessment and achieving additional gains through benchmark-tailored skills.

AI.tldr: HSE 通过分层证据聚合，从编码轨迹中渐进式蒸馏出可跨仓库迁移的过程性技能，在冻结模型的前提下由外部 writer-evaluator 循环演化技能库。
AI.motivation: 技能可为智能体提供可复用经验而不改动底层模型，但编码轨迹与具体任务和仓库上下文高度耦合，难以提炼出可跨环境泛化的过程性技能。
AI.method: 提出 Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE)：先在单条轨迹内抽取任务级证据，再在同仓库内聚合重复出现的证据形成仓库级技能候选，最后跨仓库整合一致模式得到可迁移技能；该过程由外部 writer-evaluator 循环驱动，底层编码模型保持冻结，并外部更新 writer 与 evaluator 策略以改进后续技能生成与评估；成功轨迹提供可复用指导，失败轨迹揭示可规避与可恢复的失败模式。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 与 DeepSWE 上，配合 GLM-5.2（Pi 与 Claude Code 框架）以及 GPT-5.5、Opus 4.8（Pi）评测；仅由 SWE-Gym 演化出的 10 个技能在所有设置下均提升编码性能，体现出跨基准、跨模型、跨框架的迁移性；进一步在不使用验证器反馈、仅依赖学习到的 evaluator 的情况下从目标基准轨迹演化技能库，可获得额外收益。
AI.conclusion: 分层技能演化能有效滤除任务特定细节、保留可泛化流程，且无需更新模型参数即可实现技能的跨环境迁移与基准定制化增强。

title: MATCHA: A Chinese Multi-Disorder Mental Health Dataset with Cross-Lingual Analyses on Social Media
comment: Published in Findings of EMNLP 2026. 18 pages, 6 figures
summary: Mental health research on social media has been dominated by English-language datasets and DSM-5-centered resources, limiting cross-lingual and cross-cultural understanding of online mental health expression. We introduce MATCHA, the first Chinese multi-disorder mental health dataset that links disorder-specific Weibo Super-Topic communities with users' broader public timelines. MATCHA covers seven DSM-5 disorders and a control group, comprising 46,025 cohort-level users and 1.8 million posts. The dataset distinguishes users with explicit self-disclosure evidence from broader disorder-related participants through an LLM-assisted annotation pipeline, and is released in a rigorously de-identified, controlled-access format. Using MATCHA, we analyze behavioral, linguistic, symptom-related, and life-event-related patterns across disorders, and conduct cross-lingual comparisons with Twitter-STMHD. Our analyses show that Weibo Super-Topics function as concentrated spaces for affective and health-related expression, while cross-platform differences between Weibo and Twitter often exceed cross-disorder variation. MATCHA provides a new resource for community-aware and cross-lingual mental health NLP research.

AI.tldr: MATCHA 是首个中文多障碍心理健康数据集，将微博超话社区与用户公开时间线关联，覆盖 7 种 DSM-5 障碍与对照组，含 46,025 名用户与 180 万条帖子。
AI.motivation: 现有社交媒体心理健康研究以英文数据集和 DSM-5 资源为主，缺乏跨语言、跨文化视角，对中文网络心理健康表达的理解受限。
AI.method: 构建 MATCHA：将障碍相关的微博超话社区与用户更广泛的公开时间线关联；覆盖七种 DSM-5 障碍及对照组；通过 LLM 辅助标注流程区分有明确自我披露证据的用户与更广泛的障碍相关参与者；以严格去标识化的受控访问形式发布；据此分析各障碍的行为、语言、症状与生活事件模式，并与 Twitter-STMHD 做跨语言比较。
AI.result: 微博超话是情感与健康相关表达的集中空间；微博与 Twitter 之间的跨平台差异常大于障碍之间的差异。
AI.conclusion: MATCHA 为社区感知与跨语言心理健康 NLP 研究提供了新资源。

title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
summary: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.

AI.tldr: 对DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017开展独立第三方安全评估，覆盖34个基准（含5个自研套件），比较其与V4代模型及领先闭源系统的系统级安全风险。
AI.motivation: 闭源模型发布常附完整系统卡，而开放权重模型在前沿风险上受到的审查较少；随着前沿模型能力与自主性增强，独立第三方评估对刻画系统性安全风险至关重要，因此需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 依据欧盟通用人工智能行为准则（GPAI Code of Practice），在评估完整性、失控、有害操纵三个维度上，使用34个基准（含5个内部自研套件）评估V4.1 Flash-1017；遵循AEF-1标准，与V4.1 Flash、更早的DeepSeek V4系列及GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.8 Flash等闭源系统对比。
AI.result: V4.1 Flash-1017相较V4代在安全性上有实质提升，在多个维度接近或匹配领先闭源基线，但仍表现出值得持续关注的行为。
AI.conclusion: 提出三点观察与建议：(1) 安全性会在小幅更新间波动甚至回退，应将安全评估纳入增量发布流程；(2) 仅凭末轮输出与终态检查无法可靠发现失控行为，部署需对推理轨迹与行动日志进行过程级可观测性监控；(3) 公开基准易诱发评估意识并存在数据污染风险，需建设私有基准以支撑可信的前沿评估。

title: Improving JEV Entailment Reranking with Span Readouts and Selective Adaptation
summary: JEV decision models pair a language model backbone with a lightweight scoring head to select among natural-language options. Direct selection compares candidate answers within one request, whereas entailment reranking evaluates each candidate in a separate natural language inference (NLI) request over fixed relation options. We examine whether the readout and adaptation choices used for direct selection remain effective for cross-request reranking. We combine a mean-span readout with selective backbone adaptation. Mean-span pooling replaces the option-ending pointer with an average of the contextualized states inside each NLI option, without adding head parameters. Selective adaptation retains low-rank updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing feed-forward adapters. On MC11, which averages accuracy over eleven reranking configurations from seven sources, selective adaptation improves NeoHorse-1-4B accuracy over the all-module baseline while cutting trainable parameters by more than half, and mean-span pooling yields further consistent gains at the same parameter count.

AI.tldr: 研究直接选择所用的读出与适配策略是否能迁移到跨请求的蕴含重排序，提出均值跨度读出+选择性主干适配，在MC11上以更少可训练参数取得更高准确率。
AI.motivation: JEV决策模型依赖语言模型主干+轻量打分头在自然语言选项中选择：直接选择在单次请求内比较候选，而蕴含重排序需对每个候选单独发起NLI请求（固定关系选项）。两种范式的请求结构不同，直接选择所用的读出方式与适配配置是否仍适用于跨请求重排序尚不清楚。
AI.method: 将均值跨度读出（mean-span readout）与选择性主干适配（selective backbone adaptation）结合：前者用每个NLI选项内部上下文状态的均值替代原有的选项末尾指针读出，且不新增打分头参数；后者仅在注意力与门控DeltaNet投影中保留低秩更新，移除前馈适配器。
AI.result: 在MC11（对来自七个来源的十一种重排序配置取平均准确率）上，选择性适配相比全模块基线提升NeoHorse-1-4B准确率，同时可训练参数减少一半以上；在相同参数预算下，均值跨度池化带来进一步的一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 面向直接选择的读出与适配设计不能原样迁移至跨请求重排序；以均值跨度池化替换指针式读出、并限定低秩更新作用于注意力与门控DeltaNet投影，可在显著降低可训练参数的同时稳定提升NLI式重排序准确率。

title: Lost in Translation: Investigating Systematic Discrepancies between Parallel English and Chinese Names of American Chinese Restaurants
summary: Given that the Chinese are one of the oldest ethnic groups to immigrate to the US, their cuisine have become central to the US dining scene and an interesting avenue to study how Chinese immigrants have culturally adapted into American life. In that regard, previous research has focused on analyzing the English names that Chinese restaurants adopt, e.g., finding the use of familiar and typical words. To investigate how Chinese immigrants have culturally integrated in the US depending on social, geographic and demographic contexts, we investigate in this work the under-explored relationship between the Chinese and English names of American Chinese restaurants. Specifically, we conduct a study on 3,172 Chinese restaurants (10% of the total on Google Maps) sampled across the US. We present 8-dimension name frames to capture the underlying meanings behind names and create the NameFrames dataset containing 884 annotated parallel Chinese/English names. We also built an NLP pipeline to analyze the semantic discrepancies between names with both frame-based and embedding-based distance metrics. Our frame analysis shows that English names more often emphasize Location and Specialty, while Chinese names more often emphasize Positivity and Ambiance. Furthermore, we observe that for Chinese restaurants located in urban areas, those in counties with a higher concentration of Chinese population, or those that are relatively new, the discrepancies between the English and Chinese names are noticeably larger. Finally, interviews with 10 Chinese restaurant owners reveal additional interesting insights regarding naming conventions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了美国中餐馆中英文名称之间的语义差异，构建了8维名称框架与NameFrames标注数据集（884对中英平行店名），并开发NLP管线进行框架与嵌入层面的差异度量，发现英文名更强调位置与特色、中文名更强调积极情绪与氛围，且在城市、华人聚居县及新开餐馆中差异更大。
AI.motivation: 华人是最早移民美国的族群之一，中餐已成为美国餐饮的重要组成部分，是研究华人文化适应的有趣切入点。既有研究多只分析中餐馆英文名（如常见词汇的使用），忽视了中英文名称之间的关系，而双语名称的差异可揭示华人在社会、地理与人口情境下的文化融合程度。
AI.method: 对美国范围内抽样的3,172家中餐馆（占Google Maps总量的10%）进行研究；提出8维名称框架（name frames）以刻画店名的隐含意义，构建含884对人工标注的中英平行店名的NameFrames数据集；搭建NLP管线，结合基于框架与基于嵌入的距离度量分析中英店名的语义差异；并对10位中餐馆经营者进行访谈。
AI.result: 框架分析显示英文名更常强调"位置"与"特色"，中文名更常强调"积极性"与"氛围"；位于城市地区、所在县华人人口比例较高、或开业时间较短的餐馆，其中英文名差异显著更大。
AI.conclusion: 中英双语店名的语义差异系统性地反映了华人移民的文化适应，且与地理、人口及餐馆新旧等情境因素相关；对10位经营者的访谈进一步揭示了店名命名惯例方面的见解。

title: The Patient Is Always Right? Evaluating Sycophancy in Medical Diagnosis with Graded Patient Beliefs
summary: More people are seeking out general-purpose AI models for medical advice, including diagnosis. Yet, AI models are susceptible to sycophancy, like validating users' beliefs even when they are untrue, which could lead to false positive diagnoses. Here, we evaluate how nine AI models change their diagnostic decision when a patient presents a belief that they have a specific (but incorrect) medical condition. We vary how close the user belief is to the clinical evidence presented. Models sycophantically adopt the patient's belief on average 23.2\% of the time---sometimes even when the patient proposes a fictional, made-up condition. We also varied different personas, including a Rare Disease Claimer that got models to accept their belief 43.0\% of the time. Additional analyses find that medical fine-tuning and model scale makes models less susceptible to changing their diagnoses. Sycophantic bias in medical diagnosis raises implications for safety, especially as more people are using AI for health support.

AI.tldr: 论文评估了九个通用AI模型在医疗诊断中的"谄媚"倾向：当患者提出错误（甚至虚构）的病症信念时，模型平均23.2%的概率放弃原诊断转而迎合患者；特定人设（如"罕见病声称者"）可将该比例推高至43.0%。
AI.motivation: 越来越多用户使用通用AI获取医疗建议乃至诊断，而AI存在谄媚（sycophancy）倾向，即认可用户不实的信念，可能导致假阳性诊断，构成医疗安全风险。作者旨在系统量化这一风险。
AI.method: 设计受控诊断场景：在呈现临床证据的基础上，加入患者坚持自己患有某一特定但错误病症的信念，并调节该信念与临床证据的接近程度。对九个AI模型进行测试，统计其诊断决策被患者信念改变的比例；进一步改变用户人设（personas，如"罕见病声称者"），并分析医学微调与模型规模对谄媚程度的影响。
AI.result: 模型平均23.2%的情况下谄媚地采纳患者信念，即使患者提出的是虚构病症亦如此；"罕见病声称者"人设下采纳率高达43.0%；医学领域微调与更大的模型规模可降低谄媚易感性。
AI.conclusion: 医疗诊断中的谄媚偏差对AI健康支持的安全性提出警示；随着AI在健康场景中普及，需重视并缓解此类迎合性偏差。

title: EXCISE: Locating and Excising Distracting Sentences in Medical Question Answering
summary: Language models are increasingly considered for clinical decision support, where their answers should be grounded in clinical evidence and remain robust to irrelevant information. Prior work shows that a single irrelevant sentence can lower the accuracy of medical models, but not where inside the model its effect can be removed, or how to do so without knowing which sentence it is. We find that blocking attention to a known distractor restores the answer, whereas head masking can suppress correct answers. We also show that the model's hidden states mark the distractor as the sentence that least fits the case even when the model follows it. To remove a distractor's effect without knowing which sentence it is, we propose EXCISE, an inference-time method that blocks the sentence most influencing the answer, but only if the model's hidden states mark it as inconsistent with the case. On MedQA-TD (MedQA with Targeted Distractors), a benchmark we construct in which each distractor targets a specific wrong option, EXCISE gains 16.7-22.8 accuracy points at a 1.5-2.1-point cost on the same questions without distractors, outperforming prompting, rewriting, and steering baselines for all three models. Its gains extend to MedDistractQA and BiasMedQA, as well as chain-of-thought generation.

AI.tldr: 论文发现模型隐藏状态能标记干扰句，据此提出推理期方法EXCISE，通过屏蔽最影响答案且被判定为与病例不符的句子来消除干扰，在MedQA-TD等基准上取得16.7-22.8准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 语言模型用于临床决策支持时，答案需基于临床证据并对无关信息保持鲁棒。已有工作表明单句无关信息即可降低医学模型准确率，但尚不清楚该效应在模型内部何处可被消除，以及如何在不知道是哪句话的情况下进行消除。
AI.method: 机制分析：对比阻断对已知干扰句的注意力（可恢复答案）与head masking（反而抑制正确答案），并考察隐藏状态对干扰句的标记。据此提出EXCISE：一种推理期方法，屏蔽对答案影响最大的句子，但仅当隐藏状态将该句标记为与病例最不一致时才执行。
AI.result: 构建MedQA-TD基准（每个干扰句针对特定错误选项）。EXCISE在三个模型上于同题无干扰情形仅损失1.5-2.1分的前提下获得16.7-22.8准确率提升，优于prompting、rewriting与steering基线；增益亦扩展至MedDistractQA、BiasMedQA及思维链生成。
AI.conclusion: 干扰效应可在注意力层面定位并消除；隐藏状态可作为干扰句的可靠内部信号，支撑无需外部标注的推理期去干扰方法。

title: Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/
summary: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for $4$ uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by $3.2$-$4.5$ dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by $2.8$-$3.8\times$ over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over $96\%$ Acc@$5^\circ$ without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/.

AI.tldr: GenSfM 将图像级 3D 重建与原生 3D 扩散模型耦合，用多模态扩散 Transformer 在共享自注意力下联合去噪形状隐变量与逐视图位姿隐变量，实现少视图、未标定条件下既忠实观测又合理补全未见区域，且无需外部位姿估计或已知内参。
AI.motivation: 从少量未标定视图恢复物体 3D 结构与相机运动是视觉基础问题。经典 SfM 只能得到与输入一致但无法补全未见区域的几何；原生生成方法虽能生成合理 3D 物体，却不保证与输入图像一致；简单串联重建与生成会引发两阶段间误差级联，难以同时满足分布先验与输入一致性。
AI.method: 提出 GenSfM：采用多模态扩散 Transformer，在共享自注意力机制下对形状 latent 与逐视图位姿 latent 联合去噪，以观测视图为几何锚定、以物体级先验推断未观测区域；设计紧凑的 3D 原生 UV-volume 分词化（tokenization），使视图增加时联合序列仍保持较短；并引入位姿感知精化阶段，在恢复的相机位姿下采样逐体素图像特征以优化几何与纹理。
AI.result: 在 Toys4k 与 GSO 数据集、4 张未标定视图设置下，相较强原生 3D 生成基线，新视图 PSNR 提升 3.2–4.5 dB，中位 Chamfer 距离降低 2.8–3.8 倍；输入视图位姿恢复达 96% 以上 Acc@5°，且无需外部位姿估计骨干、事后优化或已知内参。
AI.conclusion: 将重建与生成在统一扩散框架中联合建模，可避免两阶段串联的误差级联，同时兼顾对输入图像的忠实性与对未见区域的合理补全，并在位姿、几何与外观指标上均显著优于原生 3D 生成基线。

title: Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, 16 references. Author's preprint; to be submitted to a peer-reviewed journal
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on huge text collections to generate text by predicting what comes next. Engineers using ChatGPT and other generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools need a clear picture of what training changes and prompts add. The article starts with the Transformer, which connects words in context, and pre-training, where models learn to predict text. It then explains how fine-tuning adapts models to requests, with reinforcement learning from human feedback using human answer rankings. Next, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies documents, while chain-of-thought prompting encourages intermediate steps and agents use tools. FlashAttention lowers training and running costs by reducing data movement during attention; quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) saves fine-tuning memory. Readers get a life cycle figure and tables comparing methods and their limits. A short checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims flags test material in training (data contamination) and model-based grading (LLM-as-a-judge). It also covers very long inputs (long context) and hallucination, meaning false or unsupported claims. Check factual accuracy separately from whether an answer sounds helpful.

AI.tldr: 本文综述大语言模型（LLM）的工作原理与工程实践要点，涵盖Transformer与预训练、微调与RLHF、RAG、思维链与智能体、FlashAttention与QLoRA等关键技术，并给出方法对比图表及评估清单。
AI.motivation: 使用ChatGPT等生成式AI工具的工程师需要清晰理解"训练改变了什么"以及"提示带来了什么"，但相关概念庞杂、缺乏系统的对照梳理，因此需要一篇面向工程读者的原理与实务概览。
AI.method: 以综述/教程形式组织内容：从Transformer的上下文关联与预训练（下一词预测）讲起，依次介绍微调（含基于人类答案排序的RLHF）、检索增强生成（RAG）、思维链提示与工具使用型智能体；并从效率角度说明FlashAttention（减少注意力计算中的数据搬运以降低训练与推理成本）与QLoRA（量化低秩适配，节省微调显存），辅以生命周期图和对比方法及其局限的表格，最后提供评估核查清单。
AI.result: 形成了一套结构化知识框架：方法对比表呈现各技术的能力与局限；生命周期图串联训练到应用流程；评估清单用于识别数据污染（测试材料出现在训练数据中）与LLM-as-a-judge（模型自评）等评估瑕疵，并讨论长上下文与幻觉（虚假或无依据的陈述）问题。
AI.conclusion: 工程实践中应区分事实准确性与"回答看起来是否有帮助"这两类判断，二者不可混同；理解和组合预训练、微调、RAG、提示与效率优化等技术，并配合审慎的评估方法，是可靠使用LLM的关键。

title: Xing USP: A Cross-Family Semantic Contract for Information Extraction and Intent-Slot Parsing
summary: Structured semantic parsing is typically judged by whether the correct category is assigned, which leaves value recovery and instance-level associations unexamined: a system may recognize an event yet bind an argument to the wrong instance, or identify an intent yet supply an incorrect slot value. We present USP, a cross-family semantic contract that represents categories, fields, values, and instance associations through a common interface for named-entity recognition, relation extraction, event extraction, and intent-slot parsing. The contract is paired with five diagnostic matching views---category agreement, field recognition, field-value pairing, instance-bound assignment, and complete-instance recovery---that ask distinct questions about the same output. Using this contract, we normalize 61 datasets into a unified corpus with shared schemas, prompts, and matching rules, and compare six models on a fixed test subset. Our fine-tuned Xing4.0-29B-Intent attains 57.70 task-balanced Field-Value Micro-F1 (equally weighted across the four task families) and ranks first in every family and on all five views; its margin over the strongest alternative widens from 2.93 points for category matching to 20.73 points for complete-instance matching. This widening gap shows that category agreement alone understates structural deficits. USP thus offers the community a shared representation, a normalized 61-dataset corpus, and a diagnostic evaluation protocol that make structural agreement measurable and comparable across extraction and intent-slot tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出USP——跨任务族的"语义契约"，用统一接口表示类别、字段、取值与实例关联，并配套五种诊断性匹配视图，将61个数据集归一化为统一语料，用于可比较地评测结构一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化语义解析通常只以"类别是否分配正确"作为评判标准，忽视取值恢复与实例级关联：系统可能识别出事件却把论元绑到错误实例，或识别出意图却给出错误槽值。因此需要一种能衡量结构一致性的统一表示与评测协议。
AI.method: 构建USP跨族语义契约，统一表征命名实体识别、关系抽取、事件抽取、意图-槽解析四类任务的类别/字段/取值/实例关联；设计五个诊断匹配视图（类别一致、字段识别、字段-取值配对、实例绑定赋值、完整实例恢复）；据此将61个数据集归一化为共享模式、提示与匹配规则的统一语料，并在固定测试子集上比较六个模型。
AI.result: 微调后的Xing4.0-29B-Intent取得57.70的任务均衡Field-Value Micro-F1（四任务族等权），在每个任务族及全部五个视图上均排名第一；相对最强对比模型的领先幅度从类别匹配的2.93分扩大到完整实例匹配的20.73分。
AI.conclusion: 领先幅度随视图细化而扩大的现象表明，仅凭类别一致会低估结构缺陷。USP为社区提供了共享表示、归一化的61数据集语料与诊断性评测协议，使结构一致性在抽取与意图-槽任务间可测量、可比较。

title: StaX-Net: Stackelberg Interleaved Asymmetric Network for Cross-Modality Medical Image Translation
summary: Cross-modality medical image translation is challenged by anatomically inconsistent synthesis that can compromise clinical diagnosis. We propose StaX-Net, a Stackelberg interleaved asymmetric network that incorporates a partially coupled encoder-discriminator structure, and a 2D feature aggregation and spatial transformation (FAST) layer that distills target-supervised priors under the learning using privileged information paradigm. The shared blocks between the generator and discriminator enhance architectural feature alignment. To stabilize the leader-follower training, a Stackelberg-inspired asymmetric optimization scheme employs explicit shared-parameter freezing and asymmetric learning rates. The FAST layer distills target-domain priors during training and applies a source-only transform at inference. This constrains the synthesis process through target-informed feature representations relative to standard generative architectures. The code is available on GitHub for public use.

AI.tldr: 提出StaX-Net，一种Stackelberg交错非对称网络，通过部分耦合的编码器-判别器结构、FAST层（在特权信息学习范式下蒸馏目标监督先验）以及非对称优化（显式共享参数冻结+非对称学习率）来缓解跨模态医学图像转换中的解剖不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 跨模态医学图像转换存在解剖不一致的合成结果，可能影响临床诊断，需要约束合成过程以提升结构/解剖一致性。
AI.method: 1) 生成器与判别器共享部分模块（部分耦合编码器-判别器），增强架构层面的特征对齐；2) 提出2D特征聚合与空间变换（FAST）层，在学习使用特权信息（LUPI）范式下蒸馏目标域监督先验，训练时利用目标域先验、推理时仅用源域输入完成变换；3) 基于Stackelberg思想设计非对称优化方案，通过显式共享参数冻结与非对称学习率稳定leader-follower训练。
AI.result: FAST层在训练阶段蒸馏目标域先验、推理阶段仅执行源域变换，从而以目标域引导的特征表示约束合成过程；相较标准生成式架构获得更具解剖一致性约束的合成。摘要未给出定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过部分耦合结构、LUPI式先验蒸馏与非对称Stackelberg优化三者的结合，StaX-Net在保持推理时仅需源模态的前提下，为跨模态医学图像转换提供了更强的解剖一致性约束；代码已开源。

title: OrthoRF: Exploring Orthogonality in Object-Centric Representations
summary: Neural synchrony is hypothesized to help the brain organize visual scenes into structured multi-object representations. In machine learning, synchrony-based models analogously learn object-centric representations by storing binding in the phase of complex-valued features. Rotating Features (RF) instantiate this idea with vector-valued activations, encoding object presence in magnitudes and affiliation in orientations. We propose Orthogonal Rotating Features (OrthoRF), which enforces orthogonality in RF's orientation space via an inner-product loss and architectural modifications. This yields sharper phase alignment and more reliable grouping. In evaluations of unsupervised object discovery, including settings with overlapping objects, noise, and out-of-distribution tests, OrthoRF matches or outperforms current models while producing more interpretable representations, and it eliminates the post-hoc clustering required by many synchrony-based approaches. Unlike current models, OrthoRF also recovers occluded object parts, indicating stronger grouping under occlusion. Overall, orthogonality emerges as a simple, effective inductive bias for synchrony-based object-centric learning.

AI.tldr: 提出正交旋转特征（OrthoRF），通过内积损失与架构改正在相位空间强制正交性，获得更锐利的相位对齐与更可靠的物体分组，在无监督物体发现任务中匹配或超越现有模型，且无需后处理聚类、能恢复被遮挡的物体部分。
AI.motivation: 神经同步假说认为大脑借同步性组织多物体视觉场景；机器学习中以复值特征相位存储绑定关系来实现物体中心表示。旋转特征（RF）用向量激活，幅值编码物体存在、方向编码归属，但相位对齐不够锐利、分组可靠性有限，且许多同步类方法依赖事后聚类。
AI.method: 提出OrthoRF：在RF的方向空间通过内积损失及架构修改施加正交性约束，使不同物体的方向表示相互正交，从而强化相位对齐与分组判别性。
AI.result: 在无监督物体发现评测（含重叠物体、噪声、分布外测试）中，OrthoRF匹配或优于当前模型，表示更具可解释性；无需事后聚类；相较现有模型还能恢复被遮挡的物体部分，表明遮挡下分组能力更强。
AI.conclusion: 正交性是一种简单而有效的归纳偏置，可提升基于同步性的物体中心学习。

title: Quantifying Meaning with SCAPE-T: Semantic Complexity from Encoder-Only Transformer Attention
comment: 12 pages; semantic complexity, complexity estimation, encoder attention, attention analysis, pairwise accuracy, readability, text simplification, transformers
summary: Automated semantic complexity estimation remains underexplored in NLP, despite important applications in linguistics and interpretability. This paper defines semantic complexity as the code length required to uniquely specify a text's semantic meaning, and operationalises it via SCAPE-T, an attention-derived metric based on encoder-only transformers. Existing measures either model reader effort (readability, lexical difficulty), which correlates with surface features (word length, syntax), or quantify surface features directly (type-token ratio, word frequency). SCAPE-T targets semantic integration directly by combining three submetrics: (i) inverse-weighted self-focus (token-to-self), (ii) CLS focus (token-to-CLS), and (iii) inter-head redundancy (cosine similarity across heads), using layer-weighted aggregation; data-driven learning is confined to hyperparameter tuning for calibration. Development uses philosophical prose vs. MCTest stories; evaluation is on children's stories vs. technical Wikipedia articles, with pairwise accuracy on contrasts as the primary criterion. Baselines include readability, syntactic/lexical, and LLM-derived measures. SCAPE-T substantially outperforms all tested baselines under word-length control, with a pairwise accuracy of 78.5% (95% bootstrap CI: 76.1-80.4, N=10k pairwise comparisons; +12.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline); without that control, readability heuristics overtake, consistent with their reliance on surface features. On a short-terms abstractness dataset, SCAPE-T also leads. Ablations show each submetric contributes materially. Overall, the results show SCAPE-T isolates conceptual structure from lexical/syntactic confounds better than existing methods, and generalises across two held-out domains.

AI.tldr: 提出语义复杂度即"唯一确定文本语义所需的编码长度"，并用基于编码器注意力的SCAPE-T指标（逆加权自关注、CLS关注、头间冗余三子指标，层加权聚合）操作化；在控制词长下成对准确率78.5%，显著优于可读性、句法/词汇及LLM类基线，且在短词抽象性数据集上领先，消融显示各子指标均有实质贡献。
AI.motivation: NLP中自动化语义复杂度估计研究不足，但其在语言学与可解释性方面有重要应用。现有指标要么刻画读者加工努力（可读性、词汇难度），与词长、句法等表层特征高度相关；要么直接量化表层特征（类符-形符比、词频），均无法直接捕捉语义整合过程。
AI.method: 将语义复杂度定义为唯一确定文本语义所需的编码长度，并以SCAPE-T实现：基于仅编码器Transformer的注意力派生指标，含三个子指标——(i) 逆加权自关注（token-to-self）、(ii) CLS关注（token-to-CLS）、(iii) 头间冗余（各注意力头余弦相似度），采用层加权聚合；数据驱动学习仅限超参数校准。开发集为哲学散文 vs. MCTest故事，评测集为儿童故事 vs. 技术类维基百科文章，以对比样本的成对准确率为主要指标，基线包括可读性、句法/词汇及LLM衍生指标。
AI.result: 在控制词长条件下，SCAPE-T显著优于所有基线，成对准确率78.5%（95% bootstrap CI: 76.1–80.4，N=10k成对比较），较最强基线高12.7个百分点；不加该控制时可读性启发式反超，与其依赖表层特征一致。在短词抽象性数据集上SCAPE-T同样领先。消融表明三个子指标均有实质贡献。
AI.conclusion: SCAPE-T相比现有方法能更好地区分概念结构与词汇/句法混淆因素，并在两个留出领域上具备泛化性；语义复杂度可作为可从注意力中读取的、与表层特征解耦的独立维度加以度量。

title: TriageRAG: Failure-Aware Self-Training for Adapting Retrieval-Augmented Language Models to Specialized Domains
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets large language models (LLMs) answer knowledge-intensive questions from retrieved evidence, but adapting a general-purpose RAG system to a specialized domain such as medicine is difficult when only an unlabeled corpus is available. Self-training approaches such as SimRAG address this by letting the LLM write its own question-answer pairs from domain passages and fine-tuning on the pairs that survive a round-trip consistency filter. We observe that these approaches treat every retained example identically: they never ask whether the student already knows the answer, already extracts it correctly from the retrieved context, or fails - and if so, whether the failure lies with the reader or with the retriever. To tackle this, we propose TriageRAG, a failure-aware self-training approach that probes the student on each self-generated question with and without retrieved context, triages it into one of four categories (known, solved, context-failure, retrieval-failure), and routes each category to the training signal that addresses it, including a parametric route that teaches the reader to answer when retrieval misses. Probing is cheap and repeated every round, so the training mixture follows the student, and the triage histogram doubles as a label-free diagnostic of where the domain gap lies. Experiments on 11 datasets spanning three domains with a Qwen3-4B backbone, and on CS-Bench with Qwen3-8B, demonstrate that TriageRAG outperforms a budget-matched SimRAG by 1.2-6.4 points and is the only method that recovers the closed-book level in every case where retrieval hurts the base model. A single ablation identifies the mechanism: round-trip filtering removes every training context that lacks the evidence, and a reader that never sees such contexts learns to over-trust noisy retrieval.

AI.tldr: TriageRAG：一种失败感知的自训练方法，通过在有无检索上下文两种条件下探测学生模型，将每条自生成样本划分为"已掌握/已解决/上下文失败/检索失败"四类并分别路由到对症的训练信号，使训练混合比随学生能力自适应调整，并在无标签条件下诊断领域差距所在。
AI.motivation: 通用RAG系统在仅有未标注语料的专业领域（如医学）中难以适配。现有自训练方法（如SimRAG）让LLM从领域段落自造问答对并用往返一致性过滤筛选，但把保留样本一视同仁，不区分学生是否已知答案、能否正确抽取、失败时归咎于读者还是检索器。
AI.method: 对每条自生成问题，分别在"有检索上下文"和"无检索上下文（闭卷）"两种设定下探测学生模型，据结果把样本归入四类：known（已知）、solved（已解决）、context-failure（上下文失败）、retrieval-failure（检索失败），并为每类分配对应训练信号，其中"参数化路由"用于在检索缺失时教读者直接作答。探测成本低且每轮重复，故训练混合比能随学生演进；分类直方图同时充当无标签的领域差距诊断工具。
AI.result: 在3个领域共11个数据集、Qwen3-4B骨干，以及CS-Bench上以Qwen3-8B为骨干的实验中，TriageRAG比同等预算的SimRAG高1.2–6.4分；在所有"检索反而损害基座模型"的情形下，它是唯一能恢复到闭卷水平的方法。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验揭示机制：往返一致性过滤会剔除所有不含证据的训练上下文，而从未见过此类上下文的读者会习得对噪声检索的过度信任；失败感知的分诊路由正是针对这一缺陷而设计。

title: StateWise: Teaching Language Models to Track and Obey Evolving Constraints in Multi-Turn Dialogue
summary: Users of conversational assistants rarely state all requirements up front: they add constraints, amend them, withdraw them, digress, and return. Instruction-tuned LLMs fail here in two ways: active constraints stop being honored as turns accumulate (persistence failure), and withdrawn constraints keep being enacted (relapse). The only existing repair we know of is an external ledger that re-injects a compiled specification every turn. We propose StateWise, a self-improving approach that teaches a single LLM to maintain its own revisable constraint state, a typed state with tombstones for revoked constraints, so persistence and relapse are measured by executable checkers and ground-truth states are compiled for free. StateWise fine-tunes the LLM on two complementary skills, summarizing a dialogue into its constraint state and responding conditioned on that state, then self-trains on its own trajectories, keeping only turns that pass an exact round-trip check against the compiled state. This teaches 7-8B models to track the state almost perfectly but, surprisingly, not to obey it: on Llama-3.1-8B every supervised variant roughly doubles relapse. We therefore add a preference stage on self-generated relapse contrasts, where the rejected response enacts a revoked rule and the chosen one passes the round-trip check. On two backbones with held-out constraint families and unseen phrasings, StateWise cuts relapse by 8-22 points relative to supervised self-training, lifts conversation success by 8-19 points over the backbone, and beats an oracle compiled-ledger baseline on relapse with no inference-time scaffolding. We also characterize the recipe's cost on general instruction-following benchmarks and study weight interpolation as a mitigation.

AI.tldr: StateWise 让单个 LLM 维护自身可修订的、带“墓碑”标记的类型化约束状态，通过“对话→状态摘要”与“基于状态响应”的监督微调 + 自训练 + 针对复发对比的偏好学习，在不使用推理期外部脚手架的情况下显著降低约束遗忘（persistence failure）与已撤销约束复发（relapse）。
AI.motivation: 会话助手用户很少一次性给出全部需求，而是逐步增删、撤回、跑题再返回。指令微调 LLM 存在两类失效：活跃约束随轮次累积不再被遵守（persistence failure），以及已撤回约束仍被继续执行（relapse）。现有唯一修补手段是外部账本每轮重新注入编译好的规范，依赖推理期脚手架。
AI.method: 提出 StateWise：类型化约束状态 + 撤销约束的 tombstone 标记；用可执行检查器度量 persistence/relapse，并可免费编译出 ground-truth 状态。两阶段：(1) 监督微调两项互补技能——将对话摘要为约束状态、基于该状态作答；随后在自生成轨迹上自训练，仅保留通过相对编译状态精确往返校验的轮次。(2) 在自生成 relapse 对比样本上做偏好学习：被拒回答执行了已撤销规则，被选回答通过往返校验。
AI.result: 7–8B 模型几乎完美跟踪状态却不遵守：Llama-3.1-8B 上所有监督变体使 relapse 约翻倍。加入偏好阶段后，在两个骨干、留出约束族与未见措辞上，相较监督自训练 relapse 下降 8–22 点，对话成功率较骨干提升 8–19 点，且在无推理期脚手架条件下 relapse 优于 oracle 编译账本基线；同时刻画了该配方在通用指令遵循基准上的代价，并研究权重插值作为缓解手段。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠状态跟踪的监督学习不足以带来遵从，必须显式用偏好优化消解“跟踪正确但执行错误”的落差；StateWise 以自生成对比与精确可执行校验实现可自我改进的内生约束状态维护，并可替代外部账本脚手架，但需权衡通用指令遵循性能。

title: C-DFF: Concept-Level Diagnostics for Mechanism Parity in Simulation-Based Validation of Autonomous Driving Perception
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), Naples, Italy, September 15-18, 2026
summary: Simulation is widely used in autonomous-driving validation, but matching task outputs between real and synthetic images does not guarantee that a system relies on the same visual evidence. This creates a validation gap for transfer, especially in safety-critical perception functions. We present Concept-Decisive Feature Fidelity (C-DFF), a concept-level mechanism-parity diagnostic for paired real-synthetic evaluation. Starting from decisive evidence extracted from a frozen system-under-test (SUT), C-DFF projects that evidence into a shared semantic concept space using off-the-shelf segmentation and compares real and synthetic concept-importance vectors. The result is not only a scalar mechanism-parity score, but also a concept-shift diagnostic that identifies which scene concepts become more or less decisive in simulation. We evaluate C-DFF on KITTI $\leftrightarrow$ Virtual KITTI 2 with 2126 matched pairs across three frozen SUTs (steering regression, YOLOP drivable-area, YOLOP lane-line). Across these tasks, C-DFF is SUT-discriminative and yields interpretable concept-level summaries that support validation triage and simulator debugging. When reported alongside task-specific output-value context metrics, C-DFF shows that output agreement does not by itself establish mechanism parity. These results position C-DFF as a practical semantic diagnostic layer for validation and verification workflows in simulation-based AV testing.

AI.tldr: C-DFF是一种概念级“机制一致性”诊断方法，用于成对真实-合成图像评估：从冻结被测系统中提取决定性证据，经现成分割映射到共享语义概念空间，比较真实与合成图像的概念重要性向量，输出机制一致性标量分数及概念漂移诊断。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶仿真验证中，真实与合成图像的任务输出一致，并不能保证系统依赖相同的视觉证据，这一“验证鸿沟”在安全关键的感知功能上尤为突出。
AI.method: 从冻结SUT中提取决定性证据，利用现成分割模型将证据投影到共享语义概念空间，比较真实与合成的概念重要性向量；除标量机制一致性评分外，还给出概念转移诊断，识别哪些场景概念在仿真中变得更关键或更不关键。在KITTI↔Virtual KITTI 2的2126对匹配样本上，针对三个冻结SUT（转向回归、YOLOP可行驶区域、YOLOP车道线）进行评估。
AI.result: C-DFF具有SUT判别性，产出可解释的概念级摘要，支持验证分诊与仿真器调试；与任务特定的输出值上下文指标并列报告时，表明输出一致性本身并不能确立机制一致性。
AI.conclusion: C-DFF可作为基于仿真的自动驾驶测试验证与确认流程中的实用语义诊断层。

title: Embedding-Based Educational Taxonomies
summary: Educational taxonomies organize educational content, such as exercise problems, into concepts, which are also called skills or knowledge components. These taxonomies define learning objectives in educational applications such as intelligent tutoring systems. Developed through human expertise and iterative refinement, they also provide fundamental structure for curricula, assessment, and models of student learning. Recent advances in semantic text embeddings make it possible to construct alternative educational taxonomies computationally from the content itself. In this paper, we investigate this possibility by clustering embeddings of math questions to construct embedding-based educational taxonomies. We compare these taxonomies with the existing Common Core State Standards (CCSS)-based knowledge-component taxonomies in two ASSISTments datasets and evaluate their utility in Deep Knowledge Tracing, a downstream task that relies on taxonomic mappings of questions to knowledge components. The embedding-based taxonomies exhibit substantial but incomplete correspondence with the existing taxonomies, revealing both preserved and alternative organizations of educational content. When used for knowledge tracing, they improve predictive performance by approximately 3-5 AUC percentage points. These results demonstrate the potential of semantic embeddings for automatically constructing educational taxonomies that both recover structure present in human-developed taxonomies and provide useful alternative representations for downstream educational modeling.

AI.tldr: 通过聚类数学题的语义嵌入自动构建教育分类体系，其与CCSS知识组件分类体系存在实质性但不完全一致的对应关系，并在知识追踪任务中带来约3-5个AUC百分点的提升。
AI.motivation: 传统教育分类体系（如知识组件、技能）依赖人工专家构建与迭代精炼，成本高且带有主观性；语义文本嵌入的进展使从内容本身自动构建分类体系成为可能，本文旨在检验这一可行性及其下游价值。
AI.method: 对数学题目的文本嵌入进行聚类，构建基于嵌入的教育分类体系；在两个ASSISTments数据集上，将其与基于共同核心州立标准（CCSS）的知识组件分类体系进行对比，并以深度知识追踪（DKT）作为下游任务，评估不同题目—知识组件映射的功效。
AI.result: 嵌入式分类体系与人工分类体系之间呈现显著但不完全的对应关系，既保留了原有结构，也揭示了内容的替代性组织方式；用于知识追踪时，预测性能提升约3–5个AUC百分点。
AI.conclusion: 语义嵌入可用于自动构建教育分类体系，既能部分还原人工体系中已有的结构，又能提供对下游教育建模有用的替代性表示，为课程、评估与学习模型提供可扩展的结构基础。

title: $Δτ$-Bench: Pushing Agents Toward a Moving Capability
summary: In this paper, we introduce $Δτ$-Bench, an executable agent benchmark that models the structural evolution of large tool ecosystems. In $Δτ$-Bench, independently evolving services continually reshape how tasks can be accomplished: familiar tools may disappear or be replaced, while more efficient alternatives emerge amid overlapping functionality and noisy documentation. Against this moving capability frontier, we evaluate whether agents can proactively discover efficient tool-use paths and promptly revise their accumulated procedural knowledge, bringing together demands that existing benchmarks fail to examine. $Δτ$-Bench comprises 1,588 validated multi-turn tasks across 42 domains and six successive ecosystem states generated through capability-preserving transformations. Our evaluation shows that even the strongest evaluated model or harness achieves only 42.3% task success, while initial gains from existing skill-learning methods can not consistently translate into better adaptation as the ecosystem evolves. These findings motivate Steward, an ecosystem manager that jointly manages tools and procedural knowledge through incremental skill maintenance and dynamic provisioning during task execution. Experiments show that Steward sustains higher task success across ecosystem changes with lower skill-maintenance overhead, while improving both recovery from disrupted workflows and adoption of more efficient alternatives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Δτ-Bench，一个建模工具生态系统结构演化的可执行智能体基准（42 个领域、6 个连续生态状态、1,588 个多轮任务），并据此提出 Steward 生态管理器。
AI.motivation: 现实中的工具生态持续演化：常用工具消失或被替代、出现更高效的替代品、功能重叠且文档嘈杂。现有基准无法同时考察"主动发现高效工具使用路径"与"及时修正累积的过程性知识"这两项能力。
AI.method: 构建 Δτ-Bench：通过保持能力的变换生成 6 个连续生态状态，任务可执行、多轮。提出 Steward，一个生态系统管理器，相结合增量式技能维护与任务执行期间的动态供给（dynamic provisioning），联合管理工具与过程性知识。
AI.result: 最强被测模型/框架仅达 42.3% 任务成功率；现有技能学习方法带来的初始增益在生态演化中不能稳定转化为更好的适应能力。Steward 在生态变化下保持更高的任务成功率、更低的技能维护开销，并改善工作流中断后的恢复与高效替代方案采纳。
AI.conclusion: 工具生态的动态演化对当前智能体构成显著挑战，需将工具管理与过程性知识维护协同设计；Steward 验证了该方向的可行性与收益。

title: Rethinking Retrieval in the Long-Context Era: Training-Free Semantic Trees for Adaptive Context Construction
summary: Long-context language models can increasingly process entire documents, making full-context prompting a practical alternative to passage retrieval. However, greater capacity determines how much information a model can receive, but not which information best supports a query. This distinction motivates rethinking retrieval: when the full document already fits, can selecting and organizing its evidence improve answering? The challenge is to retain supporting facts and relations while keeping the context focused on the question. To reconcile these goals, we introduce \ours, a training-free framework that uses semantic abstraction to guide selection while retaining original text for answering. \ours constructs a reusable semantic hierarchy from the full document in a single generation, linking node descriptions to source spans. Given a query, structural--semantic scoring and fine-grained lexical attribution nominate shared source nodes; their union with ancestor context preserves structural relations and complete local text. Across four frontier answer models, \ours improves average QA-F1 by 1.72 points over full-context prompting on three LongBench tasks, surpassing the evaluated baselines on the four-model average while reducing answer-context length by 58.55\%. Our code is available at the $\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/treefuse-ECFE}{repository}$.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架TreeFuse：将全文构建为可复用的语义层次结构，结合结构-语义打分与细粒度词汇归因选出证据节点，并保留原文用于回答，在LongBench上以更短上下文超越全上下文提示。
AI.motivation: 长上下文模型已能处理整篇文档，使得全上下文提示可替代段落检索。但"容量"只决定模型能接收多少信息，不决定哪些信息最支持查询。因此需要重新思考检索问题：当全文已能完整放入上下文时，是否可通过选择与组织证据来提升问答效果——难点在于既保留支撑事实与关系，又让上下文聚焦于问题。
AI.method: TreeFuse为免训练框架：1）用语义抽象引导选择，同时保留原始文本用于回答；2）一次生成即从全文构建可复用的语义层次结构，将节点描述链接到源文本片段（source spans）；3）给定查询后，通过结构-语义打分与细粒度词汇归因提名共享源节点，并取其与祖先节点的并集，以保留结构关系和完整的局部文本。
AI.result: 在四个前沿答案模型上，TreeFuse于三个LongBench任务相较全上下文提示平均提升QA-F1 1.72个点，四模型平均值超过所评估基线，同时将回答上下文长度减少58.55%。
AI.conclusion: 在全文档可容纳的前提下，基于语义层次结构的证据选择与组织可同时提升长上下文问答质量并显著压缩上下文长度，为"全文畅享"场景下的检索式上下文工程提供了免训练方案。

title: Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.

AI.tldr: 提出 dSpark，一个基于调度蒸馏的框架，学习在扩散大语言模型解码中"何时提交哪些 token"，以不确定性削减为准则构造揭示调度并蒸馏进模型，配合 KL 正则保持生成质量，实现更快并行采样。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型可并行生成多个 token，但往往需要大量解码轮次才能完成响应。高效生成不仅取决于哪些 token 易预测，还取决于提交它们对剩余位置预测的帮助：高可预测 token 提供的上下文信息可能很少，而揭示一个较难预测的 token 反而能让多个其他位置更早变得可预测。现有调度策略未显式考虑这种"揭示收益"。
AI.method: 1) 构造 unmasking 调度，优先揭示能使其他位置更易预测的 token，从而在解码早期降低不确定性；2) 将这类调度蒸馏进模型，实现更快的并行采样；3) 引入 KL 散度正则项以保持生成质量。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上广泛评测；GSM8K 上，LLaDA-8B-Instruct 取得 10.12× 加速，Dream-7B-Instruct 取得 5.12× 加速（相对多种基线），同时保持更优的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 以"揭示收益"为导向的调度蒸馏可显著减少解码轮次并加速扩散语言模型生成，且不牺牲甚至提升任务表现，说明调度学习是提升 dLLM 推理效率的关键维度。

title: Beyond Belief: Evaluating and Mitigating LLM Susceptibility to Misinformation
summary: Tool-using large language models (LLMs) must decide whether external information warrants action. We investigate whether their expressed credibility judgments reliably indicate behavioral resistance to misinformation. We evaluate five LLMs on 196 constructed false notices paired with legitimate counterparts and 204 archived attacks adapted to simulated tool use. When asked to act on the constructed notices, models issue harmful tool calls in 27%--99% of cases they have rated untrustworthy. Removing the preliminary rating step increases harmful execution by 15 percentage points on average, showing that credibility elicitation itself changes the behavior being evaluated. Interventions that improve credibility discrimination do not consistently yield safer actions. A simple forewarning significantly reduces harmful execution in four of five models, but neither tested generated-example prebunk outperforms it in the main evaluation. These reductions can also compromise legitimate task completion. Supervised fine-tuning on generated false notices reduces harmful execution on held-out archived attacks under the rating-first protocol, with model-dependent utility costs and weaker protection without rating elicitation. Our findings motivate evaluating misinformation defenses through both harmful actions and legitimate task completion, while accounting for the behavioral effects of the evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 工具使用型LLM对自评为"不可信"的信息仍高比例执行有害工具调用（27%–99%），说明可信度判断与行为抵抗脱节；移除预评分步骤会使有害执行率平均上升15个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多以模型"表达的可信度判断"衡量其抗误导能力，但该判断是否能真实反映工具使用场景下的行为抵抗尚不明确，需要检验判断与行动的一致性及其评测协议本身的影响。
AI.method: 在5个LLM上评测：196条构造的虚假通知及其对应的真实通知、204条改编为模拟工具使用场景的历史攻击样本；对比"先评分后行动"与"无评分直接行动"两种协议；测试提升可信度判别能力的干预、简单预警、生成样例式预置免疫（prebunking）以及基于生成虚假通知的监督微调，并同时统计有害执行率与合法任务完成率。
AI.result: 对已评为不可信的构造通知，模型仍产生有害工具调用，比例为27%–99%；去掉预评分环节使有害执行平均增加15个百分点；改善可信度判别的干预未带来稳定的行为安全性提升；简单预警在5个模型中的4个显著降低有害执行，且测试的两种生成样例预置免疫在主评测中均未优于预警；这些降幅可能伴随合法任务完成度下降；SFT可降低留出历史攻击在"评分优先"协议下的有害执行，但效用损失依模型而异，且在无评分启发的条件下保护更弱。
AI.conclusion: 可信度表达不能可靠预测行为层面的抗误导性，且评测协议本身会改变被评估行为。建议同时以有害行动率与合法任务完成率两项指标评估防误导能力，并显式控制评分环节带来的行为效应。

title: CoDeRNet: Selective Cross-Task Routing under Heterogeneous Supervision for Change Detection and Captioning
summary: Change Detection & Captioning (CDC) aims to jointly localize changed regions and describe their semantic content from bi-temporal remote sensing images. While recent approaches have demonstrated the effectiveness of unified modeling, they primarily rely on shared representations or jointly optimized architectures, leaving task-specific communication under heterogeneous supervision less explored. However, detection and captioning differ fundamentally in their supervision granularity, leading to heterogeneous representations with uneven reliability across tasks and spatial locations.
