In this paper, we reformulate CDC as a selective information routing problem between heterogeneous task branches, where the key challenge is to determine when and where information should be transferred. To this end, we propose CoDeRNet, a unified framework that preserves task-specific representations while enabling bidirectional exchange of complementary information. CoDeRNet introduces a Confidence-Decomposed Routing (CoDeR) mechanism, which decomposes the routing condition into receiver-side need for support and sender-side reliability cues to guide selective transfer. Experiments on LEVIR-MCI and WHU-CDC show that CoDeRNet achieves strong overall CDC performance, particularly improving caption generation while preserving competitive change localization. Extensive analyses further show that the benefits arise not merely from joint learning or generic cross-task communication, but from explicitly modeling selective cross-task information routing. These results highlight the importance of conditional information transfer for unified CDC under heterogeneous supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文把变化检测与描述（CDC）重新表述为异质任务分支间的选择性信息路由问题，提出CoDeRNet框架，通过置信度分解路由（CoDeR）机制在保留任务特定表示的同时实现双向互补信息交换，在LEVIR-MCI和WHU-CDC上提升整体CDC性能，尤以描述生成改善显著。
AI.motivation: 现有统一建模方法多依赖共享表示或联合优化架构，未充分探索异构监督下任务间的通信问题。检测与描述在监督粒度上本质不同，导致跨任务、跨空间位置的表示可靠性不均，简单共享会引入不可靠信息。
AI.method: 将CDC重构为异质任务分支间的选择性信息路由问题，核心是"何时、何处"传递信息。提出CoDeRNet统一框架，保留任务特定表示并支持双向信息交换；其中置信度分解路由（CoDeR）机制将路由条件分解为接收端支持需求与发送端可靠性线索，用以指导选择性迁移。
AI.result: 在LEVIR-MCI与WHU-CDC上取得较强整体CDC性能，描述生成显著提升，同时保持有竞争力的变化定位精度。分析表明收益并非来自联合学习或通用跨任务通信，而源于显式建模的选择性跨任务信息路由。
AI.conclusion: 条件化信息迁移对异质监督下的统一CDC至关重要，选择性路由优于无差别共享表示或通用跨任务交互。

title: Adaptive Retrieval, Selective Answers: Evaluating Conformal Factuality in Agentic RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve factual grounding without guaranteeing that every generated claim is supported. Previous work has studied claim-level conformal factuality in single-stage RAG and, more recently, multi-hop RAG. We examine its behavior in agentic RAG, where a language-model policy adaptively issues follow-up retrieval queries or terminates retrieval before response generation. We retain the retrieval-based relevance-scoring formulation and post-generation conformal filtering and evaluate six model-dataset configurations: GPT-6 Luna and Llama 3.1 8B on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA. Each configuration uses 60 fixed questions, 100 seeded 30/30 calibration-test partitions, five conformal target levels, and a no-conformal-prediction baseline. Across the six configurations, higher target levels are accompanied by higher observed full-support rates and reduced answer availability. At the 95% target, non-empty response coverage ranges from 17.23% to 60.17%, claim retention from 10.72% to 43.16%, and full support among non-empty outputs from 89.14% to 95.56%. We formulate the adaptive retrieval trajectory explicitly and characterize the reliability-informativeness trade-off when conformal factuality is applied after agent termination.

AI.tldr: 该论文将声明级保形事实性（claim-level conformal factuality）评估从单阶段与多跳RAG扩展到智能体式RAG，在6组模型-数据集配置上验证目标覆盖率越高则完全支撑率越高、但答案可得性越低，并显式建模自适应检索轨迹以刻画终止后过滤带来的可靠性-信息量权衡。
AI.motivation: RAG可提升事实落地性，但无法保证每条生成声明都被证据支撑；既有工作仅研究单阶段与多跳RAG中的声明级保形事实性，尚未考察语言模型策略自适应发起后续检索或提前终止检索的智能体式RAG场景，因此需要检验保形过滤在该设定下的行为。
AI.method: 沿用基于检索的相关性打分配置与生成后保形过滤流程；六组配置为GPT-6 Luna与Llama 3.1 8B分别在HotpotQA、Natural Questions、TriviaQA上运行；每组使用60道固定问题、100个固定随机种子的30/30校准-测试划分、5个保形目标水平及一个无保形预测基线；并显式形式化自适应检索轨迹。
AI.result: 六组配置中，目标水平越高，观测到的完全支撑率越高、答案可得性越低。95%目标下，非空回答覆盖率17.23%–60.17%，声明保留率10.72%–43.16%，非空输出中的完全支撑率89.14%–95.56%。
AI.conclusion: 保形事实性过滤施加于智能体检索终止之后时，存在明确的可靠性-信息量权衡：提高事实性保障会显著牺牲回答覆盖率与声明保留率；自适应检索轨迹的形式化有助于刻画该权衡。

title: Did the Model Use That? Counterfactual Training Boosts Self-Attribution in Language Models
summary:
A fundamental challenge for explainable and accountable language models is revealing how external information influences their answers. This paper examines whether models are self-attributive: that is, whether they indicate when -- and only when -- their responses to questions are influenced by information provided alongside the question. Furthermore, we explore how self-attribution can be improved through counterfactual training, which explicitly teaches models to distinguish between answers that do and do not depend on supplied information.
  We found that most of the eleven frontier models rarely attribute influential information in their answers, and the rest attribute non-influential information. Training acknowledgment into reasoning does not fix this: the acknowledgment does not reach the final answer.
  We introduce CREDIT, which directly supervises final-answer self-attribution with counterfactual labels, without the need for human annotation. CREDIT substantially improves attribution in four open models, including two distilled reasoning models, and outperforms reasoning-level fine-tuning and prompting baselines. Among answers that agree with a user's suggestion, CREDIT distinguishes those changed by the suggestion from those the model would have given anyway. Gains transfer partly to unseen information types and prompts containing sources that support conflicting answers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型的"自归因"能力——即模型是否能在且仅在外部信息影响其回答时予以声明，并提出 CREDIT 方法显著提升该能力。
AI.motivation: 可解释与可问责语言模型的核心挑战在于揭示外部信息如何影响模型回答。现有前沿模型要么极少归因真正有影响力的信息，要么归因无效信息，且将"承认"训练进推理过程也无法传递到最终答案。
AI.method: 对 11 个前沿模型进行自归因评测；提出 CREDIT，利用反事实标签直接监督最终答案的自我归因，无需人工标注。
AI.result: CREDIT 在四个开放模型（含两个蒸馏推理模型）上大幅提升归因能力，优于推理层微调与提示基线；在用户建议一致的答案中能区分"被建议改变"与"本就会给出"的答案，且收益可部分迁移到未见信息类型与含冲突来源的提示。
AI.conclusion: 最终答案层面的反事实监督是提升模型自归因的有效途径，可用于区分真实信息影响与模型固有倾向。

title: Identically Trained Language Models Break on Different Jailbreaks
summary: Jailbreak benchmarks test one checkpoint and treat which jailbreaks break it as a property of its pretraining data and safety training. We ask whether another pretraining run of the same data, given the same safety training, would break on the same jailbreaks. For each of 25 pretraining data recipes, we take 1B base models from 3 pretraining seeds and give each the same safety post-training with 2 post-training seeds, for 150 models in all. We then collect 20 responses from every model to a shared set of jailbreak prompts and correlate the per-prompt non-refusal rates between every pair of models. On average, two post-trained copies of the same pretraining run have per-prompt non-refusal rates that correlate at 0.984. A different pretraining seed lowers the correlation to 0.811, and a different data recipe lowers it only slightly further, to 0.779. These results indicate that which jailbreaks break a checkpoint depends much more on its pretraining run than on its data, a pattern that holds in all 25 data recipes and at 150M and 300M parameters. In practice, the best of 91 attack templates found on one checkpoint stays the best after a new pretraining seed in only 27% of model pairs, against 67% after a new post-training seed. Each pretraining run also leaves a fingerprint: across 3,211 prompts, a model's per-prompt non-refusal rates identify its pretraining run among all 75 runs every time, and a random subset of 50 prompts still does so 98% of the time.

AI.tldr: 同一预训练数据下不同预训练随机种子会导致模型脆弱的具体越狱提示显著变化：预训练运行（而非数据配方）是决定哪些越狱生效的主要因素，且越狱非拒答率构成可识别预训练运行的"指纹"。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱基准只测试单个检查点，并默认"哪些越狱能攻破模型"是预训练数据与安全训练的性质。作者质疑该假设：换一个同数据、同安全训练的预训练种子，同一批越狱是否依然有效。
AI.method: 构建25种预训练数据配方，每种取3个预训练种子训练1B基座模型，各配2个后训练种子做相同安全后训练，共150个模型；每个模型对共享越狱提示集采样20条回复，计算逐提示非拒答率，并在模型两两间做相关分析；在150M/300M规模上复现，并做"最佳攻击模板迁移率"与基于3211条提示的子集识别实验。
AI.result: 同一预训练运行的两个后训练副本逐提示非拒答率相关为0.984；换预训练种子降至0.811，再换数据配方仅略降至0.779。该模式在全部25种配方及150M/300M参数下均成立。91个攻击模板中，在换预训练种子后仍保持最优的比例仅27%，而换后训练种子为67%。3211条提示的逐提示非拒答率可100%识别出模型的预训练运行（75个运行中），随机取50条提示仍有98%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 越狱脆弱性对预训练随机性的敏感性远高于数据配方差异；单检查点越狱基准的外推性有限，攻击迁移评估需考虑预训练随机性，且非拒答率模式可作为预训练运行的可识别指纹。

title: Adapting LLM-SC to Living Sacred Heritage: Domain-Specific Extraction, Semantic Networks and Human Evaluation on Pashupatinath Temple Reviews
summary: Large language model (LLM) pipelines can turn visitor reviews into structured data, but generic schemes may miss rituals, sacred spaces, cultural restrictions and emotionally mixed experiences at living sacred heritage sites. We adapted the LLM-Social Computing (LLM-SC) framework to Pashupatinath Temple, Nepal, by specifying a 12-type entity taxonomy (four original LLM-SC types plus eight sacred-heritage types), four relation types and nine aspect-sentiment dimensions in a GPT-4o extraction prompt, which was applied to a fixed random sample of 2,500 English-language Tripadvisor reviews from a processed corpus of 3,939. The exports contain 11,286 entity, 6,232 aspect-sentiment and 5,590 relation records, covering 2,485, 2,487 and 2,433 reviews, respectively; the eight added sacred-heritage types account for 64.8% of entity records. Against an adjudicated two-annotator reference for 200 reviews, exact normalized surface-and-type matching gave provisional entity scores of 41.0% precision, 21.8% recall and 28.4% micro-F1. Aspect-presence F1 was 53.6% and end-to-end aspect-plus-polarity F1 was 42.6%. Human adjudication supported 153 of 194 first-listed relation candidates (one per review; 78.9%), a candidate-level rate that does not estimate relation recall or whole-graph precision. The contribution is a culturally grounded, domain-specific adaptation with component-wise human evaluation and explicit reproducibility and generalization limitations.

AI.tldr: 该文将LLM-Social Computing框架改造用于尼泊尔Pashupatinath神庙，构建含12类实体、4类关系、9个情感维度的神圣遗产抽取方案，在2,500条Tripadvisor评论上运行并结合人工标注做组件级评测。
AI.motivation: 通用LLM信息抽取方案难以捕捉活态神圣遗产地特有的仪式、神圣空间、文化禁忌与情感混杂体验，缺乏文化适配的领域本体。
AI.method: 在GPT-4o抽取提示中定义12类实体分类（4类沿用LLM-SC+8类神圣遗产新增类型）、4种关系类型与9个方面-情感维度，对从3,939条处理后语料中固定随机抽取的2,500条英文Tripadvisor评论进行抽取；以200条评论的双标注者裁决结果为参照，采用归一化表面与类型精确匹配评测实体，并评测方面存在性与方面+极性端到端F1，另对每条评论首选关系候选做人工裁决。
AI.result: 导出11,286条实体、6,232条方面-情感、5,590条关系记录，分别覆盖2,485、2,487、2,433条评论；新增8类神圣遗产类型占实体记录64.8%。实体抽取精确率41.0%、召回率21.8%、微观F1 28.4%；方面存在性F1 53.6%，端到端方面+极性F1 42.6%；194条首选关系候选经人工裁决支持153条（78.9%），该候选级比例不估计关系召回率或全图精确率。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于一个文化根植的领域适配方案及组件级人工评测，并明确说明可复现性与泛化性局限；整体抽取性能仍有限，尤其是实体召回偏低。

title: Making Reasoning Visible: Configuration-Aware Diagnostic Modeling for Adaptive Scaffolding in Structured Reasoning Tasks
summary: Modeling the latent, multi-step reasoning processes of learners is a core challenge for adaptive tutoring systems, which often rely on simple right/wrong answers rather than understanding how students think. Instantiated here for grammatical reasoning, this study introduces a diagnostic framework that makes students' step-by-step problem-solving visible by analyzing their action sequences in an interactive learning game. The framework computes five interpretable strategy dimensions (e.g., systematic error correction, random guessing), estimates coordination demand from task structure and behavioral patterns, and classifies reasoning into four distinct states. Analyzing 36,234 interactions from 234 students working on 42 morphosyntactic exercises, we found that reasoning strategies vary primarily by context rather than stable traits (intraclass correlation = 0.14), and students show high persistence in unproductive states; specifically, 74.6% of failures driven by high coordination demand (rather than simple knowledge gaps) are followed by another failure without intervention. Our early warning model predicts validation success with strong accuracy (AUC = 0.826 using strategy patterns alone; 0.902 with additional sequential context) while avoiding circular reliance on current error counts. These findings demonstrate that making latent reasoning processes visible enables earlier, more targeted scaffolding that responds to how students are thinking rather than simply whether they succeed. While demonstrated in language learning, the framework provides a generalizable, interpretable architecture for diagnosing complex, structured reasoning in any domain.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种诊断框架，将交互式语法学习游戏中学生的动作序列转化为过程性推理指标，用于识别推理策略、协调需求与推理状态，并对失败进行早期预警。
AI.motivation: 自适应辅导系统通常只依赖对错二元结果，无法刻画学习者潜在的多步推理过程，因而难以在恰当的时机提供有效支架。
AI.method: 基于交互式学习游戏的动作序列，计算五个可解释的策略维度（如系统性纠错、随机猜测），从任务结构与行为模式估计协调需求，并将推理划分为四种状态；使用234名学生在42个形态句法练习上的36,234次交互进行建模，并构建早期预警模型（仅用策略模式、加入序列上下文两种版本）。
AI.result: 推理策略主要随情境变化而非稳定特质（ICC=0.14）；学生低效状态具有高持续性，74.6%由高协调需求（而非知识欠缺）导致的失败在无干预下再次失败；预警模型预测验证成功，AUC达0.826（仅策略模式）与0.902（加入序列上下文），且不循环依赖当前错误计数。
AI.conclusion: 使潜在推理过程可见，可支持更早、更有针对性的、面向"学生如何思考"而非"是否成功"的支架；该可解释框架具有跨领域的通用性。

title: Recovering Black-Box Point Cloud Models from Pose Shifts via Derivative-Free Optimization
summary: Point cloud models are increasingly deployed through score-only black-box interfaces. Under this access model, test-time rotations outside the training distribution can substantially degrade performance. Although existing mitigations such as equivariant retraining and gradient-based adaptation are effective, they are infeasible without access to model weights or gradients. To address this limitation, we propose CanDO, a test-time canonicalization method that recovers lost performance using only forward queries. Specifically, CanDO searches for an input transformation that maximizes model confidence and uses derivative-free optimization to perform this search without gradients. We further identify three conditions for successful recovery: a training augmentation gap, an accuracy-aligned confidence surrogate, and global search over a multi-modal objective. Across multiple architectures and benchmarks, CanDO recovers 76% of the oracle gap under azimuthal misorientation and 51% under arbitrary SO(3) rotations for object part segmentation. These results show that frozen score-only point cloud models can recover from rotation-induced distribution shifts through post-deployment canonicalization alone.

AI.tldr: 提出CanDO——一种仅依赖前向查询（score-only黑盒）的测试时规范化方法，通过无导数优化搜索使模型置信度最大化的输入旋转，从而恢复点云模型在分布外旋转下的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 点云模型越来越多以仅返回分数的黑盒接口部署，此时旋转等分布外扰动会显著降低性能。现有等变重训练与基于梯度的自适应方法虽有效，但需访问模型权重或梯度，在该访问模型下不可行。
AI.method: CanDO在测试时仅用前向查询，寻找使模型置信度最大的输入变换，并采用无导数优化（derivative-free optimization）完成该搜索而无需梯度。作者还归纳出成功恢复的三个条件：训练数据存在增广缺口（training augmentation gap）、置信度替代指标与准确率对齐、以及在多峰目标上进行全局搜索。
AI.result: 在多种架构与基准上，针对物体部件分割任务，CanDO在方位角错位下恢复约76%的oracle差距，在任意SO(3)旋转下恢复约51%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，冻结的仅返回分数的点云模型仅通过部署后的规范化即可从旋转导致的分布偏移中恢复性能。

title: Entity Matching using Decision Models
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables. Code, prompts, and results: https://github.com/wbsg-uni-mannheim/decision-models-4-entity-matching
summary: Entity matching is the task of deciding whether two records describe the same real-world entity. Current entity matching methods rely on pre-trained language models (PLMs) which require task specific fine-tuning or generative large language models (LLMs) which do not require task-specific fine-tuning but are slow and expensive at matching large record sets. Decision models are a new class of LLM-based models that return a probability for each predefined answer option rather than generate text. This paper investigates decision models as an alternative to generative LLMs and fine-tuned PLMs for entity matching. We evaluate six decision models in a zero-shot setting across eight benchmarks and compare their performance with that of the generative LLM GPT-6 Luna and the PLM-based matcher Ditto. Our experiments show that, without task-specific training data, the four strongest decision models achieve mean F1 scores close to that of GPT-6 Luna, with the best model slightly surpassing it. This model also outperforms Ditto on six of the eight benchmarks. All decision models are faster than GPT-6 Luna, and most are less expensive. For three of the four strongest decision models, the predicted match probabilities are well calibrated without requiring any task-specific recalibration. A model cascade that routes the least confident record pairs to an ensemble of generative LLMs improves the mean F1 scores of the four strongest decision models by 1.9-4.0 percentage points. Using the best decision model and its best-performing prompt for each benchmark, the cascade surpasses the highest published F1 scores from literature on four of the eight benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文将决策模型（decision models，对预定义选项输出概率的LLM衍生物）作为实体匹配的零样本方案，在八个基准上与生成式LLM（GPT-6 Luna）和微调PLM匹配器（Ditto）比较；四个最强决策模型的平均F1接近GPT-6 Luna，最佳者略有超越并在六个基准上超过Ditto，且更快更省，多数概率校准良好；级联路由可再提升1.9–4.0个百分点，在四个基准上刷新文献最高F1。
AI.motivation: 现有实体匹配依赖两类方案：PLM需任务特定微调，生成式LLM虽免微调但在大规模记录集上推理慢、成本高。作者希望考察一类新的LLM衍生模型——决策模型（输出各预定义答案选项的概率而非生成文本）——能否作为二者的替代方案，兼顾免训练、准确、快速与低成本。
AI.method: 在零样本设定下评测六个决策模型，覆盖八个基准数据集；对比基线为生成式LLM GPT-6 Luna 与基于PLM的匹配器 Ditto。分析维度包括平均F1、单基准F1、推理时延与成本、匹配概率的校准性（无需任务特定重校准）。进一步构建模型级联：将置信度最低的记录对路由至生成式LLM集成，并在每个基准上使用最佳决策模型及其最佳提示词。
AI.result: 四个最强决策模型在无任务特定训练数据时平均F1接近GPT-6 Luna，最佳模型略有超越；该模型在八个基准中的六个上优于Ditto。所有决策模型推理均快于GPT-6 Luna，多数成本更低。四个最强模型中三个的预测匹配概率校准良好，无需任务特定重校准。级联策略使这四个模型的平均F1提升1.9–4.0个百分点；结合最佳决策模型与逐基准最佳提示词，级联在八个基准中的四个上超过文献已发表的最高F1。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型是实体匹配中生成式LLM与微调PLM的一种高效可行替代：零样本下准确率具竞争力、推理更快更省、概率天然校准，并可作为级联前端以低成本逼近甚至刷新SOTA。论文为实体匹配实践提供了免训练、可扩展且可路由的建模范式。

title: Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup for Robust Camera-Based 3D Object Detection
summary: Camera-based bird's-eye view (BEV) perception methods such as Fast-BEV have demonstrated promising results with fast inference speed and competitive accuracy. However, their robustness to real-world corruptions remains insufficiently explored, posing risks for autonomous driving deployment where environmental variations are inevitable. In this paper, we propose Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup (SR-BEVS), a sparse recovery learning approach that simultaneously improves clean accuracy and corruption robustness without requiring additional data or architectural modifications. Our method identifies pruning candidates based on layer-wise weight magnitudes, applies random pruning to create diverse sparse models, and retrains each model with a randomly sampled learning rate. By averaging these diverse recovered models into a single dense model, we achieve enhanced robustness against various corruptions while introducing zero inference overhead. We further provide a mode connectivity analysis demonstrating that our pruning-based diversification preserves the connected low-loss basin necessary for stable weight averaging. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate up to 33.8% improvement in corruption robustness and a 1.8% gain in clean accuracy over the Fast-BEV baseline, with consistent improvements across sensor noise, weather distortions, and illumination changes. Our simple yet effective approach may be applicable to other BEV models.

AI.tldr: 提出SR-BEVS，一种基于稀疏恢复学习的模型汤方法，在不增加数据与不改动结构的前提下，同时提升Fast-BEV类相机BEV感知的干净精度与真实世界损坏鲁棒性，且推理零开销。
AI.motivation: Fast-BEV等相机BEV方法推理快、精度可观，但对真实世界损坏（传感器噪声、天气畸变、光照变化）的鲁棒性研究不足，给自动驾驶部署带来风险；现有提升鲁棒性的手段通常需要额外数据或结构改动。
AI.method: 基于逐层权重幅值确定剪枝候选，施加随机剪枝生成多样化稀疏子模型；每个子模型以随机采样的学习率单独重训练（稀疏恢复）；再将多样化的恢复模型权重平均为单一稠密模型。另给出模式连通性分析，说明基于剪枝的多样化能保持稳定的低损失盆地，从理论上支撑权重平均。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上，相较Fast-BEV基线，损坏鲁棒性最高提升33.8%，干净精度提升1.8%，并在传感器噪声、天气畸变与光照变化上取得一致提升；推理阶段无额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 剪枝多样化+稀疏恢复+权重平均构成简单有效的鲁棒性增强方案，可推广到其他BEV模型，具备自动驾驶实际部署价值。

title: GUIFlow: Temporal Redundancy-Aware Incremental Inference for GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents built on vision-language models interact with continuously evolving interfaces, yet conventional inference repeatedly recomputes representations of largely overlapping observations and histories. This mismatch makes multi-step interaction costly, while changes in context, interface content, and action arguments prevent straightforward cache reuse. We introduce GUIFlow, a framework for full-pipeline incremental inference in multi-image GUI interaction. Our central insight is that advancing a decision need not require rebuilding all supporting representations: each interaction step can instead selectively update computational states maintained across the trajectory. To support new decisions as the context evolves, GUIFlow adapts how past computation is reused: historical KV states are position-aligned and injected into the current context; change signals guide selective updates of current-observation states in the vision encoder and language model; and earlier action responses serve as speculative drafts verified by the target model. Together, these mechanisms enable cross-step reuse throughout visual encoding, prefill, and decoding without additional training, a separate draft model, or changes to the model-visible inputs and action interface. Experiments demonstrate up to 3.39x geometric-mean speedup across offline multi-image benchmarks and up to 3.49x in online, closed-loop interaction on OSWorld, while maintaining task performance broadly comparable to the dense baseline.

AI.tldr: GUIFlow：面向多图像GUI交互的全流程增量推理框架，通过跨步骤复用视觉编码、预填充与解码的计算状态，实现最高3.49x加速且性能与稠密基线相当。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉语言模型的GUI智能体在多步交互中反复重算高度重叠的观测与历史表示，导致推理开销大；而上下文、界面内容与动作参数的变化又阻碍了直接的缓存复用。
AI.method: 核心观点是推进决策无需重建全部支撑表示，每步只需选择性更新轨迹中维护的计算状态。具体包括：(1) 历史KV状态位置对齐后注入当前上下文；(2) 由变化信号引导视觉编码器与语言模型对当前观测状态做选择性更新；(3) 以往动作响应作为投机草稿，由目标模型验证。三者贯穿视觉编码、预填充、解码，无需额外训练、独立草稿模型或改动模型输入与动作接口。
AI.result: 离线多图像基准上几何平均加速最高3.39x，OSWorld在线闭环交互中最高3.49x，任务性能与稠密基线总体相当。
AI.conclusion: 跨步骤全流程增量推理可有效降低多步GUI交互成本，且无需训练或改变接口即可保持性能，具备实用性。

title: E3tereo: Improving Stereo Matching at Depth Boundaries with Learned Geometric Edges
summary: Depth boundaries remain a major source of error in stereo matching. For IGEV on Scene Flow, geometric edge pixels account for only 6% of evaluated pixels but about half of the total absolute disparity error. Photometric edges can respond to texture changes without corresponding depth discontinuities, making them unreliable cues for boundary refinement. We propose E3Stereo, which learns geometric edges from disparity supervision and combines these boundary cues with the backbone disparity and image details to predict full-resolution disparity corrections. The same edge map also emphasizes boundary errors during training, while joint optimization allows the edge predictor to adapt to disparity refinement. On the Scene Flow dataset, E3Stereo reduces end-point error (EPE) at depth boundaries by 9.5%-14.3% across RAFT-Stereo, IGEV, and MonSter, while also reducing overall EPE. After fine-tuning, our IGEV-based model improves upon IGEV on all eleven reported metrics across ETH3D, KITTI 2012, and KITTI 2015. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出E3Stereo，从视差监督中学习几何边缘，用于全分辨率视差边界修正。
AI.motivation: 视差边界是立体匹配的主要误差来源：IGEV在Scene Flow上，几何边缘像素仅占6%却贡献约一半的绝对视差误差；而光度边缘可能由纹理变化引起、不对应深度不连续，作为边界修正线索不可靠。
AI.method: 以视差监督学习几何边缘；将边界线索与主干视差、图像细节结合，预测全分辨率视差修正量；同一边缘图在训练中用于加权强调边界误差，并与视差修正联合优化，使边缘预测器适配细化任务。
AI.result: 在Scene Flow上，用于RAFT-Stereo、IGEV、MonSter时深度边界EPE降低9.5%–14.3%，整体EPE亦下降；微调后基于IGEV的模型在ETH3D、KITTI 2012、KITTI 2015共十一项指标上均优于IGEV。
AI.conclusion: 显式学习几何边缘并进行联合优化，可有效缓解边界误差，且作为通用模块可提升多种立体匹配基线。

title: Recursive CLIP: Vision-Language Distillation with Looped Transformer Blocks
summary: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP typically rely on independently parameterized transformer blocks across depth. We investigate the extent to which these blocks can instead be reused recurrently while preserving the transferable capabilities of CLIP. We study recursive transformer backbones in which a small set of $N$ transformer blocks is applied $M$ times per forward pass. By holding $N \cdot M$ fixed to the depth of a standard ViT-B, our models preserve computational depth while progressively increasing parameter sharing. We consider two recursive CLIP model families: rCLIP, where only the vision encoder is recursive, and r$^2$CLIP, where recurrence is also introduced in the text encoder. We study these models under both direct contrastive training and through knowledge distillation from a strong ViT-B/16 teacher pretrained on DFN-2B, using the substantially smaller CC3M and CC12M datasets. We evaluate the resulting models on zero-shot classification and cross-modal retrieval, and further study their adaptability through few-shot learning, visual grounding, and concept unlearning. Our results show that CLIP can tolerate substantial recurrent block reuse, although its effect depends on the encoder and downstream task. Recurrence also provides parameter efficiency by construction, since fewer distinct transformer blocks need to be stored and adapted. Our results establish recurrent block reuse as a practical design space for vision-language models and highlight its implications for knowledge transfer, downstream adaptation, and parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: 研究将CLIP中独立参数化的Transformer块递归复用（N个块重复M次，N·M固定为ViT-B深度），提出仅视觉端递归的rCLIP与视觉+文本端均递归的r²CLIP，在直接对比训练与DFN-2B教师蒸馏（CC3M/CC12M）下评估，发现CLIP能容忍显著的块复用，但效果依编码器与任务而异，同时带来参数效率优势。
AI.motivation: 标准CLIP各层Transformer块参数独立，参数开销大且需分别存储与适配。作者希望探究：在保持可迁移能力的前提下，这些块能否递归复用，从而在保持计算深度的同时提升参数共享与参数效率。
AI.method: 构建递归Transformer骨干：N个块在一次前向中重复M次，且N·M等于标准ViT-B深度以保持计算深度不变，随参数共享程度递增构建模型族。设计两个变体：rCLIP（仅视觉编码器递归）与r²CLIP（文本编码器也引入递归）。训练方式包括直接对比学习，以及从DFN-2B预训练的ViT-B/16教师向更小数据集CC3M/CC12M进行知识蒸馏。评测涵盖零样本分类、跨模态检索、少样本学习、视觉定位与概念遗忘。
AI.result: CLIP可承受相当大的递归块复用，但影响依编码器（视觉/文本）与下游任务而异；递归结构在构造上即具备参数效率，需存储与适配的独立块更少；蒸馏设置下递归模型仍保持可迁移性与下游适应性。
AI.conclusion: 递归块复用构成视觉-语言模型一个可行的设计空间，对知识迁移、下游适配与参数效率均有明确含义，为在受限存储/适配预算下构建CLIP类模型提供了实用路径。

title: T2D: Target-to-Draft Model Pruning & Adaptation for Efficient Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model's latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model's responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92\% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出T2D框架，将草稿模型设计形式化为优化问题，通过延迟感知结构剪枝与知识蒸馏从目标模型直接构造草稿模型，联合优化推理延迟与交叉熵损失，最多剪枝92%参数仍取得优异投机解码性能，并可即插即用兼容其他方法。
AI.motivation: 投机解码的加速效果取决于两个关键因素：草稿模型与目标模型的分布对齐程度，以及草稿模型的推理延迟。现有方法多采用独立预训练的小模型，或将目标模型剪枝为人工选定的架构，无法显式平衡"对齐度—生成效率"的权衡。
AI.method: 将草稿模型设计表述为优化问题，提出T2D框架：以目标模型为起点，采用延迟感知（latency-aware）的结构化剪枝结合知识蒸馏，直接构造草稿模型；优化目标同时包含实测推理延迟与草稿模型在目标模型响应上的交叉熵损失。
AI.result: 在多领域投机解码基准及多个不同规模的目标模型族上进行大量实验，T2D可剪枝目标模型高达92%的参数，仍获得高性能草稿模型，优于竞争基线；所得草稿模型还可被其他投机解码的token对齐与知识蒸馏方法即插即用地复用，带来进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: 联合探索草稿模型"架构—对齐"前沿对释放LLM投机解码潜力至关重要，显式建模延迟与对齐的权衡可显著提升解码效率。

title: Efficient Proof Generation for Lean Statements with Multiple Candidate Answers
summary: In formal systems such as Lean 4, efficiently finding answers to mathematical problems and generating verifiable proofs is an important task in automated mathematical reasoning. In the traditional way where an upstream solver provides multiple candidate answers, the common workflow requires searching for proofs for each candidate separately, incurring redundant computational cost. To this end, we propose a joint proof framework that integrates candidate answer selection, answer supplementation, and formal proof generation into a unified reasoning process. At its core is a trained prover that selects given or proposes new answers and generates a proof for at least one answer in a single call. Joint proof can also reuse generated proofs to check for faithfulness errors. For problems with a unique answer, if two distinct answers both obtain verifiable proofs under the same formal statement, this confirms the statement does not faithfully preserve the original problem semantics. On MATH-500, AMC 2023, and AIME 2024/2025/2026, our framework achieves the same formal proof success rate as per-candidate proof generation with about one sixth of the token cost, and identifies at least 6.1% of the formalized statements as unfaithful without requiring additional judges. Our model and code are available at https://github.com/Linppz/Gobble-Prover.

AI.tldr: 提出联合证明框架，将答案选择、答案补充与形式化证明生成统一到单次推理过程，在相近证明成功率下大幅降低token开销，并利用"同一唯一答案题目的两个不同答案均被证明"来检测形式化陈述的不忠实问题。
AI.motivation: 传统流程中，上游求解器给出多个候选答案后，需对每个候选答案分别搜索证明，造成大量冗余计算开销；同时形式化陈述可能存在语义不忠实（faithfulness）问题，通常需要额外判定器。
AI.method: 训练一个证明器（prover），在单次调用中同时完成：从给定候选中选择答案或提出新答案，并对至少一个答案生成形式化证明（Lean 4）。该联合证明过程可复用已生成的证明来检查不忠实错误：对唯一答案题目，若两个不同答案在同一形式化陈述下均获得可验证证明，则判定该陈述未忠实保留原题语义。
AI.result: 在MATH-500、AMC 2023、AIME 2024/2025/2026上，达到与逐候选证明生成相同的证明成功率，token成本约为其六分之一；并识别出至少6.1%的形式化陈述为不忠实，且无需额外判定器。模型与代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 联合证明框架在保持证明成功率的同时显著降低计算成本，并可作为形式化忠实性的自检手段，体现"答案—证明"协同推理的效率与可靠性优势。

title: What Makes a Question Curious? Measuring Model Curiosity in Human-LLM Interactions
summary: Large language models increasingly act as partners in everyday communication. In these interactions, useful assistance may require not only answering, but also asking the right questions that surface knowledge gaps, assumptions, and alternatives. In this study, we refer to such epistemic question-asking as model curiosity, and introduce a theory-grounded taxonomy that distinguishes curiosity-oriented questions from generic model questioning. Across four conversation datasets, we find that curiosity-oriented questions remain rare (17-28% of all questions), but are associated with more exploratory and epistemically rich subsequent user responses, with varying patterns across datasets. We further conduct a human study to evaluate the usefulness of model curiosity, finding that curiosity can encourage exploration, especially in advice, creative, and research contexts. These findings have implications for building LLMs that ask more selectively to support deeper exploration and human-AI collaboration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"模型好奇心"概念及其理论化分类体系，将好奇心导向的提问与一般性提问区分开；在四个对话数据集中发现此类提问仅占17–28%，但与更具探索性的用户回应相关，并通过人类研究验证其在建议、创意与研究情境中的价值。
AI.motivation: LLM increasingly作为日常沟通伙伴，有价值的协助不仅在于"回答"，还在于"提出正确的问题"以揭示知识缺口、隐含假设与替代方案；但现有研究缺乏对这类"认知性提问"的概念界定与实证考察。
AI.method: 1) 将此类认知性提问定义为"模型好奇心"；2) 构建基于理论的分类体系，区分好奇心导向提问与一般模型提问；3) 在四个对话数据集上进行标注与统计分析，考察其出现频率及与后续用户回应的关联；4) 开展人类受试者研究评估模型好奇心的有用性。
AI.result: 好奇心导向提问占比仍较低（占全部提问的17–28%），但与更具探索性、认知信息更丰富的用户后续回应相关，且模式随数据集而异；人类研究显示好奇心能促进探索，尤其在建议、创意与研究情境中效果显著。
AI.conclusion: LLM应更"有选择性地"提问以支持更深层探索与人机协作；研究为构建具备适度好奇心的对话模型提供了概念框架与实证依据。

title: SVD-Attention: Efficiently Analyzing Attention Blocks in Transformers
summary: Pretrained transformers spend a large share of their inference compute inside self-attention, yet the per-head query-key interaction is structurally low-rank by construction. We ask a diagnostic question: across layers and architectures, which heads actually use the full rank budget on real data, and which do not? We propose SVD-Attention, a post-hoc method that decomposes the per-head interaction matrix $M_h$ and scores every singular mode by both its spectral magnitude and its activation variance across tokens on a small calibration set. The score keeps the modes the head can amplify and that real data actually activates, and discards the rest; the resulting factorization is exact for the retained modes and needs no finetuning. Across seven pretrained models and five task types, the diagnostic finds a task-dependent pattern: redundancy sits in the early to middle layers for sentiment and image classification and for generation, and in the late layers for dense prediction and extractive question answering. It is also predictive: truncating the layers it flags costs at most $1.75$ F1, while truncating the same number of layers elsewhere in the same model costs up to $50$ F1. SVD-Attention is an analysis tool rather than a compression method: acting on it reduces inference FLOPs by $0.8$-$1.5\%$ on its own and by $8$-$11\%$ when composed with weight pruning, with $0$-$4\%$ change in task quality.

AI.tldr: 提出SVD-Attention，用谱幅值与激活方差对每个注意力头的交互矩阵做奇异模式打分，诊断哪些层/头的秩冗余真实存在；该信号具有预测性，但本身仅作为分析工具，单独使用可省0.8–1.5% FLOPs，与权重剪枝复合可省8–11%。
AI.motivation: 自注意力占据预训练Transformer推理算力的很大份额，而逐头query-key交互矩阵在构造上是结构低秩的。作者提出一个诊断性问题：在真实数据上，跨层与跨架构，究竟哪些头真正用满了秩预算，哪些没有？现有工作缺少对"真实数据激活下的有效秩"的量化刻画。
AI.method: SVD-Attention：对每个头h的交互矩阵M_h做奇异值分解，对小校准集上每个奇异模式同时按谱幅值和跨token激活方差打分，保留"头能够放大且真实数据确实激活"的模式，其余丢弃；保留模式上的分解是精确的，无需微调。实验覆盖7个预训练模型、5类任务，并按任务类型对比截断不同层带来的F1损失。
AI.result: 诊断结果呈任务依赖模式：情感分类、图像分类与生成任务的冗余集中在早—中层；稠密预测与抽取式问答则集中在后层。该信号具预测性：截断被标记层至多损失1.75 F1，而在同一模型中截断相同数量的其他层最多损失50 F1。实际压缩上，单独作用降低推理FLOPs 0.8–1.5%，与权重剪枝复合达8–11%，任务质量变化0–4%。
AI.conclusion: 注意力头的有效秩冗余在层间分布高度不均衡且依赖任务，可由谱幅值与激活方差的联合打分可靠定位。SVD-Attention 主要定位为分析/诊断工具，而非压缩方法；其价值在于为剪枝与低秩压缩提供可解释的层选择依据，复合使用时收益更明显。

title: ToDoPro: Faster and Better Reference-Based Generation: Early Token Reduction via Downsampled Self-Probing
summary: Recent generic reference-based image generation models natively support multiple conditions by concatenating all reference image and text tokens into a joint sequence processed by a single Diffusion Transformer (DiT). However, this versatile paradigm comes at an efficiency cost: accommodating multiple references leads to a token explosion, incurring massive $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ computational complexity. Most acceleration methods operate inside the DiT, showing limited capability in reducing spatial redundancy and failing to alleviate peak VRAM. While some pre-model token reduction alternatives exist, they inevitably introduce external models. This raises a question: Is it possible to achieve acceleration and memory savings while preserving compatibility with in-model techniques and requiring no additional parameters? In this work, we realize this goal by proposing the early Token reduction via Downsampled self-Probing (ToDoPro). By executing a few denoising steps on spatially $2\times$ downsampled reference images, this cheap probing stage utilizes the DiT model itself to effectively and efficiently extract reference token importance. Using the probed importance, we apply a hierarchical reduction before the main denoising stage: we completely discard low-importance tokens, substitute mid-importance tokens with their downsampled counterparts to cheaply preserve global context, and keep high-importance tokens. Experiments across three base models and two benchmarks demonstrate that our early reduction accelerates inference significantly and mitigates peak GPU memory. Furthermore, we can improve generation quality by safely filtering out noisy, uninformative reference tokens, enabling the model to concentrate its limited attention capacity on genuinely useful tokens. The code will be released at https://github.com/scy639/ToDoPro

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ToDoPro，一种无需额外参数的早期 token 缩减方法：通过对 2× 下采样参考图执行少量去噪步进行"廉价自探测"，利用 DiT 自身评估参考 token 重要性，在主去噪前实施分层缩减（丢弃低重要度、下采样替代中重要度、保留高重要度），从而在保持与模型内加速技术兼容的同时降低计算与显存开销。
AI.motivation: 通用参考图生成模型将参考图与文本 token 拼接为联合序列由单一 DiT 处理，多参考导致 token 爆炸与 O(N²) 复杂度；DiT 内部加速方法难以削减空间冗余、无法缓解峰值显存，而模型外 token 缩减方案需引入外部模型。
AI.method: ToDoPro：先用空间 2× 下采样参考图执行少量去噪步，作为廉价探测阶段借助 DiT 自身提取参考 token 重要度；再据此在主去噪前做分层缩减——完全丢弃低重要度 token、以对应下采样 token 替换中重要度 token 以低成本保留全局上下文、保留高重要度 token。无额外参数，可与模型内加速技术叠加。
AI.result: 在三个基础模型与两个基准上验证：显著加速推理并降低峰值 GPU 显存；同时通过滤除噪声性、无信息量的参考 token，使注意力集中于真正有用的 token，从而提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: token 缩减可在模型外部、无需额外参数地早期完成，兼顾加速、省显存、兼容性与质量提升，是一类"免费"的参考 token 冗余利用方案。

title: RIDE-Splat: Reflection Removal for In-the-Wild Driving Environments
summary: Driving video captured through a windshield violates the world-space consistency assumed by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS): the road scene exhibits parallax while cabin reflections remain attached to the camera, causing standard 3DGS to embed reflected content into the reconstructed scene. We introduce RIDE-Splat, a pipeline for reflection-free 3D reconstruction from posed driving video without clean images, reflection masks, or pretrained networks. RIDE-Splat assigns world-consistent transmission through the windshield to a 3DGS scene and the dominant camera-attached reflection to one shared, signed RGB image. It builds the clean reconstruction in two passes. First, it learns the 3D geometry and the signed reflection image, representing both added radiance and transmission attenuation. Then, it uses the reflection-removed training images to fit a clean 3DGS model. At inference, the reflection image is discarded, preserving the standard 3DGS rendering path. We also introduce the RIDE-Splat Dataset, the first 3D reconstruction benchmark for reflection removal from driving video -- with real driving scenes, physical windshield reflections in training views, and separately captured non-reflective evaluation images. Across the RIDE-Splat Dataset, XLD, and Wayve, RIDE-Splat outperforms 3DGS, DC-Gaussian, and RobustSplat on all nine aggregate metrics, improving PSNR by up to 3.59 dB and reducing LPIPS by up to 0.0876. We achieve the highest metrics in 38 out of 42 per-scene comparisons and removes windshield reflections that remain visible in the baselines while preserving the transmitted scene.

AI.tldr: RIDE-Splat：从带姿态的驾驶视频中去除挡风玻璃反射，实现无反射3DGS重建，无需干净图像/掩码/预训练网络。
AI.motivation: 行车视频中，道路场景具有视差，而车厢反射固定附着于相机，违反3DGS的世界空间一致性假设，导致标准3DGS把反射内容嵌入重建场景。
AI.method: 将世界一致的透射建模为3DGS场景，将主导的相机附着反射建模为一张共享的有符号RGB图像；两阶段流程：先联合学习3D几何与有符号反射图（同时表达附加辐射与透射衰减），再用去除反射的训练图像拟合干净的3DGS；推理时丢弃反射图，保持标准3DGS渲染路径。
AI.result: 提出RIDE-Splat Dataset（首个驾驶视频去反射3D重建基准，含真实场景、训练视图中的物理挡风玻璃反射及单独采集的无反射评测图像）；在RIDE-Splat Dataset、XLD、Wayve上，九项聚合指标全面优于3DGS、DC-Gaussian、RobustSplat，PSNR最高提升3.59 dB，LPIPS最多降低0.0876；42项单场景比较中38项最优。
AI.conclusion: RIDE-Splat能在保留透射场景的同时去除基线中仍可见的挡风玻璃反射，且推理路径与标准3DGS兼容。

title: Rank-1 Weight-Corrected Trainable Weight Averaging for Out-of-Distribution Detection
comment: Accepted to ACCV2026 Workshop on Subspaces in the Era of Foundation Models
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection identifies inputs outside the training distribution. Rank-based analyses such as RankFeat and RankWeight suggest that OOD overconfidence is closely related to dominant low-rank components in feature and weight spaces. Since weight averaging operates directly in parameter space and improves model generalization, we consider it for OOD detection from a dominant-component perspective. Trainable Weight Averaging (TWA) assigns a single coefficient to each checkpoint, limiting independent control of dominant weight components. We extend TWA with leading rank-one weight components extracted by Singular Value Decomposition as correction directions, whose contributions are learned through the in-distribution classification objective. On ResNet50, our method improves over fine-tuning and standard TWA across the evaluated datasets with MSP and RankWeight, both with and without Outlier Exposure. Mahalanobis-based evaluation yields mixed results, indicating that the benefit depends on the OOD scoring protocol. Target-layer analyses with MSP and Energy favor correction near the classifier.

AI.tldr: 将TWA扩展为以SVD提取的秩一分量作为独立校正方向，其贡献由ID分类目标学习，用于改善OOD检测，在ResNet50上对MSP与RankWeight评分优于微调与标准TWA，但Mahalanobis结果混杂。
AI.motivation: RankFeat与RankWeight等基于秩的分析表明，OOD过度自信与特征空间、权重空间中的主导低秩分量密切相关；权重平均直接在参数空间操作并能提升泛化性，因此从主导分量视角将其引入OOD检测。但TWA对每个checkpoint仅分配单一系数，无法独立控制各主导权重分量。
AI.method: 用SVD提取权重的前若干秩一分量作为校正方向，扩展TWA，使各方向贡献通过分布内分类目标学习；在高斯均值/协方差情形下给出权重空间主导分量与特征空间主导分量的对应关系，使RankFeat式推理可迁移到权重空间。
AI.result: ResNet50上，在MSP与RankWeight评分下（无论有无Outlier Exposure），方法在评测数据集上均优于微调与标准TWA；Mahalanobis评估结果不一致，说明收益依赖OOD评分协议；基于MSP与Energy的目标层分析显示，靠近分类器的层进行校正更有利。
AI.conclusion: 在权重空间针对主导低秩分量做细粒度校正可有效缓解OOD过度自信，但效果受评分函数影响，校正位置宜靠近分类器。

title: MarineLife-16K: An Attribute-Rich Video-Text Dataset for Motion-Aware Marine Video Understanding
summary: Marine video understanding is crucial for a wide range of real-world applications. However, existing marine video datasets suffer from limitations, including the limited number of data samples, fine-grained text descriptions, and detailed visual attributes. To address these limitations, we introduce a large-scale, video-text dataset featuring rich, in-the-wild visual attributes tailored for complex marine environments. Our dataset comprises 2,000 video-text pairs annotated with 13 attributes covering up to four objects per scene, object visual/geometric properties, behaviors, environmental context, and camera motion, spanning diverse lighting conditions, times of day, and 7 countries. From these annotations, we generate 16,080 video-question pairs (12,080 multiple-choice, 4,000 open-ended). Furthermore, we benchmark both proprietary and open-source video-LLM models on video question answering and video captioning tasks. We find that (i) proprietary models often achieves superior performances; (ii) VLMs handle object motion well but struggle with complex camera motion; (iii) closed-source models struggle to perceive camera motion; and (iv) VLMs struggle to reason in static cameras.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个面向复杂海洋环境的大规模视频-文本数据集，含2000个视频-文本对、13类视觉属性标注（最多每场景4个对象），派生16080个视频问答对，并系统评测闭源与开源视频-LLM在视频问答与视频描述任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有海洋视频数据集存在样本量少、缺乏细粒度文本描述与详细视觉属性标注等问题，难以支撑复杂海洋环境下的视频理解研究，因此需要一个大规模、具备丰富"in-the-wild"视觉属性的视频-文本数据集。
AI.method: 构建大规模视频-文本数据集：2000个视频-文本对，标注13类属性，覆盖每场景最多4个对象、对象的视觉/几何属性、行为、环境上下文与相机运动，涵盖多样光照条件、不同时段及7个国家；据此生成16080个视频-问题对（12080个多选、4000个开放问答）。随后在视频问答与视频描述任务上对专有与开源视频-LLM进行基准评测。
AI.result: (i) 专有（闭源）模型通常性能更优；(ii) VLM擅长处理对象运动，但对复杂相机运动表现不佳；(iii) 闭源模型难以感知相机运动；(iv) VLM在静态相机条件下推理能力不足。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集弥补了海洋视频理解领域在规模与标注粒度上的空白，基准评测揭示了当前视频-LLM在相机运动感知与静态场景推理方面的明显短板，为后续模型改进提供方向。

title: Mycelium: A Meta-Study of Hallucination Detection Across Provenance, Typology, and Granularities
summary: Hallucination detection is increasingly important for evaluating and deploying large language models. However, existing methods are often compared across benchmarks that define and measure hallucination in substantially different ways, making reported scores difficult to interpret across settings. We study hallucination detection as a benchmark-conditioned measurement problem and organize existing benchmarks along three axes: provenance, which describes how model outputs and evidence conditions are obtained; typology, which captures the factuality and faithfulness failures represented by benchmark labels; and granularity, which specifies the unit at which hallucinations are annotated, predicted, and evaluated. Using this framework, we analyze how benchmark construction, annotation, and evaluation choices shape the underlying prediction task, and relate detector mechanisms and assumptions to the settings in which their performance is measured. We also examine span-level evaluation, where variation in annotation boundaries can substantially affect reported results, and propose Span Coverage F1 as a complementary containment-based metric. Our analysis clarifies what detector scores capture, highlights limitations of cross-benchmark comparisons, and motivates more explicit evaluation of generalization across benchmark conditions.

AI.tldr: 论文将幻觉检测重新表述为“基准条件决定”的测量问题，用出处（provenance）、类型学（typology）、粒度（granularity）三轴组织现有基准，并提出基于包含关系的 Span Coverage F1 作为补充指标。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法在不同基准上比较，而这些基准对幻觉的定义与测量方式差异显著，导致报告分数难以跨设置解读，甚至不可比；需要厘清检测器分数究竟测量了什么。
AI.method: 提出三轴分析框架：provenance（模型输出与证据条件如何获取）、typology（基准标签所代表的事实性/忠实性失败类型）、granularity（标注、预测与评估的单元）；据此分析基准构建、标注与评估选择如何改变预测任务本身，并将检测器机制及假设与其性能适用设置对应；进一步针对 span 级评估中标注边界变化带来的波动，提出基于包含关系的 Span Coverage F1。
AI.result: 框架性地揭示了基准设计如何重塑底层预测任务与检测器表现；指出 span 级评估结果对标注边界高度敏感，Span Coverage F1 可作为对边界扰动更稳健的补充度量。
AI.conclusion: 澄清了检测器分数的实际含义，指出跨基准比较的局限，并倡导对跨基准条件的泛化能力进行更显式的评估。

title: SEDATE: Do Large Language Models Share an Aggression Circuit Across Languages?
summary: As the applications of AI continue to expand across various multimodal and multilingual domains, ensuring safe and responsible deployment of these systems has become an important concern. A wide-range of interventions have been proposed to make AI responses safer and more reliable. They often incur substantial computational or annotation costs, or cannot be extended to multilingual settings. In this work, we propose Selective Detection And Targeted Editing (SEDATE), a training-free approach based on detect-edit-verify strategy. SEDATE first detects the responsible neurons, edits them as and when necessary and finally verifies the model responses; all without any additional model training. We evaluate SEDATE across 7 languages and 4 model families. We further evaluate its effectiveness across 4 out-of-distribution languages and 4 additional datasets. We show that SEDATE achieves substantially superior safety scores across all languages and models over the best-performing baseline while retaining the general capabilities and incurring negligible overhead. Our results are robust, with the trends remaining similar for out-of-distribution languages and datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 SEDATE 方法，通过"检测—编辑—验证"策略定位并修改责任神经元，在 7 种语言、4 个模型族上显著提升 AI 安全性，且保持通用能力、开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: AI 在多模态、多语言场景广泛部署，安全可靠性问题突出；现有干预方法要么计算/标注成本高，要么难以扩展到多语言环境，因此需要低成本、可跨语言的方案。
AI.method: SEDATE 采用 detect-edit-verify 三阶段、无需额外训练的流程：先定位对不安全输出负责的神经元，再按需对其进行编辑，最后对模型响应进行验证；全流程不涉及模型再训练。
AI.result: 在 7 种语言、4 个模型族上评估，并扩展至 4 种分布外语言与 4 个额外数据集；相比最优基线在所有语言和模型上取得显著更高的安全分数，同时保持通用能力，开销可忽略，且在分布外语言与数据集上趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的神经元级检测与编辑是实现跨语言、低开销安全对齐的有效途径，且具备良好的鲁棒性与泛化性。

title: GRASP: Group-Adaptive Hybrid RL-SFT Post-Training for Medical VQA without Reasoning Annotations
summary: Adapting general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) to medical visual question answering (VQA) is valuable for helping clinicians read images and make diagnoses, but annotated data are scarce and provide only short answers, without reasoning annotations. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) fits these labels but overfits to them and amplifies their biases, eroding out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. Reinforcement learning (RL) better preserves generalization but never uses the gold answer as a training target: GRPO-style algorithms learn from the contrast between correct and incorrect answers within a group of sampled responses, so all-correct or all-wrong groups give no correctness signal. Existing SFT-RL hybrids either apply SFT and RL in separate stages or switch between them per question, or need reasoning traces from experts or stronger models, which medical VQA data lack. We propose GRASP, which combines RL and SFT in every update using only short answers: RL lets the model explore its own reasoning, SFT teaches the gold answer after that reasoning to supply the direct supervision RL lacks, and their balance adapts to how well the model answers each question. Tuning only about 1% of the parameters with LoRA, GRASP outperforms all compared training objectives both in domain and on OOD open-ended questions across Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3-8B and Gemma 3-4B. On an OOD benchmark spanning eight imaging modalities, GRASP-trained InternVL3-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B beat all 10 compared general and medical VLMs in open-ended accuracy, including models trained on up to 2,600 times more data or with over 250 times more trainable parameters. We release MedTerse, a dataset of 12.9K short-answer questions, and our code at https://github.com/sea-comet/GRASP-MedVQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GRASP，一种仅依赖短答案标注、在每次参数更新中同时融合强化学习（RL）与监督微调（SFT）的医学视觉问答训练目标，用 LoRA 仅调约 1% 参数即在域内与 OOD 开放式问题上超越所有对比训练目标与 10 个通用/医学 VLM。
AI.motivation: 通用 VLM 适配医学 VQA 有临床价值，但标注数据稀缺且仅有短答案、无推理标注。SFT 易对短标签过拟合、放大地域/数据偏置，损害 OOD 泛化；纯 RL（GRPO 类）虽保泛化但不以金答案为训练目标，组内全对或全错时无正确性信号；现有 SFT-RL 混合方法要么分阶段/逐题切换，要么依赖专家或强模型的推理轨迹，而医学 VQA 数据缺乏此类轨迹。
AI.method: 提出 GRASP：在每一次更新中联合 RL 与 SFT，且仅使用短答案。RL 部分让模型自主探索推理过程；SFT 部分在该推理之后教模型输出金答案，以补足 RL 缺失的直接监督；二者权重根据模型对每个问题的作答质量自适应调节。仅用 LoRA 微调约 1% 参数。同时发布 MedTerse（12.9K 短答案问题数据集）并开源代码。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B、InternVL3-8B、Gemma 3-4B 上，GRASP 在域内及 OOD 开放式问题上均优于所有对比训练目标。在覆盖 8 种影像模态的 OOD 基准上，经 GRASP 训练的 InternVL3-8B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B 的开放式准确率超过全部 10 个对比的通用与医学 VLM，其中包括训练数据多至 2600 倍、可训练参数多逾 250 倍的模型。
AI.conclusion: 短答案标注即可支撑高质量医学 VQA 适配：将 RL 的探索式推理与 SFT 的金答案直接监督在单次更新中自适应融合，可同时缓解 SFT 的偏置放大与纯 RL 的稀疏正确性信号问题，实现强 OOD 泛化且参数高效。

title: Improving the Chain-of-Thought Compressibility of Pruned Reasoning Models via Long--Short Contrastive Pruning
comment: 11 pages. Preliminary version; further experiments and revisions are planned
summary: Large reasoning models are costly to serve because they are large and because they generate long chains of thought (CoT). Weight pruning and CoT compression address these two costs separately, but they interfere in that pruning adds redundant reasoning on problems the model still solves and incomplete reasoning on those it no longer solves, and on harder problems makes the model less compressible by subsequent length-preference optimization. We trace this to a blind spot on each side: pruning criteria do not distinguish necessary from redundant reasoning, and preference-based CoT compression receives no training signal on problems a pruned model always or never solves. We propose Contrastive Set-Difference (CSD), which identifies neurons enriched in redundant reasoning by contrasting their activations on long and short correct solutions of the same problem and prunes them preferentially, and we extend preference pairs to the problems a pruned model always or never solves. Pruning 20\% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, the combination uses 8--22\% fewer thinking tokens on four math benchmarks than pruning with reasoning-aware calibration (RAC) followed by the same compression, with accuracy within 0.5 points.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出权重剪枝与思维链（CoT）压缩相互干扰，并提出对比集差（CSD）方法：通过对比同一问题长短两种正确解上的神经元激活来识别冗余推理神经元并优先剪枝，同时将偏好对扩展到剪枝模型"总是解出/从不解出"的问题，从而联合降低模型规模与输出长度。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型服务成本高，源于模型规模大与生成长CoT两点。权重剪枝与CoT压缩分别针对这两项成本，但二者存在干扰：剪枝会在模型仍能解的问题上引入冗余推理、在已无法解的问题上产生不完整推理，且在更难问题上降低后续长度偏好优化的可压缩性。作者将根源归结为双方的盲区——剪枝准则无法区分必要推理与冗余推理；基于偏好的CoT压缩在剪枝模型"总是解出"或"从不解出"的问题上缺乏训练信号。
AI.method: 提出Contrastive Set-Difference（CSD）：对同一问题的长解与短解（均为正确解）对比神经元激活，识别在冗余推理中富集的神经元并优先剪枝；同时将偏好对扩展到剪枝模型总是解出或从不解出的问题，以弥补偏好压缩的训练信号空白。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B上剪枝20%，相比"推理感知校准（RAC）剪枝+相同压缩"的基线，在四个数学基准上减少8–22%的思考token，精度差距在0.5个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 将剪枝准则与CoT压缩显式对齐（识别冗余推理神经元并对偏好数据补盲）可缓解二者干扰，在几乎不损失精度的前提下同时获益于更小模型与更短推理链，实现更高效的服务。

title: CoLink: Global Compression and Knowledge Linking for Multi-Turn Dialogue Modeling
summary: Extracting salient information from long-horizon dialogue histories remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to the restricted context windows and efficient retrieval challenges. Current methods typically rely on history organization or local token-level optimization, suffering from information loss, retrieval redundancy, and myopic attention. Inspired by the view in cognitive science that dialogue constitutes sense-making and memory association, we propose CoLink, a framework that enhances LLMs' global context awareness in domain-specific multi-turn dialogues through information linking and compression. CoLink first clusters historical contexts into topic graphs to establish cross-semantic associations with external knowledge. Guided by the adaptive control of thought, it then retrieves and activates knowledge via synergizing semantic relevance and graph-structural topology. Crucially, to achieve effective compression of history and knowledge, we ground multi-turn dialogues in information theory and derive a principled optimization objective for extracting the core sense-making information. Coupled with a competitive slot mechanism, CoLink condenses the global context into dedicated memory and knowledge slots, efficiently distilling lengthy, redundant inputs into an extremely compact latent representation. Extensive empirical results on both public and our MMD datasets validate CoLink's superiority and generalizability in knowledge linking and sense modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoLink框架，通过信息链接与压缩增强LLM在领域特定多轮对话中的全局上下文感知能力，将长冗余输入蒸馏为极紧凑的潜表示。
AI.motivation: 长程对话历史的显著信息抽取面临LLM受限上下文窗口与高效检索两大难题；现有方法依赖历史组织或局部token级优化，存在信息丢失、检索冗余和短视注意力等问题。
AI.method: 受认知科学中"对话即意义建构与记忆联想"观点启发：1）将历史上下文聚类为话题图，与外部知识建立跨语义关联；2）以"思维自适应控制"（ACT）为指导，结合语义相关性与图结构拓扑进行知识检索与激活；3）基于信息论将多轮对话建模，推导提取核心意义建构信息的原则性优化目标；4）配合竞争槽机制，将全局上下文压缩至专用记忆槽与知识槽，形成紧凑潜表示。
AI.result: 在公开数据集与自建MMD数据集上的大量实验验证了CoLink在知识链接与意义建模方面的优越性与泛化性。
AI.conclusion: CoLink通过图结构链接与信息论驱动的压缩，有效缓解信息丢失与检索冗余，实现长程对话全局上下文的高效紧凑表示。

title: Write What Matters: Disentangling Token Selection from Slot Allocation in Recurrent Memory
summary: Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). The tested adaptive rule underperforms fixed allocation under the learned gate on both tasks. A diagnostic oracle given fact labels unavailable at deployment reaches 0.372 on Passkey, showing headroom in filtering distractors. The results suggest avoiding missed writes in information-dense contexts and filtering distractors when they dominate.

AI.tldr: 提出因子化写路由（FWR），将"是否写入"与"写多少槽"解耦，并在两个合成任务上观察到随信息密度反转的写入策略效果。
AI.motivation: 长序列模型需保留早期信息。全注意力保留所有历史但代价高；循环记忆模型将历史压缩进固定槽位以实现线性时间。容量有限使写入决策变得关键：干扰项会污染有用内容，被跳过的证据则无法回忆。现有多槽记忆对每个 token 更新相同数量的槽位，将"是否存储"与"更新多少槽"混为一谈。
AI.method: 提出 FWR：先决定每个 token 保留或跳过，再选择固定或随 token 自适应的槽位数量；查询仍读取全部槽位。在长上下文后查询事实的两个合成任务上各跑十个随机种子进行对比实验，并设置使用事实标签（部署时不可得）的诊断性 oracle。
AI.result: 每写 4 槽时出现密度依赖的反转：密集的 Feature Recall 上始终写入更优（0.472 vs 0.337），稀疏事实的 Passkey 上学习式选择性写入更优（0.222 vs 0.048）。在学习门控下，所测自适应规则在两任务上均不如固定分配。oracle 在 Passkey 上达 0.372，显示过滤干扰项仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 信息密集语境应避免漏写，干扰项占主导时应侧重过滤干扰；单一写入策略难以通吃，写入密度应随上下文信息密度调整。自适应槽位分配规则需重新设计。

title: Shared-Factor-Conditioned Diffusion for Low-Rank Tensor Recovery
summary: Tensor recovery spans heterogeneous data structures and observation processes, calling for a representation that can adapt across modalities and tasks. We propose DiffTR, an unsupervised framework that unifies tensor completion, denoising, and hyperspectral super-resolution through coordinate-conditioned diffusion. Shared factors indexed by tensor coordinates condition a compact score network, and score matching jointly learns the factors and an implicit tensor representation from the available observations. Scalar and vector-valued outputs accommodate individual entries and entire tubes, enabling a common formulation for tabular tensors, images, and videos. The framework separates representation learning from task-specific observation modeling: reverse diffusion recovers missing values; estimation via Tweedie's formula, soft thresholding, and optional spatial consistency support mixed-noise denoising; and measurement-guided sampling transfers a prior learned from low-resolution hyperspectral observations to high-resolution reconstruction, followed by post-sampling refinement with data consistency and spectral subspace regularization. This separation makes the representation compatible with different corruption models and permits task-specific constraints to be incorporated within the same recovery framework. Experiments across multiple tensor modalities and recovery tasks demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality and the flexibility of a unified conditional generative representation. The code is available at https://github.com/CZY-Code/DiffTR

AI.tldr: 提出无监督框架DiffTR，用坐标条件扩散统一张量补全、去噪与高光谱超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 张量恢复涉及异构数据结构与观测过程，需要一种可跨模态、跨任务自适应的统一表示。
AI.method: 以张量坐标索引的共享因子条件化紧凑得分网络；得分匹配从观测中联合学习因子与隐式张量表示；标量/向量输出分别对应单条目与整条纤维（tube），统一表格张量、图像、视频建模；将表示学习与任务特定观测建模分离：逆扩散补全缺失值，Tweedie公式、软阈值与可选空间一致性用于混合噪声去噪，测量引导采样将低分辨率高光谱先验迁移至超分重建，并辅以数据一致性及谱子空间正则的后采样精炼。
AI.result: 在多种张量模态与恢复任务上实现有竞争力的重建质量，展现统一条件生成表示的灵活性。
AI.conclusion: 表示学习与观测建模的分离使该表示兼容不同退化模型，并可在同一框架内融入任务特定约束。

title: Beyond Vision-Language Models: Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs for Emotion Recognition in Artworks
summary: Emotion recognition in artworks remains challenging because affective meaning is often subjective, implicit, and shaped by relationships between visual form and semantic associations. While vision-language models provide strong multimodal representations, direct image-to-emotion prediction may overlook explicit relations among formal, semantic, and affective cues that support emotional interpretation. This paper proposes Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG), a graph-based framework that represents artworks through interpretable feature nodes, including color, brushstroke, composition, light-shadow, line quality, and extracted visual entities. The graph learns feature-emotion associations for dominant emotion prediction, with valence-arousal structure modeled through an optional hierarchical auxiliary affect module. We evaluate VSAG and VSAG-TopK against direct VLM inference using Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 on EmoArt-5k. Results show that direct VLMs provide useful but modest baselines, while graph-based models improve dominant emotion prediction. In particular, the hierarchical valence-arousal variant of VSAG achieves the best overall performance, improving accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted-F1 over both direct VLM inference and the emotion-only VSAG baseline. Per-class results indicate that graph-based models and VLMs capture partly complementary signals, while valence-arousal structure is most useful when integrated as a coarse-to-fine affect hierarchy rather than as a simple post-hoc correction. These findings suggest that explicit visual-semantic structure can support both prediction and interpretation in artwork emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉-语义情感图（VSAG）框架，将艺术作品表示为可解释特征节点图，学习特征-情感关联以预测主导情绪，并可选地通过层级效价-唤醒辅助模块建模情感结构；在 EmoArt-5k 上优于直接 VLM 推理。
AI.motivation: 艺术图像情感识别困难，因为情感含义主观、隐晦，且依赖视觉形式与语义联想之间的关系；视觉语言模型虽具强多模态表示能力，但直接的图像-情感预测可能忽略形式、语义与情感线索之间的显式关系，也缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 构建图结构：节点为可解释特征（颜色、笔触、构图、光影、线条质量及抽取的视觉实体），在图上学习特征-情感关联进行主导情绪分类；设定 VSAG-TopK 变体；并提出可选的分层辅助情感模块，将效价-唤醒以粗到细的层级结构融入模型。以 Qwen3-VL 与 InternVL3.5 的直接推理为基线，在 EmoArt-5k 上对比评测。
AI.result: 直接 VLM 推理基线有效但性能有限；图模型提升主导情绪预测。带层级效价-唤醒的 VSAG 变体整体最佳，在 accuracy、macro-F1、weighted-F1 上均优于直接 VLM 推理与仅情绪任务的 VSAG 基线。逐类别结果显示图模型与 VLM 捕获部分互补信号；效价-唤醒结构以粗到细层级整合时最有效，而非简单的后处理校正。
AI.conclusion: 显式的视觉-语义结构既能支撑预测性能，也能提升艺术情绪识别的可解释性；情感维度结构宜作为层级先验融入，而非事后修正。

title: Reading Beyond OCR Noise: Robust Cross-Lingual RAG for Legislative Archives
summary: India's historical public archives present severe computer vision and document image analysis challenges: decades of parliamentary records survive only as degraded, multi-column scanned pages featuring mixed scripts, complex layouts, and dense visual noise where OCR failure is the primary obstacle to information retrieval. We present an end-to-end framework that couples vision-based layout segmentation and multi-script OCR with an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. Our approach specifically addresses how visual degradation and layout fragmentation propagate into text extraction errors, using an iterative agentic loop to navigate around OCR noise and layout ambiguities before generating answers. Evaluated on the 200,000-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha archive, our system demonstrates robust handling of historical document degradation, outperforming standard text-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端框架，将基于视觉的版面分割与多文字识别（OCR）同智能体式RAG流水线耦合，用于处理印度历史公共档案的退化扫描件，并在20万页旁遮普立法会议档案上优于纯文本基线。
AI.motivation: 印度历史公共档案仅以退化、多栏扫描页形式存在，含混合文字、复杂版面和密集视觉噪声，OCR失败是信息检索的主要障碍；且视觉退化与版面碎片化如何传导为文本抽取错误这一问题尚未被系统处理。
AI.method: 构建端到端框架：先做视觉驱动的版面分割，再进行多文字OCR，并接入智能体式检索增强生成（RAG）流水线；采用迭代式智能体循环，在生成答案前绕开OCR噪声与版面歧义。
AI.result: 在20万页Punjab Vidhan Sabha档案上评测，系统对历史文档退化具有稳健处理能力，性能超过标准纯文本基线。
AI.conclusion: 将版面理解、多文字OCR与智能体式RAG耦合可有效缓解历史档案的退化与版面碎片化问题，为低质量扫描档案的信息检索提供可行方案。

title: Joint Latent Reasoning and Observation for Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Effective video agents must learn not only how to answer, but also where to look next. Transferring this capability to smaller models is challenging because each observation serves two purposes: supporting an answer and guiding the search for further evidence. Textual descriptions may capture what is currently visible while omitting cues needed for subsequent acquisition. We introduce Latent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis (LARVA), a framework that distills multi-round video agents through jointly learned latent reasoning and visual observations. Rather than communicating through captions, an observer passes compact continuous representations to a reasoner that selects the next acquisition action or produces the final answer. Crucially, action and answer supervision propagate through this interface, training the observer to communicate information useful for downstream decisions. Observation reconstruction and reasoning-distribution alignment provide auxiliary supervision from textual teacher trajectories. Across five video-understanding benchmarks, LARVA achieves strong performance with 4B and 7B backbones. On VideoHolmes, Video-MME, and LVBench, the 7B model outperforms a textual CoT student trained on the same teacher trajectories by 5.1, 2.5, and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. These results highlight the value of jointly learning how agents represent evidence and act on it when distilling video-understanding capabilities.

AI.tldr: LARVA通过联合学习的潜在推理与视觉观测蒸馏多轮视频智能体，以连续表示替代文本描述传递观测信息，在五个视频理解基准上显著优于文本CoT蒸馏学生模型。
AI.motivation: 有效视频智能体不仅需学会作答，还需学会"下一步看哪里"，但向小模型迁移该能力存在困难：每个观测同时承担两个作用——支撑答案与引导后续证据搜索；而文本描述虽能刻画当前可见内容，却会丢失后续获取所需的线索。
AI.method: 提出LARVA框架，抛弃以caption为媒介的通信方式：observer向reasoner传递紧凑连续表征，reasoner据此选择下一步获取动作或给出最终答案。动作与答案监督信号通过该接口反向传播，训练observer传递对下游决策有用的信息；并利用观测重建与推理分布对齐，从文本教师轨迹中提供辅助监督。
AI.result: 在五个视频理解基准上，基于4B和7B骨干取得强劲性能。在VideoHolmes、Video-MME和LVBench上，7B模型相比在相同教师轨迹上训练的文本CoT学生模型分别高出5.1、2.5和3.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在蒸馏视频理解能力时，联合学习智能体"如何表征证据"与"如何基于证据行动"具有重要价值。

title: Beyond Words Alone: Disentangling Distributed Evidence for Visually Grounded Cultural Translation
summary: Social media enables cross-lingual communication, yet the meaning of user-generated content (UGC) is often distributed across text, images, and cultural knowledge, making translation challenging. Existing evaluations typically treat images as optional and assume textual information is sufficient, obscuring whether errors stem from missing visual evidence or inadequate cultural adaptation. We introduce \textbf{Culture-MMT}, a diagnostic benchmark for \textbf{distributed-evidence pragmatic reconstruction} in social-media translation. It contains 498 curated, de-identified UGC instances across 20 domains, categorized into Symbol, Visual, and Hybrid by their required evidence. We also develop a human-aligned domain-specific judge, Judger, and a controlled evaluation framework that systematically varies the evidence available to translators. Across 17 model configurations, real images improve performance by +0.280 on Visual and +0.197 on Hybrid, but only +0.050 on Symbol, while random images provide no comparable gains. Human-authored descriptions further show that jointly dependent cases remain more challenging even when visual facts are explicit. These results characterize culturally effective social-media translation as {meaning reconstruction from distributed evidence}, highlighting visual grounding and cultural-pragmatic adaptation as distinct model bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Culture-MMT 诊断基准，将社交媒体翻译建模为"分布式证据的语用重构"，系统区分视觉证据缺失与文化语用适配两类瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体的跨语言传播中，UGC 语义分散于文本、图像与文化知识之间，而现有评测通常把图像视为可选、默认文本信息充分，导致无法判断翻译错误究竟源于视觉证据缺失还是文化适配不足。
AI.method: 构建 Culture-MMT 基准：498 条经过整理与去标识化的 UGC 实例，覆盖 20 个领域，按所需证据类型划分为 Symbol、Visual、Hybrid 三类；开发与人类判断对齐的领域专用评判器 Judger；设计受控评测框架，系统改变译者可获得的证据条件。共评测 17 种模型配置。
AI.result: 真实图像在 Visual 与 Hybrid 类别分别带来 +0.280 和 +0.197 的提升，但在 Symbol 类别仅 +0.050；随机图像未产生可比增益。人工撰写的描述进一步表明，即便视觉事实已被显式给出，联合依赖型案例仍然更难。
AI.conclusion: 有效的文化相关社交媒体翻译应被理解为"基于分布式证据的意义重构"；视觉 grounding 与文化语用适配是两个相互独立的模型瓶颈。

title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
summary: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-art subject identity and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality and motion. Project page: justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase

AI.tldr: OmniShowcase通过自动化3D资产生成数据管线和高程-法线几何条件方法，将少图主体到视频生成扩展到360度视角变化，并在主体身份与3D一致性上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 少参考图的主体到视频生成（S2V）在相机揭示输入中不可见表面时极具挑战：单图方法需推断未见外观与几何；多视图方法虽提供更多视角信息，却未显式指定连接这些观测的3D结构，且现有训练数据无法保证视角变化下保持同一底层3D主体。
AI.method: 提出两组件框架：(i) 全自动数据合成管线，沿多样相机轨迹生成训练视频，视角变化由底层主体几何驱动，可覆盖完整360度环绕；(ii) 几何条件方法，从参考视图重建表面法线图并组织为turntable形式输入视频模型，且不要求与生成帧做时间对齐。据此构建Showcase-4K数据集（基于3D资产的视频，涵盖12种相机运动、88种轨迹配置）及带源网格与相机参数的ShowcaseBench评测集。
AI.result: 实验显示在主体身份保持与3D一致性上取得SOTA，同时视频质量与运动表现保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 显式的几何条件（表面法线turntable）与几何驱动的合成数据能有效弥补多视图S2V缺乏3D结构约束的缺陷，使模型在剧烈视角乃至全周环绕下生成一致的主体视频。

title: NumTrace: Auditing the Number Provenance of Financial Analyst Agents
summary: A numerical claim generated by a financial analyst agent can match a number in a company filing but refer to the wrong entity, concept, period, unit or scope. A check based on reference answers can mark such an answer as wrong but does not explain why it fails. In this paper, we present NumTrace, a new benchmark that audits the provenance of each numerical claim made by financial analyst agents: its source and financial semantics. NumTrace currently has 540 questions over 2,163 SEC EDGAR documents. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first numerical benchmark about who holds a company's shares (Form 13F) and what its executives are owed (Item 402(i)). On a frozen snapshot of these documents, we build the reference answers according to accounting rules. NumTrace then gives each claim three separate verdicts: value, binding and support. By retaining separate value and binding verdicts, NumTrace detects right number, wrong account (RNWA) errors: a claim has an RNWA error when it passes the value check but fails the binding check. The RNWA rate quantifies the gap between value-only and joint value-and-binding pass rates. Finally, we audit three agents, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. RNWA errors make up 67.5-81.8% of each agent's failing claims. In particular, on 13F co-filing group questions, about 91% of claims pass the value check, but fewer than half pass the binding check.

AI.tldr: 论文提出NumTrace基准，用于审计金融分析师智能体数值主张的来源与财务语义，并将判定拆分为value、binding、support三项，以此识别"数字对、账户错"（RNWA）错误。
AI.motivation: 现有基于参考答案的检查只能判定答案对错，无法解释失败原因；智能体给出的数字可能与公司文件中的某个数字相同，但在实体、概念、期间、单位或范围上指向错误。
AI.method: 构建含540个问题、覆盖2,163份SEC EDGAR文档的基准，基于冻结文档快照按会计规则生成参考答案；首次覆盖13F持股主体与Item 402(i)高管应付款项；对每个数值主张分别给出value、binding、support三项独立判定，并以value通过但binding失败定义RNWA错误。
AI.result: 审计Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra与DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash三个智能体，RNWA错误占各自失败主张的67.5%–81.8%；在13F共同申报集团问题上，约91%的主张通过value检查，但通过binding检查的不足一半。
AI.conclusion: 仅做数值比对会显著高估智能体的可靠性，需对数值主张的绑定关系进行溯源审计；NumTrace提供了可诊断、可量化的评估框架。

title: Image Clustering with Vision-Language Model Embeddings
summary: Pretrained vision-language models provide image representations whose suitability for clustering may vary with feature extraction, image domain, and partitioning algorithm. We compare nine representation pipelines across seven image benchmarks and four clustering configurations, yielding 252 baseline combinations. Eight pipelines extract visual features, including two vision-only references; the ninth generates descriptions and embeds the resulting text. With agglomerative clustering (Ward linkage) fixed, Qwen3-VL achieves the highest adjusted Rand index (ARI) on five datasets, including 0.925 on MNIST, while BLIP-2 leads on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with ARIs of 0.925 and 0.591, respectively. A separate sensitivity analysis compares raw and L2-normalized embeddings at their original dimensionality across all 63 dataset-representation pairs. Normalization preserves the highest-ARI representation in every dataset, increases ARI in 35 pairs, decreases it in 26, and leaves two numerically unchanged. On the SVHN dataset, the highest ARI remains low, rising from 0.097 to 0.098 after normalization. The evaluated caption-mediated pipeline obtains relatively high ARI on isolated digits but does not consistently exceed direct visual features. These findings support selecting and evaluating complete representation-clustering pipelines for the intended domain, with explicit attention to extraction and normalization choices.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了9种视觉-语言/视觉表征管线在7个图像数据集与4种聚类配置下共252种组合的聚类表现，并单独分析L2归一化对ARI的影响。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉-语言模型提供的图像表征，其聚类适用性会随特征提取方式、图像域和划分算法而变化，因此需要系统评估完整"表征+聚类"管线的性能，而非孤立地比较单一环节。
AI.method: 固定凝聚聚类（Ward连接）作为主设置，比较9条表征管线（8条视觉特征提取，含2条纯视觉参考；1条先生成描述再嵌入文本）在7个基准、4种聚类配置共252种组合上的表现；另对全部63个"数据集-表征"配对做原始维度与L2归一化嵌入的敏感性分析。
AI.result: Qwen3-VL在5个数据集上取得最高ARI（MNIST上0.925），BLIP-2在CIFAR-10与CIFAR-100上领先（ARI分别为0.925与0.591）。归一化在每个数据集上都保留了最高ARI的表征，35对提升、26对下降、2对基本不变；SVHN最高ARI仍很低，仅从0.097升至0.098。基于字幕的管线在孤立数字上表现较好，但未稳定超过直接视觉特征。
AI.conclusion: 应针对目标域选择并评估完整的表征-聚类管线，并显式关注特征提取与归一化的选择；不应默认某种管线普遍占优，样本域（如SVHN）仍是主要瓶颈。

title: Energy Efficient Lung Tumor Segmentation with a modified CBAM ENet Skip Model
summary: Lung tumor segmentation plays a vital role in early detection and treatment planning of lung cancer. Although state-of-the-art deep learning models achieve high dice score coefficients (DSC), each forward pass requires computing large amounts of floating point operations, making them computationally expensive, requiring GPU acceleration, and having slow inference speed, limiting real-world clinical deployment. We propose a lightweight, energy-efficient model that leverages the ENet architecture for its real-time inference capability and low computational cost, enhanced with UNet-style skip connections between encoder and decoder stages for feature reuse and the lightweight Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for improved feature representation. The model is trained on publicly available data from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) via the Medical Segmentation Decathlon Challenge (MSD) and evaluated on the Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset. Our model achieves a DSC of 0.90812 (threshold of 0.5) with its compact architecture of 430,052 parameters and 0.549 Giga Multiply-Accumulate operations (GMAC), making it up to 10 times faster, requires 79 times less GMAC than UNet, and has 22 times fewer parameters than SegNet. These characteristics make it well-suited for deployment in clinical settings where computational resources are limited and decrease the cost of utilizing such a system. Additionally, the explainable AI technique of Grad-CAM is used to provide visual interpretability of the model's predictions and to identify regions where segmentation performance requires improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出基于ENet的轻量高效肺肿瘤分割模型：引入UNet式跳跃连接与CBAM注意力，仅43万参数、0.549 GMAC，在LIDC-IDRI上DSC达0.90812，比UNet快约10倍、GMAC少79倍、参数比SegNet少22倍，并用Grad-CAM提供可解释性。
AI.motivation: 肺肿瘤分割对肺癌早期检测与治疗规划至关重要，但SOTA深度学习模型DSC虽高，每次前向传播需大量浮点运算，算力开销大、依赖GPU加速、推理慢，难以落地临床；且临床场景算力资源有限、成本敏感。因此需要兼顾精度、速度与能耗的轻量模型。
AI.method: 以ENet为主干，利用其实时推理能力与低计算量；在编码器与解码器之间加入UNet式跳跃连接以实现特征复用；嵌入轻量CBAM（卷积块注意力模块）提升特征表达。训练数据来自TCIA经MSD挑战赛发布的公开数据，并在LIDC-IDRI数据集上评估。另用Grad-CAM进行可视化解释。
AI.result: 在阈值0.5下DSC为0.90812；模型仅430,052个参数、0.549 GMAC；相较UNet推理速度提升最高10倍、GMAC减少79倍；参数量比SegNet少22倍。Grad-CAM可视化给出预测依据并定位分割性能待改进区域。
AI.conclusion: ENet+跳跃连接+CBAM的组合可在极低参数量与算力下取得高精度肺肿瘤分割，适合算力受限的临床部署并降低成本；可解释性分析有助于发现并改进薄弱分割区域。

title: DROA-CLIPSeg: Prompt-Guided Thin Crack Segmentation in Low-Light Conditions
comment: Accepted at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Pavement crack segmentation under low light is degraded by reduced contrast, shadows, headlight glare, joints, stains, and wet seams. Existing crack segmentation methods mostly assume good illumination. Low-light enhancement methods improve visual quality, but they do not explicitly preserve crack topology. To address these limitations, we formulate low-light crack segmentation as a degradation-aware, prompt-grounded structural defect segmentation problem and propose DROA-CLIPSeg, a parameter-efficient framework that adapts a frozen CLIPSeg vision language backbone using two lightweight modules. QKV Low-Rank Adaptation is injected into the Q/K/V projections of the vision and text encoders to improve crack-specific image text alignment without backbone fine-tuning. The proposed Domain Residual Orthogonal Adapter (DROA) decomposes intermediate features into a dominant crack-domain branch, which captures recurring low-light crack patterns, and an orthogonal residual branch, which preserves faint, thin, and fragmented evidence usually suppressed by noise, shadow, or over-smoothing. We also introduce CrackLingo-9K and CrackLingo-12K, text augmented versions of Crack9k and Crack12k with crack-aware prompts. Training only approximately 1.93 M parameters, corresponding to 1.3% of the full model, DROA-CLIPSeg outperforms 9 zero-shot and 4 fine-tuned vision language baselines on both splits, generalises zero-shot to MVTec AD across textures and defect morphologies, and is supported by extensive ablations. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/VShuklacode/DROA-CLIPSeg

AI.tldr: 提出DROA-CLIPSeg，一个仅训练约1.93M参数（占全模型1.3%）的参数高效框架，通过QKV低秩适配与领域残差正交适配器，将低光照路面裂缝分割建模为退化感知、提示引导的结构缺陷分割问题，性能超越9个零样本与4个微调视觉语言基线。
AI.motivation: 低光照路面裂缝分割受对比度下降、阴影、车灯眩光、接缝、污渍与湿接缝等因素干扰而退化；现有裂缝分割方法多假设光照良好，而低光照增强方法虽改善视觉质量却不能显式保持裂缝拓扑结构。
AI.method: 以冻结的CLIPSeg视觉语言骨干为基础，注入两个轻量模块：(1) QKV低秩适配（LoRA）注入视觉与文本编码器的Q/K/V投影，提升裂缝专用图文对齐；(2) 领域残差正交适配器（DROA）将中间特征分解为主导裂缝域分支（捕捉重复性低光照裂缝模式）与正交残差分支（保留易被噪声、阴影或过度平滑抑制的微弱、细长、断裂证据）。同时构建CrackLingo-9K与CrackLingo-12K，即Crack9k/Crack12k的文本增强版本，含裂缝感知提示。
AI.result: 仅训练约1.93M参数（占全模型1.3%）即在两个数据划分上超越9个零样本与4个微调视觉语言基线；在MVTec AD上跨纹理与缺陷形态实现零样本泛化；并通过大量消融实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 退化感知、提示引导的参数高效适配可在不微调骨干的前提下有效解决低光照裂缝分割，兼顾裂缝拓扑保持与跨域泛化能力；代码已开源。

title: ACSAN: All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network Integrating Convolutional Operations with Vision Transformer
summary: In the past few years, Vision Transformer (ViT) has achieved excellent performance in the field of computer vision. However, there still some problems remain. For instance, ViTs heavily rely on large-scale training data since they simply contain a large number of trainable parameters, which slows down their learning efficiency and limits their applicability in resource-constrained scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning model, namely All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN), which applies convolution operations to replace fully-connected matrices multiplications in the ViT framework. To implement ACSAN, we firstly design Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) as the basic module, which employs multi-scale dilated convolutions to generate Query, Key, and Value. We defined spatial self-attention and channel self-attention to generate attention features respectively. The two attention features are finally merged as the output of the DCSA module. Based on DCSA, we then construct the basic ACSAN block. Comparing with ViT, we use DCSA to replace the regular self-attention operations, and use convolution layers to replace MLPs. To evaluate the performance of the proposed method, we train ACSAN on three widely-used image classification databases, i.e. CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k, from scratch. Experimental results show that ACSAN achieves excellent classification accuracy comparing with standard ViT with comparable or fewer parameters, as well as other state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies verify that each component contributes positively to the final performance.

AI.tldr: 提出全卷积自注意力网络ACSAN，用卷积替代ViT中的全连接矩阵乘法，在CIFAR-10/100与ImageNet-1k上以相当或更少参数取得优于ViT的分类精度。
AI.motivation: ViT参数量大、严重依赖大规模训练数据，学习效率低，难以适用于资源受限场景。
AI.method: 设计动态卷积自注意力（DCSA）为基本模块：用多尺度空洞卷积生成Q、K、V，分别构造空间自注意力与通道自注意力并将二者融合输出；基于DCSA搭建ACSAN block，以DCSA替换常规自注意力、以卷积层替换MLP，对ViT框架中的全连接矩阵乘法做卷积化替代。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、ImageNet-1k上从零训练，分类精度优于参数量相当或更少的标准ViT及其他先进方法；消融实验表明各组件均有正向贡献。
AI.conclusion: 卷积化自注意力可在不增加参数的前提下提升ViT的学习效率与分类性能，为资源受限场景提供可行方案。

title: CoSA: The Conflict of Skills Attack in Real-World LLM Agent Ecosystems
summary: Agent Skills allow LLM agents to combine reusable capabilities, but checking each Skill in isolation cannot rule out policy violations when they are composed. We term such failures Conflict of Skills (CoS): artifacts or assessment signals produced for one purpose may be reused downstream without preserving the restrictions or authorization needed for their new use. Using controlled executions of publicly available Skills and matched single-Skill controls, we identify four recurring mechanisms behind CoS. Building on these findings, we introduce the Conflict of Skills Attack (CoSA), which adds locally admitted Skills to an existing pool to supply missing business operations (capability supplementation) or reshape artifact exchange, decision reuse, and target/action bindings (relationship reshaping). CoSA leaves existing Skills and runtime permissions unchanged. To evaluate this threat under autonomous Skill selection, we introduce CoSA-Bench, built from real-world Skills and controlled services, with 288 tasks across recruiting, finance, IT, and business, covering data leakage, unauthorized state modification, and unsafe execution.
