Across five LLMs and three agent harnesses, additions capped at 5% of each original pool raise the policy-violation rate from 35.02% to 58.45%, an increase of 23.43 percentage points. Trace analysis links compliant-to-violating transitions to cross-Skill dependencies involving the additions. Finally, we develop a lightweight harness-level guard that checks information flow and authorization before consequential actions. On OpenClaw recruiting tasks across five models, the guard reduces violations from 65.28% to 6.67%, while policy-compliant task completion on matched benign controls changes from 66.67% to 65.00%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"技能冲突"(CoS)概念：多个可复用LLM智能体技能组合时，即使单个技能合规，其产物或评估信号在下游复用可能丢失原有约束与授权，导致策略违规。作者据此设计CoSA攻击与CoSA-Bench基准，并用轻量级守卫将违规率从65.28%降至6.67%。
AI.motivation: 现有技能(Skill)生态支持智能体组合复用能力，但单独审查每个技能无法排除组合后的策略违规风险，缺乏对该组合失效机理与威胁的系统刻画与评估手段。
AI.method: 基于公开技能的受控执行与单技能对照实验，归纳CoS的四类复发机制；提出CoSA攻击，通过向现有技能池注入局部可准入的技能实现"能力补充"与"关系重塑"（改变产物交换、决策复用、目标/动作绑定），且不修改现有技能与运行时权限；构建CoSA-Bench（真实技能与受控服务，288个任务，覆盖招聘、财务、IT、业务，涵盖数据泄露、未授权状态修改与不安全执行）；并在harness层设计检查信息流与授权的轻量守卫。
AI.result: 在5个LLM与3种agent harness上，注入技能上限为原池5%时，策略违规率由35.02%升至58.45%（+23.43个百分点）；轨迹分析表明合规→违规的转变与涉及注入技能的跨技能依赖相关。在OpenClaw招聘任务、5个模型上，守卫将违规率从65.28%降至6.67%，匹配良性对照的合规完成率从66.67%变为65.00%。
AI.conclusion: 技能组合层面存在系统性安全盲区，单一技能审查不足以保障策略合规；少量注入技能即可显著放大违规风险，而harness级信息流与授权检查可在几乎不损失良性任务完成度的前提下大幅抑制违规。

title: AskGLP1: A Knowledge Graph LLM Agent for Exploring GLP-1 Experience from Online Patient Narratives
summary: GLP-1 medications are increasingly used for weight management, and many people share their experiences online. These narratives show why people take the drugs and what they experience, but they remain unstructured and disconnected from formal pharmacovigilance. We therefore present AskGLP1, a system that transforms online patient narratives into a knowledge graph (KG) and answers questions about medication experiences. Through an LLM-assisted pipeline grounded in the MedDRA terminology, AskGLP1 screens nearly 8.5 million Reddit posts for medication experiences and distills 163,135 of them, with 2,506 WebMD reviews, into a KG of 385,790 drug-side-effect and drug-purpose relations. We find that GLP-1 experiences are source- and drug-specific. Online narratives share the most common gastrointestinal symptoms with FAERS, but they foreground everyday burdens such as fatigue and food aversion, whereas FAERS reports more often include injection-site reactions and selected serious diagnoses such as pancreatitis. We further find that posts report less nausea and vomiting for tirzepatide than for semaglutide, more fatigue for Wegovy than Ozempic and for Zepbound than Mounjaro. Evaluations show that the agent answers with verifiable evidence and declines requests for medical advice. Our findings reveal gaps between what FAERS captures and what people report online, and they call for patient-centered approaches to pharmacovigilance. Code, prompts, and evaluation questions are available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/AskGLP1.

AI.tldr: AskGLP1将近850万条Reddit帖与2,506条WebMD评论经LLM+MedDRA流水线转化为385,790条药物-副作用/用途关系的知识图谱，并构建可溯源问答智能体；揭示在线叙事与FAERS在症状谱上的系统性差异。
AI.motivation: GLP-1类药物的体重管理用途日益普及，患者在线分享的用药体验丰富但非结构化，且与传统药物警戒（FAERS）体系脱节，缺乏可查询、可比较的证据来源。
AI.method: 构建AskGLP1系统：以MedDRA术语体系为约束的LLM辅助抽取流水线，先筛查约850万条Reddit帖子中的用药体验，提炼163,135条帖子并结合2,506条WebMD评论，抽取药物—副作用与药物—用途关系形成知识图谱；在图谱上搭建检索增强的问答智能体，并与FAERS报告进行对比分析。
AI.result: 图谱含385,790条关系；GLP-1体验呈现来源特异性与药物特异性。在线叙事与FAERS共享最常见的胃肠道症状，但更突出疲劳、食物厌恶等日常负担，而FAERS更多出现注射部位反应及胰腺炎等严重诊断。帖子中替尔泊肽的恶心呕吐报告少于司美格鲁肽；Wegovy较Ozempic、Zepbound较Mounjaro报告更多疲劳。评测显示智能体能给出可验证证据并对医疗建议请求予以拒答。
AI.conclusion: 在线患者叙事与FAERS在捕捉内容上存在系统性缺口，二者应互补而非替代；研究呼吁以患者为中心的药物警戒范式，将非结构化患者体验纳入可计算的知识体系。

title: LE-GDA: Layer Ensemble Gaussian Discriminant Analysis for Training-Free Few-Shot CLIP Adaptation
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 23 pages, 5 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Training-free few-shot adaptation of vision-language models typically constructs a classifier from CLIP's final projected image representation, leaving intermediate representations unused. Combining them is not straightforward. Class scores from different representations differ in spread by orders of magnitude for the same query. Direct averaging allocates influence by numerical scale rather than predictive information. We propose Layer-Ensemble Gaussian Discriminant Analysis (LE-GDA), a method that fits regularized shared-covariance discriminants independently to intermediate and final representations extracted in one frozen encoder pass. LE-GDA standardizes each discriminant's class scores per query, selects a small representation multiset on labeled validation data, and combines it with the zero-shot classifier without gradient-based optimization. Across 11 datasets, four CLIP backbones, five shot counts, and three independently sampled K-shot training sets, LE-GDA achieves the highest mean accuracy of all evaluated methods on every backbone, raising the 16-shot mean from 78.01% to 79.54% over a matched GDA-CLIP (final-feature) baseline and improving that baseline for every backbone-shot combination. At one shot, LE-GDA retains a 1.20-point mean gain over the baseline even though covariance estimation is unavailable and per-query standardization is neutral. A control with richer per-class structure inside a single representation does not reproduce the gain, indicating that the benefit comes from combining representations. These results show that intermediate CLIP representations carry information beyond the final embedding and can improve training-free few-shot adaptation. Code and evaluation resources are available at https://github.com/pavodi-NM/le-gda.

AI.tldr: LE-GDA：对CLIP多层表示分别拟合正则化共享协方差GDA，按查询标准化类分数后选取小型表示子集，与零样本分类器无梯度融合，在11个数据集、4个骨干、5种shot设置下均取得最高平均精度。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练少样本适配仅使用CLIP最终投影图像表示构建分类器，中间层表示被浪费；而直接组合不可行，因为同一查询下不同表示的类分数数值尺度相差数量级，简单平均会按数值量级而非预测信息分配权重。
AI.method: LE-GDA在单次冻结编码器前向中提取中间层与最终层表示，对每层独立拟合正则化共享协方差高斯判别分析；对每个判别器的类分数按查询标准化；在带标签验证数据上选择小型表示多重集；再与零样本分类器融合，全程无梯度优化。
AI.result: 在11个数据集、4个CLIP骨干、5种shot数、3组独立采样K-shot训练集上，LE-GDA在所有骨干上平均精度均为最高；16-shot均值由78.01%提升至79.54%；对每个骨干-shot组合均优于基线；1-shot时仍保持1.20个百分点平均增益（此时协方差估计不可用、逐查询标准化为中性）。在单表示内引入更丰富类结构的对照实验未能复现该增益，说明收益来自多层表示组合。
AI.conclusion: 中间层CLIP表示携带最终嵌入之外的信息，可用于提升免训练少样本适配；鲁棒且无需训练，代码与评测资源已开源。

title: Conviction Without Evidence: Verdict Stability Is Independent of Visual Grounding in Medical Vision--Language Models
comment: Accepted at the Med-Reasoner workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Vision--language models applied to medical question answering can reach correct diagnoses without using the diagnostic image, inferring instead from the clinical vignette. We ask whether this is visible in how \emph{firmly} a model holds its answer: does a model defend a diagnosis derived from a blank placeholder as tenaciously as one derived from a real medical image? Crossing an image-substitution protocol with two levels of adversarial pressure on 60 Italian State Examination items, we find no evidence that ungrounded verdicts are more fragile. In a paired item-level analysis, fabricated consensus (L4) overturns 94.4\% of verdicts with the real image and 98.1\% without ($Δ= +0.037$; one-sided 95\% upper bound $+0.105$); contentless doubt (L1) overturns 62.5\% and 51.8\% ($Δ= -0.107$, 95\% CI $[-0.209, -0.001]$), the point estimate running opposite to the direction a grounding detector requires. The two levels nonetheless produce opposite \emph{dynamics}: under L4 the model flips once, always to the exact option argued for (110/110 first-turn flips), and then freezes, averaging 1.9 verdict changes over ten turns; under L1 it never settles, averaging 7.4 changes. Instability under contentless doubt tracks intrinsic item ambiguity rather than evidence availability, and so does not serve as a grounding signal. Flips are almost entirely corrupting (99/100 across both levels). The model is not unaware of the missing evidence---it flags the blank image at baseline on 35 of 60 items and abstains on 4--6---yet those abstentions do not survive contact with pressure. None of the epistemic signals a user could plausibly consult distinguishes a grounded diagnosis from a confabulated one.

AI.tldr: 本文检验医学问答中视觉语言模型的答案“坚定度”能否作为图像接地（grounding）的检测信号：在60道意大利国家考试题目上将图像替换协议与两级对抗压力交叉，发现无图诊断并不更脆弱，各类“认识论信号”均无法区分接地与虚构诊断。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在医学问答中即使图像被替换为空白占位符仍能给出正确诊断（依赖临床病例文本而非图像）。作者追问这种“无接地”答案是否在模型的置信/稳定性上有所体现，即模型是否会像捍卫真实图像得出的诊断那样坚定地捍卫空白图像得出的诊断，从而评估稳定性/可推翻性是否可作为接地的可检测信号。
AI.method: 图像替换协议（真实图像 vs 空白占位符）×两级对抗压力（L1 无内容的怀疑；L4 伪造的共识），共60道意大利国家考试（State Examination）题目，条目内配对分析。指标包括10轮交互中的诊断翻转率、翻转次数、首轮翻转去向，以及基线弃答/空白图像识别率。
AI.result: 无证据表明无图判断更脆弱：L4下真实图像组94.4%被推翻、无图组98.1%（Δ=+0.037，单侧95%上界+0.105）；L1下分别为62.5%与51.8%（Δ=-0.107，95% CI [-0.209,-0.001]），点估计方向与接地检测器所需相反。两级压力动态相反：L4下模型仅翻转一次且总指向被论证的具体选项（110/110），随后冻结，10轮平均1.9次改变；L1下始终不稳定，平均7.4次。L1下的不稳定性与题目内在歧义相关而非证据可得性。翻转几乎全为破坏性（100次中99次）。模型并非不知证据缺失：基线有35/60题标记空白图像、4–6题弃答，但弃答在压力下不保留。
AI.conclusion: 用户可合理参考的任何认识论信号（置信、翻转率、弃答、图像缺失识别）都无法区分有图像支持的诊断与凭空虚构的诊断；内容缺失质疑下的不稳定性反映题目歧义而非接地状态，不能作为接地信号。

title: The Price of Scale in Proactive Memory Recall
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/RiverChenStillCompiling/price-of-scale
summary: A long-lived assistant that brings up memories without being asked must decide at every turn whether anything in its store is worth an interruption. We show that this decision is a multiple-testing problem whose difficulty grows with the store size $N$. On streaming replays of LongMemEval and LoCoMo, a similarity threshold tuned to 5% false alarms at $N=8$ reaches 87-100% at $N=2048$, across embedding models and for explicit and implicit cues; LLM judges show the same growth from a lower base. We prove that a gate with false-alarm rate $α$ operates at a per-item false-positive rate of about $-\ln(1-α)/N$, which pins its hit rate to the far left of the single-comparison ROC curve and, under regular variation, makes it decay as a power of $N$ with an explicit constant. The resulting prediction matches the hit rate of a per-$N$ oracle threshold to within one percentage point. The analysis explains why lexical and semantic channels need thresholds growing like $\ln N$ and $\sqrt{\ln N}$, and why per-cue normalisation roughly doubles the hit rate at matched false alarms. A cue-swap conformal gate, which compares the current cue with the user's other cues on the same store, needs no labels and has a finite-sample false-alarm guarantee under exchangeability; on LongMemEval it holds false alarms near 5% at the hit rate of a label-tuned threshold. Three annotators (Fleiss' $κ=0.63$) find that about nine in ten false alarms are genuine interruptions. Code and data: https://github.com/RiverChenStillCompiling/price-of-scale

AI.tldr: 论文将长期助手"是否打断用户"的决策建模为随存储规模 N 增长的多元检验问题，从实证、理论、方法三方面给出了规模增大导致误报激增的规律及对应的免标注门控方案。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆助手需在每一轮自主判断是否主动唤起记忆（打断用户），但相似度阈值通常在固定或小规模存储上调好，随记忆库增大其可靠性存疑。作者希望刻画"规模代价"：门控决策随 N 变化的行为规律。
AI.method: 在 LongMemEval 与 LoCoMo 的流式回放上，用固定 5% 假警报（N=8 时校准）的相似度阈值测试不同 N；并用 LLM 判官对照。理论上将总假警报率 α 的门控分解为逐项误报率 ≈ −ln(1−α)/N，定位其落在单比较 ROC 曲线最左端，结合正则变差推出命中率按 N 的幂次衰减并给出显式常数。进一步分析词汇/语义通道所需阈值分别按 ln N 与 √ln N 增长，以及逐线索归一化的增益。提出 cue-swap conformal gate：用同一存储上用户其他线索作为校准集，在可交换性下给出有限样本假警报保证。
AI.result: N=8 校准到 5% 假警报的阈值，在 N=2048 时假警报率达 87–100%，跨嵌入模型、显式与隐式线索均成立；LLM 判官从更低基线同样上升。理论预测的命中率与逐 N 的 oracle 阈值相差在 1 个百分点内；逐线索归一化在同等假警报下命中率约翻倍；cue-swap conformal 门控在 LongMemEval 上无需标签即可将假警报维持在约 5%，命中率与标签调优阈值相当。三名标注者（Fleiss κ=0.63）判定约九成假警报实为真实打断。
AI.conclusion: 主动记忆唤起本质上是随 N 放大的多元检验问题，固定假警报率阈值在规模下不可用；该"规模代价"可由理论精确预测，并可通过免标签的 conformal cue-swap 门控在有限样本保证下实用化。同时，"假警报"多为真实打断，说明评价口径本身也需重新审视。

title: DynEdit: Dynamic Entropy-Guided Sequential Editing for Large Language Models
comment: Accepted by main conference of NeurIPS 2026 (poster)
summary: Knowledge editing aims to update outdated or incorrect knowledge in large language models without full retraining. Existing parameter-editing methods remain limited for long-sequence knowledge: single-point editors provide insufficient coverage for extended targets, while fixed chunk-based editors distribute editing effort uniformly across rigid predefined windows, failing to prioritize difficult, information-dense tokens. In this work, we show that token entropy is closely associated with both editing difficulty and semantic importance: high-entropy regions are harder to edit and often contain key factual content. Motivated by this observation, we propose DynEdit, a dynamic framework for long-sequence knowledge editing. DynEdit uses token-level entropy to guide non-uniform sliding, increasing the coverage of difficult high-entropy regions, and further applies entropy-guided token-level optimization to strengthen updates on information-dense tokens within each editing window. Experiments on three benchmarks and two backbone models show that DynEdit consistently outperforms competitive baselines across diverse long-form editing settings, achieving gains of up to +14.0 BLEU points on challenging paraphrase queries and near-saturated semantic scores on several diverse knowledge domains.

AI.tldr: DynEdit：利用token熵引导非均匀滑窗与token级优化，实现长序列知识编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有参数编辑方法难以处理长序列知识：单点编辑器覆盖不足，固定分块编辑器在刚性窗口上均匀分配编辑资源，无法优先处理困难且信息密集的token。
AI.method: 观察到token熵与编辑难度、语义重要性相关（高熵区域更难编辑且常含关键事实）。DynEdit据此用token级熵引导非均匀滑动窗口，提高高熵难编辑区域的覆盖；并在每个编辑窗口内采用熵引导的token级优化，强化信息密集token的更新。
AI.result: 在三个基准、两个骨干模型上，DynEdit在多种长文本编辑设置下稳定优于竞争基线；困难复述查询上BLEU提升最高+14.0，多知识领域语义分数接近饱和。
AI.conclusion: 以熵作为编辑难度与语义重要性的代理信号，可有效提升长序列知识编辑的覆盖与优化精度。

title: HARP-LoRA: Hierarchy-Conditioned Rank Projection for Low-Rank Adaptation in Scientific Table Understanding
summary: Tabular data is widely used in scientific applications, where complex layouts, including multi-level headers, merged cells, captions, and footnotes, make information extraction difficult. This is particularly important in pharmacokinetics (PK), where values must be correctly associated with the drug, species, dose, administration route, unit, and experimental condition. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) reduce adaptation cost but do not explicitly incorporate relationships between table values and surrounding headers. We introduce HARP-LoRA, a hierarchy-conditioned rank projection method for low-rank adaptation in scientific table understanding. HARP-LoRA extends projected LoRA by constructing token-specific intrinsic representations from the row- and column-header hierarchies of each data token. These representations condition the low-rank down-projection, incorporating hierarchical context while keeping the pretrained model and random projection tensors frozen. We evaluate HARP-LoRA on 950 manually annotated PK tables from 587 scientific articles and on WikiTableQuestions (WikiTQ) using Llama~3.2 3B, Llama~3.1 8B, and Gemma~3 27B. With Llama~3.1 8B, HARP-LoRA achieves a PK F1-score of 57.64\% and WikiTQ accuracy of 53.15\%, improving over LoRA by 1.42 and 6.56 points, respectively. With Gemma~3 27B, it achieves the best PK F1-score of 70.63\% and WikiTQ accuracy of 56.87\%. These results use only 172K, 197K, and 547K trainable parameters, far fewer than LoRA and TableLoRA. Overall, conditioning lightweight adapters on table-header hierarchies improves extraction from scientific tables and reasoning over flatter general-domain tables while maintaining parameter efficiency. Code is available at: https://github.com/hosseinsholehrasa/HARP-LoRA

AI.tldr: 提出 HARP-LoRA，一种以表格行列表头层级为条件构建 token 级内在表示并用于调制 LoRA 低秩下投影的参数高效微调方法，在药代动力学科表与 WikiTQ 上以极少可训练参数超越 LoRA 与 TableLoRA。
AI.motivation: 科学表格存在多级表头、合并单元格、题注与脚注等复杂版式，信息抽取困难；药代动力学场景要求数值与药物、物种、剂量、给药途径、单位、实验条件正确关联。LoRA 等参数高效微调虽降低成本，但未显式建模表格数值与其周围表头之间的层级关系。
AI.method: HARP-LoRA 在 projected LoRA 基础上，为每个数据 token 依据其行表头与列表头的层级结构构造 token 特定的内在表示（hierarchy-conditioned intrinsic representation），并用这些表示对低秩下投影（down-projection）进行条件化，从而在保持预训练模型与随机投影张量冻结的前提下注入层级上下文。模型在 950 张人工标注的 PK 表格（来自 587 篇文献）与 WikiTableQuestions 上评估，基座模型为 Llama 3.2 3B、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemma 3 27B。
AI.result: Llama 3.1 8B 下 PK F1 为 57.64%、WikiTQ 准确率 53.15%，较 LoRA 分别提升 1.42 与 6.56 个百分点；Gemma 3 27B 下取得最佳 PK F1 70.63%、WikiTQ 准确率 56.87%。三个模型仅使用 172K、197K、547K 可训练参数，显著少于 LoRA 与 TableLoRA。
AI.conclusion: 以表格表头层级对轻量适配器进行条件化，可在保持参数效率的同时提升科学表格抽取与平坦表格上的推理性能。

title: ProMo3D: Probing Motion Cues in Frozen 3D Foundation Models
summary: Feed-forward 3D foundation models have recently reshaped multi-view reconstruction, yet dynamic 4D understanding still often relies on large-scale motion supervision or hand-crafted, architecture-specific heuristics. We ask whether frozen 3D foundation model tokens already encode motion-relevant information that can be exposed by lightweight readout functions, rather than re-learning motion-specific features with high-capacity decoders. Through probing on three representative backbones, we find that static--dynamic separation is decodable from frozen token representations. Our rank-restricted and spectral analyses on $π^3$X reveal that the recovered motion cues are concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace. Building on this, we propose Probing-based Motion Distillation (PMD), which converts pairwise motion-state compatibility scores against a fixed anchor token into dense motion masks. Trained on only 160 YouTube-VOS videos using a single 16 GB GPU, PMD transfers zero-shot to DAVIS, SegTrackv2, and FBMS-59 without target-benchmark fine-tuning. With multi-view pretrained geometric backbones, PMD outperforms training-free heuristics and approaches substantially heavier supervised and self-supervised methods, suggesting that motion decoding from frozen 3D foundation models can be lightweight and data-efficient.

AI.tldr: 冻结的3D基础模型token中已编码可解码的运动信息，通过轻量探针读出即可实现高效的运动分割，无需大规模运动监督或重解码器。
AI.motivation: 动态4D理解仍依赖大规模运动监督或手工设计的、与架构强耦合的启发式规则；作者质疑是否需要重新学习运动专用特征，而非直接探测冻结3D基础模型token中已有的运动相关信息。
AI.method: 在三个代表性骨架上进行探针实验，验证静动态可分性可从冻结token表示中解码；对π³X做秩受限与谱分析，发现运动线索集中于低维子空间；据此提出PMD（Probing-based Motion Distillation），将针对固定锚点token的成对运动状态兼容性分数转化为稠密运动掩码，仅用160个YouTube-VOS视频、单张16GB GPU训练。
AI.result: 无需目标基准微调即可零样本迁移至DAVIS、SegTrackv2与FBMS-59；在多视图预训练几何骨干下，PMD优于免训练启发式方法，并接近体量明显更大的有监督与自监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 从冻结3D基础模型解码运动可以做到轻量且数据高效，提示运动理解不必依赖重型解码器与大规模运动监督。

title: Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial? Revisiting Its Impact on LLM Performance
summary: Constrained decoding guarantees that Large Language Models (LLMs) produce outputs conforming to predefined formats, but is often assumed to inherently degrade reasoning. We examine this assumption through a taxonomy of three constraint types: \emph{format constraints}, which enforce output structure; \emph{validity constraints}, which mask invalid answer; and \emph{reasoning constraints}, which restrict reasoning trajectories. We theoretically show that appropriate constraints can preserve or improve performance by eliminating invalid paths. Across four model families and eleven open-source models, causal ablations on diverse benchmarks using state-of-the-art constrained decoding strategies reveal that apparent performance degradation largely stems from non-equivalent prompting and output formats rather than from decoder-level masking. Meanwhile, validity constraints improve reliability and extractability by eliminating invalid answers, while reasoning constraints can improve reasoning and, consequently, accuracy when they enforce beneficial trajectories. These findings show that the impact of constrained decoding depends on the type of constraint and the output space it removes. Our code is available.

AI.tldr: 本文系统考察“约束解码必然损害推理”这一假设，提出三类约束的分类体系，并通过理论与因果消融实验证明：性能下降主要源于提示与输出格式不等价，而非解码层掩码；有效性约束提升可靠性，推理约束可提升准确性。
AI.motivation: 约束解码虽能保证LLM输出符合预定义格式，但社区普遍认为其固有地削弱推理能力。作者希望检验这一假设是否成立，并厘清约束解码影响性能的真实机制。
AI.method: 提出约束分类体系：格式约束（强制输出结构）、有效性约束（屏蔽无效答案）、推理约束（限制推理轨迹）。理论上分析适当约束可通过消除无效路径来保持或提升性能；实验上在四个模型家族、十一个开源模型上，于多类基准上使用当前最优约束解码策略进行因果消融，区分提示与输出格式不等价、解码层掩码两种来源。
AI.result: 表观性能下降很大程度上源于提示与输出格式的不等价，而非解码层掩码本身；有效性约束通过消除无效答案提升可靠性与可提取性；推理约束在强制有益轨迹时可改善推理并提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 约束解码的影响取决于约束类型及其所移除的输出空间，而非一概损害推理；应据此重新评估约束解码的设计与使用。

title: KINESYS: Test-Time Adaptation for Reference-Based Effect Editing in Images
summary: Visual effects are often easier to demonstrate via reference than to describe in words. We study effect-reference editing, where a reference image shows a desired visual effect and language identifies which properties should guide the edit. Existing single-pass editing techniques often fail to make fine-grained edits, resulting in unintended changes to source content or deviations from the reference effect. We introduce KINESYS, a test-time adaptation framework for effect-reference editing that combines reference-aware and source-aware feedback to transfer the desired effect while preserving the composition and content of the original shot. To ensure KINESYS can produce a diverse set of edits that preserve the source, we develop a robust optimization strategy in which the generative model is fine-tuned across multiple noise samples and optimization runs. Evaluation with VLM judges, source preservation metrics (LPIPS, TPIPS), and a user study shows that KINESYS outperforms state-of-the-art image editors in source preservation; on effect transfer, it remains competitive with Nano Banana 2 and outperforms open-weight editors.

AI.tldr: 提出 KINESYS：面向"效果参考编辑"的测试时自适应框架，融合参考感知与源感知反馈，在迁移参考视觉效果的同时保持原图构图与内容，并采用多噪声样本、多轮优化运行的鲁棒优化策略，在源保持上优于SOTA图像编辑器。
AI.motivation: 视觉效果用参考图展示比文字描述更直观，但现有单次前向（single-pass）编辑方法难以做细粒度编辑：要么对源内容产生非预期改动，要么偏离参考效果。因此需要一种在测试时精调、同时兼顾参考对齐与源保真的编辑框架。
AI.method: KINESYS 采用测试时自适应（test-time adaptation）框架，以参考图指示目标视觉效果、以语言指定应依据哪些属性进行编辑；通过组合参考感知反馈与源感知反馈进行优化，实现效果迁移与构图/内容保持。为保证在保持源图前提下生成多样的编辑结果，设计鲁棒优化策略：在多个噪声样本与多次优化运行上对生成模型进行微调。
AI.result: 使用 VLM 评审、源保持指标（LPIPS、TPIPS）及用户研究进行评估：源保持方面 KINESYS 优于当前最先进的图像编辑器；效果迁移方面与 Nano Banana 2 相当（competitive），并优于开源权重编辑器。
AI.conclusion: 参考图引导的测试时自适应是实现"效果参考编辑"的有效途径；结合参考感知与源感知的双重反馈及鲁棒优化，可在不牺牲源内容与构图的前提下完成细粒度效果迁移，在源保持与效果迁移两方面均具竞争力。

title: Whispers from the Neighbors: Rethinking Caption Consensus as Inference-Time Evidence for Vision-Language Retrieval
summary: An image is rarely described only once. Retrieval benchmarks and many collections attach several captions to each picture, yet dual encoders still judge every image-caption pair in isolation. We ask what these neighboring captions contribute when a frozen encoder consults them at inference time. Fusing image similarity with similarity to an image's own captions improves text-to-image R@1 by 3.4 to 16.8 points across nine frozen encoders when the captions come from the same annotators as the queries. The gain falls to 1.9 to 7.2 points when an off-the-shelf captioner writes them, and to at most one point when they come from a different annotation source; a paraphrase-trained text encoder strengthens the text side further. A natural refinement, scoring the part of the image that the captions leave unexplained, appears to add much more under a leave-one-out evaluation. We show that this advantage arises because the correct candidate's supports are built differently from those of the negative candidates, with set size and query removal each contributing about half, and that under a fixed support index the residual reduces to a reweighting of what the captions already provide. On compositional benchmarks, the captions help by matching candidates to human descriptions of the image, without improving image-text grounding. The code is available at: https://github.com/nhatkhangcs/clip_consensus

AI.tldr: 在冻结的双编码器推理阶段引入同一图像的多条邻近描述（caption）进行相似度融合，可在文本到图像检索上显著提升R@1，但增益高度依赖描述的来源一致性；"残差"改进的优势主要来自集合构建方式造成的评估假象。
AI.motivation: 现有检索基准与图像集合常为每张图附带多条描述，但双编码器仍孤立地评判每个图文对，忽略了邻近描述所携带的可用信息。作者希望弄清：在冻结编码器推理时引入这些邻近描述究竟能带来多少收益、在什么条件下成立。
AI.method: 将图像相似度与"图像与其自身多条描述"的相似度进行融合打分（caption consensus）；在九种冻结编码器上评测；比较三种描述来源（与查询同源标注者、现成captioner、不同标注源）；并考察用释义训练的文本编码器对文本侧的增强。此外设计"对描述未解释的图像部分打分"的残差改进，并通过留一法（leave-one-out）分析、固定支撑集索引等控制实验拆解其增益来源。
AI.result: 同源描述下文本到图像R@1提升3.4–16.8点；现成captioner生成时为1.9–7.2点；不同标注源时最多约1点；释义训练的文本编码器进一步强化文本侧。残差改进在留一法下看似增益更大，但该优势源于正候选与负候选的支撑集构建方式不同，集合大小与查询移除各贡献约一半；固定支撑集索引后，残差退化为对已有描述信息的重加权。在组合性基准上，描述的帮助在于将候选与人类对图像的描述相匹配，而非改善图文grounding。
AI.conclusion: 邻近描述在冻结编码器上是一类廉价且有效的推理期信号，但其收益对描述来源与查询分布的一致性极为敏感，且不能提升真正的图文对齐能力；所谓残差增益在很大程度上是评估协议造成的假象，需以严格的支撑集控制来审视此类"共识"方法的真实效果。

title: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
summary: Training a spatial VLM to answer which side an object lies on does not require it to preserve the metric displacement that determines that answer, while supervision for a distance estimate may leave categorical relations largely unconstrained. When post-training emphasizes one readout, improvements can therefore concentrate on that interface while transfer to others remains weak or even degrades; we call this observed specialization interface lock-in. ChronoReplay addresses it by replaying heterogeneous spatial supervision as chronologically ordered episodes, retaining source-native targets, and balancing supervision across families. Under the same observation access, a single ChronoReplay checkpoint improves OVO-S-Bench, OST-Bench, and UCS-Bench together, including a 13.41-point gain on OST-Bench, and achieves the highest three-benchmark mean among the supervision settings compared here. Same-data controls further separate the ingredients of this transfer: answer serialization redistributes gains across OST and UCS, family-balanced learning improves over ordinary joint SFT and natural turn weighting, and chronological replay exceeds a shifted-order control by about 2.41 OST points across two paired seeds. Adaptive frame selection then changes evidence access while keeping the trained model fixed, providing an additional inference-time gain at lower visual cost. Streaming spatial performance depends on what distinctions supervision preserves, how heterogeneous histories are organized during learning, and what causal evidence inference makes available at test time.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出空间VLM后训练存在“接口锁定”现象，并提出ChronoReplay，以时间有序片段重放异构空间监督，在单检查点上同时提升OVO-S-Bench、OST-Bench与UCS-Bench。
AI.motivation: 训练空间VLM回答“物体在哪一侧”并不要求模型保留决定该答案的度量位移，而距离监督也可能几乎不约束类别关系。因此当后训练侧重某一读出接口时，提升会集中在该接口，向其他接口的迁移微弱甚至退化，作者称之为“interface lock-in（接口锁定）”。
AI.method: ChronoReplay：将异构空间监督以按时间排序的episode形式重放，保留各数据源原生目标（source-native targets），并对不同监督族进行平衡；其对照实验包括答案序列化、族平衡学习与普通联合SFT/自然轮次加权、以及打乱顺序的对照。推理阶段固定模型，采用自适应帧选择改变证据获取。
AI.result: 相同观测访问条件下，单个ChronoReplay检查点同时提升OVO-S-Bench、OST-Bench与UCS-Bench，其中OST-Bench提升13.41分，并在所比较的监督设置中取得三基准平均最高。同数据对照显示：答案序列化在OST与UCS间重新分配增益；族平衡学习优于普通联合SFT与自然轮次加权；时间重放较打乱顺序对照在两个配对随机种子上平均高出约2.41个OST点。自适应帧选择在固定模型下带来额外推理期收益且视觉成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 流式空间性能取决于三点：监督保留了哪些区分、学习时异构历史如何组织、以及测试时推理可获得何种因果证据。

title: CropReward: A Human-Preference Benchmark and Reward Model for Aesthetic Image Cropping
summary: Aesthetic image cropping (AIC) aims to improve image composition and aesthetic quality by removing extraneous or distracting content. Over the past decade, AIC methods have evolved from specialized vision models to multimodal large language models(MLLMs). Reliable evaluation that reflects human preferences is essential for benchmarking AIC methods and guiding model optimization. However, the current AIC evaluation relies largely on geometry-based metrics such as intersection over union (IoU), as well as image aesthetic assessment(IAA) models. Although inconsistencies with human preferences have long been observed, the robustness and reliability of these evaluation criteria remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we first construct CropBench, a large-scale benchmark comprising 106,995 human preference pairs for 1,019 images, with each candidate set containing the original image and candidate crops produced by 14 AIC methods. A systematic study on CropBench reveals that the existing criteria, ranging from IoU to off-the-shelf IAA assessment models, only exhibit limited alignment with human preferences. Building upon CropBench, we further propose CropReward, an MLLM-based reward model that evaluates a candidate crop by comparing with the original uncropped image and outputs a score indicating explicit aesthetic improvement or degradation relative to the original. In addition, we employ CropReward to construct CropReward-300k, the largest AIC dataset to date, and further develop CropAlign, a preference-aligned AIC model trained solely with CropReward supervision, without human-annotated crop boxes. Experimental results demonstrate that CropReward aligns with human preferences significantly better than existing criteria. CropAlign also surpasses the state-of-the-art AIC methods, demonstrating the advantage of CropReward in guiding AIC model optimization.

AI.tldr: 构建CropBench大规模人类偏好基准，揭示现有AIC评价指标（IoU、IAA模型）与人偏好对齐有限；提出MLLM奖励模型CropReward及数据集CropReward-300k，并训练偏好对齐裁剪模型CropAlign，性能超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 评价 AIC 方法依赖于 IoU 等几何指标与图像美学评估（IAA）模型，与人类偏好不一致的问题长期存在但缺乏系统验证；需建立可靠、反映人类偏好的评测基准与优化信号。
AI.method: ①构建 CropBench：1,019 张图像、106,995 条人类偏好对，每候选集含原图与 14 种 AIC 方法的裁剪结果；②在其上系统评估 IoU 与现成 IAA 模型的对齐性；③提出 CropReward，基于 MLLM 的奖励模型，将候选裁剪与原图对比，输出美学提升/退化的显式分数；④用其构建 CropReward-300k 数据集，并据此训练仅依赖奖励监督、无需人工标注裁剪框的 CropAlign 模型。
AI.result: CropBench 上现有准则与人偏好一致性有限；CropReward 与人类偏好对齐显著优于现有指标；CropAlign 在无人工框标注下超越 SOTA AIC 方法。
AI.conclusion: 几何指标与 IAA 模型不足以作为 AIC 可靠评价；以 MLLM 奖励模型作为可扩展的偏好代理，可同时提升评测可靠性与模型优化效果，为 AIC 提供数据—评测—训练闭环范式。

title: MIS-VQA: An Annotation-Driven Surgical Vision-Language Dataset for Complex Surgical Understanding
summary: Modern surgical AI increasingly requires multimodal understanding rather than isolated perception, yet existing datasets remain largely limited to single-task supervision such as recognition or templated question answering. Current medical VQA resources often rely on synthetic templates, lack natural descriptive supervision, or provide sparse annotations that hinder reasoning about spatial relations and procedural context. We introduce MIS-VQA, a surgical vision-language dataset generated through an annotation-driven pipeline that converts heterogeneous surgical annotations into structured textual scene representations. Using EndoVis18 and CholecT50, we transform phase, instrument, interaction, triplet, and segmentation labels into unified contexts that guide large language models to generate clinically coherent question-answer pairs. MIS-VQA supports four response types-concise and detailed descriptions, perception-level grounding, and multi-step reasoning-enabling hierarchical evaluation from atomic visual grounding to compositional reasoning. To address annotation sparsity, we incorporate confidence-filtered segmentation and cross-annotation consistency checks, enabling spatially grounded supervision at scale. MIS-VQA establishes a unified benchmark for surgical vision-language understanding with spatial supervision and multi-tier reasoning evaluation. To demonstrate its utility, we introduce LLaVA-SurgXpert, a family of surgical vision-language models with visual encoders to analyze how visual representations influence multimodal reasoning. Experiments show consistent improvements over existing surgical VQA baselines while revealing capability gaps between perceptual grounding and higher-level reasoning hidden in prior benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出手术视觉语言数据集MIS-VQA（基于EndoVis18与CholecT50，将异构标注转化为结构化文本场景表示，经LLM生成四类问答），并构建LLaVA-SurgXpert模型族作为基准验证。
AI.motivation: 现有手术AI数据集多为单任务监督（识别或模板化VQA），医学VQA资源依赖合成模板、缺乏自然描述性监督、标注稀疏，难以支撑空间关系与流程上下文的推理。
AI.method: 采用标注驱动的流水线，将phase、器械、交互、triplet、分割等异质标注统一为结构化上下文，引导LLM生成临床连贯的QA对；支持简洁/详细描述、感知级定位、多步推理四类回答，并引入置信度过滤分割与跨标注一致性校验缓解稀疏性；同时提出LLaVA-SurgXpert系列模型（不同视觉编码器）分析视觉表征对多模态推理的影响。
AI.result: MIS-VQA提供具备空间监督与多层级推理评测的统一基准；LLaVA-SurgXpert相较现有手术VQA基线取得一致提升，并揭示此前基准掩盖的感知定位与高层推理之间的能力差距。
AI.conclusion: MIS-VQA可作为手术视觉语言理解的统一评测基准，实现从原子视觉定位到组合推理的层级评估；视觉编码器选择显著影响多模态推理表现，感知与推理能力并不等价。

title: Timing Matters Twice: When to Query and When to Skip in Flow-Matching On-Policy Distillation
summary:
On-policy distillation (OPD) enables flow-matching models to acquire complementary capabilities from specialized teachers through supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, different evaluation dimensions, such as aesthetics and OCR accuracy, and different tasks, such as image generation and editing, emphasize different aspects of the denoising process, suggesting that their effective supervision may occur at different stages. Existing methods typically select supervision states from predefined timestep distributions, which may overlook these phase-dependent differences and incur unnecessary computational overhead. This motivates two critical timing decisions: when to adaptively query teachers for effective supervision based on the evolving generative process, and when to skip the remaining rollout to avoid redundant computation.
  In this paper, we introduce PhaseOPD, a phase-aware query-and-skip framework that identifies generative phases online from revisions of predicted-clean latents, using existing student velocity predictions without additional model evaluations. For each task-assigned teacher, PhaseOPD selects a supervision state based on its phase preference and skips the unused rollout suffix once all query decisions are finalized, preserving the single-query velocity-distillation objective. On SD3.5-M, PhaseOPD executes only 5.56 of 16 rollout positions per local batch, reducing training time by 41.3% relative to DanceOPD while improving Aesthetic, GenEval, and OCR scores.

AI.tldr: PhaseOPD：一种阶段感知的查询-跳过框架，用学生速度预测在线识别生成阶段，为每个教师选择最优监督时刻并跳过无用rollout，在SD3.5-M上仅执行5.56/16个rollout位置，训练时间较DanceOPD减少41.3%，同时提升Aesthetic、GenEval与OCR得分。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏（OPD）从预设时间步分布中选取监督状态，忽视了不同评价维度（美学、OCR准确率）和不同任务（生成、编辑）对去噪过程不同阶段的侧重，导致监督时机失配并产生冗余计算开销。
AI.method: PhaseOPD利用学生已有的速度预测，基于预测干净潜变量的变化量在线识别生成阶段，无需额外模型评估；针对每个任务指定的教师，按其阶段偏好选择监督状态；在所有查询决策确定后跳过剩余的rollout后缀，从而保留单次查询的速度蒸馏目标。
AI.result: 在SD3.5-M上，PhaseOPD每个本地批次仅执行16个rollout位置中的5.56个，训练时间相对DanceOPD降低41.3%，同时Aesthetic、GenEval和OCR分数均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 监督时机应与生成阶段及任务/评价维度匹配，阶段感知的查询与跳过机制可在提升多维度生成质量的同时显著降低OPD训练成本。

title: MuSTEL: A Large-Scale Multilingual Synthetic Text-Line Image Dataset for OCR
summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) systems depend strongly on the scale and diversity of their training data. One approach to document OCR first analyzes the page layout and extracts text-line images, which are then transcribed by a recognition model. Multilingual line-level recognition involving Persian, Arabic, and English presents additional challenges because different writing directions, fonts, and styles may coexist within a single line. This paper introduces MuSTEL, a large-scale synthetic multilingual OCR dataset containing more than 14.5 million annotated text-line images, organized into a training partition and predefined small and large test sets. Samples are generated from natural-language corpora, including multilingual content already present in the source texts. The generation framework incorporates capability-aware font selection, within-line font and style changes, mixed-direction text rendering, highlighting, and underlining. A validated repository of 2,009 font files from 711 families supports broad typographic coverage, while varied backgrounds, blur, geometric distortion, skew, stroke width, and image save quality provide diverse document-like appearances. Statistical analysis characterizes the dataset's language composition, transcription lengths, lexical and character-sequence diversity, image dimensions, typography, and rendering conditions. MuSTEL provides a resource for training and evaluating multilingual line-level OCR systems and investigating recognition robustness across languages, writing directions, and visual conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MuSTEL，一个大规模合成多语种 OCR 数据集，包含超过 1450 万张标注文本行图像，覆盖波斯语、阿拉伯语与英语，支持混合书写方向、行内字体/样式变化及多种退化条件，用于训练与评估行级多语种 OCR 系统。
AI.motivation: 行级 OCR 性能高度依赖训练数据的规模与多样性；现有的波斯语、阿拉伯语与英语多语种场景中，同一文本行内可能并存不同书写方向、字体与样式，这类复杂情况缺乏大规模标注资源，制约了多语种行级识别系统的训练与鲁棒性评估。
AI.method: 构建合成数据生成框架 MuSTEL：基于自然语言语料（含源文本中已有的多语种内容）生成文本行样本；采用能力感知的字体选择策略，支持行内字体与样式切换、混合方向渲染、高亮与下划线；使用经校验的字体库（2,009 个字体文件、711 个字族）保证排版覆盖度；并施加多样背景、模糊、几何畸变、倾斜、笔画宽度变化与图像压缩质量等退化以模拟文档外观。数据划分为训练集与预定义的小/大测试集，并进行语言构成、转写长度、词汇与字符序列多样性、图像尺寸、排版与渲染条件的统计分析。
AI.result: 产出超过 1450 万张标注文本行图像的大规模合成数据集，配备训练分区及大小两套测试集；统计分析刻画了其语言组成、转写长度分布、词汇与字符序列多样性、图像尺寸、排版多样性以及渲染条件分布，显示其在语种、书写方向与视觉条件上具有较广覆盖。
AI.conclusion: MuSTEL 为多语种行级 OCR 的训练与评估提供了规模化资源，可用于研究跨语种、跨书写方向及不同视觉条件下的识别鲁棒性。

title: Intuition with Evidence: Adaptive Dual Memory for Multimodal Agents
summary: As multimodal agents engage in sustained interactions, long-term memory serves two distinct but complementary functions: fine-grained evidence recall and internalized interpretation for global understanding. Although episodic and latent memory address these demands through explicit historical records and internalized experience, neither paradigm alone can accommodate the diverse memory affinities across tasks, owing to limitations in episodic evidence coverage and integration, and in latent factual grounding. To bridge this divide, we propose a dual-memory framework, unifying a model-native latent memory as an intuitive prior with a multi-indexed episodic memory for exact evidence reconstruction via retrieval-conditioned joint alignment. At inference, the framework adaptively composes these memories through a training-free routing mechanism driven by Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) sensitivity and confidence proxies for query-dependent memory affinity. Extensive evaluations across multimodal benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, outperforming single-paradigm baselines overall (+4.67\% over vanilla Episodic), with further analysis highlighting episodic strengths in evidence-localized tasks and latent contributions to integrating dispersed information and compensating for imperfect retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出双记忆框架，将模型原生潜在记忆作为直觉先验、多索引情节记忆用于精确证据重建，并通过基于JSD敏感性与置信度代理的无训练路由实现自适应记忆组合，多模态基准上整体优于单范式基线（较vanilla Episodic +4.67%）。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体在长时交互中，长期记忆需同时承担细粒度证据召回与面向全局理解的内化解释两种互补功能。情节记忆（显式历史记录）与潜在记忆（内化经验）各自存在局限：前者证据覆盖与整合不足，后者缺乏事实落地；且不同任务对记忆范式的亲和度各异，单一范式无法适配。
AI.method: 构建双记忆框架：以模型原生潜在记忆作为直觉先验，以多索引情节记忆支持精确证据重建，二者通过检索条件化的联合对齐（retrieval-conditioned joint alignment）统一。推理阶段采用免训练路由机制，由Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）敏感性与置信度代理驱动，按查询自适应的记忆亲和度动态组合两类记忆。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准上取得SOTA，整体优于单范式基线，较vanilla Episodic提升4.67%；分析显示情节记忆在证据定位类任务上占优，潜在记忆有助于整合分散信息并补偿不完美的检索。
AI.conclusion: 双记忆互补优于任一单范式，检索条件化对齐与基于JSD敏感性的免训练路由可有效实现查询自适应的记忆组合，为多模态长时记忆提供统一方案。

title: LegoOcc++: Towards Consistent Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction is important for embodied agents operating in complex environments whose semantic categories extend beyond fixed taxonomies. While recent studies have explored open-vocabulary occupancy in outdoor driving scenarios, indoor environments remain challenging due to dense occlusions, complex geometry, and fine-grained long-tailed semantics. To reduce the need for expensive voxel-level semantic annotations, we study a geometry-only supervision setting requiring only binary occupancy labels. We build upon Language-Embedded Gaussians as a unified representation coupling 3D geometry with language-aligned semantics. For geometry learning, we introduce an opacity-aware Poisson-based Gaussian-to-Occupancy formulation that enables stable volumetric aggregation under binary occupancy supervision. For semantic learning, we render Gaussian features into images and align them with a frozen open-vocabulary model, together with Progressive Temperature Decay to reduce feature mixing during Gaussian splatting. Building on this framework, we further introduce Instance-Level Semantic Consistency to alleviate fragmented object predictions, and Covisibility-Aware Support-View Selection to provide informative and less redundant multi-view semantic supervision. We also extend our framework to outdoor driving scenarios to evaluate its generality across substantially different environments. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves strong open-vocabulary occupancy performance, validating the effectiveness and generality of our framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/JuIvyy/LegoOcc.

AI.tldr: 提出LegoOcc，以语言嵌入高斯为统一表示，在仅用二值占据标注的几何监督下实现室内外开放词汇3D占据预测。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇3D占据预测对复杂环境中的具身智能体很重要，但室内场景存在稠密遮挡、复杂几何与细粒度长尾语义等挑战；同时体素级语义标注昂贵，因此探索仅依赖二值占据标签的几何监督设定。
AI.method: 基于Language-Embedded Gaussians统一耦合几何与语言对齐语义：几何端提出不透明度感知的Poisson式Gaussian-to-Occupancy公式，在二值占据监督下实现稳定体素聚合；语义端将高斯特征渲染为图像并与冻结的开放词汇模型对齐，配合渐进温度衰减缓解splatting中的特征混合；进一步引入实例级语义一致性以缓解物体预测碎片化，以及共视感知支撑视图选择以提供信息量高、冗余低的多视图监督；并扩展至室外驾驶场景。
AI.result: 在室内与室外基准上的大量实验表明方法取得较强的开放词汇占据性能，验证了框架的有效性与通用性。
AI.conclusion: 语言嵌入高斯可作为几何-语义统一表示，在弱几何监督下有效支撑室内外开放词汇占据预测；代码将开源于github.com/JuIvyy/LegoOcc。

title: Patch-Derived or Register Tokens? Comparing Variable-Length Image Tokenizers
summary: Image tokenizers convert pixels into compact latent sequences for efficient generative modeling. Most approaches arrange latents on a downsampled two-dimensional grid, tying sequence length to image resolution. We compare two variable-length strategies: computationally efficient patch-derived tokens, which inherit explicit spatial organization, and more demanding register tokens, which have no predefined spatial layout. Our reconstruction results reveal that patch-derived tokens perform substantially better under extreme compression, whereas register tokens achieve slightly better reconstruction quality at intermediate budgets. At high token budgets, both approaches achieve similar reconstruction quality. For downstream generative tasks, register tokens outperform patch-derived tokens. Adding representation alignment with external pretrained visual encoders substantially improves the generative performance of patch-derived tokens, allowing them to match or outperform register tokens depending on the token budget. We further find that both approaches learn spatially localized representations. Patch-derived tokens largely retain their explicitly imposed spatial organization, while register tokens develop an implicit two-dimensional spatial structure despite having no predefined layout. Representation alignment reduces this spatial organizational constraint, enabling individual tokens to exert a stronger non-local influence.

AI.tldr: 比较两种可变长图像tokenizer（patch派生token与register token）在不同token预算下的重建与生成表现，并分析表达对齐的作用及空间结构特性。
AI.motivation: 主流图像tokenizer将latent排布在下采样二维网格上，使序列长度与图像分辨率绑定。为实现可变长、脱离分辨率约束的token序列，需比较不同latent组织方式（有显式空间布局 vs. 无预定义布局）对重建与生成的影响。
AI.method: 对比两类可变长策略：(1) 计算高效的patch派生token，继承显式空间组织；(2) 计算开销更大的register token，无预定义空间布局。在不同token预算下评估重建质量；在下游生成任务上比较生成性能；并引入与外部预训练视觉编码器的表达对齐；最后分析两类token的空间表示局部性与二维结构。
AI.result: 极端压缩下patch派生token重建显著更优；中等预算下register token重建略好；高预算下二者重建质量相近。下游生成中register token优于patch派生token。加入表达对齐后，patch派生token生成性能大幅提升，可依token预算追平或超越register token。两者均学到空间局部化表示：patch派生token基本保留显式空间组织，register token虽无预定义布局却自发形成隐式二维空间结构；表达对齐会削弱这种空间组织约束，使单个token具有更强的非局部影响。
AI.conclusion: token的空间布局预定义并非生成性能的必要条件；register token可自发涌现隐式二维结构。表达对齐是提升有显式布局token生成表现的有效手段，并能松解空间组织约束、增强token的非局部作用，为可变长图像tokenizer的设计提供依据。

title: Spatially-Aware Self-Organizing Graph Autoencoders via Localized Hebbian Learning
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the UBMK conference (not presented)
summary: Traditional autoencoders rely on static network architectures to learn latent representations. Recently we suggested a dynamic architecture inspired by Hebbian plasticity, enabling topological self-organization among convolutional feature maps (R. Koç et al., Proceedings of the SIU, 2026). Early implementations of this paradigm infer relationships among feature maps using global average pooling and model their interactions through scalar-valued connections. This approach falls short to fully exploit the underlying spatial information, embedded in input images. Furthermore, abrupt transitions between different loss functions and training dynamics can introduce representation shocks, leading to unstable feature learning. In this paper, we introduce a Spatially-Aware Self-Organizing Graph Autoencoder (S-LooM) to address these structural bottlenecks. By using spatial cross-correlation, and spatial kernels, S-LooM establishes dynamic connections among feature maps. We replace static scalar message passing of autoencoders with learnable spatial kernels and eliminate high-frequency deconvolutional artifacts observed in decoders using nearest-neighbor upsampling. Via a soft-blending training curriculum, the latent topology aligns smoothly during training. Our experiments show that S-LooM yields a more stable topology, compared to the state of the art dynamic architectures. Meaning, the graph structure that emerge has more resistance to feature entanglement and noise. It forms functional communities responsible for visual attributes, such as illumination, shape and texture even under high connection densities.

AI.tldr: 提出S-LooM——一种空间感知的自组织图自编码器，用空间互相关与可学习空间核替代标量消息传递，配合最近邻上采样与软混合训练课程，获得更稳定的潜在拓扑。
AI.motivation: 既有Hebbian式动态架构（Koç等，SIU 2026）通过全局平均池化推断特征图关系并以标量连接建模交互，损失了输入图像的空间信息；同时损失函数与训练动态的突变会引发表征冲击，导致特征学习不稳定。
AI.method: 1) 以空间互相关与空间核建立特征图间的动态连接；2) 用可学习空间核替换自编码器中静态标量消息传递；3) 解码端采用最近邻上采样，消除高频反卷积伪影；4) 引入软混合（soft-blending）训练课程，使潜在拓扑在训练中平滑对齐。
AI.result: 相较当前先进动态架构，S-LooM获得更稳定的拓扑结构；形成的图结构对特征纠缠与噪声更具抵抗力，并在高连接密度下仍能形成对应光照、形状、纹理等视觉属性的功能社区。
AI.conclusion: 以空间感知的核化连接与渐进式训练课程，可有效缓解静态架构与标量连接的瓶颈，实现更稳定、可解释的自组织潜在图表示。

title: Understanding Jev-Style System One Models: Does Structure Reduce Selection Bias?
summary: Selection bias in large language models (LLMs) can persist despite instructions to ignore presentation order or prompts that elicit reasoning. Recent efforts to reproduce Jev-style System One behavior have produced a growing family of models that predict probabilities directly over supplied candidates. Yet systematic comparisons of selection bias across Jev versions, Jev reproductions, and generative LLMs remain limited in multi-option tasks. This leaves a central question: does Jev-style decision structure reduce selection bias? We address this question with a simple test that shuffles options while keeping question and candidate content fixed. Across two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs, we trace individual answers through eight presentations and compare them with fixed-order repetition. On our primary collection of 1,700 questions from two benchmarks, Jev's accuracy varies by less than two percentage points, yet its cumulative failure set expands by 27--29\% relative to the original order, with first failures continuing into the final presentation. This loss of initial successes is substantially larger than under fixed-order repetition, even for highly repeatable Jev reproductions. Nor does Jev show a general advantage over the LLM baselines in preserving correct choices. Aggregation offers limited protection: voting yields modest gains for Jev, while even unanimous answers are frequently wrong. These results expose a gap between repeatable decisions and decisions that remain correct across equivalent presentations, showing why stable accuracy alone cannot establish resistance to selection bias.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过固定题干与候选内容、仅打乱选项顺序的简单测试，系统比较了两代Jev模型、十二个Jev复现模型与六个生成式LLM的多选项选择偏差。结果显示Jev在打乱顺序下总体准确率变化不足2个百分点，但累计失败集合相对原始顺序扩大27–29%，首选项失效现象持续存在，且并不优于生成式LLM；投票等聚合手段保护有限，即使全票一致也常出错。
AI.motivation: LLM在指令要求忽略呈现顺序或显式推理的情况下仍存在选择偏差；尽管出现了以直接预测候选概率为特征的Jev式"系统一"模型家族，但跨Jev版本、Jev复现模型与生成式LLM在多选项任务上的选择偏差缺乏系统比较，核心问题是：Jev式决策结构能否降低选择偏差。
AI.method: 采用"打乱选项、固定题干与候选内容"的受控测试：在两个评测基准的1700道题上，追踪两代Jev、十二个Jev复现模型和六个生成式LLM在8种呈现顺序下的个体答案，并与固定顺序重复作答进行对照，分析累计失败集合与初始成功项在后续呈现中的存续情况，同时评估投票等聚合策略的效果。
AI.result: Jev总体准确率随呈现顺序变化不足2个百分点，但累计失败集合相对原始顺序扩大27–29%，且首次失败在最后一种呈现中仍在继续；这种"初始成功丢失"显著大于固定顺序重复的情况，即便对高可复现性的Jev复现模型亦然。Jev在保持正确选择上也未表现出相对LLM基线的普遍优势；投票仅带来有限提升，全票一致的答案仍频繁出错。
AI.conclusion: 可重复的决策不等于在等价呈现下仍保持正确的决策：仅凭稳定准确率无法证明模型对选择偏差具有鲁棒性，需要以跨等价呈现的一致性作为评估选择偏差的必要指标。

title: RSKD: Grounding Semantic Consistency in Driving VLMs via Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation can transfer large multimodal models to compact models for autonomous driving, but uniform token-level matching can dilute planning-relevant semantics and amplify teacher errors. We propose RSKD, a semantic-consistency-guided distillation framework that routes supervision according to both the task importance of an answer phrase and its semantic consistency with the teacher prediction. Task-critical semantic phrases are localized in the ground-truth answer, and a phrase-level consistency score controls the balance between Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) distillation and ground-truth supervision. Teacher information is emphasized only where it is semantically consistent, while semantically inconsistent phrases receive stronger ground-truth supervision. We evaluate RSKD on DrivingVQA, LingoQA, and MapLMv2. RSKD improves over the compared student-based baselines on DrivingVQA and LingoQA and remains competitive on MapLMv2.

AI.tldr: 提出RSKD语义一致性引导蒸馏框架，按答案短语的任务重要性与师生语义一致性路由监督信号，缓解统一token级匹配稀释规划语义及放大教师错误的问题。
AI.motivation: 将大型多模态模型蒸馏到自动驾驶紧凑模型时，统一的token级匹配会稀释与规划相关的语义，并放大教师模型的错误。
AI.method: 在真实答案中定位任务关键的语义短语；计算短语级一致性分数，用于控制JSD蒸馏与真实标签监督之间的平衡——仅在与教师语义一致的短语上强化教师信息，语义不一致的短语则施以更强的真实标签监督。
AI.result: 在DrivingVQA、LingoQA和MapLMv2上评估；在DrivingVQA与LingoQA上优于所比较的学生基线，在MapLMv2上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 语义一致性引导的短语级监督路由可有效提升自动驾驶多模态蒸馏效果，避免无差别token匹配带来的语义稀释与教师错误传播。

title: Good Rankings, Poor Choices? Rethinking Language-Only Vision-Language Model Selection
summary: Language-Only Vision-Language Model Selection (LOVM) aims to identify the Vision-Language Model (VLM) with the highest zero-shot accuracy on a target task using only textual information. We revisit the existing LOVM evaluation protocol and argue that ranking metrics, such as top-5 recall and Kendall's rank correlation, do not directly assess the performance of the selected model. We therefore adopt simple regret (SR), defined as the performance gap between the best and selected models, and introduce Outlier-Robust Normalized Regret (ORNR) to account for the varying performance ranges across tasks while reducing sensitivity to outliers. Building on this revised evaluation protocol, we propose Target-Conditioned Expected Source Regret (TC-ESR), a training-free method that selects the model with the lowest similarity-weighted mean regret across source tasks. Across 22 target tasks and 43 VLMs, TC-ESR achieves the lowest mean SR and ORNR among all compared methods. Separately, we identify two sources of target performance leakage in the prior ranking-based evaluation protocol and provide corrections that remove both.

AI.tldr: 论文重新审视仅用文本信息的视觉语言模型选择（LOVM）评测协议，指出排序类指标不能直接反映所选模型性能，改用简单遗憾（SR）并提出离群鲁棒归一化遗憾（ORNR），同时提出免训练方法 TC-ESR，在22个目标任务、43个VLM上取得最低平均SR与ORNR，并修复了原协议中的两处目标性能泄漏。
AI.motivation: 现有LOVM评测采用top-5 recall、Kendall秩相关等排序指标，衡量的是模型排序质量而非被选中模型的实际表现；同时原排序式协议存在目标性能泄漏问题，导致评价失真。
AI.method: 引入简单遗憾（SR），即最优模型与所选模型之间的性能差；提出离群鲁棒归一化遗憾（ORNR），在考虑任务间性能区间差异的同时降低对离群值的敏感性。在此基础上提出免训练的Target-Conditioned Expected Source Regret（TC-ESR）：在源任务上以相似度加权计算各模型的平均遗憾，选择遗憾最低者；并识别与修正两处目标性能泄漏。
AI.result: 在22个目标任务、43个VLM的设置下，TC-ESR在所有对比方法中取得最低的平均SR与ORNR；修正后的协议消除了两处目标性能泄漏。
AI.conclusion: LOVM应直接以选择决策的性能损失为评价目标而非排序质量；TC-ESR作为一种无需训练、基于目标条件化源任务遗憾的选择方法，在该评价下表现最优，且原协议需做泄漏修正。

title: Regional prediction of hematoma expansion from non-contrast computed tomography in spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage patients
summary: Background The combination of hematoma location, expansion and final volume influence neurological outcome. The aim of this study was to derive and validate a quantitative and interpretable region-based NCCT image feature model for predicting hematoma expansion. Methods The Ethnic/Racial Variations of Intracerebral Hemorrhage(ERICH) study was used for derivation and the Virtual International Trials in Stroke Archive(VISTA) was used for validation. NCCT images at presentation and 24+/-6hours were pre-processed, segmented and categorized into lobar, basal ganglia or thalamic regions. Hematoma expansion was defined by region and according to its effect on clinical outcome. Transport-based morphometry (TBM) produced a unique transport-based representation from each NCCT hematoma image. Linear classifiers applied to transport representations were used to derive a predictive model. The regional TBM model's performance was compared to alternate methods using AUROC analyses. Results The derivation dataset included 574 patients, comprising 162 lobar, 257 basal ganglia and 155 thalamic hematomas. The validation dataset included 196 patients, comprising 31 lobar, 119 basal ganglia and 46 thalamic hematomas. A combined regional model predicted hematoma expansion in the validation dataset with an AUROC of 0.787. The principal image features which varied by location were size, heterogeneity, eccentricity and density distribution towards the hematoma periphery. The regional TBM model outperformed alternative clinician based and machine-learning methods. Conclusions TBM discriminated and visualized regional features of hematoma expansion from presentation NCCT scans. This provides preliminary evidence for regional radiographic features of hematoma expansion. It has the potential to improve hematoma expansion prediction and understanding of hematoma expansion pathophysiology.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于ERICH队列建模、VISTA队列验证，提出按血肿部位（脑叶、基底节、丘脑）划分的影像组学特征模型（TBM），用于预测脑出血血肿扩大，验证集AUROC达0.787，优于临床医生模型与机器学习方法。
AI.motivation: 血肿部位、扩大及最终体积共同影响神经功能结局，但缺乏可定量、可解释、按解剖分区建模的血肿扩大预测工具。
AI.method: 以ERICH研究为推导队列、VISTA为验证队列；对初诊及24±6小时NCCT进行预处理、分割并划分为脑叶、基底节、丘脑三个区域；按区域及临床结局定义血肿扩大；采用基于输运的形态学方法（Transport-based Morphometry, TBM）生成血肿影像的输运表示，在其上应用线性分类器构建区域预测模型，并以AUROC与临床医生评估及替代机器学习方法比较。
AI.result: 推导集574例（脑叶162、基底节257、丘脑155），验证集196例（脑叶31、基底节119、丘脑46）；联合区域模型在验证集预测血肿扩大AUROC为0.787；随部位变化的主要影像特征为大小、异质性、偏心度及血肿周边密度分布；区域TBM模型优于临床医生及替代机器学习方法。
AI.conclusion: TBM可区分并可视化初诊NCCT中与血肿扩大相关的区域影像特征，为血肿扩大的区域影像学标志提供初步证据，有望提升预测能力并加深对血肿扩大病理生理机制的理解。

title: Uncertainty Evaluation to Support Safety of the Intended Functionality Analysis for Determining the Applicability of Performance Targets Across Triggering Conditions in ML-Based LiDAR Object Detection
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. Extended version of the VEHITS 2026 conference paper (doi:10.5220/0014967200004030). Submitted for journal publication. Code and recorded results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23495356
summary: For safety of the intended functionality (SOTIF) analysis according to ISO 21448, a machine learning object detector for light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point clouds can meet a performance target, a limit on the mean per-frame share of wrong detections among accepted detections, by rejecting detections above an uncertainty threshold. A threshold selected on data of one condition carries a statistical guarantee only for data distributed like its selection data, whereas SOTIF analysis covers every triggering condition. This paper presents an uncertainty evaluation in which the threshold is transferred into a triggering condition, a test decides at a stated error probability whether the target is applicable there, not applicable or not determined, and a lower bound counts the independent units an applicable outcome requires. For PointPillars ensembles on KITTI and nuScenes, counted in recorded sequences, as the dependence between frames requires, neither dataset held enough independent units for any target limit, and no transfer had a not applicable outcome. Counted in frames, the same data gave not applicable outcomes at limits fixed in advance after transfers into far distance, into rain and between two separately trained detectors, thresholds that met the target limit after a transfer rejected most correct detections, and in rain the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve did not decrease. A performance target met under one condition therefore counts as evidence under a triggering condition only after a test there, reported with its share of accepted correct detections and its number of independent recorded sequences.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一套面向SOTIF（ISO 21448）的LiDAR目标检测不确定性评估方法：将基于阈值的性能指标迁移为触发条件，在给定错误概率下判定目标在该条件下"适用/不适用/未确定"，并以独立记录序列为单位统计证据。
AI.motivation: ISO 21448的SOTIF分析需覆盖所有触发条件，但按某一条件下的数据选出的不确定性阈值只对该分布下的统计保证有效；帧间相关使按帧计数夸大了证据量，故需检验阈值在触发条件下的可迁移性与证据充分性。
AI.method: 以PointPillars集成模型在KITTI和nuScenes上实验：将阈值迁移至远距离、降雨及两个独立训练检测器之间的条件；用统计检验在给定错误概率下给出适用/不适用/未确定三种结论；按记录的独立序列（而非帧）计数并计算所需独立单元下界。
AI.result: 按序列计数时，两个数据集均无足够独立单元支撑任何目标限值，且无迁移得出"不适用"；按帧计数则在预先设定限值下出现"不适用"结论。迁移后满足目标的阈值会拒绝大量正确检测；降雨条件下ROC-AUC并未下降。
AI.conclusion: 某条件下达标的性能目标只有经该触发条件上的检验后，才能作为该条件下的证据，且报告须给出被接受正确检测的占比与独立记录序列数。

title: DriveUniTok: A Unified Multimodal Tokenizer for Driving World-Action Models
summary: World models are emerging as a fundamental component of policy learning for real-world agents, enabling agents to predict future world states and plan actions within a learned representation of the dynamic environment. Existing approaches, however, often model appearance, metric geometry represented by projected LiDAR depth, and ego motion either partially or independently, overlooking the fact that these modalities are different projections of a shared underlying world state. This separation can lead to information loss and cross-modal inconsistency, ultimately limiting downstream performance. Motivated by this unified view of the world, we propose DriveUniTok, a unified multimodal tokenizer for driving world-action models (WAMs) that encodes these modalities in a single decodable continuous latent. We freeze DriveUniTok and adapt a pretrained diffusion model, DriveUniWAM, to predict future unified latents; the tokenizer then decodes them into future appearance, projected LiDAR depth, and ego trajectories. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate that our unified design achieves better future prediction and planning performance at lower downstream computational cost than separate-stream alternatives. With reinforcement learning post-training, DriveUniWAM achieves a PDMS of 91.54, reaching state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated WAM-based planners.

AI.tldr: 提出DriveUniTok，一个将外观、投影LiDAR深度与自车运动编码到单一可解码连续潜空间的多模态统一分词器，并冻结该分词器、适配预训练扩散模型DriveUniWAM预测未来统一潜变量，从而解码出未来外观、深度与自车轨迹。在NAVSIM上以更低下游计算成本取得更优预测与规划性能，RL后训练后PDMS达91.54。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型通常对外观、度量几何（投影LiDAR深度）与自车运动进行部分建模或独立建模，忽视了这些模态实际上是同一潜在世界状态的不同投影，导致信息损失与跨模态不一致，并限制下游性能。
AI.method: 基于"模态为共享世界状态不同投影"的统一视角，构建统一多模态分词器DriveUniTok，将三类模态编码为单一可解码的连续潜表示；随后冻结该分词器，适配预训练扩散模型DriveUniWAM来预测未来统一潜变量，再由分词器解码为未来外观、投影LiDAR深度与自车轨迹；并采用强化学习后训练。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM基准上，统一设计相比分离流方案在更低的下游计算成本下获得更好的未来预测与规划表现；经强化学习后训练，DriveUniWAM的PDMS达到91.54，在被评估的WAM类规划器中达到state-of-the-art水平。
AI.conclusion: 将外观、几何与自车运动统一到单一可解码潜空间，可缓解跨模态不一致与信息损失，在降低下游计算开销的同时提升预测与规划性能，验证了统一世界状态建模在驾驶世界-动作模型中的有效性。

title: DimFlow: Bidirectional Grid-Expert Learning for Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Dynamic Gaussian reconstruction requires compact scene features to support coordinated changes in geometry and appearance. A factorized grid provides efficient local queries, but accurate interpolation alone does not ensure that the resulting dynamic attributes remain compatible across space and time. We introduce DimFlow, a framework that learns these features through bidirectional interaction between a multi-resolution grid and a coordinate-based expert branch. Feature-level adversarial alignment connects their distributions, adaptive fusion transfers complementary information, and activation-masked residual feedback refines the grid during training. Four attribute experts organize deformation, rotation, opacity, and temporal information before Gaussian rendering. In the aggregate comparison across D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, and DAVIS, DimFlow achieves 39.73 dB PSNR, improving on 4D-GS by 1.92 dB while matching its reported 85 FPS rendering speed. The model occupies 18.9 MB, compared with 18.3 MB for 4D-GS. Component and attribute-expert ablations reveal complementary contributions from feature alignment, adaptive exchange, and temporal processing.

AI.tldr: DimFlow通过多分辨率网格与坐标基专家分支的双向交互学习紧凑场景特征，实现几何与外观协同变化的动态高斯重建。
AI.motivation: 动态高斯重建需要紧凑场景特征以支持几何与外观的协同变化。因子化网格虽能高效实现局部查询，但仅靠精确插值无法保证所得动态属性在空间与时间上的兼容性，因此需要一种机制来约束特征的一致性与互补性。
AI.method: 提出DimFlow框架，在多分辨率网格与坐标基专家分支之间建立双向交互：特征级对抗对齐连接二者分布，自适应融合传递互补信息，激活掩码残差反馈在训练中精炼网格；并设四个属性专家分别组织变形、旋转、不透明度与时间信息，再进行高斯渲染。
AI.result: 在D-NeRF、HyperNeRF与DAVIS的汇总比较中达到39.73 dB PSNR，较4D-GS提升1.92 dB，同时保持其报告的85 FPS渲染速度；模型体积18.9 MB，4D-GS为18.3 MB。组件与属性专家消融显示特征对齐、自适应交换和时间处理具有互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: DimFlow以近乎相当的存储开销显著提升重建质量而不牺牲渲染速度，表明特征级对齐与自适应交互是提升动态高斯表示时空兼容性的有效手段。

title: MedAdaptAgent: An Automatic Harness for Adapting Medical Imaging Models to New Sites
summary: Reusing pretrained medical-imaging models offers an alternative to training from scratch. A model trained for the same task may perform poorly at a new hospital because imaging protocols and preprocessing differ. Effective adaptation depends on the model architecture, domain shift, and available labels and compute. Adaptation can improve scores on a small labeled set yet reduce performance on unseen data. We present MedAdaptAgent, an automatic harness that turns a supplied model, target data, and a free-text request into a new-site adaptation workflow. Its LLM-driven Adaptation Planner uses model-site evidence to choose compatible experiments and revise subsequent adjustments. The harness requires evidence of improvement over the pretrained model, then delivers the selected model as a complete, runnable package. Evaluation spans 26 segmentation and classification transfers across architectures and compute settings, with segmentation annotation budgets ranging from zero-shot transfer to few-shot adaptation. With 20 local annotations, mean segmentation Dice rises from 0.483 to 0.774 across 10 transfers, a 60.1% relative gain, with no harmful replacements. Mean classification AUROC rises from 0.810 to 0.837 across 13 transfers, a 3.4% relative gain. Comparing adapted models with the pretrained model reduces harmful classification replacements by 30.8% versus selecting the highest-scoring model on the available labels, using identical candidates. Seven public-model deployments demonstrate adaptation and reproducible package delivery across contrast and modality shifts. A CT-to-MRI study extends the evaluation to four LLM planners, including two open-weight models. We release the code on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MedAdaptAgent：一个自动化适配框架，将给定模型、目标医院数据和自然语言请求转化为跨站点适配工作流，由 LLM 驱动的适配规划器基于模型—站点证据选择实验并迭代修正，并以"必须优于预训练模型"为门槛交付可运行模型包。
AI.motivation: 复用预训练医学影像模型可避免从头训练，但同一任务的模型在新医院常因成像协议与预处理差异而性能下降。有效适配依赖模型架构、域偏移程度以及可用标签与算力，且小样本标注上的分数提升未必泛化到未见数据，甚至可能造成有害替换，因此需要自动化的、以证据驱动的适配流程。
AI.method: 构建 MedAdaptAgent 自动化测试台（harness）：输入模型、目标数据与自由文本需求，输出新站点适配工作流；核心为 LLM 驱动的 Adaptation Planner，利用模型—站点证据（model-site evidence）筛选兼容实验并修正后续调整策略；设置改进验证门槛，仅在超过预训练模型时采纳，并将选中模型打包为可运行交付物。评估覆盖 26 项分割与分类迁移，跨多种架构与算力配置，分割标注预算从零样本迁移到少样本适配；另开展 CT→MRI 研究，比较 4 个 LLM 规划器（含 2 个开放权重模型），并完成 7 个公开模型部署。
AI.result: 在 10 项分割迁移中，使用 20 个本地标注使平均 Dice 由 0.483 提升至 0.774（相对提升 60.1%），且无有害替换；13 项分类迁移中平均 AUROC 由 0.810 提升至 0.837（相对提升 3.4%）。在相同候选集下，以适配后模型与预训练模型对比进行选择，较"选取可用标签上最高分模型"的基线减少 30.8% 的有害分类替换。7 个公开模型部署展示了在对比度与模态偏移下的适配与可复现交付；CT→MRI 研究将评估扩展至 4 种 LLM 规划器。
AI.conclusion: MedAdaptAgent 表明，以证据驱动的 LLM 规划加严格改进门槛，可在标签与算力受限条件下稳定提升跨站点性能并抑制有害替换；该框架具备跨架构、跨模态与跨规划器的泛化性，支持可复现的模型打包部署，代码已开源。

title: OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation
summary: Direct-policy World Action Models (WAM) have demonstrated the benefits of decoupling action generation from explicit future visual prediction for efficient inference in autonomous driving and embodied control. However, they still require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, incurring substantial latency and hindering real-time deployment. Simply reducing the number of denoising steps will collapse the nonlinear multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates, substantially degrading action quality. To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM, for autonomous driving and embodied control. We argue that it is the absence of structured action priors in random noise initialization that forces direct-policy WAMs to recover coherent action sequences through iterative denoising. Hence, we construct imagination tokens to initialize the diffusion process, providing physical priors and action-conditioned representations. We further introduce privileged information distillation with future conditioning to enhance future-aware action generation. As a result, OSWAM can efficiently and effectively generate high quality actions in just one diffusion step. Our experiments demonstrate that OSWAM achieves comparable or even better results in both autonomous driving and embodied control than direct-policy WAM and Joint-WAM that require tens of steps. It obtains approximately $3\times$ speedup over direct-policy WAM baselines and supports real-time compiled inference with latency as low as 40ms on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. The project page is available at https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/

AI.tldr: OSWAM通过引入想象token初始化扩散过程并结合特权信息蒸馏，将世界动作模型的动作生成压缩至单步，在保持动作质量的同时实现约3倍加速与40ms实时推理。
AI.motivation: 直接策略世界动作模型（Direct-policy WAM）解耦了动作生成与显式未来视觉预测，推理效率较高，但仍需数十步去噪才能达到有竞争力的动作质量，造成显著延迟、难以实时部署。而简单减少去噪步数会使非线性的多步去噪轨迹坍缩为粗粒度更新，大幅降低动作质量。作者认为，随机噪声初始化缺乏结构化动作先验，是迫使这类模型依赖迭代去噪恢复连贯动作序列的根本原因。
AI.method: 提出OSWAM：构造"想象token"（imagination tokens）用于初始化扩散过程，为模型提供物理先验与动作条件化表示；进一步引入带未来条件化的特权信息蒸馏，增强未来感知的动作生成能力。由此使模型仅需一个扩散步即可生成高质量动作。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶与具身控制任务上，OSWAM取得了与需数十步的直接策略WAM及Joint-WAM相当甚至更优的效果；相比直接策略WAM基线约3倍加速；在NVIDIA RTX 5090上经编译推理延迟低至40ms，支持实时推理。
AI.conclusion: 结构化动作先验初始化与特权信息蒸馏可有效替代多步迭代去噪，使世界动作模型在单步生成下兼具高质量与实时性，为自动驾驶和具身控制的实时部署提供可行方案。

title: Does VGGT Know What It Does Not Know?
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT regress cameras and geometry in a single forward pass, but they report no uncertainty for the camera poses they predict: an incorrect relative pose looks no different from a correct one. We ask whether the frozen model nonetheless knows when its pose is wrong. On HardMatch, a benchmark of 1,000 deliberately difficult image pairs on which VGGT fails on 35% of pairs, a linear probe on VGGT's frozen features predicts pose failure on held-out categories with ROC-AUC 93.5%, compared with 79.7% for VGGT's own point-map confidence and 77.7% for a classifier trained on all of VGGT's outputs. The probe catches failures VGGT is confident about, lets a downstream system abstain on the pairs it distrusts, and transfers without retraining to rotation failures on PhotoTourism and ScanNet-1500, beyond what co-visibility explains. This knowledge is absent from the per-image encoder: it is computed partway through the layers that fuse the two views, and the same holds for a second model, $π^3$. In essence, we find that VGGT knows more about its own failures than it reports.

AI.tldr: VGGT等前馈3D重建模型不报告相机位姿不确定性，但实验表明其冻结特征中已编码"位姿是否失败"的信号：线性探针在HardMatch上以93.5% ROC-AUC预测失败，显著优于自带的点图置信度(79.7%)与全输出分类器(77.7%)，且可跨数据集迁移、支持下游弃权决策。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型（如VGGT）单次前向即回归相机与几何，却不输出位姿不确定性，导致错误的相对位姿与正确位姿在输出上无法区分。作者由此提出核心问题：冻结模型内部是否"知道自己错了"，即能否从模型内部表示中探出位姿失败信号。
AI.method: 构建HardMatch基准（1,000对刻意困难图像对，VGGT在35%上失败）；在VGGT冻结特征上训练线性探针预测位姿失败；与VGGT自带点图置信度、基于全部输出的分类器对比；通过消融/层级分析定位该信号的来源；在PhotoTourism与ScanNet-1500上零重训迁移验证旋转失败检测；并在第二个模型π³上复现。
AI.result: 线性探针在留出类别上预测位姿失败达ROC-AUC 93.5%，优于点图置信度（79.7%）与全输出分类器（77.7%）；能捕捉VGGT自身高置信却失败的样本，支持下游系统弃权；零重训迁移至PhotoTourism与ScanNet-1500的旋转失败检测，且超出共视性可解释范围。该知识不存在于单图编码器中，而是在融合两视图的层中部才被计算出来，π³同样如此。
AI.conclusion: VGGT对其自身失败的了解多于其对外报告的：位姿失败的可预测信号蕴含于跨视图融合层的中间特征中，而非单图编码器或现有置信度输出。这提示可通过内部探针为前馈3D重建模型补充可靠的不确定性估计与弃权机制。

title: An Agentic AI Workflow for Liver Lesion Segmentation and Structured Radiology Reporting
summary: Despite advances in automated liver lesion segmentation, a gap remains between image-derived predictions and clinically interpretable radiology reports. Bridging this gap requires quantitative measurements that are both reproducible and traceable. We present an evidence-grounded agentic AI framework that connects liver and lesion segmentation with deterministic quantification and structured reporting. TotalSegmentator-based nnU-Net models delineate the liver, Couinaud segments, and lesions, while computational tools extract volumes, dimensions, counts, and anatomical locations. A large language model (LLM) organizes these measurements into a predefined reporting schema, with numerical consistency checks against source measurements. On 51 LiTS cases, the segmentation stage achieved a liver Dice score of 0.947, lesion sensitivity of 75.6%, and positive predictive value of 68.9%. Exploratory screening of 25,494 MERLIN reports identified 10,208 (40.0%) with liver-related abnormalities. By connecting quantitative imaging evidence with agentic report generation, this work takes a step toward human-centered medical AI that prioritizes traceability and clinical relevance.

AI.tldr: 提出证据驱动的智能体AI框架，将肝脏与病灶分割、确定性量化与结构化报告生成贯通，实现可复现、可追溯的影像-报告衔接。
AI.motivation: 现有自动肝脏病灶分割的影像预测结果与临床可解释的放射学报告之间存在鸿沟，弥合该鸿沟需要既可复现又可追溯的定量测量。
AI.method: 基于TotalSegmentator的nnU-Net模型分割肝脏、Couinaud分段及病灶；计算工具提取体积、尺寸、数目与解剖位置；由LLM按预定义报告模板组织测量值，并对数值与源测量做一致性核查。
AI.result: 在51例LiTS病例上，分割阶段肝脏Dice为0.947，病灶敏感度75.6%，阳性预测值68.9%；对25,494份MERLIN报告的探索性筛选中，识别出10,208份（40.0%）含肝脏相关异常。
AI.conclusion: 将定量影像证据与智能体报告生成相连接，朝以人为中心、强调可追溯性与临床相关性的医学AI迈出一步。

title: Finetuning Prompt-Based Image Editor for Geometry-Consistent Room Defurnishing
comment: 2 pages, 3 figures. Poster presented at IEEE ISMAR 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Erasing all furniture from a single room image to generate its empty counterpart is valuable for XR applications such as diminished reality and virtual staging. The challenge is twofold: inpainting the furniture regions with realistic content, and doing so without distorting the room's 3D geometry. Prompt-driven image editors, such as FLUX.2, handle realism impressively, but their structural faithfulness is inferior to explicit layout conditioned inpainting. To improve geometric consistency, we propose a training recipe for finetuning a LoRA on 2,500 furnished-empty room pairs. FLUX.2 with our LoRA adaptor significantly improves geometric consistency while retaining the high texture fidelity. This single-photo inpainter can be an effective building block for depth-aware and 3D-consistent XR pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LoRA微调FLUX.2的单图家具擦除方法，用2500对"有家具—空房间"数据训练，在保持高纹理真实感的同时显著提升3D几何一致性。
AI.motivation: XR应用（如diminished reality、虚拟布置）需要将单张房间图像中的家具全部擦除并生成空房版本。难点在于两点：一是家具区域需以真实内容补全，二是补全过程不能破坏房间的3D几何结构。现有prompt驱动编辑器（如FLUX.2）真实感强，但结构保真度不如显式布局条件inpainting。
AI.method: 构建2500对配对的"有家具—空房间"图像数据，在其上微调一个LoRA适配器，并挂接到FLUX.2上，形成训练方案（training recipe），以在保留生成先验纹理能力的同时注入几何一致性。
AI.result: FLUX.2 + LoRA适配器相较原始模型显著改善几何一致性，同时保留高纹理保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该单图inpainter可作为depth-aware与3D一致性XR流水线的有效基础模块。

title: On Detection Reliability for Small Object Segmentation
summary: This study investigates whether predicted bounding boxes are reliable for determining where small-object segmentation should be performed without risking false negatives outside those boxes. The investigation leverages adenovirus particles as small objects, YOLO26x for detection, YO-LO26x-Sem for segmentation, and Mask R-CNN for both detection and segmentation. Segmenta-tion-model predictions were matched to ground-truth adenovirus masks or reference objects using their centroids, with ground-truth mask centroids preferred over ground-truth bounding-box centroids as references for matching. Matched predicted-mask centroids were considered as inside at least one detector-predicted bounding box or outside all such boxes, while ground-truth masks without matched predictions were recorded as having no matched segmentation. For the YOLO26 models, 34 reference objects (47.89%) had matched segmentation centroids inside at least one pre-dicted box, 8 (11.27%) had centroids outside all predicted boxes, and 29 (40.85%) had no matched predicted segmentation. For the Mask R-CNN model, the corresponding counts were 69 (97.18%), 0 (0.00%), and 2 (2.82%). These preliminary experiments demonstrated that restricting segmentation to detector-predicted bounding boxes risks excluding matched segmentation predictions outside those boxes, potentially introducing false negatives.

AI.tldr: 该论文以小目标（腺病毒颗粒）为例，检验检测器预测框是否可安全地作为分割范围，结论是会产生假阴性。
AI.motivation: 检测-分割两阶段流程常把分割限制在检测器预测框内以降低计算量，但对小目标而言，这一假设是否可靠缺乏验证，可能引入假阴性。
AI.method: 以腺病毒颗粒为小目标，YOLO26x作检测、YOLO26x-Sem作分割，Mask R-CNN同时作检测与分割。分割预测与真值掩膜（或参考目标）以质心匹配，优先使用真值掩膜质心；将匹配成功预测掩膜的质心分类为位于至少一个检测预测框内，或位于所有预测框之外；无匹配预测的真值掩膜记为无匹配分割。
AI.result: YOLO26系列：34个参考目标（47.89%）匹配分割质心落在预测框内，8个（11.27%）在所有预测框外，29个（40.85%）无匹配预测分割；Mask R-CNN：分别为69（97.18%）、0（0.00%）、2（2.82%）。
AI.conclusion: 初步实验表明，将分割限制在检测器预测框内会排除框外的匹配分割预测，可能引入假阴性，故小目标分割不应简单依赖预测框裁剪。

title: Complexity-guided Regularization for Generalizable Human Gaussian Splatting
comment: 28 pages, 11 figures, including appendix. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Recent studies on generalizable human Gaussian splatting have achieved the notable progress in synthesizing novel views of unseen human subjects from multi-view images. Despite this progress, existing methods still struggle to represent fine-grained details of human subjects, which inherently involve high geometric and textural complexity. This is because previous methods do not impose a constraint on how densely Gaussians are placed, which often leads to blurry rendering results in complex regions. To address this problem, we propose a complexity-guided regularization scheme. The key idea is to leverage a complexity prior computed via the local entropy in geometric and textural characteristics of a clothed human. This effectively prevents Gaussians from being coarsely placed in complex regions, which facilitates the faithful reconstruction of intricate structures. Furthermore, we sample local patches predominantly from complex regions according to this complexity prior, which allows the model to be sufficiently supervised by local details. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method delivers state-of-the-art performance while maintaining the real-time inference speed in generalizable human Gaussian splatting. The code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/DCVL-3D/CGR-GS_release.

AI.tldr: 提出复杂度引导正则化（CGR），利用基于局部熵的复杂度先验约束高斯放置密度并引导局部块采样，从而在保持实时推理速度下显著提升可泛化人体高斯泼溅的细粒度重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有可泛化人体高斯泼溅方法虽能从多视图图像合成未见受试者的新视角，但难以表示人体固有的高几何与纹理复杂度细节。原因在于先前方法未约束高斯的放置密度，导致复杂区域渲染模糊、细节丢失。
AI.method: 核心是构建复杂度先验：通过计算着装人体几何与纹理特征的局部熵来衡量区域复杂度。基于该先验引入两项机制：(1) 复杂度引导正则化，抑制高斯在复杂区域的粗粒度放置，促进精细结构忠实重建；(2) 按复杂度先验优先从复杂区域采样局部块，使模型获得充分的局部细节监督。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上取得可泛化人体高斯泼溅的最先进性能，同时保持实时推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 通过局部熵复杂度先验同时引导高斯密度约束与局部块采样，可有效改善复杂区域细节重建，且不牺牲实时性；代码与模型已开源。

title: Temporal Slice Learning for AI-Generated Video Detection with 400$\times$ Fewer FLOPs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, 18 figures. Project page: https://shangwei5.github.io/TSC-Net/
summary: Recent advances in generative video models have improved visual realism, making detection increasingly dependent on subtle temporal inconsistencies. However, these signals are weak and spatially localized, while most of the video content is redundant. This creates a fundamental mismatch: existing detectors rely on heavy backbones to model full videos, which leads to high computational cost and limited scalability. In this work, we rethink AI-generated video detection from a representation perspective. Instead of modeling entire videos, we restructure them into compact temporal slice representations that isolate informative temporal evolution. We introduce a lightweight framework using frequency-aware temporal slice consistency learning, where informative spatial rows and columns are aggregated over time to form slice-domain inputs. This reparameterization suppresses redundant appearance while preserving discriminative temporal dynamics, enabling efficient and targeted detection. By constructing slices from both high- and low-frequency regions, our method exposes complementary temporal artifacts, including unstable details and abnormal motion smoothness. We instantiate this idea in a Temporal Slice Consistency Network, which integrates task-driven slice localization, hierarchical positional encoding, and a lightweight Transformer to model cross-slice and cross-frequency dependencies. We further introduce AI-Artist, a new benchmark with artist-curated videos from recent high-fidelity generators, including Seedance and Kling. Experiments on GenVideo and AI-Artist show that our method achieves strong performance while requiring over 400$\times$ fewer model-forward FLOPs and 3.6$\times$ faster model inference than the strong video-based baseline ReStraV (2.9$\times$ faster end to end, including preprocessing), enabling scalable and practical deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文从表示层面重构AI生成视频检测：将整段视频重组为紧凑的时间切片表示，采用频率感知的时间切片一致性学习，在显著降低计算量的同时保持检测性能。
AI.motivation: 生成视频模型视觉真实度提升，检测越来越依赖微弱且空间局部化的时序不一致信号，而视频大部分内容冗余。现有检测器依赖重型骨干网络建模整段视频，计算成本高、可扩展性差，存在"微弱局部信号"与"全视频重型建模"的根本错配。
AI.method: 提出频率感知时间切片一致性学习框架：沿时间聚合信息量高的空间行与列，构造时间切片域输入，抑制冗余外观、保留判别性时序动态；从高频与低频区域分别构造切片以暴露互补时序伪影（细节不稳定、运动过于平滑）。实例化为Temporal Slice Consistency Network，集成任务驱动的切片定位、层次化位置编码和轻量级Transformer建模跨切片与跨频率依赖。
AI.result: 在GenVideo与AI-Artist上取得强性能；相比强视频基线ReStraV，模型前向FLOPs减少400倍以上，模型推理快3.6倍（含预处理端到端快2.9倍）。
AI.conclusion: 通过时间切片重参数化替代全视频建模，可实现高效、可扩展且实用的AI生成视频检测；并贡献了包含Seedance、Kling等最新高保真生成器艺术家视频的新基准AI-Artist。

title: MemVLN: Streaming Episodic Memory for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through 3D environments. Maintaining persistent episodic memory remains a challenge for VLM-based streaming agents in long-horizon navigation. We present MEMVLN, a streaming episodic memory framework that maintains a bounded bank of compressed perceptual features annotated with timesteps and action-derived relative poses, and produces compact memory tokens via cross-attention. We pair the proposed memory with a frozen pretrained geometry encoder. To learn the memory module, we design a masking-based trajectory summarization task with multi-granularity sub-trajectory decomposition, encouraging route reconstruction exclusively from episodic memory. Under navigation training restricted to the official R2R/RxR trajectories, MEMVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics on standard VLN-CE benchmarks. Long-horizon analyses further characterize when episodic memory is useful. For physical evaluation, we collect 30 instruction-conditioned episodes in one physical scene, use 24 as demonstrations for post-training, and hold out six for testing. On the held-out episodes, MEMVLN improves success over the VLM baseline from 17% to 40%, and post-training further raises it to 47%.

AI.tldr: MEMVLN：面向长程VLN的流式情节记忆框架，用有界压缩记忆库+交叉注意力记忆token配合冻结几何编码器，在VLN-CE多数指标上SOTA，并在真实场景中将成功率由17%提升至40%（后训练后47%）。
AI.motivation: VLM-based流式智能体在长程导航中缺乏持久的情节记忆，难以在3D环境中持续遵循语言指令。
AI.method: 维护一个有界的压缩感知特征库，特征带时间步与动作推导的相对位姿标注；通过交叉注意力生成紧凑记忆token，并与冻结的预训练几何编码器配对；设计基于掩码的轨迹摘要任务，结合多粒度子轨迹分解，迫使模型仅依赖情节记忆重建路径。
AI.result: 仅在官方R2R/RxR轨迹上训练，即在标准VLN-CE基准的多数指标上取得SOTA；长程分析刻画了情节记忆的有效条件；实机30条指令情节（24演示后训练、6测试）中成功率由基线17%升至40%，后训练后达47%。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑、有界的情节记忆可有效支撑长程VLN；掩码轨迹摘要提供有效监督，且仿真训练可迁移至真实场景，后训练进一步提升实机表现。

title: Improving VLMs on Scientific Chart Analysis via Autonomous Evolution
summary: Understanding and operating with scientific charts is a standard approach in data analysis, and while humans are good at interpreting such charts, open vision-language models (VLMs) are known to perform poorly when it comes to question answering based on such data types. Motivated by an initial observation that many of their errors are due to inexact answering, we raise the following natural question: how much accuracy can we recover without changing the model at all? In this paper, we study this question by searching over inference programs and the code around a "frozen" version of the model.
