Using ideas from autonomous evolution (famously used in AlphaEvolve), we first start from a baseline inference program, and in each round we show an LLM judge the code together with a few failures on training questions, and ask for an improving evolutionary move. As usual in autonomous evolution approaches, the candidate programs are kept in a small pool ranked by training accuracy, and the next edit is performed on top-scorers from this pool. We run this approach on three VLMs and four popular benchmarks on scientific charts, and we measure the fraction of descriptive questions whose answer exactly matches the ground truth. The accuracy improves in all experimental settings. On average, it rises from 16.6% with the starting program to 41.3% with the evolved one, and the largest single increase is 55.2 percentage points. As a side benefit, our evolved program is 3.8x faster than the starting program, because short answers are easier to grade and faster to generate. Our results demonstrate that a large part of the observed errors arise due to the inference pipeline, and that optimizing it can improve the "frozen" VLM without the need to retrain it.

AI.tldr: 通过"自主进化"搜索推理程序与代码，在不改动模型权重的前提下大幅提升冻结视觉语言模型在科学图表问答上的精确匹配准确率（16.6%→41.3%），并使推理速度提升3.8倍。
AI.motivation: 开放视觉语言模型在基于科学图表（scientific charts）的问答任务上表现较差。作者观察到许多错误源于"答案不精确"（inexact answering）而非推理能力缺陷，于是提出问题：在完全不改变模型的情况下，能回收多少准确率？即探究错误中有多大比例来自推理流程（inference pipeline）本身。
AI.method: 在"冻结"模型外围搜索推理程序及其代码。采用自主进化（autonomous evolution，类似 AlphaEvolve）思路：从一个基线推理程序出发，每轮将代码与若干个训练题上的失败样例展示给 LLM 评判器（LLM judge），要求其给出一个改进的进化动作（evolutionary move）。候选程序保存在小规模程序池（pool）中，按训练准确率排序，下一轮编辑在得分最高的程序上进行。实验覆盖 3 个 VLM 与 4 个主流科学图表基准，以答案与真值精确匹配（exact match）的比例作为度量。
AI.result: 所有实验设置下准确率均提升。平均从起始程序的 16.6% 提升到进化后的 41.3%，单次最大提升为 55.2 个百分点。附带收益：进化后程序比初始程序快 3.8 倍，因为短答案更易于判分、生成也更快。
AI.conclusion: 观测到的错误中很大一部分源于推理流程而非模型本身，优化推理管线即可在无需重新训练的情况下提升"冻结"VLM 的表现，说明流程层面的优化是低成本、高回报的改进方向。

title: Revealing Imaging Characteristics of Thermal Wakes from Underwater Vehicles Without Cooling-Water Discharge
summary: Small uncrewed underwater vehicles are proliferating and threaten maritime security, yet evade sonar and magnetic sensors built for larger submarines. Infrared thermal wakes, generated by hydrodynamic displacement that modulates the cold-skin layer, offer a non-acoustic, non-magnetic alternative even without cooling-water discharge. Existing studies, however, rely on idealized simulations that fail to capture real-world backgrounds, offering limited guidance for target-background discrimination. We establish AVP-IR-Wake, the first large-scale, real-world, physically diverse benchmark of 161,485 frames collected over three years. We show that thermal wakes are extended structures of discrete vortices, violating the compactness assumption of conventional targets. We reveal local indistinguishability: individual wake vortices are statistically identical to wind-induced background vortices in temporal, frequency, and sparse domains, sharing low-frequency information and long-range correlations. This challenges the assumptions of compact, transient, high-frequency targets in conventional detection. Yet we establish global morphological separability: although locally inseparable, the wake as a whole is organized by vehicle trajectory, whereas background clutter is organized by wind-driven thermal fronts. This explains why representative detectors fail and shows that reliable detection must shift from local feature extraction to global trajectory-constrained physical modeling. Because the cold-skin layer varies globally and seasonally, forecasting wake observability will require integrating physical oceanography and atmospheric science, linking underwater surveillance to the changing ocean surface.

AI.tldr: 该文构建了首个大规模真实红外尾流基准AVP-IR-Wake（161,485帧，历时三年），揭示小型无人潜航器热尾流具有"局部不可分、全局可分"的特性，主张检测范式应从局部特征提取转向全局轨迹约束的物理建模。
AI.motivation: 小型无人水下航行器（UUV）日益扩散并对海上安全构成威胁，但其尺寸小，能够规避为大型潜艇设计的声呐与磁探测手段。红外热尾流由水动力位移调制冷表皮层而产生，即使无冷却水排放也存在，提供了非声、非磁的替代探测途径。然而现有研究依赖理想化仿真，无法反映真实背景，对目标—背景的判别指导有限。
AI.method: 构建AVP-IR-Wake基准数据集：真实场景、物理多样性、大规模（161,485帧、采集周期三年）。在此数据上进行时空-频域-稀疏域统计分析，比较尾流涡与风致背景涡的统计特性，并分析尾流与背景的整体组织结构（轨迹约束 vs 风驱动热锋）。同时评估代表性检测器在该数据上的表现。
AI.result: （1）热尾流是离散涡组成的延展结构，违反传统目标"紧凑性"假设；（2）局部不可分性：单个尾流涡在时域、频域与稀疏域上与风致背景涡在统计上不可区分，共享低频信息与长程相关性，挑战了"紧凑、瞬态、高频"的传统检测假设；（3）全局形态可分性：尾流整体受航行器轨迹组织，而背景杂波受风驱动热锋组织。这一"局部不可分—全局可分"的结构解释了代表性检测器的失效原因。
AI.conclusion: 可靠检测须从局部特征提取转向全局轨迹约束的物理建模。由于冷表皮层存在全球性与季节性变化，尾流可观测性的预报需融合物理海洋学与大气科学，从而将水下监视与变化中的海表联系起来。

title: Shifted Window Temporal Transformer for YOLO-Guided Phase Recognition in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Surgery
summary: Intelligent operating rooms require accurate awareness of surgical workflow for better intra-operative decisions, teamwork, and surgical documentation. Therefore, accurately recognizing surgical phase during surgery is crucial. However, previous artificial intelligence-based methods provide fluctuating predictions for the transitions, restricting their clinical use. To address this challenge, we propose a clinically meaningful framework that integrates a Swin Transformer and Temporal Transformer Encoder (TTE) for effective surgical phase recognition and a parallel YOLOv11s network for real-time surgical instrument localization. To avoid phase flickering and to produce stable workflow predictions, a causal temporal smoothing is applied. The proposed framework is tested on the Cholec80 dataset for the simultaneous recognition of the surgical phases and instruments. The overall phase recognition accuracy of this model was 92%, and the macro average F1-score was 0.86. This performance surpasses CNN based methods such as EndoNet (81.7%) and SV-RCNet (85.3%), as well as temporal convolutional and transformer-based approaches including TeCNO (88.6%), Trans-SVNet (90.9%), and LoViT (91.5%). Besides, the module of instrument detection achieved mAP@0.5 = 0.863. The reliability of the results is confirmed, obtaining a high recognition rate of the workflows, and a high accuracy of the localization of the instruments. The proposed framework can serve as a foundation for intelligent surgical assistance, enriching situation awareness, and potential robotic surgery applications. Code will be made publicly available at: https://github.com/ac005sheekar/LapChol-Surgery-Swin-Cholec80

AI.tldr: 提出Swin Transformer + 时序Transformer编码器(TTE)进行手术阶段识别，并行YOLOv11s做器械定位，并引入因果时序平滑抑制阶段闪烁；Cholec80上阶段准确率92%、宏F1 0.86，器械mAP@0.5=0.863。
AI.motivation: 智能手术室需要准确的手术流程感知以支持术中决策、团队协作与手术记录，而阶段识别是关键。已有AI方法在阶段转换处预测波动（闪烁），限制其临床应用。
AI.method: Swin Transformer提取空间特征 + Temporal Transformer Encoder建模时序，用于手术阶段识别；并行YOLOv11s网络实现实时手术器械定位；采用因果时序平滑（causal temporal smoothing）消除阶段闪烁、输出稳定流程预测。在Cholec80数据集上同时评估阶段与器械。
AI.result: 阶段识别总体准确率92%，宏平均F1 0.86，优于EndoNet(81.7%)、SV-RCNet(85.3%)、TeCNO(88.6%)、Trans-SVNet(90.9%)、LoViT(91.5%)；器械检测mAP@0.5=0.863。
AI.conclusion: 框架在流程识别率与器械定位精度上均表现可靠，可作为智能手术辅助、态势感知增强及机器人手术应用的基础。代码将公开。

title: DiffAuction: An Auction-Driven Framework for Generative Image Advertising
summary: Diffusion models enable multiple advertisers to compete for exposure within a shared generated image. Yet existing approaches are computationally costly when generating images under varying target-share configurations, and it remains unclear how the resulting outcomes should be evaluated and priced. To address these gaps, we propose DiffAuction, a framework integrating controllable generation, click-intent evaluation, and auction design. First, our training-free Residual Share Calibration (RSC) decomposes joint-attention updates into product-specific residuals and rescales them according to target shares. We further introduce Share-Conditioned Prompting (SCP) to adapt the viewpoint to each desired allocation. Second, we develop an evaluator that uses a VLM to extract visual evidence and an LLM to assess Click-Through Intent (CTI), a proxy for click propensity, along four dimensions: Product Prominence, Brand Recognizability, Scene Integration, and Contextual Value Communication. We validate its assessments against judgments from 10 trained annotators on 1000 images. Third, we formulate this advertising setting as an auction over jointly feasible generation configurations. Each configuration has a public expected CTI vector, while advertisers hold configuration-specific private values per unit of CTI that map click intent into commercial value. We adopt a learnable affine maximizer auction (AMA), which jointly selects a shared generation configuration and determines advertiser-specific payments to maximize expected platform revenue. The resulting allocation and payment rules guarantee dominant-strategy incentive compatibility (DSIC) and individual rationality (IR). Experiments show that our generation method strengthens the monotonic relationship between target shares and CTI relative to baselines, while the learned AMA achieves higher platform revenue in the resulting auction setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 DiffAuction 框架，统一可控多广告主共享生成图像、VLM+LLM 点击意图(CTI)评估与可学习仿射最大化拍卖(AMA)，实现满足 DSIC 与 IR 的生成配置竞价与平台收益最大化。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在多广告主争抢同一张生成图像曝光时，针对不同目标份额配置的生成计算代价高；且生成结果的评价与定价机制缺失，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: (1) 免训练 Residual Share Calibration (RSC)：将联合注意力更新分解为各产品残差并按目标份额重缩放；配合 Share-Conditioned Prompting (SCP) 适配不同分配的目标视角。(2) 评估器：VLM 提取视觉证据、LLM 从产品显著性、品牌可识别性、场景融合度、语境价值传达四维度评定 Click-Through Intent (CTI)，并用 10 名受训标注员在 1000 张图像上的判断做验证。(3) 拍卖：将场景建模为对联合可行生成配置的拍卖，配置具有公开期望 CTI 向量，广告主对单位 CTI 拥有配置相关的私有估值；采用可学习仿射最大化拍卖(AMA)联合选择共享生成配置并确定各广告主支付以最大化期望平台收益。
AI.result: 所提生成方法相较基线强化了目标份额与 CTI 之间的单调关系；学习到的 AMA 在相应拍卖环境下取得更高的平台收益；分配与支付规则保证 DSIC 与 IR。
AI.conclusion: DiffAuction 将可控多主体生成、可解释意图评估与机制设计闭环整合，为共享生成广告位提供了可计算、可评估、可定价且满足激励相容与个体理性的方案。

title: Interpretable Brain Age Prediction Using White Matter Fiber Orientation Distributions with Rotation-Equivariant Deep Learning
summary: Diffusion MRI (dMRI) provides information about white matter microstructure that can support brain age prediction. However, many existing prediction models use diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) scalar metrics that omit orientation information. Deep learning is increasingly used for brain age prediction, but conventional CNNs do not explicitly respect the geometric structure of orientation-dependent features. We present an interpretable brain age prediction framework that combines white matter fiber orientation distributions (WM-FODs) with an SE(3) (Special Euclidean group in 3 dimensions) equivariant CNN. The network operates directly on spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients of the FOD, preserving their transformation properties under rotation. Evaluation in 692 participants aged 36-90 years from the Human Connectome Project Aging dataset showed that the combined framework outperformed the evaluated DTI-based models and conventional CNNs. Averaging predictions from five cross-validation models yielded a mean absolute error of 3.54 years and Pearson's correlation of 0.958. Our results indicated that the performance advantage depended on combining WM-FODs with equivariant processing. Prediction accuracy was highest at a maximum SH order of Lmax = 2 and declined at higher orders. Tract-level occlusion, where each segmented tract was masked in turn, revealed age-dependent patterns of model sensitivity, with importance peaks in frontal projection pathways at 36-44 years, the fornix at 45-54 years, the callosal isthmus at 55-64 years, the middle cerebellar peduncle at 65-74 years, and the callosal genu at 75-90 years. These findings support rotation-equivariant processing of WM-FODs for accurate brain age prediction with anatomically interpretable model sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 提出将白质纤维取向分布(WM-FOD)与SE(3)等变CNN结合的可解释脑龄预测框架，在HCP-Aging 692人上达到MAE 3.54年、r=0.958。
AI.motivation: 现有dMRI脑龄预测多用DTI标量指标，丢失取向信息；常规CNN也未显式尊重取向依赖特征的几何结构，缺乏旋转等变性与解剖可解释性。
AI.method: 以WM-FOD的球谐(SH)系数为网络直接输入，采用SE(3)等变CNN，使特征在旋转下保持正确的变换性质；在HCP-Aging 692名36-90岁参与者上评估，并用逐纤维束遮挡(tract-level occlusion)分析敏感性。
AI.result: 框架优于所评估的DTI模型与传统CNN；五折交叉验证模型平均集成后MAE=3.54年、Pearson r=0.958；性能优势依赖于FOD与等变处理的结合；精度在Lmax=2时最高，更高阶下降；遮挡分析显示年龄依赖敏感性峰值：36-44岁额叶投射通路、45-54岁穹窿、55-64岁胼胝体峡部、65-74岁小脑中脚、75-90岁胼胝体膝部。
AI.conclusion: 旋转等变的WM-FOD处理可实现高精度且解剖可解释的脑龄预测，支持将等变深度学习用于取向敏感弥散特征。

title: Efficient Multi-modal Video Fusion Network with Dynamic Region-Guided Temporal Interaction
summary: Multi-modal video fusion aims to generate temporally coherent videos with salient targets and rich structural details by integrating complementary information from heterogeneous sensors. However, existing video fusion methods commonly rely on optical flow estimation and feature warping for inter-frame alignment and cross-frame information aggregation to maintain temporal consistency, thereby introducing considerable computational overhead and making the fusion performance vulnerable to flow estimation errors. To address these limitations, this paper proposes an efficient multi-modal video fusion network with dynamic region-guided temporal interaction. Specifically, the proposed spatio-temporal interaction module leverages the Test-Time Training paradigm to model temporal dependencies with linear complexity. Building on this design, the module restricts temporal modeling to key dynamic regions in the video sequence, as static background regions provide limited temporal cues. By excluding low-variation tokens from unnecessary temporal interaction, this selective strategy contributes to improved fusion quality and temporal consistency. In addition, leveraging the strong ability of pretrained MAE features to capture global structural dependencies, we introduce a feature-level temporal consistency constraint to suppress local flickering by aligning the inter-frame variation directions of the fused and source videos. We further propose a new MAE-based temporal metric that quantifies directional distance between their temporal variations within dynamic regions. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared with existing state-of-the-art methods, our method achieves superior fusion quality and temporal consistency on multiple benchmark datasets, while exhibiting high computational efficiency under edge-device deployment settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效多模态视频融合网络，利用测试时训练（TTT）在线性复杂度下建模时序依赖，并将时序交互限制在动态区域，配合基于MAE特征的时序一致性约束与新指标。
AI.motivation: 现有视频融合方法依赖光流估计与特征扭曲做帧间对齐和跨帧聚合，计算开销大且性能对光流误差敏感。
AI.method: 1) 时空交互模块采用Test-Time Training范式以线性复杂度建模时序依赖；2) 动态区域引导：排除低变化token，仅在关键动态区域做时序交互；3) 借助预训练MAE特征的全局结构建模能力，提出特征级时序一致性约束，对齐融合视频与源视频的帧间变化方向以抑制局部闪烁；4) 提出基于MAE的动态区域时序变化方向距离度量指标。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，融合质量与时序一致性优于现有SOTA方法，且在边缘设备部署下具高计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 以动态区域引导的轻量时序交互替代光流扭曲，可在保证融合质量与时序一致性的同时显著提升效率，并配套提出MAE时序指标用于评价。

title: FGD2HF: Frequency-guided Dual-domain Hypergraph Fusion for Semantic Segmentation
summary: Frequency-domain information is beneficial for semantic segmentation. However, existing frequency-based methods often suffer from insufficient frequency utilization, inefficient fusion, and high computational complexity. To address these issues, we propose FGD2HF, a dual-domain fusion network that leverages frequency features to guide spatial-domain fusion and enhancement. Specifically, we introduce a novel Hybrid-Attention Encoder (NAHA) that jointly models local and global relationships through neighborhood and hypergraph attention, enhancing the network's ability to extract effective features. We further introduce a Wavelet Transform and Enhancement (WTE) module to extract and refine low- and high-frequency cues from preceding-stage features, followed by Frequency-guided Dual-domain Fusion (FGDF) modules that use frequency cues to condition current-stage spatial grouping and feature propagation. This design incorporates both global and local frequency guidance into spatial feature modulation, enhancement and fusion with low computational cost. Extensive comparisons with numerous state-of-the-art semantic segmentation methods demonstrate that our method is highly competitive. Our full FGD2HF-B model achieves 48.7% mIoU on ADE20K (+0.3% over SegMAN-B with 18% fewer GFLOPs), 83.2% mIoU on Cityscapes (comparable to SegMAN-B with 21% fewer GFLOPs), and 1.1% higher mIoU than VWFormer-T on SBD with 21% fewer GFLOPs, while also achieving significant improvements in boundary segmentation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出FGD2HF双域融合网络，用频域特征引导空域融合与增强，在语义分割上以更低计算量取得有竞争力的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于频域的分割方法存在频域信息利用不充分、融合效率低、计算复杂度高的问题。
AI.method: 包含三个核心组件：(1) 邻域-超图混合注意力编码器(NAHA)，通过邻域注意力与超图注意力联合建模局部与全局关系；(2) 小波变换与增强模块(WTE)，从前一阶段特征中提取并精炼低频与高频线索；(3) 频域引导双域融合模块(FGDF)，以频域线索条件化当前阶段的空域分组与特征传播，将全局与局部频域引导引入空域特征调制、增强与融合。
AI.result: ADE20K上48.7% mIoU（较SegMAN-B +0.3%，GFLOPs少18%）；Cityscapes上83.2% mIoU（与SegMAN-B相当，GFLOPs少21%）；SBD上较VWFormer-T高1.1% mIoU（GFLOPs少21%），边界分割精度亦有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 双域融合并以频域引导空域融合的设计可在低计算成本下有效提升语义分割精度与边界质量，整体优于多种SOTA方法。

title: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
summary: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. However, prevailing methods largely rely on explicit requests while miss the implicit user intent (e.g., "where should I click next?" while a user navigate a website), meanwhile fail to update the state simultaneously as user requests might update continuously. These limitations make them less suited to intent-aware interaction in practical. To address these challenges, we introduce StreamVibe-Bench, a new benchmark serving as testbed for user intent interaction, with 4.1K evaluation samples and 85K training samples spanning explicit, implicit, and dynamic intents. Building on this benchmark, we develop StreamVibe-VL, a streaming proactive model that infers implicit user intents from continuous observations and dynamically tailors its interactions as these intents evolve. We further introduce StreamVibe-Harness, which maintains user intents as persistent states with a fleixble lifecycles via a hierarchical memory to track the latest user intent and environmental state. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (i) StreamVibe-VL preserves strong general video understanding while improving response timing and answer quality by 10.7% over other baselines; (ii) existing proactive models remain limited in understanding user intent and deciding when to respond, especially under implicit and dynamic intents; and (iii) StreamVibe-Harness further improves response consistency and adaptation over sustained interaction, resulting in a 12.3% gain in proactive interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出StreamVibe-Bench（4.1K评测/85K训练样本，覆盖显式、隐式、动态意图）、流式主动模型StreamVibe-VL与层级记忆维护意图状态的StreamVibe-Harness，在保持通用视频理解的同时，响应时机与答案质量提升10.7%，持续交互下主动交互再提升12.3%。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型正从离线被动理解转向在线主动交互，但现有方法主要依赖显式请求，忽略隐式用户意图（如浏览网页时的"下一步该点哪"），且难以在请求持续变化时同步更新状态，因此不适用于实际场景中的意图感知交互。
AI.method: 构建StreamVibe-Bench基准（4.1K评测样本、85K训练样本，涵盖显式/隐式/动态意图）；提出流式主动模型StreamVibe-VL，从连续观测中推断隐式意图并随意图演化动态调整交互；引入StreamVibe-Harness，通过层级记忆将用户意图维护为具有灵活生命周期的持久状态，跟踪最新意图与环境状态。
AI.result: (i) StreamVibe-VL在保持强通用视频理解能力的同时，响应时机与答案质量较基线提升10.7%；(ii) 现有主动模型在理解用户意图与决定响应时机上仍受限，隐式与动态意图下尤为明显；(iii) StreamVibe-Harness在持续交互中进一步提升响应一致性与适应性，主动交互增益12.3%。
AI.conclusion: 面向在线主动交互，需同时建模隐式意图与意图动态演化，并以持久状态化记忆支撑；该工作提供了基准、模型与状态管理框架三位一体的方案，验证了意图感知流式交互的有效性，并揭示了现有主动模型的关键短板。

title: A Computationally Efficient Non-Interpolation Virtual Trellis Approach for Mammogram Gradient-based Patterns Analysis
summary: Feature analysis is a crucial step in medical image analysis, particularly in breast cancer classification. Traditional image analysis methods often struggle with optimal patterns along the diagonal axis, computational efficiency and feature buffer storage. Different classical operators require high-efficiency hardware for the complex operations, such as image convolution and gradient analysis, which are used for processing complex machine learning models for training and test operations. Here, in this research, we introduce a non-interpolation virtual trellis-based (NVHT) operator that utilizes a filter kernel over the same square image without transformation to a hexagonal trellis. This proposed method is very efficient in reducing computational and storage costs. The proposed operator is used for improved feature extraction efficiency and accuracy in disease classification. This method outperforms conventional approaches by leveraging a hexagonal pixel representation while maintaining high sensitivity in different directions with less storage.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免插值虚拟六角网格（NVHT）算子，直接在方形图像上使用滤波核模拟六角像素表示，无需变换到六角网格，从而降低计算与存储开销并提升乳腺肿瘤分类的特征提取效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分析（尤其乳腺癌分类）中，传统图像分析方法在斜对角方向最优模式提取、计算效率和特征缓冲区存储方面存在不足；经典算子（如图像卷积、梯度分析）计算复杂，需要高成本硬件支持复杂机器学习模型的训练与测试。
AI.method: 设计非插值虚拟网格（NVHT）算子：在原始方形图像的同一网格上直接施加滤波核，通过虚拟方式获得六角像素表示，而无需插值或显式变换到六角形网格；利用该算子进行特征提取以用于疾病分类。
AI.result: 该算子显著降低计算与存储成本，提高特征提取效率和分类精度；在保持多方向高敏感性的同时减少存储需求，性能优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过虚拟六角像素表示替代显式六角网格变换，NVHT 算子在不增加插值开销的前提下兼顾了方向敏感性与资源效率，为医学图像特征分析与乳腺癌分类提供了一种轻量高效的方案。

title: Birth-Death Structural Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a standard representation for real-time novel-view synthesis. Yet, its quality-efficiency trade-off still relies heavily on adaptive density control. Existing cloning, splitting, and pruning rules use proxy signals, such as position gradients, opacity, and image-space error. Although effective in practice, these signals do not directly answer the structural question behind density control: where should new Gaussians be allocated to reduce the multi-view reconstruction loss, and which existing primitives can be pruned with minimal penalty. To address this, we propose first-variation birth-death control for 3DGS, a principled approach that replaces heuristic structural decisions with a variational score derived from the reconstruction loss. At each structural update, we freeze the current Gaussian population, attach auxiliary mass coordinates to each primitive, and differentiate the multiview loss with respect to these coordinates. We demonstrate that this score is a coordinate of the first variation of the Splat Regression Model, giving a rigorous local descent surrogate for birth-death moves: high-score Gaussians are selected as birth sites, while low-score, low-opacity Gaussians are selected for removal. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, integrating this score into 3DGS-MCMC yields state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and outperforms existing methods, delivering the most significant gains under tight Gaussian budgets. Ultimately, our work provides compelling evidence that gradient-based variational metrics offer a principled alternative to proxy heuristics in 3DGS.

AI.tldr: 提出first-variation birth-death control，用重构损失的一阶变分得分替代位置梯度、不透明度等代理启发式信号，指导3DGS的克隆/分裂/剪枝，集成进3DGS-MCMC后在标准基准上取得SOTA，低高斯预算下增益最显著。
AI.motivation: 3DGS的质量-效率权衡高度依赖自适应密度控制，但现有克隆、分裂、剪枝规则使用位置梯度、不透明度、图像空间误差等代理信号，无法直接回答密度控制的结构性问题：应在哪里新增高斯以降低多视图重构损失，以及哪些基元可在最小惩罚下被剪枝。
AI.method: 在每次结构更新时冻结当前高斯种群，为每个基元附加辅助质量坐标，并对多视图损失关于这些坐标求导，得到变分得分；证明该得分是Splat Regression Model一阶变分的坐标，从而构成birth-death操作的严格局部下降代理：高分高斯作为出生位点，低分且低不透明度高斯被移除。
AI.result: 在标准3DGS基准上，将该得分集成到3DGS-MCMC中，取得SOTA重构质量并优于现有方法，在高斯预算紧张时增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 基于梯度的变分度量可作为3DGS中代理启发式方法的有原则替代方案。

title: CrossPair: Unlocking Generalist Visual Transformation Learning in Image Editors
summary: Language models switch tasks from demonstrations, but vision still often relies on separate systems for restoration, editing, and stylization. A before--after example offers a shared instruction only if the transferable change can be separated from the scene that demonstrates it. We introduce CrossPair, which adapts a pretrained multimodal image editor to transfer diverse transformations from one exemplar pair. Exemplar-before, exemplar-after, and query images take fixed roles in its native VLM and VAE pathways: the VLM extracts operation semantics, while the VAE retains fine appearance and structure. A training-only, change-aware DINOv3 objective aligns feature-change directions across content-distinct scenes, guiding the output to follow the demonstrated relation without an inference-time encoder. We construct Transform-360K by grouping filtered pairs from conditional representations, restoration, editing, virtual try-on, and stylization under shared transformations. On Relation252K-derived seen and held-out transformations, \method improves target agreement and edit-direction similarity over released systems. Ablations show that the semantic and visual exemplar routes are complementary and that DINO relation alignment further strengthens transfer; Transform-360K training also improves aggregate held-out-operation scores.

AI.tldr: 提出 CrossPair，将预训练多模态图像编辑器改造为"示例对驱动的通用变换迁移"系统，用 VLM 提取操作语义、VAE 保留外观与结构，并以训练期 DINOv3 变化对齐目标实现跨场景的关系迁移，同时构建 Transform-360K 数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉任务多依赖修复、编辑、风格化等分离系统，而语言模型已能凭示例切换任务。前-后示例对只有在"可迁移的变化"能被从示例场景中解耦时，才构成共享指令，这正是一对示例泛化到查询图像的核心难点。
AI.method: 在预训练多模态编辑器的原生 VLM 与 VAE 双通路中固定角色分配：示例前图、示例后图、查询图各司其职，VLM 提取操作语义，VAE 保留细粒度外观与结构；引入仅在训练期生效的变化感知 DINOv3 目标，跨内容不同场景对齐特征变化方向，从而无需推理期编码器即可引导输出遵循示例关系。
AI.result: 在 Relation252K 派生的已见与留出变换上，目标一致性和编辑方向相似度均优于已发布系统；消融显示语义通路与视觉示例通路互补，DINO 关系对齐进一步增强迁移；Transform-360K 训练也提升留出操作的聚合得分。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦"变化关系"与"示例内容"是对示例对迁移的关键，语义-视觉双路示例注入与训练期关系对齐可统一多种视觉变换任务，且大规模分组式数据构建可泛化到未见操作。

title: Do Words Matter? What Text Contributes to Few and Full-Shot Vision-Language Anomaly Detection
summary: Vision-language anomaly detectors describe normal and abnormal appearance with text, and their gains are commonly credited to the semantic content of these descriptions. This attribution is plausible in the zero-shot setting, but few- and full-shot detectors interpose a trained visual adapter, and in that setting it has not been isolated. Changing a description changes both its meaning and its geometry, so accuracy comparisons cannot separate the two. We ask what a fixed pair of text embeddings, or anchors, contributes to such a detector: semantic content, effective scale, or joint anchor geometry. For a single anchor pair, the answer is effective scale alone. The score reads the anchors only through their difference, and a trained adapter can rotate to follow any replacement direction, leaving that direction, and with it the linguistic content, unidentifiable. We prove that replacement anchors with the same difference-vector length permit exactly the same probability maps and attainable losses. Across seven medical datasets, three vision backbones, both supervision regimes, and three adapter families, scale-matched random and orthogonal anchors track correct prompts; breaking the scale match opens a gap that restoring it closes without text. The same pattern holds in MVFA and when MadCLIP's learned prompts are replaced by a text-free learned scale. When one adapter serves many categories, the answer expands to their joint arrangement. Rotating all category axes together changes nothing, as predicted. For the tested CLIP prompts, these axes are nearly collinear, and meaning-free rotations that spread them apart improve performance on both industrial benchmarks. Even under frozen zero-shot transfer, a random anchor frame transfers as well as the prompt frame: coordinate consistency, not meaning. What these detectors read from their prompts is scale and arrangement, not semantic content.

AI.tldr: 在few-shot/full-shot视觉-语言异常检测器中，文本锚点（prompt嵌入）所提供的并非语义内容，而是其有效尺度（单锚点对情形）与多类锚点的联合几何排布；匹配尺度的随机或正交锚点可与正确prompt等效。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言异常检测器普遍将性能收益归因于文本描述的语义内容，但当检测器引入可训练视觉适配器后，描述同时改变语义与几何，准确率比较无法分离二者；作者希望在few-shot/full-shot设定下单独隔离文本嵌入中语义、有效尺度与联合锚点几何各自的贡献。
AI.method: 理论分析：指出现有评分仅通过两锚点的差向量读取锚点，训练后的适配器可旋转以跟随任意替代方向，故方向及语义不可辨识；证明差向量长度相同的替代锚点可产生完全相同的概率图与可达损失。实验上在7个医学数据集、3种视觉骨干、两种监督范式、3类适配器家族中，用尺度匹配的随机/正交锚点替换正确prompt；并在MVFA中验证，将MadCLIP的可学习prompt替换为无语义的可学习尺度。多类别共享适配器情形下，进一步检验类别轴的整体旋转不变性与近共线性假设，并在工业基准上用无语义旋转分散轴。
AI.result: 尺度匹配的随机与正交锚点可追踪正确prompt的表现；打破尺度匹配则出现性能差距，仅恢复尺度即可弥合（无需文本）。MVFA中同样成立，MadCLIP的可学习prompt可被无语义可学习尺度替代。整体旋转所有类别轴无影响（与理论预测一致）；测试的CLIP prompt类别轴近似共线，无语义的散开旋转在两个工业基准上均带来提升。冻结零样本迁移下，随机锚点框架的迁移效果与prompt框架相当，说明起作用的是坐标一致性而非语义。
AI.conclusion: 此类检测器从prompt中读取的是尺度与排布（锚点几何），而非语义内容；语义归因在few-shot/full-shot设定下不成立，为文本提示的设计与评估提供了新的解释与改进方向。

title: PhysCreator: Creating Physically-Attributed 3D Assets at Will
summary: Significant advancements in 3D asset creation have enabled high-fidelity 3D generation from images. However, most existing representations remain inherently static, lacking the ability to model physically plausible behaviors under dynamic interactions. We present \textbf{PhysCreator}, a unified framework that directly generates simulation-ready 3D representations with spatially varying physical properties from images. Unlike prior approaches that treat physical attributes as simple post-hoc predictions or rely on expensive per-instance optimization, we reformulate physical property estimation within a unified 3D representation learning framework. We introduce a voxel-aligned latent space by lifting image observations into a spatially structured 3D representation, in which geometry, appearance, and physical properties are jointly modeled and inferred in a feed-forward manner. To enable scalable learning without densely annotated physical ground truth, we leverage vision-language distillation to transfer material-aware semantic priors from powerful vision-language models into spatially grounded voxel-level supervision. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior visual quality, physical plausibility, and generalization compared to prior approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出PhysCreator，一个从图像直接生成可仿真三维表示的统一框架，通过体素对齐隐空间与视觉语言蒸馏，联合建模几何、外观与空间变化的物理属性，实现前馈式物理属性估计。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到3D生成的高保真表示本质上是静态的，无法在动态交互下建模物理合理行为；已有物理属性方法多将物理量视为事后简单预测，或依赖昂贵的逐实例优化，缺乏统一的、可扩展的学习范式。
AI.method: 将图像观测提升为空间结构化的3D表示，构建体素对齐隐空间，在其中以统一表征学习框架前馈式联合推断几何、外观与物理属性；为避免稠密物理真值标注，采用视觉语言蒸馏，将视觉语言模型中的材质感知语义先验迁移为空间落地的体素级监督。
AI.result: 实验表明，相较已有方法，本方法在视觉质量、物理合理性与泛化能力上均取得更优表现。
AI.conclusion: 物理属性估计可被重构为统一3D表示学习问题，结合体素对齐隐空间与视觉语言蒸馏，能够高效、可扩展地生成仿真就绪、具空间变化物理属性的3D资产。

title: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
summary: Browser agents do not just need more practice. They need to practice the right things. We introduce MiniWeb, a realistic miniature of the web comprising 65 interconnected websites across 15 domains, where agents navigate, search, and transact as people do. Its 369 human-annotated tasks cover everyday workflows and label 37 reusable interaction primitives grouped into 7 skill families, allowing us to diagnose which skills fail rather than only whether a task succeeds. Benchmarking ten open-weight agents, we find that drag & gesture is consistently the weakest family, with no agent solving more than 24% of its instances. To address this gap, we introduce MiniWebGen, a framework that autonomously generates verified, skill-centric training data from MiniWeb. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 3.1K verified trajectories improves single-primitive success by 24.9pp across 13 unseen websites, with gains across every skill family. However, these trajectories teach short-horizon interactions, which do not directly translate to full-task success. We build on this result with MiniWebAgent, which pairs the trained executor with a planner that decomposes full tasks into the skill-level steps it learned to perform. This approach improves task success by 19.4pp points on unseen MiniWeb sites and transfers to external benchmarks, with gains of 9.3pp on WebArena-Lite, 16.1pp on Online-Mind2Web, and 20.0pp on WebVoyager, without training on their trajectories. We provide a simple recipe for compact browser agents: practice reusable skills directly, then compose them to solve unfamiliar tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出MiniWeb基准与MiniWebGen训练数据生成框架，主张浏览器智能体应先直接练习可复用交互技能再组合成完整任务；微调Qwen3.5-4B后单技能成功率提升24.9pp，配合规划器后任务成功率提升19.4pp并迁移至外部基准。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览器智能体的训练缺少"练对的东西"：仅以任务成败评估，无法诊断具体哪类交互技能失败，且缺乏技能导向的高质量训练数据。
AI.method: (1) 构建MiniWeb：65个互联网站、覆盖15个领域、369个人工标注任务，并标注37个可复用交互原语，归为7个技能族；(2) 在MiniWeb上基准测试10个开放权重智能体；(3) 提出MiniWebGen，从MiniWeb自动生成经校验的技能中心训练数据；(4) 用3.1K条验证轨迹微调Qwen3.5-4B作为执行器，并构建MiniWebAgent：执行器+将完整任务分解为技能级步骤的规划器。
AI.result: 拖拽与手势族为最弱技能，无智能体解决率超过24%；微调后在13个未见网站上单原语成功率提升24.9pp且各技能族均有增益，但短时程交互未直接转化为整任务成功；MiniWebAgent在未见MiniWeb站点上任务成功率提升19.4pp，并零轨迹迁移至WebArena-Lite（+9.3pp）、Online-Mind2Web（+16.1pp）、WebVoyager（+20.0pp）。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑型浏览器智能体的有效配方是：直接练习可复用技能，再组合以解决陌生任务；技能级诊断与技能中心数据生成是提升泛化能力的关键。

title: Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark: A mechanically annotated dataset for evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction
comment: 34 pages, including 5 pages of Supplementary Methods; 10 main-text figures and 1 supplementary figure
summary: Evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction requires ground truth linking camera motion, surface deformation, material correspondence and image appearance. We introduce the Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark, generated with LumenMorph, an open-source toolkit for creating, annotating and evaluating tubular scenes. The release contains 5,580 RGB images. Its baseline crosses three surface-motion conditions with moving and stationary cameras in six scene families; matched appearance variants cover only moving-camera finite-element actions in four families. Documented public and evaluation interfaces expose camera poses, geometry, depth, deformation fields, persistent material correspondences and discrete finite-element records. Persistent triangle identities and material weights let users track the same surface location across frames and query its three-dimensional trajectory. Separately implemented geometric and mechanical checks assess annotation consistency with the generating models. Structure-from-motion, optical-flow and supplied-geometry displacement-interpolation studies demonstrate how the resource distinguishes registration coverage from geometric accuracy, exposes camera- and surface-motion effects, and tests the benefits and mismatch of mechanical priors. Public readers, evaluation contracts and the configurable generator support reuse and extension. Data integrity, fixed-environment repeatability and retained-prediction score replay have distinct verification scopes. The benchmark provides a controlled synthetic reference without claiming anatomical or clinical realism.

AI.tldr: 提出合成可变形管状基准（Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark），基于开源工具LumenMorph生成5,580幅RGB图像，提供相机位姿、几何、深度、变形场、持续材质对应及有限元记录等标注，并以SfM、光流和位移插值实验验证其可用于区分配准覆盖度与几何精度。
AI.motivation: 评估可变形3D重建需要同时关联相机运动、表面形变、材质对应与图像外观的真值，而现有数据难以提供如此完整、可追溯的标注，故构建受控合成基准以支撑该评估需求。
AI.method: 发布LumenMorph开源工具包，用于创建、标注和评估管状场景。数据包含5,580幅RGB图像；基线将三种表面运动条件与相机运动/静止交叉，覆盖六个场景族；匹配外观变体仅覆盖四个场景族中相机运动下的有限元动作。公开文档与评估接口给出相机位姿、几何、深度、变形场、持续材质对应和离散有限元记录；持久三角形身份与材质权重支持跨帧追踪同一表面点及其三维轨迹；另有独立的几何与力学一致性检查。
AI.result: SfM、光流与基于给定几何的位移插值实验表明：该资源可区分配准覆盖度与几何精度，揭示相机运动与表面运动效应，并可检验力学先验的收益与失配。数据完整性、固定环境可重复性及保留预测的分数回放各有独立验证范围。
AI.conclusion: 该基准提供受控的合成参考，支持复用与扩展，但不主张解剖学或临床真实性。

title: Targeted Deep Regression - Initial Applications in Whole-Body Water-Fat MRI in UK Biobank
summary: UK Biobank is a British clinical study which, in addition to large amounts of medical data collected, plans to include detailed Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examina- tions from 100,000 participants. The image data can be analyzed for example by auto- mated analysis with neural networks for image segmentation or classification to expand the collection of image-derived phenotypes for medical research. In this work, we pro- pose, present and evaluate a methodology that uses image-based regression to estimate numerical properties from the collected neck-to-knee water-fat MRI scans. It applies a ResNet50-style network to 2D multi-channel collages that represent targeted and study- specific anatomical sub-regions from the MRI scan. The targeted sub-region sampling is achieved by propagating manually defined subregions from a reference scan to the other >30,000 analyzed scans using image registration. The resulting collages can be compact while retaining high-resolution, for example by providing multiple slices of kidney tissue for a kidney volume regression network. This approach also enables group-wise saliency analysis that highlight image and anatomical regions used by the network for the pre- dictions. The method was applied for the regression endpoints of kidney volume, heart volume, and age. Predictive performance was found between R2 = 0.731-0.984 and the group-wise saliency maps were found to highlight medically relevant regions. We con- clude that the method can be used to standardize and restrict the information presented to a deep regression analysis pipeline, increasing information density and opening up a wide range of future medical inference studies.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于图像回归的方法，将颈至膝水脂MRI经配准定位的解剖子区域采样为2D多通道拼图，用ResNet50网络估计肾体积、心脏体积和年龄，R²为0.731–0.984，并通过组级显著性图验证网络关注医学相关区域。
AI.motivation: UK Biobank计划对10万参与者进行详细MRI扫描，需通过神经网络自动化分析扩展影像衍生表型（IDP）；但高维全扫描数据信息密度低、计算代价高，需一种标准化且信息密集的输入表示方式以支撑深度回归与后续医学推断研究。
AI.method: 利用图像配准将参考扫描中人工定义的子区域传播至其余3万余例扫描，实现目标化子区域采样；将子区域切片组织为2D多通道拼图（如多个肾脏切片）以在小体积下保留高分辨率；采用ResNet50风格网络进行回归；并对预测结果做组级显著性分析以定位网络依赖的解剖区域。
AI.result: 在肾脏体积、心脏体积与年龄三个回归端点上预测性能R²=0.731–0.984；组级显著性图凸显出医学上相关的解剖区域，表明网络决策具有解剖可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可标准化并约束输入深度回归管线的信息，提高信息密度，具备可解释性证据，并为广泛的后续医学推断研究提供可扩展范式。

title: Low-rank MERA Decomposition of 3D OCT Image Volume for Compression, Denoising, Feature Extraction and Diagnosis of Retinal Diseases
summary: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive imaging modality used for visualization of retinal tissue. However, OCT volumes are affected by speckle noise, which degrades image contrast and obscures fine structural details. Furthermore, modern clinical practice requires large field-of-view, high-resolution OCT volumes, whose storage and transmission are demanding for archiving and teleophthalmology applications. To address aforementioned challenges, we propose a low-rank multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA) tensor network approximation of 3D OCT image volume, where the image volume is represented as contractions of a top core factor encoding global features and multiple interacting low-rank orthogonal or semi-orthogonal factors modeling inter- and intra-B scan correlations. This representation jointly enables compression, denoising, and feature extraction. Unlike deep learning approaches, the proposed approach is training-free and processes each OCT volume independently. We evaluate the proposed framework on OCT image volumes acquired by two different scanners and demonstrate improved visual quality and reduced retinal layer segmentation errors in comparison with several competing methods. We also extract MERA features from two clinical OCT volume datasets. They are subsequently classified using a Grassmann-manifold nearest-subspace classifier. With the subspace dimension as its only hyperparameter, the classifier is theoretically shown to be robust in small-sample clinical scenario. We demonstrate competitive accuracy of classification of retinal diseases in these small-sample settings, where deep learning methods are often limited by the scarcity of labeled data. The proposed structure-aware model-driven representation learning for high-dimensional data under limited supervision provides good generalization performance while maintaining high interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出基于低秩MERA张量网络的3D OCT体数据表示方法，统一实现压缩、去噪与特征提取，无需训练，并结合Grassmann流形最近子空间分类器用于小样本视网膜疾病分类。
AI.motivation: OCT体数据受散斑噪声影响，对比度下降、细节模糊；临床需要大视野高分辨率体积，存储与传输负担重（存档、远程眼科）；深度学习依赖大量标注且泛化与可解释性受限。
AI.method: 将3D OCT体积表示为MERA张量网络近似：顶层核心因子编码全局特征，多个相互作用的低秩正交/半正交因子建模B-scan间与B-scan内相关性；训练-free、逐个体数据独立处理。特征送入以子空间维度为唯一超参的Grassmann流形最近子空间分类器。
AI.result: 在两台扫描仪采集的OCT体积上，视觉质量提升、视网膜层分割误差降低，优于多个对比方法；在两个临床数据集上小样本分类精度具竞争力，理论上证明分类器在小样本场景的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 面向有限监督的高维数据，结构感知、模型驱动的表示学习在保持高可解释性的同时具良好泛化性能。

title: Sexual dimorphism and sex-specific features of pediatric hand bone shapes via statistical shape modeling
summary: Understanding the envelope of shape variation encompassing both sexual dimorphism and growth-related changes in living tissue is a non-trivial task. In this work, we use statistical shape models (SSMs) and analyze demographic-stratified shape parameters to quantify sexual dimorphism and sex-specific shape changes. To this end, we developed a two-stage detection-segmentation framework that accurately segmented $n = 27664$ unique bone masks from a radiographic dataset of $n = 1456$ subjects with diverse ages and sexes (HD95 = $1.512 \pm 0.005$, ASSD $0.449 \pm 001$, Dice = $0.987 \pm 0.00004$, IoU = $0.975 \pm 0.0001$). Following SSM fitting, our follow-up analyses of stratified shape parameters highlighted the morphology of sexual dimorphisms for each bone and demonstrated sex-specific differences in shape development. Our results were consistent with existing literature and provided an unambiguous, data-driven methodology for characterizing tissue shape and its population-scale variation. This approach provides a potential methodological foundation for developing population-based models of anatomical variation and could be extended to investigate tissue growth and shape changes over time. Future work should evaluate the applicability of this methodology on alternative anatomical structures and imaging modalities, with the goal of validating these growth trajectories on longitudinal data.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"两阶段检测-分割"框架，从放射影像中高精度分割骨掩膜，结合统计形状模型(SSM)与人群分层分析，量化骨骼的性二态性与性别特异性的形状发育变化。
AI.motivation: 同时涵盖性二态与生长相关变化的组织形状变异包络难以刻画，缺乏数据驱动的群体尺度方法，故提出系统化框架予以建模。
AI.method: 两阶段检测-分割框架，分割1456名不同年龄与性别受试者的27664个骨掩膜（HD95=1.512±0.005，ASSD=0.449，Dice=0.987，IoU=0.975）；随后进行SSM拟合，并按人口学分层分析形状参数，考察各骨性二态形态及性别特异的发育差异。
AI.result: 分层形状参数分析显示了各骨的性二态形态，并揭示形状发育中的性别特异性差异，结果与既有文献一致。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种无歧义、数据驱动的组织形状及群体尺度变异刻画方法，可为群体解剖变异模型奠定方法学基础；未来需在其它解剖结构与成像模态上验证，并用纵向数据检验生长轨迹。

title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Self-Supervised Representation Forcing for Few-Step Video Generation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://sotamak1r.github.io/SF2-web/
summary: Few-step distillation is essential for deploying modern video diffusion models. Among existing approaches, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a highly promising paradigm by achieving strong output-space fidelity without adversarial training, while remaining flexible across various student architectures. We observe, however, that DMD fundamentally relies on an output-space objective, lacking explicit regularization on the model's internal representations. As the distillation step count aggressively shrinks, this output-only supervision becomes insufficient, causing the distilled student to degrade in both fine-grained spatial structures and coherent temporal dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Self Flow Forcing (SF$^2$), which incorporates a predictive representation loss into the DMD framework without altering its output objective. By providing the student and an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) teacher with heterogeneous noise levels, we establish an information asymmetry. This formulation forces the student to predict the teacher's internal representations from a more corrupted input, effectively integrating self-supervised representation alignment into distribution matching. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SF$^2$ effectively mitigates temporal flickering and consistently improves both spatial fidelity and motion quality. Furthermore, the proposed mechanism is architecture-agnostic - seamlessly supporting both bidirectional and causal models - and requires no external feature extractors, introducing minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出 Self Flow Forcing (SF²)，在 DMD 蒸馏框架中引入基于 EMA 教师的预测性表征损失，以信息不对称方式实现自监督表征对齐，缓解少步视频扩散蒸馏的时空退化。
AI.motivation: 现有 DMD 少步蒸馏仅依赖输出空间目标，缺乏对内部表征的显式正则；当蒸馏步数极度压缩时，仅输出监督不足，导致学生模型在细粒度空间结构与时间动态一致性上退化（闪烁）。
AI.method: 在保持 DMD 输出目标不变的前提下，额外加入预测性表征损失：对学生与 EMA 教师施加异质噪声水平（学生输入更"损坏"），形成信息不对称，迫使学生从更高噪声输入预测教师的内部表征，将自监督表征对齐融入分布匹配；无需外部特征提取器。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SF² 有效缓解时间闪烁，并持续提升空间保真度与运动质量；该机制与架构无关，可无缝支持双向与因果（causal）模型，计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: SF² 通过信息不对称的表征级自监督对齐补足 DMD 输出空间监督的不足，是一种架构无关、低开销的少步视频扩散蒸馏增强方案，兼顾空间保真与时间一致性。

title: HiFiPix: Bringing High-Fidelity Real-World Super-Resolution Back to Pixel Space
summary: Diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution suffers from limited reconstruction fidelity due to information loss in VAE-based latent representations. Recently, pixel-space diffusion models offer a promising high-faithfulness alternative by avoiding latent compression, but adapting them to Real-ISR remains challenging due to inherent patch boundary artifacts and degraded generative capability. To address the issues and maximize the potential of pretrained pixel-space diffusion models, we propose HiFiPix, a pixel-space Real-ISR framework capable of ultra high-fidelity reconstruction and fine-grained visual generation effects. To suppress patch boundary artifacts, we penalize unrealistic high-frequency periodic components with a Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CWSD) for image-level supervision, and Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation (MixCSD) for intermediate representation regularization. Furthermore, we uncover a heterogeneous generation-fidelity trade-off across low-rank adapters (LoRA) and propose Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) to adaptively prune LoRA layers, enhancing generative capability with minimal deterioration of reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiFiPix consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art latent space methods in terms of both restoration accuracy and perceptual quality by a large margin. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: HiFiPix：面向真实图像超分（Real-ISR）的像素空间扩散框架，通过跨尺度小波判别器（CWSD）与Mixup对比自蒸馏（MixCSD）抑制patch边界伪影，并提出选择性LoRA剪枝（LoRA-SP）以兼顾生成能力与保真度。
AI.motivation: 基于VAE潜空间的扩散式Real-ISR因潜表示的信息损失导致重建保真度受限；像素空间扩散模型虽保真度高，但存在patch边界伪影与生成能力退化，难以直接适配Real-ISR。
AI.method: 1) CWSD：以图像级监督惩罚不真实的高频周期性分量，抑制patch间边界伪影；2) MixCSD：对中间表示做Mixup对比自蒸馏正则化；3) 揭示LoRA在生成-保真上的异构权衡，提出LoRA-SP自适应剪枝LoRA层，在保真度轻微下降下提升生成能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HiFiPix在恢复精度与感知质量上均大幅优于现有先进潜空间方法。代码与模型将开源。
AI.conclusion: 验证了预训练像素空间扩散模型在Real-ISR中的潜力，所提伪影抑制与LoRA剪枝策略可同时实现超高保真重建与细粒度生成效果。

title: SG-Splat: Stable Geometry Learning under Pose Uncertainty for Pose-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a promising representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. For practical deployment, recent studies have explored pose-free feed-forward 3DGS, which reconstructs Gaussian representations directly from unposed input images. However, these methods remain sensitive to residual pose errors, which perturb canonical-space Gaussian transformation, introducing noisy supervision for geometry and attribute learning. To address this problem, we present SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that improves robustness to pose uncertainty and stabilizes the learning of Gaussian primitives. SG-Splat decouples geometry estimation and Gaussian attribute prediction into two dedicated branches, reducing error coupling between pose-sensitive geometry and Gaussian attributes. We further introduce a coarse-to-fine refinement pipeline, consisting of Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC), to improve geometric alignment before Gaussian attribute reconstruction. Specifically, FGPR refines camera poses with flow-based correlation features and differentiable bundle adjustment. RGC then corrects initial point maps using depth residuals derived from FGPR, producing more reliable Gaussian centers. To stabilize training, we introduce a dual-path strategy that mixes ground-truth and predicted poses for canonical transformation. It provides clean supervision for Gaussian attributes while improving geometry robustness to residual pose errors. Extensive experiments on DL3DV and RealEstate10K show that SG-Splat achieves state-of-the-art performance in both novel view synthesis and pose estimation.

AI.tldr: SG-Splat：一种对位姿不确定性鲁棒的无位姿前馈3DGS框架，通过双分支解耦、由粗到细的位姿/几何精化与双路径训练策略，稳定高斯图元学习，在DL3DV和RealEstate10K上取得新视角合成与位姿估计的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有无位姿前馈3DGS直接从无位姿图像重建高斯表示，但对残余位姿误差敏感：位姿误差扰动规范空间中的高斯变换，为几何与属性学习引入噪声监督。作者希望提升对位姿不确定性的鲁棒性并稳定高斯基元的学习。
AI.method: 1）将几何估计与高斯属性预测解耦为两个专用分支，降低位姿敏感几何与高斯属性之间的误差耦合；2）引入由粗到细的精化流程：Flow-Guided Pose Refinement（FGPR）使用基于光流的相关特征与可微捆绑调整精化相机位姿，Residual-Guided Geometry Correction（RGC）利用FGPR得到的深度残差修正初始点图，生成更可靠的高斯中心；3）引入双路径训练策略，混合真实位姿与预测位姿进行规范变换，为高斯属性提供干净监督，同时提升几何对残余位姿误差的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在DL3DV和RealEstate10K数据集上的大量实验表明，SG-Splat在新视角合成和位姿估计两项任务上均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: SG-Splat通过解耦式架构、由粗到细的位姿与几何精化以及双路径监督，有效缓解了无位姿前馈3DGS中的位姿误差传播问题，验证了其在实时新视角合成与三维重建实用化部署中的有效性。

title: Evidence-Guided Selection of Retinal Vessel Segmentation Pipelines: A Cross-Dataset Benchmark of Performance, Structure, Failure Modes, and Reproducibility
summary: Retinal vessel segmentation is widely used in retinal image analysis, yet model selection based only on aggregate overlap scores can overlook structural fidelity, cross-dataset robustness, and application-specific error costs. We evaluated five executable binary vessel-segmentation pipelines (FSG-Net, SA-UNetv2, DCP-1024, GAVE, and FR-UNet) on 244 images from six public datasets using pixel-level agreement, cross-dataset stability, thin-vessel retention, structural metrics, error composition, and available computational evidence. Results were aggregated with equal weighting across datasets. No pipeline was optimal in every setting. FSG-Net achieved the highest equal-dataset mean Macro-F1 (0.77), IoU (0.63), clDice (0.83), and Skeleton F1 (0.78), whereas SA-UNetv2 achieved the highest mean sensitivity (0.85) and Thin-Vessel Sensitivity (0.63). Differences across datasets were often larger than those among the leading pipelines, and errors shared by all five methods were concentrated near annotated vessel boundaries and faint peripheral vessels. In an ancillary analysis on 45 HRF images, segmentation masks were converted into 11 ring-wise vascular features for leave-one-out classification. Controlled perturbations showed that local mask errors can be amplified in downstream features, while targeted stabilization reduced sensitivity for five features. The results support task-conditioned, benchmark-relative pipeline selection rather than a single universal ranking and highlight the need to validate the selected pipeline on the intended target domain.

AI.tldr: 该文在6个公开数据集共244张图像上系统评测5种可执行视网膜血管分割流水线，从像素一致性、跨数据集稳定性、细血管保留、结构指标与误差构成等多维度比较，论证"任务条件下、相对基准"的选型优于单一排名。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖聚合重叠分数（overlap scores）选择模型，会掩盖结构保真度、跨数据集鲁棒性以及具体应用中的差异化误差代价，因此需要多维度、任务导向的评测框架。
AI.method: 对FSG-Net、SA-UNetv2、DCP-1024、GAVE、FR-UNet五种二值血管分割流水线，在6个公开数据集共244张图像上进行评测；指标包括像素级一致性、跨数据集稳定性、细血管敏感度、结构指标（clDice、Skeleton F1）、误差构成及可获得的计算开销证据；结果按数据集等权聚合。另在45张HRF图像上做辅助分析：将分割掩膜转为11个环状血管特征，进行留一法分类，并以受控扰动检验局部掩膜误差在下游特征中的放大效应。
AI.result: 无任一流水线在所有场景最优：FSG-Net取得最高的等数据集均值Macro-F1(0.77)、IoU(0.63)、clDice(0.83)与Skeleton F1(0.78)；SA-UNetv2取得最高平均敏感度(0.85)与细血管敏感度(0.63)。数据集间差异常大于领先方法间差异，五种方法的共性误差集中于标注血管边界附近及微弱周边血管。扰动实验显示局部掩膜误差可在下游特征中被放大，定向稳定化使5个特征敏感度下降。
AI.conclusion: 支持采用任务条件化、基准相对的流水线选择策略，而非单一通用排名；并强调所选流水线须在目标域上重新验证。

title: O2D-MedNet: An Optimization-Aware Dual-Domain Framework for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation (MIS) remains challenging due to composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations, which jointly impair lesion-background separability, structural consistency, and optimization stability. Existing single-stream frameworks entangle heterogeneous cues within a single representation pathway, while hybrid-stream approaches often rely on generic or static fusion, limiting effective coordination across domains and failing to explicitly address optimization instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new optimization-aware dual-domain framework for MIS (O2D-MedNet). First, a degradation-aware dualdomain interaction (DDI) module integrates Fourier - and Wavelet-domain features to suppress degradation-sensitive responses while preserving structural and fine-detail information. Second, a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective interaction between CNN-based local detail modeling and visual state-space-based global structure modeling, improving boundary accuracy and representation consistency. Third, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy stabilizes training by adaptively adjusting learning dynamics based on loss trends and gradient statistics, mitigating instability caused by class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art MIS methods across multiple imaging modalities. Further analyses confirm enhanced sensitivity, structural consistency, and optimization stability, validating the effectiveness of the proposed O2D-MedNet for robust MIS under heterogeneous conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出优化感知双域框架O2D-MedNet，通过DDI双域交互、CGF跨骨干轮廓引导融合和GCO梯度上下文优化三模块，提升医学图像分割在退化与多尺度变化下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割受复合退化与多尺度几何变化影响，病灶-背景可分性、结构一致性和优化稳定性均受损；现有单流框架将异质线索纠缠于单一表征通路，混合流方法多用通用或静态融合，缺乏跨域协同且未显式处理优化不稳定问题。
AI.method: O2D-MedNet含三个组件：(1) 退化感知双域交互（DDI）模块融合傅里叶域与波let域特征，抑制退化敏感响应并保留结构与细节；(2) 跨骨干轮廓引导融合（CGF）模块实现CNN局部细节建模与视觉状态空间全局结构建模的选择性交互；(3) 梯度上下文优化（GCO）策略依据损失趋势与梯度统计自适应调整学习动态，稳定训练。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集、多种成像模态上相比SOTA方法取得一致提升；消融/分析实验证实灵敏度、结构一致性与优化稳定性均增强。
AI.conclusion: O2D-MedNet通过双域交互、跨骨干选择性融合与优化感知训练策略，有效应对异质条件下的鲁棒医学图像分割，验证了显式建模优化稳定性与跨域协同的必要性。

title: Copying As Defense: Protecting Images from Editing By Eliciting Model Copying
summary: Image editors built on diffusion transformers (DiTs), such as Flux Kontext, make it possible to turn a single photograph into a convincing manipulated image, including harmful and non-consensual edits. Proactive defenses aim to prevent such manipulations by adding an imperceptible perturbation before an image is shared. Existing defenses for DiT-based in-context editors make the output attend less to the protected reference image. But this leaves the model free to follow the edit instruction using the text and its own generated tokens, often producing a new, weakly grounded image rather than preventing the edit. We find that the opposite strategy is more effective: instead of leading the model to ignore the reference, we encourage it to copy it. Through controlled attention interventions, we show that concentrating target-token attention on the reference image in only a few early blocks is sufficient to collapse the editing behavior, causing the model to reproduce its input, often as a lossy copy, rather than execute the requested transformation. Based on this insight, we introduce Copying-as-Defense (CaD), which maximizes per-token target-to-reference attention mass in early transformer blocks. Since attention rows are normalized, increasing reference attention suppresses the attention allocated to the text and generated canvas. Restricting the objective to early blocks also lets us truncate the backpropagation path, keeping optimization cheap. Across editors and benchmarks, CaD reduces average edit success from 81.4% on unprotected images to 24.0%, a 70.6% relative reduction, and by a further 44.3% relative to DeContext, the strongest baseline (43.0%). CaD is also roughly 1.8-2.0x faster per optimization step than comparable methods.

AI.tldr: 提出"复制即防御"(CaD)：在DiT上下文编辑器的早期Transformer块中，最大化目标token对参考图像的注意力质量，迫使模型复制输入而非执行编辑指令，从而有效防御图像篡改。
AI.motivation: 基于DiT的图像编辑器（如Flux Kontext）可轻易将单张照片篡改为有害或未经同意的内容。现有主动防御思路是让输出"少关注"受保护的参考图，但这只是让模型转而依赖文本指令与自生成token，仍能产出弱依赖的新图像，未能真正阻止编辑。
AI.method: 核心洞察与现有策略相反：应引导模型"复制"参考图。通过受控注意力干预实验发现，仅在少数早期块中将目标token注意力集中于参考图，即可使编辑行为崩溃。据此设计CaD，最大化早期Transformer块中逐token的"目标→参考"注意力质量；由于注意力行归一化，提升参考注意力会自然压制分配给文本与生成画布的注意力。限定早期块还允许截断反向传播路径，降低优化开销。
AI.result: 在多种编辑器与基准上，CaD将平均编辑成功率从无保护图像的81.4%降至24.0%（相对降低70.6%）；相较最强基线DeContext（43.0%）进一步相对降低44.3%。每步优化速度约为同类方法的1.8–2.0倍。
AI.conclusion: "逆向思维"的复制式防御比抑制参考注意力更有效，为DiT类上下文编辑器的主动防护提供了高效、可迁移的新范式。

title: Metric Scale for Insta360 Structure-from-Motion from the Camera's Embedded IMU
summary: Structure-from-motion (SfM) from the dual-fisheye video of a consumer 360-degree camera recovers geometry only up to a similarity transform; in the pipeline considered here, metric scale is obtained from smartphone ARKit or ARCore poses captured alongside the camera. This paper evaluates a self-contained alternative: the IMU embedded in the Insta360 X5 and X6, recorded at 1 kHz. The sensor is characterised (noise density, camera-IMU synchronisation, accelerometer scale factor, bias stability), the camera-IMU rotation and frame timing are estimated from the data, and the scale is recovered by a linear visual-inertial alignment over the SfM poses of a whole survey. The standard formulation, with gravity and accelerometer bias shared across the survey, overestimates the scale by 3.4% on average; estimating each contiguous segment independently and averaging removes the bias. On nine surveys with a co-mounted LiDAR scanner the inertial scale deviates from the LiDAR by 0.74% in mean absolute error, against 1.94% for the smartphone scale; on printed fiducial markers both agree within the 1% uncertainty of the target. On the reference trajectories of thirty sequences of a public benchmark, brought to scales of 1/40, 1 and 40, the estimator recovers the metric scale with a mean error of -0.07% and a standard deviation of 1.28%. On fifty production surveys where the smartphone is the only reference, the two scales agree to a standard deviation of 2.6%, the inertial scale being 0.9% lower on average; the difference does not depend on window construction, grows with the extent of the smartphone anchor, and cannot be attributed to either reference. An ablation over window construction and a comparison with monocular metric-depth networks complete the study.

AI.tldr: 本文评估利用Insta360 X5/X6内置1 kHz IMU替代智能手机ARKit/ARCore位姿来恢复SfM度量尺度的可行性。先对传感器进行标定（噪声密度、相机-IMU同步、加速度计尺度因子、零偏稳定性），再由整段测绘的SfM位姿做线性视觉-惯性对齐求尺度。标准全局公式平均高估尺度3.4%，按连续段独立估计再平均可消除该偏差。在九个同置LiDAR测绘上平均绝对误差0.74%（手机为1.94%），公开基准30条序列平均误差-0.07%、标准差1.28%，50个生产测绘与手机尺度标准差2.6%。
AI.motivation: 双鱼眼360相机的SfM只能恢复至相似变换，传统的度量尺度依赖外部智能手机ARKit/ARCore位姿，引入设备依赖与同步开销。作者希望验证相机内置IMU能否构成自包含的尺度来源，并系统量化其精度与偏差来源。
AI.method: 对Insta360 X5/X6内置IMU（1 kHz）做传感器表征：噪声密度、相机-IMU时间同步、加速度计尺度因子、零偏稳定性；从数据中估计相机-IMU旋转与帧时序；在整段测绘的SfM位姿上做线性视觉-惯性对齐恢复尺度。针对标准公式中重力与加速度计零偏跨全段共享导致的偏差，改为按连续段独立估计后平均。以同置LiDAR、印刷基准标记、公开基准（尺度1/40、1、40）和50个生产测绘进行验证，并附窗口构造消融与单目度量深度网络对比。
AI.result: 标准全局公式平均高估尺度3.4%，分段独立估计并平均可消除偏差。九个LiDAR同置测绘上，惯性尺度MAE为0.74%，手机尺度为1.94%；印刷标记上两者均在目标1%不确定度内一致。公开基准30条序列在1/40、1、40三种尺度下，估计平均误差-0.07%、标准差1.28%。50个以手机为唯一参考的生产测绘中，两者标准差2.6%，惯性尺度平均低0.9%；该差异与窗口构造无关，随手机锚点范围增大而增大，且无法归因于任一参考。
AI.conclusion: 消费级360相机内置IMU可作为自包含的度量尺度来源，精度优于智能手机位姿；但需对重力与零偏采用分段独立估计以消除系统性高估。与手机尺度的残余差异具有结构性（与锚点范围相关），无法归因于单一参考，提示需更谨慎的参考基准选择。

title: Learning High-Quality Pseudo-Labels for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Point-supervised temporal action localization (PTAL) aims to recognize and localize action instances in untrimmed videos using only point-level annotations. Existing pseudo-label-based methods have made substantial progress in PTAL. However, confidence-based initialization can overlook well-localized proposals. Meanwhile, existing methods either keep pseudo-labels fixed during detector training or update them without fully exploiting alternative boundary evidence from the original proposal pool. These limitations constrain supervision quality, thereby hindering detection performance. To learn high-quality pseudo-labels, we propose a framework that integrates prior-guided initialization with consensus-guided refinement during detector training. Our framework comprises two modules: Prior-Guided Initialization (PGI) and Consensus-Guided Refinement (CGR). PGI combines proposal confidence with point-derived priors to establish instance-specific reliability for initial pseudo-label selection and candidate retention. CGR continually uses the retained original candidates to construct boundary targets, combining their consensus with evolving detector predictions to refine pseudo-labels throughout training. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive detection performance compared with existing methods. In particular, our method achieves 68.5\% average mAP over tIoU thresholds 0.1--0.7 on THUMOS14, surpassing PseR by 3.7 percentage points. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyingfang/LHQP

AI.tldr: 提出融合先验引导初始化与共识引导精炼的框架（PGI+CGR），生成高质量伪标签以提升点监督时序动作定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于伪标签的PTAL方法存在三点局限：基于置信度的初始化会忽略定位良好的候选提案；训练中伪标签要么固定不变，要么更新时未充分利用原始提案池中的替代边界证据，导致监督质量受限、检测性能受阻。
AI.method: 框架含两模块：Prior-Guided Initialization (PGI) 将提案置信度与点导出的先验结合，建立实例级可靠性用于初始伪标签选择与候选保留；Consensus-Guided Refinement (CGR) 在训练全程持续利用保留的原始候选构建边界目标，将其共识与演化的检测器预测结合以精炼伪标签。
AI.result: 在四个基准上取得有竞争力的检测性能；THUMOS14上tIoU 0.1–0.7平均mAP达68.5%，较PseR提升3.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过先验引导初始化与共识引导精炼协同提升伪标签质量，可有效改善点监督时序动作定位的检测效果。

title: Unveil the Mask: Jointly-Optimized Diffusion Masked Pretraining for Appearance-Agnostic Operator Verification
comment: Accepted at ACCV 2026 Workshop on Who Is Behind the Avatar? (WBA)
summary: Photorealistic avatar videos decouple the appearance of a rendered face from the person who operates it, which makes conventional face recognition unsuitable for identifying the operator. Verifying the operator therefore requires representations of how a face moves that are insensitive to what the avatar looks like. We propose a verification framework built without any external pretrained model. It uses two complementary modalities provided for each sample: facial landmark sequences and video frames. From the landmark modality, it learns motion representations by diffusion masked pretraining over grouped landmarks, guided by lightweight auxiliary tasks that predict behavioral cues such as motion intensity and eye openness, and turns them into operator embeddings with a contrastive linear probe. To generalize to unseen avatar generators, the pretraining input is randomly transformed to simulate how a generator may alter the operator's motion. From the video modality, it captures fine facial motion through differences between consecutive frames. The embeddings of the two modalities are combined into one. Our approach reaches an overall AUC of 0.769 on the WBA2026 benchmark. Linear probing shows that the video embedding retains little information about the avatar's identity, whereas the landmark embedding retains some, and fusing the two modalities improves verification in particular across speaking and listening modes.

AI.tldr: 提出一个无需外部预训练模型的说话人（操作者）验证框架，联合面部关键点序列与视频帧两种模态，学习对外观不敏感的运动表征，在WBA2026基准上取得0.769的总体AUC。
AI.motivation: 逼真虚拟形象视频使"渲染外观"与"实际操作者"解耦，传统人脸识别无法识别操作者；因此需要一种对虚拟形象外观不敏感、只刻画人脸运动方式（how a face moves）的表征来完成验证。
AI.method: 框架不使用任何外部预训练模型，融合两种模态：(1) 关键点模态——对分组关键点做扩散式掩码预训练学习运动表征，辅以预测运动强度、眼睛睁闭等行为线索的轻量辅助任务，并用对比式线性探针转化为操作者嵌入；为泛化到未见过的生成器，预训练输入经随机变换以模拟生成器对运动风格的扰动；(2) 视频模态——通过相邻帧差分捕捉细微面部运动。最后将两模态嵌入合并为统一表征。
AI.result: 在WBA2026基准上总体AUC为0.769。线性探针分析显示：视频嵌入几乎不保留虚拟形象身份信息，而关键点嵌入保留了一部分；两模态融合在说话与聆听模式下尤其带来验证性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 以运动为中心、双模态互补且完全自训练的表征方案能有效应对虚拟形象外观解耦带来的验证难题；视频模态提供与身份无关的运动线索，关键点模态补充结构信息，二者融合效果最佳，且随机输入变换有助于跨生成器泛化。

title: VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
summary: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a ruleconsistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour. Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, judged by three VLM judge panels and validated with blind human preferences. Across nine frontier agent systems and 2,151 scored rollouts, the benchmark is far from solved: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly, yet even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Whether a video arrives at all matters as much as its quality, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders started too late, run too slowly or never started. The judges agree with each other and with human preferences on system rankings, but only moderately on individual videos.

AI.tldr: 提出 VibeVideoBench：一个面向"代码驱动视频生成"的多模态智能体基准，包含中英双语 239 个自包含任务、12 个类别，在沙箱中原生 harness 内限时一小时交付带音轨的 MP4；采用"程序校验 + 约 1.3 万条任务专属 rubric 检查 + 五维质量评分（三组 VLM 评审团，经盲测人类偏好验证）"的分层证据化评测。测评 9 个前沿智能体共 2151 次 rollout，结果显示基准远未饱和。
AI.motivation: 扩散视频模型虽能生成观感惊艳的片段，却无法可靠呈现精确公式、正确图表、规则一致的博弈过程，或与画面事件同步的旁白。因此出现另一条路线：多模态智能体通过编写代码逐帧渲染画面、合成每一段声音。但该方向缺乏系统、可复现的评测手段，本文即为此提出基准。
AI.method: 构建 VibeVideoBench：239 个中英文自包含任务，覆盖数据故事、音乐驱动短片、课堂讲解、论文解读等 12 类；智能体在沙箱内以其原生 harness 运行，须在一小时内产出带声音的成品 MP4。评测分三层且证据可追溯：(1) 交付规格的程序化检查；(2) 约 1.3 万条任务专属 rubric 检查，每条可追溯到其所执行的需求；(3) 逐任务锚定的五维质量评分，由三个 VLM 评审团打分，并用盲测人类偏好进行验证。共对 9 个前沿智能体系统完成 2151 次打分 rollout。
AI.result: 基准远未解决：GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5.5 明显领先，但即便是最佳系统也在约四分之一任务上未满足某项核心需求。"视频能否交付"与"质量高低"同等重要——四分之三的失败视频源于最终渲染启动过晚、运行过慢或根本未启动。评审团之间及与人类偏好在系统排名上一致，但在单个视频层面仅中等一致。
AI.conclusion: 代码驱动视频生成对当前前沿智能体仍是开放难题，可靠性与时效性（含渲染调度）与内容质量同为瓶颈；分层、可追溯的 rubric 评测配合 VLM 评审团可作为有效排序手段，但单样本判定仍需谨慎，宜结合人类偏好或多次采样。

title: FL4N: Feed-forward Latent Model for 4D Novel View Synthesis
comment: Project page and code are available at https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/FL4N/
summary: 4D novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to render dynamic scenes across viewpoints and timestamps, which requires jointly inferring 3D structure and temporal dynamics. Existing monocular feed-forward methods often rely on explicit 4D Gaussian representations, which are prone to temporal inconsistency and severe rendering artifacts. We present FL4N, the first feed-forward latent 4D NVS model. Instead of relying on explicit 4D primitives, FL4N encodes a 4D scene prior into a unified latent representation across space and time. Our core insight is that learning temporal dynamics as residuals on top of a pretrained static latent prior enables effective 4D modeling with limited dynamic training data. To this end, we introduce a lightweight dynamic encoder that leverages static scene features to disentangle object motion from camera-induced parallax. Trained solely with an image synthesis objective, FL4N achieves state-of-the-art 4D NVS quality while rendering in real time. Its learned latent representation generalizes to real-world videos and disentangles viewpoint from time.

AI.tldr: FL4N 是首个前馈式隐式 4D 新视角合成模型，将 4D 场景先验编码为统一的时空隐表示，以“静态隐先验 + 动态残差”的方式实现实时、高质量的 4D 渲染。
AI.motivation: 4D 新视角合成需同时推断三维结构与时间动态。现有单目前馈方法依赖显式 4D 高斯表示，易出现时间不一致与严重渲染伪影；同时动态训练数据有限，直接学习完整 4D 表示困难。
AI.method: 提出 FL4N，摒弃显式 4D 基元，把 4D 场景先验编码为跨时空的统一隐表示。核心思路是在预训练静态隐先验之上以残差形式学习时间动态；并引入轻量动态编码器，利用静态场景特征将物体运动与相机引起的视差解耦。仅以图像合成目标训练。
AI.result: 在仅有图像合成监督下取得当前最优的 4D NVS 质量，并可实时渲染；所学隐表示可泛化到真实视频，并实现视角与时间的解耦。
AI.conclusion: 在静态隐先验上加动态残差的隐式 4D 建模范式优于显式 4D 高斯表示，兼顾渲染质量、时间一致性与实时性，且具备向真实场景的泛化能力。

title: VidEdit3D: Flexible 3D Gaussian Editing with Video Diffusion
summary: Recent advancements in text-guided 3D editing, particularly with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), have shown promise but still lag behind the flexibility of 2D editing tools. Existing methods face a critical trade-off between preserving multi-view consistency and allowing structural modifications. Image-based editors can also struggle to apply the intended edit to objects viewed from unusual angles. To address these limitations, we introduce VidEdit3D, a framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a trajectory-based video editing task. By drawing a parallel between camera movement in static 3D scenes and temporal dynamics in video, we leverage the robust spatiotemporal priors of pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) to encourage semantic and structural coherence across views. Specifically, we propose Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) to select informative keyframes and construct smooth video clips aligned with VDM input requirements. To propagate edits from an anchor view to these clips, we develop Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE), a training-free framework incorporating an Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG) mechanism. ECG contrasts source and edited image conditions at a shared latent state, using scheduled source-image amplification to strengthen adherence to the edited reference while maintaining original scene context. Finally, we introduce Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS) to strictly confine geometric and appearance updates to target primitives, reducing background attribute leakage. Experiments demonstrate stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than the baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 VidEdit3D，将 3D 场景编辑重构为基于轨迹的视频编辑任务，借助预训练视频扩散模型的时空先验实现跨视角一致的结构编辑，并通过轨迹引导渲染、免训练流对齐视频编辑与区域选择性 3DGS 精化提升指令对齐与多视角一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导 3D 编辑（尤其基于 3DGS 的方法）在"保持多视角一致性"与"允许结构性修改"之间存在权衡；基于图像编辑器的方案在非常规视角下难以正确施加编辑，灵活性落后于 2D 编辑工具。
AI.method: 1) 将静态 3D 场景的相机运动类比为视频时间动态，把 3D 编辑表述为轨迹式视频编辑，利用 Video Diffusion Models 的时空先验；2) Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR)：选取信息量高的关键帧并构建符合 VDM 输入要求的平滑视频片段；3) Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE)：免训练框架，含 Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG)，在共享潜状态上对比源图与编辑图条件，并以计划性源图放大量化增强对编辑参考的遵循、同时保留原场景上下文；4) Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS)：将几何与外观更新严格限制在目标 primitives 上，减少背景属性泄漏。
AI.result: 实验显示，相比基线方法具有更强的指令对齐能力和更好的多视角一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过轨迹式视频编辑范式与视频扩散先验，VidEdit3D 缓解了一致性与结构可编辑性之间的权衡，并借助区域选择性精化抑制背景泄漏，为文本引导 3DGS 编辑提供了有效方案。

title: Printed and Scanned: Exposing the Fragility of Single-Image Morphing Attack Detectors under Print-Scan Degradation
summary: Face morphing attacks, in which the biometric traits of two or more identities are blended into a single face image, pose a severe threat to identity document issuance and automated border control. Consequently, a large body of work has proposed Single-image Morphing Attack Detection (S-MAD) algorithms and benchmarked them on datasets such as SYN-MAD22. However, the majority of these benchmarks operate exclusively in the digital domain, which contrasts with the real-world passport issuance pipeline in some countries, which still requires an applicant-supplied photograph to be printed and subsequently re-scanned before it is embedded in the identity document or fed into an automated verification system. This print-scan step introduces halftoning, resampling, color-space, and sensor noise that are absent from digital pipelines, and may mask the high-frequency artifacts that S-MAD models rely on. In this work, we introduce a print-scan version of the SYN-MAD22 dataset, obtained by printing and re-scanning all bona fide and morphed images at 300 and 600 DPI, and we use it to evaluate eight state-of-the-art S-MAD models trained exclusively on digital data. We additionally repeat the acquisition with a second scanner to assess cross-device robustness. Our results show that detectors that achieve near state-of-the-art performance in the digital domain suffer a more than threefold increase in average equal error rate, with the same qualitative degradation observed across both scanning devices, exposing a critical, previously under-reported gap between digital-benchmark performance and robustness to print-scan degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了SYN-MAD22的打印-扫描版本（300/600 DPI，双扫描仪），并评测8个仅在数字域训练的S-MAD模型，发现其平均EER增至三倍以上，揭示数字基准性能与打印-扫描鲁棒性之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有多数S-MAD基准仅停留在数字域，而部分国家的护照签发流程要求申请人照片先打印再扫描，该过程引入半色调化、重采样、色彩空间变换与传感器噪声，可能掩盖S-MAD模型依赖的高频伪造痕迹。数字域基准性能与真实打印-扫描场景鲁棒性之间的差距此前被严重低估。
AI.method: 将SYN-MAD22中全部真实（bona fide）与变形（morphed）图像在300 DPI与600 DPI下进行打印并重新扫描，构建打印-扫描版数据集；使用仅以数字数据训练的8个先进S-MAD模型在该数据集上进行评估；并使用第二台扫描仪重复采集，以考察跨设备鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在数字域接近SOTA的检测器在打印-扫描条件下平均等错误率（EER）增长超过三倍，且两台扫描设备上呈现一致的定性退化趋势。
AI.conclusion: 数字域基准评测高估了S-MAD模型在真实证件签发流程中的鲁棒性，打印-扫描退化是此前报道不足的关键薄弱环节，亟需在该条件下开展基准测试与模型训练。

title: Seeing Before Naming: Context-Grounded Learning of Novel Visual Concepts
summary: Learning an unfamiliar visual category requires more than adapting a classifier: the model must connect its visual evidence to a useful semantic name. A pre-trained vision-language model can retain discriminative image features while providing a weak textual anchor for the target concept. We address this imbalance through context-grounded semantic anchoring. Our framework, SynerNet, learns concept-specific name embeddings, exposes them to compatible linguistic contexts, and conditions their representations on visual evidence. Difficulty-aware processing and adaptive objective weighting coordinate this adaptation while retaining the pre-trained backbone. On four VISTA-Beyond domains, SynerNet reaches a mean 16-shot accuracy of 74.35%, compared with 72.45% for few-shot name learning. Across 14 domains in the name-masked transfer setting, it improves mean accuracy from 45.17% to 46.74%. Ablations identify concept-specific name embeddings and cross-modal context integration as important components. These results support treating concept acquisition as the construction of visually grounded semantic anchors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SynerNet框架，通过"上下文接地的语义锚定"来解决新视觉类别学习中视觉特征强而文本锚弱的不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 学习陌生视觉类别不仅需调整分类器，还需将视觉证据与有用的语义名称关联。预训练视觉-语言模型虽保留判别性图像特征，但对目标概念仅提供弱文本锚，存在视觉与文本两方面能力的不平衡。
AI.method: SynerNet学习概念特定的名称嵌入，将其置于兼容的语言上下文中，并依据视觉证据对其表示进行条件化；采用难度感知处理与自适应目标加权来协调适配，同时保留预训练骨干网络。
AI.result: 在四个VISTA-Beyond域上，16-shot平均准确率达74.35%（对比少样本名称学习的72.45%）；在名称屏蔽迁移设置的14个域上，平均准确率由45.17%提升至46.74%。消融实验表明概念特定名称嵌入与跨模态上下文整合为关键组件。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将概念习得视为构建视觉接地的语义锚的过程。

title: PosePlaner: Denoising Any Feed-Forward Pose Predictor from Pairwise Planar Geometry
summary: Recent multi-view Transformers (e.g., DUSt3R and VGGT) have advanced 3D reconstruction by scaling training data and model capacity from two views to many views and long sequences, subsuming the classical SfM/SLAM pipeline of feature extraction, matching, and pose estimation in a single feed-forward pass. Yet this subsumption hides the interfaces between pipeline stages---correspondences, geometry, and pose are entangled in a single forward pass, leaving supervised fine-tuning as the major path to improvement and offering no mechanism to correct predictions from geometric evidence at test time. We propose PosePlaner to close this gap by reviving the classical coupling between correspondences and pose via flow matching, treating pose refinement as a conditional generation problem that takes coarse geometric matches and initial pose as input condition and fuses the resulting pose hypotheses into a single refined estimate, providing a continuous, data-driven analog of RANSAC voting. Our method is trained efficiently on two-view data, yet serves as a periodic refiner for streaming n-view pose estimators with no retraining. Empirically, it corrects failures of feed-forward predictors, substantially improves correspondence-based solvers, and reduces accumulated drift in long streaming sequences.

AI.tldr: 提出 PosePlaner，通过 flow matching 复兴经典的对应关系-位姿耦合，将位姿精化建模为条件生成问题，以粗几何匹配与初始位姿为条件生成位姿假设并融合为单一精化解，作为流式 n 视角位姿估计器的周期精化器。
AI.motivation: 近期多视角 Transformer（如 DUSt3R、VGGT）将 SfM/SLAM 的特征提取、匹配与位姿估计压缩进单次前馈，但对应关系、几何与位姿在单个前向中被耦合纠缠，导致除监督微调外缺乏改进途径，也无法在测试时利用几何证据纠正预测。
AI.method: 以 flow matching 将位姿精化视为条件生成：输入条件为粗几何匹配与初始位姿，生成位姿假设，并将多个假设融合为单一精化估计，构成 RANSAC 投票的连续、数据驱动类比。方法仅在双视角数据上高效训练，可作为周期精化器接入流式 n 视角位姿估计器而无需重训练。
AI.result: 实验上可纠正前馈预测器的失败案例，显著提升基于对应关系的求解器性能，并降低长流式序列中的累积漂移。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式重建对应与位姿之间的经典耦合接口，PosePlaner 在不重训练主干的前提下为前馈位姿估计器提供了测试时可用的几何证据纠正机制，兼具双视角训练效率与 n 视角流式部署的通用性。

title: From Sentinel-2 to 1-m Imagery: Real-World $\times 10$ Cross-Sensor Super-Resolution via Visual Autoregressive Modeling
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/SHANOAL/RSSR
summary: Reconstructing 1-m imagery from Sentinel-2 combines two difficulties. The input and the reference are observed by different satellites, which differ in spatial resolution, spectral response, radiometry, acquisition time, and local geometry, so no synthetic degradation operator links them. The required magnification of ten in each spatial dimension also far exceeds the factors of two to four at which remote sensing super-resolution is usually developed. We study this real-world $\times 10$ problem using YREB-SR, which pairs 2022 Sentinel-2 RGB composites with 2022 Jilin-1 RGB references resampled to a 1-m grid over the Yangtze River Economic Belt. The benchmark contains 11,559 geographically matched scene pairs, with 6,409, 2,135, and 3,015 assigned to training, validation, and testing, respectively. We develop CrossVAR, a visual autoregressive model that predicts the 1-m latent as a nine-scale hierarchy conditioned on the Sentinel-2 input and estimates the remaining quantization residual with a diffusion refiner run without injected noise. Complete 1600 $\times$ 1600 scenes are reconstructed in overlapping windows that start on the Sentinel-2 pixel grid, as every training patch does, and every window is decoded at the size on which the decoder was trained before the windows are blended with Gaussian weights. On all 3,015 test scenes, CrossVAR achieves 27.60 dB PSNR, 0.7725 SSIM, 0.1451 LPIPS, and 7.15 FID, the best value of each metric among the compared methods. These results establish a strong autoregressive baseline for large-scale cross-sensor reconstruction. To facilitate reproducibility, the source code and implementation are publicly available at https://github.com/SHANOAL/RSSR.

AI.tldr: 提出YREB-SR跨传感器×10重建基准与CrossVAR视觉自回归模型，在3015个测试场景上取得27.60 dB PSNR等四项指标最优。
AI.motivation: 从Sentinel-2重建1-m影像存在双重困难：输入与参考由不同卫星观测，在空间分辨率、光谱响应、辐射度量、成像时间与局部几何上均不一致，因此不存在可用的合成退化算子；同时每个空间维度10倍的放大倍率远超遥感超分通常研究的2–4倍。
AI.method: 构建YREB-SR基准（2022年Sentinel-2 RGB合成与2022年Jilin-1 1-m重采样参考，长江经济带，11559对地理配准场景，训练/验证/测试为6409/2135/3015）；提出CrossVAR——以Sentinel-2为条件，将1-m潜变量预测为九尺度层级结构的视觉自回归模型，并用无注入噪声的扩散精修器估计量化残差；1600×1600整景以对齐Sentinel-2像素网格的重叠窗口重建，每个窗口按解码器训练尺寸解码后以高斯权重融合。
AI.result: 在全部3015个测试场景上达到27.60 dB PSNR、0.7725 SSIM、0.1451 LPIPS、7.15 FID，四项指标均为对比方法中最优。
AI.conclusion: 为大规模跨传感器重建建立了强自回归基线；代码与实现已开源以促进可复现性。

title: Kronecker-Structured Video Completion with Cross-Fitted Self-Supervised Residual Learning
summary: Tube-wise video completion reconstructs temporal trajectories at spatial locations unobserved in every frame. We propose a two-stage framework combining regularized masked Kronecker product decomposition (KPD) with cross-fitted self-supervised residual learning. First, we estimate a compact structural backbone directly from observed entries using cyclic component-wise least-squares updates, spatial and temporal factor regularization, and regularizer-optimal scale balancing. The exact updates yield a nonincreasing objective. Second, we address the mismatch between in-sample fitting errors and the prediction errors encountered at missing tubes. We partition observed tubes into folds and construct residual targets using backbone models fitted without the corresponding target tubes. A lightweight 3-D convolutional neural network then predicts corrections from the backbone, visible residual context, observation mask, and local detail features. Exact data consistency preserves observed measurements. Experiments include ablations, sensitivity analysis, grayscale and RGB video completion, and structured missing patterns. Our method achieves the highest mean PSNR and SSIM at the higher tested sampling rates on the grayscale benchmark. On eight selected DAVIS RGB sequences, it achieves the highest mean missing-region PSNR and full-frame SSIM and the lowest mean missing-tube temporal-gradient MAE at every evaluated sampling rate.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架（正则化掩码Kronecker积分解 + 交叉拟合自监督残差学习）用于tube-wise视频补全，在灰度与RGB基准上取得最优指标。
AI.motivation: Tube-wise视频补全需在每帧均未观测的整条空间位置上重建时间轨迹。单一低秩分解存在样本内拟合误差与缺失tube处预测误差之间的失配，需要同时保证结构建模的稳定性与缺失处的泛化能力。
AI.method: 第一阶段：直接从观测条目估计紧凑结构骨架，采用循环分量最小二乘更新、空间/时间因子正则化与正则项最优尺度平衡，更新精确且目标函数单调不增。第二阶段：将观测tube划分为若干折，用未包含目标tube的骨架模型构造残差目标实现交叉拟合，再由轻量3D CNN结合骨架、可见残差上下文、观测掩码与局部细节特征预测修正量，并以精确数据一致性保持观测值。
