AI.result: 灰度基准在较高采样率下平均PSNR与SSIM最高；8个DAVIS RGB序列在所有采样率下平均缺失区域PSNR、全帧SSIM最高，平均缺失tube时间梯度MAE最低。另含消融实验、敏感性分析及结构化缺失模式评估。
AI.conclusion: 将可解释的掩码KPD结构骨架与交叉拟合自监督残差修正相结合，可有效缓解拟合—预测误差失配，在灰度与RGB视频补全及多种缺失模式下均表现优越。

title: When Pointing Becomes Profiling: Social Bias and Refusal in Text-Steerable Visual Encoders
summary: Text-steerable visual encoders condition a frozen Vision Transformer on a natural-language prompt and point at the matching image region, producing prompt-conditioned heatmaps and features. We audit the released SteerViT model and find that its steering interface turns language-driven pointing into demographic profiling. On counterfactual face mosaics and real multi-person photographs, "the person" selects a man more often than the base rate, crime words select Black people more often than occupation words do, "the man" among four women selects the Black woman 75.6% of the time on SocialCounterfactuals, and "the monkey" selects Black people. None of them is in the backbone's unsteered saliency, and the crime association is not in the frozen text encoder; the race effects grow with steering strength and enter through the last two cross-attention layers: giving the prompt to those layers alone reproduces them. Four other grounding models, CLIPSeg, Grounding-DINO, SAM 3, and Qwen2.5-VL, show no crime routing and weaker race routing. The model cannot refuse. Its patch softmax must place its mass somewhere, and its heatmap separates a groundable request ("the police officer") from one that is absent ("the pizza") or that would require a stereotyped demographic inference ("the criminal") only at chance (AUROC 0.52). We introduce SafeSteer, which adds a learned abstention output and counterfactual-invariance training on the same 23M steering parameters. SafeSteer separates should-point from should-abstain prompts at AUROC 0.997, generalizes to held-out sensitive and absent words (0.998; at a 0.5 threshold it refuses 99.8% of trained and 62% of held-out sensitive words) with no over-refusal of visible people on the benchmark, and removes most race routing while keeping localization and retrieval within 1 point of the released model. Code, benchmarks, and the curated mosaic sets will be released.

AI.tldr: 论文审计了文本可控视觉编码器 SteerViT，发现其引导接口会把语言指代转化为人口统计学画像（种族/性别路由），且模型无法拒答；据此提出 SafeSteer，用学习式弃答输出与反事实不变性训练在同一 23M 引导参数上消除该问题。
AI.motivation: 文本可控视觉编码器（以自然语言提示条件化冻结 ViT 并输出提示条件热图）被广泛使用，但其"必须输出"的架构特性可能使语言指代退化为对敏感属性的刻板画像，且缺乏拒答能力；作者希望系统审计该风险并给出修复方案。
AI.method: 1) 在反事实人脸马赛克与真实多人照片上审计 SteerViT 的性别/种族路由行为，并通过对照实验定位来源（骨干未引导显著性、冻结文本编码器、最后两层交叉注意力）；2) 比较 CLIPSeg、Grounding-DINO、SAM 3、Qwen2.5-VL 四个 grounding 模型；3) 提出 SafeSteer：在同样 23M steering 参数上加入可学习的 abstention 输出与反事实不变性训练。
AI.result: SteerViT 中"the person"过度选择男性、犯罪词比职业词更常指向黑人、"the man"在四位女性中 75.6% 选中黑人女性、"the monkey"指向黑人；这些效应不在骨干显著性或冻结文本编码器中，而随引导强度增强、经最后两层交叉注意力进入；区分应答/弃答仅达随机水平（AUROC 0.52）。SafeSteer 达到 AUROC 0.997（留出敏感词与缺失词 0.998），0.5 阈值下拒绝 99.8% 训练敏感词与 62% 留出敏感词，无对可见人物的过度拒答，大幅削弱种族路由，定位与检索性能差距在 1 点以内。
AI.conclusion: 语言驱动的指代接口在缺乏拒答机制时会系统性地产生人口统计学偏见路由，且偏置源自引导模块而非骨干或文本编码器；加入弃答与反事实不变性训练可在不牺牲定位与检索性能的前提下显著缓解该问题，为可控视觉编码器提供安全对齐范式。

title: Reason or Recite: Complementary Specialists with an LLM Judge for Traffic Anomaly Reasoning
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the AI City Challenge Workshop, ECCV 2026. 1st place in Track 3 (Traffic Anomaly Reasoning)
summary: Road anomalies such as collisions, violations, and sudden hazards demand more from video understanding than detection: a practical system must verify what happened, describe the scene, and explain the cause. We find these competences pull in opposite directions for vision-language models: closed-form questions reward precise, evidence-grounded reasoning, while open-ended answers are scored by similarity to reference text, where matching the annotation style matters as much as reasoning correctly. We present Reason-or-Recite (RoR), a two-specialist framework for the Traffic Anomaly Reasoning track of the 2026 AI City Challenge. RoR (1) rewrites the official chain-of-thought annotations into a structured, temporally grounded schema and LoRA-tunes a 9B vision-language model on the enhanced traces; (2) fine-tunes a 4-bit-quantized 27B model on answers alone, absorbing the annotation style; and (3) selects between the two candidates per question with a training-free LLM judge. RoR ranks first on the in-domain leaderboard with mean score 0.6788.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reason-or-Recite (RoR)双专家框架，用于2026 AI City Challenge交通异常推理赛道：一个专家经结构化标注重写与LoRA微调做精确证据推理，另一专家在答案上微调以习得标注风格，再由免训练LLM评判器逐题择优选答，域内榜单以0.6788均分排名第一。
AI.motivation: 碰撞、违规、突发危险等道路异常要求视频理解超越检测，需兼具"核实事件、描述场景、解释原因"的能力，然而作者发现这两类能力对视觉语言模型存在冲突：封闭式问题奖励精确、以证据为依据的推理，而开放式答案按与参考文本的相似度评分，匹配标注风格与推理正确同等重要，单一模型难以兼顾。
AI.method: RoR由两个专家与一个选择器组成：(1)将官方思维链标注重写为结构化、具备时间锚定的模式，并在增强轨迹上用LoRA微调9B视觉语言模型；(2)仅在答案上微调4-bit量化的27B模型，使其吸收标注风格；(3)对每题用免训练的LLM评判器在两个候选答案间择优。
AI.result: 在赛道域内榜单上排名第一，平均得分0.6788。
AI.conclusion: 结论是"推理能力"与"风格对齐"应解耦为两个专门化模型，而非由单一模型同时承担，并通过免训练的LLM评判进行逐题路由，可在封闭式与开放式混合评测下同时获益；该分而治之加模型选择的思路在交通异常推理任务上验证有效。

title: Rethinking Data Imbalance in Class Incremental Surgical Instrument Segmentation
summary: In surgical instrument segmentation, the increasing variety of instruments over time poses a significant challenge for existing neural networks, as they are unable to effectively learn such incremental tasks and suffer from catastrophic forgetting. When learning new data, the model experiences a sharp performance drop on previously learned data. Although several continual learning methods have been proposed for incremental understanding tasks in surgical scenarios, the issue of data imbalance often leads to a strong bias in the segmentation head, resulting in poor performance. Data imbalance can occur in two forms: (i) class imbalance between new and old data, and (ii) class imbalance within the same time point of data. Such imbalances often cause the dominant classes to take over the training process of continual semantic segmentation (CSS). To address this issue, we propose SurgCSS, a novel plug-and-play CSS framework for surgical instrument segmentation under data imbalance. Specifically, we generate realistic surgical backgrounds through inpainting and blend instrument foregrounds with the generated backgrounds in a class-aware manner to balance the data distribution in various scenarios. We further propose the Class Desensitization Loss by employing contrastive learning to correct edge biases caused by data imbalance. Moreover, we dynamically fuse the weight parameters of the old and new models to achieve a better trade-off between the biased and unbiased model weights. To investigate the data imbalance problem in surgical scenarios, we construct a new benchmark for surgical instrument CSS by integrating datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, achieving significant performance improvement against existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的持续语义分割框架SurgCSS，通过修补生成背景并按类混合前景、类别脱敏损失与新旧权重动态融合，缓解手术器械分割中的数据不平衡与灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 手术器械种类随时间增多，现有神经网络难以有效学习增量任务并出现灾难性遗忘；已有的手术场景持续学习方法受数据不平衡影响（新老数据类别不平衡、同一时间点内类别不平衡），导致分割头产生强偏置、训练被主导类别占据，性能下降。
AI.method: 1) 利用图像修补（inpainting）生成逼真的手术背景，并按类别感知方式将器械前景与生成背景混合，以平衡多种场景下的数据分布；2) 提出类别脱敏损失（Class Desensitization Loss），借助对比学习纠正数据不平衡引起的边缘偏置；3) 动态融合新旧模型权重参数，在偏置与非偏置权重间取得更优折中。
AI.result: 整合多个数据集构建了面向手术器械持续语义分割的新基准；大量实验表明该框架有效，相较现有基线取得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: SurgCSS作为即插即用框架，通过数据层面重平衡、损失层面去偏与参数层面动态融合，有效缓解手术器械增量分割中的数据不平衡与灾难性遗忘问题，并提供了相应基准。

title: SGDB: Semantic-Geometric Decoupling and Evidence Binding for Logical Anomaly Detection
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, includes supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/Qybc/SGDB
summary: Logical anomaly detection requires recognizing scene components and measuring whether their configuration satisfies task constraints. Correct identities can coexist with inaccurate geometry; clean mask fragments can yield misleading lengths. We propose Semantic-Geometric Decoupling and Evidence Binding (SGDB). A semantic decoder learns object identities from component-annotated normal sources and factual edits; a separate reader supplies final measurements. Partial one-to-one association binds geometric witnesses to identities while retaining unmatched objects in the count. A support-certified reader selects mask-derived axes using line quality and complete component ownership. Explicit task requirements and normal-data references define executable checks, with decision thresholds fixed by independent normal calibration. Execution-grounded explanation traces rule contributions to source objects and measurements, extracting compact sufficient alarm certificates. A frozen language model expresses selected outcomes as cited claims, with numeric evidence retained by the executor. Reports preserve observed deviations and unavailable evidence. SGDB achieves 98.19% AUROC and 94.52% fixed-threshold F1 on five MVTec LOCO logical categories, and 93.56% AUROC and 92.76% F1 across all 50 VID-AD tasks. Frozen-output controls evaluate geometric readout and explanatory sufficiency and compactness.

AI.tldr: 提出语义-几何解耦与证据绑定框架SGDB，用于逻辑异常检测，在MVTec LOCO与VID-AD上取得高AUROC与固定阈值F1，并提供可执行、可引用的解释。
AI.motivation: 逻辑异常检测需同时识别场景组件并判断其配置是否满足任务约束；但身份正确可能伴随几何测量失准，掩码碎片干净却导致长度误导，语义与几何误差相互混杂，需将其解耦并绑定可信证据。
AI.method: 语义解码器从组件标注的正常源与事实性编辑中学习物体身份；独立读取器负责最终测量；采用部分一对一关联将几何证据绑定到身份，未匹配物体保留计数；支撑认证读取器依据线质量与组件归属完整性选择掩码派生轴；以显式任务需求与正常数据参考定义可执行检查，阈值由独立正常校准固定；执行溯源解释将规则贡献追溯到源对象与测量，抽取紧凑充分报警证书；冻结语言模型仅将选定结果表述为带引用断言，数值证据保留于执行器。
AI.result: 五个MVTec LOCO逻辑类别上AUROC 98.19%、固定阈值F1 94.52%；全部50个VID-AD任务上AUROC 93.56%、F1 92.76%；并通过冻结输出对照评估几何读取与解释的充分性及紧凑性。
AI.conclusion: 语义与几何解耦加证据绑定可有效提升逻辑异常检测的判别性能与阈值稳定性，同时给出可验证、可溯源且紧凑的解释，并如实保留观测到的偏差与不可得证据。

title: LayoutMamba: Efficient Document Layout Analysis with Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Networks
summary: Document layout analysis (DLA) faces a long-standing dilemma: existing methods either capture rich local details at prohibitive computational cost (e.g., Transformer-based approaches with quadratic complexity) or achieve efficient global modeling but sacrifice fine-grained structural awareness (e.g., state-space models). This trade-off hinders deployment in resource-constrained scenarios. We present LayoutMamba, a hybrid framework that synergistically combines sparse-attention Transformers for localized feature extraction (O(n) complexity) and the recurrent state-space mechanism of Mamba for dilution-free long-range dependency modeling across the 2D document canvas. Our two-stage paradigm first uses a lightweight Transformer encoder to hierarchically distill salient local semantics; second, Mamba propagates global contextual dependencies without attention dilution, enabling precise, efficient, and scalable layout understanding. We further identify a critical yet overlooked issue in existing DLA benchmarks: the inherent low-overlap distribution bias of layout objects, which we mitigate through a novel Geometric Overlap Penalty Loss (GOPLoss), a dual-optimization objective that minimizes redundant bounding box overlaps and encourages geometrically consistent predictions. Extensive experiments on PubLayNet and D4LA show that LayoutMamba surpasses state-of-the-art AP on PubLayNet with 8x fewer parameters and maintains leading performance on D4LA, ranking top-3 among published methods, achieving an unprecedented balance between accuracy, efficiency, and scalability. Our work pioneers a cognition-inspired paradigm for document analysis, advancing practical deployment in edge computing and resource-limited environments.

AI.tldr: LayoutMamba是一种混合架构：用稀疏注意力Transformer提取局部特征（O(n)复杂度），用Mamba状态空间机制建模2D文档画布上的长程依赖，并提出GOPLoss缓解DLA基准中布局对象低重叠分布偏置，在PubLayNet/D4LA上实现精度-效率-可扩展性的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有文档布局分析（DLA）方法存在两难：Transformer类方法以平方复杂度获取丰富局部细节但计算开销过大；状态空间模型可高效全局建模却牺牲细粒度结构感知。该权衡阻碍了资源受限场景的部署，同时现有DLA基准存在被忽视的布局对象低重叠分布偏置问题。
AI.method: 提出LayoutMamba混合框架，采用两阶段范式：第一阶段用轻量级Transformer编码器（稀疏注意力、O(n)复杂度）分层蒸馏显著局部语义；第二阶段用Mamba的循环状态空间机制在2D文档画布上无稀释地传播全局上下文依赖。此外提出几何重叠惩罚损失GOPLoss，作为双重优化目标，最小化冗余边界框重叠并鼓励几何一致的预测。
AI.result: 在PubLayNet与D4LA上的大量实验表明：LayoutMamba以少8倍的参数量超越PubLayNet上的SOTA AP；在D4LA上保持领先性能，在已发表方法中位列前三，实现了精度、效率与可扩展性之间前所未有的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作开创了受认知启发的文档分析范式，缓解了局部细节与全局建模之间的效率权衡，并指出与修正了DLA基准的分布偏置，推动在边缘计算与资源受限环境中的实际部署。

title: EviGround-CT: Sentence-to-Volume Grounding for Verifying LLM-Generated Chest CT Reports
summary: Chest computed tomography (CT) reports generated by large language models (LLMs) can describe positive findings that lack localized evidence in the scan. We propose EviGround-CT to verify these findings after report generation. A deterministic extractor identifies positive finding sentences, and a 3D grounding model predicts an evidence mask for each sentence. Using the full sentence retains anatomical location, laterality, and descriptive modifiers in the grounding query. We evaluate report generation on CT-RATE, and grounding and verification on a held-out 100-case ReXGroundingCT subset. Using the available annotations, sentence-grounded verification raises evidence-supported precision (ESP) from 0.263 to 0.365 across 137 extracted in-scope positives, compared with category conditioning. The corresponding unsupported positive finding rate falls from 0.737 to 0.635. The paired case-level bootstrap ESP difference is +0.102 (95% confidence interval: [0.028, 0.181]). The predicted masks associate individual report statements with spatial evidence that can be inspected alongside the CT.

AI.tldr: 提出EviGround-CT：生成后对CT报告中的阳性发现做句子级3D定位验证，ESP由0.263升至0.365。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的胸部CT报告可能描述扫描中缺乏局部证据的阳性发现，存在幻觉风险，需在报告生成后进行事实验证。
AI.method: 确定性提取器抽取阳性发现句；3D grounding模型为每句预测证据掩膜；以完整句子作为grounding查询以保留解剖位置、偏侧性与描述修饰语；在CT-RATE评估报告生成，在100例留出ReXGroundingCT子集评估grounding与验证。
AI.result: 137条范围内阳性发现上，句子级grounding验证将ESP从0.263提升至0.365（对比类别条件化），无支持阳性发现率由0.737降至0.635；病例级配对bootstrap ESP差+0.102（95% CI [0.028, 0.181]）。
AI.conclusion: 句子级grounding验证可有效检出缺乏影像证据的阳性陈述，预测掩膜将报告语句与可核查的空间证据关联。

title: No Cones, No Duals: A Fast and Scalable Solver for NRSfM
comment: 21 pages, 14 figures, 19 tables, Accepted for publication at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), 2027
summary: Non-rigid structure from motion (NRSfM) aims to recover camera motion and time-varying 3D shape from tracked 2D image measurements. Recent high-performing methods show that shape-space factorization remains highly effective for this task. These methods often use costly solvers for two key steps. First, a semidefinite programming (SDP) cone solver to perform Euclidean correction. Next, an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) solver to recover the low-rank shape. These steps often scale poorly to long sequences and dense point tracks. We propose a fast, scalable NRSfM solver that avoids these costly steps. For rotation estimation, we introduce a differentiable Euclidean correction that directly optimizes small factors for each sequence. A row-polar projection then maps each estimated camera block to the closest row-orthonormal matrix. For shape estimation, we introduce an unrolled spectral-proximal solver. It combines reprojection-gradient steps with weighted singular-value shrinkage in the reshuffled shape domain. This solver further uses FISTA-style restart and continuation. The spectral shrinkage operator itself is classical, but we embed it in a fixed differentiable solver, while preserving NRSfM's geometric constraints. The proposed approach is category-agnostic, requires no external training data, and maps naturally to modern accelerator-friendly linear algebra primitives. Across sparse, dense, noisy, missing-data, and long-sequence benchmarks, our solver achieves substantial speedups with competitive reconstruction accuracy, including 7x-1000x runtime improvements on dense sequences with 28,887 tracked points.

AI.tldr: 提出一种快速可扩展的非刚性结构从运动（NRSfM）求解器，用可微分欧氏校正与展开的谱近端求解器替代昂贵的SDP与ADMM步骤，在保持竞争性重建精度的同时实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 现有基于形状空间分解的高性能NRSfM方法依赖两个代价高昂的求解步骤：用于欧氏校正的半定规划（SDP）锥求解器，以及用于恢复低秩形状的ADMM求解器。这些步骤在长序列和密集点轨迹上扩展性差，计算开销大。
AI.method: 旋转估计方面：引入可微分的欧氏校正，直接对每个序列优化少量小因子，再用行极投影（row-polar projection）将每个估计的相机块映射到最接近的行正交矩阵。形状估计方面：引入展开的谱近端求解器（unrolled spectral-proximal solver），在重排形状域中结合重投影梯度步与加权奇异值收缩，并配合FISTA式重启与延拓策略；将经典谱收缩算子嵌入固定可微求解器，同时保持NRSfM几何约束。
AI.result: 在稀疏、密集、含噪、缺失数据及长序列等基准上，该方法均取得显著加速且重建精度具竞争力；在含28,887个跟踪点的密集序列上实现7倍至1000倍的运行时间提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法与类别无关、无需外部训练数据，且天然契合现代加速器友好的线性代数原语，为NRSfM提供了一种高效可扩展的替代方案。

title: Hyperspectral Unmixing using a Structured Linear Mixing Model with Additive Spectral Variability
summary: Linear hyperspectral unmixing aims at retrieving pure material spectra present in an observed scene and their associated abundance fractions in each pixel. In most practical situations, hyperspectral images are affected by spectral variability (SV) also known as intra-class variability, which is caused by different physical phenomena including atmospheric effects, intrinsic variability of the pure materials and illumination or topographic changes. Nevertheless, the standard hyperspectral unmixing methods that rely on the Linear Mixing Model (LMM) do not consider these phenomena. Thus, neglecting them will spread errors throughout the linear hyperspectral unmixing process. To avoid this problem, this paper proposes two hyperspectral unmixing algorithms dedicated to a parametric model called Structured Additive Variability LMM (SAV-LMM). This mixing model handles SV in an additive manner by incorporating two terms into the standard LMM. Moreover, the designed algorithms are based on Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and optimize a cost function which integrates additional penalization accounting for SV. Furthermore, a novel improved initialization scheme, which takes SV into account, is proposed. Experiments conducted on both synthetic and real datasets show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms for linearly unmixing hyperspectral images with SV compared to the tested state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 该文针对线性高光谱解混中的光谱变异性（SV）问题，基于结构化加性变异性线性混合模型（SAV-LMM）提出两种NMF类解混算法，并设计考虑SV的改进初始化方案。
AI.motivation: 标准线性混合模型（LMM）忽略由大气效应、纯材料内在变异及光照/地形变化引起的光谱变异性（类内变异性），导致误差在解混全流程中传播。为缓解该问题，需要面向能够显式建模SV的混合模型设计专用解混算法。
AI.method: 采用参数化的结构化加性变异性LMM（SAV-LMM），该模型在标准LMM中引入两个加性项以刻画SV；据此设计两种基于非负矩阵分解（NMF）的解混算法，优化融合SV惩罚项（penalization）的代价函数；并提出一种考虑SV的改进初始化策略。
AI.result: 在合成数据集与真实数据集上的实验表明，所提算法在含SV的线性高光谱解混任务上优于所对比的现有先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模光谱变异性并结合相应惩罚与初始化设计，可有效提升线性高光谱解混性能；SAV-LMM框架下基于NMF的算法对SV具有鲁棒性。

title: Factorized Gradients for Scalable Highly-expressive Parametric Diffeomorphisms
summary: Diffeomorphisms provide a flexible, topology-preserving mathematical tool for modeling complex spatial or temporal deformations and are used in various scientific fields. However, making these deformations simultaneously highly expressive and computationally efficient remains challenging. Continuous Piecewise-Affine Based (CPAB) transformations (Freifeld et al., ICCV 2015; IEEE TPAMI 2017) offer an attractive solution by parameterizing a family of diffeomorphisms via continuous velocity fields that are piecewise affine with respect to a chosen tessellation of the domain. Importantly, $d=\dim(θ)$, the dimension of the parameter vector $θ$, depends on the fineness of the tessellation rather than on the data resolution. Despite this compact parameterization, CPAB optimization has long been hindered by the tight coupling between trajectory integration and gradient computation with respect to $θ$. We introduce FG-CPAB, a factorized-gradient formulation for scalable CPAB transformations. By separating integration from parameter-space projection, our method reduces gradient computation complexity from $\mathcal{O}(dTN)$ to $\mathcal{O}(TN+dC)$, where $T$ is the number of integration steps, $N$ is the number of transformed points, and $C$ is the number of tessellation cells. This reformulation yields speedups of up to four orders of magnitude (e.g., $\approx 10^4\times$ in 2D), substantial memory savings (e.g., $\approx 500\times$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage in 2D), and dramatically higher expressiveness. This makes fine-tessellation CPAB practical in 2D and 3D for the first time, enabling highly expressive parametric diffeomorphisms.

AI.tldr: 提出FG-CPAB，将CPAB变换的轨迹积分与参数空间投影解耦，把梯度计算复杂度从O(dTN)降至O(TN+dC)，实现最高四个数量级加速与约500倍GPU显存节省，首次让精细剖分CPAB在2D/3D中实用。
AI.motivation: CPAB变换以连续速度场参数化微分同胚，参数量d取决于剖分精细度而非数据分辨率，表达力强且参数紧凑；但其优化长期受制于轨迹积分与对θ的梯度计算之间的紧密耦合，导致计算与显存开销过大，难以使用精细剖分。
AI.method: 提出FG-CPAB（因子化梯度）公式：将轨迹积分与参数空间投影分离，先计算与参数无关的积分项，再通过剖分单元上的投影映射回参数梯度，从而避免逐点、逐参数、逐步的耦合求导。
AI.result: 梯度复杂度由O(dTN)降为O(TN+dC)（T为积分步数，N为变换点数，C为剖分单元数）；实测最高约10^4倍加速（2D）、峰值GPU显存约500倍下降，并显著提升表达力。
AI.conclusion: FG-CPAB使精细剖分的CPAB在2D与3D中首次变得实用，提供高表达力的参数化微分同胚，适用于复杂空间/时间形变建模。

title: Understanding and Repairing Cooperative Perception under Adverse Weather
summary: A cooperative 3D detector can miss a vehicle even when the LiDAR points on it remain unchanged. We study this failure under adverse weather as Weather-Induced Context Interference. To our knowledge, this is the first controlled study of how weather-related exterior changes remove cooperative benefits while preserving all points inside annotated objects. Controlled experiments on simulated and real roadside inputs show that exterior loss changes object representations before fusion and removes previously useful assistance. On real inputs, restoring object-neighborhood features recovers 30 of 31 induced failures; three equal-area exterior controls recover none. The failure condition also appears with a second fusion model. These findings motivate Adverse-Weather Cooperative Repair (AWCR), with separate implementations for the available supervision. Point Classifier filters added weather returns in simulation. On real inputs, Local Correction refines candidates and Quality Selection checks them against current measurements, without naturally paired clear/adverse-weather recordings. Candidate tracing shows that correction supplies accurate geometry for some targets that original candidates cannot localize at the evaluation threshold. On natural adverse-weather CoInfra development data, AWCR improves car bird's-eye-view (BEV) AP@0.7 by 4.66 points with V2X-ViT and 5.56 with AttFuse. On simulated V2X-R fog, it improves vehicle BEV AP@0.7 by 4.47 points at a fixed 4,096-candidate budget.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并研究"天气诱导上下文干扰"（Weather-Induced Context Interference）：在协同3D检测中，即使目标上的LiDAR点完全不变，恶劣天气导致的目标外部邻域特征丢失也会使协同增益消失、造成漏检；作者据此提出恶劣天气协同修复方法AWCR，在真实与仿真数据上显著提升BEV AP@0.7。
AI.motivation: 协同3D检测通常被认为能通过多视角互补提升鲁棒性，但作者观察到：当恶劣天气改变目标外部区域（目标点云本身未变）时，协同检测器仍可能漏检，即协同收益被"无声地"消除。现有工作缺乏对"仅外部环境改变、标注目标内部点全部保留"这一条件下的受控研究，因此需要厘清该失效机理并提出修复方案。
AI.method: 1) 受控实验：在仿真与真实路侧输入上，保持标注目标内部点不变，仅改变目标邻域外部特征，验证失效是否由外部上下文损失引起；并设置三个等面积外部对照与第二个融合模型做排除性验证。2) 机理分析：表明外部特征损失在融合之前即改变了目标表征，从而消除原先有用的协同辅助。3) 方法AWCR（按可用监督分设实现）：仿真中用Point Classifier过滤新增的天气回波点；真实场景下用Local Correction精化候选、Quality Selection以当前测量校验候选，无需自然配对的晴/恶劣天气录制；并通过候选追踪分析修正对几何定位的作用。
AI.result: 真实输入上，恢复目标邻域特征可挽回31例诱导失效中的30例，而三个等面积外部对照均无法挽回；该失效条件在第二个融合模型上同样出现。在CoInfra自然恶劣天气开发集上，AWCR使V2X-ViT的汽车BEV AP@0.7提升4.66点、AttFuse提升5.56点；在仿真V2X-R雾天数据、固定4,096候选预算下，车辆BEV AP@0.7提升4.47点。
AI.conclusion: 协同检测的鲁棒性依赖于目标邻域的外部上下文，天气引起的外部表征退化可在目标点云完好时仍破坏协同融合。AWCR通过区分"天气伪回波"与"由测量校验的候选修正"两条路径，在不依赖配对清晰/恶劣天气数据的前提下恢复了协同收益，为该失效模式提供了有效且可迁移的修复范式。

title: DUET4D: Self-Corrective Coupled Guidance for Sparse-View 4D Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view 4D reconstruction is highly under-constrained when only a few cameras are available. Generative priors can recover missing appearances, but video models are computationally impractical for iterative reconstruction, whereas single-view models produce temporally inconsistent pseudo-observations. Moreover, directly absorbing uncertain generative outputs into Gaussian optimization often creates redundant primitives and floating artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose DUET4D, a self-corrective coupled guidance framework for sparse-view 4D Gaussian splatting. The core of our approach is a self-corrective framework where the 4D representation guides generative prior for spatio-temporal consistent supervisions. We first construct sequential alignments from current Gaussian evidence to steer the latent restoration. Then we use Sequential Fidelity Resampling to lift generative supervisions into Gaussian space to selectively distinguish repeatedly supported primitives. The corrected representation then provides more reliable Gaussian evidence for the next restoration cycle. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUET4D significantly improves rendering quality and rendering efficiency.

AI.tldr: DUET4D：面向稀疏视角4D高斯溅射的自校正耦合引导框架，用4D表示反向引导生成先验，形成时空一致监督的闭环迭代。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角下4D重建严重欠约束：视频生成模型算力昂贵、难以嵌入迭代重建；单视图生成模型产生时序不一致的伪观测；且直接吸收不确定生成结果易引入冗余基元与漂浮伪影。
AI.method: 构建自校正框架：先由当前高斯证据构造序列对齐（sequential alignments）以引导潜空间恢复；再用序列保真重采样（Sequential Fidelity Resampling）将生成监督提升至高斯空间，甄别被反复支持的基元；校正后的表示反过来为下一轮恢复提供更可靠的证据。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DUET4D 显著提升渲染质量与渲染效率。
AI.conclusion: 将生成先验与4D高斯表示耦合为自校正闭环，可有效缓解稀疏视角4D重建的欠约束与生成不一致问题，在质量与效率上均优于现有方案。

title: More Memory, Better Videos? A Controlled Study of Visual Memory in Long-Video Generation
summary: Long-video generators increasingly retrieve past visual observations to prevent identity drift. The intuition is compelling: more access to history should make future video more consistent. But an image can be faithful to the past and wrong for the present. Does visual memory always improve the generated story? We investigate this question through VMem-Bench, a two-track diagnostic study. Track-A measures which references are selected from 92 real films (16,548 segments), before generation and without generator confounds. Track-B compares four retrieval policies with no-memory and gold-informed last-seen controls on 30 causally generated stories (2,824 segments) using a shared generator. Retrieval increases entity recall from 0.559 to 0.628-0.693 and improves similarity to past appearances, but decreases precision from 0.977 to 0.915-0.938 and forbidden-entity avoidance from 0.968 to 0.845-0.898. It can also reinforce obsolete appearances after the story changes them. Conversely, high long-gap recall can arise without memory when the prompt itself supplies the appearance; an appearance-stripping analysis exposes this confound. These results distinguish historical fidelity from current-story correctness and show why retrieval relevance or final-video consistency alone does not establish memory utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VMem-Bench，双轨诊断长视频生成中的视觉记忆检索：检索虽提升实体召回与历史相似度，却降低精度与禁止实体规避，甚至强化过时外观；历史保真度≠当前故事正确性。
AI.motivation: 长视频生成普遍引入对过去视觉观察的检索以避免身份漂移，学界直觉认为"历史访问越多越一致"。但作者指出：一张图像可能忠实于过去却错误于当下，视觉记忆是否总让生成的故事更好缺乏严格检验。
AI.method: VMem-Bench双轨诊断。Track-A在生成前、排除生成器混杂，测量从92部真实影片（16,548段）中选取哪些参考。Track-B使用共享生成器，在30个因果生成故事（2,824段）上比较四种检索策略与无记忆、gold-informed last-seen对照；并设计appearance-stripping消融分析以暴露提示词自身上下文带来的混淆。
AI.result: 检索将实体召回率从0.559提升至0.628–0.693，并提高与过往外观的相似度；但精度从0.977降至0.915–0.938，禁止实体规避从0.968降至0.845–0.898。检索还会在故事改变外观后强化过时外观。反之，当提示词本身已提供外观时，无记忆也能出现高长间隔召回。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了"历史保真度"与"当前故事正确性"，表明仅凭检索相关性或最终视频一致性不足以证明记忆的效用；需要面向当前故事正确性的评测与记忆使用机制。

title: Fed-MAPTrack: Federated Modality-aware Prompt Tuning for RGB-X Tracking
summary: RGB-X tracking complements RGB appearance with thermal, depth, or event observations, but centralized training requires collecting multimodal videos at a single location. Federated training keeps raw videos local, but sensor heterogeneity can create a mismatch between parameter-sharing domains and the clients contributing to them. This mismatch is particularly relevant when RGB-only clients coexist with sensor-equipped clients: their RGB observations remain useful, but they provide no auxiliary measurements for learning sensor-dependent interactions. We propose Fed-MAPTrack, a modality-aware federated prompt tuning framework for RGB-X tracking. The pretrained tracking backbone and prediction head are frozen, and clients optimize and exchange only prompt-related parameters. The server aggregates RGB-shared parameters globally and maintains separate thermal, event, and depth banks for auxiliary-specific, fusion, and normalization parameters. Selective participation retains RGB-only clients' contributions to the global RGB bank while excluding their fusion and normalization updates from modality-specific aggregation. Across three matched training repetitions under a fixed client partition, Fed-MAPTrack improves the mean FedAvg scores by 2.35 AUC points on LasHeR, 3.45 SR points on VisEvent, and 2.11 F-score points on DepthTrack. Among the nine evaluated methods, it achieves the highest mean thermal AUC and depth F-score, while its mean event SR is 0.07 points below that of Independent FL. Controlled ablations show that extending the bucketing scope without a compatible participation rule can reduce performance. These results highlight the need to jointly define the sharing domain and eligible contributors for each parameter group.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fed-MAPTrack，一种面向 RGB-X 跟踪的模态感知联邦提示微调框架，冻结骨干与预测头，仅优化并交换提示相关参数，按模态建立独立参数库并选择性吸纳客户端，缓解传感器异构下的共享域与贡献者错配。
AI.motivation: 集中式 RGB-X 训练需在同一地点采集多模态视频；联邦训练虽保留原始视频本地化，但传感器异构导致参数共享域与实际贡献客户端不匹配，尤其 RGB-only 客户端与传感器客户端共存时，其无辅助模态观测，却会被纳入融合/归一化等模态相关聚合。
AI.method: 冻结预训练跟踪骨干与预测头，仅优化提示相关参数；服务器全局聚合 RGB 共享参数，并为 thermal/event/depth 分别维护辅助特定、融合与归一化参数库；采用选择性参与规则，保留 RGB-only 客户端对全局 RGB 库的贡献，但将其融合与归一化更新排除于模态特定聚合之外。
AI.result: 在固定客户端划分的三次匹配训练重复下，平均 FedAvg 分数提升：LasHeR 上 +2.35 AUC，VisEvent 上 +3.45 SR，DepthTrack 上 +2.11 F-score。九种方法中取得最高平均 thermal AUC 与 depth F-score，事件 SR 较 Independent FL 低 0.07。消融显示，在无兼容参与规则时扩大参数分桶范围会降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 需为每组参数联合定义共享域与合格贡献者；模态感知的提示微调加选择性参与可在保护隐私的前提下有效利用异构客户端数据，提升 RGB-X 跟踪性能。

title: Learning Dual-Camera Smooth Zoom via Decoupled Geometric-Photometric Data Synthesis
comment: Project page: https://hitjunjief.github.io/DCSZ-v2/; Code: https://github.com/hitfanjj/DCSZ-v2. 13 pages, 13 figures
summary: When zooming between dual cameras on smartphones, prominent discontinuities in both geometric perspective and color rendition inevitably degrade the visual experience of users. To address this issue, we introduce the dual-camera smooth zoom (DCSZ) task, aiming to synthesize continuous intermediate frames for fluid zooming. However, directly applying existing video frame interpolation (VFI) models to this task is severely hindered by substantial domain gaps and the practical intractability of capturing real-world continuous ground-truth. To this end, we propose a novel data synthesis framework to generate high-fidelity DCSZ training sequences, named ZoomGS v2. It explicitly decouples geometric and color transformations from 3D scene representation modeling, thereby enabling extensive data generation from easily accessible single-camera 3D scenes. Furthermore, we develop ZoomFI, a specialized VFI network tailored to the DCSZ task, which leverages complementary bidirectional warping for comprehensive dual-camera information fusion. Extensive experiments on test datasets captured using two mobile phones demonstrate that training with the constructed DCSZ data significantly improves the performance of various VFI models. Moreover, ZoomFI achieves state-of-the-art results in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. The datasets, code, and pretrained models are available at https://hitjunjief.github.io/DCSZ-v2

AI.tldr: 提出双摄平滑变焦（DCSZ）任务，用数据合成框架ZoomGS v2生成训练数据，并设计专用视频插帧网络ZoomFI，实现智能手机双摄变焦的连续过渡。
AI.motivation: 智能手机双摄切换时几何透视与色彩渲染出现明显不连续，破坏变焦视觉体验；而直接套用现有VFI模型受域间隙和真实连续真值难以获取的制约。
AI.method: 提出ZoomGS v2数据合成框架，从3D场景表示建模中显式解耦几何变换与色彩变换，从而利用易获取的单摄3D场景大规模生成高保真DCSZ训练序列；并设计ZoomFI网络，采用互补双向warping实现双摄信息融合。
AI.result: 在两部手机采集的测试集上，所构造的DCSZ数据显著提升多种VFI模型性能；ZoomFI在定量指标与视觉质量上均达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 数据合成与专用网络相结合可有效解决双摄变焦的连续性问题，数据集、代码与预训练模型已开源。

title: Towards Spatio-Temporal Intelligence Systems in Urban Space: A Twin-Agent Perspective
comment: A review of urban digital twins and urban agent systems
summary: Cities must coordinate domains like infrastructure, mobility, environmental management, emergency response, and public services as conditions evolve. An urban Spatio-Temporal Intelligence (STI) system helps the city monitor citywide states, analyze problems, plan and execute interventions, and adapt through feedback, making urban governance more timely, effective, and transparent. Recent urban twinning and agentic AI techniques provide foundations for such systems. From a twin-agent perspective, this survey takes a system-level view of how these disparate techniques can be coherently integrated into an urban STI system. Specifically, we review how the twin reconstructs and represents a persistent, information-enriched urban environment, and how the agent understands the twin via interfaces, reasons over it, acts reliably, and continuously evolves with the city. Built upon this synthesis, we summarize a two-loop blueprint, where an inner agent loop for grounding, reasoning, and verification, and an outer system loop linking data, twin, agentic action, feedback, and update. We then use this to structure an STI research agenda and show how a shared prototype supports diverse urban domains.

AI.tldr: 从"孪生—智能体"视角系统综述城市时空智能（STI）系统，提出内环（智能体grounding—推理—验证）与外环（数据—孪生—智能体行动—反馈—更新）的双环蓝图，并据此构建研究议程与跨领域共享原型。
AI.motivation: 城市需在基础设施、出行、环境管理、应急响应与公共服务等多领域随条件变化进行协调，亟需更及时、有效、透明的城市治理。城市孪生与智能体AI技术已为城市时空智能系统提供基础，但已有技术分散，缺乏系统级视角说明如何将其有机整合为统一的城市STI系统。
AI.method: 综述性研究，采用系统级视角：1）分析孪生如何重建并表征一个持久、信息丰富的城市环境；2）分析智能体如何通过接口理解孪生、在其上进行推理、可靠行动并随城市持续演化；3）在此基础上归纳出双环蓝图——内环为智能体的grounding—推理—验证闭环，外环为数据—孪生—智能体行动—反馈—更新的系统闭环。
AI.result: 提出双环蓝图为分散技术提供统一整合框架；据此组织STI研究议程，并展示一个共享原型如何支撑多个城市领域（如基础设施、出行、环境、应急与公共服务）的多样化应用。
AI.conclusion: 城市STI系统的关键在于孪生与智能体的协同整合，双环蓝图可作为组织研究与系统设计的系统级参照框架，并通过共享原型实现跨领域复用。

title: P2P-Former: Bridging the Supervision Gap Between Point and Proposal in Temporal Action Localization
summary: Recently, point-supervised temporal action localization has attracted increasing attention due to its low annotation cost (only one frame per action instance) and competitive detection performance. However, since point annotations are less complete than proposal annotations, existing methods mainly rely on multiple instance learning for snippet-level classification, which leads to a performance gap compared to fully supervised models. To bridge this gap, we propose P2P-Former, a novel point-to-proposal Transformer-based framework that effectively connects point-level supervision with proposal-level learning for temporal action localization. In this work, we identify two key challenges in transitioning from point-level supervision to full supervision: (1) how to generate reliable proposals as pseudo ground-truth, and (2) how to effectively integrate point-level cues into the fully supervised paradigm. To address the first challenge, we propose a Point-aware Proposal Generation (PPG) strategy that refines the confidence of proposals produced by a base locator using a point-aware importance estimation function, and then performs optimal matching between point annotations and candidate proposals to select reliable proposals as pseudo ground-truth. To tackle the second challenge, we introduce a Point-guided Semantic Enhancement (PSE) module that aggregates prototypes from point-annotated features and injects them into snippet features through Transformer-based interactions. Moreover, we design a Point-to-Proposal Constraint Loss (PPCL) that enforces each predicted proposal to include the annotated point, thereby encouraging more accurate localization. Extensive experiments on the THUMOS14 and ActivityNet-1.3 datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms several existing state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出P2P-Former框架，将点级监督与提议级学习有效衔接，缩小点监督时序动作定位与全监督模型的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 点监督（每个动作实例仅一帧标注）成本低且性能有竞争力，但因点标注不如提议标注完整，现有方法主要依赖多实例学习进行片段级分类，导致与全监督模型存在性能差距。核心难点有二：(1)如何生成可靠的伪真值提议；(2)如何将点级线索有效融入全监督范式。
AI.method: 提出P2P-Former（点到提议的Transformer框架），包含三个组件：(1) Point-aware Proposal Generation (PPG)：用点感知重要性估计函数细化基础定位器产出的提议置信度，再对点标注与候选提议做最优匹配以筛选可靠提议作为伪真值；(2) Point-guided Semantic Enhancement (PSE)：从点标注特征聚合原型，并通过Transformer交互注入片段特征；(3) Point-to-Proposal Constraint Loss (PPCL)：约束每个预测提议包含其标注点，促使定位更准确。
AI.result: 在THUMOS14与ActivityNet-1.3数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法优于多种现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过点感知提议生成、点引导语义增强与点-提议约束损失，P2P-Former成功实现从点级监督向提议级/全监督范式的过渡，为低成本时序动作定位提供了有效方案。

title: FlexiMIND: Combined Pretrained Vision Features and Local Structure for Training-Free Deformable Medical Image Registration
summary: Objective. Deformable image registration remains challenging because corresponding anatomy may exhibit different intensity relationships. Hand-crafted modality-robust descriptors such as Modality-Independent Neighborhood Descriptor with Self-Similarity Context (MIND-SSC) and features from pretrained vision encoders provide distinct representations for correspondence estimation, but how they should be combined remains unclear. We investigate whether tighter integration improves registration over a sequential, scale-separated design. Approach. We introduce FlexiMIND, a training-free and label-free two-stage framework in which frozen FlexiCT-2D encoder features establish contextual correspondence and MIND-SSC refines the deformation within ConvexAdam. Five alternative feature-coupling strategies were evaluated under a protocol across CT-CT (DIR-Lab 4DCT 4DCT, 10 cases), MR-MR (ACDC, 50 patients), and MR-CT (Learn2Reg Abdomen MR-CT, 8 pairs) registration. Performance was assessed using target registration error (TRE), Dice similarity coefficient (Dice), SDlogJ, and local folding. Main results. FlexiMIND achieved a TRE of 1.27 mm on DIR-Lab 4DCT, a DSC of 0.807 on ACDC, and an organ-averaged DSC of 0.825 on Abdomen MR-CT. Across 15 coupling-strategy dataset comparisons, only four outperformed the reference method, with a maximum absolute improvement of 0.0043 in Dice, whereas degradation reached 20.6 % in TRE and 37.9 % in Dice. Changes in registration accuracy were closely associated with changes in deformation-field regularity, and strategies that better preserved regularity generally remained closest to the reference performance. Landmark-level analysis showed that the pretrained encoder stage primarily reduced large correspondence errors rather than uniformly improving local precision. Code is available upon acceptance at https://github.com/mosaf/FlexiMIND.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练、无需标签的两阶段配准框架FlexiMIND：冻结的FlexiCT-2D编码器特征建立上下文对应，MIND-SSC在ConvexAdam内细化形变；并系统比较五种特征耦合策略，发现更紧耦合并未优于"尺度分离"的串行设计。
AI.motivation: 可变形图像配准中，对应解剖结构可能呈现不同强度关系。手工的模态鲁棒描述子（如MIND-SSC）与预训练视觉编码器特征各自提供不同的对应表征，但二者应如何组合尚不清楚；作者希望验证更紧密的特征集成是否能优于串行的、尺度分离的设计。
AI.method: FlexiMIND为两阶段、免训练免标签框架：第一阶段用冻结的FlexiCT-2D编码器特征建立上下文对应，第二阶段用MIND-SSC在ConvexAdam中细化形变。在统一协议下评估5种替代特征耦合策略，覆盖CT-CT（DIR-Lab 4DCT，10例）、MR-MR（ACDC，50例）与MR-CT（Learn2Reg Abdomen MR-CT，8对）配准任务，指标为TRE、Dice、SDlogJ与局部折叠。
AI.result: FlexiMIND在DIR-Lab 4DCT上TRE为1.27 mm，ACDC上DSC为0.807，Abdomen MR-CT上器官平均DSC为0.825。在15组耦合策略-数据集比较中，仅4组优于参考方法，Dice最大绝对提升0.0043，而退化可达TRE 20.6%、Dice 37.9%。配准精度变化与形变场正则性变化密切相关，较好保持正则性的策略通常最接近参考性能。标记点级分析表明，预训练编码器阶段主要减少大的对应误差，而非均匀提升局部精度。
AI.conclusion: 更紧密的特征耦合并不能稳定提升配准性能，串行、尺度分离的两阶段设计（上下文对应+局部细化）是稳健有效方案；性能收益主要来自对大对应误差的抑制，同时需关注形变场正则性的保持。代码将在接收后于 https://github.com/mosaf/FlexiMIND 开放。

title: FlockWorld: Toward Population-Scale Multi-Agent Video World Models through Artificial Life Simulation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Creative AI Track
summary: Most action-conditioned video world models remain limited to a single player, while existing multiplayer models support only small, fixed groups of agents. We introduce FlockWorld, an artificial-life environment built on Reynolds's Boids algorithm for studying population-scale multi-agent video world models. Specifically, FlockWorld renders synchronized egocentric crops, assigns distinct colors to preserve camera-agent identity across views, exposes rule-derived accelerations as actions, and lets the number of camera agents be configured independently of the size of the surrounding population. We further introduce FlockDiT, an action-conditioned latent diffusion transformer trained with flow matching on FlockWorld data to jointly generate synchronized egocentric videos for multiple agents. Our results suggest that joint generation benefits agent detection at density-matched settings and that diffusion forcing improves rollout fidelity. Together, FlockWorld and FlockDiT provide a controlled testbed for multi-agent video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlockWorld（基于 Boids 的群体规模多智能体视频环境）与 FlockDiT（动作条件潜空间扩散 Transformer），用于研究多智能体同步自我中心视频世界模型，并发现联合生成有助于智能体检测、diffusion forcing 提升长时推演保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频世界模型多局限于单智能体，已有多人模型仅支持规模小且固定的智能体组，缺乏可控的群体规模多智能体视频生成测试平台。
AI.method: 构建 FlockWorld：基于 Reynolds Boids 算法的人工生命环境，渲染同步的自我中心裁剪视图，用不同颜色保持跨视图的相机-智能体身份一致性，将规则推导的加速度作为动作，且相机智能体数量可独立于周围群体规模配置。提出 FlockDiT：动作条件潜扩散 Transformer，采用 flow matching 在 FlockWorld 数据上训练，联合生成多智能体同步自我中心视频；并考察 diffusion forcing 对推演的影响。
AI.result: 在密度匹配设置下，联合生成有利于智能体检测；diffusion forcing 可提升 rollout 保真度。
AI.conclusion: FlockWorld 与 FlockDiT 共同构成面向多智能体视频生成的受控测试平台。

title: VTC-AUDIT: An Interventional Reliability Audit for Visual-Token Compression under Paired Image Shifts
comment: 9 pages, 6 tables. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/IsaacLi74/VTC-AUDIT
summary: Visual-token compression is usually evaluated by clean accuracy and efficiency, but these averages do not reveal failures that compression introduces under an image shift where the uncompressed model stays correct. We introduce VTC-AUDIT, which estimates this incremental risk only on pairs where the full model is correct on both images and the compressed model is correct on the clean image. The four arms then cross two binary choices: which image selects the retained token positions, and which image supplies the visual features. We audit three open 8-9B vision-language models on four tasks and eight pre-specified shifts. We evaluate two training-free compressors---hard-pruning DivPrune and prune-and-merge ApET---at a matched 25% retained-position budget, producing 708,000 inference records. Reselecting positions on the shifted image, rather than reusing the clean-image positions, raises the failure rate in all six model-compressor settings. The increase is 3.04-9.60 percentage points for DivPrune and 2.05-4.20 percentage points for ApET, with every 95% interval above zero. Repeating the audit on a separately resampled second manifest reproduces all six increases. In a pooled monitor audit across the four benchmarks, support Jaccard instability fails the practical AUROC criterion of 0.65 in all six settings, whereas clean compressed-model uncertainty clears it. Thus, support turnover is a weak ranking signal under the audited benchmark mixture, while clean compressed-model uncertainty is substantially more informative. These results suggest that future visual-token compression evaluations should report conditional reliability alongside clean accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VTC-AUDIT 审计框架，在"全模型在两张图上均正确、压缩模型在干净图上正确"的条件子集上估计增量失败风险，发现按移位图像重新选择保留位置会显著抬高失败率（DivPrune 3.04–9.60pp，ApET 2.05–4.20pp），且支持集换手率（Jaccard 不稳定）作为排序信号弱于干净压缩模型的置信度。
AI.motivation: 视觉 token 压缩通常仅用干净精度与效率衡量，平均值掩盖了在图像分布移位下、未压缩模型仍正确时压缩所引入的失败。作者希望量化这种"增量风险"，并检验哪些监控信号能有效预警。
AI.method: 在 3 个 8–9B 开源视觉语言模型、4 个任务、8 个预指定移位上，以 25% 保留位置预算评估两种免训练压缩器（硬剪枝 DivPrune、剪枝-合并 ApET）。采用 2×2 四臂设计，交叉两个二元选择：由哪张图决定保留位置、由哪张图提供视觉特征；共生成 708,000 条推理记录，并在独立重采样的第二清单上复现；另做池化监控审计，比较支持集 Jaccard 不稳定性与干净压缩模型不确定性的 AUROC。
AI.result: 在移位图像上重新选择位置（而非复用干净图位置）使全部 6 个"模型×压缩器"组合的失败率上升：DivPrune 提升 3.04–9.60 个百分点，ApET 提升 2.05–4.20 个百分点，所有 95% 区间均高于零，第二清单复现全部 6 项增量。池化审计中，支持集 Jaccard 不稳定性在全部 6 个设置下均未达到 0.65 的实用 AUROC 门槛，而干净压缩模型不确定性达标。
AI.conclusion: 支持集换手率在所审基准混合下是较弱的排序信号，干净压缩模型不确定性信息量明显更高。作者建议未来视觉 token 压缩评估应在干净精度与效率之外，一并报告这种条件可靠性指标。

title: Multi-Agent Relay Thinking
summary: Existing multi-agent collaboration (MAC) methods have primarily explored a group thinking collaboration topology, where agents independently generate solutions and aggregate their outputs. In this work, we investigate an alternative relay thinking topology, where reasoning ownership is dynamically transferred across agents, allowing subsequent agents to inherit and refine an evolving reasoning trajectory. We introduce Multi-Agent Confidence-guided Relay (MACR), a framework that enables dynamical relay collaboration among agents. The key challenge is determining when reasoning should be relayed and which agent should continue the process. method addresses this challenge through confidence-guided relay triggering and a bidding mechanism that selects the next agent based on its confidence. Experiments on four benchmarks show that method outperforms the strongest single-model strategies in accuracy, e.g., +3.3% on MathVista and +3.9% on MMStar, and remains on par with multi-agent strategies while consuming 6.0x less token overhead on HallusionBench and MMStar.Further analysis demonstrates that relay collaboration enables heterogeneous agents to progressively integrate complementary insights, combining heterogeneous capabilities across reasoning stages. Our source code is available at https://github.com/67L1/MACR.

AI.tldr: 提出MACR框架，以"接力式思维"拓扑替代传统多智能体"群体思维"拓扑，通过置信度触发的接力与竞价机制动态转移推理主导权。
AI.motivation: 现有MAC方法多采用群体思维拓扑（各自独立生成再聚合），未探索推理轨迹可被继承与精炼的接力式协作方式。
AI.method: MACR：置信度引导的接力触发判断"何时接力"，竞价机制依据各智能体置信度选择"由谁接力"，使后续智能体继承并改进演进中的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 四个基准上优于最强单模型策略（MathVista +3.3%，MMStar +3.9%），并在HallusionBench与MMStar上与多智能体策略持平且token开销降低6.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 接力协作可使异构智能体逐步整合互补洞见，在不同推理阶段组合异构能力，实现高效且有效的多智能体协作。

title: EARS: Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and Motion for Budgeted Video Reasoning
summary: Uniform frame sampling can miss brief evidence in sparse-event videos when the VLM sees only K frames. We propose EARS (Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and motion), a training-free, query-free front-end that ranks frames using optical-flow motion and audio energy, then applies temporal non-maximum suppression for diversity. The evidence score alone has frame-level AP 0.39; used only to select frames for the VLM, EARS with temporal diversity reaches localization AP 0.94, compared with 0.88 under Uniform sampling. In the updated matched study, at K = 1 EARS reaches XD-subset F1 0.660 versus 0.614 for centered Uniform (the paired interval includes zero); earlier backbone studies use separate protocols. On mostly-silent UCF-Crime, however, EARS slightly trails Uniform. A single configuration is used across both benchmarks; the new controls do not repeat the original held-out search. EARS therefore targets low-budget videos whose salient evidence aligns with motion or audio; on dense narratives or stealthy events, uniform or semantic selection remains preferable, and cheap modality statistics cannot reliably route between them. Code: https://github.com/mikeslin-ir/EARS

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、免查询的前端EARS，用光流运动与音频能量对帧打分并做时序NMS，在低预算下显著提升VLM稀疏事件定位，但对静音或隐蔽事件失效。
AI.motivation: VLM仅能观察K帧，均匀帧采样在稀疏事件视频中容易漏掉短暂的关键证据，因此需要一种无需训练、无需查询的帧选择前端来提升有限帧预算下的证据覆盖率。
AI.method: EARS以光流运动强度与音频能量构建证据分数并对帧排序，再用时序非极大值抑制（temporal NMS）保证所选帧的多样性；属于training-free、query-free的前端，仅用于为VLM挑选帧，单一配置跨两个基准使用。
AI.result: 证据分数单独使用时帧级AP为0.39；加入时序多样性后定位AP达0.94，高于Uniform的0.88。更新后的匹配研究在K=1时XD-subset F1为0.660（居中Uniform为0.614），但配对区间含零；在基本静音的UCF-Crime上EARS略逊于Uniform。
AI.conclusion: EARS适用于证据与运动或音频对齐的低预算视频；对密集叙事或隐蔽事件，均匀或语义选择更优，且廉价模态统计不足以可靠地路由二者；新对照未重复原始留出搜索。

title: TP-JSCC: Efficient Token Pruning and Joint Source-Channel Coding for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration
summary: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC.

AI.tldr: 提出TP-JSCC方法，结合局部/全局语义混合token剪枝(LGS-HTP)与轻量级token联合信源信道编码(T-JSCC)，实现云边协同下LVLM 3D-VQA的高效鲁棒传输，整体数据量降低180倍、计算复杂度节省90%，精度损失极小。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的具身智能体上部署大视觉语言模型(LVLM)进行3D视觉问答需要云边协同，但将海量视觉数据经带宽受限且噪声信道卸载至云端会带来严重时延与传输失真，因此亟需兼顾压缩效率与传输鲁棒性的方案。
AI.method: 1) LGS-HTP模块：通过解耦前景-背景token并联合选择局部与全局语义，在保留推理关键token的同时大幅削减视觉token冗余；2) T-JSCC模块：采用轻量级级联线性层与信噪比(SNR)自适应机制，对剪枝后token进一步压缩并保证错误信道下的鲁棒传输，计算开销极小。
AI.result: 在ScanQA与SQA3D数据集上验证：ScanQA验证集上LGS-HTP实现90%剪枝率而CIDEr损失<1%；T-JSCC在此基础上再压缩18倍，整体数据量降低180倍，同时为LVLM部署节省90%计算复杂度，展现出优异的效率与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TP-JSCC为云边协同下LVLM 3D-VQA提供了一种高效、鲁棒的压缩-传输一体化方案，在保持精度的前提下显著降低传输数据量与计算开销，适配动态信道条件。

title: OBB-PBD: Extending Parallel Box Decoding to Oriented Bounding Boxes for Referring Expression Grounding in Aerial Imagery
comment: Published in Remote Sensing 18(20), 3535 (2026). Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/ce-dric/OBB-PBD and https://huggingface.co/ce-dric/OBB-PBD
summary: Referring expression grounding in overhead imagery requires oriented bounding boxes rather than horizontal ones, since aerial objects appear at arbitrary orientations. Most grounding models emit box coordinates sequentially; Parallel Box Decoding (PBD) instead predicts all geometry slots in one forward pass, but only for four-coordinate horizontal boxes. We extend this block-aligned interface to a six-slot oriented representation using a double-angle parameterization. Rather than assuming correctness from a decreasing loss curve, we verify the extension with image/prompt-shuffle controls and visibility/leakage probes, which show that the corrected model depends on both the image and the prompt rather than on prompt statistics alone. On the aerial vehicle visual grounding (AVVG) benchmark, whose targets are genuinely oriented, the extended model improves rotated intersection over union (rotIoU) from 0.1253 for the zero-shot baseline to 0.303 +/- 0.012 (mean +/- standard deviation over three training seeds) across the complete 6139-record test split spanning all 120 images. Learning oriented boxes rather than their axis-aligned envelopes adds 0.055 +/- 0.008 rotIoU beyond a matched control (per-seed 95% confidence intervals all excluding zero), whereas block expansion alone yields no rotIoU gain distinguishable from zero.

AI.tldr: 将并行框解码（PBD）的四坐标水平框接口扩展为六槽定向框表示（双角度参数化），并用对照实验验证模型确实依赖图像与文本，在AVVG上rotIoU由0.1253提升到0.303。
AI.motivation: 航拍目标朝向任意，定向框（OBB）比水平框更贴合；而现有PBD式并行解码仅支持四坐标水平框，需要把块对齐接口扩展到六槽定向表示，并避免仅凭损失下降就断言扩展有效。
AI.method: 采用双角度参数化把PBD的块对齐接口扩为6个几何槽；以图像/提示词打乱对照、可见性与泄漏探针检验模型是否真正依赖图像与提示词；在AVVG上以3个训练种子统计rotIoU，并设置"轴对齐包络框"匹配对照与"仅扩展块"对照进行消融。
AI.result: AVVG完整6139条测试记录（120幅图像）上rotIoU从零样本基线0.1253提升至0.303±0.012；学习定向框较轴对齐包络匹配对照额外增益0.055±0.008（各种子95%CI均不含0），而单纯扩展块带来的rotIoU增益与0不可区分。
AI.conclusion: 六槽双角度定向表示可有效拓展并行框解码；增益来源是定向几何建模而非参数/块容量增加，且经对照探针证实模型依赖图像与提示词而非提示词统计捷径。

title: Toward Clinical Translation of Deep Learning-Based Intracranial Super-Resolution 4D Flow MRI Using Multi-Cohort Transfer Learning
comment: 28 pages, 6 main figures, 4 main tables; supplementary material includes 6 sections, 2 figures, and 1 table
summary: We evaluated synthetic pretraining and multi-cohort transfer learning for deep learning-based super-resolution of intracranial 4D Flow MRI across heterogeneous neurologic cohorts. This mixed prospective-retrospective study analyzed 18 participants (12 healthy participants, 3 with moyamoya disease, and 3 with multiple sclerosis) with paired 1.2-mm and 0.6-mm 4D Flow MRI scans. A convolutional neural network pretrained on synthetic cerebrovascular data was fine-tuned using cohort-specific or pooled multi-cohort in vivo data. High-resolution-derived inputs enabled voxel-wise evaluation; native standard-resolution scans were used for angiographic and hemodynamic analyses. Synthetic pretraining reduced mean artery-wise velocity-normalized root mean square error (vNRMSE) versus interpolation (0.147 vs 0.166). Pooled transfer learning yielded the lowest mean vNRMSE (0.119 vs 0.127 for cohort-specific models and 0.147 for synthetic pretraining), with narrower 95% limits-of-agreement widths than synthetic pretraining across all test cases (0.109-0.222 vs 0.154-0.278 m/s). Super-resolved phase-contrast angiography achieved higher precision-recall area under the curve than native standard-resolution imaging in all cohorts (0.848-0.896 vs 0.486-0.805). These results indicate that pooled transfer learning improves cross-cohort reconstruction agreement and that super-resolution can improve vessel depiction, supporting further multi-center validation for cerebrovascular imaging.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了合成数据预训练与多队列迁移学习在颅内4D Flow MRI超分辨率重建中的效果，发现合并多队列迁移学习在跨队列一致性上最优。
AI.motivation: 颅内4D Flow MRI存在空间分辨率与成像时间的权衡，深度学习超分辨率可缓解该问题，但跨异质神经系统队列的泛化性（预训练与迁移策略）尚不明确。
AI.method: 混合前瞻-回顾性研究，纳入18名受试者（12名健康、3名烟雾病、3名多发性硬化），采集配对的1.2 mm与0.6 mm 4D Flow MRI。先在合成脑血管数据上预训练CNN，再用队列特异或合并多队列的在体数据进行微调；以高分辨率衍生输入做体素级评估，并以原生标准分辨率扫描做血管造影与血流动力学分析。
AI.result: 合成预训练较插值降低平均逐动脉速度归一化RMSE（vNRMSE：0.147 vs 0.166）；合并迁移学习取得最低vNRMSE（0.119，队列特异模型0.127，合成预训练0.147），且95%一致性界限宽度更窄（0.109–0.222 vs 0.154–0.278 m/s）。超分辨相位对比血管造影的PR-AUC在所有队列中均高于原生标准分辨率（0.848–0.896 vs 0.486–0.805）。
AI.conclusion: 合并多队列迁移学习可提升跨队列重建一致性，超分辨率能改善血管描绘，支持开展多中心验证以推进脑血管成像应用。

title: GIFT: Representation Geometry Matters for Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection
summary: Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (S-DGOD) aims to generalize from a single source domain to unseen domains under distribution shifts. Existing efforts mainly focus on simulating unseen domains or suppressing domain-specific factors. However, they largely overlook the intrinsic generalization capability embedded in Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). In this work, we show that unconstrained fine-tuning disrupts the geometric structure of pre-trained representations, which encodes domain-invariant semantics. Motivated by this, we propose Geometric-Invariance Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a geometric-aware fine-tuning method for VFMs. Specifically, we introduce a series of learnable Householder reflections to the pre-trained weights to encourage geometry-consistent adaptation under domain shift. In addition, we propose a lightweight channel-wise scaling to facilitate effective task-specific adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GIFT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches on two S-DGOD benchmarks. Notably, by introducing fewer than 1% additional trainable parameters into the frozen backbone, the proposed method achieves improvements of +7.9% and +2.9% in mPC over the previous SOTA on the Cityscapes-C and Diverse Weather Dataset, respectively. This finding highlights that preserving representation geometry is crucial for robust cross-domain generalization, establishing GIFT as a principled and efficient solution to domain shift.

AI.tldr: 提出GIFT——一种几何感知的视觉基础模型微调方法，通过可学习的Householder反射与通道缩放保持预训练表征的几何结构，在单域泛化目标检测任务上以不到1%的额外参数超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有S-DGOD方法主要依赖模拟未见域或抑制域特定因素，忽视了视觉基础模型（VFM）本身内蕴的泛化能力；作者指出无约束微调会破坏预训练表征中编码域不变语义的几何结构。
AI.method: 在预训练权重上引入一系列可学习的Householder反射，促使域偏移下实现几何一致的适配；并辅以轻量级的逐通道缩放（channel-wise scaling）以完成高效的任务特定适配；主干网络保持冻结，仅训练极少参数。
AI.result: 在两个S-DGOD基准（Cityscapes-C、Diverse Weather Dataset）上持续优于SOTA；以不到1%的额外可训练参数，mPC分别提升+7.9%与+2.9%。
AI.conclusion: 保持表征几何结构对鲁棒跨域泛化至关重要，GIFT为域偏移问题提供了原理清晰且高效的解决方案。

title: MatAnyone-E: Sparse Memory Propagation for Efficient High-Resolution Video Matting
summary: High-resolution video matting requires preserving fine details, such as hair strands and soft transparency, while maintaining consistency across frames. Memory-based methods achieve strong matting quality by matching current-frame features with information stored from earlier frames, but this process becomes increasingly costly as resolution grows. We present MatAnyone-E, an efficient extension of MatAnyone 2 that focuses computation where it is most needed. Our approach first performs low-resolution propagation to identify uncertain regions that require closer inspection and the memory candidates most relevant to them. It then performs high-resolution matching only for these regions using the selected memory, while reusing low-resolution matching results elsewhere. This strategy reduces both the number of locations requiring detailed matching and the amount of memory searched, while preserving the information needed to produce a complete matte. We further reduce the cost of generating high-resolution mattes with a lightweight decoder designed around measured runtime bottlenecks and trained to reproduce the original decoder's representations. Experiments show that MatAnyone-E maintains matting quality comparable to MatAnyone 2 while achieving an estimated 7.4x inference speedup and reducing peak GPU memory usage to 7.6% of the usage of MatAnyone 2 at 4K. With compilation-enabled inference on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, it reaches 73.07 FPS at 1080p and 28.62 FPS at 4K.

AI.tldr: MatAnyone-E：通过"低分辨率传播定位不确定区域 + 选择性高分辨率记忆匹配 + 轻量解码器"降低 4K 视频抠像的计算与显存开销，质量持平 MatAnyone 2，估算 7.4× 加速，4K 峰值显存降至 7.6%，单卡 H200 达 1080p 73.07 FPS、4K 28.62 FPS。
AI.motivation: 基于记忆的高分辨率视频抠像需保头发丝、软透明等细节并保证时序一致性，但记忆匹配代价随分辨率增长而急剧上升，难以实时/高分辨率部署。
AI.method: 1）先做低分辨率传播，识别需要精细处理的不确定区域及其最相关的记忆候选；2）仅对这些区域用筛选后的记忆做高分辨率匹配，其余位置复用低分辨率匹配结果，从而同时减少需精匹配的位置数与记忆检索量；3）依据实测运行时瓶颈设计轻量解码器，并通过蒸馏式训练复现原解码器表示，进一步降低高分辨率哑图生成成本。
AI.result: 质量与 MatAnyone 2 相当；估算推理加速 7.4×；4K 峰值 GPU 显存仅为 MatAnyone 2 的 7.6%；编译推理下单块 NVIDIA H200 上 1080p 73.07 FPS、4K 28.62 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 将计算按需分配到高不确定性区域是提升记忆型抠像效率的有效途径，可在几乎不损质量的前提下实现高分辨率实时视频抠像；但加速比为"估算"值，缺少与精确全分辨率基线的严格对照及感知指标细节。

title: Do vision models know that three is three?
summary: Do vision models encode the transition $2{\to}3$ the same way whether it appears in handwritten digits or in hand gestures, and do they "understand" that clean${\to}$dirty is the same transformation regardless of whether it is applied to a kitchen or a carpet? The linear representation hypothesis (LRH) answers this for language models: concept changes correspond to directions in (language) embedding space. In vision, the same concept can manifest in visually unrelated "regimes" that rarely co-occur: images of digits and hands do not share much in common in pixel space. To understand whether vision models still encode the underlying abstract concepts, we study 46 vision encoders across architectures, training objectives, and scales, on 10 concept families including numerosity, age, object identity, and MIT-States attributes. Within each regime, we find statistically significant concept directions near-universally across our tested models. However, two distinct regimes do not always share the same concept direction. Several models learn multiple linear structures for the same concept transition, split across regimes. We call this phenomenon "fragmented linearity": strong local linearity coexisting with near-absent global linearity. Fragmentation is, however, not fixed: models with stronger local linearity progressively escape it (local-global linearity correlated with $τ\in [0.38, 0.89]$ across all concepts), and where global linearity does emerge, concept directions can transfer as linear probes across regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"碎片化线性"现象：视觉模型在单一视觉"regime"内普遍存在显著的概念方向（局部线性性），但跨regime的同一概念转变往往不共享同一线性方向（全局线性性缺失），且局部线性性越强的模型越能逐步克服碎片化。
AI.motivation: 线性表示假说（LRH）在语言模型中已被验证：概念变化对应嵌入空间中的方向。但在视觉中，同一抽象概念（如数字量、状态变化）可表现为视觉上毫不相关的regime（手写数字 vs 手势），二者在像素空间几乎无共性。作者希望检验视觉模型是否仍编码这种跨regime的抽象概念，以及是否以统一的线性方向表达。
AI.method: 在46个覆盖不同架构、训练目标和规模的视觉编码器上，针对10个概念族（含数感、年龄、物体身份、MIT-States属性等）提取概念方向，并在单一regime内部与跨两个regime分别检验线性可分性与方向一致性，同时分析局部线性性与全局线性性的关系及方向迁移（线性探针跨regime迁移）。
AI.result: 在每个regime内部，几乎所有测试模型都找到统计显著的概念方向；但两个regime并不总是共享同一概念方向，部分模型为同一概念转变学习到多个线性结构（分裂于不同regime），呈现强局部线性性与近乎缺失的全局线性性并存。局部线性性越强的模型越能摆脱碎片化（局部-全局线性性在所有概念上相关系数 τ∈[0.38, 0.89]），且一旦出现全局线性性，概念方向可作为线性探针跨regime迁移。
AI.conclusion: 视觉模型普遍具备局部线性概念结构，但跨视觉无关regime的全局线性表示并非必然，而是随局部线性性增强而逐步涌现；全局线性性一旦形成，概念方向即具有跨regime的可迁移性，为评估视觉模型的抽象概念理解提供了新视角。

title: Seeing Through Distractions: Context-Stable Attribution via the Least Core
summary: Shapley-value-based explanations are widely used for feature attribution in machine learning. However, in computer vision, a feature may reduce the target-class score when added to the complete genuine image, even when the predicted label remains unchanged. We formalize such features as contextual distractors and investigate their attributions under semivalues and the least core. Under a weak average marginal monotonicity assumption, we derive quantitative semivalue--least-core gap bounds and sufficient conditions based on the probability of sampling smaller contexts. We further show that shifting semivalue weights toward larger contexts decreases the signed gap. Finally, controlled image-classification experiments and evaluations on Salient ImageNet provide strong empirical support for our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 该论文形式化了视觉模型中“上下文干扰特征”（contextual distractors）——即加入完整真实图像后即便预测标签不变仍会降低目标类分数的特征，并在半值与最小核心（least core）博弈解概念下量化了二者的归因差异，给出误差界与充分条件。
AI.motivation: Shapley 值等方法在视觉特征归因中被广泛使用，但在计算机视觉中，特征的重要性依赖于上下文：某些特征只在完整真实图像中被加入时才降低目标类分数，而预测标签保持不变。这类特征在现有归因框架下缺乏理论刻画，半值（semivalue）与最小核心等解可能给出不一致的归因结果，需要定量分析。
AI.method: 将此类特征定义为 contextual distractors；在弱平均边际单调性（weak average marginal monotonicity）假设下，推导半值与最小核心之间差距（semivalue–least-core gap）的定量上界，以及基于“采样到更小上下文的概率”的充分条件；并分析将半值权重向更大上下文偏移时带符号差距的变化趋势。实验上采用受控的图像分类实验与 Salient ImageNet 进行评估。
AI.result: 在弱平均边际单调性假设下得到了半值与最小核心差距的定量界与充分条件；证明将半值权重向更大上下文偏移会减小带符号差距；受控图像分类实验与 Salient ImageNet 上的评估均有力支持了理论结论。
AI.conclusion: 上下文干扰特征的归因对解概念与采样上下文大小敏感，半值与最小核心的差距可被显式界定，且通过调整权重偏向更大上下文可缓解该差距；这为视觉归因方法的选择与设计提供了理论依据与实证支持。

title: SeeRF: Learning to See Beyond Fields of View via Generative Image Registration and Fusion
summary: Due to the inherent discrepancies in imaging viewpoints and field-of-view mismatches among multi-modal sensors, existing fusion methods have long struggled to achieve complete scene-level information integration beyond the limitation in sensor fields of view. Consequently, the generated fusion results often contain modality-specific regions and fusion artifacts, limiting the comprehensive representation of scene structures and semantic information. To address this challenge, we propose a generative registration-fusion framework, termed SeeRF. Specifically, it first introduces a deformation generation strategy based on the diffeomorphic stationary velocity field, combined with visual foundation model-guided feature extraction and a coarse-to-fine progressive multi-modal image registration module, to achieve accurate cross-modal flow estimation and generate valid field-of-view masks. Subsequently, the registration module is tightly coupled with the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion, where the cross-modal control encoding module and the control residual feature encoder-decoder mechanism provide effective guidance. By leveraging the powerful prior modeling capability of generative diffusion models, the proposed framework overcomes the limitations imposed by shared fields of view and enables effective completion and natural fusion of non-overlapping field-of-view regions. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets and real-world scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance, validating its effectiveness, superiority, and robustness. The code will be available at https://github.com/XunpengYi/SeeRF.

AI.tldr: 提出生成式配准-融合框架 SeeRF，通过跨模态配准生成视场掩码并与扩散生成模块紧耦合，突破传感器视场限制，实现非重叠视场区域的补全与自然融合。
AI.motivation: 多模态传感器存在成像视角差异与视场不匹配，现有融合方法难以在视场之外完成完整的场景级信息整合，融合结果中包含模态特有区域与融合伪影，无法全面表征场景结构与语义信息。
AI.method: 1）基于微分同胚平稳速度场的形变生成策略，结合视觉基础模型引导的特征提取与由粗到细的渐进式多模态配准模块，实现精确跨模态光流估计并生成有效视场掩码；2）将配准模块与生成式扩散模块紧耦合以进行多模态补全与融合，其中设计跨模态控制编码模块与控制残差特征编解码机制提供有效引导，借助扩散模型的强大先验建模能力完成非重叠视场区域的补全与自然融合。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集与真实场景上的大量实验表明，该方法取得更优性能，验证了其有效性、优越性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 配准与生成式扩散的紧耦合设计可有效突破共享视场约束，实现视场外区域的补全与无缝融合，为场景级多模态信息整合提供了可行范式。

title: Learning Scene Coordinate Reconstruction from Unposed Images via Pose Graph Optimization
summary: Learning-based structure-from-motion methods such as ACE-Zero have demonstrated strong performance in estimating cameraposes and scene coordinates from unordered image collections without requiring ground truth supervision. However, the lack of global and multi-view consistency constraints in ACE-Zero can lead to pose drift and misalignment, particularly in complex or ambiguous scenes. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates pose graph optimization (PGO) into ACE-Zero to refine camera poses and suppress incorrect refinements. We construct pose graphs directly from ACE-Zero outputs by extracting relative pose constraints from predicted scene coordinates. Furthermore, we introduce an uncertainty-aware optimization strategy by estimating confidence scores using geometric priors, including epipolar and optical flow consistencies across views. Our approach improves the robustness and accuracy of pose estimation, demonstrating that global geometric reasoning can effectively complement learning-based inference in structure-from-motion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将位姿图优化（PGO）与ACE-Zero结合的混合框架，通过从预测场景坐标中提取相对位姿约束、并用几何先验估计置信度做不确定性感知优化，来抑制位姿漂移与错位，提升SfM位姿估计的鲁棒性与精度。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的SfM方法（如ACE-Zero）无需真值监督即可从无序图像集估计相机位姿与场景坐标，但缺乏全局与多视图一致性约束，在复杂或歧义场景中容易出现位姿漂移和错位。
AI.method: 在ACE-Zero中嵌入位姿图优化：直接从ACE-Zero输出的预测场景坐标中提取相对位姿约束构建位姿图；并引入不确定性感知的优化策略，利用对极一致性和光流一致性等几何先验估计置信度分数，以抑制错误的位姿精化。
AI.result: 提升了位姿估计的鲁棒性与准确性，表明全局几何推理能够有效补充SfM中的学习式推断。
AI.conclusion: 将全局几何推理（PGO与不确定性加权）与学习式SfM推断相结合，是缓解位姿漂移与错位的有效途径。

title: S$^2$-RL: Sample-Set Dual Reinforcement Learning for Generative Semantic Segmentation Dataset Distillation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project Page: https://00why00.github.io/S2RL/
summary: While dataset distillation has witnessed significant advances in image classification, its extension to dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation is plagued by two core bottlenecks: bi-level optimization-based approaches suffer from prohibitive computational costs stemming from pixel-wise gradient unrolling, whereas proxy-based generative methods merely infuse visual textures into fixed semantic masks derived from real data, thus failing to condense rich semantic knowledge into a compact set of informative, novel scene generations. To address both bottlenecks simultaneously, we propose a novel Sample-Set Reinforcement Learning (S$^2$-RL) framework for generative semantic segmentation dataset distillation (SSDD). Specifically, S$^2$-RL formulates SSDD as a diffusion model based text-to-image generation paradigm, enabling flexible generation of images with informative, novel semantic distributions via a concise text prompt. Furthermore, we fine-tune a diffusion policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), leveraging a sample-set dual reward paradigm: for individual samples, it enforces semantic alignment with input text prompts and intra-class feature diversity; for sample sets, it maximizes inter-sample semantic distribution diversity by solving a contextual multi-armed bandit problem. These design choices enable S$^2$-RL to distill large-scale semantic segmentation datasets into a compact set of generated samples that encapsulate diverse, informative semantic knowledge without the need of pixel-wise gradient unrolling. Extensive experiments on the ADE20K and COCO datasets demonstrate that S$^2$-RL achieves substantial and consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, establishing a new benchmark for SSDD.

AI.tldr: 提出 S²-RL 框架，利用扩散模型文本生成与 GRPO 强化学习，将语义分割数据集蒸馏建模为生成式问题，兼顾信息量、多样性与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 语义分割数据集蒸馏（SSDD）存在两大瓶颈：基于双层优化的方法因逐像素梯度展开导致计算成本过高；基于代理的生成方法仅将视觉纹理注入由真实数据得到的固定语义掩码，无法将丰富语义知识压缩到紧凑且信息量高、场景新颖的生成样本中。
AI.method: 将 SSDD 表述为基于扩散模型的文本到图像生成范式，以简洁文本提示灵活生成具有信息量高、分布新颖的语义图像；并用 GRPO 微调扩散策略，设计样本集双重奖励：单样本层面约束与文本提示的语义对齐及类内特征多样性，样本集层面通过求解上下文多臂老虎机问题最大化样本间语义分布多样性，从而无需逐像素梯度展开。
AI.result: 在 ADE20K 与 COCO 数据集上的大量实验表明，S²-RL 相较于当前最先进基线取得显著且一致的提升，为 SSDD 建立了新的基准。
AI.conclusion: S²-RL 通过生成式范式与样本集强化学习，同时缓解计算开销与语义信息压缩不足两大瓶颈，可高效将大规模语义分割数据集蒸馏为紧凑且多样、信息丰富的生成样本集。

title: CVTSplat: Multi-view Reconstruction Using an Adaptive Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation
summary: Voronoi tessellations have recently emerged as an adaptive, space-partitioning discretization for shape and appearance reconstruction from multi-view images. However, the irregular cells they produce make the repeated reconstruction of the tessellation during optimization costly. We therefore explore adaptive centroidal Voronoi tessellations (CVTs), which extend standard CVTs with non-uniform cell sizes while preserving the regular, well-shaped cells that make them efficient to compute. In CVTSplat, cell size is modulated by the evolving signed distance field, concentrating sites near the zero level set while keeping cells nearly centroidal. This regularity lets us specialize the whole pipeline, with GPU algorithms for nearest-neighbor queries and approximate Voronoi construction, and a rasterizer tailored to small, nearly isotropic cells. Our Voronoi construction is 5 to 10 times faster than general-purpose alternatives in this regime. On DTU and BlendedMVS, CVTSplat reaches geometric accuracy competitive with the best Gaussian-splatting surface methods while training in about 2.5 minutes on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: CVTSplat 用自适应质心 Voronoi 镶嵌（CVT）从多视图图像重建形状与外观，利用单元尺寸随 SDF 调制、保持近质心规则单元，实现 GPU 专用最近邻查询、近似 Voronoi 构造与小各向同性单元光栅化，单 GPU 约 2.5 分钟训练即可达到与最佳高斯泼溅表面方法相当的几何精度。
AI.motivation: Voronoi 镶嵌作为自适应空间划分已被用于多视图形状与外观重建，但其不规则单元导致优化中反复重建镶嵌代价高昂。作者希望引入自适应质心 Voronoi 镶嵌（CVT）：在允许非均匀单元尺寸的同时保持单元规则、形状良好，从而降低计算成本并便于专用化。
AI.method: 以 CVT 为基础，用演化的符号距离场（SDF）调制单元尺寸，使站点向零水平集聚集，同时单元保持近似质心性；据此对整个管线做专用化：GPU 最近邻查询、近似 Voronoi 构造算法，以及针对小型、近各向同性单元定制的光栅化器。
AI.result: 在该规则单元区间内，Voronoi 构造比通用方案快 5–10 倍；在 DTU 与 BlendedMVS 数据集上，CVTSplat 的几何精度与最佳高斯泼溅表面方法相当，而单 GPU 训练仅约 2.5 分钟。
AI.conclusion: 自适应 CVT 通过保持单元规则性，可将重建管线高度专用化，在显著加速镶嵌构建与训练的同时维持有竞争力的表面重建精度，说明“规则化自适应划分 + 端到端 GPU 优化”是高效多视图表面重建的有效路径。

title: OVM-Occ: Open-Vocabulary Monocular Occupancy Prediction via Geometry-Aware Vision-Language Distillation
summary: Monocular occupancy prediction in indoor scenes aims to recover a scene's 3D geometry and semantics from a single RGB image. Existing methods are restricted to a closed set of predefined categories, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen categories. This limitation is particularly critical in indoor scenes, where objects exhibit highly diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. We study open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes and present OVM-Occ, a Gaussian-based occupancy framework with an instance-aware vision-language teacher. Specifically, we adopt Language-Embedded Gaussians as the intermediate scene representation, propose a geometry-aware deformable attention module to refine Gaussian semantic features, and construct instance-level vision-language embeddings to provide reliable semantic supervision. We further introduce geometry-aware decoupled semantic distillation to mitigate the interference between geometry learning and semantic learning. To evaluate open-vocabulary occupancy prediction performance, we introduce OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica, two extended benchmarks with more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art approach by 12.2 mIoU and 0.6 IoU on the Occ-ScanNet dataset, with consistent gains under new open-vocabulary evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出 OVM-Occ，基于语言嵌入高斯与实例级视觉-语言教师的开放词汇单目室内占据预测框架，并构建 OpenOcc-ScanNet/OpenOcc-Replica 两个基准，取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有单目室内占据预测受限于预定义类别闭集，难以泛化到未见过类别，而室内物体语义类别高度多样且细粒度，因此研究开放词汇单目占据预测。
AI.method: 以 Language-Embedded Gaussians 作为中间场景表示；提出几何感知可变形注意力模块精炼高斯语义特征；构建实例级视觉-语言嵌入提供可靠语义监督；引入几何感知解耦语义蒸馏以缓解几何与语义学习之间的干扰。
AI.result: 在 Occ-ScanNet 上较此前 SOTA 提升 12.2 mIoU 与 0.6 IoU，并在新的开放词汇评测协议下取得一致增益；同时提出 OpenOcc-ScanNet 与 OpenOcc-Replica 两个更细粒度、类别更丰富的扩展基准。
AI.conclusion: OVM-Occ 在室内开放词汇单目占据预测上达到 SOTA，验证了高斯表示结合实例级视觉-语言蒸馏的有效性，并为该任务提供了新的评测基准。

title: Domain-Adapted Latent Diffusion Models for CT-to-PET Image Translation
summary: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) provides important metabolic information for tumor detection and staging but remains significantly less accessible than Computed Tomography (CT) due to its high cost, infrastructure requirements, and reliance on injected radioactive tracers. CT-to-PET image translation using generative models aims to address this disparity, yet state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods are limited by the scarcity of paired training data. To overcome this, we propose a domain-adapted latent diffusion framework that transfers natural-image priors using a relatively small dataset of 21,930 paired CT/PET slices, incorporating a signed power transform to resolve extreme intensity sparsity in PET data. Compared to CPDM, a state-ofthe-art baseline for CT-to-PET image translation, our approach yields superior performance in pixel-wise reconstruction and localized tumor fidelity, demonstrating effective transfer of natural-image priors to the medical domain. We further provide a systematic analysis of evaluation metric reliability for sparse PET data, showing that standard full-image metrics can be misleading indicators of translated image quality, and propose background-filtered and mask-restricted metrics as more clinically meaningful alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出域自适应潜在扩散框架，用相对少量配对CT/PET数据迁移自然图像先验，并以符号幂变换解决PET极端强度稀疏性，优于CPDM基线；同时揭示稀疏PET下全图指标的误导性，提出背景滤波与掩膜限定指标。
AI.motivation: PET代谢信息对肿瘤检测与分期价值高，但成本高、基础设施要求高、依赖放射性示踪剂，可及性远低于CT。用生成模型做CT→PET图像翻译可缓解该差距，但现有扩散方法受配对数据稀缺限制。
AI.method: 域自适应潜在扩散框架，借自然图像先验迁移至医学域；仅用21,930对配对CT/PET切片；引入符号幂变换（signed power transform）应对PET强度的极端稀疏性。
AI.result: 相较SOTA基线CPDM，在像素级重建与局部肿瘤保真度上均更优，验证自然图像先验向医学域的有效迁移；系统分析表明标准全图指标在稀疏PET上具有误导性。
AI.conclusion: 自然图像先验可有效迁移至小样本CT→PET翻译任务；建议采用背景滤波与掩膜限定指标作为更具临床意义的评价替代方案。

title: TopX: Text-to-Motion for Unseen Skeletons from the Skeleton File Alone
summary: Text-to-motion models generate for the skeletons they were trained on, while a new character arrives as a skeleton file and nothing else. We study text-to-motion for skeletons that no training clip has used, with no clips of the character, no template, no retargeting and no fine-tuning. We present TopX, a 73M-parameter flow-matching transformer that generates joint rotations and a root trajectory for any kinematic tree from its tree, rest pose and joint names. Motion is normalised by the rest pose and the size of the skeleton, and the rest pose enters as a world-frame descriptor that does not depend on how the rig's author oriented each joint, with rest conventions randomised in training. Attention is factorised over the joints and the frames of a motion and carries a spatial--temporal encoding designed for skeleton graphs of any topology: queries and keys are rotated across joints by a heat-kernel coordinate of the skeleton graph, which is defined for every tree and does not change with the order of its joints or the eigenbasis of its Laplacian, and across frames by a rotary encoding of frame order. To measure what this buys, we build SkelShift: four motion corpora under one codec, 143,334 captioned clips on skeletons of 4 to 142 joints, from which 4,232 clips on 2,043 skeletons are held out by clip, rig, tree class or species and organised along topology, joint count, body plan, species and rig source, and scored by motion quality: Fréchet distances on public kinetic features and on kinematic descriptors, foot skating and ground contact. Against UniMate trained on the same clips, on test rigs without a training clip, TopX lowers the descriptor FID from 5.73 to 4.58 when UniMate's guidance is tuned for the kinetic FID, and the kinetic FID from 1.48 to 0.55 when it is tuned for the descriptor FID, also on motions no training skeleton performs; fewer of its frames sink below the ground.

AI.tldr: TopX 是一个 73M 参数的流匹配 Transformer，仅凭骨骼文件（树结构、rest pose、关节名）即可为任意运动学树生成文本驱动运动，无需模板、重定向或微调，并在新构建的 SkelShift 基准上优于 UniMate。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到运动模型只能为训练时见过的骨架生成，而新角色通常只以骨骼文件形式出现。作者研究"零训练片段骨架"场景：无角色动作片段、无模板、无重定向、无微调。
AI.method: 提出 TopX 流匹配 Transformer，输出关节旋转与根轨迹。运动以 rest pose 与骨架尺度归一化；rest pose 作为世界坐标系描述符输入，不依赖作者对关节的朝向约定，训练时随机化 rest 约定。注意力在关节与帧上因子化，并采用面向任意拓扑骨架图的时空编码：关节维度用骨架图热核坐标旋转 query/key（对任意树都有定义，且不随关节顺序或拉普拉斯特征基改变），帧维度用旋转位置编码。另构建 SkelShift：四套语料统一编解码，143,334 条带字幕片段，骨架 4–142 关节；按 clip、rig、树类别或物种留出 2,043 个骨架上的 4,232 条片段，沿拓扑、关节数、体型、物种与 rig 来源组织，并用公共动力学特征 FID、运动学描述符 FID、脚滑与地面接触评分。
AI.result: 与同片段训练的 UniMate 相比，在无训练片段的测试 rig 上：当 UniMate 引导偏向动力学 FID 时，TopX 将描述符 FID 由 5.73 降至 4.58；当其引导偏向描述符 FID 时，动力学 FID 由 1.48 降至 0.55；且下沉到地面以下的帧更少。
AI.conclusion: TopX 证明仅依靠骨骼拓扑信息即可实现跨骨架泛化的文本到运动生成，配合 SkelShift 基准为"未见骨架"设定提供了可量化评测。

title: Test-Time Prompt-Agnostic Decomposition
summary: Test-Time Prompt Tuning (TPT) adapts large pretrained models to unseen target distribution shifts by updating only lightweight prompt tokens. Existing TPT methods are effective, but they mainly optimize each prompt update locally. Across test-time steps, prompts updated at the current step are reused for the corresponding predictions and updates, so noisy or biased unlabeled objectives can accumulate and destabilize the prompt-update trajectory. We identify two failure modes: magnitude expansion, where updates move the prompt too far, and directional drift, where consecutive updates point in inconsistent directions. To analyze and control these failures, we propose Test-Time Prompt-Agnostic Decomposition ($\mathtt{TPD}$), which characterizes observed prompt-update trajectories from a dynamical-systems view and decomposes base prompt updates into magnitude and direction. $\mathtt{TPD}$ computes a spectral radius to measure update expansion and decomposes update directions into persistent, oscillatory, and residual components. Building on this decomposition, Adaptive Koopman Control ($\mathtt{AKC}$) regulates update magnitude by shrinking updates under expansive recent dynamics, while Hankel Update Router ($\mathtt{HUR}$) refines update direction by preserving persistent components and suppressing oscillatory and residual components. Together, $\mathtt{AKC}$ and $\mathtt{HUR}$ produce a stabilized prompt update. As a prompt-agnostic framework, $\mathtt{TPD}$ can be plugged into visual and text TPT methods without modifying the backbone, prompt architecture, or adaptation loss. Experiments on 15 datasets show that $\mathtt{TPD}$ consistently improves 10 baselines, with accuracy gains of $3$--$8\%$ for visual prompts and over $2\%$ for text prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TPD框架，从动力系统视角分解测试时提示更新为幅度与方向两部分，并用AKC与HUR分别抑制幅度扩张与方向漂移，作为即插即用模块稳定视觉和文本TPT方法的提示更新轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有TPT方法主要局部地优化每个提示更新，当前步更新的提示被直接复用于后续预测与更新，导致有噪声或有偏的无标签目标累积并破坏更新轨迹的稳定性。作者识别出两种失败模式：幅度扩张（更新使提示偏移过远）与方向漂移（连续更新方向不一致）。
