AI.method: 提出Test-Time Prompt-Agnostic Decomposition（TPD），以动力系统视角刻画提示更新轨迹，将基础提示更新分解为幅度与方向；用谱半径度量更新扩张，并将更新方向分解为持续、振荡与残差分量。基于该分解，Adaptive Koopman Control（AKC）在近期动态呈扩张性时收缩更新以调节幅度，Hankel Update Router（HUR）保留持续分量、抑制振荡与残差分量以精炼方向，二者共同产生稳定的提示更新。该框架与提示无关，无需修改骨干网络、提示结构或适配损失即可插入视觉与文本TPT方法。
AI.result: 在15个数据集上的实验表明，TPD一致地提升了10个基线方法，视觉提示准确率提升3–8%，文本提示提升超过2%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将提示更新轨迹建模为动力系统并进行幅度—方向分解，可有效抑制测试时提示调优中的误差累积与轨迹不稳定；TPD作为通用即插即用框架，具有跨模态、跨基线的普适增益。

title: Reading the Registers of Honorius III without Manual Line Transcription: Forced-Aligned HTR, End to End, Modular or Hybrid
summary: Unlocking medieval archives at scale is bottlenecked by the cost of line-level diplomatic transcriptions and manual abbreviation expansion. Focusing on the registers of Pope Honorius III (1216-1227) over 5,000 letters surviving in full only as manuscript images - we show that existing, line-break-free expert transcriptions (edition drafts) suffice to train end-to-end hand-written text recognition (HTR) that jointly transcribes and expands heavily abbreviated Latin. Using forced alignment on 860 unaligned edition entries across 394 pages of Reg. Vat. 9, we automatically bootstrap 13,122 training lines without manual alignment of segmented lines. While the generic CATMuS baseline struggles on this domain (18.9% CER) and a modular space-free HTR + word-segmentation pipeline (cf. Camps et al. 2021) plateaus at 15.6% WER, our from-scratch hybrid Conformer - combining CTC with bidirectional subword attention decoders, iterative self-realignment and n-best LM rescoring - achieves 4.7% CER and 8.7% WER (8.4% WER with ROVER system combination), nearly halving errors on clause-final words (22.7% to 12.2% WER). These figures are measured on the test lines that align with the transcription (86% of all test lines for the best hybrid). Furthermore, we address a tension between paleographic fidelity and editorial normalization: training on targets that preserve scribal name initials reduces the WER against the manuscript text on the 31 affected test lines from 13.3% to 9.2%, at a small cost against the expanded transcription (WER +0.3 points, CER +0.4). Finally, extensive ablations show that none of an auxiliary diplomatic CTC head, a copy mechanism, a permutation decoder or masked-image pretraining improves on direct end-to-end supervision, while strict padding-mask propagation and per-line beam termination make inference batch-invariant.

AI.tldr: 本文针对教宗档案中手写拉丁文的重度缩写问题，利用无需行对齐的既有专家校勘本（edition drafts）通过强制对齐自动构建13122行训练数据，训练端到端混合Conformer模型，同时完成转写与缩写展开，取得4.7% CER / 8.7% WER。
AI.motivation: 大规模开放中世纪档案的核心瓶颈在于行级外交体转写（diplomatic transcription）与人工缩写展开成本极高。教宗Honorius III登记册（1216–1227）共5000余封信件，仅以手稿图像形式完整存世，现有通用HTR基线（18.9% CER）与模块化"无空格HTR+词分割"流水线（15.6% WER）在该领域表现不足，亟需能直接利用既有非对齐校勘本、并联合处理缩写展开的端到端方案。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：对Reg. Vat. 9中394页、860条未对齐的校勘条目做强制对齐，自动引导出13,122行训练样本，免去人工行级标注。2) 模型：从零训练的混合Conformer，CTC与双向子词注意力解码器联合优化，配合迭代自重新对齐与n-best语言模型重打分；并采用ROVER系统组合。3) 对比基线：CATMuS通用模型、模块化无空格HTR+词分割流水线（Camps et al. 2021）。4) 兼容性实验：在保留书写者姓名首字母缩写的目标上训练，以兼顾古文字学忠实性与编辑规范化。5) 消融：辅助外交体CTC头、copy机制、permutation解码器、掩码图像预训练；以及严格padding-mask传播与逐行beam终止以保证推理的批次不变性。
AI.result: 混合模型达4.7% CER、8.7% WER（ROVER组合后8.4% WER），显著优于CATMuS基线（18.9% CER）和模块化流水线（15.6% WER）；分句末词错误近乎减半（22.7%→12.2% WER）。指标在与转写对齐的测试行上统计（最优混合模型覆盖全部测试行的86%）。在31行含姓名首字母的测试样本上，保留缩写形式训练使对手稿文本的WER由13.3%降至9.2%，而对展开转写仅小幅退化（WER +0.3、CER +0.4）。消融显示辅助CTC头、copy机制、permutation解码器与掩码图像预训练均未超过直接的端到端监督。
AI.conclusion: 非行对齐的既有专家校勘本足以支撑端到端HTR联合完成转写与缩写展开，无需人工行级对齐即可规模化解锁中世纪档案。混合Conformer+CTC/注意力架构叠加自重新对齐与n-best LM重打分是关键增益来源；古文字学忠实性（保留书写者缩写）与编辑规范化之间存在可量化的小幅权衡。严格的padding-mask传播与逐行beam终止可保证推理批次不变性，便于实际部署。

title: Blendshape Generation for Models with Disconnected Parts: Adding ARKit/MediaPipe Blendshapes to Anime-Style Character Models
summary: Blendshape generation for 3D models has been extensively researched, but very few works address generating blendshapes for models with multiple disconnected parts. We present a case study of generating fixed facial expression blendshapes for commercial anime-style 3D character models with up to 11 parts per face. To make sure that our system can handle models in a way that is agnostic to topology, we train neural networks to generate deformation fields around the input meshes. We employ at least one network to independently process each part, and the relative positions of their outputs are coordinated by having each network also process the geometry of an anchor part. We use two mechanisms to improve accuracy: having the networks predict whether the output displacement is zero or not, and classifying blendshapes into different size groups and dedicating a network to each group. We also introduce a method to improve blendshape quality by enhancing bilateral symmetry. Our method is simpler than recent neural-network-based works and solves a real problem of the user community of these models.

AI.tldr: 针对含多个断开部件的商业动漫风格3D角色模型（每张脸最多11个部件），提出一种拓扑无关的固定表情Blendshape生成方法：用神经网络在输入网格周围生成形变场，每个部件由独立网络处理并通过共享锚点部件几何来协调相对位置，结合零位移预测、按尺寸分组的专用网络及双侧对称增强，简化了现有神经方法并解决了用户社区的实际问题。
AI.motivation: 现有Blendshape生成研究多针对单一连通网格，很少处理多断开部件模型；而商业动漫风格角色模型常由多个部件拼合而成，拓扑不统一，传统方法难以直接适用，用户社区对此有真实需求。
AI.method: 1）训练神经网络生成输入网格周围的形变场，使方法对拓扑无关；2）至少为每个部件配置一个独立网络，并让各网络同时处理一个锚点部件的几何，以协调各部件输出的相对位置；3）引入两项精度提升机制：预测输出位移是否为零，以及将Blendshape按尺寸分组并为每组分配专用网络；4）提出通过增强双侧对称性来提升Blendshape质量的方法。
AI.result: 方法结构比近年基于神经网络的工作更简单，可处理每张脸最多11个部件的模型，并在商业动漫风格角色上生成固定表情Blendshape，同时通过对称性增强提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以案例研究形式表明，基于形变场、按部件独立处理并以锚点协调的简洁网络设计，能够有效解决多断开部件3D模型的Blendshape生成问题，具备实际应用价值。

title: LOCUS: Locate Once, Check Until Settled. Draft-and-Verify Visual Grounding with a Box Head and Coordinate-Token Verification
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Project page: https://muhammad-talha-ad.github.io/LOCUS/ Code: https://github.com/muhammad-talha-ad/LOCUS Models: https://huggingface.co/MTalha2001/LOCUS-2B and https://huggingface.co/MTalha2001/LOCUS-0.8B
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) ground a referring expression in one of two ways. They decode the box as coordinate tokens, which is precise but takes one sequential step per token, or they regress it from a hidden state with a small head, which takes one step but loses accuracy at high IoU. The two fail differently: a head usually finds the right object but places its edges loosely, while coordinate tokens place edges precisely. We therefore use the regression head as a speculative drafter for the model's own coordinate tokens. Locus writes the head's box as coordinate tokens and checks them with the same backbone by Jacobi iteration over a shared image prefix. The fixed point is the model's greedy coordinate-token answer, reached in about 5.60 sequential passes on average instead of 18.46 decoding steps; head and verifier are one set of weights, trained jointly. On the 8 RefCOCO, RefCOCO+ and RefCOCOg splits, verification raises Locus-2B's Acc@0.9 from 54.87 for its own head to 59.13, and the one-pass head is ahead at Acc@0.5 of every published model with at most 3B parameters except Florence-2-L. Against Jag, the strongest open regression-head model, at its own size and training budget, Locus ties at Acc@0.5 and, with typical acceptance, gains +4.52 points at Acc@0.9, with paired significance tests. Exact answers come 1.5x faster than vLLM greedy-decoding the same coordinate tokens with the same weights; a pure regression head remains faster still.

AI.tldr: Locus将回归头作为坐标token解码的推测性草稿器，通过共享图像前缀上的Jacobi迭代验证，在被指代目标定位上同时获得高IoU精度与少步数。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型定位指代表达有两种范式：坐标token解码精确但逐token串行、步数多；小回归头一步出框但在高IoU下精度下降。二者失败模式互补——回归头通常找对目标但边界松，坐标token边界精确。作者希望兼得精度与效率。
AI.method: 用模型自身的回归头作推测性草稿器，将其输出框写成坐标token，再由同一backbone在共享图像前缀上通过Jacobi迭代并行校验，收敛的不动点即模型的贪心坐标token答案；草稿器与验证器共享同一套权重并联合训练。
AI.result: 平均约5.60次串行pass即可达到不动点，而非18.46个解码步。在8个RefCOCO/RefCOCO+/RefCOCOg划分上，验证将Locus-2B的Acc@0.9从自身头的54.87提升至59.13；单pass头在Acc@0.5上优于除Florence-2-L外所有≤3B的已发表模型。与同等规模、同等训练预算的Jag相比，Acc@0.5持平，在典型接受率下Acc@0.9提升+4.52并做配对显著性检验。精确答案比用vLLM对相同权重贪心解码相同坐标token快1.5倍；纯回归头仍更快。
AI.conclusion: 投机式草稿-验证框架可将回归头的低延迟与坐标token的高精度统一于单一权重集，显著改善高IoU定位精度且加速精确解码，但纯回归头在速度上仍有优势。

title: Supervising the Visible State: Separating Representation from View Selection in Streaming Video
summary: An action seen once and the same action seen three times receive the same action-recognition label, so that supervision does not require a model to count. Answers shared across histories that differ in event order, accumulation, or relations leave those distinctions unconstrained; we call this state under-specification. Visible-State Supervision (ViSS) addresses it by training on source-grounded probes of event identity, order, accumulation, relation change, and answer sufficiency; under the same recent-frame interface it improves OVO-Bench over a strict-matched generic temporal supervision baseline while remaining comparable on StreamingBench, with the largest gain in hallucination detection. Test-Time Causal View Search (TVS) then adapts evidence access while keeping the learned model fixed, expanding from recent frames to sparse event and compact history views on demand. The two interventions separate representation from view selection: supervision particularly benefits hallucination detection and causal reasoning, access particularly benefits event recall and forward reasoning. Together they reach the best reported accuracy among the published systems compared here on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench at a fraction of the processed frames of exhaustive selection, and strict replay shows that most of the remaining gap to a three-view oracle is a correct answer that was later replaced. Streaming accuracy depends on what supervision asks the model to keep, what evidence inference exposes, and whether the model keeps a correct answer once it has one.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"状态欠定"(state under-specification)问题：相同动作序列无论观看一次还是三次得到同一标签，使模型无需计数。作者以ViSS(可见状态监督)训练事件身份、顺序、累积、关系变化与答案充分性探针，并以TVS(测试时因果视图搜索)按需扩展证据视图；两者分离"表示"与"视图选择"，在StreamingBench与OVO-Bench上以远少于穷举选择处理的帧数取得所比较已发表系统中的最佳准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频动作识别只依赖答案标签监督，跨不同历史（事件顺序、累积次数、关系）共享同一答案，导致这些区分未被约束，即状态欠定。此外，证据访问方式（仅近期帧）与模型表示能力被混为一谈。
AI.method: ViSS：在保持近期帧输入接口不变的前提下，用源视频可验证的探针任务监督事件身份、顺序、累积、关系变化与答案充分性。TVS：固定已学模型，仅在测试时自适应调整证据访问，从近期帧按需扩展到稀疏事件视图与紧凑历史视图。二者分别作用于表示学习与视图选择。
AI.result: 在严格匹配的通用时序监督基线之上，ViSS提升OVO-Bench并在StreamingBench上保持可比，幻觉检测增益最大；组合后在StreamingBench与OVO-Bench上达到本文比较范围内已发表系统的最佳准确率，且处理帧数远少于穷举选择；严格重放显示与三视图oracle的剩余差距主要源于正确回答随后被替换。
AI.conclusion: 流式准确率取决于三点：监督要求模型保留什么、推理时暴露哪些证据、以及模型在得到正确回答后能否保持。将监督与视图选择解耦是有效且高效的改进路径。

title: Task Relevance-Driven Prompt Expansion for Federated Continual Learning
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: Federated continual learning (FCL) has attracted considerable interest by enabling local clients to continually acquire knowledge from new tasks. However, most FCL methods assume that the global server has prior knowledge of the arrival times and number of categories for new tasks, which is unrealistic in the real world. Furthermore, they neglect the importance of positive inter-task semantic relationships when learning new tasks and are significantly affected by irrelevant relationships from old tasks, thereby exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To resolve the above challenges, we develop a novel Task Relevance-driven Prompt Expansion (TRPE) model. Specifically, to eliminate the reliance on prior knowledge of new tasks, we propose an out-of-distribution detector to identify the arrival of new tasks within local clients, along with a radius-adaptive DBSCAN to infer the quantity of categories in new tasks on the proxy server. Moreover, to explore positive inter-task relationships, we calculate the affinity between the original gradient for learning new task and its gradient orthogonal to the feature space of old tasks to evaluate semantic relevance between old and new tasks from a global perspective. Then, we use this global task relevance to determine the key-prompt pair for new tasks and identify highly related old tasks. After concatenating their prompts for training, we can leverage such positive inter-task relations to improve the continual learning of newly arriving tasks. To balance the learning of new tasks and the forgetting of old ones, a soft orthogonality constraint is applied to the local key and prompt gradients. Experiments spanning diverse datasets and backbones confirm the efficacy of our TRPE model.

AI.tldr: 提出任务相关性驱动的提示扩展模型TRPE，解决联邦持续学习中依赖新任务先验知识、忽视任务间正向语义关系的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有FCL方法假设全局服务器已知新任务的到达时间与类别数，现实中不成立；同时忽视任务间正向语义关系、受旧任务无关关系干扰，加剧灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 1) 本地客户端用分布外检测器识别新任务到达，代理服务器用半径自适应DBSCAN推断新任务类别数，摆脱先验依赖；2) 计算新任务学习原始梯度与其在旧任务特征空间正交方向梯度之间的亲和度，从全局视角评估新旧任务语义相关性，据此确定新任务关键提示对并识别高相关旧任务，拼接其提示联合训练；3) 对本地关键与提示梯度施加软正交约束，平衡新任务学习与旧任务遗忘。
AI.result: 在多种数据集与骨干网络上进行实验，验证了TRPE的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TRPE通过OOD检测与自适应聚类实现无先验的新任务感知，利用全局任务相关性驱动的提示扩展与软正交约束，有效利用正向任务关系并缓解联邦持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。

title: Selective Monocular Precession Estimation under Geometric and Evaluation Ambiguity: An Auditable Synthetic Study with ORBIT-SCOUT
comment: 29 pages, 4 figures and 7 tables; extended narrative review and ancillary code/data for descriptive arithmetic and physical-metric reproduction
summary: Monocular observations of a tumbling object can support a precise fitted trajectory without establishing that the recovered physical axis is correct. We study this distinction for elongated, approximately cylindrical targets observed by a calibrated stationary camera. ORBIT-SCOUT couples image-derived line and rim geometry to constant-cone and torque-free triaxial trajectory families, then returns a linked momentum-axis and mean-precession-rate estimate only when numerical, geometric, temporal and competing-hypothesis checks pass. We describe the measurement objective, selection policy and limitations, and situate them within spacecraft pose estimation, unknown-target reconstruction, rigid-body identification and selective prediction. An internally preregistered population of 96 new synthetic scenes was processed in two cold passes, retaining all 192 attempts. In the primary pass, 38 scenes produced jointly correct estimates, none produced an incorrect estimate, 57 were withheld and one execution was incomplete. Correct coverage on the 64 supported scenes was 25/64. Ninety-five repeated pairs were scientifically equivalent under a frozen comparison policy; the remaining pair was incomplete. The registered coverage, failure-free execution and all-case repeatability targets were not met. Historical audits also exposed an overly permissive axis metric and motion-dependent acquisition cadence. The contribution is a documented measurement-to-decision implementation and a failure-preserving evaluation case study, not a new rigid-body theory or evidence of state-of-the-art accuracy. Zero observed errors does not establish calibrated risk, and conditional temporal checks do not remove shared image-feature bias. Real-image transfer and external reproduction remain open.

AI.tldr: 论文研究细长近圆柱目标在单目静止标定相机下的"物理轴正确性"判定问题，提出ORBIT-SCOUT框架，将图像线/轮廓几何与恒定锥、无扭矩三轴轨迹族耦合，仅当多维检查通过时输出动量轴与平均进动率；在96个合成场景上做预注册评估，结果未达成覆盖与可重复性目标，作为保留失败的测量-决策案例研究。
AI.motivation: 单目观测翻滚目标可拟合出精确轨迹，但拟合轨迹不等于恢复的物理轴正确。作者意在区分"轨迹拟合精度"与"物理轴有效性"，并将该判定置于航天器位姿估计、未知目标重建、刚体辨识与选择性预测的语境中。
AI.method: ORBIT-SCOUT将图像导出的直线与轮缘几何与constant-cone及torque-free triaxial轨迹族耦合；仅当数值检查、几何检查、时间检查与竞争假设检查全部通过时，才返回linked momentum-axis与mean-precession-rate估计。采用内部预注册的96个新合成场景、两次冷运行（共保留192次尝试），并冻结比较策略做重复性对照。
AI.result: 主轮：38个场景给出联合正确估计，0个错误估计，57个被withheld，1次执行不完整；64个supported场景上正确覆盖为25/64。95对重复实验中科学等价，1对不完整。预注册的覆盖率、无故障执行与全案例可重复性目标均未达成。历史审计还暴露axis metric过于宽松与motion-dependent acquisition cadence问题。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于一套可记录的measurement-to-decision实现与failure-preserving评估案例，而非新的刚体理论或SOTA精度证据。零观测错误不等于校准风险；条件性时间检查无法消除共享图像特征偏差。真实图像迁移与外部复现仍待完成。

title: Quantifying Claim Smoothing by LLM Research Agents
comment: Code and data present at: https://github.com/tiasa2/SmoothScore
summary: Deep research, or any use of large language models (LLMs) to read a large document collection and produce insights, requires synthesizing information from different sources. In this work, we find that LLMs produce long-form research reports that read as confident syntheses but which fail to accurately reflect the underlying documents. We call this failure smoothing. In collapsing diverse and potentially conflicting sources into a single narrative, the model discards the evidential "jaggedness" of its corpus and asserts conclusions more decisive than the citations can support. We introduce a claim level scoring pipeline, SmoothScore, to quantify this effect. Our pipeline extracts key conclusive claims from model generated reports, then finds evidence relevant to each claim and clusters that evidence along high level aspects. Finally, each claim is scored with respect to the evidence to quantify the degree of smoothing done by the agent. Across 7 systems and 4 datasets, we find that agents consistently produce stronger claims than warranted.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并量化了LLM在长文研究中"平滑化(smoothing)"失败现象：模型生成的报告看似自信综合，却未忠实反映原始文献，并给出主张级评分管线SmoothScore加以度量。
AI.motivation: 深度研究类任务要求LLM阅读大规模文档集并综合多源信息，但作者观察到模型产出读起来像有把握的综合报告，实则未能准确反映底层文献。将多样甚至相互冲突的来源压缩为单一叙事时，模型丢弃了语料的证据"崎岖性(jaggedness)"，给出超出引用支撑力的结论，这一失败此前缺乏系统刻画与量化。
AI.method: 提出SmoothScore的主张级评分管线：(1)从模型报告抽取关键结论性主张；(2)为每条主张检索相关证据；(3)沿高层维度对证据进行聚类；(4)对每条主张相对证据打分，量化智能体平滑化的程度。在7个系统、4个数据集上评估。
AI.result: 跨7个系统和4个数据集，智能体持续产出比证据所能支撑更强的结论，平滑化效应普遍存在且可被SmoothScore量化。
AI.conclusion: LLM综合报告存在系统性"平滑化"问题，结论强度与证据支撑不匹配；主张级评分可作为诊断工具，提示需在深度研究系统中关注证据忠实度而非仅报告流畅性。

title: Not One Belief: Answer Payloads, Persistence, and Dissociated Confidence Signals in Conversational Question Answering
summary: Conversational QA systems should fix errors when users push back and signal which answers to trust. We split each follow-up into its speech act (re-ask, agree, or challenge) and its payload (an answer string, correct or not), and measure four confidence signals on the same transcripts: verbalized confidence, length-normalized likelihood, a frozen hidden-state probe, and P(True). Answers change when the user supplies an answer string and almost never under the speech act alone: in every retained full-size cell, the correct answer converts at least four times as many wrong answers as re-asking or agreement. The four signals disagree. On Qwen2.5-7B the frozen probe rises with answer persistence rather than truth; this holds on held-out questions, with Llama-3-8B (cleaned answers) as support, but not on four other models. Among 81 Qwen2.5-7B errors that survive one re-ask, re-asking, a fresh chat, or abstain repair almost none, while a gold answer repairs 75-95%. In two preregistered replications, every repair rate without an answer string stays below 0.15; a larger post-hoc rerun excludes 0.15 except for the empty elicit. With BM25 TriviaQA evidence, sentences that contain the answer repair 67-76% of persistent errors versus at most 12% when they do not. An end-to-end contain-gate cuts harm on TriviaQA, but a deployable gate that does not know the gold answer repairs few errors.

AI.tldr: 论文将多轮对话中的追问拆解为"言语行为"与"答案载荷"两部分，系统比较四种置信度信号，并测试各类纠错（修复）机制。核心发现：错误答案的修复几乎完全依赖用户提供答案字符串，而非重新提问或表示同意；四种置信度信号彼此不一致，冻结隐状态探针反映的是答案持续性而非真实性；不注入答案的修复手段对顽固错误几乎无效。
AI.motivation: 对话式QA系统在用户"反驳"时应能修正错误，并向用户提示哪些答案可信。然而现有工作未区分追问中"怎么说"（言语行为）与"说什么"（答案内容）各自的作用，也不清楚主流置信度信号是否一致有效，以及何种干预才能真正修复模型已给出的错误答案。
AI.method: 将每次追问分解为speech act（re-ask/agree/challenge）与payload（正确或错误的答案字符串），在同一批转写文本上测量四种置信度信号：verbalized confidence、长度归一化似然、冻结隐状态探针、P(True)。对81个经一次re-ask仍存活的Qwen2.5-7B错误实施多种修复干预（re-ask、new chat、abstain、gold answer），并进行两次预注册复制与一次事后扩大重跑；另用BM25检索的TriviaQA证据句测试"含答案句 vs 不含答案句"的修复率，并评估端到端contain-gate及不知晓金标答案的部署型门控。
AI.result: 答案仅在用户提供答案字符串时才会改变，仅有speech act时几乎不变：所有保留的满规模单元格中，正确答案的转化率至少是re-ask或agree的4倍。四种置信度信号相互分歧；Qwen2.5-7B上冻结探针随答案持续性上升而非真实性，该现象在留出问题上成立，Llama-3-8B（清洗答案）支持，但四个其他模型不成立。81个顽固错误中，re-ask、新会话、abstain修复率几乎为零，而金标答案修复75–95%。两次预注册复制中，不含答案字符串的修复率均低于0.15；事后扩大重跑除empty elicit外均排除0.15。TriviaQA中，含答案的BM25证据句修复67–76%的顽固错误，不含答案句至多12%。
AI.conclusion: 多轮纠错的瓶颈在于是否注入答案内容而非对话形式；主流置信度信号不可互换，冻结探针尤其可能误导。端到端contain-gate可降低伤害，但实际部署中不知晓金标答案的门控只能修复极少数错误，表明可部署的自我纠错能力仍受限。

title: Preserve to Expand: Source-Aware Adaptation and Model Merging for Multilingual LLM-Based ASR
summary: Expanding multilingual ASR systems to new languages is challenging when adaptation must preserve previously supported languages without replaying source-language training data. We study this problem in connector-based Speech LLMs, where a trainable connector maps speech representations into a frozen large language model. We evaluate target-update construction and merging strategies for adapting the connector while preserving source-language performance. In single-target expansion, target-only fine-tuning and standard TIES merging learn new languages but cause severe source-language forgetting, while SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the best source-preserving trade-off. In multi-target expansion, update merging provides stable source retention, whereas recursive expansion can improve target adaptation under favorable orders but is highly order-sensitive. These results show that multilingual ASR expansion requires balancing target acquisition, source retention, and interactions among target-language updates.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在基于连接器的语音大模型（Speech LLM）中，如何在不重放源语言训练数据的前提下扩展新的多语言ASR能力，同时保持已支持语言的性能。
AI.motivation: 多语言ASR系统扩展到新语言时，若无法重放源语言训练数据，标准微调会导致严重的源语言遗忘；因此需要探索如何在仅更新连接器（connector）模块的条件下，平衡新语言习得与源语言保持。
AI.method: 在冻结LLM、仅训练连接器的架构下，系统性评估target-update的构建与合并策略：包括单目标扩展中的target-only微调、TIES合并、SSU-Wanda+TIES；以及多目标扩展中的更新合并与递归扩展（recursive expansion）方案。
AI.result: 单目标扩展中，target-only微调与标准TIES合并虽能学会新语言但造成严重源语言遗忘，SSU-Wanda+TIES在源语言保持上取得最佳权衡；多目标扩展中，更新合并能稳定保持源语言，而递归扩展在有利顺序下可提升目标适配，但对顺序高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 多语言ASR扩展需在新目标语言习得、源语言保持以及多目标更新之间的相互作用三方面取得平衡；连接器层面的更新构建与合并策略是实现无重放持续扩展的关键。

title: SEMA-Auto: Sighted and Efficient Multi-Turn Attack with Autonomy
summary: Existing jailbreak attackers fall into two classes: static planners fix their single- or multi-turn adversarial plans in advance, remaining simple but losing sight of the victim's replies, wasting turns and limiting transferability; interactive generators read each victim reply to generate the next-turn attack but require in-loop evaluators for success signals or hints, incurring substantial costs and inflated performance. Bridging this gap, we propose SEMA-Auto, a sighted and efficient multi-turn attacker with autonomy, interacting with the victim model and terminating the session by itself upon success. To stabilize its behaviors and boost its capabilities, SEMA-Auto is trained in two stages. Synthetic bootstrap tuning installs the notion of attack targets and conforming decisions by fine-tuning the base model with bootstrapped trajectories. Decision-supervised reinforcement learning then optimizes two objectives jointly yet separately, reinforcing the attack with higher jailbreak reward while supervising the decision at each turn against an absolute target. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) attack success rates (ASR) across multiple datasets, victims, and judges, outperforming all static and interactive baselines, within almost the fewest turns, demonstrating both effectiveness and efficiency. For example, SEMA-Auto performs a $76.0\%$ ASR@1 within an average of $3.0$ turns against DeepSeek-V4-Flash on AdvBench, while the best static baseline is $54.8\%$ with fixed $7$ turns and the best interactive baseline is $43.8\%$ in $3.7$ turns. Against safety-hardened frontier models, GPT-oss-120B, GPT-5.4, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and GPT-6-Astra, our counter-trained attacker achieves an average $59.6\%$ ASR@1 on HarmBench, $13.8\%$ over prior SOTA. Our code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/SEMA

AI.tldr: 提出SEMA-Auto，一种具备自主终止能力的"有感知"高效多轮越狱攻击器，通过合成引导微调+决策监督强化学习两阶段训练，在几乎最少轮数下取得SOTA攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱攻击分两类：静态规划器预先固定单/多轮攻击计划，简单但无视受害者回复，浪费轮次且迁移性差；交互式生成器逐轮读取回复生成下一轮攻击，但需在环评估器提供成功信号或提示，成本高且性能虚高。需弥合二者差距。
AI.method: SEMA-Auto与受害者模型交互并在成功时自主终止会话。两阶段训练：(1) 合成引导微调（synthetic bootstrap tuning），用引导生成的轨迹微调基座模型，植入攻击目标与符合性决策的概念；(2) 决策监督强化学习，联合但分离地优化两个目标——以更高越狱奖励强化攻击，同时每轮依据绝对目标监督决策。
AI.result: 在多数据集、多受害者、多评估器上取得SOTA ASR，优于所有静态与交互式基线，且轮数近乎最少。AdvBench上对DeepSeek-V4-Flash实现76.0% ASR@1、平均3.0轮（最佳静态基线54.8%@固定7轮，最佳交互基线43.8%@3.7轮）；对GPT-oss-120B、GPT-5.4、Claude-Haiku-4.5、GPT-6-Astra等加固前沿模型，在HarmBench上平均59.6% ASR@1，较此前SOTA提升13.8%。
AI.conclusion: SEMA-Auto兼顾有效性与效率，无需外部在环评估器即可自主判断终止，证明了"有感知+自主决策"多轮攻击范式的优越性；代码已开源。

title: From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM-Assisted Auditing
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. Reproduction artifacts available at https://github.com/harinechoi/confidence-auditing-reproduction
summary:
For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost.
  This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries.
  Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target--verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful.

AI.tldr: 该论文为LLM/MLLM评估中的两条路线——基于自置信度的分层人工审计与LLM-as-a-judge自动评估——建立统一统计框架，给出误差校正估计量、有限样本不确定性刻画及人工标注-总成本效率边界，并在MMLU-Pro/MMMU-Pro上验证。
AI.motivation: 模型自报置信度常失校准，但仍可能用于高效评估；LLM-as-a-judge虽可扩展替代人工审计，其收益取决于校准质量与推理成本。现有工作缺乏对两条评估路线的统一统计刻画及成本-精度权衡分析。
AI.method: (1) 直接审计：采用置信度分层抽样，在仅部分输出被验证的情况下恢复总体准确率，无需依赖已校准置信度；给出有限样本不确定性刻画，分析置信层高度不均衡对审计效率与标签分配的影响（等额分配 vs 比例分配）。(2) 评判辅助评估：以敏感度与假阳性率对judge建模，构造带校准不确定性的误差校正估计量。(3) 通过人工标签效率边界与总成本效率边界对两条路线进行比较。
AI.result: 在MMLU-Pro与MMMU-Pro上，失校准的自置信度仍可支撑统计有效的分层审计；在置信度分布高度不均衡时，比例分配相较等层等额分配显著降低估计误差。judge辅助评估中，仅少部分目标-验证器对满足理想化的人工标签效率条件，且自动推理成本进一步限制潜在节省。
AI.conclusion: 明确了置信度引导审计与自动验证在统计与经济层面各自适用的条件，为在有限审计预算下选择评估路线提供可量化的判据。

title: Natural Jammers: When Non-Robust Features Become Antagonistic
summary: Deep neural networks are known to rely on non-robust features that align poorly with human perception. Prior work has largely framed these features as opportunistic shortcuts that help standard models on clean data. We show instead that non-robust cues can be antagonistic: they can act as Natural Jammers that actively mislead standard models on clean, unmodified images. Using disagreement between a standard model and robust models as an analysis lens, we identify a Jammed Set on which robust models outperform standard models. We provide causal evidence for Spectral-spatial Locking: jamming arises only when high-frequency components are precisely aligned with specific spatial structures. Disrupting this lock through spectral filtering or small geometric shifts can restore correct predictions. Crucially, we uncover a Substitution Paradox: while individual jammers are fragile to geometric shifts, the aggregate prevalence of jamming remains approximately stable and is redistributed rather than eliminated under such transformations. Our results reframe natural non-robustness as a failure field over the empirical model-data geometry: one that redistributes rather than disappears under small transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文指出非鲁棒线索并非只是标准模型的“捷径”，而可作为“自然干扰器”(Natural Jammers) 在干净图像上主动误导标准模型；干扰源于频谱-空间锁定，且在小几何变换下呈现“替换悖论”——总量近似稳定、仅重新分配。
AI.motivation: 既有工作把非鲁棒特征理解为有助于标准模型在干净数据上表现的机会性捷径；作者希望反驳这一单一看法，揭示非鲁棒线索可以是对抗性的、主动造成干净样本上的错误。
AI.method: 以标准模型与鲁棒模型之间的预测分歧为分析视角，构建“Jammed Set”；通过频谱滤波与小幅几何平移等干预做因果实验，检验高频分量与特定空间结构的对齐关系。
AI.result: 发现鲁棒模型在 Jammed Set 上优于标准模型；干扰仅在“频谱-空间锁定”成立时出现，破坏锁定可恢复正确预测；同时观察到替换悖论：单个干扰器对几何变换敏感，但干扰的总体普遍度近似稳定，只是在样本间重新分配。
AI.conclusion: 自然非鲁棒性应被重新表述为经验模型-数据几何上的“失效场”(failure field)，该失效场在小变换下重新分配而非消失。

title: Zero-Shot Monocular Depth Estimation for Visual Perception in Lower-Limb Prostheses
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Integrated Systems in Medical Technologies 2026
summary: Monocular depth estimation has advanced rapidly with the development of foundation models that demonstrate strong zero-shot generalisation across diverse visual domains. However, the applicability of these models to visual perception for lower-limb prosthetics remains largely unexplored. Reliable depth perception is particularly important for prosthesis users, who often experience significant challenges when navigating stairs, uneven terrain, and other complex environments. To address this gap, we introduce the Lower-Limb Prosthesis (LP) dataset, a benchmark designed to evaluate depth perception from an emulated knee-level prosthetic viewpoint. Using this dataset, we evaluate four state-of-the-art monocular depth estimation foundation models. Our results provide the first systematic benchmark of monocular depth estimation performance from a prosthetic viewpoint, while highlighting both the challenges and the potential of deploying foundation models in prosthetic perception systems. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Ishivijay/lp_dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出下肢假肢（LP）数据集，用于从模拟膝部假肢视角评估单目深度估计基础模型的性能，并对四个先进模型进行系统基准测试。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计基础模型已在多视觉域展现强零样本泛化能力，但其在下肢假肢视觉感知中的适用性尚未被探索。假肢使用者在上下楼梯、不平整地形等复杂环境中亟需可靠深度感知，因此需要专门的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建Lower-Limb Prosthesis（LP）数据集，采集模拟膝部高度假肢视角的图像，并以其为基准，对四种最先进的单目深度估计基础模型进行评测。
AI.result: 给出了首个针对假肢视角的单目深度估计系统性基准结果，揭示基础模型在该场景下的性能表现与局限。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了假肢视觉感知中深度估计评估的空白，指出基础模型应用于假肢感知系统的挑战与潜力，并公开了代码与数据集。
